original: upodghātaprakaraṇam || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || vāgīśādyāḥ sumanasaḥ sarvārthānāmupakrame | yaṃ natvā kṛtakṛtyāḥ syustaṃ namāmi gajānanam || 1 || yasya niḥśvasitaṃ vedā yo vedebhyo'khilaṃ jagat | nirmame tamahaṃ vande vidyātīrthamaheśvaram || 2 || yatkaṭākṣena tadrūpaṃ dadhadvikramahīpatiḥ | ādiśanmādhavācāryaṃ vedārthasya prakāśane || 3 || ye pūrvottaramīmāṃse te vyākhyāyātisaṃgrahāt | kṛpālurmādhavācāryo vedārthaṃ vaktumudyataḥ || 4 || ādhvaryavasya yajñeṣu prādhānyānmākṛtaḥ purā | yajurvedo'tha hautrārthamṛgvedo vyākariṣyate || 5 || etasmin prathamo'dhyāyaḥ śrotavyaḥ saṃpradāyataḥ | vyutpannastāvatā sarvaṃ boddhuṃ śaknoti buddhimān || 6 ||
ṛgvedasya prāthamyena sarvatrājñātatvāt ' abhyarhitaṃ pūrvam ' iti nyāyenābhyarhitatvāt tadvyākhyānamādau yuktam |
prāthamyaṃ ca puruṣasūkte ' tasmādyajñātsarvahuta ṛcaḥ sāmāni jajñire |
tasmāt ' sahasraśīrṣā puruṣaḥ ' (ṛ.saṃ.10.90.1) ityuktāt parameśvarāt yajñāt yajanīyāt pūjanīyāt sarvahutaḥ sarvairhūyamānāt |
yadyapīndrādayastatra tatra hūyante tathāpi parameśvarasyaiva indrādirūpeṇāvasthānādavirodhaḥ |
tathā ca mantravarṇaḥ- ' indraṃ mitraṃ varuṇamagnimāhuratho divyaḥ sa suparṇo garutmān |
ekaṃ saddiprā bahudhā vadantyagniṃ yamaṃ mātari- śvānamāhuḥ ' (ṛ. saṃ. 1. 164. 46) iti |
vājasaneyinaścāmananti- ' tadyadidamāhuramuṃ yajāmuṃ yaje- tyekaikaṃ devametasyaiva sā visṛṣṭireṣa u hyeva sarve devāḥ ' (bṛ. u. 1. 4. 6) iti |

1. ṭa-ṭha-taktākṣeṇa | 2. ṭa-ṭha-sāyaṇācāryam | 3. ṭa-ṭha-sāyaṇācāryau | 4. va-pha-prathamādhyāyaḥ | ca-ta-pha-' sa prāha nṛpatiṃ rājan sāyaṇāyā~ mamānujaḥ | sarva vettyeṣa vedānāṃ vyākhyātṛvena yujyatām || ityukte mādhavācāryeṇa vīrabukamahīpatiḥ | anvagāt (ta-anvaśāt) sāyaṇācāryaṃ vedārthasya prakāśane '|| imau ślokau tṛtīyaślokānantaramadhikau dṛśyete | 5. ṭa-ṭha-' atra ' nāsti | 6. ta-tha-' tasmāt ' nāsti | 7. ca-cha-ja-'yajñāt ' nāsti | 8. ṭha-'pūjanīyāt ' nāsti | 9. ṭha-parameśvarasya | 10. ṭa-ṭha-prāthamyamātreṇa |
tathā ca taittirīyā āmanti - 'yadvai yajñasya sāmnā yajuṣā kriyate śithilaṃ tadyadvā tadṛddham' (tai. saṃ. 6. 5. 10. 3) iti |
tathā ca sarvavedagatāni brāhmaṇāni svāmihite'rthe viśvāsadāḍharyāya 'tadetadvā- bhyuktam' iti ṛgvedodāharanti ||
mantrākāṇḍe'pi yajurvedateṣu tatra tatrādhvaryuṇā prayojyā ṛco bahvya ājñātāḥ |
chandogāśca prāthamye sanakumāraṃ prati nāradavākyamevamāmanti - 'ṛgvedaṃ bhagavo'dhyemi yajurvedaṃ sāmavedamātharvaṇaṃ caturtham' (chāṃ. u. 7. 1. 2) iti |
tāpanīyopaniṣadyapi mantrājapādeṣu krameṇādhyayanamevāmanti - 'ṛgyajuḥ sāmātharvaṇaścatvāro vedāḥ sāṅgāḥ saśākhāścatvāraḥ pādā bhavanti' (nṛ. tā. u. 1. 2) iti |
arthajñānasya tu yajñānuṣṭhānārtha- tvāt tenra tu yajurvedasyaiva pradhānatvāt tadvākhyānamevādau yuktam |
tatraivādhāyaṃ ca kācidagvedāha - 'ṛcāṃ tvaḥ popamāste pupupvān gāyatraṃ tro gāyati śakkarīṣu |
brahmā svo vadati jātavidyāṃ yajñasya mātrāṃ vi mimīta u svaḥ' (ṛ. saṃ. 10. 71. 11) iti |
etasyā ṛcastātparyaṃ niruktakāro yārakaḥ saṃkṣipya darśayati - 'ityutthikrameṇāṃ viniyogamācaṣṭe' iti |
punarapi sa eva prathamaṃ pādaṃ vivṛṇoti - ṛcānekaḥ popamāste pupupvān hotargarcanī' (niru. 1.8) iti |
hotṛnāmaka eka ṛtvik yajñakāle svakīyavedagatāmṛcāṃ puṣṭiṃ kuruśāste |
bhijñapradeśevājñātānāmṛcāṃ saṃghamekatra saṃpādyaitāvadidaṃ śastamiti kṛtsniṃ karoti |
arcyate praśasyate'nayā devaviśeṣaḥ kriyāviśeṣastatsādhanaviśeṣo vā iti ṛkśabdavyutpattiriti |
atha dvitīyaṃ pādaṃ vivṛṇoti - 'gāyatrameko gāyati śakkarīpudgātā |
gāyatraṃ gāyateḥ stutikarmaṇaḥ śakya ṛcaḥ śaknote- stadyadābhivṛtramaśakdantuṃ tacchakarīṇāṃ śakkarītvamiti vijñāyate' iti |
udgātṛnāmakaḥ ekaḥ ṛtvik gāyatraśabdābhidheyaṃ stotraṃ śakkarīśabdābhidheyāsu ṛkṣu gāyati |
dhātūnāmanekārthatvena stuti- kriyāvācino gāyatidhāto rūpatvenoktaṃ gāyatraśabdaḥ |
vṛtraṃ śatruṃ hantuṃ śaknotyābhiḥ ṛgbhirityepā vyutpattiḥ karṣimaśritaṃ brāhmaṇe vijñāyate iti |
atha tṛtīyaṃ pādaṃ vivṛṇoti- 'brahmaṇo jāte jāte vidyāṃ vadati |
brahmānāmakaḥ ekaḥ ṛtvik jāte jāte tadā tadopayajñe prastute praṇayādikarmaṇi viṣām anujñāṃ vadati, 'brahmannapaḥ praṇeṣyāmi' ityevaṃ saṃbodhitaḥ san 'oṃ praṇaya' ityanujānāti |
tasmād yogyatāṃ dṛṣṭvā tattadajñaṃ jñātuṃ sati pramāde samādhotuṃ ca samarthaḥ iti |
tacca sāmarthyaṃ chandogā āma- nti - 'eṣa eva yajñastasya manaśca vāk ca vartanī tayoranyatarāṃ manasā saṃskaroti brahmā vācā hotā- pyurdgātā'nyatarām' (chāṃ. u. 4. 16. 1-2) iti |
kṛtsno yajñaḥ pramādarahitāya manasā samyaganu- ṣṭheyo vācā ca vedatrayoktamantrāḥ paṭhanīyāḥ |
tatra hotrādayastrayo militvā vāmṛpaṃ yajñamārgaṃ saṃskurvanti |
brahmā tu eka eva manorūpaṃ yajñamārgaṃ kṛtsnamapi saṃskaroti |

1. ca-cha-ṭa-ṇa-ya-nābhidhīyante | 2. ṭa-ṭha-'vedairāhatatvāt' nāsti | 3. ca-cha-jha-pha-śa-'prasiddham' nāsti | 4. ṭa-ṭha-varjitamaṃreṣu- chandogāstu | 5. ṭa-varjitamaṃreṣu-prāthamyena | 6. ṭa-ṭha-rhitatvāt tasya ādau | 7. ṭha-tyevamucyate; ṭha-pratyucyate | 8. ṭa-ṭha-astyeva | 9. ṭa-ṭha-brahmavādādau; ṭha-brahmajādau | 10. ṭha-'tu' nāsti | 11. ṭha-tasya | 12. ṭa-ṭha-ca | 13. ṭa-prādhānyam | 14. gha-ca-cha-ṇa-ta-tha-pa-pha-śa-saṃghātaṃ | 15. ga-gha-ca-ṭa-pha-śa-vyutpatteriti | 16. ṭha-sāma | 17. ca-ta-pa-'ayam' nāsti | 18. ṭa-ṭha- 'śatrum' nāsti | 19. ṭa-ṭha-'jāte jāte' nāsti | 20. ṭa-ṭha- 'yajñe' nāsti | 21. ṭa-tavaduṇudhātuḥ... saṃbhātum | 22. gha-cha-ṇa-ta-tha-na-ya-vākyam |
viṣṇunoti—'yajñasya mātrāṃ vinimīta eko'dhvaryuryajñasya yajñasya netā' iti|
adhvaryunāmakaḥ ekaḥ ṛtvik yajñasya mātrāṃ svarūpaṃ vinimīte viśeṣeṇa niṣpādayati|
mīyate nirmī- yate iti mātrā svarūpam|
' adhvaryuḥ' ityatra cāndhasyā prakriyayā luptam akāraṃ punaḥ prakṣipya 'adhvarayuḥ' iti nāma saṃpādanīyam|
etadevābhipretya adhvaryuvedasya yāganiṣpādakatvadyotakaṃ nirvacanaṃ yāsko darśayati—'mantrā mananācchandāṃsi chādanāt stomaḥ stavanādyurjayateḥ' (niru. 7. 12) iti|
evaṃ sati adhvaryusambandhini yajurvede niṣpannaṃ yajñaśarīramupajīvya tadapekṣitau stotraśastrarūpāyavau itareṇa veda- dvayena pūryate ityupajīvyasya yajurvedasya prathamato vyākhyānaṃ yuktam|
tata ūrdhvaṃ sāmnāmagāśritatvādubhayo- medhye prathamata ṛgyākhyānaṃ yuktamiti ṛgveda idānīṃ vyākhyāyate||
nanu veda eva tāvannāsti kutastadvāntaraviśeṣa ṛgvedaḥ|
na hi tatra lakṣaṇaṃ pramāṇaṃ vāsti|
'lakṣaṇapramāṇābhyāṃ hi vastu- siddhiḥ' iti nyāyavidāṃ matam||
pratyakṣānumānāgameṣu pramāṇaviśeṣeṣu antimo veda iti tallakṣaṇamiti cet|
'apauruṣeyatve sati' iti viśeṣaṇāt adoṣaḥ iti cet|
'ṛgveda evāgre- rajāyata yajurvedo vāyoḥ sāmaveda ādityāt' (ai. brā. 5. 32) iti|
īdṛśo mantraḥ īdṛśaṃ brāhmaṇam itya- nayoravyāpyanirṇayatvāt|
'ṛgvedaṃ bhagavo'dhyemi yajurvedaṃ sāmavedamātharvaṇaṃ caturtham' (chāṃ. u. 7. 1. 2) ityādivākyaṃ pramāṇamiti cet|
'veda eva dvijātīnāṃ niḥśreyasakaraḥ paraḥ' (yājña. 1. 40) ityādismṛtivākyaṃ pramāṇamiti cet|
vedaviṣayā tu lokaprasiddhiḥ sārvajanīnāpi 'nīlaṃ nabhaḥ' ityādivat bhrāntā|
tasmāt lakṣaṇapramāṇarahitasya vedasya sadbhāvo nāṅgīkartuṃ śakyate' iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ||
8. ca-pa-pha-karmaphalaśarīra- rūpadhāri'; ṭa-ṭha- 'karmaphalarūpa......vivakṣitamiti cet na' ityasya sthāne 'śarīradhāritvaṃ na vivakṣitamiti cet na' iti pāṭhaḥ|
9. ṭa-ṭha- 'tasyāpi vākyasya......prasaṅgāt' ityasya sthāne 'svavākye hyasya prāmāṇyādarśanāt'|
svaprakāśakatvamaviruddhaṃ, tathā manuṣyādīnāṃ khaskandhāhorāhasaṃbhave'pi akuṇṭhitaśaktervedasya itaravastupratipāda- katvavat svapratipādakatvamapyastu |

ata eva saṃpradāyavidaḥ akuṇṭhitāṃ śaktiṃ vedasya darśayanti--'codanā hi bhūtaṃ bhavantaṃ bhaviṣyantaṃ sūkṣmaṃ vyavahitaṃ viprakṛṣṭamityevaṃjātīyakamarthaṃ śaknotyavagamayitum' (śāba. bhā. 1. 1. 2) iti |
tathā sati vedamūlāyāḥ smṛtestadubhayamūlāyā lokaprasiddheśca prāmāṇyaṃ durvvāram |
tasmāt lakṣaṇapramāṇasiddho vedo na kenāpi cārvākādinā apoḍhuṃ śakyate iti sthitam ||
'amyaksā ta indra ṛṣṭiḥ' (ṛ. saṃ. 1. 169. 3) ityeko mantraḥ |
eteṣvanubhava eva yadā nāsti tadā tatsamyaktvaṃ tadīyasādhanatvaṃ ca dūrāpetam |
'adhaḥ svidāsīdupari svidāsīt' (ṛ. saṃ. 10. 129. 5) iti mantrasya bodhakave'pi sthāṇurvā puruṣo vā ityādivākyavat saṃdi- gdhārthabodhakatvāccāsti prāmāṇyam |
'opadhe āyasvenam' (tai. saṃ. 1. 2. 1. 1) iti mantro darbha- viṣayaḥ (āśva. gṛ. 1. 17. 8) |
'svadhite mainaṃ hiṃsīḥ' (tai. saṃ. 1. 2. 1. 1) iti kṣuraviṣayaḥ (āśva. gṛ. 1. 17. 9) |

'eka eva rudro na dvitīyāya tasthe' (tai. saṃ. 1. 8. 6. 1), 'sahasrāṇi sahasraśo ye rudrā adhi bhūmyām' (tai. saṃ. 4. 5. 11. 1) ityanayostu mantrayoḥ 'yāvajjīvamahaṃ maunī' iti vākyavat vyāghātabodhakatvādāprāmāṇyam |
'āpa udantu' (tai. saṃ. 1. 2. 1. 1) iti mantro yajamānasya kṣaurakāle jelena śiraḥ kledanaṃ brūte |
'śubhike śira āroha śobhayantī mukhaṃ mama' iti mantro vivāhakāle maṅgalacaraṇārthaṃ puṣpanirmitāyāḥ śubhikāyā varavadhvoḥ śirastvasthānaṃ brūte |
ata evātra lokanyāyamudāharanti—'naipa sthāṇoraparādho yadenamandho na paśyati puruṣāparādhaḥ sa bhavati' (niru. 1. 16) iti |
'adhaḥ svidāsīt' iti mantraśca na sandehaprabodhanāyai pravṛttaḥ |
kiṃ tarhi jagatkāraṇasya paravastuno'tigambhīratvaṃ niśretumeva pravṛttaḥ |
tadarthameva hi guruśāstra- saṃpradāyahitairdubodhatvam 'adhaḥ svit' ityanayā vacobhaṅgayopanyasyati |
sa evābhiprāya upariteneṣu 'ko addhā veda' (ṛ. saṃ. 10. 129. 6) ityādimantreṣu spaṣṭīkṛtaḥ |
opadhyādimantreṣvapi cetanā eva tattadabhimānidevatāḥ tena tena nāmnā saṃbodhyante |
tāścadevatā bhagavatā bādarāyaṇena 'abhimānivyapadeśastu' (bra. sū. 2. 1. 5) iti sūtre sūcitāḥ |

1. ṭa-ta-varjitarepu-svaprakāśatvam | 2. ṭa-ṭha-lakṣaṇasiddhī | 3. ga-gha-ca-cha-ṇa-ta-tha-pa-ya- śakyaḥ | 4. ta-tha-ityetayostu; ṭha-iti vākyayoḥ | 5. ṭa-'śirasaḥ' nāsti | ṭha-'jalena śirasaḥ' nāsti | 6. ca-ṭa-ṭha-°nāmabodho | 7. ṭa-ta-tha-sandehabodhanāya | 8. ka-jha-śa-'durbodhatvam | 9. ṭa-jaladravyeṇa | 10. ta-'lokasiddhatvepi; ṭa-'api' nāsti |
etadevābhipretya bhagavān jaiminiḥ mantrādhikaraṇe mantrāṇāṃ vivakṣitārthatvamasūtayat (jai. sū. 1. 2. 31-45 )|
yasyārthasyābhidhāne samartho mantraḥ sa evābhidheyo yasya śāstrasya brāhmaṇa- vākyasya tadidaṃ vākyaṃ tadarthaśāstram |
tathā hi ‘uru prathasva’ (tai. saṃ. 1. 1. 8; vā. saṃ. 1.22 ) iti mantreṇa puroḍāśaprathana mabhidhīyate |
‘puroḍāśaṃ prathayati’ (tai. brā. 3. 2. 8. 4; śa. brā. 1. 2. 2. 8 ) iti brāhmaṇenāpi tadevābhidhīyate |
tathā saiti mantreṇaiva pratītatvāt tadarthabodhanāya pravṛttaṃ brāhmaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt |
nanu uccāraṇārthatve sati adṛṣṭaṃ prayojanaṃ parikalpyeta |
tasmāt brāhmaṇasyānuvādakatvamabhyupetyāpi mantrasyābhidhāyakatvameva ityāśaṅkya uttaraṃ sūtrayati—
‘agnimūrdhā divaḥ kakut’ (ṛ. saṃ. 8. 44. 16 ) ityevameva vākyaṃ paṭhitavyamiti mantre niyama upalabhyate |
nanu pāṭhakamaniyamamātrasya adṛṣṭārthatve'pi mantrapāṭho'rthabodhārtha eva ityāśaṅkya tatra doṣāntaraṃ sūtrayati—
tacca agnibihāraṇādikam ābhīdhreṇa adhyayanakāle eva svakartavyatvena buddham |
tasya ca buddhasyā- rthasya punarmantroccāraṇena śāsanamanarthakam |
na hi sopānatke pāde punarapyupānahaṃ pratimuñcati ||
nanu buddhasyā- pyarthasya prāmādikavismaraṇaparihārāya mantreṇa smaraṇamastu ityāśaṅkya doṣāntaraṃ sūtrayati—
‘catvāri śṛṅgā trayo asya pādā dve śīrṣe sapta hastāso asya’ (ṛ. saṃ. 4. 58. 3 ) iti mantra āmnāyate |
na khalu catuḥśṛṅgādyupetaṃ kiñcit yajñasādhanaṃ vidyate yanmantrapāṭhenānusmaryeta ||
nanu īdṛśī kāciddevatā syāt ityāśaṅkya anyaṃ doṣaṃ sūtrayati—
‘oṣadhe trāyasvainam’, ‘śṛṇota grāvāṇaḥ’ ityādau acetane dravye cetanocitairaṅgaiścāvagādhārthaṃ badhnāti |
nanu ‘abhimānivyapadeśa’ iti vaiyāsikaśāstre sūcitatvāt oṣadhyādyabhimānidevatātvaṃ vivakṣitaṃmityāśaṅkya doṣāntaraṃ sūtrayati—
evaṃ ‘eka eva rudraḥ’ (tai. saṃ. 1. 8. 6. 1 ), ‘sahasrāṇi sahasraśo ye rudrāḥ’ (tai. saṃ. 4. 5. 11. 1 ) ityādikamapyudāhartavyam ||
nanu ‘tvameva mātā ca pitā tvameva’ ityādibat antarikṣādirūpatvena aditiḥ stūyate |
pūrṇikā nāma kācit yoṣit avaghātaṃ karoti |
na ca tasyārthaprakāśanavivakṣā'sti, pratimusalapraharaṃ tasya mantrasyāpyamānatvāt |
tatra svādhyāyakāle paṭhito- pyavaghātamantro yathā pūrṇikā prati svārthaṃ na brūte tathā karmakāle'pi svārthaṃ na vakṣyati ||

1. ṭa-ṭha-masūyat | 2. ṭa-ṭha-śāstrasya ’ nāsti | 3. ṭa-ṭha-tathāpi | 4. ca-ṭa-brāhmaṇavākyamanarthakam | 5. ṭa-ṭha-dṛṣṭaṃ prayojanaṃ labhyate | 6. ta-vādatvaṃ | 7. ca-cha-pa-pha-pāṭhārthaṃ | 8. jha-ṇa-na-śa-buddhārthasya | 9. ṭa-ṭha-icchanti; ga-gha-pha-pratimuñcanti | 10. ca-cha-ṭa-pa-pha-°syārthasya | 11. ta-anya doṣam | 12. ga-gha-ca-cha-ta-ṇa-pa-pha-ya-°nusmaryate | 13. ta-°citaṃ rakṣaṇaṃ | 14. tha-°taccāyuktam | 15. ṭha-pratipādyatā | 16. ca-cha-tha-pa-pha-’ evam ’ nāsti | 17. ṭa-ṭha-nāsti virodhaḥ |
karmaṇi tu avyavorarthavivakṣā vidyate, bodhaśca saṃbhavati ityāśaṅkya doṣāntaraṃ sūtrayati— ‘avijñeyāt’ iti |
tathathā—‘ambaksā ta indra ṛṣi- rasme’ ityeko mantraḥ |
nanu īdṛśamantrārthabodhādyaiva nigama- nirukta-vyākaragāni pravṛttānītyāśaṅkya doṣāntaraṃ sūtrayati— ‘anityasaṃyogānmantrānarthakyam’ iti |
‘kiṃ te kṛṇvanti kīkaṭeṣu’ (ṛ. saṃ. 3. 53. 14) iti mantre kīkaṭo nāma janapada āmnātaḥ |
tathā naicāśākhaṃ nāma nagaraṃ pramagando nāma rājā ityete'rthā anityā āmnātāḥ |
tathā cai sati prāk pramagandāt nāyaṃ mantro bhūtapūrve iti gamyate |
tathā sati yathā loke'rthapratyayā- nayaiva vākyamuccāryate tathā vaidikayāgaprayoge'pi draṣṭavyam |
nanu ‘agnirasi nārirasi’ ityārabhya ‘traiṣṭubhena tvā chandasā dade’ (tai. saṃ. 4. 1. 1. 3-4) iti mantra āmnātaḥ |
tenaiva mantreṇa pratīte'pi anyādāne punarbrāhmaṇe ‘tāṃ caturbhirbrimādatte’ (tai. saṃ. 5. 1. 1. 4) iti vidhīyate |
tadetadvidhānaṃ vyarthaṃ syādityāśaṅkyasottaraṃ sūtrayati— ‘guṇādyena punaḥśrutiḥ’ iti |
mantreṇa pratītasyārthasya brāhmaṇe yāpunaḥśravaṇaṃ tadetaccatuḥsaṃkhyālakṣaṇa- guṇavidhānārthatvenopayujyate |
etasya vidhānasyābhāve caturṇāṃ mantrāṇāṃ madhye yena kenāpyekana abhirā- dayeta ||
nanu ‘imāmagṛbhṇanraśanāmṛtasyetyetyābhidhānīmādatte’ (tai. saṃ. 5. 1. 2. 1) ityatra mantrasāmarthyā- deva prāptasya raśanādānasya punarbrāhmaṇavākyaṃ viniyojakamāmnāyate |
raśanādavasāmānyānyena prāptaṃ gardabharaśanāyā ādānaṃ bādhyata iti trayo doṣāḥ |
tvatpakṣe prakaraṇapāṭhamathyānupapattyā mantregānena ādānaṃ kuryāt iti vākyaṃ parikalpyate |
tena ca vākyena mantrādānayoḥ saṃbandhe siddhe’’ sati paścāt kiṃ viparyakramādānamiti vīkṣāyāṃ liṅgāt raśanāmātrasyādānamupetya gardabharaśanāyāḥ prāptirvaktavyā |
‘ityaśvābhidhānīm’ iti pratyakṣaṃ vākyena mantrādānayoḥ saṃbandhe ’sati liṅgāt raśanāmātre prāptamādānam ‘aśvābhidhānīm’ iti śrutvā viśeṣe vyavasthāpyate |
tato mantrasya nirā- kāṅkṣatvāt gardabharaśanāyā aprāptatvānāsti prāptabādhaḥ |
nanu ‘uru prathasveti prathayati’ iti brāhmaṇasya vaiyarthyaṃ tadavasthamevetyāśaṅkya uttaraṃ sūtrayati— ‘arthavādo vā’ iti |
nanu prathayatītyanenaiva vidhiśabdena prathamanamūha ‘yajña- patimeva’ ityādinā'rthavādena stotavyam |
tadeva tu prathane kutaḥ prāptamityāśaṅkya uttaraṃ sūtrayati—

1. ta-arthavivakṣā | 2. ca-pa-pha-niṣaṇṭhāni | 3. ṭa-ṭha-ca nāsti | 4. ṭa-ṭha-matratvam | 5. ṭha-vākyaṃ prayujyate | 6. ta-vaidike yāgaṃ | 7. ca-ta-pha-brāhmaṇe | 8. ka-jha-ṇa-ḍa-śa- ‘śabdo’ nāsti | 9. ṭa-ṭha-ādānaṃ | 10. ṭa-ṭha-ta-tha-taści | 11. ka-jha-na-śa-siddhe naisti | 12. ṭa-viṣayamā | 13. ṭa-ṭha-siddhe sati | 14. ṭa-avasthāpyate | 15. ṭha-tyanena |

'babaraḥ prāvāhaṇira- kāmayata' (tai. saṃ. 7. 1. 10. 2) ityanityānāṃ babarādīnāmarthānāṃ darśanāt tataḥ pūrvamasattvāt pauru- ṣeyo veda iti tasyottaramevaṃ sritaṃ- 'paraṃ tu śrutisāmānyamātram' (jai. sū. 1. 1. 31) iti|
na tu tatra anityo babarālyaḥ kaścitpuruṣo vivakṣitaḥ|
tathā sati bebereti śabdaṃ kurvan vāyurabhidhīyate|
tadevaṃ kasyacidapi doṣasyāsaṃbhavāt vivakṣitārthā mantrāḥ svārthaprakāśanāyaiva prayoktavyāḥ|
nanu arthaprakāśanāyatve sati dṛṣṭaṃ prayojanaṃ labhyate iti yuktimātramidamucyate|
na tvetadupodvalakaṃ kiṃcit śrautaṃ liṅgaṃ paśyāmaḥ ityāśaṅkya uttaraṃ sūtrayati- 'liṅgopadeśaśca tadarthavat' iti|
atra hupasthānamupadiśadbrāhmaṇam 'agne naya' (ṛ. saṃ. 1. 189. 1) ityanayā 'upatiṣṭheta' iti mantrapratīkaṃ paṭhitvā nopadiśati; kiṃtu āgneyyātvaliṅgena upadiśati|
yadā tasyāmṛci agniḥ prādhānyena pratipādyate tadā tasyā ṛcaḥ agnidevatā bhavati|
tathā sati āgneyyā iti devatāvācitaddhitāntanirdeśa upapadyate|
tasmāt ayamupa- deśaḥ tanmantravākyamarthavat iti bodhayati|
ato vivakṣitārthatvāt arthapratyayānāyarthaṃ prayogakāle mantroccāra- ṇam|
prakṛtāvāmnātasya mantrasya vikṛtau samavetārthatvāya taducitapadāntarasya prakṣepeṇa pāṭhaḥ ūhaḥ|
tadyathā 'anvenaṃ mātā manyatām anu pitā anu bhrātā' (tai. brā. 3. 6. 6. 1) iti prākṛtaḥ paśuviṣayo mantrapāṭhaḥ|
tasya ca mantrasya vikṛtau paśudvaye sati 'anvenau mātā manyatām' ityūhaḥ|
paśubahutve sati 'anvenān mātā manyatām' ityūhaḥ kartavyaḥ|
etanmantravyākhyānarūpaṃ brāhmaṇamevāmnāyate- 'na mātā vardhate na pitā' iti|
ekavacanāntasya mātṛśabdasya mātarau iti dvivacanāntatvena vā mātaraḥ iti bahuvacanāntatvena vā prayogaḥ śabdavṛddhiḥ|
tatra na tāvat śarīravṛddhirniṣedhuṃ śakyate, bālyakaumārayauvanādivayo'nusāreṇa tadvṛddheḥ pratyakṣatvāt|
mātṛśabdapitṛśabdayorviśeṣapākāreṇa vṛddhiniṣedhāt itarasya enam iti śabdasya arthānusāriṇī vṛddhiḥ sūcitā bhavati|
tatra yadyartho na vivakṣayeta tadā paśudvitve dvivacanaṃ paśubahutve bahuvacanaṃ ca kathamuhyeta|
sa caivamāmnā- yate- 'śataṃ himāḥ śataṃ varṣāṇi jīvīyāsmetyetadāha' (śa. brā. 2. 3. 4. 21) iti|
mantrāsyāvivakṣitārthatve tu kiṃ nāma tātparyaṃ mantre vyākhyāyeta|
tasmāt vivakṣitārthā mantrāḥ prayogakāle svārthaprakānāyoccāra- yitavyāḥ|
tatra saṃgrahaślokau- mantrā uru prathasveti kimadṛṣṭahetavaḥ|
4. ca-pa-pha-prakṛtipa'; ta-tha- prakṛtapa'; ṭha- 'prākṛta......paśudvaye sati' ityasya sthāne 'prākṛtapaśuviṣayamantrasya vikṛtau paśudvaye sati' iti|
'āgneyeyavaṃ puroḍāśaṃ nirvapanti dīkṣaṇīyam' (ai. brā. 1. 1) ityādyāḥ karmakāṇḍagatavidhayo'pravṛttapravartakāḥ |
'ātmā vā idameka evāgra āsīt' (ai. ā. 2. 4. 1) ityādayo brahmakāṇḍagato ajñātājñāpakāḥ |
tatra karma- kāṇḍagatānāṃ 'jatilayavāgvā vā juhuyādvīdhukayavāgvā vā' (tai. saṃ. 5. 4. 3. 2) ityādi vidhīnāṃ nāsti prāmāṇyam, pravṛttyayogyadravyavidhānena samyaganubhava
śākhāntarapāṭhaṃ nirākṛtya pāṭhāntaraṃ taittirīyāḥ āmanti- 'yadvātsūpapāvasānā ca svadhyavasānā veti pramāyuko yajamāmaḥ syāt' (tai. saṃ. 2. 1. 9. 6) iti nirākaraṇam |
'supacaraṇā ca svadhicaraṇā vetyeva brūyāt' iti pāṭhāntaraupadeśaḥ |
ṣoḍa- śigrahaṇādidvaṣaṇaṃ tu aśrutamīmāṃsāvṛttāntasya tavaiva śobhate |
pūrvamīmāṃsāyāṃ daśamādhyāyasyāṣṭamapāde ṣoḍaśino grahaṇāgrahaṇavikalpo nirṇītaḥ (jai. sū. 10. 8. 6) |
tadvaduttaramīmāṃsāyāṃ prathamādhyāyasya caturthapāde 'kāraṇatvena cākāśādiṣu yathāvyapadiṣṭeṣṭeḥ' (bra. sū. 1. 4. 14) ityasmin sūtre jagatkāraṇe paramātmani śrutivipratipattinirākṛtā |

dvitīyasyādhyāyasya prathamapāde ārambhaṇādhikaraṇe tu 'asadyapadeśānneti cenna dharmāntareṇa vākyaśeṣāt' (bra. sū. 2. 1. 17) iti sūtre taittirīya- vākyagatasya asacchabdasya na śūnyaparatvaṃ kintu avyaktāvasthāparatvam iti nirṇītam |
tathā jaiminiḥ codanāsūtre vidhivākyaṃ dharmaṃ pramāṇamiti pratijñāya aupattikasūtre tatprāmāṇyaṃ samarthayāmāsa (jai. sū. 1. 1. 2; 5) |
vyāso'pi 'śāstrayonitvāt' (bra. sū. 1. 1. 3) iti sūtre vedāntānāṃ brahmaṇi prāmāṇyaṃ pratijñāya 'tatta samenvayāt' (bra. sū. 1. 1. 4) ityadisūtraiḥ samarthayāmāsa |
arthavādabhāgasya prāmāṇyaṃ mahatā prayatnena jaiminiḥ samarthayāmāsa |
tatra pūrvapakṣaṃ sūtrayati-- 'āmnāyasya kriyārthatvādānarthakyamatadarthānāṃ tasmānnityamucyate' iti |
āmnāyasya sarvasya kriyāpratipādanāya pravṛttatvātkriyāpratipādakānāmanarthavedāṃnāṃ nāsti kaścit vivakṣitaḥ svārthaḥ |

te cārtha- vādā evamāmnāyante-'so'rodīdyadarodīttadrudrasya rutvam' (tai. saṃ. 1. 5. 1. 1), 'sa āmano vapā- mudakhidat' (tai. saṃ. 2. 1. 1. 4), 'devā vai devayajanamadhyavasāya diśo na prājānan' (tai. saṃ. 6. 1. 5. 1) iti |
yasmādīdṛśasya vākyasya vivakṣitārthaḥ kaścidapi nāsti tasmādidaṃ vākyamanitya- mucyate |
yadyapyanāditvāt svarūpenānityatvaṃ nāsti tathāpi dharmabodhanalakṣaṇasya niyakāryasyābhāvāt anityaiḥ kāvyālāpaiḥ samānatvāt apramāṇamityarthaḥ ||
nanu udāhṛtānāmarthavādānāmanuṣṭheye dharme prāmāṇyā- bhāve'pi svārthe prāmāṇyamastu |

tatpratyāyakatvena svataḥ prāmāṇyasyāpavāditumaśakyatvāt ityāśaṅkaya anyeyu keṣucidarthavādeṣu mānāntaravirodhadarśanādaprāmāṇye sati tad dṛṣṭāntena sarveṣāmarthavādānāmaprāmāṇya- mityebhiprayatya sūtrayati-- 'śāstradṛṣṭavirodhācca' iti |
śāstravirodho dṛṣṭavirodhaḥ śāstradṛṣṭavirodhaḥ iti trividho virodho'rthavādeṣūpalabhyate |
tathā hi 'stenaṃ mano'nṛtavādinī vāk' ityatra śrūyamāṇaṃ mānasaṃ cauryaṃ vācikamanṛtaṃvedanaṃ ca pratiṣedhaśāstreṇa viruddham |
'tasmādbrahmavāmerdevā dadṛśe nācintsmādadhire- vāprenarkaṃ dadṛśe na dhūmaḥ' ityatra dṛṣṭavirodhaḥ |
tathā 'na caitadvidmo vayaṃ brāhmaṇā vā smoṃ'brāhmaṇā vā' ityatrāpi pratyakṣavirodhaḥ |
'ko hi tadveda yadyamuṣmi~lloke'sti vā na vā' (tai. saṃ. 6. 1. 1. 1)

1. ṭha-nirasya | 2. ṭha-pāṭhopadeśaḥ | 3. ca-pha-tadvidhiṣu; pa-tat vidhivat | 4. ṭa-ṭha-tathaiva param | 5. ṭa-ṭha-'tadvat' nāsti; ta-tha-varjamitareṣu-taduttara | 6. ga-ca-cha-ṇa-pha-ya-śruterviṃ | 7. ṭa-dvitīyādhyā- yasya | 8. ṭa-varjamitareṣu-' ārambhāthiṃ' | 9. ka-kha- ṭa-ṭha-na-'yonitvasūtre | 10. ṭa-ṭha-'nyādādibhiḥ sūtraiḥ | 11. ka-kha-ca-cha-ṇa-na-duṣparihāraḥ | 12. ṭa-ṭha-siddham | 13. ṭa-ṭha-prayāsena | 14. ṭa-ṭha- vyākhyāyante | 15. ca-pha-pravṛttitvā | 16. ṭa-'arthavādānām' nāsti | 17. ṭa- 'tvarthaḥ; ṭha-arthaḥ | 18. ṭa-ṭha-vivakṣito'rthaḥ | 19. ṭha-'api' nāsti | 20. ṭa-virodhādaprāmāṇyadarśane | 21. ca-cha-pa-pha- 'iti' nāsti | 22. ṭa-ṭha-'nṛtavacanam |

nanu 'so'rodīt' ityādīnāṃ niṣprayojanatvāt 'stenaṃ manaḥ' ityādīnāṃ ca virodhādaprāmāṇye'pi phalapratipādakānāṃ arthavādānāṃ tadubhayavailakṣaṇyāt astu prāmāṇyamityāśaṅkya uttaraṃ sūtrayati- tatra phalābhāvāt' iti |
tathā hi gargatrirātraṃ prakṛtya śrūyate- 'śobhate'sya mukhaṃ ya evaṃ veda' (tāṇḍya. brā. 20. 16. 6) iti |
darśapūrṇamāsayordevābhimarśanaṃ prakṛtya śrūyate- 'āsya prajāyāṃ vājī jāyate ya evaṃ veda' (tai. saṃ. 1. 7. 4. 6) iti |
nanu aihikaphalavākyānāṃ visaṃvādāt aprāmā- ṇye'pi āmuṣmikaphalavākyānāmastu prāmāṇyamityāśaṅkya uttaraṃ sūtrayati
nanu "suyajñena vidhīnāṃ syuḥ" iti yaduktaṃ tat asat vaiyadhikaraṇyāt |
'vetasaśākhayā cāvakābhiśca vi kalpyāpo vai śāntāḥ' (tai. saṃ. 5. 4. 4. 3) ityatra vetasāvake vidhīyete āpaśca stūyante iti vaiya- dhikaraṇyamityāśaṅkayāha- 'gugatrādastu' iti |
yathā loke kaśmīrābhijanoṃ devadattaḥ kāśmīradeśeṣu stūyamāneṣu stutamātmānaṃ manyate evamatrāpi abhyau jāte vetasāvake asu stutāsu stute evaṃ bhavataḥ |
śāntābhyo'bhyau jātatvāt vetasāvake svayamapi śānte sakhyau yajamānasthāniṣṭaṃ śamayataḥ ityetādṛśasya guṇasya vādo'trābhipretaḥ |
'so'rodīt' ityatrāpi rajatasya patitāśrurūpatvāt rajatadāne gṛhe'pi rodanaprasaṅgāt 'barhiṣi rajataṃ na deyam' iti tanniṣedhena vidheyanārthavādasyaikavākyatvam |
tena ca guṇena rajatadānanivāraṇarūpo vidhiḥ stūyate |
yadyapi rajatasya aśruprabhavatvamatyantamasat tathāpi yathoktarītyā vidheḥ stutiḥ saṃpadyate |
'yaḥ prajākāmaḥ paśukāmaḥ syātsa etaṃ prājāpatyamajaṃ tūpara- mālabheta' (tai. saṃ. 2. 1. 1. 4-5) ityayaṃ vidhiḥ prajāpatitvapoṣatvena stūyate |
yasmāt prajāpatiḥ svapoṣamapi uskhitha agnau prahavya tato jātaṃ tūparam ajam ātmārthamālabhya prajāḥ paśūṃśca labdhavān, tasmāt prajādisaṃpādako'yaṃ tūparaḥ iti tūparaguṇasya vādo'tra vivakṣitaḥ |
'ādityaḥ prāyaṇīyaśvaraḥ' ityeṣa vidhiḥ 'diśo na prājānan' ityanena diṅmohena stūyate |

yadidaṃmaditidevatā diṅmo- hamapyapanīya dvigviśeṣaṃ jñāpayati tadā bahuvidhakarmasamudāyarūpe somayāge'nuṣṭhānaviṣayaṃ bhramamapanayatīti kimu vaktavyamityevam aditidevatāgatasya guṇasya vādo'tra vivakṣitaḥ |
svakīyavapoṣedoṃ devayajanādhyavasānamātreṇa diṅmohahetubhayamatu vā mā vā |
'śikhā te vardhate vasta guhyī śraddhayā piba' ityādyāvavidyamānenāpyathena loke stutidarśanāt ||
atha pūrvapakṣiṇā śāstravirodhaṃ darśayituṃ yadudāhṛtaṃ 'stainaṃ mano'nṛtavādinī vāk' iti tatrottaraṃ sūtrayati- 'rūpāāyāta' iti |
'hiraṇyaṃ haste bhavatyatha gṛhṇāti' ityetaṃ vidhiṃ stotumayamarthavāda ucyate |

yathā loke 'kimmipiṇā devadatta eva pūjayitavya ityatra devadattapūjāṃ stotumeva audāsīnyamṛṣāpyupanyasyate, na tu pūjyatvamapyevāryitum; evamatrāpi haste hiraṇyagrahaṇaṃ praśaṃsituṃ manasaḥ stenarūpatvaṃ vāco'nṛtavāditvaṃ copanyasyate |
yathā stenāḥ pracchanna- rūpā evaṃ mano'pīti pracchannarūpatvamatraguṇaḥ |
prāyeṇa vāganṛtaṃ vakti iti prāyikatvaṃ tatra guṇaḥ |
yadapi dṛṣṭavirodhāya 'dhūma evāgnerdevā dadṛśe' ityādikamudāhṛtaṃ tatrottaraṃ sūtrayati- 'dūrabhūyastvāt' iti |
'agnihotraṃ jyotirjyotirmiḥ svāheti sāyaṃ juhoti', 'sūryo jyotirjyotiḥ sūryaḥ svāheti prātaḥ' ityetau vidhī stotuṃ so'rthavādaḥ |
yasmāt arcirdivā na dṛśyate tasmāt sūryamantra eva prātaḥ prayoktavyaḥ |
yasmāt rātrāvacireva dṛśyate tasmāt agnimantro rātrau prayoktavya ityevaṃ tayormantrayoḥ stutiḥ |
bhūyasi hi dūre parvatāgre vṛkṣādayo'pi na vispaṣṭaṃ dṛśyante, kiṃtu tṛṇasādṛśyena teṣāṃ darśanābhāsa eva |
3. ta-'eva' nāsti; tha-'stute eva' ityasya sthāne 'te eva stute' |
yadapyanyadṛṣṭavirodhādyevodāhṛtaṃ ‘na caitadvibho vayaṃ brāhmaṇā vā smo'brāhmaṇā vā’ iti tatrottaraṃ sūtrayati—
‘pradhare pradhiyamāṇe brūyādevāḥ pitaraḥ’ ityasya vidheḥ stāvakako'yamarthavādaḥ |
yadi yajamāno ‘devāḥ pitaraḥ’ (tai. brā. 3. 7. 5. 4) ityādimantreṇa pravaramanumantrayet tadānīm abrāhmaṇo'pi brāhmaṇo bhavet ityanumantraṇasya stutiḥ |
yatra striyā aparādhā bhavati tatra karturapyadhiturjā rasyāpi putro dṛśyate |
ataḥ patyupapatyorubhayoḥ putradarśanāt svakīyajanmā kīdṛśamiti durjñānam |
na hi tatra dṛśyamānaṃ svabrāhmaṇyamapavadituṃ ‘na caitadvibhaḥ’ ityupapadyastam ||
yadi śāstrīyadarśanavirodhādyevodāhṛtaṃ ‘ko hi tadveda yadyamuṣmiṃlloke'sti yā na vā’ iti tatrottaraṃ sūtrayati—
sā ca ‘ko hi tadveda’ ityaniścayo'nyāse kāraṇam |
yathā bhāvikālīnaḥ pautraprapautrādi- vṛttānto niścetuṃ na śakyate, tadvat svargaprāptirbhāvikālīnati guṇayogādiścayopanyāsaḥ |
yadapyanyadṛṣṭavirodhādyevodāhṛtaṃ ‘śobhate'sya mukhaṃ ya evaṃ veda’ iti tatrottaraṃ sūtrayati—
yathā karṇābharaṇādinā mukhaṃ śobhitaṃ bhavati evaṃ vediturassāhenaiva vikasita vadanaṃ śobhitamiva śiṣyairdṛśyate |
yadapyanyadvirodhādyevodāhṛtaṃ ‘āsya prajāyāṃ vājī jāyate ya evaṃ veda’ iti so'pi vedānumantraṇavidheḥ śeṣaḥ |
vedituḥ putraḥ pitṛśikṣayā svayamapi vidvān bhavati |
yathā sarve brāhmaṇā bhojayitavyā ityatra sarvatvaṃ svagṛhāgatabrāhmaṇaviṣayam, evaṃ pūrṇāhutyā karmasāṅgatve yatphalaṃ tasminnadhikāre prastāve saṃbhāvitaṃ tadviṣayameva sarvatvaṃ draṣṭavyam |
pūrṇāhuterabhāve sati ādhānarūpaṃ karma aṅgavikalaṃ bhavati |
tacca vaikalyaṃ pūrṇāhutyā satrādhīyate ityekaḥ kāmaḥ |
tasmin samāhite sati āhavanīyādyamayo'gnihotrādikarmasu yogyā bhavantītyayamantaḥ kāmaḥ |
taiśca karmabhiḥ taphalaṃ prāpyate iti kāmāntaram |
īdṛśī sarvakāmāvāptiḥ āhutyantareṇapi triyate iti cet, vidyatāṃ nāma |
nanu pūrṇāhuteraṅgatvāt tadīyaphalaśruterarthavādatvena stāvakatvaṃ bhavatu, 'dravyasaṃskāra- karmasu parārthatvātphalaśrutirathaṃvādaḥ' (jai. sū. 4. 3. 1) iti sūtreṇa nirṇītatvāt |

paśubandhavākyasya tu karmavidhāyakatvāt sarvalokābhijayesya mukhyaphalatvādanānarthakyaṃ durvāramityāśaṅkya uttaraṃ sūtrayati— ' phalasya karmaniṣṭhasteṣāṃ lokavatparimāṇataḥ sārato vā phalaviśeṣaḥ syāt ' iti |
teṣāṃ ca pṛthivyā- dīnāṃ phalānāṃ karmāntareṇa parimāṇādhikyaṃ sāratvaṃ vā saṃpadyate |
yathā loke niṣkeṇa khārīparimitān vrīhīn vikrīya niṣkā- ntareṇa punaḥ kraye sati parimāṇādhikyaṃ bhavati |
yathā vā niṣkeṇa vakṣyamāṇaṃ labhyate niṣkadvayena tu sārabhūtaṃ dukūlam |
tathā bhogādhikyaṃ bhogasāratvaṃ vā karmāntareṇa draṣṭavyam |
brahmahatyāyā api mānasatvāḥ svargāyā vedanamātreṇa taraṇaṃ, kāyikāstu mahatyā aśvamedheneti nāsyānyānarthakyam ||
yo'pi ' nāntarikṣe na divi ' ityaprasaktapratiṣedha udāhṛtaḥ tathā ' babaraḥ prāvāhaṇiḥ ' ityanityasaṃyoga udāhṛtastalo- bhayottaraṃ sūtrayati—
antarikṣādau cayananindā rūpo'rthavādo ' hiraṇyaṃ nidhāya cetavyam ' ityasya vidheḥ śeṣaḥ |

' babaraḥ prāvāha- ṇirakāmayata ' ityatrāpi babaranāmakaḥ kaściditthaṃ: puruṣo manuṣyo na vivakṣitaḥ; kintu babaradhvaniyuktaḥ prakarṣaṇa vahanaśīlo vāyurvyavahāradaśāyāṃ niya evārtho vivakṣitaḥ ityetaduttaraṃ prathamapādasyāntimādhikaraṇe proktam |
na vidheye'sti dharme kiṃ kiṃ vā'sau tatra vidyate ||
tadevaṃ vede vidyamānānāṃ trayāṇāṃ mantravidhyarthavādabhāgānāmaprāmāṇyakāraṇābhāvāt bodhakānāṃ teṣāṃ prāmāṇyasya svatastvāṅgīkārāt kṛtsnasyāpi vedasya prāmāṇyaṃ siddham ||
nanu evamapi vedasya pauruṣeyatvena vipralambhakavākyavadaprāmāṇyaṃ syāt |
pauruṣeyatvaṃ ca prathamapāde pūrvapakṣatvena jaiminiḥ sūtrayāmāsa—(jai. sū. 1. 1. 27-32) ' vedāścaikaṃ sannikarṣaṃ puruṣākhyāḥ ' iti |
eke vādino vedān prati sannikarṣaṃ manyante |
yathā raghuvādya idānīṃ nāstathā vedā api |
vaiyāsikaṃ bhārataṃ vālmīkīyaṃ rāmāyaṇamityatra yathā bhāratādikartṛtvena vyāsādaya ākhyāyante, tathā kāṭhakaṃ kauthumaṃ taittirīyamityevaṃ tattaddeśākhākartṛtvena kaṭhādīnāmākhyāyatvāt vedāḥ

1. ṭa-ṭha-varjimatareṣu - śgabhāvatvāt | 2. ṭa-ṭha-sūtre | 3. ca-cha-ṭa-ṭha-ta-tha-pha-niṣpadyataṃ | 4. ta-tha-vikīṇāti | 5. ṭa-ṭha-' dukūlam ' nāsti | 6. ga-gha-ca-cha-ṇa-ta-tha-ja-pa-phya-nāstyānarthakyam | 7. ca-cha-sa-pa-pha-anayostadāharaṇayoḥ |
nanu nityānāmeva satāṃ vedānāmupādhyāyavat saṃpradāyapravartakatvena kāṭhakādisamākhyā syādi- tyāśaṅkya yuktyantaraṃ sūtrayati— ‘anityadarśanācca’ iti |
anityā jananamaraṇavanto babarādayo vede śrūyante—‘babaraḥ prāvāha- ṇirakāmayata’, ‘kusurubinda auhālakirakāmayata’ (tai. saṃ. 7. 2. 2. 1) iti |
vimataṃ vedavākyaṃ pauruṣeyaṃ, vākyatvāt, kālidāsādi- vākyavat ityādyanumānasamuccayārthaścakāraḥ ||
śabdasya vedarūpasya kāṭhādipuruṣebhyaḥ pūrvatvamanāditvaṃ prācīnaiva sūtre'uktam |
‘autpattikastu śabdasyārthena saṃbandhaḥ’ (jai. sū. 1. 1. 5) ityasmin sūtre autpattikaśabdena sarveṣāṃ śabdānāṃ vedānāṃ ta
nanu bhagavatā bādarāyaṇena vedasya brahmakāryatvaṃ sūtritaṃ—‘śāstrayonitvāt’ iti |
ihaśamapauruṣeyatvamabhipretya vyavahāradaśāyāmākāśādivat nityatvaṃ bādarāyaṇenaiva devatādhikaraṇe sūtritam—‘ata eva ca nityatvam’ (ba. sū. 1. 3. 29) iti |
‘anādinidhanā nityā vāgu- tsṛṣṭā svayaṃbhuvā’ (ma. śāṃ. 232. 23) iti smṛtiḥ |
tasmāt kartṛdoṣaśaṅkāyā anudayāt mantra- brāhmaṇakasya vedasya nirdoṣaṃ prāmāṇyaṃ siddham ||
nanu mantrabrāhmaṇatvaṃ vedasya na yuktaṃ, tayoḥ svarūpasya nirṇetumaśakyatvāt |
saptamādhikaraṇamāracayati— ahe budhinaya mantraṃ sa iti mantrasya lakṣaṇam |
ādhāne idamamnāyate—‘ahe budhniya mantraṃ me gopāya’ (tai. brā. 1. 2. 1. 26) iti |
ityukte ‘vasantaya kapiñjanānālabhate’ (vā. saṃ. 24. 20) ityasya mantrasya vidhirūpatvādyāsyati |
evam abhidadhāno mantraḥ, uttamapurupānto mantraḥ, ityādilakṣaṇānāṃ parasparamavyāptiriti cet, maivam |
‘agna ā yāhi vītaye’ (tai. brā. 3. 5. 2. 1) ityādaya āmantraṇo- petāḥ |
‘ambe ambālyambike na mā nayati kaścana’ (tai. saṃ. 7. 4. 16. 1) ityādayaḥ paridevanarūpāḥ |
‘pṛcchāmi tvā paramantaṃ pṛthivyāḥ’ (tai. saṃ. 7. 4. 16. 2) ityādaya uttararūpāḥ |
itthamevamanvijātīyeṣu samākhyānamantareṇa nānyaḥ kaścidanugato dharmo'sti yasya lakṣaṇatvamucyate |
lakṣaṇasya copayogaḥ pūrvācāryairdarśitaḥ— ṛṣyo'pi padārthānāṃ nāntaṃ yānti pṛthakvaśaḥ |
mantraśca brāhmaṇaṃ ceti dvau bhāgau tena mantrataḥ |
vedabhāgānāmiyattāvadhāraṇaṇa brāhmaṇabhāgeṣvanyabhāgeṣu ca lakṣaṇasyā- vyāptitbyāptyoḥ śodhayitumaśakyatvāt |
bhāgāntarāṇi ca kānicit pūrvairudā- hṛtaṃ saṃgṛhītāni — heturnirvacanaṃ nindā praśaṃsā saṃśayo vidhiḥ |
'taṃ vyacikisañjuhavāmī 3 mā hauṣā 3 m' (tai. saṃ. 6. 5. 9. 1) iti saṃśayaḥ |
na ca hetvādīnāmantyataṃ brāhmaṇamiti lakṣaṇaṃ, mantreṣvapi hetvādisadbhāvāt |
'handvā vai bāhubhiriti hi' (ṛ. saṃ. 1. 2. 4) iti hetuḥ |
'adhaḥ svidāsau 3 ścupari svidāsau 3 t' iti saṃśayaḥ |
'ityadadā ityayajathā ityapaca iti brāhmaṇo gāyet' (tai. brā. 3. 9. 14. 3) ityasmin brāhmaṇe gātavye mantre'tivyāpteḥ |
'ityāha' ityanena vākyenopa- nibaddhaṃ brāhmaṇamiti cet, na |
'rājā ciyaṃ bhagaṃ bhakṣītyāha' (ṛ. saṃ. 7. 41. 2), 'yo māyātuṃ yātudhānetyāha yo vā rakṣāḥ śucirasmītyāha' (ṛ. saṃ. 7. 104. 16) ityanayormantrayorativyāpteḥ |
tasmāt nāsti brāhmaṇasya lakṣaṇamiti prāpte' brūmaḥ |
mantrabrāhmaṇarayau dvāveva vedabhāgau ityaṅgīkārāt mantralakṣaṇasya pūrvamabhihita- tvādavaśiṣṭo vedabhāgo brāhmaṇamityevalakṣaṇaṃ bhaviṣyati |
tadetalakṣaṇadvayaṃ jaiminiḥ sūtrayāmāsa—'tayorṛkṣu mantrākhyā', 'śeṣe brāhmaṇaśabdaḥ' (jai. sū. 2. 1. 32-33) iti |
tadyorṛkṣu tadabhidhāyakeṣu vākyeṣu mantra iti samākhyā saṃpradāyavicchinnavadahiyate—'mantrānadhīmahe' iti |
nanu brahmayajñaprakaraṇe mantrabrāhmaṇavyatiriktā itihāsadayo bhāgā āmnāyante—'yadbrāhmaṇānīti- hāsānupapurāṇāni gāthā nārāśaṃsīḥ' (tai. ā. 2. 9) iti |
'idaṃ vā agre naiva kiṃcanāsīt' (tai. brā. 2. 2. 9. 1) ityādikaṃ jagataḥ prāgavasthāsupakramya sargapratipādakaṃ vākyajātaṃ purāṇam |
agnicayane 'yamagāthābhiḥ pari gāyati' (tai. saṃ. 5. 1. 8. 2) iti vihitā mantraviśeṣā
tasmāt mantrabrāhmaṇavyatiriktabhāgābhāvāt mantrabrāhmaṇasvarūpasya lakṣitatvāt tadubhayātmakatvaṃ vedasya susthitam ||
mantrāvāntaraviśeṣaśca tasminneva pāde itthaṃ vicāritaḥ— narvasāmayajuṣāṃ lakṣma sāṃkaryāditi śaṅkite |
idamamnāyate—'ahe budhniya mantraṃ me gopāya yamṛṣayastraividā viduḥ |
te ca yaṃ mantrabhāgam ṛgādirūpeṇa trividhamāhustaṃ gopāya iti yojanā |
adhyāpakaprasiddheṣuvedādiṣu paṭhito mantra iti lakṣaṇaṃ vaktavyam |
'devo vaḥ savitopyunātvacchidreṇa pavitreṇa vasoḥ sūryasya raśmibhiḥ' (tai. saṃ. 1. 1. 5. 1) ityayaṃ mantro yajurvede saṃpratiṛgyajuṣāṃ madhye paṭhitaḥ |
na ca tasya yajuṣṭvamasti tadbrāhmaṇe 'sāvitryarcā' (tai. brā. 3. 2. 5. 3) iti ṛgvena vyavahṛtatvāt |
'etatsāma gāyajāste' (tai. ā. 9.10.5) iti pratijñāya kiṃcit sāma yajurvede gītam |
'akṣita- masyacyutamasi prāṇasaṃśitamasi' (chāṃ. u.3. 17. 6) iti trīṇi yajūṃṣi sāmavede samāmnātāni |
tathā gīyamānasya sāmna āśrayabhūtā ṛcaḥ sāmavede samāmnāyante |
tasmāt nāsti lakṣaṇamiti cet, na, pādādīnāmasaṃkīrṇalakṣaṇatvāt |
pādenārthena copetaḥ vṛttabaddhaḥ mantrā ṛcaḥ, gītirūpā mantrāḥ sāmāni, vṛttagītivarjitatvena praśiṣṭapaṭhitā mantrā yajūṃṣi ityukte na kāpi saṃkaraḥ |
tadetat traividhyaṃ jaimininā sūtratrayeṇa lakṣitaṃ—'teṣāmṛgyatrārthavaśena pādavyavasthā', 'gītiṣu sāmākhyā', 'śeṣe yajuḥśabdaḥ' (jai.sū. 2. 1. 35-37) iti |
etameva mantrāvāntaraviśeṣamupajīvya vedānām ṛgvedo yajurvedaḥ sāma- veda iti traividhyaṃ saṃpannam ||
teṣāṃ ca vedānāṃ sarveṣāmanyatamasya vā svaprajñānusāreṇādhyayanamupanītena kartavyam |
tathā ca yājña- valkyaḥ smarati—'vedānadhītya vedau vā vedaṃ vāpi yathākramam' iti |
ekavedapakṣe pitṛpitāmahādiparaṃparā- prāpta eva vedo'dhyetavya ityabhipretya 'svādhyāyo'dhyetavyaḥ' (tai. ā. 2. 15) iti svaśabd āgnātaḥ |
ata eva puruṣārthānuśāsane sūtritam— 'vedādhyayanaṃ niyamanadhyayane pātāt' iti |
pātithyaṃ caivāmnāyate—'apahatapāpmā svādhyāyo devapavitraṃ vā etattaṃ yo'nṛtamyajābhāge vāca bhavatyabhāgo nāke tadepāmuktā yastiyāja sakhividaṃ sakhāthaṃ na tasya vācyapi bhāgo asti |
yadīṃ śṛṇotyalaṃ śṛṇoti nahi praveda sukṛtasya panthāmiti |
adhyetāraṃ puruṣaṃ tadīyaprayāsā- bhijñānena sakhivat pālayatīti sakhividvedaḥ |
tadapyāmrāyate—'yaṃ yaṃ kratumadhīte tena tenāyaṣṭaṃ bhavatyevādyorāyadityasya sāyujyaṃ gacchati' (tai. ā. 2. 15) iti |
yadyapyetat brahmayajñasvādhyāyaphalaṃ tathāpi grahaṇādhyāyanāmantareṇa brahmayajñā- saṃbhavāt tadīyaphalamapi saṃpadyate |
īdṛśaṃ sakhividhaṃ vedarūpaṃ sakhāyaṃ yaḥ pumānadhyayanaṃ kṛtvā parityajati tasya vācyapi bhāgyaṃ nāsti |
sakaladevatānāṃ dharmasya paramabrahmatvavattvaṃ ca pratipādakaṃ vedamamuṣyārthya parinindyānṛtakalahe hetuṃ laukikīṃ vārtāṃ sarvatroccārayataḥ spaṣṭa eva vāci bhāgyā- bhāvaḥ |
ata evāmnāyate—'nānudhyāyādbahuñchandānvāco viglāpanaṃ hi tat' (bṛ. u. 4. 4. 21) ||

1. ṭa-pādakāḥ | 2. ṭa-ṛbhumya ityādayo nārā | 3. ṭa-paṭhitā mantrāḥ | 4. ṭa-u-varjamitareṣu-saṃpratipanno yajuṣām | 5. ca-ca-cha-ṇa-pa-pha-gāyane | 6. ca-cha-ta-tha-pa-pha-samāmnātāḥ | 7. sa-cha-tha-pa-pha-nārthyena, ṭa-u-nārthena | 8. u-bhapagutha | 9. ṭa-ṭha sarvadoṣāḥ |
yadyapyasau kāvyanāṭakādikaṃ śṛṇoti tathāpi nirarthakameva tacchravaṇam |
sa jīvanneva śūdratvamāśu gacchati sāmvayaḥ' (manu. 2. 168) iti |
nanu adhīte vede paścādadhyayanavidheyarthaṃ jñānaṃ, jñāne sati paścādadhyayanapravṛttiḥ, ityanyonyāśraya iti cet, bāḍham |
ata eva gurumatānusāriṇaḥ ācāryakartṛkādhyāpanena pravṛttiṃ mānavakādhyayanasya mahatā prayāsena saṃgadayanti |
matāntarānusāristu prakāśamādyo'dhyayanāt prāgeva sandhyāvandanādividhijñānavat pitrādibhyo'dhyayanavidhijñānaṃ varṇayanti |
yadadhyāpanavidhiprayuktirvā svavidhiprayuktiḥ sarvathāpyupanītai- radhyetavya eva vedaḥ |
tasyai ca adhyayanasya dṛṣṭārthatvamakṣaragrahaṇagatatvaṃ ca puruṣārthānuśāsane sūtritam |
adhyayanasya dṛṣṭārthatvaṃ sādhayituṃ pūrvapakṣayati— 'adṛṣṭārthā tvadhītirvaihitatvāt' iti |
adṛṣṭaviśeṣo na śruta iti cet, tatrāha— 'ghṛtakulyādyatideśaḥ svargakalpaṃ vā' iti |
brahmayajñapadhyāyanārthavādaṃ nityādhyayane'tidiśya tatratyaṃ ghṛtakulyādikaṃ rātrisatranyāyena phalatvena kalpanīyam |
ye svarthavādātideśaṃ necchanti tairviśvajityāyena svargaḥ kalpanīyaḥ ||
dṛṣṭaphalayoḥ saṃskāraprāptyoḥ saṃbhave kathamadṛṣṭakalpanetyata āha— 'ayukte saṃskāraprāptau' iti ||
saṃskṛtasvādhyāyasya kvacit viniyogādarśanāt prāpteḥ svayama- gurupārthatvāccetyarthaḥ |

svādhyāyaprāptirarthamitihetutayā puruṣārtha ityāśaṅkya vipaniharaṇādikāryavini- yuktaramantravadadhyayanāṅgatayā viniyuktānāṃ jyotiṣṭomādivākyānāṃ na svārthe prāmāṇyamityāha— 'anyāṅgaṃ nārthapramāpakam' iti |
nanu evamadṛṣṭārthatve karmakārakabhūtasvādhyāyagataphalābhāvādhya- tavya iti karmavācī tavyapratyayo virudhyate ityata āha— 'saktuvakaraṇapariṇāmaḥ' iti |

'saktūñjuhoti' ityatra karmatvena pradhānabhūtān saktūnuddiśya homasaṃskāravidhāne pratīyamāne'pi homasaṃskṛtatāṃ bhasmībhūtānāṃ saktūnāmantya viniyogābhāvāt karmaprādhānyaṃ hitvā saktubhirjuhotīti karaṇapariṇāmaḥ kṛtaḥ |
evamatrāpi karmagatayoḥ saṃskāraprāptyo- rasaṃbhavāt svādhyāyena trīhīna iti vākyapariṇāmaḥ kartavyaḥ ||
idānīṃ dṛṣṭaphale sati adṛṣṭaphalaṃ na kalpyamiti siddhāntayati— 'dṛṣṭe tu nādṛṣṭam' iti ||
kiṃ tat dṛṣṭaphalamiti tadāha— 'dṛṣṭau prāptisaṃskārau' iti ||
na ca bhojanādivadanvayavyatirekasiddhatvāt vidhi- vaiyarthyamiti śaṅkanīyam |
yattūktaṃ saṃskṛtasya svādhyāyasyaiva viniyogādarśanāt na saṃskāra iti tatrāha— 'saṃskārasiddhiḥ kratvadhyayanavidhivyupādānāt' iti |
ṛtuvidhayo hi viṣayavabodhamapekṣa- māṇāstadavabodhe svādhyāyaṃ viniyuñjate |

1. ṭa-ṭha-° vidhyarthajñānam | 2. ṭa-ṭha-°yanavidhipravṛttiḥ | 3. gha-ca-pha-pravṛttiyuktim; ta-tha- prayuktim | 4. ṭha-tatra | 5. ṭa-ṭha-°praṇārthatvam | 6. te-arthe | 7. ṭa-ṭha-dṛṣṭaṃ phalaṃ | 8. ṭa-ṭha- tatrāha | 9. ṭa-ṭha-°iti' nāsti | 10. ca-cha-pa-pha-°nirṇayasyā | 11. ga-gha-ca-cha-ṇa-ta-tha-pa-pha-ya- 'svādhyāyasya 'nāsti | 12. ca-cha-ta-tha-pa-pha-' hi 'nāsti | 13. ca-pa-pha-°vyāvṛtādhyayanaṃ |
tataḥ kathaṃ svādhyāyasya saṃskṛtatvamiti tatrāha— ‘tathyaḥ karmagadṛṣṭavācī’ iti |
atra tavyapratyayasya karmabhidhāyitayā karmakārakatvaṃ tavyapratyayaṃ prati prakṛtyarthādhyayanādapi pratyāsannatvāt svādhyāyagatamevāpūrvaṃ tavyapratyayo vakti |
yathoktam ‘ambājñaṃ nārthapramāpakam’ iti tadasat ; yato mantrāṇāṃ svatantrādṛṣṭaśeṣāṇāṃ tathātvaṃ yujyate |

tasya ca svādhyāyagatākṣara- sāmarthyasiddhārthabodhe phale sati phalāntarakalpanāyogāt prāmāṇyasyopabṛṃhakamevādṛṣṭam, na tu pratibandhaka- mityāha— ‘svatantrādṛṣṭaśeṣāṅga svārthapramā pratibadhyate’ iti |
saktunyāyena karmakārakaprādhānye parityakte svatantrādṛṣṭevātrāpi syādisyata āha— ‘yathāśrutopapatterna saktunyāyaḥ’ iti |
saktuṣu gatyabhāvāt śrutaṃ parityajya aśrutaṃ kalpyatāṃ nāma |
ithamadhyayanavidherdṛṣṭārthaṃ prasādhya arthabodhaparyantatāṃ nirākartuṃ pūrvapakṣayati— ‘vaidhamarthanirṇayaṃ bhaṭṭaguru vidheḥ pumarthāvasānāt’ iti |
sarvatra vidheḥ puruṣārthaparyavasāyitva- niyamādatrāpi puruṣārthabhūtaṃ phalavadarthaniścayamadhyayanavidhiprayuktaṃ bhaṭṭaguru manyete ||
nanu sakṛdadhyayanādāvṛtti- sahitāt vā arthaniścayo nopalabhyate ityāśaṅkya, tathā sati tasiddhaye so'dhyayanavidhirthaniścayahetuṃ vicāraṃ kalpayiṣyatītyāha— ‘sa vicāramākṣipet’ iti ||
nanu svavidheyatadupakārigoreva vidhiḥ prayojaka iti sarvatra niyamaḥ |
tathā sati atodṛśaṃ kathamadhyayanavidhirākṣipyatītyata āha— ‘avidheyānupakāryākṣepo'vaghātāvṛttivat’ iti |
‘vrīhīnavahanti’ ityatra avaghātāmātraṃ vidheyaṃ na tu tadāvṛttiḥ |
tathāpi taṇḍulaniṣpattiphalasiddhaye sa vidhivṛttiryadvadākṣipeta tadvat prakṛte'pya- vagantavyam ||

nanu vedamātrādhyāyano'rthāvabodhānudaye'pi vyākaraṇajñasahitavedadhyāyanastudayasadbhāvāt taṃ prati vyarthaṃ vicāraṃ vidhirna kalpayedityāśaṅkya arthagatavidhoparihārāyāpekṣita eva vicāra ityāha— ‘sākṣādhyayanāttajjñāne vicāro virodhapanut’ iti ||
yathā phalabhūtasya kṣīrāderhetavo gavādyo'pi puruṣairarthyante, tathā phalavadarthāvabodhahetorakṣaraprāptepi puruṣārthatvāt adhyayanavidhirakṣaraprāptyavasāno'va- gantavyaḥ ||
nanu akṣaraprāpteḥ puruṣārthatvaṃ phalavadarthāvabodhaprayuktaṃ cet, tarhi tadbodhasya mukhyapuruṣārthatvāt bodhānta eva vidhiḥ kiṃ na syāt ityata āha— ‘phaladrovāntave'dhyayanākārasyetyam’ iti |
tathā sati yasya brāhmaṇādeyasmin bṛhaspatitvādādhikārastasya tadāvaśyakamādhyayanaṃ syāt |
svapakṣe tu nāyaṃ doṣa ityāha— ‘hastanaprāptirjapārthā’ iti |
na ca abodhaketve'rthāvabodha eva na sidhyediti śakanīyam |

nanu bodhasya vidhirūpatve bodhakāmamuddiśya vidhātuṃ śakyatvāt sukhamo'dhikārī syādityāśaṅkya prātipakṣe'pi prātikāma uknītādvarṣabrāhmaṇo'trādhikārī sulabha eva iti parihāraṃ spaṣṭatvāpekṣya bodhasya kāmyatvaṃ dūṣayati— ‘so'kāgryaḥ prāgbodhyānābhānayoḥ’ iti |
bodhyasyāgnihotrādilakṣaṇavedārthasya adhyayanataḥ prāk saṃdhyopāsanādivat pitrādyupadeśata eva bhāne siddhatvādeva so'rthabodho na kāmyaḥ |
nanu sāmānyato jñāte viśeṣato bubhutsā saṃbhavati |

yadvā viśeṣato'pi pitrādyupadeśādavagate sati arthadeśikajñānasya prāmāṇyanirṇayāya punarbodhakāmanā yuktaiva ityāśaṅkya evamapyarthāvabodhamuddiśyādhyayanavidhānaṃ na saṃbhavatītyāha— ‘uddeśāyogāt’ iti |
agnihotrādiviśeṣajñānānāṃ na tāvadekabuddhyā viśeṣākāreṇoddeśaḥ saṃbhavati, anantatvāt |
sāmānyākāreṇeddeśe sāmānyameva vidhiphalaṃ syāt, na tu jñānaviśeṣaḥ |
nanu arthāvabodhamuddiśyoccāraṇābhāve vedasya svārthe tātparyaṃ na syāt, ityāśaṅkya upakramādiliṅgagamyaṃ tātparyaṃ śabdabalādeva sidhyatītyāha— ‘tātparya śabdāt’ iti ||
tadarthajñānamuddiśya śabdoccāraṇaṃ loke vyarthaṃ syāditi cet, na |
nanu adhyayanavidherbodhāntatvābhāve vicāraśāstraṃ na pravarteta prayojakābhāvādityāśaṅkyāha— ‘vicāra uttaravidhiyukta upapadyate’ iti |
ṛtubodhavidhayaḥ sāṅgavedādhyayanādāpātapratipannā virodhaparihāreṇa pratiṣṭhitaṃ nirṇayajñānamantareṇa anuṣṭhāpayitumaśaknuvantastannirṇayāya ṛtuvicāraṃ prayojayanti |
evaṃ ca sati śravaṇavidheḥ svavidheyaprayojakatvaṃ ṛtuvidhīnāṃ ca vidheyopakāriprayojakatvamityupapadyatetarām |
adhyayanavidhiprayukte pakṣe tu tadvidheḥ ṛtudvārā svargasiddhi- paryantatvāt kratvanuṣṭhānasyāpi tatrayuktau ṛtuvidhivaiyarthyamāpadyeta ||
nanu adhyayanavidhervarṇikamātraṃ prati niyatatvāt tatprayuktau vicārasyāpi tallabhyeta nāmyatheti cet, ṛtuvicārasya traivarṇikamātre'pi nityatvasiddhiḥ: kiṃ vā brahmavicārasya |
tatrādyo'smanmate'pi sama ityāha— ‘ato nityaḥ ṛtuvicārastraivarṇikamātrasya’ iti |
yato'karaṇe pratyavāyaśravaṇāt ṛtavaḥ traivarṇi- kānāṃ nityā ata ityarthaḥ ||
‘brāhmaṇena niṣkāraṇo dharmaḥ ṣaḍaṅgo vedo'dhyeyo jñeyaśca’ iti tadvidhiḥ |

arthajñāne puruṣapravṛttikaraṃ vacanadvayaṃ śāstrāntargataṃ niruktakāro yāska evamudājahāra—‘athāpi jñānapraśaṃsā bhavatyajñānanindā ca— sthāṇurayaṃ bhārahāraḥ kilābhūdadhītya vedaṃ na vijānāti yo'rtham |
yo'rthajña it sakalaṃ bhadramaśnute nākameti jñānavidhūtapāpmā ||
anagnāviva śuṣkaidho na tajjvalati karhicit’ (niru. 1. 18) iti ||
yo vedārthaṃ jānāti so'smiha loke sakalaṃ śreyaḥ prāpnoti |
tathā tena jñānena pāpakṣaye sati mṛtaḥ ||
1. va-pha- tadvidherarthajñānasya | 2. ṭa-yadhadhītaṃ | 3. ṭa-ṭha- ityanenārthena | 4. ṭa-arthajñānarā- hityam | 5. pha-anena |
yaḥ pumān vyākaraṇārthajñaiḥ svaśabdārthaṃ mīmāṃsayā tātparyaṃ ca śodhayituṃ pravṛttaḥ, tasmai ekasmai vedaḥ svakīyāṃ tanuṃ visrabhe |
vedārtha- prakāśanakṣamaṃ samyagjñānamanayā tṛtīyapādarūpayā vācā mantra āheti |
caturthapādatātparyaṃ darśayati- ‘upamottamayā vācā jāyeva patye kāmayamānā suvāsā ṛtakāleṣu suvāsāḥ kalyāṇavāsāḥ kāmayamānā ṛtakāleṣu yathā sa enāṃ paśyati sa śṛṇotītyarthajñapraśaṃsā’ iti |
yadyapi ahni gṛhakṛtyavelāyāṃ malinavāsastathāpi saṃbhogakāleṣu kalyāṇavāsā bhavati |

yathā sa patirenāṃ jāyāṃ sākalyenādarayuktaḥ paśyati, kiṃca tayoktamarthaṃ hitabuddhyā śṛṇoti, tathāyaṃ caturdaśa- vidyāsthānapariśīlanāpetaḥ puruṣo vedārtharahasyaṃ samyak paśyati, vedoktaṃ ca dharmabrahmarūpamarthaṃ hitabuddhyā strīkaroti |
punarapyṛgantaraṃ yāskaḥ ( niru0 1.20 ) udājahāra- ‘tasyottarā bhūyase nirvacanāya
uta tvaṃ sakhye sthirapītamāhurnainaṃ hinvantyapi vājineṣu |
adhenvā carati māyayaiva vācaṃ śuśruvā~ aphalāmapuṣpām ( ṛ. saṃ. 10.71.5 ) iti ||
pūrvodāhatāyāḥ ‘uta tvaḥ paśyan’ ityādikāyā ṛco'nantaramevāganātā kācit ṛk tasya pūrvoktamantrārthasya bhūyase nirvacanāya saṃpadyate |
api caikaṃ caturdaśavidyāsthānakuśalaṃ puruṣaṃ vedarūpayā vācaḥ sakhye sthitvā stharyeṇa vedoktāmṛtapānayuktamāhuḥ, abhiśāḥ kathayanti |
‘sakhividaṃ sakhāyam’ ( tai. ā. 2. 15 ) iti mantre vedasya sakhitvamudāhṛtam |
yadvā svargaloke devānāṃ sakhye sthitvātiśayena pītāmṛtamāhuḥ |
vācām inā īśvarāḥ sabhāsu pragalbhā vā vājināḥ |
teṣu madhye'pyenaṃ vedārthakuśalaṃ codayituṃ na hinvanti |
yastu anyaḥ pāṭhamātraparaḥ puṣpaphalarahitāṃ vācaṃ śuśruvān bhavati |
yathā loke puṣpaṃ phalasyotpādakaṃ tathā vedānuvacanādidharmajñānamanuṣṭhānadvārā phalātmakabrahmajñānecchāṃ janayati |
‘tametaṃ’ vedānuvacanena brāhmaṇā vividanti yajñena dānena tapamānāśakena’ ( bṛ. u. 4. 4. 22 ) iti śruteḥ |
yathā ca phalaṃ tṛptihetustathā brahmajñānaṃ kṛtakṛtyahetuḥ |
tādṛśapuṣpaphalarahitavedapāṭhakaḥ sa eṣa pumān adhenvā māyayā saha carati |
navaprasūti kā kṣīradoghrī gauḥ prītihetutvāt dhinotīti vyutpatyā dhenustityucyate |
pāṭhamātraparaṃ prati vedarūpā vāgarthajñānarūpaṃ kṣīraṃ na dogdhīyadhenuḥ |
mayā māyayā saha carannayaṃ paramapuruṣārthaṃ na labhate ityarthaḥ |
itthaṃ yāskena jñānastutyajñānanindodāharaṇasya pragalbhitatvāt yacca stūyate taddiryate iti nyāyena adhyayanavadarthasyāpi vidhirabhyupagantavyaḥ ||

kiṃca nakṣatreṭikāṇḍe pratīṣṭi phalavākyaṃ yāgatadvedanayoḥ samānamevāmnāyate- ‘yathā ha vā agnidevā- nāmannāda evaṃ ha vā eṣa manuṣyāṇāṃ bhavati ya etena haviṣā yajate ya u cainadevaṃ veda’ ( tai. grā. 3. 1. 4. 1 ) iti |
anena nyāyena sarveṣvapi brāhmaṇeṣu vedana- vidhayo draṣṭavyāḥ ||
nanu ‘vidyāpraśaṃsā’ ( jai. sū. 1. 2. 15 ) iti sūtre vedanaphalānāṃ praśaṃsā rūpatvaṃ jaimininā sūtritamiti cet, astu nāma |
darśayāgasya pūrṇamāsa- yāgasya ca atipāte sati prāyaścittarūpāṃ vaiśvānareṣṭiṃ vidhātuṃ vidyamānenaiva svargaphalena stutiḥ kriyate
1. ṭa-śabdārtham | 2. ṭha-atiśayena pītāmṛtamāhuḥ | 3. ṭa-ṭha- ‘vā’ nāsti | 4. ṭha- veditum | 5. ṭha-anena | 6. ṭha-aindrajālikago | 7. ṭha-yat |
etadācāryairbrahmajñāna- phalavākyasya svārthe'pi tātparyaṃ darśayitumudāhṛtam— icchāsyevārthavādatvaṃ vacaso'nyaparasvataḥ|
na ca bhūtārthavādatvaṃ pāpaślokā śrutiryathā (bṛ. u. vā. 127-128)||
na ca vedanamātreṇa phalamiddhāvanuṣṭhānavaiyarthyamiti śaṅkanīyam; phalabhūyastvena parihṛtatvāt|
udāhṛtaṃ cātra jaiminisūtraṃ- ‘phalasya karmanippattesteṣāṃ lokavatparimāṇataḥ sārato vā phalaviśeṣaḥ syāt’ (jai.sū. 1. 2. 17) iti|
etaccāsmābhiḥ ‘tarati brahmahatyāṃ yo'śvamedhena yajate ya u cainamevaṃ veda’ (tai. saṃ. 5. 3. 12. 2) ityudāharaṇena vyākhyātam|
chandogāśca kevalādanuṣṭhānāt vidyāsahite'nuṣṭhāne phalā- tiśayamāmananti- ‘tenobhau kuruto yaścaitadevaṃ veda yaśca na veda|
yadeva vidyayā karoti śraddhayopaniṣadā tadeva vīryavattaraṃ bhavati’ (chāṃ. u. 1. 1. 10) iti|
yadyapyaṅgā- vabaddhāpāstatra vidyāśabdena vivakṣitā tathāpi nyāyaḥ sarvasvapi vidyāsu samānaḥ||
kiñca karmajanyamapūrvaṃ yathā maraṇādūrdhvaṃ jīvena saha gacchati tathā vidyājanya- mapyapūrvaṃ gacchati|
tathā ca vājasaneyina āmananti- ‘taṃ vidyākarmaṇī samanvārabhete pūrvaprajñā ca’ (bṛ. u. 4. 4. 2) iti|
yadyapyetāvat prasiddhaṃ tathāpi vedasya viṣayādyabhāve vyākhyānasyāpi paramaviṣayādikaṃ na syāt|
vede pūrvottarakāṇḍayoḥ krameṇa dharmabrahmaṇī viṣayaḥ, tayoranya- labhyatvāt|
tathā ca purupārthānuśāsane sūtritaṃ- ‘dharmabrahmaṇī vaidakavece’ iti|
jaiminīye ca dvitīyasūtre ‘codanaiva dharme pramāṇam’, ‘codanā pramāṇameva’ iti niyamadvayaṃ saṃpradāyavidbhirabhihitam|
codanaivatyamumartha- mupapādayituṃ caturthasūtre pratyakṣaviṣayaśca dharmasya nirākṛtam ‘pratyakṣamanimittaṃ vidyamānopalambhanatvāt’ (jai. sū. 1. 1. 4) iti|
anuṣṭhānādūrdhvamupasthimānasya dharmasya pūrvamavidyamānatvāt na pratyakṣa- yogyatāsti|

traiyāsikasya tṛtīyasūtramya dvitīyavarṇake brahmaṇaḥ siddhavastuno'pi śāstraikaviṣayatvaṃ bhāṣyakṛdbhirvyākhyātam- ‘śāstrādeva pramāṇajagato janmādhikāraṇaṃ brahmādhigamyata ityabhiprāyaḥ’ (bra. sū. śāṃ. bhā. 1. 1. 3) iti|
śrutiśca bhavati- ‘nāvedvinmanute taṃ bṛhantam’ (tai. ā. 3. 12. 1. 7) iti|
tatropapattiḥ pūrvācāryairevamudīritā- ‘rūpaliṅgādi- rāhityācca māntayogyatā’ (ve. nyā. 1. 1. 3. 18) iti|
na ca tasya jñānasya ‘saptadvīpā vasumatī’, ‘rājāsau gacchati’ ityādijñānavat apuruṣārthaparyavasāyitvaṃ śaṅkanīyam|

dharmayuktasya puruṣārthasya styamānatvāt ‘dharmo viśvasya jagataḥ pratiṣṭhā loke dharmiṣṭhaṃ prajā upasarpanti dharmeṇa pāpamapanudati dharme sarva pratiṣṭhitaṃ tasmāddharmaṃ paramaṃ vadanti’ (tai. ā. 10. 63) iti|
1. ṭa-ityādyudāharaṇena| 2. ca-cha-tha-pha-taiveśca| 3. ṭa-kica| 4. ca-cha-ṭa-pha-avagamyate; ṭha-avagantuṃ śakyate| 5. ṭa-cha-siddhāmano'pi| 6. ṭa-dhūyamāṇatvāt|
vivadamānayoḥ puruṣayormadhye durbalasyāpi rājasāhāyyavat jayahetutvācca dharmaḥ puruṣārthaḥ |

tathā ca vāja- saneyinaḥ sṛṣṭipakaraṇe samāmananti- 'tacchreyo rūpamatyasṛjata dharmaṃ tadetatakṣatrasya kṣatraṃ yaddharmastasmāddharmātparaṃ nāstyatho abalīyānbalīyasāṃśaṃsate dharmeṇa yathā rājñaivam' (gṛ. u. 1. 4. 14) iti |
'brahmavidāpnoti param' (tai. ā. 8. 2), 'brahma veda brahmaiva bhavati' (muṃ. u. 3. 2. 9), 'tarati śokamātmavit' (chāṃ. u. 7. 1. 3) ityādi śrutiṣu brahmajñānaprayuktaḥ puruṣārthaḥ prasiddhaḥ |
brīhyādayostu syāmapi jñānāpekṣāyāmupanayanābhāvena adhyayanarāhityāt vede'dhikāraḥ pratibandhaḥ |
na dvitīyaḥ 'āgnāvaiṣṇavaṃ puroḍāśaṃ nirvapanti dākṣaṇīyamekādaśakapālam' ( ai. brā. 1. 1 ) ityevaṃ dīkṣaṇīyeṣṭeḥ brāhmaṇye prakrāntatvāt |
atrocyate-mantrakāṇḍo brahmayajñādiprakrameṇa pravṛtto na tu yāgānuṣṭhānakrameṇa |
'yastvādhyāyamadhīyītainaikāmapyacya yajuḥ sāma vā tadbrahmayajñaḥ' ( tai. ā. 2. 10 ) iti |
tathā 'sarvā ṛcaḥ sarvāṇi yajūṃṣi sarvāṇi sāmāni vācaḥ stome pāriplavaṃ śaṃsati' iti vidhīyate |
tathāśvine śasyamāne 'sūryo nodiyā- dapi sarvāṃ dāśatayīranubrūyāt' iti vidhīyate |
tathā 'ricyata iva vā eṣa preva ricyate yo yājayati prati vā gṛhṇāti yājayitvā pratigṛhya vānaśnan triḥ svādhyāyaṃ vedamadhīyīta' ( tai. ā. 2. 16 ) iti prāyaścittarūpaṃ vedapārāyaṇaṃ vihitam |
ityādiṣu kṛtsnamantrakāṇḍaviniyogeṣu saṃpradāya- pāraṃparyagata eva krama ādaraṇīyaḥ |
viśeṣaviniyogaistu mantraviśeṣāṇāṃ śrutiliṅgavākyādipramāṇā- nyupajīvya āśvalāyano darśayati |
'iṣe tvā' ityādi- mantrāstu ṛtvanuṣṭhānakrameṇāmnātā ityāpastambādayastenaiva krameṇa sūtranirmāṇa pravṛttāḥ |
yadyapi brāhmaṇe dīkṣaṇīyeṣṭiḥ upakrāntā, tathāpi tasyā iṣṭerdarśapūrṇamāsavikṛtitvena tadapekṣatvāt āśvalāyanasya ādau tadvākhyānaṃ yuktam |
tarhi 'pra vo vājā' ( ṛ. saṃ. 3. 27. 1 ) ityādīnāṃ sāmidhenīnāmātraiva viniyogamāśvalāyano'bravīt |
'namaḥ pravaktre' ( āśva. śrau. 1. 2 ) ityā- dapasavanāmnātāḥ kuto viniyujyante iti cet, nārthaṃ doṣaḥ |
tathā ca aindrāyavagraha- brāhmaṇe samāmnāyate-'vāgvai parācyavyākṛtā'vadatte devā indramabruvannimāṃ no vācaṃ vyākurviti |
so'tharvāṅgiraṃ vṛṇe mahaṃ caivaiṣa vācye ca saha gṛhṇātā iti tasmādaindravāyavaḥ saha gṛhyate |
tasmādiyaṃ vyākṛtā vāgudyate' ( tai. saṃ. 6. 4. 7. 3 ) iti |
'agnimīḻe purohitam' ( ṛ. saṃ. 1. 1. 1 ) ityādivāk pūrvasmin kāle parācī samudrādvidhvani- vadekātmikā satī avyākṛtā prakṛtiḥ pratyayaḥ padaṃ vākyamityādivibhāgakārigrantharahitā āsīt |
tadānīṃ devaiḥ prārthitaḥ indraḥ ekasminneva pātre vāyoḥ svasya ca somarasagrahaṇarūpeṇa vareṇa tuṣṭaḥ tāmakhaṇḍāṃ vācaṃ madhye vicchidya prakṛtipratyayādivibhāgaṃ sarvatrākarot |
tasmāt iyaṃ vāk idānīmapi pāṇinpādi- maharṣibhirvyākṛtā sarvaiḥ paṭhyate ityarthaḥ |
tasyaitasya vyākaraṇasya prayojanaviśeṣo vararucinā vārtike darśitaḥ-'rakṣāhāgamalaghvasaṃdehāḥ prayojanam' iti |
etāni rakṣādiprayojanāni prayojanāntarāṇi ca mahābhāṣye patañjalinā spaṣṭīkṛtāni |
lopāgamavarṇavikārajño hi samyak vedān paripālayiṣyati vedārthaṃ cādhyavasyati |
ūhaḥ khalvapi na sarvairliṅgaiḥ sarvārvibhaktibhi- rye mantrā nigaditāḥ |
āgamaḥ khalvapi 'brāhmaṇena niṣkāraṇo dharmaḥ ṣaḍaṅgo vedo'dhyeyo jñeyaśca' iti |
pradhāne ca kṛto yatnaḥ phalavān bhavati |
bṛhaspatirindrāya divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ pratipadoktānāṃ śabdānāṃ śabda- pārāyaṇaṃ provāca nāntaṃ jagāma |
adya tu punaryadi paramāyurbhavati sa varṣaśataṃ jīvati |
tatra na jñāyate kiṃ sthūlāni pṛṣanti yasyāḥ sā sthūla- pṛṣatī kiṃvā sthūlā cāsau pṛṣatī ca sthūlapṛṣatīti |
te'surā helayo helaya iti kurvantaḥ parābabhūvuḥ |
'duṣṭaḥ śabdaḥ svarato varṇato vā mithyā prayukte na tamarthamāha |
so'nantamā- pnoti jayaṃ paratra vāgyogaviduṣyati cāpaśabdaiḥ' ||
yo hi śabdān jānāti apa- śabdānapyasau jānāti |
yathā gauritye- tasya śabdasya gāvī goṇī gopotalikā ityevamādayaḥ |
yo hyajānanvai brāhmaṇaṃ hanyāt surāṃ vā pibet |
atha yo vāgyogavit jñānaṃ tasya śaraṇam ||
'avidvāṃsaḥ pratyabhivāde nāmno ye na plutiṃ viduḥ |
kāmaṃ teṣu tu viprovya strīvivāyamahaṃ vadet' iti |
na cāntareṇa vyākaraṇaṃ prayājāḥ savibhaktikāḥ śakyāḥ kartum |
yo vā imāṃ padaśaḥ svaraśo varṇaśo vācaṃ vidadhāti sa ārṣvi- jīno bhavati |
'catvāri śṛṅgā trayo asya pādā dve śīrṣe sapta hastāso asya |
tridhā baddho vṛṣabho roravīti maho devo martyā ā viveśa' (ṛ. saṃ. 4. 58. 3) iti |
triṣu sthāneṣu baddha urasi kaṇṭhe śirasi ca |
mahatā devena nastādābhyaṃ yathā syādityadhyeyaṃ vyākaraṇam ||
'catvāri vākparimitā padāni tāni vidurbrāhmaṇā ye manīṣiṇaḥ |
guhā trīṇi nihitā neṅgayanti turīyaṃ vāco manuṣyā vadanti' (ṛ. saṃ. 1. 164, 45) |
'uta tvaḥ paśyandadarśa vācamuta tvaḥ śṛṇvanna śṛṇotyenām |
uto tvasmai tanvaṃ vi sale jāyeva patya uśatī suvāsāḥ' (ṛ. saṃ. 10. 71. 4)||
'vasmai anyasmai tanvaṃ vi sale tanuṃ vivṛṇute |
yathā jāyā patye kāmayamānā suvāsāḥ svamātmānaṃ vivṛṇute evaṃ vāk vāgvidre svamātmānaṃ vivṛṇute |
'saktumiva titaunā punanto yatra dhīrā manasā vācamakrata |
sakhyāni jānate bhadraiṣā lakṣmīrnihitādhi vāci' (kra. saṃ. 10. 71. 2) |
dhīrā dhyānavanto manasā prajñānena vācamakrata vācamakrupata |
atra sakhāyaḥ sakhyāni saṃjānate sāyujyāni jānate |
ka eṣa durgo mārga ekagamyo vāgviviṣayaḥ |
yājñikāḥ paṭhanti--'āhitābhirapaśabdaṃ prayuñjānaḥ prāyaścittīyāṃ sārasvatīmiṣṭiṃ nirvapet' iti |
'daśamyāṃ putrasya jātasya nāma vidadhyādropavadādyantarantasthamabhiniṣṭhānāntaṃ vyakṣaraṃ caturakṣaraṃ vā kṛtaṃ nāma kuryācca
ekaikasya padasya saṃbhāvita avayavārthastatra niḥśeṣeṇocyante iti vyutpatteḥ |

tatra hi 'catvāri padajātāni nāmākhyāte copasarganipātāśca' iti pratijñāya 'uccāvaceṣvartheṣu nipatanti' iti nipātasvarūpaṃ nirucya evamudāhṛtaṃ- 'neti pratiṣedhārthīyo bhāṣāyāṃmubhayamanbadhyāya nendraṃ devamamaṃsateti pratiṣedhārthīyaḥ' iti; 'durmadāso na surāyāmityupamārthīyaḥ' (niru. 1.1; 4) iti ca |
tacca loke kevalapratiṣedhārthīyasyāpi nakārasya vede pratiṣedhopamālakṣaṇobhayārtho- dāharaṇamasmin granthe'vagamyate |
aitareyataittirīyakāṭhakādisākhāsūktāni hariścandrānāciketādyupākhyānāni dharma- brahmavacoyogayuktāni teṣu tevitihāsagrantheṣu spaṣṭīkṛtāni |
nyāyaśāstre pramāṇaprameyasaṃśayaprayojanadṛṣṭāntādīnāṃ ṣoḍaśapadārthānāṃ nirūpaṇāt tadanusāregadaṃ vākyamasminnarthe pramāṇaṃ bhavati, neta raditi nirṇayaḥ kartuṃ śakyate |
' tadu ha vā ete brahmavādinaḥ pūrvāṃbhimukhāḥ saṃdhyāyāṃ gāyatryābhimantritā āpa ūrdhvaṃ vikṣipanti (tai. ā. 2. 2 ) ityādiḥ saṃdhyāvandanavidhiḥ |
' padma vā ete mahāyajñāḥ satati pratāyante ' (tai. ā. 2. 10 ) ityādi ko mahāyajñavidhiḥ |
etaiḥ purāṇādibhiḥ caturdaśabhi- vidyāsthānairhapuṃhitāyā vidyāyā grahaṇe'dhikāriviśeṣaḥ |
vidyā ha vai brāhmaṇamājagāma gopāya mā śevadhiṣṭe'hamasmi |
asūyakāyānujave'dhatāya na mā brūyā vīryavatī tathā syām ||
tādṛśyāṃ mayi tadupadeṣṭari tvayi ca yo'sūyāṃ karoti |
tathā sati tvadhṛdaye sthitvā phalapradā bhaveyam ||
taṃ manyeta pitaraṃ mātaraṃ ca tasmai na duhrelatamañjasāha ||
pūrvasmin mantre ācāryasya niyamamabhidhāya asmin mantre śiṣyasya niyamo'bhidhīyate |
tādṛśena vākyena ya ācāryaḥ śiṣyasya karṇau ātṛṇatti sarvatastadaṃ pūraṇaṃ karoti |
mandaprajñasya māṇavakasya ādau ardhamaitraṃ vā grahītumaśaktasya yathā duḥkhaṃ na bhavati, tathā pādaṃ pādaikadeśaṃ vā grāhayan |
amṛtatvasya devajanmano mokṣasya vā prāpakatvādamṛtaṃ vedārthaḥ |
pūrvasiddhau tu mātāpitarau adhamasya manuṣyasya śarīrasya pradānānmukhyau |
tasmai mukhyamātāpitararūpāyācāryādyaika mapi drohaṃ na kuryāt ||
1. ga-gha-cha-ṇa-ya-tvāvagamāt | 2. ṭa-vedavākyaṃ | 3. ṭa-go vispaṣṭa eva | 4. ca-cha-tha-pha- evam | 5. ṭa-ādāveva | 6. cha-amṛtasya | 7. ṭa-ṭha-tha-manuṣyaśarī |
adhyāpitā ye guruṃ nādriyante viprā vācā manasā karmaṇā vā |
yathaiva te na gurorbhojanīyāstathaiva tān bhuṅkte śrutaṃ tat ||
ye tu adhamā viprā guruṇādhyāpitāḥ santo vinayoksā tadīyahitacintanena śuśrūṣayā vā guruṃ nādriyante |
ādararahitāste śiṣyābhāsā gurona bhojanīyāḥ, anubhavayogyā na bhavanti |
na hi teṣu guruḥ kṛpāṃ karoti |
yathaiva guruṇā te na pālanīyāstathaiva tān adhamān śiṣyān tacchrutaṃ gurupadiṣṭaṃ veda- vākyaṃ na pālayati, phalapradaṃ na bhavatītyarthaḥ ||
yaste na druhyetamaccanāha tasmai mā brūyā nidhipāya brahman ||
he ācārya yameva mukhyaśiṣyaṃ śucitvādiguṇopetaṃ jānīyāḥ |
kiṃca yo mukhyaśiṣyastvaṃ kadācidapi na druhyet |
tasmai tu mukhyaśiṣyāya tvadīyanidhipālakāya brahman vedarūpāṃ māṃ vidyāṃ brūyāḥ |
itthaṃ vidyādeva- tayā prārthitatvādācāryeṇa mukhyaśiṣyāya vedavidyopadeṣṭavyā ||
mantrabrāhmaṇātmake vede brāhmaṇasya mantra- vyākhyānopayogivādadau brāhmaṇamāraṇyakāṇḍasahitaṃ vyākhyātam |
atha tatra tatra brāhmaṇodāharaṇena mantrā- tmakaḥ saṃhitāgrantho vyākhyātavyaḥ ||

sa ca ‘agnimīḻe’ ityārabhya ‘yathā vaḥ susahāsati’ ityanto'ṣṭakāṇḍardaśamaṇḍalaiścatuḥ- pañcādhyāyaiḥ pañcāśītyanuvākaiḥ īṣadadhikasahasrasūktaiḥ īṣadadhikadvāsahasravargaiḥ īṣadadhikābhiraṣṭasahasrasaṃkhyā- bhirṛgbhiścopetaḥ |
tasya ca granthasya kṛtssyāpyāmnātakrameṇaiva sāmānyaviniyogo brahmayajñajapādī pūrvamevābhihitaḥ |
sa ca trividhaḥ sūktaviniyogasta- cādiviniyoga ekaikasyā ṛco viniyogaśceti ||
tatra ‘agnimīḻe’ iti sūktaṃ prātaranuvāke āgneye kratau viniyuktam |
sa viniyoga āśvalāyanena caturthādhyāyasya trayodaśe khaṇḍe sūtritaḥ—‘avā no agna iti ṣaḻprimīḻe'gniṃ dūtam’ iti |
‘sūktaṃ sūktādau hīne pāde’ (āśva. śrau. 1. 1) iti paribhāṣitātvāt |
tasminsūkte prathamāyā ṛco dvitīyasyāṃ pavamāneṣṭau sviṣṭakṛto yājyātvena viniyogaḥ |
sa ca dvitīyā- dhyāyasya prathamakhaṇḍe sūtritaḥ—‘sāhāgnidhvā abhiyujo'gnimīḻe purohitamiti saṃyājye’ iti |
tathā ‘saṃyājye ityukte sauviṣṭakṛtī pratīyatāt’ (āśva. śrau. 2. 1) iti paribhāṣitātvāt sviṣṭakṛtsambandhiniścayaḥ |
yadyapi sāhānityanayā puronuvākyayaiva devatāyā anusmaraṇarūpasaṃskāraḥ siddhastathāpi yājyānuvākyayoḥ samuccayo dvādaśe'dhyāye caturthapāde mīmāṃsitaḥ— puronuvākyayā yājyā vikalpyā vā samuccitā |
kiṃca ‘puronuvākyamanūcya yājyā juhoti’ iti pratyakṣavacanena devatopalakṣaṇahaviṣpradānakārya bhedokti- puraḥsaraṃ sāhityaṃ vidhīyate |
etaccābhimityādisūktaṃ navarcam 'agniṃ naya madhucchandā vaiśvāmitraḥ' ityanukramaṇikāyāmuktatvāt |
viśvāmitraputro madhucchandānāmakaratasya sūktasya draṣṭṛtvāt tadīya ṛṣiḥ |
vedaprāptyarthaṃ tapo'nu- tiṣṭhataḥ puruṣān svayaṃrbhūvedapuruṣaḥ prāpnot |
tathā ca śrūyate-'ajānaha vai pṛṣṭhīstapasyamānānbrahmā svayambha- vyānardhattapayo'bhavan' (tai. ā. 2. 9) iti |
tathātīndriyasya vedasya parameśvarānugraheṇa prathamatau darśanāt ṛṣitvamityabhipretya smaryate-
avidivā ṛṣiṃ chandāṃ daivataṃ yogameva ca |
svairo varṇo'kṣaraṃ mātrā viniyogo'rtha eva ca |
agnimityādisūktasya chando'nukramaṇikāyāṃ yadyapyatra noktaṃ tathāpi paribhāṣāyāmevamuktam |
hiraṇyastūpa ṛṣiyaiṣāṃ mantrāṇāṃ vakṣyate tataḥ prācīneṣu mantreṣu sāmānyena gāyatraṃ chanda ityarthaḥ |
taccāraṇyakāṇḍe samāmnāyate- 'chādayanti ha vā enaṃ chandāṃsi pāpākarmaṇaḥ' (ai. ā. 2.5) iti |
tacca taittirīyā āmananti- 'prajāpatiragniṃ cinuta ma śvaravirbhūtvā'tiṣṭhata devā vibhyato nopāyanta chandobhirātmānaṃ chādayiṣoyantacchandasāṃ chandasvam' (tai. saṃ. 5. 6. 6. 1) iti |
tadapi chāndogyopaniṣadā- mnātaṃ- 'devā vai mṛtyorbyanasyatīṃ dhiyāṃ prāviśaṃste chandobhirātmānamacchādayandyadebhiracchādayastacchandasāṃ chandasvam' (chāṃ. u. 1. 4. 2) iti |
tathā dyotanāthedīvyatidhātunimitto devaśabda ityetadāgnāyate- 'divā vai no'bhūditi tadvānāṃ devavam' iti |
tasya sūktasya prathamāsṛcaṃ bhagavān vedapuruṣa āha-
oṃ agnimīḻe purohitaṃ yajñasya devamṛtvijam | hotāraṃ ratnadhātamam || 1 || oṃ agnim | īḻe | puraḥ'hitam | yajñasya | devam | ṛtvijam | hotāram | ratna'dhātamam || 1 ||
tathā ca paṭhyate- 'ajamadhyasthaṭhakārasya ḻakāraṃ vai yathākramam' iti||
yathā rājñaḥ purohitamadabhīṣṭaṃ saṃpādayati, tathāmignipi yajñasyāpekṣataṃ homaṃ saṃpādayati|
tathā ca śrūyate-' +agnirvai devānāṃ hotā' (ai. brā. 3. 14) iti|

atrāgmiśabdasya yāsko bahudhā nirvacanaṃ darśayati-'athāto'nukramipyāmo'gniḥ pṛthivīsthānastaṃ. prathamaṃ vyākhyāsyāmo'gniḥ kasmādagraṇīrbhavatyagraṃ yajñeṣu praṇīyate'ṅgaṃ nayati saṃnama- māno'krapano bhavatīti sthaulārhavirna kropayati na snehayati tribhya ākhyātebhyo jāyata iti śākapūṇiranādaktāhagvādvā|
sāmānyena sarvadevatānāṃ lakṣa- ṇasyābhihitatvādantaraṃ yataḥ pratipadaṃ viśeṣeṇa vaktavyaṃ tasmātkaḍakṣitamanto'nukrameṇa vakṣyāmaḥ|
etadevābhipretya bahucā mantrabrāhmaṇe āmananti-'agnirvai prathamaṃ devatānām' (ai. brā. 1. 4) iti mantraḥ|
tathā taittarīyaśābhāmananti-'agnirvai prathamaṃ devatānām' (tai. brā. 2. 4. 3. 3) iti|
vājasaneyinastvaivamāmananti-'sa vā eṣo'gre devatānāmajāyata tasmādagnināma' iti|
yajñeṣu agnihotrepyaśusomarūpeṣu agraṃ pūrvaditvyāhavanīyadeśaṃ prati gārhapatyāt praṇīyate iti dvitīyaṃ pravṛttinimittam|
saṃnamānaḥ samyak svayameva prahlībhavan aṅgaṃ svakīyaṃ śarīraṃ nayati kāṣṭhadāhe havi- pyāke ca prerayatīti tṛtīyaṃ pravṛttinimittam|
sthūlārhavīnāmakamaharṣeḥ putro niruktakāraḥ kaścit 'akno- panaḥ' iti agniśabdaṃ nirvakti|
tatra na kropayatītyukte na snehayati, kiṃtu kāṣṭhādikaṃ rukṣayatītyuktaṃ bhavati|
sa ca hrasvo bhūtvā paro bhavati|
+ - 'agnirvai devānāṃ ...... dhārayitāraṃ poṣayitāraṃ vā' ityasya sthāne-'agnirvai devānāṃ hotāṃrīn iti|
tathā ratnadhātamaṃ yāgaphalarūpāṇāṃ ratnānāṃ ramaṇānāṃ dhanānāṃ vā ātāśayena dātāraṃ dhārayitāraṃ vā' ityādhikam|
yajñabhūmiṃ gatvā svakīyamannaṃ nayati kāṣṭhadāhe haviṣpāke ca prera- yatīti samudāyārthaḥ |
tasya agniśabdārthasya devatāviśeṣasya prādhānyena stutipradarśanāyaiṣā 'agnimīḻe' iti ṛk bhavatīti |

tāmetāṃ ṛcaṃ yāska evaṃ vyākhyātavān—'agnimīḻe'gniṃ yācāmīḻiradhyeṣaṇā- karmā pūjakarmā vā purohito vyākhyāto yajñasya devo dānādvā dīpanādvā dyonanādvā dyusthāno bhavatīti vā yo devaḥ sā devatā hotāraṃ hatāraṃ juhoterhotetyaurṇavābho ratnadhātamaṃ ramaṇīyānāṃ dhanānāṃ dātṛtamam' (niru. 7. 15) iti |
purohitaśabdo dvitīya'dhyāye 'yadevāpiḥ śaṃtanave purohitaḥ' ityetāṃ ṛcamudāhṛtya 'pura enaṃ dadhate' (
ayamagniḥ pūrvaibhiḥ purātanairbhṛgvādibhiḥ prabhṛtibhiḥ ṛṣibhiḥ īḍyaḥ stutyaḥ, nūtanairuta idānīṃnairasmābhirapi stutyaḥ |
yamaḥ agniḥ stutaḥ san iha yajñe devān havirbhujaḥ āvakṣati 'vaha prāpaṇe' iti dhātuḥ |
inapratyayānta ṛṣiśabdaḥ 'ṛpyandhaka' (pā. sū. 4. 1. 114) iti nipātanāt laghupadhaguṇābhāvaḥ (pā. sū. 7. 3. 86) |
īḍyaśabdasya yapratyayāntatvāt (pā. sū. 3. 1. 124) 'tisvaritam' (pā. sū. 6. 1. 185) iti svarite śeṣānudāttatve ca prāpte tadapavādatvena 'īḍavanda' (pā. sū. 6. 1. 214) ityādinādyudāttatvam |
'navasya nū stanavāśva' (pā. sū. 5. 4. 30. 6) iti vārtikena navaśabdasya nū ityādeśaḥ tanapratyayaśca mahāvārtike vihitaḥ |
utaśabdo yadyapi vikalpārthe prasiddhastathāpi nipātanenānekatvāddhaucityenātra samuccayārtho draṣṭavyaḥ |
tarhi 'nipātā ādyudāttāḥ' (ki. sū. 80) ityukārasyodāttaḥ prāpta iti cet, na |
yathā prātaḥśabdo'ntodāttatvenaiva svarādiṣu (pā. sū. 1. 1. 37) paṭhitaḥ, evamutaśabdasyāpi pāṭho draṣṭavyaḥ, svarāderākṛtigaṇatvāt |
devān ityasya nakārasya saṃhitāyāṃ 'dīrghādaṭi' (pā. sū. 6. 3. 9) iti rutvam |
'atrānunāsikaḥ' (pā. sū. 8. 3. 2) ityanuvṛttau 'āto'ṭi nityam' (pā. sū. 8. 3. 3) ityākāraḥ sānunāsikaḥ |
ma ca 'lopaḥ śākalyasya' (pā. sū. 8. 3. 19) iti lupyate |
idamau hapratyaye sati niṣpannatvāt (pā. sū. 5. 3. 11) ihaśabde pratyayasvaraḥ |
agninā | rayim | aśnavat | poṣam | eva | divedive | yaśasam | vīravattamam || 3 ||
yo'yaṃ hotā nyuyo'mistena agninā nimittabhūtena yajamānaḥ rayiṃ dhanam aśnavat prāpnoti |
kīdṛśaṃ rayim ? divedive poṣam eva pratidinaṃ puṣyamāṇatayā vardhamānameva, na tu kadācidapi kṣīyamāṇam |
yaśasaṃ dānādinā yaśoyuktaṃ vīravattamam atiśayena putranṛtvādivīrapurupopetam |
1. ga-gha-cha-ṇa-ya- 'yadvā ...... ityantodāttaḥ' nāsti; ta-tha- 'antodāttaḥ' ityasya sthāne 'antodāttam' |

vakārāntāt divśabdāt parasyāḥ saptamyāḥ 'supāṃ suluk' (pā. sū. 7. 1. 39 ) ityādinā śebhāve sati 'māvekācaḥ' (pā. sū. 6. 1. 168 ) ityādinā 'uḍidaṃpadāt' (pā. sū. 6. 1. 171 ) ityādinā vā tasyodāttatvam |
'nityavīpsayoḥ' (pā. sū. 8. 1. 4 ) iti dvirbhāve sati uttarabhāgasya 'anudāttaṃ ca' (pā. sū. 8. 1. 3 ) ityanudātta- tvam |
yaśo'syāstīti vigrahe sati 'arśaādibhyo'c' (pā. sū. 5. 2. 127 ) iti acpratyayaḥ |
abhipnavapadahasya madhyavartipakveṣu tṛtīyamavane maitrāvaruṇasya 'agne yaṃ yajñam' ityādiko vaika- lpiko'nurūpastracaḥ |
etacca saptamādhyāye 'eṣva' ityādikhaṇḍe sūtritam—'agniṃ vo vṛdhanmamahe yaṃ yajñamadhvaram' (ādha. śrau. 7. 8 ) iti ||
agne yaṃ yajñamadhvaraṃ viśvataḥ paribhūrasi | sa iddeveṣu gacchati || 4 || agne | yam | yajñam | adhvaram | viśvataḥ | paribhūḥ | asi | saḥ | it | deveṣu | gacchati ||4||
he agne tvaṃ yaṃ yajñaṃ viśvataḥ sarvāmu dikṣu paribhūḥ paritaḥ prāptavān asi saḥ it sa eva yajño deveṣu nṛsi praṇenaṃ svargaṃ gacchati |
na hyagninā sarvataḥ pālitaṃ yajñaṃ rākṣasādayo hiṃsituṃ prabhavanti ||
na vidyate dhvaro'syeti bahuvrīhau 'nañmukhyām' (pā. sū. 6. 2. 172 ) ityantodāttatvam |
viśvataḥ ityatra tasilaḥ pratyayasvaratvaṃ bādhitvā pūrvavarṇasya 'liti' (pā. mū. 6. 1. 193 ) ityudāttatvam |
paribhūrityatra avyayapūrvapadaprakṛtisvaratve prāpte (pā. mū. 6. 2. 2 ) tadapavādātvena kṛduttarapadaprakṛtisvaratvam (pā. sū. 6. 2. 139 ) |
agni iti tiṅantanmaya 'yadvṛttānnityam' (pā. sū. 8. 1. 66 ) iti nighātābhāvaḥ ||
agnihotā kavikratuḥ satyaścitraśravastamaḥ | devo devebhirā gamat || 5 || agniḥ | hotā | kavikratuḥ | satyaḥ | citraśravaḥ | tamaḥ | devaḥ | devebhiḥ | ā | gamat || 5 ||
ayam agniḥ devaḥ anyairdevairvibhorbhiḥ saha ā gamat asmin yajñe samāgacchatu |
kavi- kratuḥ citraśravastamaḥ ityatrobhayatra bahuvrīhitvāt pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaratvam (pā. sū. 6. 2. 1 ) |
satyaṃ sādhuḥ satyaḥ : 'satyādaśapathe' (pā. sū. 5. 4. 66 ) ityantodātto haradattena nipātitaḥ ||
2. ṭha- 'tābhyan tṛce yā prathamā sā sūkte caturthī' ityadhikaṃ itītyasyānantaram |
yadaṅga dāśuṣe tvamagne bhadraṃ kariṣyasi | tavettatsatyamaṅgiraḥ || 6 || yat | aṅga | dāśuṣe | tvam | agne | bhadram | kariṣyasi | tava | it | tat | satyam | aṅgiraḥ ||6||
aṅga agne he agne tvaṃ dāśuṣe havirdattavate yajamānāya taptrī- tyathaṃ yat bhadraṃ vittagrahaprajāpaśuguṇaṃ kalyāṇaṃ kariṣyasi tat bhadraṃ tava it tadeva |
he aṅgiraḥ agne etacca satyaṃ na tatra visaṃvādo'sti |
yajamānasya vittādisaṃpattau satyāmuttaraṛcyanuṣṭhā- nenāgnereva sukhaṃ bhavati |
bhadraśabdārthaṃ śāṭyāyaninaḥ samāmananti—‘yadvai puruṣasya vittaṃ tadbhadraṃ
rājantamdhvarāṇāṃ gopāmṛtasya dīdivim| vardhamānaṃ sve dame || 8 || rājantam | adhvarāṇām | gopām | ṛtasya | dīdivim | vardhamānam | sve | dame || 8 ||
rājantaṃ dīvyamānam adhvarāṇāṃ rākṣasa- kṛtahiṃsārahitānāṃ yajñānāṃ gopāṃ rakṣakam ṛtasya satyasyāvaśyabhāvinaḥ karmaphalasya dīdiviṃ paunaḥ- punyena bhṛśaṃ vā dyotakam |
sve dame svakīyagṛhe yajñaśālāyāṃ havirbhiḥ vardhamānam ||
sa naḥḥ piteva sūnave'gne sūpāyano bhava | sacasvā naḥ svastaye || 9 || saḥ | naḥ | pitāiva | sūnave | agne | su'upāyanaḥ | bhava | sacasva | naḥ | svastaye || 9 ||
he agne saḥ tvaṃ naḥ asmadarthaṃ sūpāyanaḥ śobhanaprāptiyuktaḥ bhava |
tathā naḥ asmākaṃ svastaye vināśarāhityārthaṃ sacasva samaveto bhava |
yathā sūnave putrārthaṃ pitā suprāpaḥ prāyeṇa mamavetto bhavati tadvat ||
asmacchandādeśasya na ityetasya anudāttaṃ sarvam (pā. sū. 8. 1. 18) ityanudāttatvam |
ivena nitya- samāsaḥ pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaratvaṃ ca vaktavyam (pā. sū. 2. 1. 4. 2) iti samastaḥ piteveti śabdo madhyodāttaḥ |
śobhanamupāyanaṃ yasyeti bahuvrīhau nañsubhyām (pā. sū. 6. 2. 172) ityantodāttatvam |
agmīḻe ityādi sūktamiśramesya prātaranuvāke yathā viniyuktaṃ tathā vāyavā yāhi ityādistṛcāḥ praugaśastre viniyuktāḥ |
tatredaṃ cintyate, śāstraṃ kiṃ devatāsmaraṇarūpasaṃskārakarma kiṃ vā adṛṣṭaphalaṃ pradhānakarmeti |
tatra pūrvapakṣaṃ jaiminiḥ (jai. sū. 2. 1. 12-29) sūtrayāmāsa- stutaśastrayostu saṃskāro yājyādevatābhidhānatvāt iti ||
ājyaiḥ stuvate pṛṣṭhaiḥ stuvate praugaṃ śaṃsati niṣkevalyaṃ śaṃsati iti śrūyate |
tatra stutiḥ śaṃsanaṃ ca guṇaniṣṭha- guṇābhidhānam indrasya nu vīryāṇi pra vocam (ṛ. saṃ. 1. 32. 1) ityatra dṛṣṭatvāt |
evaṃ sati yājyānyāyena guṇinyā devatāyā abhidhāyakatvena stutaśastrayoḥ saṃskārarūpatvamabhyupeyam |
yājyāyāstadrūpatvaṃ daśamādhyāyasya caturthapāde (jai. sū. 10. 4. 39-41) dṛṣṭārthalāmena nirṇotam |
siddhāntī taṃ pakṣaṃ dūpayati- arthena svapakṛṣyeta devatānāmaśrodhanārthasya guṇabhūtatvāt iti |
tuśabdena saṃskāratvaṃ vārayati saṃskārapakṣe prayojanavaśene mantraḥ svasthānādākṛṣyeta |
mantragataṃ devatāvācakaṃ yadindrādināmāsti taccodanayā mantrarūpayā pratipādyasya devatārūpasyārthasya guṇabhūtam |
tasmān yatra pradhānabhūtadevatāsti tatra guṇabhūto mantro netavyaḥ |
tadyathā māhendragrahasannidhau abhi tvā śūra (ṛ. saṃ. 7. 32. 22) ityayaṃ pragātha āmnātaḥ |
sa cendraṃ prakāśayati na tu mahendram |
tadetat siddhāntinābhihitaṃ dūṣaṇaṃ pūrvapakṣī samādhatte- vaśāvaddhā guṇārthaṃ syāt iti |
yathā sā vā eṣā sarvadevatyā yajñā vaśā
vāyavyāmā labheta ' ( tai. saṃ. 3. 4. 3. 2 ) ityatra ajāvaśāśabdena codite karmaṇi chāgaśabdena kevalena yuktā nigamā vaśātvaguṇamapyupalakṣayanti tadvat |
yaduktaṃ vaśānyāyena rājanyāyena vāsya grahasyendro devatā yujyate iti tanna |
māhendragraha ityatra sāsya devatetyasminnarthe ' mahendrādgaṇau ca ' ( pā. sū. 4. 2. 29 ) iti mahendraśabdāt aṇpratyayo vihitaḥ |
tasmāt mahendra eva devatā na svindraḥ ||
yadīndro devatā syāt tadānīm aindragraha ityetāvataiva arthāvagatau māhendra iti mahattvaguṇo'narthakaḥ syāt |
indramahendrayordevatāyorbhedo yathā mahattvaguṇaḥ sārthakastathā yājyā- puronuvākyayorbhedo'pyasminneva pakṣe upapadyate |
' aindraṃ sānasim ' ( ṛ. saṃ. 1. 8. 1 ) ityādi ke indrasya yājyāpuronuvākye |
' mahā~ indro ya ojasā ' ( ṛ. saṃ. 8. 6. 1 ) ityādi ke mahendrasya ||
yā vaśā vidhivakye śrutā tasyā eva nigameṣu chāgaśabdena vyavahāro na viruddhaḥ |
evaṃ saṃskārapakṣe pragāthasyaindrakarmaṇyapakarṣa- prasaṅgāt taddhārayituṃ stotraśastrayoḥ pradhānakarmatvamiti siddhāntano matam ||
yataindraṃ karma tatra pragātho netavya ityayameva pakṣaḥ syāt |
aindro mantra indraṃ prakāśayituṃ samartha ityarthavān syāt |
' api vā śrutisaṃyogātprakaraṇe stotiśaṃsatī kriyautpattiṃ vidadhyātām ' iti |
stotidhātuḥ śaṃsatidhātuścetyāvubhāvapi svaprakaraṇe eva kasyāścit pradhānakriyāyā utpattiṃ vidadhyātām |
tathā hi guṇinamupasarjanīkṛtya tanniṣṭhānāṃ guṇānāṃ prādhānyena kathanaṃ stutiḥ |
yo devadattaḥ sa caturvedābhijña ityukte sarve janāḥ stutimavagacchanti |
' yaścaturvedābhijñanmākāraya ' ityukte stutiṃ na manyante kiṃtvājñāmaprādhānyameva budhyante |
evaṃ mantratvapi yā devatā seyamīdṛśaguṇopateti guṇaprādhānyavivakṣāyāṃ mukhyaḥ stotidhātvartho vidhīyate |
svalpakṣe tu yemīṭaguṇayuktā seyaṃ devateti devatāsmaraṇasya prādhānyādeyaṃ stutirna syāt |
tathā sati devanāprakāśane tātparyabhāvāt aindro'pi pragāthaḥ svaprakaraṇagate māhendrakarmaṇyevātiṣṭhate |
yadi devatāsmaraṇarūpaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ prayojanaṃ na labhyeta tarhyadṛṣṭamastu ||

1. tatra-pūrvahetusamuccayārthaḥ | 2. ga-gha-cha-ṇa-ta-tha-pha-ya-vyāvṛttyarthaḥ | 3. ga-gha-cha-ṇa- ya-pratīyate | 4. ṭha-mantre'pi | 5. ga gha-cha-ṇa-ya-vidhīyeta | 6. ṭha-mahendrakarmaṇyevā | 7. ga-gha- cha-ṭha-ṇa-pha-ya-devatāsmaraṇam |
'dvādaśāṣṭomasya stotrāṇi dvādaśa śastrāṇi' ityatra dvādaśaśabdena stotrāṇāṃ pṛthaktvamavagamyate |
devatāprakāśanapakṣe sarvairapi mantrasaṃghaiḥ kṛtasya prakāśanasyaikatvena dvādaśa- saṃkhyā na syāt |
codakaprāpteṣu stotraśastramantreṣvāgneyagrahānusāreṇa devatāpadasya uhe sati āgneyatvasiddheḥ |
teṣu tṛceṣu pratipādyā vāyvādayaḥ sarasvatyantāḥ saptasaṃkhyākāḥ praugaśastrasya devatā iti |
vāyavye tṛce prathamā grahasya aindravāyavasyaikā puronuvākyā |
etacca brāhmaṇe samāmnātaṃ- ‘vāyavyā pūrvā puronuvākyaindra- vāyavyuttarā’ (ai. brā. 2. 26) iti |
tathā sūtritaṃ ca- ‘vāyavā yāhi darśatendrāvāyū ime sutā ityanuvākye’⁵ (āśva. śrau. 5. 5) iti ||
vāyo iti | ā | yāhi | darśa | ime | somāḥ | araṃkṛtāḥ | teṣām | pāhi | śrudhi | havam || 1 ||
atra yāskaḥ- ‘vāyavā yāhi darśanīyeme somā araṃkṛtāsteṣāṃ piba śṛṇu no hvanam’ (niru. 10. 2) iti ||

araṃkṛtaśabde samāsāntodāttatvam (pā. sū. 6. 1. 223) bādhitvā avyayapūrvapadaprakṛtisvaraprāptau (pā. sū. 6. 2. 2) ‘bhūpaṇe'lam’ (pā. sū. 1. 4. 64) ityalaṃśabdasya gatisaṃjñāyāṃ ‘gatikāraka’ (pā. sū. 6. 2. 139) ityādinā kṛduttarapadaprakṛ- tisvaratve prāpte tadapavādatvena ‘gatiranantaraḥ’ (pā. sū. 6. 2. 49) iti pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaratvam |
havamityatra hvayatidhātoḥ ‘bahulaṃ chandasi’ (pā. sū. 6. 1. 34) iti saṃprasāraṇe sati ukārāntatvāt ‘ṛdorap’ (pā. sū. 3. 3. 57) iti appratyayaḥ |
saṃhitāyāṃ śrudhītyasya ‘anyenāmapi dṛśyate’ (pā. sū. 6. 3. 137) iti dīrghaḥ |
vāyo iti | ukthaiḥ | jarante | tvām | acchā | jaritāraḥ | sutasomāḥ | ahaḥ | vidaḥ || 2 ||
he ‘vāyo ‘jaritāraḥ stotāra ṛtvigyajamānāḥ ‘tvāmaccha tvāmabhilakṣya ‘ukthaiḥ ājyapraugā- diśastraiḥ ‘jarante stuvanti |
'arcita gāyati' ityādiṣu catuścatvāriṃśatsvaracitakemeṣu dhātuṣu 'jarate hyayati' (ni. 3. 14. 8) iti paṭhitam |
acchaśabdasya saṃhitāyāṃ 'nipātasya ca' (pā. sū. 6. 3. 136) iti dīrghaḥ |

aharvida ityatra samāsasvaraṃ (pā. sū. 6. 1. 223) bādhitvā 'tatpuruṣe tulyārthe' (pā. sū. 6. 2. 2) ityādinā dvitīyāpūrvapadaprakṛtisvare prāpte tadapavādatvena 'gatikārakopapadāt' (pā. sū. 6. 2. 139) iti kṛduttarapadaprakṛtisvaraḥ ||
vāyo tarva prapṛñcutī dhenāṃ jigāti dāśuṣe |
vāyo iti | tarva | prapṛñcutī | dhenā | jigāti | dāśuṣe | urūcī | somapītaye || 3 ||
he vāyo tava dhenā vāk somapītaye somapānārthaṃ dāśuṣe dāśvāṃsaṃ dattavantaṃ yajamānaṃ jigāti gacchati |
he yajamāna tvayā dattaṃ somaṃ pāsyāmītyevaṃ vāyubrūte ityarthaḥ |
prapṛñcatī prakarṣeṇa somasaṃparkaṃ kurvatī somaguṇaṃ varṇayantītyarthaḥ |
ye ye soma- yājinastān sarvān varṇayantītyarthaḥ ||
'ślokaḥ dhārā' ityādiṣu matapvāśassu vāṅnāmasu 'ghnaḥ dhenā mrāḥ' (ni. 1. 11. 39) iti paṭhitam |
'vartate ayate' ityādiṣu dvāviṃśādhikaśatasyeṣu gatikarmasu 'gāti jigāti' (ni. 2. 14. 113) iti paṭhitam |
urūcītyatra gaurāditvena (pā. sū. 4. 1. 41) ṅīpi kṛte pratyayasvaraḥ |
indravāyū iti | ime | sutāḥ | upa | prayaḥ | bhiḥ | ā | gatam | indvaḥ | vām | uśanti | hi ||4||
he indravāyū bhavadartham ime somāḥ sutāḥ abhiputāḥ |
tasmāt yuvāṃ prayaubhiḥ annairasmabhyaṃ dātavyaiḥ saha upa ā gatam, asmatsamīpaṃ prati āgacchatam |
hi yasmāt indvaḥ somāḥ vāṃ yuvām uśanti kāmayante tasmāt āgamanamucitam ||
gamidhātorlommadhyama- puruṣadvivacane 'bahula chandasi' (pā. sū. 2. 4. 73) iti śapo luki sati 'anudāttopadeśa' (pā. sū. 6. 4. 37) ityādinā makāralopaḥ |
'undī kledane' iti dhātoḥ 'undericcādeḥ' (u. sū. 1. 12) iti unpratyayaḥ |
uśantītyasya nighāte 'hi ca' (pā. sū. 8. 1. 34) iti sūtreṇa pratiṣiddhe sati pratyayasvaraḥ |
vāyvindraśca cethaḥ sutānāṃ vājinīvasū | tāvā yātum upa dravat || 5 || vāyo iti | indraḥ | ca | cethaḥ | sutānām | vājinīvasū iti vājinī'vasū | tau | ā | yātam | upa | dravat || 5 ||
he vāyo tvam indraśca yuvāmubhau sutānām abhiputān somān cethaḥ jānīthaḥ |
tau tathāvidhau yuvāṃ dravat kṣipram upa samīpe ā yātam āgacchatam |
pañcaviṃśatisaṃkhyākeṣu kṣipranāmasu ' nu kṣipraṃ makṣu dravat ' ( ni. 2. 15. 3 ) iti paṭhitam |
vāyvindraśca sunvat ā yātam upa niṣkṛtam | makṣvitthā dhiyā narā || 6 || vāyo iti | indraḥ | ca | sunvataḥ | ā | yātam | upa | niḥ'kṛtam | makṣu | itthā | dhiyā | narā || 6 ||
he vāyo tvam indraśca sunvataḥ somābhiṣavaṃ kurvato yajamānasya niṣkṛtaṃ saṃskṛtaṃ saṃskṛtāraṃ vo somam upa ā yātam āgacchatam |
narā he naro purugau pauruṣeṇa sāmarthyenopetau yuvayorāgatayośca satoḥ dhiyā amunā karmaṇā makṣu tvarayā saṃskāraḥ saṃpatsyate |
vāyo ityasya 'āmantritasya' ( pā. sū. 6. 1. 198 ) iti pākṣikamādyudāttatvam |
indraśabdaḥ ' ṛjendrā ' ( u. sū. 2. 186 ) ityādinā ranpratyayāntāvena nipānito ' jintyādirniyamyate ' ( pā. sū. 6. 1. 97 ) ityādyudāttaḥ |
sunvata ityatra ' śaturanumo nadyajādī ' ( pā. sū. 6. 1. 173 ) iti vibhakterudāttatvam |
' niśyeya samiyetasya sthāne ' ( niru. 12. 7 ) iti yāskaḥ |
kṛtaśabda ādikarmaṇi kartari ktaḥ ( pā. sū. 3. 4. 71 ) |
' kugatiprādayaḥ ' ( pā. sū. 2. 2. 18 ) iti samāse'vyayapūrvapadaprakṛtisvaratve prāpte ' thāthaghañktājabitrakāṇām ' ( pā. sū. 6. 2. 144 ) ityantodāttaḥ |
iti tu nisaḥ udāttatvaṃ na bhavati |
taddhi karmaṇi kte vihitam ( pā. sū. 6. 2. 38 ) |
niṣkarotīti niṣkṛditi kibantvyākhyāne tu, ' gatikākopapadātkṛt ' ( pā. sū. 6. 2. 139 ) iti ṛkāra udāttaḥ syāt |
' supāṃ suluk ' ( pā. sū. 7. 1. 39 ) ityādinā saṃbodhanadvivacanasya ḍādeśaḥ |
padātsvaratvāt ' āmantritasya ' ( pā. sū. 8. 1. 19 ) ityādyanmiko nighātaḥ ||
5. ca-cha-pha- ' syāt ' ityanantaraṃ ' dhīriti apa ityādi pāṇḍuśatau kamamu pāṭhataḥ ' ityādhikam |
‘mitraṃ huve’ iti maitrāvaruṇasya gavāmayane ārambhaṇīye caturviṃśe'hani prātaḥsavane maitrā- varuṇasya stotriyaḥ|
tathā cāśvalāyanena ‘caturviṃśe hotā'janiṣṭa’ ityādikhaṇḍe ‘mitraṃ vayaṃ havāmahe mitraṃ huve pūtadakṣam’ (āśva. śrau. 7. 2) ityādi sūtritam|
tethāha ‘abhiplavapṛṣṭhahāni’ iti khaṇḍe pariśiṣṭānāvāpānudṛśya ‘mitraṃ vayaṃ havāmahe mitraṃ huve pūtadakṣam’ (āśva. śrau. 7. 5) iti ca||
mitraṃ huve pūtadakṣaṃ varuṇaṃ ca riśādasam|
mitram| huve| pūtadakṣam| varuṇam| ca| riśādasam| dhiyam| ghṛtācīm| sādhantā ||7||
ahamasmin karmaṇi haviḥpradānāya pūtadakṣaṃ pavitrabalaṃ mitraṃ huve|
tathā riśādasaṃ riśānāṃ hiṃsa- kānām adasam attāraṃ varuṇaṃ ca huve āhvayāmi|
ghṛtamudakamicchati bhūmiṃ prāpa- yati yā dhīrvairpakramaṃ tāṃ ghṛtācīṃ dhiyaṃ sādhantā sādhayantau kurvantau||
huve iti hūyate: ‘bahula chandasi’ (pā. sū. 2. 4. 73) iti śapo luki sati ‘hvaḥ saṃprasāraṇam’ (pā. sū. 6. 1. 32) ityanuvṛttau ‘bahula chandasi’ (pā. sū. 6.1. 34) iti saṃprasāraṇe uvaḍādeśaḥ|
varuṇaśabdaḥ ‘kṛvṛdāribhya unan’ (u. sū.3. 333) iti unanpratyayānto nisvādādyudāttaḥ|
riśanti hiṃsantīti riśāḥ śatravaḥ: ‘igupadhajñāprīkiraḥ kaḥ’ (pā. sū. 3. 1. 135) iti kaḥ|
śeṣanighāte sati ‘ekādeśa udāttenodāttaḥ’ (pā. sū.8.2.5) iti savarṇadīrgho'pyudātta eva|
‘ṛtvigdadhak’ (pā. sū. 3. 2. 59) ityādinā kvini ‘anidi- tām’ (pā. sū. 6. 4. 24) iti nakāralopaḥ|
ghṛtaśabdaḥ ‘naḍivapayasthānisantasya’ (phi. sū. 26) ityādyudāttaṃ bādhitvā ‘ghṛtā- dīnāṃ ca’ (phi. sū. 21) ityantodāttaḥ|

‘samāsasya’ (pā. sū. 6. 1. 223) ityantodātta- syāpavādakaṃ ‘tatpuruṣe tulyārthe’ (pā. sū. 6. 2. 2) itipūrvapadaprakṛtisvaraṃ bādhitvā ‘gatikāra- kopapadāt’ (pā. sū. 6. 2. 139) iti uttarapadaprakṛtisvareṇodāttasya dhātvakārasya lope sati ‘anudāttasya ca yatrodāttalopaḥ’ (pā. sū. 6. 1. 161) iti ṅīp udāttatve prāpte ‘cau’ (pā. sū. 6. 1. 222) iti pūrvapadāntodāttatvam|
‘rādha sādha saṃsiddhau’ ityasmādantarbhā- vitaṇyarthāt laṭaḥ śatrādeśe (pā. sū. 3. 2. 124) śaṃ bādhitvā vyatyayena śap|
dvitīyādvivacanasya śapaśca ‘anudāttau suppitau’ (pā. sū. 3. 1. 4) ityanudāttatve ‘dhātoḥ’ (pā. sū. 6. 1. 162) iti dhātusvara eva śiṣyate|
atastayoḥ satyeva parasparānvaye parāṅgadbhāvena bhavitavyaṃ 'samarthaḥ padavidhiḥ' (pā. sū. 2. 1. 1) iti niyamāt |
śrutidvisara- svatipadayośca na paraspareṇānvayaḥ kiṃtu sacata ityanena ityasāmarthyāt na parāṅgadbhāvaḥ |
prakṛte tu mitrā- varuṇau ṛtāvṛdhau iti dvayorapi sāmānādhikaraṇyena parasparānvayādastisāmarthyamiti bhavitavyaṃ parāṅga- dbhāvena |
nanu ata eva tarhi mitrāvaruṇapadasya parāṅgadbhāvena pādāditvāt 'apādādau' iti paryudāsādā manvitanighāto na syāditi cet, na |
pūrvaṃ subantaṃ paraṃ cāmantritamāśritya yaḥ svaraḥ pravartate tala 'subāmantrita' iti parāṅgadbhāvaḥ |
mitrāvaruṇapadanighātastu pūrvameva padamupajīvati na parāmantritamiti na parāṅgadbhāvaḥ ||
nanu parāṅgadbhāvannighāto'pi padavidhi- riti ṛtena ityanenāsāmarthyāt tataḥ padātparasya mitrāvaruṇapadasya na syāt iti cet, na |
'samānavākye nighātayuṣmadasmadādeśā vaktavyāḥ' (pā. sū. 2. 1. 1. 11) iti nighāte padavidhāvapi samānavākya- tvameva paryāptaṃ, na parāṅgadbhāvavat parasparānvayo'pītyalam |
kavī iti | naḥ | mitrāvaruṇā | tuvi'jātā | uru'kṣayā | dakṣam | dadhate iti | apasam ||9||
mitrāvaruṇāvetau devau naḥ asmākaṃ dakṣaṃ balam apasaṃ karma ca dadhate poṣayataḥ |
'vipraḥ dhīraḥ' ityā- diṣu caturviṃśatisaṃkhyākeṣu medhāvināmasu 'kaviḥ manīṣī' (ni. 3. 15. 10) iti paṭhitam |
'uru tuvi' (ni. 3. 1. 1, 2) ityetau śabdau dvādaśasu bahunāmasu paṭhitau |
'ojaḥ vājaḥ' ityā- diṣu aṣṭāviṃśatisaṃkhyākeṣu balanāmasu 'dakṣaḥ vīḻu' (ni. 2. 9. 13) iti paṭhitam |
bahunāmupakārakatayā tatsambandhitvena jātāviti ṣaṣṭhī- samāse samāsāntodāttatvam |
caturthī samāse hi 'ke ca' (pā. sū. 6. 2. 45) iti pūrvapadaprakṛti- svaraḥ syāt |
