adhikaraṇe 'erac' (pā. sū. 3. 3. 56) ityacpratyayāntasya 'citaḥ' (pā. sū. 6. 1. 163) ityantodāttatve prāpte 'kṣayo nivāse' (pā. sū. 6. 1. 201) ityādyudāttatvaṃ vihitam |

samāse tu 'samāsasya' (pā. sū. 6. 1. 223) ityantodāttatvaṃ bādhitvā kṛduttarapadaprakṛtisvareṇa prāpta- muttarapadādyudāttatvaṃ yadyapi thāthādisvareṇāntodāttena bādhyate, tathāpi 'parādiśchandasi bahulam' (pā. sū. 6. 2. 199) ityuttarapadādyudāttatvaṃ draṣṭavyam |
'āpaḥ karmākhyāyāṃ hrasvo nucca vā' (u. sū. 4. 647) ityasunnantasya 'apasaspāre' (ṛ. saṃ. 6. 69. 1) ityādau nisvādādyudāttasyāpi apaḥśabdasya atra vyatyayena prāyayādyudāttatvam ||
tatra āśvinastṛcaḥ prātaranuvākasya āśvine kratau viniyuktaḥ |
tathā ca sūtritam—‘athāśvina eṣo upāḥ prātaryujeti catasro'śvinā yajvarīripaḥ’ ( āśva. śrau. 4. 15 ) iti |
aśvinā | yajvarīḥ | iṣaḥ | dravatpāṇī iti dravat'pāṇī | śubhaḥ | patī iti | puru'bhujā | canasyatam || 1 ||
he aśvinau yuvām ‘ipaḥ’ havirlakṣaṇā'nnani ‘canasyatam’ icchataṃ bhuñjāthāmityarthaḥ |
yadyapi canaḥ- śabdo'nnavācī tathāpi iṣaḥ ityanena saha nāsti punaruktadoṣaḥ |
yāgakaraṇānāmapyannānām ‘asibhinati’ itivat svavyāpāre kartṛtvavivakṣayā ‘suyajordvinip’ ( pā. sū. 3. 2. 103 ) iti ḍinipratyayaḥ |
‘vano ra ca’ ( pā. sū. 4. 1. 7 ) iti ṅīp |
pratyayadvayasya ‘anudāttau suppitau’ ( pā. sū. 3. 1. 4 ) ityanudāttatvāt dhātusvara evāvaśiṣyate |
dravantau dhāvantau pāṇī yayostayoḥ sambodhane dravapāṇī iti |
tasyāmantritādyudāttatvaṃ na punarātmiko nighātaḥ ‘apādādau’ iti pratiṣedhāt |
iṣaḥ iti pūrvapadasya ‘subāmantrita’ ( pā. sū. 2. 1. 2 ) iti parāṅgavadbhāvena ‘mitrāvaruṇāvṛtāvṛdhau’ itivat apādāditvamiti cet, na |
iha tu iṣaḥ dravatpāṇī ityanayoḥ sarasvatīstutidrupadavat asāmarthyena prayuktatvāt |
śubhaḥ iti ‘śubha śubhram dīptau’ ityasya saṃpadāditvāt bhāve kvibantasya ṣaṣṭhyekavacanam |
‘padhyāḥ patiputra’ ( pā. sū. 8. 3. 53 ) iti visarjanīyasya satvam |
tasya patī iṣyāmantrita pare : parāṅgadbhāvāt āmantritādyudāttatvam |
tasmin kartavye dravatpāṇī iti pūrvasyāmantritasya ‘āmantritaṃ pūrvamavidyamānavat’ ( pā. sū. 8. 1. 72 ) ityavidyamānatvāt pādāditvāt ‘apādādau’ iti pratiṣedhāt ||
nanu ‘mitrāvaruṇā- vṛtāvṛdhau’ itivat ‘nāmantrita samānādhikaraṇe’ ( pā. sū. 8. 1. 73 ) ityavidyamānatva- pratiṣedhena bhavitavyamiti cet, na |
dravatpāṇī padaṃ tu na tatheti vaiṣamyāta |

canasyatam dṛśyatra ‘cāyateraśca hasvaśca’ ( u. sū. 4. 639 ) iti ‘cāyū pūjāniśāmanayoḥ’ ityasya asunpratyaye ākārasya hasvaṃ cānukṛṣṭe nuḍāgame ca ( u. sū. 4. 636 ) ‘lopo vyorvali’ ( pā. sū. 6. 1. 66 ) iti yakāralope canaḥśabdo'nnāmasu paṭhitaḥ ( nigha0 6. 16 ) |
sat ātmanaḥ icchatīti ‘supa ātmanaḥ kyac’ ( pā. sū. 3. 1. 8 ) |
śapā ekādeśe kṛte ‘ ekā- deśa udāttenodāttaḥ ’ (pā. sū. 8. 2. 5) ityudāttaḥ|
na ca ‘ tiṅṅatiṅaḥ ’ (pā. sū. 8. 1. 28) iti nighātaḥ|
aśvinā | purudaṃsasā | narā | śavīrayā | dhiyā | dhiṣṇyā | vanatam | giraḥ || 2 ||
aśvinā he aśvinau yuvāṃ giraḥ asmadīyāḥ stutīḥ dhiyā ādarayuktayā buddhyā vanataṃ saṃbhajataṃ svīkurutam|
purudaṃsasā ityapi hi pādādireva ‘ āma- ntritaṃ pūrvamavidyamānavat ’ (pā. sū. 8. 1. 72) iti pūrvasyāvidyamānavattvāt|
‘ nāmantrite samānādhikaraṇe ’ (pā. sū. 8. 1. 73) iti pūrvasya sāmānyavacanatvena asya viśeṣavacanatvāt nāvidyamānavattvamiti cet, na|
adhiśabdavat purudaṃsaḥśabdasyāpi aśvinoraiva rūḍhyā prayujyamānatayā sāmānyaśabdatvāt|
ubhayoḥ sāmānyavacanatve paryāyatvena paunaruktyāt sahāprayoga iti cet, na|
guṇaviśeṣasaṃkīrtanavat prasiddhanā- kanāmaviśeṣasambandhasaṃkīrtanasyāpi stutyupayogena saprayojanatvāt; niṣprayojanapunarvacanasyaiva punaruktatvāt|
adhi- śabdasyāśvasambandho nimittaṃ purudaṃsaḥśabdasya tu bahukarmasambandha iti pravṛttinimittabheda iti cet, na|

ata eva hi ‘ iḍe rante'dite sarasvati priye preyasi mahi viśruyetāni te agniye nāmāni ’ (tai. saṃ. 7. 1. 6. 8) ityatra sahasratamīpraśaṃsopayogi- tvena iḍādiśabdānām ‘ etāni te agniye nāmāni ’ iti vacanena paryāyāṇāmapi anekaviśiṣṭanāma- sambandhanivandhanastulyatvenaiva sahaprayogaḥ|

stutyupayogenaiva vyutpattinimittabhedavivakṣāyāmapi paryāyatve- nāsāmānādhikaraṇyādeva ‘ nāmantrite ’ iti niṣedhābhāvāt ‘ āmantritaṃ pūrvamavidyamānavat ’ iti pūrvapūrvasyāvidyamānavattvāt sarveṣāṃ pāṣṭhikamāyudāttatvam|
‘ kṛṣpṛkaṭīpa- ṭiśauṭibhya īran ’ (u. sū. 4. 470) ityataḥ ‘ īran ’ ityanuvṛttau ‘ bahulavacanādanyatrāpi ’ ityanena ‘ śu gatau ’ iti dhātorīranpratyaye kṛte sati niśtvāt śavīrayāśabda ādyudāttaḥ|
dhiye- tyatra ‘ sāvekācaḥ ’ (pā. sū. 6. 1. 168) iti vibhaktirudāttā|
vanatamityatra śapaḥ pistvāt lopamadhyamadvivacanasya lasārvadhātukatvāt ‘ vana paṇa saṃbhaktau ’ iti dhātudāttatvameva śiṣyate|
na ca ‘ tiṅṅatiṅaḥ ’ (pā. sū. 8. 1. 28) iti nighātaḥ; pūrvamāmantritasyāvidyamānavattvena pādāditvāt|
dastrā | yuvākavaḥ | sutāḥ | nāsatyā | vṛkta'barhiṣaḥ | ā | yātam | rudravartanī iti rudra'vartanī || 3 ||
'sutāḥ' yuṣmadarthaṃ somā abhiṣutāḥ tān svīkartumiti śeṣaḥ |

dravati iti vendau ramata iti vendhe bhūtānīti vā tadyadaṃ prāṇe: sanaiścantadindrasevendratvamiti vijñāvata idaṃ- karaṇādityāprāyaṇa idaṃdarśanādisaupamanyava indatevaidharyakarmaṇa icchantrāṃ dārayitā vā drāvayitā vādarayitā ca yavanām' ( niru. 10. 8 ) iti |
irāmannuddiśya tanniṣpādakajalasiddhayarthaṃ daṇāti meghaṃ vidīrṇaṃ karotītīndra: |
irāmannaṃ tṛptikāraṇaṃ sasyaṃ dadhāti jalapradānena puṣṇātītīndra: |
bhūtāni prāṇidehān indhe jīvacaitanyarūpeṇānta: praviśya dīpayatītīndra: |
etadevābhipretya vājasaneyina āmananti- 'indho ha vai nāma yo'yaṃ dakṣiṇe'kṣanpuruṣa: |
parokṣeṇa parokṣapriyā iva hi devā: pratyakṣadviṣa: ' ( bṛ. u. 4. 2. 2 ) iti |
yadyasmāt kāraṇādenaṃ paramātmarūpamindraṃ devaṃ prāṇe: vākcakṣurādīndriyai: prāṇāpānādivāyubhiśca sahitaṃ samaindhan upāsakā dhyānena samyak prakāśitavanta:, tat tasmāt kāraṇāt indranāma saṃpannam |
asmin pakṣe idhyate dīpyate iti karmaṇi vyutpatti: |
idam itthāparokṣyamucyate vivekena hi paramātmānamāparokṣyeṇa paśyati |
etadevābhipretya āraṇyakāṇḍe samāmnāyate-'sa etameva puruṣaṃ brahma tatamamapaśyadidamadarśīmitī |
tasmādindro nāmendro ha vai nāma tamidandraṃ santamindra ityācakṣate parokṣeṇa parokṣapriyā iva hi devā: ' ( ai. ā. 2. 4. 3 ) iti |
anenābhipretyaṇa śrūyate-'indro māyābhi: pururūpa īyate ' ( ṛ. saṃ. 6. 47. 18 ) iti |
inaśabdasyeśvaravācakasya akāralopa sati nakārāntam in iti padaṃ bhavati |
sa ca parameśvara: śatrūṇāṃ dārayitā bhīṣayi- tetīndra: |
svāmi- cchantītyarthe yuṣmacchabdāt ' supa ātmana: kyac ' ( pā. sū. 3. 1. 8 ) |
'kyācchandasi ' ( pā. sū. 3. 2. 170 ) iti kyaja- ntāt upratyaya: |
svayave iti prāptau 'yuṣmadasmadoranādeśe ' ( pā. sū. 7. 2. 86 ) ityavibhaktā- vapi halādau vyatyayena āvam |
'voto guṇavacanāt ' ( pā. sū. 4. 1. 44 ) iti ṅīpi prāpte vyatyayena ṅīn |
1. ṭha-irāmannakāraṇam | 2. ta-somavalīrasa: | 3. ṭha-tacca | 4. ca-cha-ta-tha-pha- 'yudāttatvam | 5. gha-ca-kṣa-ta-tha-tvasyatra; cha-ṇa-ya-tvayava |
indrā yāhi dhiyeṣito viprajūtaḥ sutāvataḥ | upaṃ brahmāṇi vāghataḥ || 5 || indra | ā | yāhi | dhiyā | iṣitaḥ | vipra'jūtaḥ | suta'vataḥ | upaṃ | brahmāṇi | vāghataḥ || 5 ||
he indra svam ā yāhi asmin karmaṇyāgaccha |
vāghataḥ ṛtvijaḥ brahmāṇi veda- rūpāṇi stotrāṇyupaitum |
dhiyā asmadīyayā prajñayā iṣitaḥ prāptaḥ asmadyakṣyā prerita ityarthaḥ |
caturviṃśatisaṃkhyākeṣu medhāvināmasu 'vipraḥ dhīraḥ' ( ni.3.15. 1 ) iti paṭhitam |
'āgamā anudāttāḥ' ( pā. ma. 3.1.3. 7 ) iti iṭaḥ anudāttatvāt kasvaraḥ śiṣyate |
'ḍuvap bījasaṃtāne' iti dhātoḥ 'ṛtendrāpravatravipra' ( u. sū. 2.166 ) ityādinā ranpratyayānto vipraśabdo nipātitaḥ |
indrā yāhi tūtajān upa brahmāṇi harivaḥ | sute dadhiṣva naścanaḥ || 6 || indra | ā | yāhi | tūtajān | upa | brahmāṇi | hari'vaḥ | sute | dadhiṣva | naḥ | canaḥ ||6||
hariśabdaḥ indrasambandhinoraśvayornāmadheyaṃ 'harī indrasya rohito'meḥ' ( ni. 1.15. 1 ) iti tadīyādhvanāmatvena paṭhitatvāt |
he harivaḥ adhvayukta indra tvaṃ brahmāṇi upaitum ā yāhi kīdṛśa- svam |
āgatya ca asmin sute somābhipavayukte karmaṇi naḥ asmadīyaṃ canaḥ annaṃ havirlakṣaṇaṃ dadhiṣva dhāraya svīkurvityarthaḥ ||
hariva ityatra harayo'sya santīti matupi 'chandasīraḥ' ( pā. sū. 8.2.15 ) iti makārasya vatvam |
saṃbuddhau 'ugi- dacām' ( pā. sū. 7.1.70 ) iti num |
saṃyogāntalope ( pā. sū. 8.2.23 ) nakārasya 'matuvaso ru saṃbuddhau chandasi' ( pā. sū. 8.3.1 ) iti rutvam |

brahmā- ṇītyasya hariva ityanenāsāmarthyāt 'samarthaḥ padavidhiḥ' ( pā. sū. 2.1.1 ) iti niyamāt subā- mantritaparāṅ‌vadbhāvābhāvena āmantritanighātābhāvāt āyudāttatve sati upa iti akārasthe sannataraḥ |
4. ga-gha- ca-ṇa-pha- ya-'mantrita parāṅ‌vadvā' ; ya-'mantrita iti parāṅ‌vadvā' |

‘chandasyubhayathā’ (pā. sū. 3. 4. 117) iti sārvadhātukārdhadhātukasaṃjñayoḥ satyoḥ sārvadhātukatvena śapi (pā. sū. 3. 1. 68) tasya luau ca dvirbhāvaḥ (pā. sū. 6. 1. 10), ārdhadhātukatvena iḍāgamaśca (pā. sū. 7. 2. 35) |
omāsaḥ | carṣaṇīdhṛtaḥ | viśve | devāsaḥ | ā | gata | dāśvāṃsaḥ | dāśuṣaḥ | sutam ||7||
he viśve devāsaḥ etannāmakā devaviśeṣāḥ dāśuṣaḥ havirdattavato yajamānasya sutam abhiṣutaṃ somaṃ prati ā gata āgacchata |
te ca devāḥ omāsaḥ rakṣakāḥ carṣaṇīdhṛtaḥ manuṣyāṇāṃ dhārakāḥ dāśvāṃsaḥ phalasya dātāraḥ |

etāmantra yāsta eva vyākhyātavān- ‘avitāro vāvanīyā vā manuṣyaprattaḥ sarve ca devā ihāgacchanta dattavanto dattavataḥ sutamiti tadetadekameva vaiśvadevaṃ gāyatraṃ tṛcaṃ daśatīyeṣu vidyate yatu kiṃciddhahudaivataṃ tadvaiśvadevānāṃ sthāne yujyate yadeva viśvaliṅgamiti śākapūṇiḥ’ (niru. 12. 40) iti |
atra viśvaśabdaḥ sarvaśabdaparyāya iti yāskasya matam |
pūrvasyāmantritasya sāmānyavacanasya ‘vibhāṣitaṃ viśeṣavacane bahuvacanam’ (pā. sū. 8. 1. 74) iti avidyamānavatpratiṣedhāt apādāditvena nighātaḥ |
nanu ata eva vidyamānatvāt ‘subāmantrita’ (pā. sū. 2. 1. 2) iti parāṅgavattvenaikapadābhāvāt padādaparatvena kathaṃ nighātaḥ iti cet, na |
‘vaskaraṇaṃ svāśrayamapi yathā syāt’ (pā. ma. 8. 1. 72) iti vacanāt padabhedaprayuktasya nighātāsyāpyupapatteḥ |
aikapadye'pyādyudāttatve ‘anudāttaṃ padamekavarjam’ (pā. sū. 6. 1. 158) iti mutarāmeva nighāto bhaviṣyati |
itthameva tarhi ‘dravatpāṇī śubhravatī’ ityatrāpi parāṅgavattvenaikapadādyuttarasya śeṣanighātaprasaṅga iti cet, na |
tatra parāṅgavattvasya pareṇa ‘āmantritaṃ pūrvamavidyamānavat’ (pā. sū. 8. 1. 72) ityavidyamānavatvena bādhitatvāt |
iha punaḥ ‘vibhāṣitaṃ viśeṣavacane bahuvacanam’ ityavidyamānavatvasya niṣedhāt |
gaṇadevatāvācanaścātra viśvaśabdo na sarva śabdaparyāya iti viśeṣyaparatayā sāmānyavacanatvāt omāsaḥ ityanena na sāmānādhikaraṇyam |
sāmānādhikaraṇye hi pūrvasya pādasya parāṅgavattve sati ‘mitrāvaruṇāvṛtavṛdhau’ ityādāviva atrāpyāmantritāyudāttatā na syāt |
nanu ‘avayavaprasiddheḥ samudāyaprasiddhirbalīyasī’ (paribhā0 98) iti rūḍha evārtho devaśabdasya grāhyo na yaugikaḥ |
samudāyaprasiddhau tu na vikṣepa iti cet, na |

samudāyaprasiddhau hi devaśabdasya sāmānyaparatayā viśeṣavacanatvābhāvāt ‘vibhāpitaṃ viśeṣa- vacanaṃ bahuvacanam’ ityanenānidiṣṭatvāt viśve hyasyavidyamānatvena śubhaspatī iti padavat devāsaḥ ityasyāpi ādyudāttatvaṃ syāt |
svarānusāreṇa ca rūḍhityāgenāpi devaśabdasya yogasvīkāro yukta eva |
‘bahula chandasi’ (pā. sū. 2. 4. 73) iti śapo luki sati ‘anudāttaupadeśa’ (pā. sū. 6. 4. 37) ityādinā makāralopaḥ |
‘dāṣṭra dāne’ ityasya ksau ‘dāśvān sāhvān mīḍhvāṃsa’ (pā. sū. 6. 1. 12) iti nipātanāt krādi- niyamaprāptaḥ iḍāgamo (pā. sū. 7. 2. 13) dvivacanaṃ ca na bhavati |
dāśuṣa ityatra ‘vasoḥ saṃprasāraṇam’ (pā. sū. 6. 4. 131) iti saṃprasāraṇam |
viśve devāso apturaḥ sutamā gantu tūrṇyaḥ |
devāsaḥ | apturaḥ | sutam | ā | gantu | tūrṇyaḥ | ustrāḥ'iva | svasarāṇi || 8 ||
viśveṣāṃ devānāṃ somaṃ prati āgamane ustrā ityādidṛṣṭāntaḥ |
^ustrāḥ sūryyaraśmayaḥ ^svasarāṇi ahāni prati ālasyarahitā yathā samāgacchanti tadvat |
‘khedayaḥ’ ityādiṣu pañcadaśasu raśmināmasu ‘ustrā vasavaḥ’ (ni. 1. 5. 9) iti paṭhitam |
‘vastoḥ’ ityādiṣu dvādaśavahanāmasu ‘svasarāṇi dhraṃsaḥ gharmaḥ’ (ni. 1. 9. 5) iti paṭhitam |
tacca padaṃ yāskena vyākhyātaṃ— ‘svasarāṇyahāni bhavanti svayaṃsā- rīṇyapi vā svarādityo bhavati sa enāni sārayati |
ustrā iva svasarāṇītyapi nigamo bhavati’ (niru. 5. 4) iti ||
tutarati svarayantītyarthe ‘kvip ca’ (pā. sū. 3. 2. 76) iti kvip |
tasya ‘tasanasanathanāśca’ (pā. sū. 7. 1. 45) iti tabādeśe ‘apit’ (pā. sū. 1. 2. 4) iti niṣedhāt aṅiṅatvāt anunāsikalopābhāvaḥ |
‘jitvarā saṃbhrame’ iti dhātoḥ svarante iti tūrṇyaḥ |
ustrā iva ityatra ‘ivena’ vibhaktyalopaḥ pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaratvaṃ ca (pā. sū. 2. 1. 4 2) iti samāse pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaratvaṃ nityam |
svaḥ saro yeṣāṃ tāni svasarāṇi ahāni |
‘bahuvrīhau prakṛtyā pūrvapadam’ (pā. sū. 6. 2. 1) iti svaśabda ādyudāttaḥ ||

vviśve vdevāsa: etannāmakā devaviśeṣā: vmedhaṃ haviryajñasaṃbaddhaṃ vjuṣanta sevantām|
saucīkamabhimapsu praviṣṭam ‘ehi mā yāsī: ’ iti yadavocan tadanukaraṇahetuko'yaṃ viśeṣaṇa devānāṃ vyapadeśa ehimāyāsa iti|
vadruha: droharahitā: vvahnaya: voḍhāro dhanānāṃ prāpayitāra:|
stridhe: kṣayarathasya śoṣaṇārthasya vā saṃpadādibhyo bhāve kvipa (pā. sū. 3. 3. 108. 9) nañā bahuva
punātītyarthe ṇuli ‘pratyayasthātkātpūrvasyāta idāpyasupaḥ’ (pā. sū. 7. 3. 44) iti isvasyābhāvo'ntodāttatvaṃ ca chāndasaṃ draṣṭavyam |
tāḥ kriyā yasyāḥ santi sā sarasvatī vājinīvatī |

tatra 'endra sānasim' ityādikaṃ prathamaṃ daśacaṃ sūktaṃ 'surupa- kṛnum' ityādiṣu paṭ pañcamam |

sūtritaṃ ca- 'indramidrāthino bṛhadendra sānasim' (āśva. śrau. 6. 4) iti |
darśayāge indrayājinaḥ sāṃnāyyasya anuvākyā 'endra sānasiṃ rayim' iti |
'uktā devatāḥ' ityasmin khaṇḍe 'endra sānasiṃ rayiṃ pra samāhipe puruhūta śatrūn' (āśva. śrau. 1. 6) iti sūtritam ||

'te prāgdhātoḥ' (pā. sū. 1. 4. 80) iti dhātoḥ prāk prayoktavyasya āṅaḥ 'vyavahitāśca' (pā. sū. 1. 4. 82) iti chandasi vyavahitaprayogaḥ ||

he śatakrato bahukarman bahuprajña vā indra tvāṃ gāyatriṇaḥ udgātāraḥ gāyanti stuvanti |
arkiṇaḥ arcanahetumantrayuktā hotāraḥ arkam arcanīyamindram arcanti śāstratarmantraiḥ praśaṃsanti |
brahmāṇaḥ brahmā- prabhṛtaya indre brāhmaṇāḥ tvām ut yemire unnatiṃ prāpayanti |
yathā vaṃśāmre nṛtyantaḥ śilpinaḥ prauḍhaṃ vaṃśamunnata kurvanti |
yathā vā sanmārgavartinaḥ svakīyaṃ kulamunnata kurvanti tadvat |
etāmṛcaṃ yāska evaṃ vyācaṣṭe- 'gāyanti tvā gāyatriṇaḥ prārcanti te'rkamarkiṇo brāhmaṇāstvā śatakrata uyemire vaṃśamiva |

āgamya ca stomān udgāt- prayuktāni stotrāṇi abhi svara abhilakṣya praśārūpaṃ śabdaṃ kuru |
tathā hotṛprayuktāni śastrāṇyalakṣya ruva śabdaṃ kuru |
tata ūrdhvaṃ naḥ asmākaṃ brahma ca annaṃ ca yajñaṃ ca anuṣṭhīyamānaṃ karma ca sacā saha vardhaya |
sāṅgaravasaṃpādanena yajñaṃ vardhayitvā tatphalamannaṃ ca pravṛddhaṃ kuru |

nisaḥ sakāreṇa iṇo vyavadhāne chāndasatvādanādya 'upasargātsunoti' (pā. sū. 8. 3. 65) ityādinā dhātu- sakārasya patvam |
nimaḥ sakārasya 'punā puḥ' (pā. sū. 8. 4. 41) iti patvam |
kudrahaṇe gatikārakapūrvasyāpi grahaṇāt punaḥ kārakasamāse'pi sa eva svaraḥ |
namo nakārasya 'naśca dhātusthorupabhyaḥ' (pā. sū. 8. 4. 27) iti saṃhitāyāṃ ṇatvam |

atra hi indrakartṛkaṃ rāraṇam uvathaśāsanasya kartavyatve hetuḥ |
tasya carkarītaṃ parasmaipadam adādivacca draṣṭavyam iti adādidvāvāt 'adiprabhṛtibhyaḥ śapaḥ' iti prāpto luk 'bahulaṃ chandasi' iti niṣidhyate |
śapā lasārvadhātukasya vyavadhānāt tatra parato vidhīyamānam 'abhyastānāmādiḥ' (pā. sū. 6. 1. 189) ityādyudāttatvaṃ na bhavati |

tatra bhaṃmajñāyāṃ 'yasyeti ca' (pā. sū. 6. 4. 148) iti ikāra- lopaḥ |

he girvaṇaḥ asmadīyastutibhāgindra viśvataḥ sarveṣu karmasu prayujyamānāḥ imāḥ giraḥ asmadīyāḥ stutayaḥ tvā tvāṃ pari bhavantu sarvataḥ prāpnuvantu | kīdṛśyo giraḥ | vṛddhāyumanu pravṛddhenāyuṣyopetaṃ tvāmanusṛtya vṛddhayaḥ vardhamānāḥ | kiṃ ca etā giraḥ juṣṭāḥ tvayā sevitāḥ satyaḥ juṣṭayaḥ asmākaṃ prītihetavaḥ bhavantu || girvaṇaḥ | gīrbhirvyanata iti girvaṇaḥ | 'vana paṇa saṃbhaktau' | 'sarvadhātubhyo'sun' | giraḥ | upadhāyā dīrghabhāvaśchandasaḥ | āmantritanighātaḥ | viśvataḥ | 'liti' (pā. sū. 6. 1. 193) iti pratyayātpūrvasyodāttatvam | vṛddhāyum | 'vṛdha vṛddhau' | ktapratyayaḥ | 'udito vā' (pā. sū. 7. 2. 56) iti iṭaḥ vatvāpratyaye vikalpitatvāt 'yasya vibhāṣā' (pā. sū. 7. 2. 15) iti niṣṭhāyām iḍabhāvaḥ | pratyayasvaraḥ | 'haṇ gatau' | 'chandasīna' (u. sū. 1. 2) iti uṇ | ṇiśvāt vṛddhiḥ | āyādeśaśca | vṛddhamāyuryasya | bahuvrīhau pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaratvam | vṛddhayaḥ | vṛdheḥ ktini 'titutratathasisusarakaseṣu ca' (pā. sū. 7. 2. 9) iti iḍabhāvaḥ | niśvā- dādyudāttatvam | juṣṭāḥ | 'śrīdito niṣṭhāyām' (pā. sū. 7. 2. 14) iti iḍabhāvaḥ | 'juṣṭāpite' ityanuvṛttau 'nityaṃ mantre' (pā. sū. 6. 1. 210) ityādyudāttatvam | juṣṭayaḥ | 'jupī prītiseva- nayoḥ' | ktin | 'titutra' iti iḍabhāvaḥ | niśvādādyudāttaḥ || || 20 ||

yajeḥ ' tumarthe sesena ' ( pā. sū. 3. 4. 9 ) ityādinā tavenpratyayaḥ |
naktopāsā | su'peśasā | asmin | yajñe | upa | hvaye | idam | nau | barhiḥ | ā'sadai ||7||
dvitīyādvivacanasya ' supāṃ suluk ' ( pā. sū. 7. 1. 39 ) iti ākāraḥ |
' devatādvandve ca ' ( pā. sū. 6. 2. 141 ) iti pūrvottarapadayoḥ yugapat prakṛtisvaratvam |
ntodāttatvasya apavādatvena ‘ādyudāttaṃ ścacchandasi’ (pā. sū. 6. 2. 119) ityuttarapadādyu- dāttatvam|
āṅpūrvāt asmāt saṃpadādibhyo bhāve kip (pā. sū. 3. 3. 108. 1) |
tā sujihvā upa haye hotārā daivyā kavī |
tā | sujihvā | upa | haye | hotārā | daivyā | kavī iti | yajñam | naḥ | yakṣatām | imam ||8||
ata eva imau agnī daivyahotṛnāmako ^kavī medhāvinau ||
dvi- vacane ‘ṛto ṅi’ (pā. sū. 7. 3. 110) iti guṇaḥ|
loṭi śapi parataḥ ‘mibbahula leṭi’ (pā. sū. 3. 1. 34) iti bahulagrahaṇāt sip|
iḻā | sarasvatī | mahī | tisraḥ | devīḥ | mayaḥbhuvaḥ | barhiḥ | sīdantu | asridhaḥ ||9||
atra mahīśabdo mahattvaguṇayuktāṃ bhāratīmācaṣṭe; anyeṣu āprīsūkteṣu sadṛśeṣu iḻā sarasvatī bhāratī iti āgnātatvāt|
‘ṭāpaṃ cāpi halantānāṃ yathā vācā diśā niśā ’ (kau. 2. 4. 82) iti ṭāp|
‘tasau matvarthe’ (pā. sū. 1. 4. 19) iti bhāvena padatvasya bādhitatvāt ratvādyabhāvaḥ|
triṣadāt jasi ‘tricanuroḥ striyāṃ tisṛcatasra’ (pā. sū. 7. 2. 99) iti tistrādeśaḥ|
tisṛbhyo jasaḥ’ (pā. sū. 6. 1. 166) iti jasa udāttatvam|
niṣiddhaṃ dīrghatvaṃ ' vā chandasi ' (pā. sū. 6. 1. 106) iti pakṣe'bhyanujñāyate |
midheḥ hiṃsārthasya śoṣapārthasya vā saṃpadādibhyo bhāve kvipi nañā bahuvrīhiḥ |
panīmayāje tvaṣṭuḥ puronuvākyā ' iha tvaṣṭāramapriyam ' iti |
' śaṃ yuvākāya saṃrepitaḥ ' iti maṇḍe sūtritaṃ—' saṃ te payāṃsi samu yantu vājā iha tvaṣṭāramapriyam ' (āśva. śrau. 1. 10) iti ||
iha | tvaṣṭāram | agriyam | viśva'rūpam | upa | haye | asmākam | astu | kevalaḥ ||10||
' svaratisūtisūyatidhūtūñdito vā ' (pā. sū. 7. 2. 44 ) iti iḍabhāvapakṣe ' skaḥ ' saṃyogadyorante ca ' (pā. sū. 8. 2. 29 ) iti kakāralopaḥ |
dvitīyaikavacane ' ṛto ḍisarvanāmasthānayoḥ ' (pā. sū. 7. 3. 110 ) iti guṇe ' asaṃtṛ ' (pā. sū. 6. 4. 11 ) ityādinā upadhāyā dīrghaḥ |
' agrāt ' (pā. sū. 4. 4. 116 ) ityanuvṛttau ' ghacchau ca ' (pā. sū. 4. 4. 117 ) iti ghac |
' āyanādiṣūpadeśivadvacanaṃ svarasiddhayartham ' (pā. sū. 7. 1. 2 ) iti upadeśivadbhāvāt pratyayādyudāttatvāt ghvaściśvādantodāttatvam |
' tvaṣṭā vai paśūnāṃ mithunānāṃ rūpakṛt ' (tai. saṃ. 6. 1. 8. 5 ) iti śruteḥ |
viśvaśabdasyāyudāttatvāt pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaratve prāpte ' bahuvrīhau viśvaṃ saṃjñāyām ' (pā. sū. 6. 2. 106 ) iti pūrvapadāntodāttatvam |

atra paramapi ' yoḍaci ' (pā. sū. 7. 2. 89 ) iti yvaṃ bādhitvā nityatvāt pratipadavidhitvācca āṅākamādeśe ' (pā. sū. 7. 1. 33 ) kṛte ' anādeśa ' (pā. sū. 7. 2. 86 ) iti niṣedhe yatvābhāvāt ' śeṣe lopaḥ ' (pā. sū. 7. 2. 90 ) iti dakāralope akārāntatvena paścāta prāptasyāpi suṭaḥ (pā. sū. 7. 1. 52 ) sāma iti nirdeśe sthānivyantabhāvena nivṛttiḥ |
evamartha eva hi sāma iti samudnirdeśaḥ |
arva sṛjā vanaspate devaṃ devebhyo haviḥ |
arva | sṛja | vanaspate | devam | devebhyaḥ | haviḥ | pra | dātuḥ | astu | cetanam || 11 ||

he ᵛvanaspate ᵛetannāmakāne ᵛdeva havirbhūbhyaḥ ᵛdevebhyaḥ asmadīyaṃ ᵛhaviḥ ᵛava ᵛsṛja samarpaya ityarthaḥ | ᵛpra ᵛdhātuḥ yajamānasya ᵛcetanaṃ paralokaviṣayaṃ vijñānaṃ tvatprasādāt ᵛastu | ᵛvanaspate | āma- ntritanighātaḥ | deva | pādāditvāt na nighātaḥ | pākṣikam āmantritādyudāttatvam | haviḥ | isaḥ pratyaya- svaraḥ | dhātuḥ | dadāteḥ tṛc | ‘citaḥ’ ityantodāttaḥ | ḍasi ‘ṛta ut’ (pā. sū. 6. 1. 111) iti uttvam ekādeśo raparatvaṃ ca | ‘ratasya’ (pā. sū. 8. 2. 24) iti salopaḥ | ekādeśa- svareṇa ukāra udāttaḥ | cetanam | ‘citī saṃjñāne’ | karaṇe lyuṭ | yoranādeśaḥ laghūpadhaguṇaḥ | ‘liti’ (pā. sū. 6. 1. 193) iti pratyayātpūrvasyodāttatvam ||
svāhā̭ | ya॒jñam | kṛ॒ṇo॒ta॒na | i॒ndrāya̭ | yajva̭naḥ | gṛ॒he | tatra̭ | de॒vān | upa̭ | hayḙ || 12 ||
tadabhisaṃpāditaṃ ᵛyajñam ᵛindrāya indratṛptyarthaṃ ᵛyajvanaḥ yajamānasya ᵛgṛhe ṛtvijaḥ ᵛkṛṇotana kuruta |
śapi prāpte ‘dhinvikṇvyora ca’ (pā. sū. 3. 1. 80) iti umatyayaḥ; tarsaniyogena vakārasya ca akāraḥ |
tasya ‘acaḥ parasmin’ (pā. sū. 1. 1. 57) iti sthānivadbhāvāt ṛkārasya laghūpadhaguṇo na bhavati |
ḍasi bhasaṃjñāyām alope prāpte ‘na saṃyogādvamantāt’ (pā. sū. 6. 4. 137) iti niṣedhaḥ |
‘devā~ upa’ ityatra saṃhitāyāṃ ‘dīrghādi’ (pā. sū. 8. 3. 9) iti nakārasya ratvam |
viniyogastu-vyūḍhadvādaśāhasya prathame chandome tṛtīyasavane vaiśvadevaśastre ‘aibhiragne duvo giraḥ’ iti sūktam |
tathā ca sūtritam- ‘atha chandomāḥ samudrā- dbhiḥ’ ityupakramya ‘aibhiragne duvo gira iti vaiśvadevam’ (āśva. śrau. 8. 9) iti ||
ā | e॒bhiḥ | a॒gne | duva̭ḥ | gira̭ḥ | viśvḙbhiḥ | so॒ma॒pī॒tayḙ | de॒vebhi̭ḥ | yā॒hi | ya॒kṣi | ca || 1 ||
ha ᵛagne ᵛebhiḥ asmin yajñe saṃbhāvitaiḥ ᵛviśvebhiḥ ᵛdevebhiḥ sarvairdevaiḥ saha ᵛsomapītaye somapāno- petayāgārthaṃ ᵛduvaḥ asmadīyāṃ paricaryāṃ ᵛgiraḥ asmadīyāḥ stutīśca prati ᵛā ᵛyāhi āgaccha |
pūrvanirdiṣṭāṃ devānām idamā parāmarśān ‘idamo'nvādeśe'śanudāttastṛtī- yādau’ iti aś anudāttaḥ |
na ca ‘uḍidam’ ityādinā vibhakterudāttatvaṃ tatra ‘antodāttāt’ (pā. sū. 6. 1. 169) ityadhikārāt |
‘bahulaṃhchandasi’ (pā. sū. 7. 1. 10) iti bhisa ais na bhavati |
ā tvā̭ ka॒ṇvā a̭hūpata gṛṇa॒nti vipra॒ te dhi॒yaḥ |
ā | tvā̭ | ka॒ṇvāḥ | a̭hūpata | gṛṇa॒nti | vipra̭ | te | dhi॒yaḥ | de॒vebhi̭ | a॒gne | ā | ga̭hi || 2 ||
he vipra medhāvin agne kaṇvāḥ medhāvina ṛtvijaḥ tvā yajñaniṣpādakaṃ tvām ā ahūpata āhvayanti |
tathā te dhiyaḥ tvadīyāni karmāṇi gṛṇanti kathayanti |
tato he agne devebhiḥ devaiḥ saha ā gahi āgaccha |
‘vipraḥ’ ityādiṣu caturviṃśatisaṃkhyakeṣu medhāvināmasu ‘kaṇvāḥ ṛbhuḥ’ (ni. 3. 15. 7) iti paṭhitam ||
‘tvāmau dvitīyāyāḥ’ (pā. sū. 8. 1. 23) iti tvādeśaḥ sarvānu- dāttaḥ |
‘anudāttam’ ityanuvṛttau ‘temayāvekavacanasya’ (pā. sū. 8. 1. 22) iti ṣaṣṭhyāḥ te iti ādeśaḥ |
tasya ‘amidvavadadvā bhāt’ (pā. sū. 6. 4. 22) iti asiddhatvāt ‘ano heḥ’ (pā. sū. 6. 4. 105) iti herluk na bhavati ||
indravāyū bṛhaspatīṃ mitrāgniṃ pūṣaṇaṃ bhagam | ādityānmārutaṃ guṇam || 3 || indravāyū iti | bṛhaspatīm | mitrā | agnim | pūṣaṇam | bhagam | ādityān | mārutam | guṇam || 3 ||
indrādidevān mārutaṃ marutāṃ vāyūnāṃ saṃbandhinaṃ gaṇaṃ ca he agne yakṣa iti padadvayamanuvartate ||
'devatādvandve ca' (pā. sū. 6. 3. 26) iti prāptasya ānaṅaḥ 'ubha- yatra vāyoḥ pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ' (pā. sū. 6. 3. 26. 1) iti pratiṣedhaḥ |
'devatādvandve ca' (pā. sū. 6. 2. 141) iti prāptasyobhayapadaprakṛtisvarasya 'nottarapade'nudāttādau' (pā. sū. 6. 2. 142) iti niṣedhaḥ |
'tadbahatoḥ karapatyo- śro radevatayorabhidheyayoḥ sud talopaṃ vaktavyaḥ' (pā. ma. 6. 1. 157) iti talopaḥ suḍā- gamaśca |
samāse 'ubhe vanaspatyādiṣu yugapat' (pā. sū. 6. 2. 140) iti ubhayapadaprakṛtisvaratvam |
pra vo śriyantu indavo matsarā mādayiṣṇavaḥ | drapsā madhvaścamuṣadaḥ || 4 || pra | vaḥ | śriyante | indavaḥ | matsarāḥ | mādayiṣṇavaḥ | drapsāḥ | madhvaḥ | camuṣadaḥ || 4 ||
he indrādidevāḥ vaḥ yuṣmadartham indavaḥ somāḥ pra śriyante prakarṣeṇa saṃpādyante |
bhajo yaki 'riṅ- śayagliṅkṣu' (pā. sū. 7. 4. 28) iti riṅadeśaḥ |
'nit' ityanuvṛttau 'undericcādeḥ' (u. sū. 1. 12) iti upratyayaḥ ādeḥ ikāraśca |
'ṇeraniṭī' (pā. sū. 6. 4. 51) iti ṇilope prāpte 'ayāmanantvādyayelviṇṇapu' (pā. sū. 6. 4. 55) iti ayādeśaḥ |
'saṃjñāpūrvako vidhiranityaḥ' iti 'jami ca' (pā. sū. 7. 3. 109) iti guṇo na bhavati |
camyate bhakṣyate yeṣu camaseṣu te cambaḥ |
īḻate | tvām | avasyavaḥ | kaṇvrāsaḥ | vṛkta'barhiṣaḥ | haviṣmantaḥ | aram'kṛtaḥ || 5 ||

he agne tvām īḻate ṛtvijaḥ stuvanti | kīdṛśāḥ | avasyavaḥ | avanaṃ rakṣaṇaṃ taddhetūn devānicchantaḥ | kaṇvrāsaḥ medhāvinaḥ | vṛktabarhiṣaḥ āstaraṇārthaṃ chinnadarbhāḥ | haviṣmantaḥ haviryuktāḥ | araṃkṛtaḥ alaṃkṛtāraḥ || īḻate | 'īḍa stutau' | anudāttettvāt laṭo jhaḥ | 'adiprabhṛtibhyaḥ śapaḥ' iti śapo luk | jhasya adādeśaḥ | ṭeḥ etvam | 'tāsyanudāttet' (pā. sū. 6. 1. 186) ityādinā lasārvadhātukasyānudāttatvāt dhātusvara eva śiṣyate | avasyavaḥ | avantītyavā devāḥ | tānaniśayenecchanti | 'supa ātmanaḥ kyac' | 'kyaci ca' (pā. sū. 7. 4. 33) iti ītvaṃ na bhavati | 'na cchandasyaputrasya' (pā. sū. 7. 4. 35) iti niṣedhāt | 'sarvaprātipadikebhyo lālasāyāṃ sugva- ktavyaḥ' (pā. ma. 7. 1. 51. 2) iti suk | 'kyācchandasi' (pā. sū. 3. 2. 170) iti upratyayaḥ | ato lopaḥ | pratyayasvareṇāntodāttatvam | kaṇvrāsaḥ | kaṇa śabdārthaḥ | kaṇanti dhvananti stotrādigāṭheneti kaṇvā ṛtvijaḥ | 'aśiprapi' (u. sū. 1. 149) ityādinā kan | nisvā- dādyudāttaḥ | 'ājaseramuk' (pā. sū. 7. 1. 50) iti amuk | vṛktabarhiṣaḥ | vṛktam uktam | bahuvrīhau pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaratvam | haviṣmantaḥ | havirepāmastīti haviṣmantaḥ | 'tasau matvarthe' (pā. sū. 1. 4. 19) iti bhatvena apadatvāt na ratvam | araṃkṛtaḥ | alaṃkurvantītyaraṃkṛtaḥ | 'kvip ca' iti kvip | hrasvasya tuka | 'kapilakārdīnāṃ saṃjñācchandasorvā lo ratvamāpadyate' (pā. ma. 8. 2. 18) iti lakārasya rephādeśaḥ ||
ghṛtapṛṣṭhā manojujo ye tvā vahanti vahnayaḥ |
ghṛta'pṛṣṭhāḥ | manaḥ'yujaḥ | ye | tvā | vahanti | vahnayaḥ | ā | devān | soma'pītaye ||6||
he agne tvā tvāṃ ye aśvāḥ rathena vahanti |
somapītaye somapānahetuyāgārthaṃ devān ā vaha iti śeṣaḥ ||
ghṛtaṃ dīptaṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ yeṣāṃ te ghṛtapṛṣṭhāḥ |
'niḥ' (u. sū. 4. 488) ityanuvṛttau 'vahiśraśrudugalāhātvaribhyo nit' (u. sū. 4. 411) iti nipratyayaḥ |
sakāre parato nakārasya saṃhitāyāṃ 'naśca' (pā. sū. 8. 3. 30) iti ṣuḍāgamaḥ |
'catho dvitīyāyāḥ śari paukkarasādeḥ' (pā. sū. 8. 4. 46. 3) iti dvitīyasakāraḥ ||
tān | yajatrān | ṛta'vṛdhaḥ | agne | patnī'vataḥ | kṛdhi | madhvaḥ | sujihva | pāyaya ||7||
he agne tān indrādīn devān yajatrān yajanīyān ṛtāvṛdhaḥ satyasya yajñasya vā vardhakān patnīvataḥ patnīvataḥ kṛdhi kuru |
he sujihva śobhanajihvopeta madhvaḥ madhusya somasya bhāgaṃ devān pāyaya ||

dīptau | ' anudāttetaśca halādeḥ ' ( pā. sū. 3. 2. 149 ) iti kartari yuc | ' citaḥ ' ityanto- dāttatvam | viśvān | viśvaḥ kkananto nivādādyudāttaḥ | uparbudhaḥ | uparbudhyante ityuparbudhaḥ | ' kip ca ' ( pā. sū. 3. 2. 76 ) iti kip | dhātusvareṇa ukāra udāttaḥ | samāse kṛduttarapadaprakṛtisvaratvam | citraḥ | ' kajendra ' ( u. sū. 2. 186 ) ityādinā ran | nivādādyudāttaḥ | hotā | hūyatestā- cchīle van | ' bahulaṃ chandasi ' iti saṃprasāraṇam | parapūrvatvam | guṇaḥ | nivādādyudāttaḥ | iha | ' idamo haḥ ' ( pā. sū. 5. 3. 11 ) iti hapratyayaḥ | ' idama iśa ' ( pā. sū. 5. 3. 3 ) iti iśa | śivāta sarvādeśaḥ | pratyayasvaraḥ | vakṣati | vahaḥ prārthanāryā liṅarthe leṭ | tasya tip | kartari śap |
‘kartṛkaraṇe kṛtā bahulam’ ( pā. sū. 2. 1. 32 ) iti samāsa: |
kṛtsvarāpavādena ‘tṛtīyā karmaṇi’ ( pā. sū. 6. 2. 48 ) iti pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaratvam |
semiti yatra saṃhitāyāṃ ‘so'ci lope cetpādapūraṇam’ ( pā. sū. 6. 1. 134 ) iti sorlope guṇa: |
na vidyate dhvaro hiṃsā yasmin so'dhvara: |
‘no adhva- ram’ ityatra saṃhitāyām ‘eḍa: padāntādati’ ( pā. sū. 6. 1. 109 ) iti pūrvarūpaṃ prāptaṃ ‘prakṛ- syantaḥpādamanyapare’ ( pā. sū. 6. 1. 115 ) iti prakṛtibhāvāt nivartate |
yuṣvā arupī rathe harito deva rohita: |
yuśva | hi | arupī: | rathe | harita: | deva | rohita: | tābhi: | devān | iha | ā | vaha ||12||

he deva agne rohita: rohicchabdābhidheyāstadīyā vaḍavā: | rathe yuśva yojaya | hiśabda: pādapūraṇārtha: | kīdṛśī: | arupī: gatimatī: | harita: hartuṃ rathāruḍhān puruṣān netuṃ samarthā: | tābhi: vaḍavābhi: | iha asmin karmaṇi devān ā vaha || yuśva | ‘yujira yoge’ | loṭ | svaritatvādātmane- padam | ‘thāsa: se’ | ‘savābhyāṃ vāmau’ | ‘rudhādibhya: śma’ | tasya bāhulakāt luk | kṛtsvarapatve | pratyayasvareṇāntodātta: | saṃhitāyāṃ ‘vyaco'tasmin:’ ( pā. sū. 6. 3. 135 ) iti dīrgha: | arupī: | ‘ṛ gatau’ | ranti (?) gacchantītyarudhyo vaḍavā: | ‘ṛhannibhyāmupan’ ( u. sū. 4. 513 ) | dhātorguṇo raparatvam | nivādādyudātto'rupaśabda: | tasmāt striyāṃ chāndaso ḍīp | śasi ‘prathamayo: pūrvasavarṇa:’ ( pā. sū. 6. 1. 102 ) iti dīrgha: | rathe | rame: auṇādika: kyanpratyaya: | nivādādyudātta: | harita: | ‘hasruhiyubhibhya iti:’ ( u. sū. 1. 97 ) iti harate: itipratyaya: | ikāra: pratyayasvareṇodātta: | rohita: | ruherapi tenaiva sūtreṇa iti: | ikāra: pratyayasvareṇodātta: | tābhi: | ‘sāvekāca:’ ( pā. sū. 6. 1. 168 ) iti vibhakte: prāptamudāttatvaṃ ‘sāvavarṇa’ ( pā. sū. 6. 1. 182 ) iti niṣidhyate | devān ityatra pūrvavat ṛtvānunāsikau || || 27 ||
‘indra somam’ ityādikasya dvādaśarcasya caturthasya sūktasya ṛṣicchandasī pūrvavat |
yadyapyetatsūktaṃ kṛtsnam ṛtudevatākaṃ tathāpi pratyṛcam indrādidevatāntarāṇi militāni |
tathā ca anukramyate—‘indra somamṛtavyaṃ tatraindrī mārutī tvāṣṭrāgneyyaindrī maitrāvaruṇī catasro draviṇodasa āśvinyāgneyyatudevatā: sarvatra’ iti |
indra somaṃ piba ṛtunā tvā viśantvandava: |
indra | somam | piba | ṛtunā | ā | tvā | viśantu | indava: | matsarā: | tat'aukasa: ||1||

he indra ṛtunā saha somaṃ piba | indava: pīyamānā: somā: tvā tvām ā viśantu | kīdṛśā: | matsarāsa: nṛttikarā: | tadaukasa: tannivāsā: | sarvadā tvadudarasthāyina ityartha: | indra | pāṣṭhikam āmantritādyudāttatvam | somam | ‘artitastu’ ( u. sū. 1. 137 ) ityādinā man | nivādādyudātta: | piba | ‘pibā mitrasya’ ( ṛ. saṃ. 1. 14. 10 ) ityatroktam | asya ā tvā viśantu
ataḥ ' cādilope vibhāṣā ' ( pā. sū. 8. 1. 63 ) ityayaṃ prathamā tiṅvibhaktirna hinyate |
saṃhitāyām ' āhunaḥ ' iti prāptasya guṇasya ' ṛtyakaḥ ' ( pā. sū. 6. 1. 128 ) iti śākalyamate prakṛtibhāvādbhāvaḥ |
' pra vo mriyante ' ( ṛ. saṃ. 1. 14. 4 ) ityatro- ktam |

yuvāku hi śacīnāṃ yuvāku sumatīnām | bhūyāma vājadānnām || 4 || yuvāku | hi | śacīnām | yuvāku | sumatīnām | bhūyāma | vāja'dānnām || 4 ||
hi yasmāt kāraṇāt śacīnām asmadīyakarmaṇāṃ saṃbandhi somarūpaṃ haviḥ yuvāku vasatīvaryaika- dhanāmakairūdakaiḥ payaḥsakvādidravyāntaraiśca miśritam |
tathā sumatīnāṃ śobhanabuddhiyuktānāmṛtvijāṃ stotrarūpaṃ vacanamapi yuvāku nānāvidhaiḥ stutyaguṇairmiśritam |
tasmāt kāraṇāt he indrāvaruṇau tathāvidhaṃ haviḥ svīkurvateyurvayoḥ prasādāddhayaṃ vājadānnām annapradānāṃ purupāṇāṃ madhye mukhyā bhūyāma bhavema |
'apaḥ apanaḥ' ityādiṣu pañcaviṃśatisaṃkhyākeṣu karmanāmasu 'śacī śamī' (ni. 2. 1. 22) iti paṭhitam ||
'kaṭikuṣibhyāṃ kākuḥ' (u. sū. 3. 357) ityatra bāhulakāt yauterapi kākuḥ pratyayaḥ |
ḍīnanto (pā. sū. 4. 1. 73) nittvādāyudāttaḥ iti 'ubhe vanaspatyādiṣu yugapat' ityatra vṛttikṛtoktam (kā. 6. 2. 140) |
vastutastu 'āto ḍitaḥ' (pā. sū. 7. 2. 81 ) ityanenaiva iyādeśo bhavati
'yāsuṭ parasmaipadeṣūdātto ṅicca' (pā. sū. 3. 4. 103) iti udātto yāsuḍāgamaḥ |
tasya 'acaḥ parasmin' (pā. sū. 1. 1. 57) iti sthānivadbhāvāt 'lopo vyorvali' (pā. sū. 6. 1. 66) iti vakāralope na bhavati ||
indraḥ sahasradātrāṃ varuṇaḥ śaṃsyānām | kraturbhavatyukthyaḥ || 5 || indraḥ | sahasra'dātrāṃ | varuṇaḥ | śaṃsyānām | kratuḥ | bhavati | ukthyaḥ || 5 ||
ayam indraḥ sahasradātrāṃ sahasrasaṃkhyākadhanapradānāṃ madhye kratuḥ dhanadānasya kartā bhavati prabhūtaṃ dadātītyarthaḥ |
tathā varuṇaḥ śaṃsyānāṃ stutyānāṃ madhye ukthyaḥ stutyo bhavati atiśayena stutya ityarthaḥ ||
atra 'tisvacaritam' ityetadbādhitvā 'tīrthāya kūpyāya' ityādidavat bactvāt 'yato'nāvaḥ' iti prāsamādyudāttatvaṃ 'sarve vidhayaśchandasi vikalpyante' (paribhā. 35) iti na kriyate |
ata eva hi 'ūrmyāya ca sūrdhyāya ca' ityādau svaritatvaṃ dṛśyate |
na ca paratvātrityatvācca 'yasya' iti lopena prathamatau bhāvyamiti vācyam |
prakṛtipratyayāśrayāt bahiraṅgāt 'yasya' iti lopāt pratyayamātrāśrayatayā antaraṅgatvena 'tisvacari- tam' ityetasya prābalyāt |
ataḥ 'ūrmyāya' ityādidavat 'ukthyaḥ' ityatrāpi lakṣaṇata eva svari- tattvaṃ bhaviṣyatīti kiṃ chāndastena |
yatra hi lopamantareṇaiva bactvaṃ tatra 'yato'nāvaḥ' ityetadbhavati |
evaṃ tarhi 'tīrthāya kūpyāya' ityādidau yan ādyudāttatvaṃ tadeva cchāndasamatu |
athātra tu 'varṇādāṅgaṃ balīyaḥ' (paribhā. 55) ityantaraṅge'pi svaritatvaṃ bādhitvā lopa eva bhaviṣyati |
tarhi 'ukthyaḥ, ūrmyāya sūrdhyāya' ityādau ca cchāndasayamastu |
tayoridarvasā vayaṃ sanem ni ca dhīmahi | syāduta arecanam || 6 || tayoḥ | it | avasā | vayam | sanem | ni | ca | dhīmahi | syāt | uta | pra'recanam ||6||
tayorit pūrvoktayorindrāvaruṇayoreva avasā rakṣaṇena vayam anuṣṭhātāraḥ sanem saṃbhajema dhanamiti śeṣaḥ |
prāpte dhane yāvadapekṣitaṃ tāvaduktvā tato'vaśiṣṭaṃ dhanaṃ

kacinnidhirūpeṇa sthāpayāmaśca | 'uta api ca 'prerecanaṃ bhuktābhihitācca prakaryeṇādhikaṃ dhanaṃ 'syāt saṃpadyatām || avasā | asun | nistvādāyudāttaḥ | vayam | 'yūyaṃ hi chā' (ṛ. saṃ. 1. 15. 2) ityatra yaduktaṃ tadatra draṣṭavyam | sanema | āśiṣi liṅ | tasya mas | 'niyaṃ ḍitaḥ' iti sakāralopaḥ | 'kidāśiṣi' (pā. sū. 3. 4. 104) iti yāsuṭ | 'chandasyubhayathā' iti sārvadhātukatvamapyastīti 'liṅaḥ salopo'nantyasya' (pā. sū. 7. 2. 79) iti sakāra- lopaḥ | 'ato yeyaḥ' (pā. sū. 7. 2. 80) iti iyādeśaḥ | 'lopo vyorvali' (pā. sū. 6. 1. 66) iti yalopaḥ | 'liṅyāśiṣyaṅ' (pā. sū. 3 1. 86) iti aṅ | 'ādruṇaḥ' | pādāditvāt na nighātaḥ | dhīmahi | 'ḍudhāñ dhāraṇapoṣaṇayoḥ' | āśiṣi liṅo mahiṅ | tasya 'chandasyubhayathā' iti sārvadhātu- kārdhadhātukasaṃjñe | tatra sārvadhātukatvena 'liṅaḥ salopo'nantyasya' iti sakāralopaḥ | 'sārvadhātukama- pit' iti ṅittvaṃ śap ca | 'bahulaṃ chandasi' iti juhotyāderapi śapo luk | ārthadhātukatvāt 'āto lopa iṭi ca' (pā. sū. 6. 4. 64) iti ākāralopaḥ | nighātaḥ | sanema ityapekṣayā dvitīyavādatra 'cavāyoge prathamā' iti na niṣedhaḥ | syāt | asteḥ prārthanāyāṃ liṅ | tip | 'itaśca' (pā. sū. 3. 4. 100) iti dakāralopaḥ | 'yāsuṭ parasmaipadātto ṅicca' (pā. sū. 3. 4. 103) iti yāsuṅṅittve | 'adiprabhṛtibhyaḥ śapaḥ' iti śapo luk | 'kṣasoralopaḥ' iti akāralopaḥ | pādāditvāt anighātaḥ | uta | 'evamādīnāmantaḥ' ityantodāttaḥ | prerecanam | 'ricir virecane' | bhāve lyuṭ | yoranādeśaḥ | 'liti' iti pratyayātpūrvasyodāttatvam | prādisamāsaḥ | kduttarapadaprakṛtisvaratvam ||
indrāvaruṇa vāmahaṃ huve citrāya rādhaṃse | asmāntasu jigyurpaskṛtam || 7 ||
indrāvaruṇā | vām | aham | huve | citrāya | rādhaṃse | asmān | su | jigyurpaḥ | kṛtam ||7||

'indrāvaruṇā he indrāvaruṇau 'vāṃ yuvāmubhau 'ahaṃ 'huve āhvayāmi | kimartham | 'citrāya maṇisuktādirūpeṇa vividhāyā 'rādhase dhanāya | tata āhūtau yuvām 'asmān anudhātṛn 'su 'jigyuṣaḥ śatruvipaye suṣṭhu jayayuktān 'kṛtaṃ kurutam || indrāvaruṇā | 'supāṃ suluk' ityādinā saṃbodhanasya ākāraḥ | 'devatādvandve ca' iti pūrvapadasya ānaṅ | āmantritādyudāttatvam | saṃhitāyāṃ chāndasaṃ hrasvatvam | huve | hūyateḥ laḍuttamaikavacanam iṭ | 'śapaḥ' ityanuvṛttau 'bahulaṃ chandasi' iti luk | 'haḥ' ityanuvṛttau 'bahulaṃ chandasi' iti saṃprasāraṇaṃ parapūrvatvam | 'aci bhnudhātu' (pā. sū. 6. 4. 77) ityādinā uvaṅ | na ca 'hunuvoḥ' (pā. sū. 6. 4. 87) ityādinā yaṇādeśaḥ | juhotereva hi pratipadoktasya tat, na punarasya lākṣaṇikatvāt | iṭaḥ pratyayasvareṇodāttatvam | pādāditvāt na nighātaḥ | rādhase | asun | nistvādāyudāttatvam | asmān | śasi 'dvitīyāyāṃ ca' (pā. sū. 7. 2. 87) iti ātvam | 'śaso na' (pā. sū. 7. 1. 29) iti natvam | jigyupaḥ | 'ji jaye' | liṭaḥ 'kasuśca' (pā. sū. 3. 2. 107) iti kasuḥ | dvirbhāvaḥ | 'sanalliṅojeḥ' (pā. sū. 7. 3. 57) iti dvitīyasya kuruvam | kasoḥ | kitrādguṇābhāvaḥ | kādiniyamāt prāptasya iṭaḥ 'vasvekā- jāddāsam' iti niyamena nivṛttiḥ | dvitīyābahuvacanaṃ śas | bhasaṃjñāyāṃ 'vasoḥ saṃprasāraṇam' iti saṃprasāraṇam | parapūrvatvam | 'ernekācaḥ' iti yaṇādeśaḥ | 'śāsivasighasīnāṃ ca' iti ṣatvam | pratyayasvareṇa ukāra udāttaḥ | kṛtam | 'ḍukṛñ karaṇe' | lopyamadhyamadvivacanasya laṅdvātvāt tamādeśaḥ | śapaḥ 'bahulaṃ chandasi' iti luk | 'tiṅatiṅaḥ' iti nighātaḥ || ka. 19
indrāvaruṇa nū nu vāṃ sipāsantīpu dhīṣvā | asmabhyaṃ śarma yacchatam || 8 || indrāvaruṇā | nu | nu | vām | sipāsantīṣu | dhīṣu | ā | asmabhyam | śarma | yacchatam ||8||

'indrāvaruṇā he indrāvaruṇau 'dhīṣu asmadīyabuddhiṣu 'vāṃ yuvāṃ 'sipāsantīṣu sanituṃ saṃbhaktuṃ samyak sevitumicchantīṣu tadānīm 'ā samantāt 'asmabhyaṃ 'śarma sukhaṃ 'nū 'nu atiśayena kṣipraṃ 'yacchataṃ dattam |
pra vāmaśvotu suṣṭutirindrāvaruṇa yāṃ huve | yāmṛdhāyai sadhastutim || 9 || pra | vām | aśvotu | suṣṭutiḥ | indrāvaruṇā | yām | huve | yām | ṛdhāyai iti | sadhastutim || 9 ||
'indrāvaruṇā he indrāvaruṇau 'yām asmatkartṛkāṃ śobhanastutiṃ prati 'huve yuvāmubhau āhvayāmi |
kiṃca 'sadhastutiṃ yuvayorubhayoḥ sāhityena kriyamāṇāyāḥ stavakriyāyāḥ 'yāṃ suṣṭutiṃ pratilabhya 'ṛdhāyai yuvāṃ vardhāye tādṛśī 'suṣṭutiḥ śobhanastutihetubhūta ṛksamūhaḥ 'vāmaśvotu yuvāṃ vyāpnotu ||
saha stutiryasyāṃ suṣṭutau sā sadha- stutiḥ |
atra suṣṭutiranyapadārthe stutiśabdasya stūyate'nayeti karaṇasādhanatvena ṛkparatve ayaṃ stuti- śabdo bhāvasādhanatayā stavanakriyāparaḥ |
tasmin bhāvasādhanatvaṃ kriyāpare ayaṃ karaṇasādhanatayā ṛkpara iti samasyāmānapadārthādanyaḥ |
dakṣiṇā cānyāḥ sādasaspatyā nārāśaṃsī cānyā' iti|
tāsāṃ madhye 'sa ghā vīraḥ' ityetarayāścaturthyā ṛco brahmaṇaspatirindraśca somaśceti tisro devatāḥ|
'tvaṃ tam' ityetasyāḥ pañcamyā dakṣiṇayā saha pūrvoktāstisro devatāḥ|
somānam | svaraṇam | kṛṇuhi | brahmaṇaspate | kakṣīvantam | yaḥ | auśijaḥ || 1 ||
he brahmaṇaspate etannāmakedeva somānam abhipavasya kartāraṃ svaraṇaṃ deveṣu prakāśanavantaṃ kṛṇuhi kuru|
kakṣīvato'nuṣṭhātṛ muniṣu prasiddhastaittirīyairāmnāyate—'etaṃ vai para ānvāraḥ kakṣīvā~ auśijo vītahavyaḥ śrāyasaścasadasyuḥ paurukutsyaḥ prajākāmā acinvan' (tai. saṃ. 5. 6. 5. 2) iti|
ṛgantare'pi ṛṣitvakathanenānuṣṭhātṛvatprasiddhiḥ sūcyate—'ahaṃ kakṣīvā~ ṛṣirasmi vipraḥ' (ṛ. saṃ. 4. 26. 1) iti|
so'yaṃ mantro yāskenainaṃ vyākhyātaḥ—'somānaṃ sotāraṃ prakāśanavantaṃ kuru brahmaṇaspate kakṣīvantamiba ya auśijaḥ|
kakṣīvān kakṣīvānauśija uśijaḥ putra uśigvateḥ kāntikarmaṇo'pi tvayaṃ manuṣyakakṣa evābhipretaḥ syāttaṃ somānaṃ sotāraṃ mā prakāśanavantaṃ kuru brahmaṇaspate' (niru. 6. 10) iti|
asmin mantre somānamiti pādena kṛṇuhi brahmaṇa iti pādena sūcitaṃ tātparyaṃ taittirīyā āmananti—'somānaṃ svaraṇamityāha somapīthamevāvarundhe|
kṛṇuhi brahmaṇasata ityāha brahmavarcasamevāvarundhe' (tai. saṃ. 1. 5. 8. 4) iti|
dṛśigrahaṇasya vidhvantaraprasaṃgamatvāt nipāte'pi nādyudāttatvaṃ kiṃtu pratyayasvara eva|
kṛtyalyuṭo bahulam (pā. sū. 3. 3. 113) iti karmaṇi lyuṭ|
idito num dhātoḥ (pā. sū. 7. 1. 58) iti num|
śapi prāpte dhinvikṇvyora ca iti upratyayaḥ; tatsaṃyogena vakārasya ca akāraḥ|
utaśca pratyayācchandovāvacanam (pā. sū. 6. 4. 106. 1) iti heluk na|
sati śiṣṭasvarabalīyastvamanyatra vikaraṇebhyaḥ iti vacanāt hereva pratyayasvareṇodāttatvam|
ṣaṣṭhyāḥ patiputra (pā. sū. 8. 3. 53) ityādinā saṃhitāyāṃ visarjanīyasya sakāraḥ|
sā asyāstītyarthe āsandibadavīvakṣvīvatkakṣīvat (pā. sū. 8. 2. 12) iti ṛṣiviśeṣanāma kakṣīvacchabdo nipātitaḥ|
iji (u. sū. 2. 228) ityanuvṛttau vaśeḥ kicca (u. sū. 2. 229) iti ijpratyayaḥ|
tasya kitvāt prahijyā (pā. sū. 6. 1. 16) ityādinā samprasāraṇam,
yo revānyo amīvahā vasuvitpuṣṭivardhanaḥ | sa naḥ siṣaktu yasturaḥ || 2 || yaḥ | revān | yaḥ | amīva'hā | vasuvit | puṣṭi'vardhanaḥ | saḥ | naḥ | siṣaktu | yaḥ | turaḥ ||2||

yaḥ brahmaṇaspatiḥ revān dhanavān yaḥ ca amīvahā rogāṇāṃ hantā vasuvit dhanalabdhā puṣṭi vardhanaḥ puṣṭervardhayitā yaḥ ca turaḥ tvaropetaḥ śīghraphaladaḥ saḥ brahmaṇaspatiḥ naḥ asmān siṣaktu seva tām |
atra siṣaktuśabdasya sevārthatvaṃ yāska āha- ‘siṣaktu sacata iti sevamānasya’ (niru. 3. 21) iti |
arupa: martyasya upadravaṃ kartumasmatsamīpaṃ prāptasya śatrurūpasya manuṣyasya dhūrti: hiṃsaka: śaṃsa: śaṃsanam |
tādṛśo vāgviśeṣa: na: asmān mā praṇak mā saṃpraṇak |
tadartha he brahmaṇaspate na: asmān rakṣa pālaya ||
'aterera: ' (u. sū. 4. 519 ) iti antarbhāvitaṇyarthāt 'ṛ gatau' ityasmān arus |
vali lopaṃ bādhitvā ūṭhi prāpte (pā. sū. 6. 4. 19 ) 'rālopa: ' (pā. sū. 6. 4. 21 ) iti vakāralopa: |
marteṣu bhava ityarthe 'bhave chandasi' (pā. sū. 4. 4. 110 ) iti yat |
'upasargādahulam' (pā. sū. 8. 4. 28 ) iti bahulagrahaṇāt anupasargādapi nayo ṇatvam |
'paṣṭyā: patiputra' (pā. sū. 8. 3. 53 ) iti saṃhitāyāṃ visargasya sakāra: |
sa ghā vīro na riṣyati yamindro brahmaṇaspatiḥ | somo hinoti martyam ||4|| sa: | gha | vīra: | na | riṣyati | yam | indra: | brahmaṇa: | pati: | soma: | hinoti | martyam ||4||

indra: deva: yaṃ martyaṃ yakṣyamāṇaṃ hinoti prāpnoti vardhayati vā | tathā brahmaṇaspati: devo hinoti | tathā soma: hinoti | sa: gha sa eva yajamāna: vīra: vīryayukta: san na riṣyati na vinaśyati || gha | cādiranudātta: | saṃhitāyām 'ṛci tunudhamamadhdakutroruyaṇām' iti dīrgha: | brahmaṇaspati: | uktam | hinoti | 'hi gatau vṛddhau ca' | 'svādibhya: śnu:' | tipa: pitvāt śnupratya- yasvara eva śiṣyate ||
tvaṃ taṃ brahmaṇaspate soma indraśca martyam | dakṣiṇā pātvaṃhasaḥ ||5|| tvam | tam | brahmaṇa: | pate | soma: | indra: | ca | martyam | dakṣiṇā | pātu | aṃhasa: ||5||

he brahmaṇaspate tvaṃ taṃ martyam anuṣṭhātāraṃ manuṣyam aṃhasa: pāpāt pāhīti śeṣa: | tathā soma: pātu indraśca pātu dakṣiṇākhyā devatā ca pātu || dakṣiṇā | 'dakṣa vṛddhau' | 'dudakṣabhyāminn' (u. sū. 2. 208 ) | nivādādyudātta: | aṃhasa: | 'naḍvapayasya' ityādinādyudātta: || || 34 ||
tathā ca gṛhye 'mekhalāmābadhya' iti khaṇḍe paṭhyate—'ācāryaḥ samanvārabdhe juhuyāt sadasaspatimadbhutam' (āśva. gṛ. 1. 22. 11) iti ||
sada̭saspatimadbhutaṃ priyamindra̭sya kāmya̭m | sa॒niṃ me॒dhāma̭yāsiṣam || 6|| sadasaḥ | patim | adbhutam | priyam | indrasya | kāmyam | sanim | medhām | ayāsiṣam ||6||

medhāṃ labdhuṃ sadasaspatima etannāmakaṃ devam ayāsiṣaṃ prāptavānasmi | kīdṛśam | adbhutam āścaryakaraṃ indrasya priyaṃ somapāne sahacāritvāt kāmyaṃ kamanīyaṃ saniṃ dhanasya dātāram || sadasaḥ | padu viśaraṇadau | 'sarvadhātubhyo'sun' | nipādādyudāttaḥ | patim | pāterdetiḥ (u. sū. 4. 497) | ṭilopaḥ | pratyayasvaraḥ | priyam | 'igupadhajñāprīkiraḥ kaḥ' | iyaḍādeśaḥ | pratyayasvaraḥ | kāmyam | kāmayateḥ 'aco yat' | 'ṇeraniṭī' iti ṇilopaḥ | 'yato'nāvaḥ' ityādyudāttatvam | sanim | 'paṇa dāne' | 'dhātvādeḥ paḥ saḥ' | 'aca iḥ' (u. sū. 4. 578) ityanuvṛttau 'khani-kaṇyayasivasivasinidhavanigranthivaribhyaśca' (u. sū. 4. 579) iti ipratyayaḥ | pratyayasvaraḥ | ayāsiṣam | 'yā prāpaṇe' | luṅ | migo'mādeśaḥ | 'yamaramanamātāṃ sak ca' (pā. sū. 7. 2. 73) iti sica iḍāgamaḥ | dhātoḥ sagāgamaḥ | nighātaḥ ||
yassā̭dṛte na sidhyati ya॒jño vi̭pa॒ścita̭ścana | sa dhī॒nāṃ yo॒gami̭nvati || 7|| yasmāt | ṛte | na | sidhyati | yajñaḥ | vipaḥ'citaḥ | cana | saḥ | dhīnām | yogam | invati ||7||

yajñaḥ ayamanuṣṭhātavyaḥ vipaścitaścana tridoṣapi yajamānasya yasmāt sadasaspatidevāt ṛte na sidhyati saḥ ayaṃ sadasaspatirdevaḥ dhīnāṃ mano'nuṣṭhānaviṣayāṇāmasmaddhīnāmanuṣṭheyakarmaṇāṃ vā yogaṃ saṃbandham invati vyāpnoti |
sāvekācaḥ iti vibhakterudāttatve prāpte na godhnasāvavarga iti pratiṣedhaḥ |
ārdha̭noti ha॒viṣkṛ̭tiṃ prā॒ñcaṃ kṛ̭ṇotyadhva॒ram | hotrā̭ de॒veṣṷ gacchati || 8|| āt | ṛṇoti | haviḥ'kṛtim | prāñcam | kṛṇoti | adhvaram | hotrā | deveṣu | gacchati ||8||
āt anantarameva haviṣkṛtiṃ haviḥsaṃpādanayuktaṃ yajamānam ṛṇoti sadasaspartidevo vardhayati |
yajaṃ prājaṃ prakarṣeṇa gacchantamicchitena parisamāptiyuktaṃ, kṛgonikaroti |
hotrā hūyamānā devatā tuṣṭā satī yajamānaṃ pratyāpayituṃ deveṣu gacchati |
hotrā asmadīyastutirūpā vāk devān paritoṣa- yituṃ deveṣu gacchati |
śloka: dhārā ityādiṣu saptapañcāśatsu vāṅnāmasu hotrā gī: (ni. 1. 11. 35) iti paṭhitam ||
haviṣa: kṛti: saṃpādanaṃ yasya yajamānasya so'yaṃ haviṣkṛti: |
aniganto'natau vapravyaye (pā. sū. 6. 2. 52) iti gate: prakṛtisvaratvam |

atra agnivat sadasaspaterapi naire: śasyamānatvāt narāśaṃsatvam |
etamevābhiprāyaṃ hṛdi nidhāya brāhmaṇamevamāmnāyate- prajā vai naro vāk śaṃsa: (pe. brā. 6. 27) iti |

sudhṛṣṭam atyādhikyena dhārṣṭyayuktaṃ suprathastamam atiśayena prakhyātam sarvamakhasaṃ prāptatejaskam |
ādityacandrādibhi- radhiṣṭhinā dyulokaviśeṣā yathā tejasvina: tadvadayaṃ narāśaṃsastejasvītyartha: ||

tathā ca sūtritaṃ- varṣakāmeṣṭi: kārīrī tasyāṃ prati tyaṃ cārumadhvaramīḻe agniṃ svavasaṃ namobhiriti dhāyye (āśva. śrau. 2. 13) iti ||
prati tyaṃ cārumadhvaraṃ gopīthāya pra hūyase | marudbhirna ā gahi || 1 || prati | tyam | cārum | adhvaram | gopīthāya | pra | hūyase | marudbhi: | agne | ā | gahi || 1 ||

he agne yo yajñaḥ cāhaḥ aṅgavaikalyarahitaḥ tvaṃ tathāvidhaṃ cārumadhvaraṃ pratilabhya gopīthāya somapānāya pra hūyase prakarṣeṇa tvaṃ hūyase tasmāt asminnadhvare tvaṃ marudbhiḥ devaviśepaiḥ saha ā gahi āgaccha |
seyamuk yāskenaiva vyākhyātā—‘ taṃ prati cārumadhvaraṃ somapānāya prahūyase so'gne marudbhiḥ sahāgaccha ’ ( niru. 10. 36 ) iti ||
‘ ata upadhāyāḥ ’ ( pā. sū. 7. 2. 116 ) iti vṛddhiḥ |
‘ niśīthagopīthāvagathāḥ ’ ( u. sū. 2. 166 ) iti thakpratyayānto nipātitaḥ |

tathā matyaḥ manuṣyaśca paraḥ na bhavati |
ye manuṣyāsavadīyaṃ ṛnumanutiṣṭhanti ye ca devāsavadīye kratau ijyante te evoktā ityarthaḥ |
‘ anudāttopadeśa ’ ( pā. sū. 6. 4. 37 ) ityādinā anunāsi- kalopaḥ |
tasya ‘ asiddhavadatrā bhāt ’ ( pā. sū. 6. 4. 22 ) iti asiddhatvāt ‘ ato heḥ ’ iti luk na bhavati |
ye maho rajaso viduviśve devāso adruhaḥ |
ye | mahaḥ | rajasaḥ | viduḥ | viśve | devāsaḥ | adruhaḥ | marudbhiḥ | agne | ā | gahi ||3||
he agne ye marutaḥ maho rajasaḥ mahata udakasya varṇaprakāraṃ viduḥ taiḥ marudbhiḥ ityanvayaḥ |
‘ saptagaṇā vai marutaḥ ’ ( tai. saṃ. 2. 2. 11. 1 ) iti śruteḥ |
devāsaḥ dyotamānāḥ adruhaḥ droharahitā varṇyena sarvabhūtapakāritvāt |
tathā ca upariṣṭā- dāmnāyate—‘ udīrayathā marutaḥ samudrato yūyaṃ vṛṣṭiṃ varṣayathā purīṣiṇaḥ ’ ( ṛ. saṃ. 5. 55. 5 ) iti |
śākhāntare'pi mantrāntarasya brāhmaṇamevāmnāyate—‘ marutāṃ pṛpatayaḥ sthetyāha maruto vai vṛṣṭyā īśate ’ ( tai. brā. 3. 3. 9. 4 ) iti |
rajaḥśabdo bhāṣyakena bahudhā vyākhyātaḥ—‘ rajo rajate'rthauṃtī raja ucyata udakaṃ raja ucyate lokā rajāṃsyucyante'sṛgahanī rajasī ucyate ’ ( niru. 4. 19 ) iti ||
‘ vido laṭo vā ’ ( pā. sū. 3. 4. 83 ) iti jheḥ usādeśaḥ |

yudāttatvam | devāsaḥ | ‘ājaserasuk’ | devaśabdaḥ pacādyantaḥ | citvādantodāttaḥ | adaḥ | saṃpadā- ditvāt bhāve kipi bahuvrīhau ‘nañsubhyām’ ityantodāttatvam | kartari vā kip | tatpuruṣe hi avyaya- pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaratvaṃ syāt | na ca kṛduttarapadaprakṛtisvaratvam (pā. sū. 6. 2. 139), yato nañ na gatirna ca kāraka iti ||
ye | ugrāḥ | arkām | ānucuḥ | anādhṛṣṭāsaḥ | ojasā | murudbhiḥ | agne | ā | gahi ||4||
^ye marutaḥ ^ugrāḥ tīvrāḥ santaḥ ^arkam udakam ^ānucuḥ arcitavantaḥ varṣaṇena saṃpāditavanta ityarthaḥ |
arkaśabdasyodakavācitvaṃ vājamaneyina āmananti—‘āpo vā arkaḥ’ (śa. brā. 10. 6. 5. 2) iti |
tannivvacanaṃ ca ta evāmananti—‘so'caiścarattasyārcata āpo'jāyantārcate vai me kamabhūditi tadevarkasyārkatvam’ (śa. brā. 10. 6. 5. 1) iti |
sa jagat sraṣṭā hiraṇyagarbha udakaṃ sraṣṭumudyukto'van satyasaṃkalpamahimaprakhyāpanena svātmānaṃ pūjayannacarat |
ye | śugrāḥ | ghorarvapasaḥ | sukṣatrāsaḥ | riśārdasaḥ | murudbhiḥ | agne | ā | gahi ||5||
‘madham’ ityādipañcaviṃśati- saṃkhyākeṣu dhananāmasu ‘kṣatra bhagaḥ’ (ni. 2. 10. 9) iti paṭhitam |
‘āyudāttaṃ bacchandasi’ (pā. sū. 6. 2. 119) ityeva tu na bhavati, kṣatraśabdasyānodāttatvāt |
ye nākusyārdhi rocane divi devāsa āsate |
ye | nākusyārdhi | rocane | divi | devāsaḥ | āsate | murudbhiḥ | agne | ā | gahi ||6||
'ye marutaḥ 'nākasyādhi duḥkharahitasya sūryasyopari 'divi dyuloke 'rocane dīpyamāne 'ye 'devāsaḥ svayamapi dīpyamānāḥ 'āsate taiḥ marudbhiḥ ityanvayaḥ ||
tat yasminnāsti asau akaḥ iti bahuvrīhiṃ kṛtvā paścāt nañ |
' nalopo nañaḥ ' ( pā. sū. 6. 3. 73 ) iti lopo na bhavati, ' naāṇpāt ' ( pā. sū. 6. 3. 75 ) ityādinā prakṛtibhāvāt |
' tatpuruṣe tulyārtha ' ( pā. sū. 6. 2. 2 ) ityādinā avyayapūrvapadaprakṛtisvaratveno- dāttatvam |
prathamastatpuruṣaṃ kṛtvā paścāt bahuvrīhī uttarapadāntodāttatvaṃ syāt |
' anudāttettaśca halādeḥ ' ( pā. sū. 3. 2. 149 ) iti yuc |
ya īḍyanti parvatān tiraḥ samudramarṇavam | marudbhirga ā gahi || 7 || ye | īḍyanti | parvatān | tiraḥ | samudram | arṇavam | marudbhiḥ | agne | ā | gahi ||7||
'ye marutaḥ 'parvatān meghān 'īḍyanti cālayanti tathā 'arṇavaṃ udakayuktaṃ 'samudraṃ 'tiraḥ kurvantīti śeṣaḥ |
' hetumati ca ' ( pā. sū. 3. 1. 26 ) iti ṇic |
ā ye tanvanti raśmibhistiraḥ samudramojasā | marudbhirga ā gahi || 8 || ā | ye | tanvanti | raśmibhiḥ | tiraḥ | samudram | ojasā | marudbhiḥ | agne | ā | gahi ||8||
'ye marutaḥ 'raśmibhiḥ sūryakiraṇaiḥ saha 'ā 'tanvanti āpnuvanti ākāśamiti śeṣaḥ |
kiṃca 'ojasā svakīyabalena 'samudraṃ tiraskurvanti taiḥ marudbhiḥ ityanvayaḥ ||
' sati śiṣṭasvarabalīyastvamanyatra vikaraṇebhyaḥ ' iti tiṅa eva ādyudāttatvam |
abhi tvā pūrvapītaye sṛjāmi somyaṃ madhu | marudbhirga ā gahi || 9 || abhi | tvā | pūrvapītaye | sṛjāmi | somyam | madhu | marudbhiḥ | agne | ā | gahi ||9||
niyo miḥ ityanuvṛttau aśnoteśca iti miḥ |

he <sup>V</sup>agne <sup>V</sup>pūrvapītaye pūrvakāle pravṛttāya pānāya tvāṃ prati <sup>V</sup>somyaṃ <sup>V</sup>madhu somasambandhinaṃ madhurasam <sup>V</sup>abhi <sup>V</sup>sṛjāmi sarvataḥ saṃpādayāmi|

iti śrīmadrājādhirājaparameśvaravaidikamārgapravartakaśrīvīrabukkabhūpālasāmrājyadhuraṃdhareṇa sāyaṇācāryeṇa viracite mādhavīye vedārthaprakāśe ṛksaṃhitābhāṣye prathamāṣṭake prathamodhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ ||
1. ca-śa- ‘anyadṛtam’ ityasyānantaraṃ ‘atra yāskaḥ-abhisjāmi tvā pūrvapītaye pūrvapānāya somyaṃ madhu somamayaṃ so'gne marudbhiḥ sahāgaccheti’ ityadhikam|
yasya niḥśvasitaṃ vedā yo vedebhyo'khilaṃ jagat |
viniyogastu sūktasya laiṅgikaḥ smārto vā draṣṭavyaḥ |
vyūḍhasya prathame chandome vaiśvadevaśastre ‘ayaṃ devāya janmane’ iti ārṣevastṛcaḥ |
‘atha chandomāḥ’ iti khaṇḍe sūtritam—‘abhi tvā deva savitaḥ pretāṃ yajñasya śaṃbhuvāyaṃ devāya janmane iti tṛcāḥ’ ( āśva. śrau. 8. 9 ) iti ||
ayam | devāya̭ | janmanḙ | stoma̭ḥ | viprḙbhiḥ | ā॒sayā̭ | a॒kāri̭ | ratna̭dhātamaḥ || 1 ||
ṛbhavo hi manuṣyāḥ santaḥtapasā devatvaṃ prāptāḥ |
takṣṇāsatyābhyāṃ parijamānaṃ sukhaṃ ratham| takṣdhenuṃ sabardudhām || 3 || takṣn | nāsatyābhyām | pari'jamānam | su'gvam | ratham | takṣn | dhenum | sabaḥ'dudhām ||3||
˅nāsatyābhyām adhidevaprītyarthaṃ ˅rathaṃ ˅takṣan ṛbhavo devāḥ kaṃcidrathama takṣaṇena saṃpādita- vantaḥ |
' bahulaṃ chandasi ' ( pā. sū. 6. 4. 75 ) iti aḍabhāvaḥ |
' nabhrāṇnapāt ' ( pā. sū. 6. 3. 75 ) ityā- dinā nalopābhāvaḥ |
ajeḥ paripūrvesya ' śnajakṣan ' ( u. sū. 1. 157 ) ityādinā manpratyaye akāralopaḥ āyudāttatvaṃ ca nipātanāt |
' duhaḥ kaccaśca ' ( pā. sū. 3. 2. 70 ) iti kap |
sabar iti rephāntaṃ prātipadikaṃ kṣīravācī iti saṃpa- dāyavidaḥ |
dvitīye chandome vaiśvadevaśastre ' yuvānā pinarā punaḥ ' iti ārbhvasṛcaḥ |
dvitīyasya ' agniṃ vo devam ' iti khaṇḍe sūtritaṃ- ' mahī dyauḥ pṛthivī ca no yuvānā pitarā punariti tucau ' ( āśva. śrau. 8. 10 ) iti ||
yuvānā pitarā punaḥ satyamantrā ṛjūyaveḥ | ṛbhavau viṣṭyakrata || 4 || yuvānā | pitarā | punariti | satya'mantrāḥ | ṛju'yavaḥ | ṛbhavaḥ | viṣṭī | akrata || 4 ||
˅ṛbhava etannāmakā devāḥ pitarau svakīyau mātāpitarau pūrvaṃ vṛddhāvapi ˅punaḥ ˅yuvānā taruṇau ˅akrata kṛtavantaḥ |
puraścaraṇādyanuṣṭhānena siddha- mantratvāt yadyatphalamuddiśya mantrāḥ prayujyante tattatphalaṃ tathaiva saṃpadyate |
tasmāt jīrṇayoḥ pitroryuvatvaṃ saṃpādayituṃ samarthā ityarthaḥ |
ata eva etepāmanu- ṣṭhitā mantrāḥ sidhyanti |
sarveṣu kāryeṣu etadīyasya mantrasāmarthyasyā- pratighāto'tra vyāptirucyate |
ṛbhuśabdaṃ yāska evaṃ nirvakti- ‘ ṛbhava uru bhāntīti vartena bhāntīti vartena bhavantīti vā ' ( niru. 11. 15 ) iti ||
' kvinkau ca saṃjñāyām ' ( pā. sū. 3. 3. 174 ) iti kvip |
tasmāt jasaḥ ' iyādiyājīkārāṇāmupasaṃkhyānam ' ( pā. sū. 7. 1. 39 ) iti tasya īkārādeśaḥ |
sa ca ' alo'ntyasya ' ( pā. sū. 1. 1. 52 ) iti sakārasya bhavati |
tataḥ ‘ ādaguṇaḥ ’ iti guṇe kṛte ' prathamayoḥ pūrvasavarṇaḥ ' ( pā. sū. 6. 1. 102 ) iti pūrvasavarṇadīrghaḥ |
taṃ bādhitvā paratvāt ' jami ca ' ( pā. sū. 7. 3. 109 ) iti hrasvasya guṇena avitavyamiti cet na |
' mantre ghasaḥ ' ( pā. sū. 2. 4. 80 ) ityādinā celuk |
saṃ vo madāso agmatendreṇa ca marutvatā ādityaiśca rājabhiḥ || 5 || sam | vaḥ | madāḥ | agmata | indreṇa | ca | marutvatā | ādityaiḥ | ca | rājabhiḥ ||5||
he ṛbhaḥ : vaḥ yuṣmākaṃ saṃbandhin : madāḥ madahetavaḥ somāḥ : indreṇa ca ādityaiḥ : ādityaiḥ ca sam agmata saṃgatāḥ |
ata eva āvāhananigadaḥ āśvalāyanenaivaṃ paṭhitaḥ- 'indramādityavantammadhumantaṃ vibhumantaṃ vājavantaṃ bṛhaspativantaṃ viśvadevyāvantamāvaha' (ādha. śrau. 5. 3) iti |
ata eva mantrāntaramevamāmnāyate- 'marudbhirindra sakhyaṃ te astu' (ṛ. saṃ. 8. 96. 7) iti |
'tasau mavarthe' (pā. sū. 1. 4. 19) iti bhasaṃjñayā padasaṃjñayā bādhitatvāt jaśtvābhāvaḥ |
'bahulaṃhchandasi' (pā. sū. 7. 1. 10) iti bhisa aisādeśābhāve 'bahuvacane jhalyet' iti etvam |
uta tyaṃ camasaṃ navaṃ tvaṣṭurdevasya niṣkṛtam | arkāta caturaḥ punaḥ || 6 || uta | tyam | camasam | navam | tvaṣṭuḥ | devasya | niḥ'kṛtam | arkāta | caturaḥ | punariti ||6||
api ca tvaṣṭuḥ etannāmakasya devasya saṃbandhī takṣaṇavyāpāraḥ 'navaṃ nūtanaṃ 'tyaṃ 'camasaṃ taṃ somadhāraṇakṣamaṃ kāṣṭhapātraviśeṣaṃ 'niṣkṛtaṃ niḥśoṣeṇa saṃpāditamakaroditi śeṣaḥ |
takṣaṇavyāpārakuśalasya tvaṣṭuḥ śiṣyāḥ ṛbhavaḥ tena nirmitaṃ tamekaṃ camasaṃ punarapi 'caturaḥ caturthyā vibhaktyārthamasmān kṛtavantaḥ |
ekasya caturvidhakaraṇarūpo'yamartho mantrāntare'pi vispaṣṭaḥ- 'ekaṃ camasaṃ caturaḥ kṛṇotana' (ṛ. maṃ. 1. 161. 2) iti ||
sa hi ghaño'pavādavān granthai sarvatra bhavati |
ghañapratyayaśca 'akartari ca kārake saṃjñāyām' (pā. sū. 3. 3. 19) iti kartṛvyatirikte sarvatra kārake bhavati |
yadyapi tatra saṃjñāyāṃ ityuktaṃ tathāpi cakārasya saṃjñāvyabhicārārthatvāt asaṃjñāyāmapi bhavatyeva |

atra 'kartṛkarmaṇoḥ kṛti' (pā. sū. 2. 3. 65) iti prāptā ṣaṣṭhī yadyapi 'na lokāvyaya-' (pā. sū. 2. 3. 69) iti niṣiddhā tathāpi kartuḥ śeṣatvena vivakṣitatvāt 'kartṛkaraṇayostṛtīyā' (pā. sū. 2. 3. 18) ityetasyāḥ prāpteḥ śaiṣikī ṣaṣṭhī (pā. sū. 2. 3. 50) |

iti | ‘gatiranantaraḥ’ iti nima udāttatvam | akarte akṛpata | kṛjo luṅi jhasya vyatyayena tādeśaḥ | ‘mantre ghasa’ ityādinā calelu~k | ‘chandasyubhayathā’ iti tiṅa ārdhadhātukatvāt ṅittvābhāvena guṇaḥ | caturaḥ | ‘caturaḥ śasi’ (pā. sū. 6. 1. 167) ityukāra udāttaḥ | punaḥ | svarādiṣvādyu- dāttaḥ paṭhitaḥ ||
tṛtīye chandome vaiśvadevaśastre ‘te no ratnāni dhattana’ iti dve ṛcāvāmanvau |
‘tṛtīyasyāganma maha’ iti khaṇḍe sūtritam-‘indra iṣe dadātu naste no ratnāni dhattanetyekā dve ca’ (āśva. śrau. 8. 11) iti||
te no ratnāni dhattana trirā sāptāni sunvate | ekamekaṃ suśastibhiḥ || 7 || te | naḥ | ratnāni | dhattana | triḥ | ā | sāptāni | sunvate | ekamekam | suśastibhiḥ ||7||

pūrvāstveṣu ye pratipāditā ṛbhavaḥ ‘te yūyaṃ suśastibhiḥ śobhanairasmadīyaśaṃsanairyuktāḥ santaḥ naḥ asmākaṃ sabandhane sunvate somābhiṣavaṃ kurvate yajamānāya ratnāni ramaṇīyāni suvarṇamaṇimuktādīni dhanāni ekamekaṃ krameṇa pratyekaṃ dhattana prayacchata |
suvarṇādīnāṃ madhye pratidravyaṃ yāvadapekṣitaṃ tāvaditi vivakṣayā ekamekamityuktam |
uttamāni madhyamanyadha- māni ca ityevaṃ ratnānāṃ trirāvṛttiḥ |
kiṃca sāptāni saptasaṃkhyāniṣpannavargurūpāṇi karmāṇi ca dhattana saṃpādayata |
aupāsanahomo vaiśvadevamityādīnāṃ saptānāṃ pākayajñānāṃ vargo dvitīyaḥ |
agni- ṣṭomo'yamiṣṭoma ityādināṃ saptānāṃ somasaṃsthānāṃ vargastṛtīyaḥ ||
‘nit’ ityanuvṛttau ‘ramesta ca’ (u. sū. 3. 294) iti napratyayaḥ; tatsaṃniyogena makārasya takāraḥ |
atra vargavacanenānena vargiṇo lakṣyante tena bahuvacanam |
anyathā hyeka eva vargirāvṛtta ityekavacanameva syāt |
dvitīyasyaikaśabdasya ‘tasya paramābhreditam’ iti āmreḍitasaṃjñāyām ‘anu- dāttaṃ ca’ (pā. sū. 8. 1. 3) ityanudāttatvam |

śobhanāḥ śastayaḥ iti prādisamāse yadyapi ca ktino nisvādādyudāttatvena kṛduttarapadaprakṛtisvaratvena tadeva prāptaṃ, tat pareṇa ‘manuktinyā- syāna’ (pā. sū. 6. 2. 151) ityādinā uttarapadāntodāttatvena bādhyate ||
adhārayanta vahnayo'bhyajanta sukṛtyayā | bhāgaṃ deveṣu yajñiyam || 8 || adhārayanta | vahnayaḥ | abhyajanta | sukṛtyayā | bhāgam | deveṣu | yajñiyam || 8 ||
vahnayaḥ camasādisādhananiṣpādanena yajñasya voḍhāraḥ ṛbhavaḥ adhārayanta pūrvaṃ manuṣyatvena maraṇayogyā api amṛtatvalābhena prāṇān dhāritavantaḥ |
kiṃcaite sukṛtayā yajñasādhanadravyasaṃpādana- rūpeṇa śobhanavyāpāreṇa deveṣu madhye sthitāḥ yajñiyaṃ yajñārhaṃ bhāgaṃ havirlakṣaṇam abhajanta sevitavantaḥ|
ayamarthaḥ 'sādhanavanā yajñiyaṃ bhāgamānaśa' (ṛ. saṃ. 3. 60. 1) ityādimantrāntare vispaṣṭaḥ|
brāhmaṇe'pi 'ṛbhavo vai deveṣu tapasā somapīthamabhyajayan' (ai. brā. 3. 30) ityādyupākhyānaṃ vispaṣṭam ||
'vibhāṣā kṛvapoḥ' (pā. sū. 3. 1. 120) iti kṛjaḥ karmaṇi kyap |
śobhanaṃ kṛtyaṃ yasyā bhajanakriyāyāḥ sā sukṛtā |
nanu kṛyaśabde kyap: pitvenānudāttatvāt dhātusvare- ṇādirudāttaḥ |
tena hi purastādapavādena paramapi 'nañsubhyām' ityuttarapadāntodāttatvaṃ bādhyate ityuktam |
evaṃ tarhi 'kṛjaḥ śa ca' (pā. sū. 2. 3. 100) iti striyāṃ bhāve kyappratyayāntaḥ kṛtyāśabdaḥ |
viniyogastu-agniṣṭome acchāvākaśāstre 'ihendrāgnī upa haye' iti sūktam |
'stotramagne śastrāt' iti khaṇḍe 'ihendrāgnī upeyaṃ vāmasya manmana iti nava' (āśva. śrau. 5. 10) iti sūtritatvāt |
tathā abhiplavapaḍahaṃ prātaḥsavane acchāvākaśāstre stomātiśaṃsanārthametadeva sūktam |
tathā ca sūtritam 'abhiplavapṛṣṭhagrāhāni' ityupakramya-'ihendrāgnī indrāgnī ā gatam' (āśva. śrau. 7. 5) iti ||
iha | indrāgnī iti | upa | haye | tayoḥ | it | stomam | uśmasi | tā | somam | soma'pātamā ||1||
'iha asminkarmaṇi 'indrāgnī devau 'upa 'haye āhvayāmi 'tayorit indrāmyoraiva 'stomaṃ stotraṃ 'uśmasi kāmayāmahe |
atiśayena somaṃ pātuṃ kṣamau tau dvau devau 'somaṃ pibatām iti śeṣaḥ ||
atra devatādvandve'pi pūrvapadasya ānaṅ na bhavati |
tatra hi dvandve ityanuvṛttau punadvandva- grahaṇāt lokaprasiddhamāhacaryāṇāmeva dvandve ānaṅ ityuktam (kā. 6. 3. 26) |
'devatādvandve ca' (pā. sū. 6. 2. 141) iti ubhayapadaprakṛtisvaratvaṃ tu na bhavati |
tā yajñeṣu pra śaṃsatendrāgnī śubhratā naraḥ |
tā | yajñeṣu | pra | śaṃsata | indrāgnī iti | śubhrata | naraḥ | tā | gāyatreṣu | gāyata ||2||
he nara:manuṣyā: ṛtvija: tā pūrvoktau tau indrāgnī yajñeṣu anuṣṭhīyamānakarmasu pra śaṃsata śabdai:|
tathā tā pūrvoktau tāvindrāgnī gāyatreṣu gāyatrī- cchandaskeṣu mantreṣu sāmarūpeṇa gāyata ||
asya saṃhitāyām ‘anyeṣāmapi dṛśyate’ (pā. sū. 6. 3. 137) iti dīrgha: ||
tā mitrasya praśastaya indrāgnī tā havāmahe|
tā| mitrasya| pra'śastaye| indrāgnī iti| tā| havāmahe| soma'pā| soma'pītaye || 3 ||
mitrasya snehaviṣayasya mama anuṣṭhātu: praśastaye tā pūrvoktau devau saṃpadyetām iti śeṣa:|
mitrasya mama saṃbandhinau tāvindrāgnī praśastaye praśaṃsitumicchāma: iti śeṣa:|
tena̭ | sa॒tyena̭ | jā॒gṛta̭m | ardha̭ | pra॒'ce॒tunai̭ | pa॒de | i॒ndrā॒gnī iti̭ | śa॒rma | ya॒ccha॒tam ||6||
he indrāgnī satyena avaśyaphalapradānādityathena tena asmābhiranuṣṭhitena karmaṇā pracetune praka- peṇa phalabhogajñāpake pade svargalokādisthāne adhi jāgṛtaṃ ādhikyena sāvadhānau bhavatam |
tataḥ asmabhyaṃ śarma yacchataṃ sukhaṃ gṛhaṃ vā dattam |
‘gayaḥ kṛdaraḥ’ ityādiṣu dvāviṃśatisaṃkhyākeṣu gṛhanāmasu ‘śarma varma’ (ni. 3. 4. 21) i
yā su॒rathā̭ ra॒thītamau de॒vā di॒vispṛśā̭ | a॒śvinā॒ tā ha̭vāmahe || 2 || yā | su॒'rathā̭ | ra॒thī'ta̭mā | u॒bhā | de॒vā | di॒vi'spṛśā̭ | a॒śvinā̭ | tā | ha॒vā॒ma॒he॒ ||2||
ᵛyā ᵛubhā ᵛaśvinā ᵛdevā yāvubhāvaśvinau devau ᵛsurathā śobhanarathayuktau ᵛrathītama rathināṃ madhye atiśayena rathinau ᵛdivispṛśā dyulokanivāsinau ᵛtā ᵛhavāmahe tādaśmināvāhayāmahe ||
yā ityādiṣvapsu padeṣu 'supāṃ suluk' iti dvivacanasya ākāraḥ |
samāsāntodāttatvāpavādaṃ bahuvrīhau pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaraṃ bādhitvā 'nañsubhyām' ityuttarapadāntodāttatve prāpte 'āyudāttaṃ cchandasi' ityuttarapadādyudāttatvam |
'anyenāmapi dṛśyate' (pā. sū. 6. 3. 137) iti saṃhitāyām ikārasya dīrghatvam |
yā vāṃ ka॒śā ma̭dhu॒matya̭śvinā sūnṛ॒tāvatī̭ | tayā̭ ya॒jñaṃ mi̭imakṣatam || 3 || yā | vām | ka॒śā | ma॒dhu॒'matī̭ | a॒śvinā̭ | sū॒nṛ॒tā'vatī̭ | tayā̭ | ya॒jñam | mi॒mi॒kṣa॒tam ||3||
ᵛaśvinā he aśvinau devau ᵛvāṃ yuvayoḥ sambandhinī ᵛyā ᵛkaśā aśvatāḍanī vidyate ᵛtayā sahāgasya ᵛyajñam asmadīyaṃ ᵛmimikṣataṃ somarasena sektumicchatam |
kaśāyāśvān dṛḍhaṃ tāḍayitvā sahasā samāgatya bhavadvipayāṃ somarasāhutiṃ niṣpādayitumudyuktau bhavatamityarthaḥ |
'arṇaḥ kṣodaḥ' ityādiṣu ekaśatasaṃkhyākeṣu udakanāmasu 'madhu purīṣam' (ni. 1. 12. 11) iti paṭhitam |
aśvasya śīghragatyā yat svedodakaṃ sravati teneyaṃ kaśā klidyetyarthaḥ |
tīvreṇa kaśātāḍanena yo dhvanirniṣpadyate tāḍanavelāyām aśruruḍhena ca ya ākrośaḥ kriyate tadubhayaṃ śīghragamanahetutvena yajamānasya priyam |
'ślokaḥ dhārā' ityādiṣu saptapañcāśadvāināmasu 'kaśā dhipaṇā' (ni. 1. 11. 43) iti paṭhitam |
aśvinoryā vāk madhumatī mādhuryopetā pāruṣyarahitā sūnṛtāvatī priyavastvyaḥvopetā phalapradānaviṣayetyarthaḥ |
tayā vācā yuktau yajñaṃ mimikṣata miti yojanīyam ||
tathāvidham ṛtaṃ satyaṃ yasyāṃ vāci sā sūnṛtā |
'nañsubhyām' ityuttarapadāntodāttatvaṃ bādhitvā 'parādiśchandasi bahulam' iti ṛkāra udāttaḥ |
sā yasyā asti sā kaśā sūnṛtāvatīti kaśāyāḥ saṃjñā |
na॒hi vā॒masti̭ dū॒rake॒ yatrā॒ rathḙna gacchathaḥ | a॒śvinā॒ somino̭ gṛ॒ham || 4 || na॒hi | vā॒m | a॒sti | dū॒rakḙ | yatra̭ | rathḙna | ga॒ccha॒thaḥ | a॒śvinā̭ | so॒mina̭ḥ | gṛ॒ham || 4 ||
'adhina he aśvinau devau yuvāṃ 'sominaḥ somavato yajamānasya 'gṛhaṃ prati 'rathena 'gacchathaḥ sa mārgo 'vāṃ yuvayoḥ 'dūrake dūradeśe 'nahi 'agni na vartate khalu |
'yatra gṛhe gacchathaḥ tacca gṛhaṃ dūre na bhavati ||
atra hi gṛhaṃ dūre ca nāsti yuvāṃ ca rathena gacchathaḥ iti samuccayaścārtho gamyate, caśabdo na prayujyate iti calope prathamā tiṅibhaktirastīti |
iyaṃ yadyapi na prathamā tathāpi yatra iti yadvattayogāt na nighātaḥ ||
vyūḍhasya dvitīye chandome vaiśvadevaśastre ' hiraṇyapāṇimutaye ' iti sāvitryaśastrasaḥ |
' dvitīyasya ' iti khaṇḍe sūtritaṃ- ' hiraṇyapāṇimutaya iti catasro mahī dyauḥ pṛthivī ca naḥ ' ( āśva. śrau. 8. 10 ) iti ||
hiraṇya'pāṇim | ūtaye | savitāram | upa | hvaye | saḥ | cettā | devatā | padam || 5 ||
'saḥ ca savitā devaḥ etanmantra- pratipādyadevatā bhūtvā 'padaṃ yajamānena prāpyaṃ sthānaṃ 'cettā jñāpayitā bhavati |
devakartṛke yāge savitā svayamtvigbhūtvā brahmatvena avasthitaḥ |
tadānīṃ kasyācidiṣṭau adhvaryavaḥ tasmai mavitre brahmaṇe prāśitranāmakaṃ puroḍāśabhāgaṃ dattavantaḥ |
tacca prāśitraṃ haste savitrā gṛhītaṃ sat tadīyapāṇiṃ ciccheda |
tataḥ prāśitrasya dātāro'- dhvaryavaḥ suvarṇamayaṃ pāṇiṃ nimāya prakṣisavantaḥ |
so'yamarthaḥ kaupītakibrāhmaṇe samāptaḥ—' savitre prāśitraṃ pratijahastasya pāṇiṃ praviccheda tasmai hiraṇmayau pratidadhustasmāddhiraṇyapāṇiriti stutaḥ ' iti |

hiraṇyaśabdaṃ pāṇiśabdaṃ ca yāska evaṃ nirvakti—' hiraṇyaṃ kasmāddhriyata āyamyamānamiti vā hiyate janājjanamiti vā hitaramaṇaṃ bhavatīti vā hṛdayaramaṇaṃ bhavatīti vā haryatervā syātprepsā- karmaṇaḥ ' ( niru. 2. 10 ) iti |
' udāttaḥ ' ityanuvṛttau ' atyūtijutisāti ' ityādinā ktinantaḥ antodātto nipātitaḥ |
' devāttal ' ( pā. sū. 5. 4.27 ) iti svārthe tal |
apāṃ | napātama | arvase | savitāram | upa | stuhi | tasya | vratāni | uśmasi || 6 ||
atra hotā sāmagamtvijam anyaṃ vā śaktriṇaṃ brūte |
tasya nañā samāse 'nabhrānnapāt0' ityādinā nalopapratiṣedha iti vṛttikāraḥ |
tarhi katham apām iti ṣaṣṭhyā 'na lokāvyayaniṣṭhākhalartha0' (pā. sū. 2. 3. 69) iti karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhyāḥ pratiṣedhāt iti cet, tarhepā śeṣalakṣaṇāstu |
agnyādityau apāṃ kāragatayā saṃbandhinau 'agnerāpaḥ' (tai. ā. 8. 2) iti śruteḥ |
agnyādibhyāṃ hapāṃ na prāpakau pratyuta tacchoṣakau |
vibhaktāraṃ havamahe vasauścitrasya rādhasaḥ | savitāraṃ nucakṣasam || 7 ||
vibhaktāram | havamahe | vasauḥ | citrasya | rādhasaḥ | savitāram | nucakṣasam || 7 ||

'vasauḥ nivāsahetoḥ 'citrasya suvarṇarajatādirūpeṇa bahuvidhasya 'rādhasaḥ dhanasya 'vibhaktāram asya yajamānasya etāvaddhanadānam ucitamiti vibhāgakāriṇaṃ 'nucakṣasaṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ prakāśakāriṇaṃ 'savitāraṃ 'havamahe |
kauṣītakina etasyā ṛco vyākhyānarūpe brāhmaṇe saviturvibhāgahetutvameva memā- mananti - 'yadenadvasościtraṃ rādhastadeva savitā vibhaktābhyaḥ prajābhyo vibhajati' iti |
nṝ caṣṭe iti nucakṣāḥ taṃ nucakṣasam |
sakhāya ā ni ṣīdata savitā stomyo nu naḥ | dātā rādhāṃsi śumbhati ||8||
sakhāyaḥ | ā | ni | sīdata | savitā | stomyaḥ | nu | naḥ | dātā | rādhāṃsi | śumbhati ||8||
'naḥ asmākam ayaṃ 'savitā 'nu kṣipraṃ 'stobhyaḥ stutiyogyaḥ 'rādhāṃsi dhanāni 'dātā pradātumyuktaḥ eṣa savitā 'śumbhati śobhate |
samānāḥ santaḥ syānanti prakāśānte iti sakhāyaḥ |
'samāne rayaścodāttaḥ' (u. sū. 4. 576) iti iṇpratyayaḥ; tsaṃniyogena ḍicca yalopaśca |
dātasvam dātā dānaśīlaḥ | tācchīlye tṛn | niśvādādyudāttaḥ | rāghāṃsi | gatam | 'kartṛkarmaṇoḥ kṛti' (pā. sū. 2. 3. 65) iti prāsāyāḥ ṣaṣṭhyāḥ 'na lokāvyaya' (pā. sū. 2. 3. 69) iti pratiṣedhaḥ ||
agniṣṭome prātaḥsavane 'agne patnīrihā vaha' iti neṣṭuḥ sthitayājyā |
'praśastā brāhmaṇācchaṃsī' iti khaṇḍe sūtritam-'agne patnīrihā vahokṣānnāya vaśānnāya' (āśva. śrau. 5. 5) iti ||
agne patnīriha vaha devānāmuśatīrupa | tvaṣṭāraṃ somapītaye || 9 || agne | patnīḥ | iha | ā | vaha | devānām | uśatīḥ | upa | tvaṣṭāram | somapītaye ||9||
tathā 'tvaṣṭāraṃ devaṃ 'somapītaye somapānārtham 'upa samīpe ā vaha ||

na hi pakṣirūpāṇāṃ devapatnīnāṃ pakṣā: kenacit chidyante |

‘supāṃ supo bhavanti’ (pā. ma. 7. 1. 39) iti tṛtīyaika- vacanasya ṅasādeśa:|
ihendrāṇīmupa haye varuṇāṇīṃ svastaye | agrāyīṃ somapītaye || 12 || iha | indrāṇīm | upa | haye | varuṇāṇīm | svastaye | agrāyīm | soma'pītaye || 12 ||
^iha asminkarmaṇi ^svastaye ahamākamavināśāya ^somapītaye somapānāya ca indravaruṇāgnīnāṃ patnī: āhvayāmi |
‘vṛṣākapyagnisitakusidanāmudātta:’ (pā. sū. 4. 1. 37) iti ṅīp; tatsaṃyogena ikārasya aikāra udāttaḥ|
dvitīye chandome vaiśvadevaśastre ‘mahī dyau: pṛthivī ca na:’ iti dyāvāpṛthivyanividvānīyastṛca:|
‘dvitīyasyāgni va:’ iti khaṇḍe sūtritaṃ—‘mahī dyau: pṛthivī ca no yuvānā pitarā puna:’ (āśva. śrau. 8. 10) iti|
‘āgrayaṇaṃ vrīhiśyāmāka’ iti khaṇḍe sūtritaṃ—‘ye ke ca umā mahino ahimāyā mahī dyau: pṛthivī ca na:’ (āśva. śrau. 2. 9) iti|
‘prātarvaiśvadevyām’ iti khaṇḍe sūtritam— ‘abhi tvā deva savitarmahī dyau: pṛthivī ca na:’ (āśva. śrau. 2. 16) iti|
‘vidhayaparādhe’ iti khaṇḍe tathaiva sūtritaṃ—‘vidhandamānaṃ mahī dyau: pṛthivī ca ityantaḥparidhideśe ninayeyu:’ (āśva. śrau. 3. 10) iti|
āśvinaśastre'pyepā ‘saṃsthi teṣvāśvināya’ iti khaṇḍe sūtritaṃ—‘mahī dyau: pṛthivī ca naste hi dyāvāpṛthivī viśvaśaṃbhuvā’ (āśva. śrau. 6. 5) iti|
mahī dyau: pṛthivī ca na imaṃ yajñaṃ mimikṣatām | pipṛtāṃ no bharīmabhi: ||13|| mahī | dyau: | pṛthivī | ca | na: | imam | yajñam | mimikṣatām | pipṛtām | na: | bharīmabhi: ||13||
^maṃhī mahatī ^dyau: dyulokadevatā ^pṛthivī bhūmidevatā ^ca ^na: asmadīyam ^imaṃ ^yajñaṃ ^mimi- kṣatāṃ svakīyasārabhūtena rasena mimikṣatāṃ sektumicchatām|

piptam ubhe devyau pūrayatām || mahī | mahacchandāt 'ugitaśca' (pā. sū. 4. 1. 6) iti ṅīp | acchandalopaśchandasaḥ | 'brahmamahattorupasaṃkhyānam' (pā. sū. 6. 1. 173. 1) iti ṅīp udāttatvam | dyauḥ | divśabdaḥ prātipadikasvareṇāntodāttaḥ | 'goto ṇit' (pā. sū. 7. 1. 90) iti tataḥ parasya soḥ ṅidbhāvāt bhavantī vṛddhirapi sthānivadbhāvenodāttā | pṛthivī | 'pratha prakhyāne' | 'pratheḥ śivansaṃpa- sāraṇaṃ ca' (u. sū. 1. 148) iti pivanpratyayaḥ | 'vidvorādisyaśca' (pā. sū. 4. 1. 41) iti ṅīp | pratyayasvaraḥ | mimiksatām | 'miha secane' | sani dvirbhāvahalādiśeṣau | hatvakatvapatvāni | piptatām | 'pṛ pālanapūraṇayoḥ' | hasva ityeke | śapaḥ śluḥ | 'atipipatyośca' (pā. sū. 7. 4. 77) iti abhyāsasya akārasya ikāraḥ | tiṅaḥ pratyayasvaraḥ | marīmabhiḥ | 'ḍubhṛñ dhāraṇapoṣaṇayoḥ' | 'hustṛbhṛstṛsṛbhya īman' (daśa. pā. 6) iti īman | nistvādādyudāttaḥ ||
tayorhitvatpayo viprā rihanti dhītibhiḥ | gandharvasya dhruve pade || 14 || tayoḥ | ita | ghṛta'vat | paryaḥ | viprāḥ | rihanti | dhīti'bhiḥ | gandharvasya | dhruve | pade || 14||
tathā ca tāpanīyaśākhāyāṃ samāmnāyate—'yakṣagandharvāpsaro- gaṇasevitamantarikṣam' (nṛ. tā. 1. 2) iti |
tenāntarikṣeṇa upalakṣite ākāśe vartamānayoḥ 'tayo- riti dyāvāpṛthivyoreva saṃbandhaḥ 'payaḥ jalaṃ 'ghṛtavat ghṛtasadṛśaṃ 'viprāḥ medhāvinaḥ prāṇinaḥ 'dhītibhiḥ karmabhiḥ 'rihanti lihanti |
'gaivi gan ghṛño vaiḥ' iti vapratyayaḥ; tatsaṃyogena gośabdasya ca gantrādeśaḥ ||
'etadvidaṃ brahmacāriṇam' iti khaṇḍe sūtritaṃ—'syonā pṛthivi bhaveti samāpta' (āśva. śrau. 8. 14) iti |
'mārgaśīrṣyāṃ pratyavarohaṇam' iti khaṇḍe sūtritaṃ—'tasminnupaviśya syonā pṛthivi bhaveti japitvā' (āśva. gṛ. 2. 3. 6) iti ||
syonā pṛthivi bhavānṛkṣarā niveśanī | yacchā naḥ śarma saprathaḥ || 15 || syonā | pṛthivi | bhava | anṛkṣarā | ni'veśanī | yaccha | naḥ | śarma | sa'prathaḥ || 15 ||
tathā ca vājasaneyabrāhmaṇe syonaśabdopetaṃ kaṃcinmantramudāhṛtya vyākhyātam—'indrasyomāviśa syonaḥ syonamiti vistīrṇo vistīrṇamityeva tadāha' iti |
'anṛkṣarā kaṇṭakarahitā 'niveśanī niveśasthānabhūtā 'saprathaḥ vistārayuktaṃ 'śarma śaraṇaṃ 'naḥ asmabhyaṃ 'yaccha he pṛthivi dehi |

tāmetāmṛcamudāhṛtya yāska evaṃ vyācaṣṭe—'sukhā naḥ pṛthivi bhavānṛkṣarā niveśanvyakṣaraḥ kaṇṭaka ṛcchateḥ kaṇṭakaḥ kantapo vā kuntatervā kaṇṭervā syāditi- karmaṇa uddattamo bhavati yaccha naḥ śamaṃ dāraṇaṃ sarvataḥ pṛdhu' (niru. 9. 32) iti ||

ᵥāghṛṇiḥ ᵥpūṣā ᵥrājānaṃ somam ᵥavindat alabhata | kīdṛśam | ᵥapagūḻaham atyantagūḍham | tatra hetuḥ | ᵥguhā ᵥhitaṃ guhāsadṛśe durge dyuloke sthitaṃ tathā ᵥcitrabarhiṣam || apagūḻaham | ‘gū saṃvaraṇe’ | ‘niṣṭhā’ iti karmaṇi ktaḥ | ‘ho ḍhaḥ’ (pā. sū. 8. 2. 31) iti ḍhatvam | ‘jhaṣasta- thordhodhaḥ’ (pā. sū. 8. 2. 40) iti dhakāraḥ | itvaḍhalopadīrghāḥ | samāse ‘gatiranantaraḥ’ iti gateḥ prakṛtisvaratvam | guhā | ‘supāṃ suluk0’ iti saptamyā luk | hitam | niṣṭhāyāṃ dadhāterhiḥ ||
uto | iti | saḥ | mahyam | indubhiḥ | ṣaṭ | yuktān | anu'seṣidhat | gobhiḥ | yavam | na | carkṛṣat || 15 ||
'uto apica 'saḥ pūṣā 'mahaṃ yajamānāya 'indubhiḥ yāgahetubhiḥ somaḥ 'yuktān 'ṣaṭ vasantā- dīn ṛtūn 'anuseṣidhat anukramena punaḥpunaryanan vartate iti śeṣaḥ |
yathā yavamudiśya bhūmiṃ pratisaṃvatsaraṃ punaḥpunaḥ kṛpati tadvat ||
'sāvekācaḥ ' iti bhisa udāttatve prāpte 'na gośvan ' iti pratiṣedhaḥ |
'rimriko ca luki ' (pā. sū. 7. 4. 91 ) iti abhyāsasya rugāgamaḥ |
laghūpadhaguṇe prāpte 'nābhyasta- syāci piti ' (pā. sū. 7. 3. 87 ) iti niṣedhaḥ |
apanatrīye ekadhanāsūpānītāsu svayamanugacchan 'anvayaḥ ' iti dve anubrūyāt |
tṛtīyāyā 'apo devīḥ ' ityanayā ekadhanāsu havirdhānaṃ praviśāmu svayamanupraviśet |
tathaiva sūtritam—'ambayo yantyadhvabhiriti tikta uttamyānuprapayeta ' (āśva. śrau. 5. 1 ) iti ||
ambaryaḥ | yanti | adhva'bhiḥ | jāmayaḥ | adhvari'yatām | pṛśnatīḥ | madhunā | paryaḥ || 16 ||
tathā ca kauṣītakibrāhmaṇe samāmnāyate— 'ambayo yantyadhvabhirityāpo vā ambayaḥ ' iti |
tathā 'madhunā mādhurya rasena yuktaṃ 'payaḥ 'pṛśnatīḥ : gavādiṣu yojayantyaḥ ||
etasmāt 'aca haḥ ' (u. sū. 4. 578 ) iti prakaraṇe bāhulakāt iḥ |
'aputrādīnāmiti vaktavyam ' (pā. ma. 7. 4. 35 ) iti vacanāt 'na cchandasyaputrasya ' iti ītvaniṣedhābhāvaḥ |
'sarve vidhayaśchandasi vikalpyante ' iti 'kavyadhvarapatanasya ' (pā. sū. 7. 4. 39 ) iti akāralopo'pi na bhavati |
'ekādeśa udāttenodāttaḥ ' ityantodāttatve sati 'śatrunbho nayajādī ' iti pañcā udāttatvam |
