ā nau barhī riśādaso varuṇo mitro aryamā |
ā | naḥ | barhiḥ | riśādasaḥ | varuṇaḥ | mitraḥ | aryamā | sīdantu | manuṣaḥ | yathā || 4 ||
he agne varuṇāyo devāḥ tvaddhandhavaḥ tvayā preritāḥ 'riśādasaḥ hiṃsānadantaḥ 'naḥ asmadīyaṃ 'barhiḥ yajñam 'ā 'sīdantu |
visarjanīyasya ratve kṛte 'ro ri ' (pā. sū. 8. 3. 14 ) iti rephalopaḥ |
'ḍhalope pūrvasya dīrgho'ṇaḥ ' (pā. sū. 6. 3. 111 ) iti ikārasya dīrghatvam |
manyatrāpi ' ( u. sū. 2. 278 ) iti auṇādikaḥ usipratyayaḥ |
' yatheti pādānte ' ( phi. sū. 85 ) iti sarvānudāttatvam ||
pūrvya hotarasya no mandasva sakhyasya ca | imā u ṣu śrudhī giraḥ || 5 || pūrvyaḥ | hota: | asya | naḥ | mandasva | sakhyasya | ca | imāḥ | ū~ iti | su | śrudhi | giraḥ ||5||
he pūrvya asmadādeḥ pūrvamutpanna hota: homaniṣpādakāgne na: asmadīyasya asya pravartamānasya yajñasya sakhyasya ca asmadanugrahasya ca siddhayarthaṃ mandasva tvaṃ hṛṣṭo bhava |
imā: asmābhi: prayujya- mānā: gira: u ṣu stutirūpā vāco'pi śrudhi śṛṇu |
hota: ityasya ' nāmantritaṃ samānādhikaraṇe ' iti pūrvasya vidyamānatvāt āṣṭamiko
ᵛviśvapatiḥ viśāṃ prajānāṃ pālakaḥ ᵛhotā homaniṣpādakaḥ ᵛmandraḥ hṛṣṭaḥ ᵛvareṇyaḥvaraṇīyoḍagniḥ ᵛnaḥ asmākaṃ ᵛpriyaḥ ᵛastu |
ᵛvayam api ᵛsvamayaḥ śobhanābhiyuktāḥ santaḥ tava ᵛpriyāḥ bhūyāsmeti śeṣaḥ ||
‘ paśyāvaiśvaryaṃ ’ iti pūrvapadaprakṛtisvare prāpte ‘ parādiśchandasi bahuḻam ’ ityu- ttarapadādyudāttatvam |
svamayo hi vāryaṃ devāso dadhire ca naḥ | svamayo manāmahe || 8 || suamaryaḥ | hi | vāryam | devāsaḥ | dadhire | ca | naḥ | suamaryaḥ | manāmahe || 8 ||

ᵛsvamayaḥ śobhanābhiyuktāḥ ᵛdevāsaḥ dīpyamānā ṛtvijaḥ ᵛnaḥ asmadīyaṃ ᵛvāryavaraṇīya haviḥ ᵛhi yasmāt ᵛdadhire dhṛtavantaḥ tasmādvayaṃ ᵛsvamayaḥ śobhanābhiyuktāḥ santaḥ ᵛmanāmahe tvāṃ yācāmahe || vāryam | ‘ vṛña varaṇe ’ | vṛña sambhaktau ’ | ‘ ṛhalorṣyat ’ | ‘ īdavanda ’ ityādinādyudāttatvam | dadhire | hrecaḥ cittvādantodāttatvam | ‘ hi ca ’ iti nighātapratiṣedhaḥ | manāmahe | ‘ mana jñāne ’ | dhyatyayena śap ||
arthā na ubhayaiṣāmṛta martyānām | mithaḥ santu praśastayaḥ || 9 || artha | naḥ | ubhayeṣām | amṛta | martyānām | mithaḥ | santu | praśastayaḥ || 9 ||
he agne ᵛamṛta maraṇarahitāme ᵛatha karmānuṣṭhānānantaraṃ ᵛmartyānāṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ ᵛnaḥ asmākam asmatsvāminastava ca ᵛubhayeṣāṃ ᵛmithaḥ parasparaṃ ᵛpraśastayaḥ praśastārūpā vācaḥ ᵛsantu |
‘ asihasi 0 ’ ( u. sū. 3. 366 ) ityādinā tanpratyayānto martaśabdaḥ |
tasmāt bhave chandasi ’ ( pā. sū. 4. 4. 110 ) iti yat |
viśvebhiragne agnibhirimaṃ yajñamidaṃ varcaḥ | canau dhāḥ sahaso yaho || 10 || viśvebhiḥ | agne | agnibhiḥ | imam | yajñam | idam | varcaḥ | canaḥ | dhāḥ | sahasaḥ | yaho iti || 10 ||

ᵛsahasaḥ balasya ᵛyaho putra he devārūpa ᵛagne ᵛviśvebhiḥ ᵛagnibhiḥ sarvairāhavanīyādibhiryuk- svam ᵛimam asmadīyaṃ ᵛyajñam ᵛidam asmadīyaṃ ᵛvacaḥ stotraṃ ca sevamānaḥ ᵛcanaḥ annaṃ ᵛdhāḥ asmabhyaṃ dhehi ||
‘ cāyareje hasvaśca ’ ( u. sū. 4. 639 ) iti asun ; tatsaṃniyogena juḍāgamaśca |
sahaso yaho iti ‘ subāmantrite 0 ’ iti parāṅgavadbhāvāt ‘ āmantritasya ca ’ iti ṣaṣṭhyāmantritasamudāyo nihanyate ||
‘aśvaṃ na tvā’ iti trayodaśacaṃ caturthaṃ sūktam|
tathā cānukrāntam— ‘aśvaṃ sasonā gāyatre'nyā daivī triṣṭup’ iti|
aśvaṃ na tvā vāraṃvantaṃ vandadhyā agniṃ namaubhiḥ| samrājantamadhvarāṇām || 1 ||
aśvam | na | tvā | vāra'vantam | vandadhyai | agnim | namaḥ'bhiḥ | sam'rājantam | adhvarāṇām ||1||
ᵛadhvarāṇāṃ yajñānāṃ ᵛsamrājantaṃ samrāṭsvarūpaṃ svāminam ᵛagniṃ tvāṃ ᵛnamobhiḥ stutibhiḥ ᵛvandadhyai vandituṃ pravṛttā iti śeṣaḥ |
abhro yathā vālairbādhakān maśakamakṣikādīn pariharati tathā tvamapi jvālābhirasmadvirodhinaḥ pariharasītyarthaḥ |
‘ karṣātvataḥ ’ iti antodāttatvaṃ vyatyayena na pravartate |
sa ghā naḥ sūnuḥ śavasā pṛthupragāmā suśevaḥ | mīḍhva~ asmākaṃ babhūyāt || 2 ||
saḥ | gha | naḥ | sūnuḥ | śavasā | pṛthu'pragāmā | su'śevaḥ | mīḍhvān | asmākam | babhūyāt ||2||
ᵛsaḥ ᵛgha sa evāgniḥ ᵛnaḥ asmākaṃ ᵛsuśevaḥ susukho bhavatīti śeṣaḥ |
ᵛśavasā balasya ᵛsūnuḥ putraḥ ᵛpṛthupragāmā pṛthupragamanaḥ |
kiṃca ᵛasmakaṃ ᵛmīḍhvān kāmānāṃ varṣitā ᵛbabhūyāt bhavatu |
‘ ṛci tunudhamakṣudrukoruvyāṇām ’ ( pā. sū. 6. 3. 133 ) iti dīrghaḥ |
‘ supāṃ supo bhavanti ’ iti ṅasaḥ tādeśaḥ |
‘ iṇśībhyāṃ van ’ ( u. sū. 1. 150 ) iti śeṣaśabdo vanapratya- yāntaḥ āyudāttaḥ |
tato bahuvrīhau ‘ nansubhyām ’ ityuttarapadāntodāttatve prāpte ‘ āyudāttaṃ cchandasi ’ ityuttarapadādyudāttatvam |
‘ miha secane ’ ityasmāt kasupratyayānto ‘ dāśvān sādvān mīḍhvāṃśa ’ iti nipātitaḥ |
bhavateśchāndasasya liṭaḥ ‘ tiṅāṃ tiṅo bhavanti ’ ( prā. ma. 7. 1. 39 ) iti liṅādeśaḥ |
sa nau durāccāsācca ni martyādghāyāḥ | pāhi sadimidviśrāyuḥ || 3 ||
saḥ | naḥ | durāt | ca | āsāt | ca | ni | martyāt | aghāyoḥ | pāhi | sadam | it | viśva'āyuḥ || 3 ||
1. ca-pha-sa-vāravantam | vārayati daṃśakāmiti vāraḥ | pacādyac | kāpilakāditvāt ( sa-kapilakā- ditvāt ) rūpavikalpaḥ ||

he agne viśvāyuḥ vyāsatagamana: saḥ tvaṃ durācca dūre'pi āsācca āsannadeśe'pi aghāyoḥ aghaṃ pāpamaniṣṭaṃ kartumicchataḥ martyāt manuṣyāt vairiṇa: naḥ asmān sadamit sarvadaiva ni pāhi nitarāṃ pālaya ||
‘iṇ gatau’ ityasmāndhāve ‘eternicca’ ( u. sū. 2. 275 ) iti usi: |
imam pu tvamasmākaṃ suniṃ gāyatraṃ navyāṃsam | agne deveṣu pra vocaḥ || 4 || imam | ū~ iti | su | tvam | asmākam | sunim | gāyatram | navyāṃsam | agne | deveṣu | pra | vocaḥ ||4||
he agne tvam asmākam asmatsambandhinam imam pu purodeśe anuṣṭhīyamānamapi saniṃ havirdānaṃ navyāsaṃ navataraṃ gāyatraṃ stutirūpaṃ vaco'pi deveṣu devānāmagre pra vocaḥ prabrūhi ||
‘chandasi luṅlaṅliṭa:’ iti loḍarthe prārthanāyāṃ luṅi ‘asyativakti’ ( pā. sū. 3. 1. 52 ) iti cle: aḍādeśa: |
ā nau bhaja parameṣvā vājeṣu madhyameṣu | śikṣā vasvo antaṃmasya || 5 || ā | na: | bhaja | parameṣu | ā | vājeṣu | madhyameṣu | śikṣa | vasva: | antaṃmasya || 5 ||
he agne parameṣu utkṛṣṭeṣu dyulokavartiṣu vājeṣu anneṣu naḥ asmān ā bhaja sarvataḥ prāpaya |
antaṃmasya antikatamasya bhūlokasya sambandhine vasva: vasūni śikṣa dehi |
vibhaktāsi citrabhāno sindhaurmā upāka ā | sadyo dāśuṣe kṣarasi || 6 || vibhaktā | asi | citrabhāno iti citra'bhāno | sindho: | ūrmau | upāke | ā | sadya: | dāśuṣe | kṣarasi || 6 ||
he citrabhāno vicitraraśmiyuktāgne vibhaktā viśiṣṭasya dhanasya prāpayitā asi |
yathā sindho: nadyā: upāke samīpe ūrmau ūrmiṃ taraṅgopalakṣitaṃ kulyādi- pravāhaṃ vibhajanti tadvat |
dāśuṣe havirdattavate yajamānāya sadya: tadānīmeva kṣarasi karmaphalabhūtāṃ

vṛṣṭiṃ karopi || sindhoḥ | ‘ syandū prasravaṇe ’ | ‘ syandeḥ saṃprasāraṇaṃ dhaśca ’ ( u. sū. 1. 11 ) iti upratyayaḥ | ‘ nit ’ ityanuvṛtteḥ ādyudāttatvam | ūrmiḥ | ‘ arterūrca ’ ( u. sū. 4. 484 ) iti miḥ | pratyayasvaraḥ | dāśuṣe | ‘ ghṛtavratāya dāśuṣe ’ ( ṛ. saṃ. 1. 25. 6 ) ityatroktam ||
yamagne pṛtsu martyamavā vājeṣu yaṃ junāḥ |
yam | agne | pṛtsu | martyam | avāḥ | vājeṣu | yam | junāḥ | saḥ | yantā | śaśvatīḥ | iṣaḥ ||7||

he agne pṛtsu saṃgrāmeṣu yaṃ martyaṃ yajamānam avāḥ avasi rakṣasi | yaṃ puruṣaṃ vājeṣu saṃgrāmeṣu junāḥ prerayasi | saḥ naro yajamānaḥ śaśvatīriṣaḥ nityānyannāni yantā niyantuṃ samartho bhavati | pṛtsu | ‘ padādiṣu māṃstṛstṛnāmupasaṃkhyānam ’ ( pā. sū. 6. 1. 63. 1 ) iti pṛtanāśabdasya pṛdādeśaḥ | sāvekācaḥ 0 iti vibhakterudāttatvam | avāḥ āvaḥ | akārākārayo- rviparyayaḥ | yadvā | leṭi āḍāgamaḥ | ‘ itaśca ’ iti sipa ikārasya lopaḥ | junāḥ | jū iti gatyarthaḥ sautro dhātuḥ | laḍaḥ sip | ‘ ṛyādibhyaḥ bhā ’ | ‘ bahulaṃ chandasyamāṅ‌yoge'pi ’ iti aḍāgamābhāvaḥ | yadtayogādanighātaḥ | yantā | tṛno nittvādādyudāttatvam | śaśvatīḥ | ‘ ugitaśca ’ iti ṅīp ||
nakiḥ | asya | sahantya | pari'etā | karyasya | cit | vājaḥ | asti | śravāvyaḥ ||8||
he sahantya śatrūṇāmabhibhavanaśīlābhe asya svadrakasya yajamānasya kayasya cit kasyāpi paryatā nakiḥ ākramitā nāsti |
kiṃca asya yajamānasya śravāvyaḥ śravaṇīyaṃ : vājaḥ asti balaviśeṣo'sti |
‘ śrudakṣisṛhigṛhibhya āyyaḥ ’ ( u. sū. 3. 376 ) iti āyyapratyayaḥ ||
saḥ | vājam | viśva'carṣaṇiḥ | arvata'bhiḥ | astu | tarutā | vipraibhiḥ | astu | sanitā ||9||
viśvacarṣaṇiḥ sarvairmanuṣyairupetaḥ saḥ agniḥ arvadbhiḥ aśvaiḥ vājaṃ saṃgrāmaṃ tarutā tārayitā astu |
vipraibhiḥ medhāvibhiḥ ṛtvigbhiḥ sahitaḥ tuṣṭo'gniḥ sanitā phalasya dātā astu ||
bhisi ‘ arvaṇastasāvanajaḥ ’ ( pā. sū. 6. 4. 127 ) iti nakārasya tṛ ityayamādeśaḥ |
asmāt ‘ grasi- taskabhitaḥ ’ ( pā. sū. 7. 2. 34 ) ityādau tṛnto nipātitaḥ |
atoyāme hoturatiriktakthe ‘ jarābodha tadvividdhi ’ iti stotriyastṛcaḥ |
‘ yasya paśavo nopadhareran ’ iti khaṇḍe sūtritam—‘ atiriktakthāni jarābodha tadvividdhi ’ ( āśva. śrau. 9. 11 ) iti ||
jara'bodha | tat | vividdhi | viśva'viśe | yajñiyāya | stomam | rudrāya | darśikam || 10 ||
he jarabodha jarayā stutyā bodhamānāgne viśviśe tattadyajamānarūpaprajānugrahātha yajñiyāya yajñasaṃbandhyanuṣṭhānasiddhayartha tat devayajana vividdhi praviśa |
yajamāno'pi rudrāya krūrāyāgnaye tubhyaṃ dṛśīkaṃ darśanīyaṃ samīcīnaṃ stomaṃ stotraṃ karotīti śeṣa: |
atra yāska evaṃ vyākhyātavān—‘jarā stutirjarete: stutikarmaṇastāṃ bodha tayā bodhayitariti vā tadviddhi taskuru manuṣyasya manuṣyasya yajanāya stomaṃ rudrāya darśanīyam’ (niru. 10. 8) iti ||
‘vipu vyāptau’ ityasmāt loṣmadhyamaika- vacane abhyāsasya guṇābhāva: |
sa nau mahān animāno dhūmaketu: puruścandra: |
sa: | na: | mahān | ani'māna: | dhūma'ketu: | puru'candra: | dhiye | vājāya | hinvatu || 11 ||
sa: agni: na: asmān dhiye karmaṇe vājāya annāya ca hinvatu prīṇayatu |
mahān guṇādhika: animāna: nimānavarjita: aparivicchinna ityartha: |
mahāṃ ani ityatra saṃhitāyāṃ nakārasya ruvānunāsikāvuktau |
sa revā~iva viśapatidaivya: ketu: śṛṇotu na: |
sa: | revān'iva | viśapati: | daivya: | ketu: | śṛṇotu | na: | ukthai: | agni: | bṛhat'bhānu: || 12 ||
sa: agni: ukthai: stotrairyuktān na: asmān śṛṇotu |
yathā loke dhanavān rājā vandināṃ stotraṃ śṛṇoti tadvat |
‘ agnirvai devānāṃ dūta āsīt ’ (tai. saṃ. 2. 5. 8. 5) iti śruteḥ |
‘ āreśabdasya matupa udā- ttatvaṃ vaktavyam ’ (pā. sū. 6. 1. 176. 1) iti matupa udāttatvam |
darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ śugādāpanāt pūrvabhāvini jape ‘ namo mahadbhyaḥ ’ ityepā |
‘ brahmaudane prāśipya- māṇe ’ iti khaṇḍe ‘ sūryo no divaspātu namo mahadbhyo namorbhakebhyaḥ ’ (āśva. śrau. 1. 4) iti sūtritam ||

namo mahadbhyo namorbhakebhyo namo yuvabhyo nama āśinebhyaḥ | yajāma devānyadi śakvāma mā jyāryasaḥ śaṃsamā vṛkṣi devāḥ || 13 || namaḥ | mahat'bhyaḥ | namaḥ | arbhakebhyaḥ | namaḥ | yuva'bhyaḥ | namaḥ | āśinebhyaḥ | yajāma | devān | yadi | śakvāma | mā | jyāryasaḥ | śaṃsam | ā | vṛkṣi | devāḥ || 13||
agninā preritaḥ śunaḥśepo viśvān devān anayā tuṣṭāva |
tathā ca ānnāyate- ‘ tamagniruvāca viśvān devān stuhya tvokṣasyama iti viśvāndevāṃstuṣṭāva namo mahadbhyo namorbhakebhya ityetayarcā ’ (ai. brā. 7. 16) iti |
‘ yadi ’ śaktavāma kathaṃcid dhanā- disaṃgrahayā śakvāśret tadānīṃ ‘ devān ’ yajāma |
he ‘ devāḥ ’ ‘ jyāyasaḥ ’ jyeṣṭhasya devatāviśeṣasya ‘ ā sarvataḥ prasṛtaṃ ’ ‘ śaṃsaṃ stotraṃ ’ ‘ mā ’ ‘ vṛkṣi ahaṃ vicchinnaṃ mā kāryam |
‘ āṅuttamasya picca ’ iti tiṅaḥ piṅtvāt anudāttatve sati vikaraṇasvaraḥ |
praśasyaśabdāt īyasuni ‘ jya ca ’ (pā. sū. 5. 3. 61) iti jyādeśaḥ |
‘ jyādīdīyasaḥ ’ (pā. sū. 6. 4. 160) iti īyasuna īkārasya ātvam |
‘ yatra grāvā ’ iti pañcamaṃ sūktaṃ navarcam |
tathā ca bṛhadevatāyāmuktam- ‘ carmādhipavanīyaṃ vā somaṃ vānvā praśaṃsati ’ (bṛhade. 3. 101) iti |
tadukta- manukramaṇyām- ‘ yatra grāvā nava palanuṣṭubādi yaccidvayolūkhalyau pare mausalyau ca prajāpaterhariścandrasyāntyā

tathā ca brāhmaṇam- 'atha haitaṃ śunaḥśepo'saṃvaṃ dadarśa tametābhi- śśatabhirabhisuṣāva yabddhi tvaṃ gṛhegṛha ityathainaṃ droṇakalaśamabhyavanināyocchiṣṭaṃ cambordharetyayarcātha hāsminnvārambhe pūrvābhiśratasubhiḥ sasvāhākārābhirjuhavāṃcakāra' (ai. brā. 7. 17) iti ||
yatra grāvā pṛthubudhna ūrdhvo bhavati sortave |
yatra | grāvā | pṛthubudhnaḥ | ūrdhvaḥ | bhavati | sortave | ulūkhalasutānām | ava | it | ū~ iti | indra | jalgulaḥ ||1||
he indra yatra yasmin ajñaḥsave karmaṇi sotave abhiṣavārthaṃ grāvā pāṣāṇaḥ pṛthubudhnaḥ sthūlamūlaḥ ū
yatra | nārī | apa'cyavam | upa'cyavam | ca | śikṣate | ulūlakhala'sutānām | arvā | ita | ū~ iti | indra | jalgulaḥ || 3 ||

'yatra yasmin karmaṇi 'nārī patnī 'apacyavaṃ śālāyāḥ nirgamanam 'upacyavaṃ 'ca śālāprāptiṃ ca 'śikṣate abhyāsa karoti | anyatpūrvavat || apacyavam | ' cyuṅ gatau ' | ' ṛdorap ' iti ap | guṇāvādeśau | thāthādinā ( pā. sū. 6. 2. 144 ) uttarapadāntodāttatvam | evam upacyavam | śikṣate | ' śikṣa vijopādāne ' | adupadeśāt lasārvadhātukānudāttatve dhātusvaraḥ | ' nipātairyadyadihanta ' iti nighātapratiṣedhaḥ ||
yatra | manthām | vi'badhnatai | raśmīn | yamitavai'iva | ulūlakhala'sutānām | arvā | ita | ū~ iti | indra | jalgulaḥ || 4 ||
'pathimadhyumukṣāmāt ' ( pā. sū. 7. 1. 85 ) iti dvitīyāyāmapi vyatyayena autvam |
prātipadikasvareṇāntodāttatve prāpte ' pathimathoḥ sarvanāmasthāne ' ( pā. sū. 6. 1. 199 ) ityādyudāttatvam |
' mithi viloḍane ' ityasmāt ' halaśca ' iti karaṇe ghañ |
' aniditām ' iti nalope ' bhābhyastayorātaḥ ' iti ākāralopaḥ |
' antaśca tavai yugapat ' ( pā. sū. 6. 1. 200 ) ityādyantayorudāttatvam |
yat | cit | hi | tvam | gṛhe'gṛhe | ulūlakhalaka | yujyasai | iha | ghumat'tamam | vada | jaryatām'iva | dundubhiḥ || 5 ||
he vulūkhalaka vyacciddhi yadyapi tvamavaghātāthaṃ vgṛhegṛhe vyujyase tathāpi viha vaidike karmaṇi tīvramulaprahāreṇa vghumattamam atiśayena dīptaṃ prabhūtadhvaniyuktaṃ śabdaṃ vvada |
yathā yuddhe jayaṃ prāpnuvatāṃ rājñāṃ dundubhiḥ mahāntaṃ dhvaniṃ karoti tadvat |
ulūkhalaśabdaṃ yāska evaṃ vyākhyātavān- ‘ulūkhalamuskaraṃ vordhvaṃ vorkaraṃ voru me kurvitamavīttadulūkhalamabhavadurukaraṃ vai tattadulūkhalamityācakṣate parokṣeṇeti ca brāhmaṇam’ (niru. 9 20) iti |
nanu ‘diva ut’ ityatra prātipadikaṃ gṛhyate na dhāturiyuktatvāt akṣaghūḥ ityādāviva atrāpi uṭhā bhavitavyam (pā. sū. 6. 4. 19) |
evaṃ tarhi dīsimatsvargavācakena divprātipadikena dīptirlakṣyate ityutvaṃ bhaviṣyati |

uta smaṃ te vanaspate vāto vi vātyagramit | atho indrāya pātave sunu somamulūkhala || 6 || uta | sma | te | vanaspate | vātaḥ | | vi | vāti | agram | it | atho iti | indrāya | pātave | sunu | somam | ulūkhala || 6 ||

atra yāska evaṃ vyācaṣṭau- ‘āyajī āyapṭhye annānāṃ saṃbhaktame te huccairvihiyete harī ivānnāni bhuñjāne’ (niru. 9. 36) iti |

guṇe prāpte ' jhjhiti ca ' iti pratiṣedhaḥ |

he ṛtvigviśeṣa hariścandradevatāpakṣe he hariścandra iti 'camvoḥ somasya bhakṣatvasaṃpādakayoḥ adhi- pavaṇaphalakayoḥ 'śiṣṭam abhiṣavarāhityena avaśiṣṭaṃ somam 'ut 'bhara śakaṭasyopari hara |
prakṣepe sati avaśiṣṭaṃ somaṃ 'goḥ 'tvaci ānaḍuhe carmaṇi 'adhi 'ni 'dhehi adhyāropya sthāpaya ||
' udāttayaṇo halpūrvāt ' iti vyatyayena na bhavati |
' yacciddhi satya somapāḥ ' iti ṣaṣṭhaṃ sūktaṃ saptarcaṃ śunaḥśepasyārṣaṃ pāṅktamaindram |
anukramaṇikā ca- ' yacciddhi sapta pāṅktam ' iti ||
pṛṣṭhapaḍahasya pañcame'hani mādhyaṃdine savane hotrāḥ ' yacciddhi ' iti saptarcaṃ sūktaṃ trīṃścākṛtvā svasvaśākhe ekaikaṃ tṛcamāpayeran |
' caturthe'hani ' iti khaṇḍe ' yacciddhi satya somapā ityekaikamevameva ' (āśva. śrau. 7. 11) iti sutritam ||
ā tū na indra śaṃsaya goṣvaśveṣu śubhriṣu sahastreṣu tuvīmagha ||

'tyāḥ asmābhiradṛśyamānāḥ parokṣāstāḥ 'arātayaḥ adānaśīlāḥ śatravaḥ 'sasantu nidrāṃ kurvantu |

'nāmantritaṃ samānādhikaraṇe' iti pūrvasya avidyamānavattvaniṣedhāt parāñcadbhāve sati śeṣanighātena vā 'āmantritasya ca' iti vā sarvānudāttatvam |
a॒smāka̭ṃ śi॒priṇī̭nāṃ soma॒pānā̭m | sa॒khye va̭ji॒ntsakhī̭nām || 11 || a॒smāka̭m | śi॒priṇī̭nām | soma॒'pānā̭m | sa॒khye | va॒ji॒n | sakhī̭nām || 11 ||

he 'somapāḥ somasya pātaḥ 'sakhe sakhivat priya 'vajin vajrayuktendra 'sakhīnāṃ sakhivat priyāṇāṃ 'somapānāṃ somasya pātṝṇām 'asmākaṃ 'śipriṇīnāṃ dīrghābhyāṃ hanūbhyāṃ nāsikābhyāṃ vā yuktānāṃ gavāṃ samūhaḥ tvatprasādādasti iti śeṣaḥ ||
'alloponaḥ' (pā. sū. 6. 4. 134) iti anaḥ akā- rasya lopaḥ ||
tathā tadastu somapāḥ sakhe vajrintthā kṛṇu | yathā ta uśmasīṣṭayai || 12 || tathā | tat | astu | soma'pāḥ | sakhe | vajrin | tathā | kṛṇu | yathā | te | uśmasi | iṣṭayai ||12||

he 'somapāḥ 'sakhe 'vajrin 'iṣṭaye abhilaṣitārthaṃ 'te tava anugrahaṃ 'yathā yena prakāreṇa 'uśmasi vayaṃ kāmayāmahe tvaṃ 'tathā kuru | 'tvatprasādāt 'tat abhīṣṭaṃ 'tathā 'astu || kṛṇu | 'kṛci hiṃsākaraṇa- yośca ' | idittvāt num | 'dhanvikrumbhyora ca ' iti upratyayaḥ ; tatsaṃniyogena vakārasya ca akāraḥ | 'ato lopaḥ ' iti tasya lopaḥ | tasya sthānivadbhāvāt laghūpadhaguṇābhāvaḥ | 'utaśca pratyayādasayogapūrvāt ' iti herluk | uśmasi | 'vaśa kāntau ' | 'idanto masi ' | adāditvāt śapo luk | prahijyā- dinā saṃprasāraṇam | pratyayasvaraḥ | yadvattayo

, he ᵥghṇo dhārṣṭyayukta indra ᵥtvāvān svasadṛśo devatāviśeṣaḥ ᵥdhamanāsaḥ tvadanugrahaśālaṃ svayameva āsaḥ san ᵥiyānaḥ asmābhiryācyamānaḥ ᵥstotrabhyaḥ stotrāṇāmanugrahāya tadabhīṣṭamarthaṃ ᵥgha avaśyam ᵥā ᵥṛṇoḥ ānīya prakṣipatu |
‘ vatupkaraṇe yuṣmadasmadbhyāṃ chandasi sādṛśya upasaṃkhyānam ’ ( pā. sū. 5. 2. 39. 1 ) iti vatup |
‘ ā sarvanāmnaḥ ’ ( pā. sū. 6. 3. 91 ) iti dakārasya ātvam |
tasya ‘ liṭaḥ kānajvā ’ ( pā. sū. 3. 2. 106 ) iti kānajādeśaḥ |
‘ aci śnudhātu ’ ( pā. sū. 6. 4. 77 ) ityādinā iyaḍādeśaḥ |
‘ dvivacanaprakaraṇe chandasi veti vaktavyam ’ iti vacanāt abhyāso na kriyate |
laṅi vyatyayena tipaḥ sipi ‘ itaśca ’ ( pā. sū. 3.. 4. 100 ) iti ikāralopaḥ |
ā yadurvaḥ śatakratvā kāmaṃ jaritṛṇām | ṛṇorakṣaṃ na śacībhiḥ || 15 || ā | yat | durvaḥ | śatakrato iti śata'krato | ā | kāmam | jaritṛṇām | ṛṇoḥ | akṣam | na | śacībhiḥ || 15 ||
he ᵥśatakrato indra ᵥyahuvaḥ dhanaṃ kāmitārtharūpam ᵥā stotṛbhirāsavyamasti taṃ ᵥkāmaṃ ᵥjaritṛṇāṃ stotrāṇāmanugrahāya ᵥā ᵥṛṇoḥ ānīya prakṣipasi |
ᵥśacībhiḥ karmabhiḥ śakaṭocitavyāpāraviśeṣaiḥ ᵥakṣaṃ ᵥna yathā akṣaṃ prakṣipanti tadvat ||
śacīśabdaḥ śārṅkhavādi- ṅīnantaḥ ( pā. sū. 4. 1. 73 ) ādyudāttaḥ ||

śaśvadindraḥ popruthadbhirjigāya nānadadbhiḥ śārśvasadbhirvardhanāni | sa nau hiraṇyarathaṃ daṃsanāvānta naḥ sanitā sanaye sa nau'dāt || 16 || śaśvat | indraḥ | popruthadbhiḥ | jigāya | nānadadbhiḥ | śārśvasadbhiḥ | dhanāni | saḥ | naḥ | hiraṇya'ratham | daṃsanā'vān | saḥ | naḥ | sanitā | sanaye | saḥ | naḥ | adāt || 16 ||
tuṣṭena indreṇa dattaṃ hiraṇyaratham anayā pratijagrāha |
tathā ca brāhmaṇaṃ—‘ tasmā indraḥ stūyamānaḥ prīto manasā hiraṇyarathaṃ dadau tametayā pratīyāya śaśvadindra iti ’ ( ai. brā. 7. 16 ) iti |
ᵥindraḥ ᵥśaśvat sarvadā ᵥdhanāni vairisambandhīni ᵥjigāya jitavān aairiti śeṣaḥ |
ghāsabhakṣaṇānantarabhāvinam oṣṭhaśabdaṃ kurvadbhiḥ 'nānadadbhiḥ nādam āsyagataṃ heṣāśabdaṃ kurvadbhiḥ 'śāśva- sadbhiḥ punaḥpunarśa vā śvasadbhiḥ |
'daṃsanāvān karmavān 'sanitā dātā 'saḥ indraḥ 'naḥ asmākaṃ 'sanaye saṃbhajanāthaṃ 'hiraṇyarathaṃ suvarṇena nirmitaṃ ratham 'adāt dattavān |
'hasvaḥ ' (pā. sū. 7. 4. 59) iti hasvatve kṛte 'guṇo yaṅlukoḥ ' (pā. sū. 7. 4. 82) iti guṇaḥ |
prātaranuvāke āśvine ṛtau gāyatre chandasi 'āśvināvaśvāvatyā ' iti tṛcaḥ |
'athāśvinaḥ ' iti khaṇḍe 'aśvinā yajvarīrapa āśvināvaśvāvatyā ' (āśva. śrau. 4. 15) iti sūtritam |
āśvināvaśvāvatyeṣā yātaṃ śarvīrayā | gomadaśvā hiraṇyavat || 17 || ā | aśvinau | aśvā'vatyā | iṣā | yātam | śarvīrayā | go'mat | dastrā | hiraṇya'vat ||17||
tathā ca brāhmaṇaṃ- 'tamindra uvācāśvinau nu stutha stotrakṣayām iti so'śvinau tuṣṭāvāta uttareṇa tṛcena ' (ai. brā. 7. 16) iti |
he 'aśvinau 'aśvāvatyā bahubhiraśvairyuktā 'śarvīrayā preryamāṇayā 'iṣā annena saha 'ā 'yātam asmin karmaṇi āgacchatam |
he 'dastrā aśvinau yuvayoḥ prasādāt 'gomat bahubhirgobhiryutaṃ 'hiraṇyavat bahunā hiraṇyena yuktam asmadīyaṃ gṛhamāstviti śeṣaḥ |
'kṛṣpṛkaṭīpaṭiśoṭībhya īran ' (u. sū. 4. 470) iti īranpratyayo bahulavacanāt asmādapi bhavati |
samānayojano hi vāṃ rathau dastrāvamartyaḥ | samudre aśvinairyete || 18 || samāna'yojanaḥ | hi | vām | rathaḥ | dastrā | amartyaḥ | samudre | aśvinau | īryete || 18 ||
he 'dastrau aśvinau 'vāṃ yuvayoḥ sambandhī 'rathaḥ 'samānayojanaḥ tulyayojanaḥ yuvayordvayorekarathā- rūḍhatvāt ubhayārthaṃ sakadeva yujyate |
ata eva he aśvinau 'hi yasmāt 'samudre antarikṣe 'īryete gacchati |
antarikṣanāmasu paṭhitaṃ samudraśabdaṃ yāska evaṃ vyācakhyau-'samudraḥ kasmātsamudravantyasmādāpaḥ samabhidravantyenamāpaḥ saṃmodante'sminbhūtāni

samudko bhavati samunattīti vā ' ( niha. 2. 10 ) iti | samānayojanaḥ | bahuvrīhau pūrvapadaprakṛti- svaratvam | amartyaḥ | avyayapūrvapadaprakṛtisvaratvam | īyate | ' īṅ gatau ' | adupadeśāt lasārvadhātu- kānudāttatve śyano nittvādādyudāttatvam | ' hi ca ' iti nighātāpratiṣedhaḥ ||
ni | adhyasya | mūrdhani | cakram | rathasya | yemathuḥ | pari | dyām | anyat | īyate ||19||
he aśvinau yuvām adhyasya hantuṃ vināśayitumaśakyasya dṛḍhasya parvatasya mūrdhani upari cakraṃ bhavadīyatharathasambandhvekaṃ cakraṃ ni yemathuḥ niyamitavantau |
anyat cakraṃ pari dyāṃ dhulokasya paritaḥ īyate gacchati ||
vayam | hi | te | amanmahi | ā | antāt | ā | parākāt | aśve | na | citre | aruṣi || 21 ||
vaśve vyāpakaśīle vcitre cāyanīye vahaṣi ārocamāne uṣaḥkālābhimānini devate tava svarūpam vantāt samīpaparyantam vā vparākāt dūraparyantaṃ vvayaṃ manuṣyāḥ vna vamanmahi na boḍhuṃ samarthāḥ |
tvam | tyebhiḥ | ā | gahi | vājebhiḥ | duhitaḥ | divaḥ | asme iti | rayim | ni | dhāraya || 22 ||
he vdivaḥ vduhitaḥ ghudevatāyāḥ putra uṣo devi vtyebhiḥ vvājebhiḥ tairaḥ saha vtvam vā vgahi atrāgaccha |
vasme asmāsu vrayiṃ dhanaṃ vni vdhāraya nitarāṃ sthāpaya ||
parasyāpi diva ityasya divaḥ duhitaḥ ityanvaye sati pūrvatvāt ‘subāmantrita’ iti parāṅgavadbhāvena paśyāmantritasamudāyasya sarvānudāttatvam |
‘kāryakālaṃ hi saṃjñāparibhāṣam’ (paribhā. 3) iti nyāyena ‘suvā- mantrita’ ityasya ‘āmantritasya ca’ iti āṣṭamikena yogenaikavākyatve sati paratvāt parāṅgavadbhāve sati sarvānudāttatvam |
kṛtasvarayoḥ paśyāmantritayoḥ paścāt ‘vyatyayo bahulam’ iti vyatyayastaprayogaḥ |
tathā ca anukramaṇikā—‘tvamagne yūnā hiraṇyastūpa āgneyaṃ triṣṭubantyāṣṭyaṣṭyau ca’ iti |
prātaranuvāke āgneye kratau āśvinaśastre ca ‘tvamagne prathamaḥ’ iti sūktam |
‘athaitasyā rātreḥ’ iti khaṇḍe ‘tvamagne prathamo aṅgirā ṛṣinuṃ cisahojā amṛto ni tundate’ (āśva. śrau. 4. 13) iti sūtritam |
abhilavayajñasya tṛtīye'hani āgnimārute śastre idaṃ sūktaṃ jātavedasyanividvānīyam |
tathā ca ‘tṛtīyesya vyarthamā’ iti khaṇḍe sūtritaṃ—‘tvamagne prathamo aṅgirā ityāgnimārutam’ (āśva. śrau. 7. 7) iti |
vājapeye āgnimārute etasūktaṃ jātavedasyaṃ nividvānīyaṃ, ‘tṛtīyenābhilavikenoktaṃ tṛtīyasavanam’ (āśva. śrau. 9. 1) ityatikṣiptatvāt ||
tvamagne prathamo aṅgirā ṛṣirdevo devānāmabhavaḥ śivaḥ sakhā |
tava vrate kuvayo viśvanāpaso'jāyanta maruto arjataṣṭayaḥ ||
tvam | agne | prathamaḥ | aṅgirāḥ | ṛṣiḥ | devaḥ | devānām | abhavaḥ | śivaḥ | sakhā | tava | vrate | kuvayaḥ | viśvanāpasaḥ | ajāyanta | marutaḥ | arjataṣṭayaḥ || 1 ||
tathā ca brāhmaṇaṃ — 'ye'ṅgārā āsaṃste'ṅgiraso'bhavan' (ai. brā. 3. 34) iti |
tathā svayaṃ <sup>v</sup>devaḥ bhūtvā <sup>v</sup>devānām anyeṣāṃ <sup>v</sup>śivaḥ śobhanaḥ <sup>v</sup>sakhā abhavaḥ |

<sup>v</sup>tava <sup>v</sup>vrate tvadīye karmaṇi <sup>v</sup>kavayaḥ medhāvinaḥ <sup>v</sup>vipranāpasaḥ jñānena vyāpyuvānāḥ jñātakarmāṇo vā <sup>v</sup>bhrājadṛṣṭayaḥ dīpyamānāyudhāḥ <sup>v</sup>marutaḥ marutsaṃjñakāḥ devāḥ <sup>v</sup>ajāyanta ||
pūrvapadasya 'anyeṣāmapi dṛśyate' iti dṛśigrahaṇāt avagrahasamaye'pi dīrghatvam |
'ṛṣī gatau' ityasmāt 'kiccaktau ca saṃjñāyām' iti kijantaḥ ṛṣiśabdaḥ |
tvamagne prathamo aṅgirastamaḥ kavirdevānāṃ pari bhūṣasi vratam |
vibhuviśvasmai bhuvanāya medhiro dvimātā śayuḥ katidhā cidāvave ||
tvam | agne | prathamaḥ | aṅgiraḥtamaḥ | kaviḥ | devānām | pari | bhūṣasi | vratam |
tri'bhuḥ | viśvasmai | bhuvanāya | medhiraḥ | dvi'mātā | śayuḥ | katidhā | cit | āyave || 2 ||

he <sup>v</sup>agne <sup>v</sup>tvaṃ <sup>v</sup>prathamaḥ ādyaḥ <sup>v</sup>aṅgirastamaḥ atiśayena aṅgirāḥ bhūtvā <sup>v</sup>kaviḥ medhāvī san <sup>v</sup>devānām anyeṣāṃ <sup>v</sup>vrataṃ karma <sup>v</sup>pari <sup>v</sup>bhūṣasi paritaḥ alaṃkāroṣi |
tattanmanuṣyagṛhe'vasthitasya tava prakārā iyanta iti na kenāpi jñāyate ityarthaḥ ||
'viprasaṃbhyo dvasaṃjñāyām' (pā. sū. 3. 2. 180) iti vipūrvāt bhavateḥ ḍapratyayaḥ |
'nadyataśca' (pā. sū. 5. 4. 153) iti kappratyayo na bhavati, mātṛmātṛkayoḥ bhedenopā- dānāt 'nadyataśca' iti kvapi vibhāṣyate iti tasya mātṛśabdaviṣaye pākṣikatvoktiḥ |
ityantasya kiṃśabdasya 'bahugaṇavatuḍati saṃkhyā' (pā. sū. 1. 1. 23) iti saṃkhyāsaṃjñāyāṃ 'saṃkhyāyā vidhārthe dhī.' (pā. sū. 5. 3. 42) iti dhāpratyayaḥ |
tvama̭gne॒ pratha॒mo mā̭ta॒riśva̭na॒ āvi̭rbhava sukra॒tūyā॒ viva̭svate |
tvam | agne | prathamaḥ | mātariśvane | āviḥ | bhava | sukratūyā | vivasvate | arejetām | rodasī iti | hotṛvūrye | asannaḥ | bhāram | aryajaḥ | mahaḥ | vaso iti ||3||
he 'gne tvaṃ mātariśvane prathamaḥ mukhyo bhūtvā vartase |
tādṛśastvaṃ sukratūyā śobhanakarmecchayā vivasvate paricarate yajamānāya āvirbhava prakaṭo bhava |
tava sāmarthyaṃ dṛṣṭvā rodasī dyāvāpṛthivyau arejetām akampetām |
he vagne vtvaṃ vmanave manoranugrahāthaṃ vyāṃ dyulokam vavāśaya: śaṃsitavānasi |
vsukṛte tava paricaraṇaṃ kurvate vpururavase etannāmakasya rājo'nugrahāthaṃ vsukurūra: atiśayena śobhanaphalakāryabhū: |
vyat yadā vpitro: araṇyo: vścātreṇa kṣipramathanena vpari vmubhyase parito mukto bhavasi utpadyase ityartha: |
tadānīṃ vtvā araṇyo rūpaṃ vtvāṃ vpūrvaṃ vede: pūrvadeśam vā vanayan āhavanīyatvena sthāpitavanta: |
vpuna: paścāt vaparaṃ paścimadeśam vā anayan gārhapatyarūpeṇa prāpitavanta: |
asmāt auṇādike asuni ‘purasi ca pururavā:’ (u. sū. 4. 671) iti pūrvapadasya dīrgho nipātyate |

yadyapi ‘satiśiṣṭasvara- balīyastvamanyatra vikaraṇebhya:’ iti vacanāt vikaraṇasvara: satiśiṣṭo'pi lasārvadhātukasvarasya bādhako na bhavati tathāpi dhātusvaraṃ bādhate eva, ‘dhātusvaraṃ bhāsvara:’ ityuktvāt |
ato yaka eva svare prāpte vyatyayenādyudāttatvam ||
tvamagne vṛṣabha: puṣṭivardhana urgatasuce bhavasi śravāvya: |
ya āhutiṃ pari vedā varṣakṛtumekāyurge viśaṃ āvivāsasi ||
tvam | agne | vṛṣabha: | puṣṭivardhana: | urgata'suce | bhavasi | śravāvya: | ya: | āhutim | pari | veda | varṣaṭ'kṛtim | eka'āyu: | agne | viśam | āvivāsasi ||5||
he vagne vtvaṃ vvṛṣabha: kāmānāṃ varṣitā vpuṣṭivardhana: yajamānasya dhanādipoṣābhivṛddhihetu: vurgatasuce udutatayā sucā yuktāya yajamānāya tadanugrahāthaṃ vśravāvya: mantrai: śravaṇīya: vbhavasi |
vya: yajamāna: vvaṣaṭkṛtiṃ vaṣaṭkārayuktām vāhutiṃ vpari vveda parito jānāti samarpayatītyartha: |
vekāyu: mukhyāgne: tvam vagne prathamaṃ taṃ yajamānaṃ vviśa: tadanukūlā: prajā: vāvivāsasi sarvata: prakāśayasi ||
asmāt utpūrvāt ‘niṣṭhā’ iti kamapratyaye ‘anudāttopadeśa’ ityādinā anunāsikalopa: |
tvamagne vṛjinavartaniṃ naraṃ sakarmaniparṣi vidathe vicarṣaṇe |
ya: śūrasātā paritakamye dhanai dabhrebhiścitsamṛtā haṃsi bhūyasa: ||
tvam | agne | vṛjina'vartanim | naram | sakarman | piparṣi | vidathe | vi'carṣaṇe | ya: | śūra'sātā | pari'takamye | dhanai | dabhrebhi: | cit | sam'ṛtā | haṃsi | bhūyasa: ||6||
he 'vicaṣaṇe viśiṣṭajñānayukta 'agne 'tvaṃ 'vṛjinavartinaṃ viplutamāgaṃ sadācārarahitaṃ 'naraṃ puruṣaṃ 'sakaman sacanīye samavetuṃ yogye 'vidathe karmaṇi 'piparṣi pālayasi pūrayasi vā|
'yaḥ tvaṃ 'paritakamye parito gantavye 'dhane dhanavat śarāṇāṃ priyatame 'śarasātā śaraiḥ saṃbhajanīye yuddhe 'dabhrebhiśrita alpairapi śauryarahitaiḥ puruṣaiḥ|
'samṛtā samyak yoddhuṃ prāse sati tadanugrahārthaṃ 'bhūyasaḥ prauḍhān pratipakṣiṇaḥ śatrūn 'haṃsi mārayasi|
'śuṣicimīnāṃ dīrghaśca' (u. sū. 2. 183) iti śaraśabdo ranpratyayānta ādyudāttaḥ|
'prādayo gatādyarthe prathamāyā' (pā. ma. 2. 2. 18. 4) iti samāse avyayapūrvapadaprakṛtisvaratvam|
hanteḥ sipi 'naścāpadāntasya jhali' (pā. sū. 8. 3. 24) iti anusvāraḥ|
'bahorlopo bhū ca bahoḥ' (pā. sū. 6. 4. 158) iti bahuśabdāt uttarasya īyasunaḥ īkāralopo bahoḥ bhūbhāvaśca|
tvaṃ tama̭gne amṛtatva u॒ttame marta̭ dadhāsi śrava̭se di॒vedi̭ve |
yasta̭tṛṣāṇa u॒bhayā̭ya॒ janma̭ne maryaḥ kṛ॒ṇoṣi॒ praya॒ ā ca॒ sūryai ||
tvam | tam | agne | amṛtatve | uttame | martam | dadhāsi | śravase | divedive | yaḥ | tṛṣāṇaḥ | ubhayāya | janmane | maryaḥ | kṛṇoṣi | prayaḥ | ā | ca | sūryai || 7 ||
he 'agne 'tvaṃ 'taṃ 'mataṃ tathāvidhaṃ tvatsevinaṃ manuṣyaṃ 'divedive pratidinaṃ 'śravase annāthaṃ 'uttame 'amṛtatve utkṛṣṭamaraṇarahite pade 'dadhāsi dhārayasi|
'yaḥ yajamānaḥ 'ubhayāya 'janmane dvividhajanmārthaṃ dvipadāṃ catuṣpadāṃ ce lābhāyetyarthaḥ|
'tatṛṣāṇaḥ atiśayena tṛṣṇāyukto bhavati tasmai 'sūryai abhijñāya yaja- mānāya 'mayaḥ sukhaṃ, 'yadvai sukhaṃ tanmayaḥ' iti śruyantarāt|
tvaṃ no̭ agne॒ suna̭ye॒ dhanā̭nā॒ṃ yaśa̭sa॒ṃ kārṷṃ kṛṇuhi॒ stavā̭naḥ |
ṛ॒dhyāma̭ ka॒rma॒pasā॒ navḙna de॒vyā̭vāpṛthi॒vī prāva̭taṃ naḥ ||
tvam | naḥ | agnḙ | suna̭ye | dhanā̭nām | yaśa̭sam | kārṷm | kṛṇuhi | stavā̭naḥ | ṛ॒dhyāma̭ | ka॒rma | apa̭sā | navḙna | de॒vaiḥ | dyāvā̭pṛthi॒vī iti̭ | pra | a॒va॒tam | naḥ || 8 ||
he vagne vstavānaḥ stūyamānaḥ vtvaṃ vnaḥ asmākaṃ vdhanānāṃ vsamaye dānārthaṃ vyaśasaṃ yaśoyuktaṃ vkāruṃ karmāṇaṃ kartāraṃ putraṃ vkṛṇuhi kuru |
vnavena nūtanena vapasā prāptena vahatena putreṇa vkarma yāgadhā- nādirūpam vṛdhyāma vardhyāma |
he vdyāvāpṛthivī ubhe devate vdevaiḥ anyaiḥ saha vnaḥ asmān vprāvataṃ prakarṣeṇa rakṣatam |
‘ sarvaprātipadikebhyaḥ kvivaktavyaḥ ’ (pā. ma. 3. 1. 11. 3) iti yaśasaśabdāt kvip |
tasya pratyayāntasya sanācantatvāt dhātusaṃjñāyāṃ ‘ kvip ca ’ iti kvippratyayāntadhātoḥ satiśiṣṭatvāt ‘ dhātoḥ ’ ityantodāttatvam |
‘ samyañc stuvaḥ ’ (u. sū. 2. 246) iti bahulavacanāt kevalasyāpi stauteḥ ānacpratyayaḥ |
tvaṃ no̭ agne॒ pi॒tro॒rupa̭stha ā de॒gho de॒veṣva̭navadya॒ jāgṛ̭viḥ |
ta॒nu॒kṛ॒ddhaudhi॒ prama̭tiśca॒ kāra̭ve॒ tvaṃ ka̭lyā॒ṇa va̭su॒ viśva̭mo॒piṣe ||
tvam | naḥ | agnḙ | pi॒troḥ | upa̭'sthe | ā | de॒vaḥ | de॒veṣṷ | a॒na॒va॒dya | jāgṛ̭viḥ | ta॒nu॒'kṛt | bodhi̭ | pra'ma̭tiḥ | ca॒ | kāra̭ve | tvam | ka̭lyā॒ṇa | vasṷ | viśva̭m | ā | ū॒piṣe ||9||

he vanavadya doṣarahita vagne vdeveṣu sarveṣu madhye vjāgṛviḥ jāgarūkaḥ vtvaṃ vpitroḥ mātṛpitṛ- rūpayoḥ(?) dyāvāpṛthivyoḥ vupasthe samīpasthāne vartamānaḥ san vnaḥ asmākaṃ vtanukṛt putrarūpaśarīrakārī bhūtvā vbodhi budhyasva |
tathā vkārave karmakartre yajamānāya vpramatiśca anugraharūpa- prakṛṣṭamatiyuktaśca bhaveti śeṣaḥ |
he vkalyāṇa maṅgalarūpa agne vtvaṃ vviśvaṃ vvasu sarvamapi dhanam vopiṣe yajamānārthamāvapasi |
‘ supi sthaḥ ’ (pā. sū. 3. 2. 4) iti tiṣṭhateḥ kaḥ pratyayaḥ |
‘ āto lopa iṭi ca ’ iti ākāralopaḥ |
‘ vā chandasi ’ iti heḥ apittvasya vikalpitatvena pittvāt aṅisve sati ‘ aṅitaśca ’ (pā. sū. 6. 4. 103) iti herlugādeśaḥ |

śchāndasaḥ | pramatiḥ | ‘mana jñāne’ | ktini ‘anudāttapadaṃ’ ityādinā anunāsikalopaḥ | prakṛṣṭā matiḥ yasyeti bahuvrīhau pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaratvam | upiṣe | ‘ḍuvap bījasantāne’ | chāndase liṭi ‘thāsaḥ se’ | ‘vacisvapi0’ ityādinā saṃprasāraṇapūrvatve | dvirbhāvahlādiśeṣau | krādiniyamāt ida ||
tvama̭gne॒ prama̭ti॒stvaṃ pi॒tāsi̭ nu॒stvaṃ va̭ya॒skṛttava̭ jā॒mayo̭ va॒yam |
saṃ tvā̭ rā॒yaḥ śa॒tina̭: saṃ sa॒hasri̭ṇaḥ su॒vīra̭ṃ yanti॒ vrata̭pāmadābhya ||
tvam | agne | pra'matiḥ | tvam | pitā | asi | naḥ | tvam | vayaḥ'kṛt | tava | jāmayaḥ | vayam | sam | tvā | rāyaḥ | śatinaḥ | sam | sahasriṇaḥ | su'vīram | yanti | vrata'pām | adābhya || 10 ||
tathā tvaṃ naḥ asmākaṃ pitā pālakaḥ |
he adābhya kenāpi ahiṃsanīya agne suvīraṃ śobhanapuruṣayuktaṃ vratapāṃ karmaṇaḥ pālakaṃ tvāṃ śatinaḥ śatasaṃkhyāyuktāḥ rāyaḥ dhanāni saṃ yanti samyak prāpnuvanti |
tathā sahasriṇaḥ sahasrasaṃkhyākāḥ rāyaḥ saṃ yanti |
bahuvrīhau ‘nañsubhyām’ ityuttarapadāntodāttatve prāpte ‘vīravīryau ca’ (pā. sū. 6. 2. 120 ) ityuttarapadādyudāttatvam |
tvām | agne | prathamam | āyum | āyave | devāḥ | akṛṇvan | nahuṣasya | viśaḥ'patim | iḻām | akṛṇvan | manuṣasya | śāsanīm | pituḥ | yat | putraḥ | mama | kasya | jāyate || 11 ||
he agne tvāṃ prathamaṃ purā devāḥ āyave āyoḥ manuṣyarūpasya nahuṣasya etannāmakarāna- viśeṣasya āyuṃ manuṣyarūpaṃ viśaspatiṃ senāpatim akṛṇvan kṛtavantaḥ |
tathā manuṣasya manoḥ iḻām etannāmadheyāṃ putrīṃ śāsanīṃ dharmopadeśakartrīm akṛṇvan kṛtavantaḥ |
tathā ca taittirīyabrāhmaṇādyate—‘iḍā vai mānavī yajñajñākāśinyāsīt’ (tai. brā. 1. 1. 4. 4) iti |
vājasaneyino'pyevamāmananti— ‘prajāanuyājānāṃ madhye māmavakalpaya mayā sarvānavāpsyasi kāmāniti sā manumanśāditi yat jñāt’ iti |
yat yadā mama kasya madīyasya hiraṇyastūpasaṃbandhinaḥ yaḥ pitā aṅgirāḥ tasya pituḥ putraḥ jāyate |
tadānīṃ he agne tvameva putrarūpa āsiriti śeṣaḥ ||
1. jha-sa- ‘yat śāt’ iti nāsti | ḍha-bandhane | tasmāt | 2. ca-cha-jha-na-pha-śa-ṣa-ha- bāhulakāddvayabhāvaḥ | pūrvapadādyudāttatvam |
mamedamityarthe ‘tasyedam’ (pā. sū. 4. 3. 120) iti aṇi ‘tavaka mamakāvekavacane’ (pā. sū. 4. 3. 3) iti asmacchabdasya mamakādeśaḥ |
tvaṃ nau agne tarva deva pāyubhirmaghonoṃ rakṣa turvaśca vandya |
trātā tokasya tanaye gavāmasyanimeṣaṃ rakṣamāṇastava vrate ||
tvam | naḥ | agne | tarva | deva | pāyubhiḥ | maghonaḥ | rakṣa | turvaḥ | ca | vandya | trātā | tokasya | tanaye | gavām | asi | animeṣam | rakṣamāṇaḥ | tava | vrate || 12 ||
he ᵥvandya vandanīya ᵥagne ᵥdeva ᵥtvaṃ ᵥtava ᵥpāyubhiḥ tvadīyaiḥ pālanaiḥ ᵥmaghonaḥ dhanayuktān ᵥnaḥ asmān ᵥrakṣa |
ᵥtokasya asmadīyasya putrasya yaḥ tanayo'sma- tautrādiḥ ᵥtava ᵥvrate tvadīye karmaṇi ᵥanimeṣaṃ nirantaraṃ ᵥrakṣamāṇaḥ sāvadhāno vartate tasmin yā gāvaḥ santi tāsāṃ ᵥgavāṃ ᵥtrātā rakṣakaḥ ᵥasi |
śasi hi ‘udāttayaṇe halpūrvāt’ iti vibhaktyudāttatvaṃ syāt ||
tvamagne yajyave pāyu rantaroṃ'niṣajñāya caturakṣa īdhyase |
yo rātahavyo'vṛkāya dhāryase kīreścinmantraṃ manasā vanoṣi tam ||
tvam | agne | yajyave | pāyuḥ | antaraḥ | aniṣajñāya | catuḥ | akṣaḥ | īdhyase | yaḥ | rātahavyaḥ | avṛkāya | dhāryase | kīreḥ | cit | mantram | manasā | vanoṣi | tam || 13 ||

he ᵥagne ᵥtvaṃ ᵥyajyave yajyaḥ ᵥyajamānasya ᵥpāyuḥ pālakaḥ ᵥantaraḥ samīpavartī san ᵥaniṣajñāya rakṣobhirasaṃbaddhāya yajñāya ᵥcaturakṣaḥ dikṣu catuṣṭaye'pi indriyasthānīyajvālāyuktaḥ ᵥīdhyase dīpyase |

ᵥavṛkāya ahiṃsakāya ᵥdhāyase poṣakāya tubhyaṃ ᵥrātahavyaḥ dattahaviṣkaḥ ᵥyaḥ yajamāno'sti ᵥkīre- śrita stotureva sata: tasya saṃbandhanaṃ ᵥmantraṃ ᵥtvadīyastotrarūpaṃ ᵥmanasā tvadīyena cittena ᵥvanoṣi yācasi ||
na vidyate nipajño'syeti bahuvrīhau ‘nañsubhyām’ ityuttarapadāntodātta- tvam |

hābhābhyaśchandasi' iti asun | 'ṇit' ityanuvṛtteḥ 'āto yuk ciṇkṛtoḥ' iti sugāgamaḥ | kīreḥ | 'kṛta saṃśadane' | asmāt ṇyantāt 'aca haḥ' iti ipratyaye ṇilope dhātoranyalopaśchandasaḥ | mantram | 'matri guptabhāṣaṇe' | pacādyaci vṛṣādiṣu pāṭhādādyudāttatvam | vanoṣi | 'vanu yācane' | 'tanādikṛbhya uḥ' | pratyayasvaraḥ ||
tvama̭gra॒ urṷśaṃsāya॒ vāgha̭te॒ spāha̭ṃ ya॒drekṇa̭: pa॒raṃ va॒noṣi̭ ta॒t |
ādha̭sya॒ ci॒tprama̭ti॒rucya̭se pi॒tā pra pā॒kaṃ śā̭ssi॒ pra di॒śau vi॒duṣṭa̭raḥ ||
tvam | agne | uru'śaṃsāya | vāghate | spāham | yat | rekṇaḥ | paramam | vanoṣi | tat | ādhasya | cit | pra'matiḥ | ucyase | pitā | pra | pākam | śāssi | pra | diśau | viduḥ'taraḥ ||14||
he 'agne 'tvam 'uruśaṃsāya bahubhiḥ stotravyāya 'vāghate ṛtvije tadupakārārthaṃ 'spāhaṃ spṛhaṇīyaṃ 'paramam uttamaṃ 'yadrekṇaḥ dhanamasti 'tat dhanaṃ 'vanoṣi anuṣṭhātā labhatām iti kāmayase |
tathā 'tvam 'ādhasya 'cit sarvato dhāraṇīyasya popaṇīyasya durbalasya yajamānasyāpi 'pramatiḥ prakṛṣṭabuddhiyuktaḥ 'pitā pālakaḥ ityabhijñaiḥ 'ucyase |
tathā ca śrūyate-'devā vai devayajana- madhyavasāya diśo na prājānan' iti |
tadapi tatraivāmnātaṃ- 'panthāṃ svastiyamayan prācīmeva tayā diśaṃ prājānannagninā dakṣiṇā' (tai. saṃ. 6. 1. 5. 1-2) iti |
aitareyiṇāpi tathaivāmnātam-'atho etaṃ varamavṛṇīta mayaiva prācīṃ diśaṃ prājānāthāgninā dakṣi- ṇām' (ai. brā. 1. 7) iti ||
pākaṃ ca praśāssi diśaśca praśāssi ityatra cārtho gamyate |
viducchabdāt tarapi 'ayasmādīni chandasi' (pā. sū. 1. 4. 20) iti bhasaṃjñāyāṃ 'vasoḥ samprasāraṇam' iti samprasāraṇaṃ parapūrvatvam |
tarapaḥ pittvādanudāttatve vasoḥ svareṇa ukāra udāttaḥ ||
tvamagne praytadakṣiṇaṃ naraṃ vaṃrmaiva syūtaṃ pari pāsi viśvataḥ |
svādukṣmā yo vasaṃtau syonakṛjjīvayājaṃ yarjate sopamā divaḥ ||
tvam | agne | prayta'dakṣiṇam | naram | vaṃrma'iva | syūtam | pari | pāsi | viśvataḥ | svādu'kṣmā | yaḥ | vasaṃtau | syona'kṛt | jīva'yājam | yarjate | saḥ | upa'mā | divaḥ ||15||
he 'gne tvaṃ 'prayatadakṣiṇaṃ yena yajamānena ṛtvigbhyo dakṣiṇā dattā tādṛśaṃ 'naraṃ puruṣaṃ yajamānaṃ 'viśvataḥ 'sarvataḥ 'pari 'pāsa sambak pālayasi |
'syūtaṃ niśchidratvena sūcībhiḥ samyak niṣpāditaṃ 'varmaiva yathā kavacaṃ yuddhe pālayati tadvat |

'svādukṣmā svā'kṣmāḥ 'vasaṃtau nivāsabhūte svagṛhe 'syonakṛt atithīnāṃ sukhakārī 'yaḥ yajamānaḥ 'jīvayājaṃ jīvajanasahitaṃ yajñaṃ yadvā jīvananiṣpādyaṃ 'yajate anutiṣṭhati 'saḥ yajamānaḥ 'divaḥ svargasya 'upamā dṛṣṭānto bhavati |
yathā svargo'nuṣṭhātṛn sukha- yati tathā tvamapi ṛtvigādīnityarthaḥ ||
‘ chvoḥ śūḍanunāsike ca ’ (pā. sū. 6. 4. 19) iti vakārasya ūḍādeśaḥ |
jīvāḥ ṛtvijaḥ ijyante dakṣiṇābhiḥ pūjyante atreti adhikaraṇe ghañ |
‘ ṇeraniṭī ’ iti ṇilopasya ‘ acaḥ parasmin ’ iti sthānivadbhā- vāt ‘ cajoḥ ku ghiṇṇyatoḥ ’ iti kutvābhāvaḥ |
‘ so'ci lope cetpādapūraṇam ’ iti saṃhitāyāṃ sorlopaḥ |
‘ imāmagne ’ ityanayā anāhitāgniḥ ātvijyaṃ kṛtvā svāmāvāhutiṃ juhuyāt |
‘ ṛtvijo vṛṇīte ’ iti khaṇḍe ‘ evamanāhitāmirgṛhā imāmagne śaraṇi mīmṛṣo naḥ ’ (āśva. gṛ. 1. 23. 23) iti sūtritam ||
imāmagne śaraṇi mīmṛṣo na imadhvānaṃ yamagāma dūrāt |
āpiḥ pitā pramatiḥ somyānāṃ bhūmirasyṛṣi kṛnmatyānām ||
imām | agne | śaraṇim | mīmṛṣaḥ | naḥ | imam | adhvānam | yam | agama | dūrāt | āpiḥ | pitā | 'pramatiḥ | somyānām | bhūmiḥ | asi | ṛṣi'kṛt | matyānām ||16||
he 'agne tvaṃ 'naḥ asmatsambandhinīm 'imām idānīm saṃpāditāṃ 'śaraṇiṃ hiṃsāṃ vrataloparūpāṃ 'mīmṛṣaḥ kṣamasva |
tathā tvadīyasevāṃ agnihotrādirūpāṃ parityajya 'dūrāt dūradeśaṃ 'yam 'imadhvānam 'agāma vayaṃ gatavantaḥ tamapi kṣamasveti śeṣaḥ |
āpiḥ prāpaṇīyaḥ pitā pālakaḥ pramatiḥ prakṛṣṭamananayuktaḥ bhramiḥ āmakaḥ karmanirvāhaka ityarthaḥ|
asmāt ṇī caḍi guṇe prāpte ‘ nityaṃ chandasi ’ (pā. sū. 7. 4. 8) iti upadhākārasya ṛkārādeśaḥ|
‘ iṇo gā luṅi ’ (pā. sū. 2. 4. 45) iti gādeśaḥ|
‘ ameḥ saṃprasāraṇaṃ ca ’ (u. sū. 4. 560) iti inpratyayaḥ|
accha̭ yā॒hā va॒hā daivya॒ṃ jana॒mā sā̭daya ba॒rhiṣi॒ yakṣi̭ ca pri॒yam ||
manu॒vat | agnḙ | aṅgira̭svat | aṅgira̭ḥ | yayāti̭'vat | sa॒danḙ | pūrva̭'vat | śu॒ce | accha̭ | yā॒hi | ā | va॒ha | daivya̭m | jana̭m | ā | sā॒daya̭ | ba॒rhiṣi̭ | yakṣi̭ | ca | pri॒yam || 17 ||
he śuce śuddhiyukta aṅgiraḥ aṅganaśīla havirādānāya tatra tatra gamanaśīla agne accha ābhi- mukhyena sadane devayajanadeśe yāhi gaccha|
manuvat yathā manuḥ anuṣṭhānadeśe gacchati, aṅgirasvat yathā ca aṅgirāḥ gacchati, yayātivat yathā yayātirnāma rājā gacchati, pūrvavat anye ca pūrvapuruṣāḥ yathā gacchanti|
athavā manvādīnāṃ yajñe yathā tvaṃ gacchasi tadvat|
gatvā ca daivyaṃ devatasamūha rūpaṃ janam ā vaha asmin karmaṇi ānaya|
ānīya ca barhiṣi āstīrṇe darbhe ā sādaya tān devān upaveśaya|
upaveśya ca priyam abhīṣṭaṃ haviḥ yakṣi ca dehi ||
‘ tena tulyam ’ iti prathamārye vā ‘ tatra tasyeva ’ iti ṣaṣṭhyarthe vā vatiḥ (pā. sū. 5. 1. 115-116)|
loṭi ‘ bahulaṃ chandasi ’ iti śapo luk|
sāmidhayane ṛtau ukhāsaṃbharaṇīyāyām iṣṭau agnerbrahmaṇavataḥ puronuvākyā ‘ etenāgne ’ ityeṣā|
‘ darśapūrṇamāsābhyāmiṣṭā ’ iti khaṇḍe ‘ etenāgne brahmaṇā vāvṛdhasva brahma ca te jātavedo namaśca ’ (āśva. śrau. 4. 1) iti sūtritam ||
etenā̭gne॒ brahma̭ṇā vāvṛdhasva śa॒ktī vā॒ yattai̭ cakṛ॒mā vi॒dā vā̭ |
u॒ta pra̭ ṇeṣi॒bhirva̭syo॒ asma̭ntsa na॒ḥ sṛja॒ su॒matyā॒ vāja̭vatyā ||

etena̭ | agnḙ | brahma̭ṇā | vā॒vṛ॒dha॒sva॒ | śa॒ktī | vā॒ | yat | te॒ | ca॒kṛ॒ma | vi॒dā | vā॒ | u॒ta | pra | ne॒ṣi॒ | a॒bhi | va॒sya̭ḥ | a॒smān | sam | na॒ḥ | sṛ॒ja॒ | su॒'ma॒tyā | vāja̭'vatyā || 18 ||
he ᵛame ᵛitena asmatprayuktena ᵛbrahmaṇā mantreṇa ᵛvadhrava ᵛabhibṛddho bhava |
ᵛśaktī ᵛvā ᵛvidā ᵛvā asmadīyaśaktyā ca asmadīyajñānena ca ᵛte tava ᵛyat stotraṃ ᵛcakram vayaṃ kṛtavantaḥ |
ᵛuta api ca ᵛasmān anuṣṭhātṛn ᵛvasyaḥ vasuttaratvalakṣaṇaṃ śreyaḥ ᵛpra ᵛṇeṣi prakarṣeṇa prāpaya |
ᵛnaḥ asmān ᵛvājavatyā prabhṛtāyuktayā ᵛsumatyā anuṣṭhānaviṣayayā śobhanabuddhyā ᵛsaṃ ᵛsṛja saṃyojaya ||
‘ mankkin ’ ityādinottarapadāntodāttatvaṃ prathamādhyāye prapañcitam ( ṛ. saṃ. 1. 7. 7 ) |
‘ indrasya nu vīryāṇi ’ iti pañcadaśarcaṃ dvitīyaṃ sūktam |
agniṣṭome mādhyaṃdine savane nikevalya- śastre ‘ indrasya nu vīryāṇi ’ iti nividdhānīyaṃ sūktam |
‘ nikevalyasya ’ iti khaṇḍe ‘ indrasya nu vīryāṇītyetasminnaindrī nividaṃ dadhyāt ’ ( āśva. śrau. 5. 15 ) iti |
‘ viṣuvāndivā kīrtyaḥ ’ iti khaṇḍe sūtritam— ‘ indrasya nu vīryāṇīti etasminnaindrī nividaṃ śastvā ’ ( āśva. śrau. 8. 6 ) iti |
‘ rathantaro dakṣiṇaḥ pakṣaḥ ’ iti khaṇḍe ‘ catasraḥ satīḥ ṣaḍ bṛhatīḥ karotīndrasya nu vīryāṇi pra vocam ’ ( ai. ā. 5. 2. 2 ) iti ||
indrasya nu vīryāṇi pra vocaṃ yāni cakāra prathamārni vajrī |
indrasya | nu | vīryāṇi | pra | vocam | yāni | cakāra | prathamārni | vajrī | ahan | ahim | anu | apaḥ | tatarda | pra | vṛkṣaṇāḥ | abhinat | parvatānām || 1 ||
ᵛvajrī vajrayuktaḥ indraḥ ᵛprathamārni pūrvasiddhāni mukhyāni vā ᵛyāni ᵛvīryāṇi parākramayuktāni karmāṇi ᵛcakāra tasya ᵛindrasya tāni ᵛvīryāṇi ᵛnu kṣipraṃ prabravīmi |
ᵛanu paścāt ᵛapaḥ jalāni ᵛtatarda hiṃsitavān bhūmau pātitavānityarthaḥ |
ᵛparvatānāṃ saṃbandhinīḥ ᵛvṛkṣaṇāḥ pravahanaśīlāḥ nadīḥ ᵛpra ᵛabhinat bhinnavān kūladvayakarṣaṇena pravāhitavānityarthaḥ |
ādyudāttatve hi suṣādena bahuvrīhau ‘ ādyudāttaṃ cchandasi ’ ityanenaivottarapadādyudāttatvasya siddhatvāt ‘ vīravīryau ca ’ iti punastadvidhānamanarthakaṃ syāt |
ato'vagamyate ‘ yato'nāvaḥ ’ ityādyudāttatvaṃ vīraśabde na pravartate

‘suparṇaḥ śobhanapatanaḥ sūryasya raśmiḥ | ‘suparṇo’ iti pañcadaśa raśmināmāni’ (ni. 1. 5. 15) iti tannāmasu paṭhitatvāt | ‘antarikṣāṇi antarikṣopalakṣitāni lokatrayasthānāni ‘vi ‘akhyat viśve- ṣeṇa khyāpitavān prakāśitavān | kīdṛśo raśmiḥ | ‘gabhīravepāḥ gambhīrakampanaḥ | raśmeḥ prakampanaṃ calanaṃ kenāpi draṣṭumaśakyamityarthaḥ | ‘asuraḥ sarveṣāṃ prāṇadaḥ | tathā cānyatrāgnāyate—‘sarveṣāṃ bhūtānāṃ prāṇā- nādyāyodeti’ (tai. ā. 1. 14. 1) iti | ‘sunīthaḥ sunayanaḥ śobhanaprāpaṇaḥ | mārgaprakāśanena abhīṣṭa- deśaṃ prāpayatītyarthaḥ | tādṛśaraśmiyuktaḥ ‘sūryaḥ ‘idānīṃ rātrau ‘ka kutra vartate | tadetadrahasyaṃ ‘kaściketa ko jānāti | na ko'pītyarthaḥ | ‘asya sūryasya ‘raśmiḥ ‘katamāṃ ‘dyām ‘ā ‘tatāna ca dyulokaṃ rātrau vyāptavān | etadapi ko jānāti || suparṇaḥ | ‘nañsubhyām’ ityuttarapadāntodāttatvam | gabhīravepāḥ | ‘duveṣṭra kampane’ | asun | gabhīraṃ vepo yasya | pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaratvam | asuraḥ | ‘asu kṣepaṇe’ | asyati śatrūna ityasuraḥ | ‘aseruran’ (u. sū. 1. 42) | nittvādādyudāttatvam | yadvā | asūn prāṇān rāti dadātītyasuraḥ | ‘āto'nupasarge kaḥ’ iti kapratyayaḥ | ‘sunīthaḥ | ‘ṇīñ prāpaṇe’ | ‘hanikuṣi- nīramikāśibhyaḥ kyan’ (u. sū. 2. 159) iti kyan | prādisamāse thāthādinā uttarapadānto- dāttatvam | idānīm | idaṃśabdāt saptamyarthe ‘dānīṃ ca’ (pā. sū. 5. 3. 18) iti dānīṃpratyayaḥ | ‘idam iś’ iti idaṃśabdasya iśādeśaḥ | pratyayādyudāttatvam | sūryaḥ | ‘pū preraṇe’ | suvatīti sūryaḥ | ‘rājasūyasūrye’ ityādinā ruḍāgamasahitaḥ kyappratyayo nipātitaḥ | pratyayasyādyudāttatve dhātu- svareṇādyudāttatvam | ciketa | ‘kita jñāne’ | liṭ | katamāṃ kiṃjātīyām | ‘vā bahūnāṃ jātiparipraśne ḍatamac’ (pā. sū. 5. 3. 93) iti kiṃśabdāt ḍatamac | ḍittvāt ṭilopaḥ | ‘citaḥ’ itya- ntodāttatvam ||

devānāmagre'dhikasvena kathaya ca || panyāḥ | ‘supāṃ suluk’ iti jasaḥ suḥ | ‘pathimaśrauḥ sarvanāma- sthāne’ ityādyudāttatvam | pūryāṃsaḥ | pūrvaiḥ kṛtāḥ pūryāḥ | ‘pūrvaiḥ kṛtaminiyau ca’ (pā. sū. 4. 4. 133) iti yaḥ | pratyayasvaraḥ | asugāgamaḥ | areṇavaḥ | ‘nansubhyām’ ityuttarapadantodāttatvam | sukṛtāḥ | karmaṇi ktaḥ | ‘gatiranantaraḥ’ iti gateḥ prakṛtisvaratvam | sugebhiḥ | suṣṭhu gacchantyeṣbiti sugāḥ | ‘suduroradhikaraṇe’ (pā. sū. 3. 2. 48. 3) iti gamerḍapratyayaḥ | kuduttarapadaprakṛtisvaratvam | rakṣa | ‘vyo'tastiṅaḥ’ iti saṃhitāyāṃ dīrghaḥ || 7 || || 7 ||
tatra ‘pra vo yahvam’ iti viṃśatyṛcaṃ prathamaṃ sūktam |
tathā cānukrānte—‘pra vo viṃśatiḥ kaṇvo ghaura āgneyaṃ prāgātmūrdhva ū pu yaupyau’ iti |
nanu ‘ūrdhva ū pu’ ityādikayorapyagnidevatātvena bhavitavyamāgneye kratau anayoranuddhārāt |
tathā hi sūtre ‘enā vo agniṃ pra vo yahvam’ (āśva. śrau. 4. 13) iti pratīkamātrasyaivopādānāt kṛtsnasūktamāgneyamiti gamyate |
yacete anyadevatye syātāṃ ‘vasipvā hīti sūktoruttamāmuddharet’ (āśva. śrau. 4. 13) itivitat uddhāraṃ brūyāt |
yūpādhiṣṭhānasyāgneḥ stūyamānatvāt anayorapi agnidevatā ityāgneye kratau uddhāro na kṛtaḥ |
prātaranuvāke āgneye kratau bārhate chandasi ‘pra vo yahvam’ iti sūktam |
‘athaitasyā rātrervivāsakāle’ iti khaṇḍe sūtritam— ‘enā vo agniṃ pra vo yahvam’ iti ||

devāsa̭stvā varṷṇo mi॒tro a̭rya॒mā saṃ dūtaṃ pratnami̭ndhate | viśva̭ṃ so a॒gne ja̭yati॒ tvayā॒ dhana॒ṃ yastai̭ dadāśa॒ martya̭ḥ || 4 || devāsa̭ḥ | tvā | varṷṇaḥ | mi॒traḥ | a̭rya॒mā | sam | dūtam | pratnam | i॒ndhate | viśva̭m | saḥ | a॒gne | ja̭yati | tvayā̭ | dhana̭m | yaḥ | te | dadāśa | martya̭ḥ || 4 || he 'gne varuṇādayastvayaḥ 'devāsaḥ devāḥ 'pratnaṃ purātanaṃ 'dūtaṃ tvāṃ 'sam 'indhate samyak dīpayanti 'yaḥ 'martyaḥ manuṣyo yajamānaḥ 'te tubhyaṃ 'dadāśa havirdattavān 'saḥ yajamānaḥ 'tvayā sahāyabhūtane 'viśvaṃ sarvaṃ 'dhanaṃ 'jayati || aryamā | aryānmimīte ityaryamā | ‘ śṛṇuṣva 0 ’ (u. sū. 1. 157) ityādinā kaninpratyayānto nipātitaḥ | indhate | ‘ jindhī dīsau ’ | asmāt laṭi jhasya adādeśe bham | ‘ ābhalopaḥ ’ (pā. sū. 6. 4. 23) | ‘ bhasoralopaḥ ’ iti akāralopaḥ | dadāśa | ‘ dāśva dāne ’ | liṭi ṇali lisasvareṇa pratyayātpūrvasya ākārasyodāttatvam | yadvṛttayogādanighātaḥ ||

mandro hotā̭ gṛ॒hapa̭ti॒rdūtoṃ vi॒śāṃma̭si | tve vi॒śvā sa̭ṃga॒tāni॒ vratā̭ dhru॒vā yā̭ni de॒vā a̭kṛṇvata || 5 || mandra̭ḥ | hotā̭ | gṛ॒ha'pa̭tiḥ | a॒gne | dūta̭ḥ | vi॒śām | a॒si | tve | vi॒śvā | sa̭m'ga॒tāni | vratā̭ | dhru॒vā | yā̭ni | de॒vāḥ | a̭kṛṇvata || 5 || he 'gne tvaṃ 'mandraḥ harṣahetuḥ 'hotā devānāmāhvātā 'viśāṃ yajamānarūpāṇāṃ prajānāṃ 'gṛhapatiḥ gṛhasya pālakaḥ 'dūtaḥ devadūtaḥ 'asi | 'tve tvayi 'viśvā vratā sarvāṇi karmāṇi 'saṃgatāni | ‘ vrataṃ karvaram ’ (ni. 2. 1. 7) iti karmanāmasu vrataśabdaḥ paṭhitaḥ | pṛthivyādayaḥ 'devāḥ 'dhruvā sthirāṇi 'yāni karmāṇi 'akṛṇvata kṛtavantaḥ | pṛthivī dhārayati parjanyo varṣati sūryaḥ prakāśayati | tānyetāni tvayi saṃgatānīti pūrvatrānvayaḥ || gṛhapatiḥ | ‘ patyāvaiśvaryaṃ ’ iti pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaratvam | ‘ supāṃ suluk ’ iti sasabhyekavacanasya śeṣādeśaḥ | ‘ tvamāvekavacane ’ iti maparyantasya tvādeśaḥ | ‘ śeṣe lopaḥ ’ iti ṭilopakṣe udāttanivṛttisvareṇa vibhakterudāttatvam; anyalopapakṣe tu ekādeśasvareṇa | saṃgatāni | gameḥ karmaṇi niṣṭhāyām ‘ ekācaḥ 0 ’ (pā. sū. 7. 2. 10) iti iṭpratiṣedhaḥ | ‘ anudāttopadeśa 0 ’ ityādinā anunāsikalopaḥ | ‘ gatiranantaraḥ ’ iti gateḥ prakṛtisvaratvam | vratā dhruvā ityubhayatra śelaupaḥ | akṛṇvata | ‘ kṛvi hiṃsākaraṇayośca ’ | vyatyayenātmanepadam | idittvāt num | ‘ dhinvikṛṇvyora ca ’ iti upratyayaḥ || || 8 ||

he yaviṣṭha yuvatama agne subhage saubhāgyayukte tve it tvayyeva viśvaṃ sarvaṃ haviḥ ā hūyate sarvataḥ prakṣipyate |

sa tvaṃ naḥ asmānprati sumanāḥ śobhanamanasko bhūtvā atha asmin dine uta api ca aparaṃ śvaḥ paraśca ityādikamuttaraṃ kālaṃ sarvasminnapi kāle nairantaryeṇa suvīryā śobhanavīryopetān devān yakṣi yaja |
‘ sthūladūra ’ ityādinā yaṇādeḥ parasya lopaḥ pūrvasya ca guṇaḥ |
abhiṣṭave sāyaṃkālīne uttarasmin paṭale ‘ taṃ ghemithā namasvinaḥ ’ ityeṣā viniyuktā |
‘ atho- ttaram ’ iti khaṇḍe sūtritaṃ- ‘ prāgāthīṃ pūrvāhṇe kāṇvīmaparāhṇe ’ ( āśva. śrau. 4. 7 ) iti |
hotrābhirrgni manuṣaḥ sarmindhate titirvāṃso ati sirdhaḥ ||
tam | gha | īm | itthā | namasvinaḥ | upa | svarāja̭m | āsate | hotrābhiḥ | agnim | manuṣaḥ | sam | indhate | titirvāṃsaḥ | ati | sirdhaḥ || 7 ||
he agne namasvinaḥ abhyayuktā namaskārayuktā vā |
‘ namaḥ āyuḥ sūnṛtā ’ ( ni. 2. 7. 22 ) iti annanāmasu pāṭhāt namaḥśabdasyānnavācitvam |
tādṛśā yajamānāḥ svarājaṃ svatau dīpyamānaṃ taṃ ghe tameva pūrvoktasarvaguṇaviśiṣṭaṃ tvām itthā anena prakāreṇa haviṣpradānādirūpeṇa upa āsate |
‘ sapta hotrāḥ prācīrvaṣaṭkurvanti ’ ( tai.brā.2.3.6.4 ) iti śruyantarāt |
sirdhaḥ śatrūn ati titirvāṃsaḥ atiśayena tarantaḥ |
‘ hali ca ’ ( pā. sū. 8. 2. 77 ) iti dīrghatvaṃ ca na bhavati, ‘ saṃjñāpūrvako vidhiranityaḥ ’ iti tayoranityatvāt |
ghnanto vṛtramata̭rannodasī apa uru kṣayāya cakrire |
ghnantaḥ | vṛtram | ataran | rodasī iti | apaḥ | uru | kṣayāya | cakrire | bhuvat | kaṇve | vṛṣā | dyumnī | ā'hutaḥ | krandat | ardhaḥ | go'iṣṭiṣu || 8 ||
he agne ᵛhanta: ᵛsvasmāyanetare devā: praharanta: ᵛvṛtram ᵛataran tīrṇavantaḥ |
tadanantaraṃ ᵛrodasī dyāvāpṛthivyau ᵛapa: antarikṣaṃ ca ᵛkṣayāya prāṇināṃ nivāsārtham ᵛuru vistāro yathā bhavati tathā ᵛcakre |
bhavāṃstu ᵛkaṇve kaṇvanāmake mahapau ᵛvṛpā kāmānāṃ varṣitā ᵛdyumnī dhanavān ᵛāhutaḥ sarvato homayuktaśca ᵛbhuvat bhavatu |
ᵛgaviṣṭheṣu govipayecchāyukteṣu saṃgrāmeṣu ᵛaśva: ᵛkrandat śabdaṃ kurvan yathā- bhīṣṭaprāpakastatheti śeṣa: ||
‘ ho hante- ṣṇimeṣu’ (pā. sū. 7. 3. 54) iti ghatvam |
pravarye mahāvīre khare saṃsādyamāne ‘saṃ sīdasva mahā~ asi’ ityeṣā |
‘saṃ sīdasva mahā~ asi saṃsādyamāne’ (āśva. śrau. 4. 6) iti ||
saṃ sīdasva mahā~ asi śorcasva devavītamaḥ |
vi dhūmamagne aruṣaṃ miyedhya suja praśasta darśitam ||
sam | sīdasva | mahān | asi | śorcasva | devavītama: | vi | dhūmam | agne | aruṣam | miyedhya | suja | pra'śasta | darśitam || 9 ||

he agne ᵛsaṃ ᵛsīdasva barhiṣyupaviśa | ᵛmahān ᵛasi guṇādhiko bhavasi | ᵛdevavītama: ati- śayena devān kāmayamāna: ᵛśocasva dīpyasva | he ᵛmiyedhya medhārha ᵛpraśasta utkṛṣṭa ᵛagne ᵛarupaṃ gamana- śīlaṃ ᵛdarśitaṃ darśanīyaṃ ᵛdhūmaṃ ᵛvi ᵛsaja viśeṣeṇa saṃpādaya || sīdasva | ‘palū viśaraṇagatyavasādaneṣu’ | vyatyaye- nātmanepadam | prārthanāyāṃ loṭi śapi ‘pāghrā’ ityādinā sīdādeśa: | mahān | saṃhitāyāṃ nakārākā- rayo: hravānunāsikāvuktau | śocasva | ‘śuca dīptau’ | adupadeśāt lasārvadhātukānudāttatve dhātusvara: | tiṅa: paratvāt nighātābhāva: | devavītama: | ‘vī gatiprajanakāntyaśanakhādaneṣu’ | devān vetti gacchatīti devavī: | ‘kvip ca’ iti kvip | atiśayena devavīrdevavītama: | tamapa: pittvādanudāttatve kṛduttara- padaprakṛtisvaratvam | arupam aropaṇam | ‘ripa rūpa hiṃsāyām’ | ‘ghañarthe kavidhānam’ iti bhāve kapratyaya: | nāsti rūpo'syeti bahuvrīhau ‘nañsubhyām’ ityuttarapadāntodāttatvam | miyedhya | ‘chandasi ca’ iti aharthe yapratyaya: | makārāntara: iyāgamaśchāndasa: | suja | ‘suja visarge’ | tudāditvāt śa: | vikaraṇasvara: | pādāditvādanighāta: | darśitam | ‘mṛdaśa’ ityādinā dṛśe: karmaṇi atacpratyaya: ||

yaṃ tvā̭ de॒vāso॒ mana̭ve dadhu॒riha॒ yaji̭ṣṭhaṃ ha॒vyavā̭hana | yaṃ ka॒ṇvo me॒dhyāti̭thirdha॒naspṛ̭ta॒ṃ yaṃ vṛ॒ṣā॒ yamṷpastutaḥ || 10 || yam | tvā | de॒vāsa̭ḥ | mana̭ve | dadhuḥ | i॒ha | yaji̭ṣṭham | ha॒vya'vā̭hana | yam | ka॒ṇvaḥ | me॒dhya'a̭tithiḥ | dha॒na'spṛ̭tam | yam | vṛ॒ṣā | yam | u॒pa'stṷtaḥ || 10 ||
he havyavāhana havipo vāhakāgne manave manoranugrahāya devāsaḥ sarve devāḥ yajiṣṭham atiśayena pūjyaṃ yaṣṭatamaṃ vā yaṃ tvām iha devajanadeśe dadhuḥ dhṛtavantaḥ |
medhyātithiḥ medhāhḙratithibhiryuktaḥ kaṇvaḥ etannāmako maharṣiḥ yaṃ tvāṃ dhanaspṛtaṃ dhanena prīṇayitāraṃ kṛtvā dadhe iti śeṣaḥ |
tathā vṛṣā indraḥ yaṃ tvāṃ dadhe |
tathā upastutaḥ anyo'pi stotā yajamāno yaṃ tvāṃ dadhe |
liṭi usi kitve ‘āto lopa iṭi ca’ iti ākāralopaḥ |
yaṣṭaśabdāt ‘tucchandasi’ (pā. sū. 5. 3. 59) iti aguṇavacanādapi ātiśāyanika ichan |

ya॒magniṃ me॒dhyāti̭thiḥ ka॒ṇva i̭dha ṛ॒tādadhi̭ | tasya॒ preṣo̭ dī॒di॒yustami̭mā ṛ॒castama॒gniṃ va̭rdhayāmāsi || 11 || yam | a॒gnim | me॒dhya'a̭tithiḥ | ka॒ṇvaḥ | i̭dhe | ṛ॒tāt | adhi̭ | tasya̭ | pra | i॒ṣaḥ | dī॒di॒yuḥ | tam | i॒māḥ | ṛ॒caḥ | tam | a॒gnim | va॒rdha॒yā॒ma॒si || 11 ||
medhyātithiḥ yāgayogyā atithaya ṛtvigūpā yasya tādṛśaḥ kaṇvaḥ ṛṣiḥ ṛtādadhi ādityādadhyāhṛtya yam agnim īdhe dīsavān tasya agneḥ iṣaḥ gamanasvabhāvā raśmayaḥ pra dīdipuḥ prakarṣeṇa dīpyante |
tathā tam agnim imāḥ asmābhiḥ prayujyamānāḥ ṛcaḥ vardhayantīti śeṣaḥ |
1. ḍha-medhyā yāgayogyā atitayaḥ yasya iti tādṛśaḥ |
tvaṃ vājasya śrutyasya rājāsi sa nau mṛḻa mahāṃ asi ||
rāyaḥ | pūrdhi | svadhāvaḥ | asti | hi | te | agne | deveṣu | āpyam | tvam | vājasya | śrutyasya | rājasi | saḥ | naḥ | mṛḻa | mahān | asi || 12 ||

he svadhāvaḥ annavan agne | 'svadhā arkeḥ' (ni. 2. 7. 17) iti tannāmasu pāṭhāt | asmākaṃ rāyaḥ dhanāni pūrdhi pūraya dehiti vā | 'pūrdhi pūraya dehīti vā' (niru. 4. 3) iti yāskaḥ | he agne te tava deveṣvāpyaṃ prāpaṇīyaṃ sakhyam asti hi vidyate khalu | tvaṃ śrutyasya śravaṇīsya vājasya annasya rājasi īśvaro bhavasi | saḥ tvaṃ naḥ asmān mṛḻa sukhaya | mahān guṇairadhikaḥ asi || rāyaḥ | 'uḍidam' iti vibhakterudāttatvam | pūrdhi | 'pṛ pālanapūraṇayoḥ' | 'śruśruṇupṛkṛ-vṛbhyaśchandasi' iti herdhirādeśaḥ | 'bahulaṃ chandasi' iti śapo luk | herapittvena ṅittvādguṇābhāve 'udoṣṭhyapūrvasya' (pā. sū. 7. 1. 102) iti utvam | 'hali ca' iti dīrghaḥ | svadhāvaḥ | 'saṃbuddhau matuvasoḥ' iti rutvam | āpyam | anupadadhatvābhāve'pi vyatyayena 'poradupadhāt' (pā. sū. 3. 1. 98) iti karmaṇi yat | 'yato'nāvaḥ' ityādyudāttatvam | yadvā | pyati chāndasamādyudāttatvam | śrutyasya | 'śru śravaṇe' | auṇādikaḥ kyap | tugāgamaḥ | yadvā | śrutiśabdāt 'bhave chandasi' iti yat | mṛḻa | 'mṛḍa sukhane' | śasya ṅittvāt laghūpadhaguṇābhāvaḥ ||
yupocchrayaṇaṃ 'ūrdhva ū ṣu ṇa utaye' iti dve |
'paśāviṣṭiḥ' iti khaṇḍe sūtritam-'ūrdhva ū ṣu ṇa utaya iti dve' (āśva. śrau. 3. 1) iti |
'athottaram' iti khaṇḍe sūtritaṃ—'sakhe sakhāyamabhyā vastrāsvordhva ū ṣu ṇa utaya iti dve' (āśva. śrau. 4. 7) iti ||
ūrdhva ū ṣu ṇa ūtaye tiṣṭhā devo na savitā |
ūrdhvaḥ | ū~ iti | su | naḥ | ūtaye | tiṣṭha | devaḥ | na | savitā | ūrdhvaḥ | vājasya | sanitā | yat | agnibhiḥ | vāghadbhiḥ | hvayāmahe || 13 ||
he yūpa yadvā yūpatmakadāruniṣṭhāgne naḥ asmākam ūtaye rakṣaṇāya ūrdhvaḥ unnataḥ tiṣṭha |
ūrdhvaḥ unnataḥ san vājasya annasya sanitā dātā bhaviṣyasi |
yat yasmāt kāraṇāt agnibhiḥ ājyena yūpam agnibhiḥ vāghadbhiḥ yajñaṃ vahadbhirittribhiḥ saha vihvayāmahe annadānāya tvāṃ viśeṣaṇāhuyāmaḥ |
‘kriyāgrahaṇaṃ kartavyam’ (pā. ma. 1. 4. 32 ) iti karmaṇaḥ saṃpradānatvāccaturthyarthe ṣaṣṭhī |
udāttanivṛttisvareṇa tibādeśasya udāttatve ‘tāsya- nudāttet0’ iti tasyānudāttatvam |
ūrdhvo naḥ pāyahaṃso ni ketunā viśvaṃ atriṇaṃ daha |
kudhī na ūrdhvāścarathāya jīvasai vidā deveṣu no durvaḥ ||
ūrdhvaḥ | naḥ | pāhi | aṃhesaḥ | ni | ketunā | viśvam | sam | atriṇam | daha | kudhī | naḥ | ūrdhvān | carathāya | jīvasai | vidā | deveṣu | naḥ | durvaḥ || 14 ||
he yūpa yadvā tajjiṣṭhāpre ūrdhvaḥ unnata: san naḥ asmān ketunā jñānena aṃhasaḥ pāpāt ni pāhi nitarāṃ pālaya |
viśvam atriṇam sarvamattāraṃ bhakṣakaṃ rākṣasaṃ saṃ daha samyagbhasmīkuru |
naḥ asmān ūrdhvān unnatān kudhī kuru |
carathāya loke caraṇāya jīvase jīvanāya ca naḥ asmākaṃ durvaḥ dhanaṃ haviḥsvarūpaṃ deveṣu vidā labhaya ||
‘ade- ktini ca’ (u. sū. 4. 508 ) iti auṇādikaḥ trinipratyayaḥ |
‘ubhayatharju’ (pā. sū. 8. 3. 8 ) iti vikalpavidhānāt ‘naścavyapraśān’ (pā. sū. 8. 3. 7) iti nakārasya rutvābhāvaḥ |
asmādantarbhāvitaṇya- thāt leṭi sipi ‘leṭo'ḍāṭau’ iti āḍāgamaḥ |
‘śe sucādīnām’ iti num na bhavati, ‘anityamāgamaśāsanam’ iti vacanena tasyānityatvāt |

pāhi no agne rakṣasaḥ pāhi dhūrterarāṇṇaḥ | pāhi rarṣata uta vā jighāṃsato bṛhaddāno yaviṣṭhya || 15 || pāhi | naḥ | agne | rakṣasaḥ | pāhi | dhūrteḥ | arāṇṇaḥ | pāhi | rarṣataḥ | uta | vā | jighāṃsataḥ | bṛhaddāno iti bṛhat'bhāno | yaviṣṭhya || 15 ||
he agne he bṛhaddāno bṛhanto bhānavo yasya tādṛśa he yaviṣṭhya yuvatama he agne naḥ asmān rakṣasaḥ bādhakādrākṣasādeḥ pāhi pālaya |
tathā arāṇṇaḥ dhanādīnāmadātṛrūpāt dhūrteḥ hiṃsākāt pāhi |
uta vā athavā jighāṃsataḥ hantumicchataḥ śatroḥ sakāśāt pāhi |
hantericchārthe sani 'ajjhanagamāṃ sani' (pā. sū. 6. 4. 16) iti upadhādīrghatvam |
adupadeśāt lasārva- dhātukānudāttatve sano nittvāt nisvareṇa padasyādyudāttatvam |
'sthūladūra' ityādinā yaṇādiparasya lopaḥ, pūrvasya ca guṇaḥ |

ghaneva viśvagviva jahrāṇṇastapurjambha yo asmadhuk | yo martyaḥ śiśīte atyaktubhirmā naḥ sa ripurīṃśata || 16 || ghanā'iva | viśvak | vi | jahi | arāṇṇaḥ | tapuḥ'jambha | yaḥ | asma'dhuk | yaḥ | martyaḥ | śiśīte | ati | akkubhiḥ | mā | naḥ | saḥ | ripuḥ | īśata || 16 ||
he tapurjambha tapyamānaraśmiyuktāgne arāṇṇaḥ asmabhyaṃ deyasya dhanasya adātṛn vairiṇaḥ viśvak vi jahi viśeṣeṇa māraya |
yathā kaṭhinena daṇḍapāṣāṇādinā bhāṇḍā- dibhaṅgaṃ karoti tadvat |
yaḥ anyo'pi ripuḥ asmadhuk asmadviṣayadrohakārī bhartsanādinā bādhate |
yaḥ ca anyaḥ martyaḥ manuṣyaḥ śatruḥ akkubhiḥ āyudhaiḥ ati śiśīte tanūkaroti asmān praharatītyarthaḥ |
sa ripuḥ bhartsanaprahārakārī dvividho'pi śatruḥ naḥ asmān prati mā īśata īśvaraḥ śakto mā bhūt ||
1. ca-cha-ṇa-pha-he bṛhaddāno bṛhanto bhānavo yasya tādṛśa he yaviṣṭhya yuvatama naḥ asmān; na-he bṛhaddāno......tādṛśa yaviṣṭhya yuvatama naḥ asmān; sa-naḥ asmān |

karaṇe usinpratyayāntaḥ tapasuśabdo nittvādādyudāttaḥ | ‘jabhi nāśane’ | jabhyante śatrava ebhiriti jambhānyāyudhāni | karaṇe ghañ | tapūṃyeva jambhāni yasyāsau taparjambhaḥ | āmantritādyudāttatvam | asmabhuka | ‘druha jighāṃsāyām’ | ‘satsṛdvipa’ ityādinā kip | ‘vā druhamuhasnuhasnihām’ (pā. sū. 8. 2. 33) iti hakārasya ghatvam | bhabhāvaḥ | śiśīte | ‘śo tanūkaraṇe’ | vyatyayenātmane- padam | ‘bahula chandasi’ iti vikaraṇasya śluḥ | ‘ādecaḥ’ iti āttvam | tato dvivacane ‘bahula chandasi’ (pā. sū. 7. 4. 78) iti abhyāsasya itvam | ‘ī halyaghoḥ’ iti ītvam | vyatya- yenādyudāttatvam | yadvṛttayogādanighātaḥ | īśata | laṅi ‘bahula chandasi’ iti śapo lugabhāvaḥ | ‘na māṅyoge’ iti aḍagamābhāvaḥ ||
agniḥ | vane | su'vīryam | agniḥ | kaṇvaya | saubhagam | agniḥ | pra | āvat | mitrā | uta | medhya'atithim | agniḥ | sātā | upa'stutam || 17 ||
vagniḥ devaḥ vsuvīryaṃ śobhanavīryopetaṃ dhanamuddiśya vvane yācitaḥ |
saḥ vagniḥ vkaṇvaya maharṣaye vsaubhagaṃ śobhanadhanādirūpaṃ bhāgyaṃ prāyacchaditi śeṣaḥ |
tathā vagniḥ vmitrā asmanmitrāṇi vprāvat prakarṣeṇa rakṣitavān |
vuta api ca vmedhyātithiṃ medhayogyairatithibhirupetamṛṣiṃ prāvat |
tathā vupa- stutam anyamapi stotāraṃ yajamānaṃ vsātāau dhanādidānanimittaṃ prāvaditi śeṣaḥ ||
‘subhagānmantre’ iti udāttādiṣu pāṭhāt tasya bhāvaḥ ityetasminnarthe añ (pā. sū. 5. 1. 129) |
‘kiccā ca saṃjñāyām’ iti stauteḥ kartari kaḥ |
agninā turvaśaṃ yaduṃ parāvata ugrādevaṃ havāmahe |
agninā | turvaśam | yadum | parā'vata | ugra'devam | havāmahe | agniḥ | nayat | nava'vāstvam | bṛhat'ratham | turvitim | dasyave | sahaḥ || 18 ||
vagninā mahāvasthitān turvaśanāmakaṃ yadunāmakaṃ ugradevanāmakaṃ ca rājarṣīn vparāvataḥ dūradeśāt vhavāmahe āhvayāmaḥ |
sa ca vagniḥ navavāstvanāmakaṃ bṛhadrathanāmakaṃ turvitināmakaṃ ca rājarṣīn vnayat ihānayat |
dīdetha kaṇva ṛtajāta ukṣito yaṃ namasanti kṛṣṭayaḥ ||
ni | tvām | agne | manuḥ | dadhe | jyotiḥ | janāya | śaśvate | dīdetha | kaṇve | ṛta'jātaḥ | ukṣitaḥ | yam | namasyanti | kṛṣṭayaḥ || 19 ||
he agne jyotiḥ prakāśarūpaṃ tvāṃ śaśvate bahuvidhāya janāya manuḥ prajāpatiḥ ni dadhe devayajanedhe sthāpitavān |
he agne tvam ṛtajātaḥ ṛtena yajñena nimittabhūtenotpannaḥ ukṣitaḥ havi- rbhistarpitaḥ san kaṇve etannāmake mahapau dīdetha dīsavānasi |
thali ' dvivacanaprakaraṇe chandasi veti vaktavyam ' ( kā. 6. 1. 8. 1 ) iti dvivacanabhāvaḥ |
' namovarivaḥ ' ( pā. sū. 3. 1. 19 ) iti pūjārthe kyac |
tvepāsau agneramavanto arcayo bhīmāso na pratīṃtaye |
tvepāsaḥ | agneḥ | ama'vantaḥ | arcayaḥ | bhīmāsaḥ | na | pratī'itaye | rakṣasvinḥ | sadam | ita | yātu'māvataḥ | viśvam | sam | atriṇam | daha || 20 ||

agneḥ arcayaḥ jvālāḥ tvepāsaḥ dīptāḥ amavantaḥ balavantaḥ bhīmāsaḥ bhayaṃkaraḥ | ataḥ pratītaye asmābhiḥ pratyetuṃ na śakyā iti śeṣaḥ | he agne rakṣasvinḥ balavataḥ yātumāvataḥ yātudhānānsurān sadamit sarvadaiva saṃ daha sambhasmamīkuru | tathā viśvaṃ sarva atriṇaṃ bhakṣakaṃ asmadbādhakaṃ śatruṃ saṃ daha || tvepāsaḥ | ' sviṣa dīsau ' | pacādyac | ' citaḥ ' ityanto- dāttatvam | amavantaḥ | ' ama roge ' | amati śatrūn rajatīti amo balam | pacādyac | vṛṣāditvā- dādyudāttatvam | tadeṣāmastītyamavantaḥ | pratīteye | ' tādau ca niti ' iti gateḥ prakṛtisvaratvam | rakṣasvinḥ | rakṣantyaneneti rakṣo balam | karaṇesun | ' asamāyāmedhā ' iti matvarthīyo viniḥ | yātumāvataḥ | yātavo yātavāḥ | tān bhimate nirmimate iti rākṣasavyāpārā yātumāḥ | ' āto'nupasarge

ka: ' iti ka: | tadepamastīti matup | ' matau bahvo'najirādīnām ' (pā. sū. 6. 3. 119) iti dīrghatvam | ' saṃjñāyām ' (pā. sū. 8. 2. 11) iti vatvam | matupaḥ pivādanudāttatve kṛduttara- padaprakṛtisvaratvam | atraṇam | ' adestrini ca ' iti kartari trinipratyayaḥ || || 11 ||
' krīḻaṃ va: ' iti dvitīyaṃ sūktaṃ pañcadaśarcam |
atreyamatramaṇikā— ' krīḻaṃ pañconā mārutaṃ hi gāyatraṃ tu ' iti |
' ṛṣibhyānyasmātparavāviśiṣṭa: ' iti paribhāṣayā ghoraputra: kaṇva ṛṣi: |
vyūḍhe dvitīye chandome ābhimārutaśastre etatsūktaṃ nividānīyam |
' dvitīyasyāmi vo devam ' iti khaṇḍe sūtritaṃ— ' krīḻaṃ va: śardho'gne muletyābhimārutam ' (āśva. śrau. 8. 10) iti |
brāhmaṇaṃ ca— ' krīḻaṃ va: śardho mārutam ' (ai.brā.5.19) iti |
' marudgya: krīḍibhya: puroḍāśaṃ samakapālam ' ityasyāmiṣṭau ' krīḻaṃ va: ' ityeṣā pradhānasyānuvākyā |
' tathā tataḥ ' iti khaṇḍe sūtritaṃ— ' krīḻaṃ va: śardho māruta- mayāso na ye marutaḥ svañja: ' (āśva. śrau. 2. 18) iti ||
krīḻam | va: | śardha: | mārutam | anarvāṇam | rathe'śubham | kaṇva: | abhi | pra | gāyata ||1||

he kaṇva: kaṇvagotrotpannā maharṣaya: | yadvā | medhāvina ṛtvija: | va: yuṣmadarthaṃ mārutaṃ maru- tsamūhyarūpaṃ śardha: balam abhi pra gāyata abhita: prakaraṇaṃ studhvam | kīdṛśaṃ śardha: | krīḻaṃ viharaṇa- śīlam anarvāṇaṃ ātapyarahitam | ata eva śrutyantarabrāhmaṇe mantrāntaramevaṃ vyākhyātam— ' anarvā prehītyāha ātapyo vā arvā bhāntryāpanuttyai ' (tai. saṃ. 6. 3. 8. 4) iti | ratheśubhaṃ svakīye rathe'- vasthāya śobhamānam | krīḻam | ' krīḍ vihāre ' | pacādyac | śardha: | ' śrudhu prasahane ' | śardhayatyanena śatrūniti śardho balam | asun | niccādādyudāttatvam | mārutaṃ marutāṃ sambandhi | ' tasyedam ' iti aṇ | vyatyayenādyudāttatvam | yadvā | samūhārthe ' anudāttāderañ ' (pā. sū. 4. 2. 44) ityanudā- ttādilakṣaṇa: aṇpratyaya: | anarvāṇam | vyatyayena puṃliṅgatā | ' nambubhyām ' ityuttarapadāntodāttatvam | ratheśubham | ' śubha dīptau ' | rathe śobhate iti ratheśubh | ' kip ca ' iti kip | ' tatpuruṣe kṛti bahulam ' iti aluk | kṛduttarapadaprakṛtisvaratvam | gāyata | ' kai gai rai śabde ' | ' tiṅṅatiṅa: ' iti nighāta: ||
ye | pṛṣatībhi: | ṛṣṭibhi: | sākam | vāśībhi: | añjibhi: | ajāyanta | svabhānava: ||2||

he marutaḥ 'nūnam idānīṃ 'ka yūyaṃ kutra sthitāḥ | 'kat kadā 'vaḥ yuṣmākam 'artham araṇaṃ' devajanadeśe gamanam | vilambaṃ mā kurutetyarthaḥ | 'divaḥ 'ganta dyulokādgacchata | 'pṛthivyāḥ 'na ganta bhūlokānmā gacchata | 'vaḥ yuṣmān 'ka 'raṇyanti | devajanarūpāyāḥ pṛthivyā anyatra kutra śabdayanti | yajamānāḥ stuvanti | tatra dṛṣṭāntaḥ | 'gāvo 'na | yathā gāvo raṇanti śabdayanti tadvat | ka | kiṃśabdāt saptamyantāt 'kimot' (pā. sū. 5. 3. 12) iti apratyayaḥ | 'kāti' (pā. sū. 7. 2. 105) iti kimaḥ kādeśaḥ | 'tisvaritaḥ' iti svaritavam | artham | 'ṛ gatau' | 'upikuṇigātibhyaścan' (u. sū. 2. 161) iti bhāve than | nittvādādyudāttatvam | ganta | gameloṭi ' bahulaṃ chandasi ' iti śapo luk | thādeśasya tasya 'tasanasanathanāśca' iti tabādeśaḥ | ata eva dvitvābhāvāt 'anudāttaupadeśa' ' ityādinā anunāsikalopo na bhavati | pratyayasya pittvādanudāttatve dhātusvaraḥ | 'byo'talmiṅaḥ' iti saṃhitāyāṃ dīrghatvam | divaḥ | 'uḍiḍam' iti vibhakterudāttatvam | pṛthivyāḥ | 'udāttayaṇo halpūrvāt' iti vibhakterudāttatvam | raṇyanti | raṇatiḥ śabdārthaḥ | vyatyayena śyan ||

he ṛtviksamūha 'āsye svakīyamukhe 'ślokaṃ stotraṃ 'mimīhi nirmitaṃ kuru | taṃ ca ślokaṃ 'tatana: vistāraya | tatra dṛṣṭānta: | 'parjanyeiva | yathā megho vṛṣṭiṃ vistārayati tadvat | 'ukthyaṃ śabdayogyaṃ 'gāyatraṃ gāyatrīcchandaskaṃ sūktaṃ 'gāya paṭha || mimīhi | 'māṅ māne ' | jauhotyādika: | vyatyayena parasmai- padam | 'bhṛñjāmit ' iti abhyāsasya hrasvam | āsye | 'asu kṣepaṇe ' | asyate kṣipyate'sminniti āsyam | 'kṛtyalyuṭo bahulam ' ( pā. sū. 3. 3. 113 ) ityadhikaraṇe ṇyat | 'tisvaritam ' iti svaritatvam | tatana: | 'tanu vistāre ' | leṭi sipi ' bahulaṃ chandasi ' iti vikaraṇasya bhlu: | 'leṭo'ḍāṭau ' iti aḍāgama: | 'itaśca lopa: ' iti ikāralopa: | gāyatram | gāyatryā: saṃbandha | 'tasyedam ' iti aṇ | yadvā | gāyatrastrāyate iti gāyatram | 'āto'nupasarge ka: ' ||
vandasva | mārutam | gaṇam | tveṣam | panasyum | arkiṇam | asme | vṛddhā: | asan | iha ||15||
he ṛtviksaṃgha 'mārutaṃ marutsambandhinaṃ 'gaṇaṃ samūhaṃ 'vandasva namaskuru stuhi vā |
'asme asmākam 'iha asmin karmaṇi 'vṛddhā: 'asan maruta: pravṛddhā bhavantu ||
‘puṃsi saṃjñāyām’ iti ghaḥ| ako'syāstīti akī| ‘ata initanau’ | asan| ‘bahulaṃ chandasi’ iti śapo lugabhāvaḥ| ‘dvataśca lopaḥ’ iti ikāralopaḥ| ‘tiṅḍatiṅaḥ’ iti nighātaḥ|| 17||
‘pra yaditthā’ iti daśarcaṃ caturthaṃ sūktam| ghoraputrasya kaṇvasyārṣaṃ maruddevatākam| yujaḥ sato-bṛhasyaḥ| ayujo bṛhatyaḥ| ‘pra yadvā prāgārthaṃ tu’ ityanukramaṇikā| gato viniyogaḥ||
kasya kratvā marutaḥ kasya varpasā kaṃ yātha kaṃ he dhūtayaḥ ||
pra | yat | itthā | parā'vataḥ | śociḥ | na | mānam | asyatha | kasya | kratvā | marutaḥ | kasya | varpasā | kam | yātha | kam | ha | dhūtayaḥ || 1 ||
he dhūtayaḥ sthāvarādīnāṃ kampanakārinaḥ marutaḥ yat yadā mānaṃ mananīyaṃ yuṣmadalaṃ parāvataḥ dūrāt |
itthā asmādanta-rikṣāt yat asyatha bhūmau prakṣipatha |
yathā sūryasya tejo'ntarikṣāt bhūmau prakṣipyate tadvat |
tadānīṃ yūyaṃ kasya yajamānasya kratvā kratunā saṃgacchadhve iti śeṣaḥ |
tathā kasya yajamānasya varpasā stotreṇa saṃgacchadhve |
kaṃ ha kaṃ khalu yajamānamanugṛhṇītheti śeṣaḥ ||
‘thā hetau ca chandasi’ (pā. sū. 5. 3. 26) iti iṃdaśabdāt prakāravacane thāpratyayaḥ |
yadi tatra iṃdaśabdasya nānuvṛttiḥ tarhi thamupratyayāntāt idaṃ-śabdāduttarasyā vibhaktervyākhyayena ‘supāṃ suluk’ iti ḍādeśaḥ |
jasādiṣu chandasi vāvacanam (pā. sū. 7. 3. 109. 1) iti nābhāvasya vikalpitatvādbhāvaḥ |
vṛḍ-śīḍbhyāṃ rūpasvādyoḥ pukca (u. sū. 4. 640) iti asun; tatsaṃniyogena pugāgamaśca |
atra rūpābhidhāyinā varpaśabdena devatāsvarūpaprakāśakaṃ stotraṃ lakṣyate kratunā sāhacaryāt||
sthirā vaḥ santvāyudhā parāṇudai vīḻu uta pratiṣkamai |
yuṣmākamastu tarviṣī panīyasī mā martyasya māyinaḥ ||
sthirā | vaḥ | santu | āyudhā | parā'nudai | vīḻu | uta | prati'skabhe | yuṣmākam | astu | tarviṣī | panīyasī | mā | martyasya | māyinaḥ || 2 ||
he marutaḥ vaḥ āyudhā yuṣmākamāyudhāni parāṇude śatrūṇāmapanodanāya sthirā santu sthirāṇi bhavantu |
uta api ca pratiṣkamabhe śatrūṇāṃ pratibandhyāya vīḻu santu dṛḍhāni santu |
yuṣmākaṃ tarviṣī balaṃ panīyasī atiśayena stotavyaṃ bhavatu |
māyinaḥ asmāsu chadmacāriṇaḥ martyasya manuṣyasya śatroḥ |

'mā balaṃ mā bhavatu' | sthirā āyudhā | ubhayatra 'śeṣchandasi bahulam' iti śelopaḥ | parāṇude | 'ṇuda preraṇe' | saṃpadādilakṣaṇaḥ kip | 'upasargādasamāne'pi' (pā. sū. 8. 4. 14) iti ṇatvam | kuduttarapadaprakṛtisvaratvam | vīḻu | 'supāṃ suluk' iti vibhakterluk | īṣākṣatvāditvātprakṛti- bhāvaḥ (pā. sū. 6. 1. 127. 2) | pratikambhe | skambhuḥ sautro dhātuḥ | saṃpadādilakṣaṇo bhāve kip | 'aniditām' iti nalopaḥ | panīyasī | panatiḥ stutyarthaḥ | asmāt auṇādikaḥ karmaṇi asun | tata īyasuni 'ṭeḥ' iti ṭilopaḥ | 'ugitaśca' iti ṅīp | īyasuno nistvādādyudāttatvam | māyinaḥ | māyāśabdasya vrīhādiṣu pāṭhāt 'vrīhādibhyaśca' iti mattvarthīya iniḥ ||
parā ha yatsthiraṃ hatha narau vartayathā guru |
vi yāthana vuninaḥ pṛthivyā vyāśāḥ parvatānām ||
parā | ha | yat | sthiram | hatha | naraḥ | vartayatha | guru | vi | yāthana | vuninaḥ | pṛthivyāḥ | vi | āśāḥ | parvatānām || 3 ||
he 'naraḥ netārī marutaḥ 'yat yadā 'sthiraṃ vastu 'parā 'hatha vṛkṣādikaṃ parāhataṃ bhagnaṃ kurutha |
tadānīṃ 'pṛthivyāḥ saṃbandhin: 'vaninaḥ vanavato vṛkṣān 'vi 'yāthana viyujya madhye gacchatha |
araṇyagatānāṃ nibiḍānāṃ vṛkṣāṇāṃ madhye yasya kasyāpi vṛkṣasya bhaṅgāvāditaravṛkṣāṇāṃ parasparaviyogena prauḍho mārgo bhavati |
adupadeśāt lasārva- dhātukānudāttatve ṇicaḥ svara eva śiṣyate |
nahi vaḥ śatrurvivide adhi dyavi na bhūmyāṃ riśādasaḥ |
yuṣmākamastu tarviṣī tanā yujā rudrāso nū cidādhṛṣe ||
nahi | vaḥ | śatruḥ | vivide | adhi | dyavi | na | bhūmyām | riśādasaḥ | yuṣmākam | astu | tarviṣī | tanā | yujā | rudrāsaḥ | nu | cit | ādhṛṣe || 4 ||
he 'riśādasaḥ śatruhiṃsakā marutaḥ 'adhi 'dyavi dyulokasyopari 'vaḥ yuṣmākaṃ 'śatruḥ 'nahi 'vivide na ca babhūva |

he 'rudrāsaḥ rudraputrā marutaḥ 'yuṣmākam ekonapañcāśatsaṃkhyānāṃ bhavatāṃ 'yujā yogena parasparaikamatyena 'ādhṛṣe vairiṇāṃ sarvato dharṣaṇāya 'tarviṣī balaṃ 'nū 'cit kṣiprameva 'tanā 'astu vistṛtā bhavatu ||
dyavi nahi trivide bhūmyāṃ ca na vivide iti caśabdārthapratīteḥ |

nighātaḥ | yujā | ‘yujir yoge’ | ‘ṛtvik’ ityādinā kin | ‘sāvekācaḥ’ iti vibhakte- rudāttatvam | hlāsaḥ | rudaśabdena tatsambandhino maruto lakṣyante | ‘ājaserasuk’ | nū cit | ‘ṛci tunugha’ ityādinā dīrghaḥ | ādyeṣe | ‘bhṛṣvā prāgalbhye’ | saṃpadādilakṣaṇe bhāve kip | kṛduttarapada- prakṛtisvaratvam ||
pro ārata maruto durmadā iva devāsaḥ sarvayā viśā ||
pra | vepayanti | parvatān | vi | viśvanti | vanaspatīn | pro iti | ārata | marutaḥ | durmadāḥ | iva | devāsaḥ | sarvayā | viśā || 5 ||

^parvatān meruhimavadādīn ^pra ^vepayanti marutaḥ prakarṣeṇa kampayanti | ^vanaspatīn vaṭāśvatthādīn ^vi ^viśvanti parasparaviyuktān kurvanti | he ^marutaḥ ^devāsaḥ devāḥ ^sarvayā ^viśā prajayā sahitā yūyaṃ ^pro ^ārata prakarṣeṇaiva sarvato gacchatha | tatra dṛṣṭāntaḥ | ^durmadā iva | yathā madonmattāḥ svecchayā sarvataḥ krīḍanti tadvat || vepayanti | ‘ṭuvep kampane’ | vepamānān prayuñjate | hetumaṇṇic | viśvanti | ‘vicir pṛthagbhāve’ | rudāditvāt śam | ‘atoralopaḥ’ iti akāralopaḥ | vanaspatīn | vanānāṃ patayo vanaspatayaḥ | pāraskarāditvāt suṭ | vanapatiśabdāvādyudāttau | ‘ubhe vanaspatyādiṣu yugapat’ iti pūrvottarapadayoryugapaprakṛtisvaratvam | ārata | ‘ṛ gatau’ | laṅi madhyamabahuvacane ‘bahulaṃ chandasi’ iti śapo lugbhāvaḥ | yadvā luk | ‘satiśāstyartibhyaśca’ (pā. sū. 3. 1. 56) iti aṅ | ‘āṅādīnām’ iti āḍāgamaḥ | ‘āṭaśca’ (pā. sū. 6. 1. 90) iti vṛddhiḥ | devāsaḥ | āmantritādyudāttatvam | sarvayā | ‘sarvasya supi’ (pā. sū. 6. 1. 191) ityādyudāttatvam | viśā | ‘sāvekācaḥ’ iti vibhakterudāttatvam || || 18 ||
ā vo yāmāya pṛthivī cidaśraudabībhayanta mānuṣāḥ ||
upo iti | rayaiṣu | pṛṣatīḥ | ayugdhvam | pṛṣṭiḥ | vahati | rohitaḥ | ā | vaḥ | yāmāya | pṛthivī | cit | aśraut | abībhayanta | mānuṣāḥ || 6 ||
he marutaḥ ^rayaiṣu bhavadīyeṣu ^pṛṣatīḥ binduyuktā mṛgīḥ ^upo sāmīpyenaiva ^ayugdhvaṃ yojitavantaḥ |
^pṛṣṭiḥ etatsaṃjñako vāhanatrayamadhyavartī yugaviśeṣaḥ ^rohitaḥ mṛgāvāntarajātilohitavarṇaḥ ^vahati rathaṃ nayati |
^vaḥ yuṣmākaṃ ^yāmāya gamanāya ^pṛthivī ^cit antarikṣamapi ^ā ^aśraut ābhimukhyena aśruṇot anujānātītyarthaḥ |
pṛthivītyantarikṣanāma, ‘pṛthivī bhūḥ svayaṃbhu’ (ni. 1.3.9) iti tannāmasu pāṭhāt |
^mānuṣāḥ bhūlokavartinaḥ puruṣāḥ ^abībhayanta svayaṃ bhītāḥ santo'nyebhāmapi bhītimutpā-

ditavantaḥ || upo' iti nighātadvayasamudāyātmakamanyannipātāntaram | 'ot' (pā. sū. 1. 1. 15) iti pragṛhyatvam | ayuṣdhvam | luṅi 'jhalo jhali' (pā. sū. 8. 2. 26) iti sakārasya lopaḥ | 'coḥ kuḥ' iti kutvam | rohitaḥ | 'rahe raśva lo vā' (u. sū. 2. 374) iti itantraya-yāntaḥ | niccādāyudāttaḥ | yāmāya | yamerbhāve ghañ | 'karṣātvataḥ' ityantodāttātve prāpte vṛṣādiṣu pāṭhā-dāyudāttatvam | aśrot | 'śru śravaṇe' | 'bahulaṃh chandasi' iti vikaraṇasya luk | abībhayanta | 'jibhī bhaye' | asmāt pyantāt luṅi 'bhīsmyorhetubhaye' (pā. sū. 1. 3. 68) ityātmanepadam | 'bibheterhetubhaye' (pā. sū. 7. 3. 40) iti puk prāpnoti | tanna kriyate, āgamānuśāsanasyānityatvāt | ṇau caṅyupa-dhāsvatvādi (pā. sū. 7. 4. 1) ||
ā vau makṣu tanāya kaṃ rudrā avo vṛṇīmahe | gantā nūnaṃ no'rvasā yathā purethā kaṇvaya vibhyuṣeṃ || 7 ||
ā | vaḥ | makṣu | tanāya | kam | rudrāḥ | avaḥ | vṛṇīmahe | gantā | nūnam | naḥ | avasā | yathā | purā | itthā | kaṇvaya | vibhyuṣeṃ || 7 ||
he rudrāḥ rudraputrā marutaḥ 'tanāya 'kaṃ asmadīyaputrārthaṃ 'makṣu śīghraṃ 'vaḥ yuṣmadīyam 'avaḥ rakṣaṇam 'ā vṛṇīmahe sarvataḥ prārthayāmahe |
makṣu iti kṣipranāma, 'nu makṣu' (ni. 2. 15. 2) iti tannāmasu paṭhitatvāt |

'purā pūrvasmin kāle karmāntareṣu 'naḥ 'avasā asmadīya-rakṣaṇena nimittena yūyaṃ 'yathā' prāptavantaḥ 'itthā anena prakāreṇa 'vibhyuṣe bhītiyuktāya 'kaṇvaya medhā-vine yajamānāya 'tadanugrahārthaṃ 'nūnaṃ kṣipraṃ 'ganta prāptuta |
kam ityetat pādānte prayujyamānaṃ pādapūraṇaṃ 'śiśiraṃ jīvanaya kam' itivat |
yuṣmeṣito maruto matyaiṣita ā yo no abhva īṣate | vi taṃ yuyota śavasā vyojasā vi yuṣmākābhirūtibhiḥ || 8 ||
yuṣmā'īṣitaḥ | marutaḥ | matyai'īṣitaḥ | ā | yaḥ | naḥ | abhvaḥ | īṣate | vi | tam | yuyota | śavasā | vi | ojasā | vi | yuṣmākābhiḥ | ūti'bhiḥ ||8||

he marutaḥ yaḥ yaḥ kaścit avaḥ śatruḥ yuṣmeṣitaḥ yuṣmābhiḥ preṣitaḥ maryaiṣitaḥ mārakai- rnyairvā preṣitaḥ san naḥ asmān prati ā īyate ābhimukhyena prāpnoti, taṃ śatruṃ śavasā agnena vi yuyota vibhaktaṃ kuruta |
na ca 'na lumatāṅgasya' iti pratiṣedhaḥ, 'iko'ci vibhaktau' (pā. sū. 7. 1. 73) ityatra ajgrahaṇena tasya pākṣikatvokteḥ |
'tasminnaṇi ca yuṣmākāsmākau' (pā. sū. 4. 3. 2) iti yuṣmacchabdasya yuṣmākādeśaḥ |
asāmi hi prayajvaḥ kaṇvaṃ dada pracetasaḥ |
asāmibhiramarut ā na ūtibhirgantā vṛṣṭiṃ na vidyutaḥ ||
asāmi | hi | pra'yajvaḥ | kaṇvam | dada | pra'cetasaḥ |
asāmi'bhiḥ | marutaḥ | ā | naḥ | ūti'bhiḥ | gantā | vṛṣṭim | na | vi'dyutaḥ || 9 ||
asāmi hi saṃpūrṇameva yathā bhavati tathā prayajvaḥ prakarṣeṇa yaṣṭavyāḥ |
kaṇvaṃ medhāvinaṃ yajamānametannāmakampe vā dada dhārayata |
hi yasmāt yūyaṃ kaṇvanāmakamṛṣiṃ dhāritavantastasmāt kāraṇāt asāmibhiḥ ūtibhiḥ saṃpūrṇai rakṣaṇaiḥ naḥ asmān prati ā ganta āgacchata |
'chandasyubhayathā' iti ārdhadhātukatvāt 'abhyastānāmādiḥ' ityādyudāttatvaṃ na bhavati, kiṃtu pratyayasvara eva |
ṛṣidviṣe marutaḥ parimanyava iṣuṃ na sṛjata dviṣam ||
asāmi | ojaḥ | bibhṛtha | sudānavaḥ | asāmi | dhūtayaḥ | śarvaḥ | ṛṣi'dviṣe | marutaḥ | pari'manyave | iṣum | na | sṛjata | dviṣam || 10 ||
he sudānavaḥ śobhanadānepetāḥ marutaḥ asāmi saṃpūrṇam ojaḥ balaṃ bibhṛtha dhārayatha |
he dhūtayaḥ kampanakāriṇo marutaḥ asāmi saṃpūrṇaṃ śavaḥ balaṃ parimanyave kopaparivṛtāya ṛṣidviṣe ṛṣīṇāṃ dveṣaṃ kurvate śatrave tadvināśārthaṃ dviṣaṃ dveṣakāriṇaṃ hantāraṃ sṛjata |
atra niruktam- 'asāmi sāmi pratiṣiddhaṃ sāmi syate |
asusamāptaṃ balaṃ bibhṛtha kalyāṇadānātaḥ' ( niru. 6. 23 ) iti ||
'uttiṣṭha' ityaṣṭarcaṃ pañcamaṃ sūktaṃ kaṇvasya ārṣaṃ bārhatam |
caturviṃśe'hani marutvatīya prākṛtāt brāhmaṇaspatyāt pragāthāt pūrvam 'uttiṣṭha brahmaṇaspate' ityayaṃ pragāthaḥ |
'marutvatīya' iti khaṇḍe sūtritaṃ- 'praitu brahmaṇaspatiruttiṣṭha brahmaṇaspata iti brāhmaṇaspatyāvāvapate pūrvau nisyāt' ( āśva. śrau. 7. 3 ) iti |
'uttiṣṭha brahmaṇaspata ityetāmuktvāvatiṣṭhate' ( āśva. śrau. 4. 7 ) iti sūtritatvāt ||
upa pra yantu marutaḥ sudānava indra prāśūrbhavā sacā ||
ut | tiṣṭha | brahmaṇaḥ | pate | deva'yantaḥ | tvā | īmahe | upa | pra | yantu | marutaḥ | sudānavaḥ | indra | prāśūḥ | bhava | sacā || 1 ||
he brahmaṇaspate etannāmaka deva uttiṣṭha asadanugrahāya tvadīyanivāsādutthānaṃ kuru |
devayantaḥ devān kāmayamānā vayaṃ tvā tvām īmahe yācā mahe |
sudānavaḥ śobhanadānayuktāḥ marutaḥ upa pra yantu samīpe prakarṣeṇa gacchantu |
he indra tvaṃ sacā brahmaṇaspatinā saha prāśūḥ somasya prāśako bhava |

syāpi niṣedhaḥ, ‘adhāghasyāt’ iti punaratvavidhānasāmarthyāt | īmahe ityādayo gatāḥ | prāśvaḥ | ‘śru hiṃsāyām’ | prakarṣeṇa ā samantāt śruṇāti hinastīti prāśvaḥ | ‘bahulaṃ chandasi’ (pā. sū. 7. 1. 103) iti uttvam | ‘vorupadhāyā dīrghaḥ’ | kṛduttarapadaprakṛtisvaratvam | bhava | ‘aco'- tastikaḥ’ iti saṃhitāyāṃ dīrghatvam ||
tvāmiddhi sahasaputra martyaṃ upabrūte dhane hite |
suvīryaṃ maruta ā svabhvyaṃ dadhīta yo va ācuke ||
tvām | it | hi | sahasaḥ | putra | martyaḥ | upa'brūte | dhane | hite | suvīryam | marutaḥ | ā | su'aśvyam | dadhīta | yaḥ | vaḥ | ā'cuke || 2 ||
martyaḥ manuṣyaḥ hite śatrupu prakṣipte dhane nimittabhūte sati tvāmit tvāmeva upa- brūte hi samīpaṃ prāpya stauti khalu |
he marutaḥ yaḥ dhanārthī martyaḥ vaḥ yuṣmān brahmaṇaspatisahitān ācuke stauti sa martyaḥ svabhvyaṃ śobhanāśrayuktaṃ suvīryaṃ śobhana- vīryayuktaṃ ca dhanaṃ dadhīta dhārayet ||
brahmaṇaspate itivat ‘paṣṭyāḥ patiputrau’ iti visarja- nīyasya satvam |
śobhanaṃ vīryaṃ yasyeti bahuvrīhau ‘vīravīryau ca’ ityuttarapadādyudāttatvam |
‘keśāśvābhyāṃ yacchā- vanyatarasyām’ (pā. sū. 4.2.47) iti samūhārthe chapratyayaḥ |
caturviṃśe'hani marutvatīye ‘uttiṣṭha brahmaṇaspate’ ityasmātpragāthātpūrva ‘pretu brahmaṇaspatiḥ’ ityayaṃ pragātho viniyuktaḥ |
mahāvīramādāya śālāṃ prati- gacchatsu ‘pretu brahmaṇaspatiḥ’ ityetāṃ paṭhan hotānugacchet |
sūtritaṃ ca- ‘pretu brahmaṇaspati- rhotā devo amartyaḥ’ (āśva. śrau. 4. 10) iti ||
acchā vīraṃ naryaṃ paṅktirādhasaṃ devā yajñaṃ nayantu naḥ ||
pra | etu | brahmaṇaḥ | patiḥ | pra | devyai | etu | sūnṛtā | acchā | vīram | naryam | paṅkti'rādhasam | devāḥ | yajñam | nayantu | naḥ || 3 ||
