ā | tat | te | dasta | mantumaḥ | pū॒ṣan | ava̭ | vṛ॒ṇī॒ma॒he | yena̭ | pi॒tṛn | acaṷdayaḥ || 5 ||
he ‘mantumaḥ jñānavan ‘dasta darśanīya yadvā vairyapakṣakārin ‘pūpan ‘te tvadīyaṃ ‘tat ‘avaḥ tādṛśaṃ rakṣaṇam ‘ā ‘vṛṇīmahe sarvataḥ prārthayāmahe |
ardha | naḥ | vi॒śvasaṷbhaga | hi॒raṇya̭vāśīmattama | dha॒nāni̭ | su॒ṣaṇā̭ | kṛ॒dhi || 6 ||

he ᵥviśvasaubhaga kṛtsnadhanayukta yadvā kṛtsnasaubhāgyayukta ᵥhiraṇyavāśīmattama atiśayena suvarṇa- mayāyudhavana pūṣan ᵥadha pūrvoktāsmadīyaprārthanānantaraṃ ᵥnaḥ asmākaṃ ᵥdhanāni suvarṇamaṇimuktādīni ᵥsuṣaṇā suṣṭhu dānayuktāni ᵥkṛdhi kuru ||
hasraga- sindhante pūrvapadasya ca’ ityuttarapadavṛddhau prāptāyāṃ matyāṃ sarvavibhaktīnāṃ chandasi vikalpitatvāduttarapada- vṛddhina bhavatīti vṛttāvuktam (kā. 7. 2. 19) |
atiṃ naḥ saśvatau naya sugā naḥ supathā kṛṇu | pūrṣabhiha kratuṃ vidaḥ ||7|| atiṃ | naḥ | saśvataḥ | naya | sugā | naḥ | supathā | kṛṇu | pūrṣan | iha | kratum | vidaḥ ||7||
ᵥsaśvataḥ asmadvādhanāya prāpnuvataḥ śatrūn ᵥnaḥ ᵥati asmānatikramya ᵥnaya anyatra prāpaya |
ᵥnaḥ asmān ᵥsugā suṣṭhu gantuṃ śakyena ᵥsupathā śobhanamārgeṇa ᵥkṛṇu gantṝn kuru |
he ᵥpūṣan ᵥiha adhvani ᵥkratuṃ prajñānamasmadrakṣaṇarūpaṃ ᵥvidaḥ jānīhi ||
‘gluñja pasta gatau’ ityatra saścimapyeke paṭhantīti dhātuvṛttāvuktam |
abhi suyavasaṃ naya na navajvāro adhvane | pūrṣabhiha kratuṃ vidaḥ ||8|| abhi | suyavasam | naya | na | nava'jvāraḥ | adhvane | pūrṣan | iha | kratum | vidaḥ ||8||
he ᵥpūṣan ᵥsuyavasaṃ śobhanatṛṇopalakṣitaṃ sarvopadhiyuktaṃ deśam ᵥabhi ᵥnaya asmānabhitaḥ prāpaya |
ᵥadhvane mārgāya ᵥnavajvāraḥ nūtanaḥ saṃtāpaḥ ᵥna bhavatviti śeṣaḥ |
mārge gacchatāmasmākamidānīṃtanaḥ kleśaḥ ko'pi mā bhūdityarthaḥ |
śobhanaṃ yavasaṃ yasmin deśe sa suyavaso deśaḥ |
śadhi pṛdhi pra yaṃsi ca śiśīhi prāsyudaram | pūṣanniha kratuṃ vidaḥ || 9 || śadhi | pṛdhi | pra | yaṃsi | ca | śiśīhi | prāsi | udaram | pūṣan | iha | kratum | vidaḥ ||9||

he pūṣan śadhi asmānanugrahītuṃ śakko bhava | pṛdhi asmadgṛhaṃ dhanena pūraya | kiṃca pra yaṃsi anyadapyapekṣitaṃ vastu prayaccha | śiśīhi asmān sarveṣu madhye tīkṣṇīkuru tejasvinaḥ kuru ityarthaḥ | udaram asmadīyaṃ prāsi mṛṣṭānnena somarasena vā pūraya | anyat pūrvavat || śadhi | ‘śakku śaktau’ | loṭo hiḥ | ‘bahulaṃ chandasi’ iti vikaraṇasya luk | ‘hujhalbhyo hedhiḥ’ iti dhirādeśaḥ | herapistvāt pratyayasvareṇodāttatvam | pṛdhi | ‘pṛ pālanapūraṇayoḥ’ | ‘śruśrupukkṛvṛbhyaśchandasi’ iti herdhirādeśaḥ | pūrvavadvikaraṇasya luk | ‘udoṣṭhyapūrvasya’ iti uttvam | ‘hali ca’ iti dīrghaḥ | tiṅaḥ para- tvāt nighātābhāvaḥ | yaṃsi | ‘yama uparame’ | loḍarthe laṭi pūrvavadvikaraṇasya luk | nighātaḥ | śiśīhi | ‘śo tanūkaraṇe’ | loṭi ‘bahulaṃ chandasi’ (pā. sū. 7. 4. 78) iti abhyāsasya itvam | ‘ī halyaghoḥ’ iti ītvam | pratyayasvaraḥ | prāsi | ‘prā pūraṇe’ | adāditvāt śapo luk | sipaḥ pittvādanudāttatve dhātusvaraḥ ||
na pūṣaṇaṃ methāmasi sūktairabhi gṛṇīmasi | vasūnni dasmamīmahe || 10 || na | pūṣaṇam | methāmasi | su'uktaiḥ | abhi | gṛṇīmasi | vasūn | dasmam | īmahe ||10||

pūṣaṇaṃ devaṃ na methāmasi vayaṃ na tu nindāmaḥ | kiṃtu sūkteḥ vedagataiḥ abhi gṛṇīmasi sarvatra stumaḥ | dasmaṃ darśanīyaṃ pūṣaṇaṃ prati vasūn dhanāni īmahe yācāmahe || methāmasi | ‘methu medhā- hiṃsanayoḥ’ | laṭi ‘indato masi’ iti masa ikāragamaḥ | sūktaiḥ | suṣṭhu stuvate devatāḥ prakāśayantīti sūktāni | ‘kiccau ca saṃjñāyām’ iti kartari kaḥ | ‘vacisvapi’ ityādinā saṃprasāraṇam | thāthādi- svaraḥ | yadvā | karmaṇi niṣṭhā | ‘sūpamānāt kaḥ’ (pā. sū. 6. 2. 145) ityuttarapadāntodātta- tvam | gṛṇīmasi | ‘gṛ śabde’ | ‘pvādīnāṃ hrasvaḥ’ iti hrasvatvam | idanto masiḥ | dasmam | ‘iṣi- yudhīṣmidasiṣyādhūsamyo mak’ (u. sū. 1. 142) iti makpratyayaḥ || || 25 ||
atrānukramyate- ‘kadrudrāya nava raudraṃ tṛtīyā maitrāvaruṇī cānyastṛcaḥ saumyo'nyānuṣṭup’ iti |
sarveṣu rudradevatākeṣu karmasu anena sūktena digupasthānaṃ kartavyam |
tathā ca sūtritaṃ- ‘kadrudrāyemā rudrāya te pitarimā rudrāya sthiradhanvana iti sarvarudrayajñeṣu diśāmupasthānam’ (āśva. gṛ. 4. 1. 21-22) iti ||
kadrudrāya pracetase mīḻhuṣṭamāya tavyase | vocema śaṃtamaṃ hṛde || 1 || kat | rudrāya | pra'cetase | mīḻhuṣṭa'tamāya | tavyase | vocema | śam'tamam | hṛde || 1 ||

^kat kadā ^rudrāya etannāmakāya devāya ^śaṃtamam atiśayena sukhakaraṃ stotraṃ ^vocema paṭhema | kīdṛśāya | ^pracetase prakṛṣṭajñānayuktāya ^mīḻahuṣṭamāya sektutamaya abhīkāmavarṣāyetyarthaḥ | ^tabhyase atiśayena pravṛddhāya ^hade asmadīyahṛddiṣṭāya || kat, kadā | antyalopaścchandasaḥ | rudrāya | rodayati sarvamantakāle iti rudraḥ | ‘rodeṇilukca’ (u. sū. 2. 179 ) iti rakpratyayaḥ | pracetase | ‘citī saṃśāne’ | prakṛṣṭaṃ cetatīti pracetaḥ | gatikārakayorapi pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaratvaṃ ca iti asun pūrvapadaprakṛti- svaratvaṃ ca | mīḻahuṣṭamāya | atiśayena mīḍhvān mīḻahuṣṭamaḥ | ‘dādhān sāhvān mīḍhāṃśca’ iti asu- pratyayānto nipātitaḥ | tamapi ayasmādisvena bhavān ‘vasoḥ saṃprasāraṇam’ iti saṃprasāraṇam | ‘śāsivasighasīnāṃ ca’ iti patram | tabhyase | navanivṛddhyarthaḥ sautro dhātuḥ | atiśayena tavitā tavīyān | ‘tubhchandasi’ iti īyasunpratyayaḥ | ‘turighemeyaḥsu’ iti tulopaḥ | īyasuna īkāralopa- śchandasaḥ | nittvādādyudāttatvam | vocema | ‘vaca paribhāṣaṇe’ | ‘liḍaśāśiṣyaṅ’ | ‘vaca um’ iti umāgamaḥ | yāsuṭaḥ svareṇa ekāra udāttaḥ | hṛde | ‘padana’ ityādinā hṛdayaśabdasya hṛdādeśaḥ | ‘uḍiḍam’ ityādinā vibhakterudāttatvam ||
yathā no aditiḥ karatpaśve nṛbhyo yathā gavai | yathā tokārya rudriyam ||2|| yathā | naḥ | aditiḥ | karat | paśve | nṛ'bhyaḥ | yathā | gavai | yathā | tokārya | rudriyam ||2||
^aditiḥ bhūmiḥ ^naḥ asmākaṃ ^rudriyaṃ rudrasambandhi bheṣajaṃ ^yathā yena prakāreṇa sidhyati ^karat tathā karotu |
kiṃca ^yathā yena prakāreṇa ^paśve asmadīyāśvamahiṣādipaśve ^nṛbhyaḥ asmadīyapuruṣebhyo viśeṣeṇa ^gave gojātaye hitaṃ rudriyaṃ sidhyati tathā karotu |
kiṃca ^tokāya asmadīyāpatyāya rudriyaṃ ^yathā sidhyati tathā karotu |
bheṣajasya rudrasambandhitvaṃ mantrāntare samā- jñātaṃ—‘yā te rudra śivā tanūḥ śivā viśvāhabheṣajī |
gavādiviṣayabheṣajaṃ cānyatra spaṣṭamāmnātaṃ—‘bheṣajaṃ gave'śvāya puruṣāya bheṣaja- matho asmabhyaṃ bheṣajaṃ subheṣajam’ (tai. saṃ. 1. 8. 6. 1) iti ||
ādyayoḥ pakṣayoḥ pratyayasya pittvādan udāttatve dhātu- svaraḥ |
‘sāvekācaḥ’ iti prāptasya vibhaktyudāttasya ‘na gobhansāvarṇa’ iti pratiṣedhaḥ |
yathā no mitro varuṇo yathā rudraściketati | yathā viśve sajoṣasaḥ || 3 || yathā | naḥ | mitraḥ | varuṇaḥ | yathā | rudraḥ | ciketati | yathā | viśve | sa'joṣasaḥ ||3||
^mitro ^vahagaḥ ca ^naḥ asmān ^yathā yena prakāreṇa ^ciketati anugrāhatvena jānāti |
^sajoṣasaḥ samānaprītayaḥ ^viśve sarve devāḥ ^yathā ciketanti tathā bhavatviti

śeṣa: | yadvā | yathāśabdopetamantradvayasya tathā kadā vocemeti pūrvatrānvayaḥ || ciketati | 'kita jñāne' | leṭi aḍāgamaḥ | 'nābhyastasya' (pā. sū. 7. 3. 80) iti guṇaniṣedhena bhavati, 'bahulaṃ chandasīti vaktavyam' iti vacanāt | sārvadhātukatvācca 'abhyastānāmādiḥ' ityādyudāttatvam | sajopasaḥ | 'juṣī prītisevanayoḥ' | samānaṃ jupantīti sajopasaḥ | 'samānasya chandasi' iti sabhāṣaḥ | asuno nittvāduttarapadasyādyudāttatvam | tadeva kuduttarapadaprakṛtisvaratvena śiṣyate ||
gātha'patim | medha'patim | rudram | jalāṣa'bheṣajam | tat | śaṃyoḥ | sunmam | īmahe ||4||
rudram abhilakṣya vayaṃ 'śaṃyoḥ: bṛhaspatiputrasya saṃbandha 'tat prasiddhaṃ sarvaprajāmyo hitaṃ 'sunnaṃ sukham 'īmahe yācāmahe |
udakaṃ hi rudranāmābhimantritaṃ sat auṣadhaṃ bhavati ||
gāthā iti vāṅnāma, 'gāthā gaṇaḥ' (ni. 1. 11. 37) iti takṣāmasu paṭhitatvāt |
'patyāvaiśvaryaṃ' iti pūrvapadaprakṛtisvare prāpte 'marudbṛdhādīnāṃ chandasyupasaṃkhyānam' iti pūrva- padāntodāttatvam |
'anyevapi dṛśyate' (pā. sū. 3. 2. 101) iti raśigrahaṇāt kevalādapi ḍapratyayaḥ |
jalāṣarūpaṃ bheṣajaṃ yasmin rudre sa jalāṣabheṣajaḥ |
yaḥ | śukraḥ'iva | sūryaḥ | hiraṇyam'iva | rocate | śreṣṭhaḥ | devānām | vasuḥ || 5 ||
yathā sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ hiraṇyaṃ prītikaraṃ bhavati tathā rudro'pi |
praśasyaśabdāt iṣṭhani 'praśasyasya śraḥ' (pā. sū. 5. 3. 60) iti śrādeśaḥ |
'atha yathemam' iti khaṇḍe sūtritaṃ- 'vaiśvānarāya pṛthupājase śaṃ naḥ karayate' (ādha. śrau. 5. 20 ) iti ||
śaṃ naḥ karatyarvate sugaṃ meṣāya meṣyai | nṛbhyo nāribhyo gave || 6 || śam | naḥ | karati | arvate | sugam | meṣāya | meṣyai | nṛbhyaḥ | nāribhyaḥ | gave ||6||
'naḥ asmākaṃ sambandhibhyaḥ arvādādibhyaḥ 'sugaṃ suṣṭhu gamyaṃ 'śaṃ sukhaṃ 'karati devaḥ karoti |
'meṣāya meṣa- jātipuruṣāya 'meṣyai tajjātīyastriyai 'nṛbhyaḥ puruṣebhyaḥ 'nāribhyaḥ strībhyaḥ 'gave gojātaye ||
'udāttayaṇo halpūrvāt' iti tu na bhavati, 'sarve vidhayaśchandasi vikalpyante' iti vacanāt |
'sāvekācaḥ' iti prāptasya vibhaktyudāttasya 'nṛ cānyatara- syām' iti pratiṣedhaḥ |
'nṛnarayorvṛddhiñca' (pā. sū. 4. 1. 73 ga.) iti śārṅgaravādiṣu pāṭhāt ṅīnpratyayaḥ |
asme saum śriyamadhi ni dhehi śatasya nṛṇām | mahi śravastvinumṇam ||7|| asme iti | soma | śriyam | adhi | ni | dhehi | śatasya | nṛṇām | mahi | śravaḥ | tuvi'nṛmṇam ||7||
he 'soma deva 'nṛṇāṃ puruṣāṇāṃ 'śatasya paryāptāṃ 'śriyam 'asme asmāsu 'adhi 'ni 'dhehi ādhikyena sthāpaya |
tathā 'mahi mahat 'tuvinṛmṇaṃ prabhūtabalayuktaṃ 'śravaḥ annam adhi ni dhehi ||
mā naḥ somaparibādho mārātayo juhuranta | ā na indo vājeṃ bhaja || 8 || mā | naḥ | soma'paribādhaḥ | mā | arātayaḥ | juhuranta | ā | naḥ | indo iti | vājai | bhaja ||8||
'somaparibādhaḥ somasya parito bādhakā yāgarahitāḥ 'naḥ asmān 'mā 'juhuranta mā hiṃsantu |
he 'indo soma 'vāje balaviṣaye'vipaye vā 'naḥ asmān 'ā 'bhaja sarvataḥ sevasva ||
'bahula chandasi' (pā. sū. 7. 1. 103) iti bahulavacanāt ikārasyāpi utvam |
'sarve vidhayaśchandasi vikalpyante' iti vacanāt 'adabhyastāt' (pā. sū. 7. 1. 4) iti adādeśābhāve sati 'jho'ntaḥ' iti antādeśaḥ |

yāstai prajā amṛtasya parasmindhāmanṛtasya | mūrdhā nābhā soma vena ābhūṣantīḥ soma vedaḥ || 9 || yāḥ | te | pra'jāḥ | amṛtasya | parasmin | dhāman | ṛtasya | mūrdhā | nābhā | soma | venaḥ | ā'bhūṣantīḥ | soma | vedaḥ || 9 ||

he soma te tava saṃbandhinyaḥ yāḥ prajāḥ santi stotraṃ vā kurvanti tāḥ prajāḥ mūrdhā śiraḥ- sthānīyastvaṃ nābhā saṃhananayukte yajñagṛhe venaḥ kāmayasva | kīdṛśasya te | amṛtasya maraṇarahitasya parasmindhāmanṛtasya uttame sthāne prātasya | he soma ābhūṣantīḥ sarvatastvāmalaṃkurvantīḥ prajāḥ vedaḥ jānīhi || dhāman | ' supāṃ suluk ' iti saptamyā luk | nābhā | ' ṇaha bandhane ' | ' naho bhaśra ' ( u. sū. 4. 565 ) iti karmaṇi ipratyayaḥ | jittvādādyudāttatvam | ' supāṃ suluk ' iti saptamyā ḍādeśaḥ | venaḥ | ' venatiḥ kāntikarmā ' ( ni. 2.6.4 ) | leṭi sipi aḍā- gamaḥ | ' tiṅatiṅaḥ ' iti nighātaḥ | ābhūṣantīḥ | ' bhūpa alaṃkāre ' | bhauvādikaḥ | śapaḥ pittvā- nudāttatvam, śatuśca lasārvadhātukasvareṇa | dhātusvareṇa ādyudāttatvam | samāse kṛduttarapadaprakṛtisvaratvam | vedaḥ | ' vida jñāne ' | leṭi sipi aḍāgamaḥ || || 27 || || 8 ||
tatra ' agne vivasvat ' iti caturdaśacaṃ prathamaṃ sūktam |
atrānu- kramaṇikā— ' agne paṅknā praskaṇvaḥ kāṇva āgneyaṃ tu prāgāthamādyo dvauco'bhyupasāṃ ca ' iti |
prātaranuvāke āgneye ṛtau bārhate chandasyāśvinaśastre cedaṃ sūktam |
' ayaitasyā rātreḥ ' iti khaṇḍe sūtritam— ' agne vivasvatsakhāyastvā ' ( āśva. śrau. 4. 13 ) iti |
' vājapeyena ' iti khaṇḍe sūtritaṃ— ' citravatīṣu cet stuvītaṃsavaṃ naścitra ūryābhe vivasvadupasa ityamiṣṭomasāmnaḥ stotriyā- nurūpā ' ( āśva. śrau. 9. 9 ) iti |
' yadi paryāyānabhiyucchet ' iti khaṇḍe ' āśvināyakāntitriyo'gne vivasvadupasaḥ ' ( āśva. śrau. 6. 6 ) iti sūtritam ||

agne vivasvadupasaścitraṃ rādho amartya | ā dāśuṣe jātavedo vahā tvamadyā devā~ uparbudhaḥ || 1 || agne | vivasvat | upasaḥ | citram | rādhaḥ | amartya | ā | dāśuṣe | jāta'vedaḥ | vaha | tvam | adya | devān | upaḥ'budhaḥ || 1 ||
he agne tvam upasaḥ upodevatāyāḥ sakāśāt rādhaḥ dhanaṃ dāśuṣe havirdattavate yajamānāya ā vaha ānīya prāpaya |

tametaṃ śabdaṃ yāsko vyācaṣṭe- 'jātavedāḥ kasmāt | jātāni veda jātāni vainaṃ vidurjāte jāte vidyata iti vā jātavitto vā jātadhano jātavitto vā jātaprajñāno yattajjātaḥ paśūnavindateti tajjātavedaso jātavedasvamiti brāhmaṇam | tasmātsarvāṃtūnapaśavo'gnimabhisarpantīti ca ' (niru. 7. 19) iti | kīdṛśaṃ rādhaḥ | 'vivasvata viśiṣṭanivāsopetaṃ 'citraṃ nānāvidham | kiṃca 'atha asmin dine 'uṣa- budhaḥ upaḥkāle prabuddhān 'devān ā vaha | vivasvata | vivāsanaṃ vivaḥ tayupham | 'vasa nivāse ' | vipūrvāt antarbhāvitaṇyarthāt saṃpadādilakṣaṇo bhāve kvip | 'tasyāsmin ' iti matup | 'mādhapadhāyāḥ ' iti vatvam | 'tasau matvarthe ' iti bhāvena pañcatvābhāvāt rūtvābhāvaḥ | vṛṣādivādādyudāttatvam | rādhaḥ | 'rādha sādha saṃsiddhau ' | rādhotyaneneti rādho dhanam | karaṇe'sun | niccādādyudāttatvam | dāśuṣe | 'dāśva dāne ' | 'dāśvān sāhān ' iti kamupratyayānto nipātitaḥ | caturthyekavacane 'vasoḥ saṃprasāraṇam ' iti saṃprasāraṇam | 'śāsivasi ' iti patvam | jātavedaḥ | jātāni vetīti jātavedāḥ | 'gatikārakayorapi pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaratvaṃ ca ' iti asun | yadvā | veda iti dhananāma | jātaṃ dhanaṃ yasya sa tādṛśaḥ | āmantritanivātaḥ | vaha | 'ayo'tasmin ' iti saṃhitāyāṃ dīrghatvam | devān | 'dīrghadiṭi samānapāde ' iti saṃhitāyāṃ nakārasya rūtvam | 'āto'ṭi nityam ' iti sānunāsika ākāraḥ | upabudhaḥ | upasi budhyante ityupabudhaḥ | 'budha avagamane ' | 'kvip ca ' iti kvip | roḥ utvābhāvaśchāndasaḥ | kṛduttarapadaprakṛtisvaratvam ||
juṣṭo hi dūto asi havyavāhano'gne rathīradhvarāṇām |
juṣṭaḥ | hi | dūtaḥ | asi | havyavāhanaḥ | agne | rathīḥ | adhvarāṇām | saṃjūḥ | aśvibhyām | upasā | suvīryam | asme iti | dhehi | śravaḥ | bṛhat || 2 ||
'dūtaḥ devānāṃ vārtāhāraḥ 'havya- vāhanaḥ haviṣo voḍhā 'adhvarāṇāṃ ṛtūnāṃ 'rathīḥ rathasthānīyaḥ |
tathā ca mantrāntaraṃ brāhmaṇenaiva ' vyākhyātaṃ- 'rathīradhvarāṇāmityāhaipa hi devarathaḥ ' (tai. saṃ. 2. 5. 9. 2) iti |
brāhmaṇāntaraṃ ca- 'rathī- radhvarāṇāmityāha ratho ha vā eṣa bhūto devebhyo havyaṃ vahati ' iti |

viśeṣeṇocchyante tamasā varjyante iti vyuṣṭyaḥ upaḥkālāḥ |

śreṣṭhaṃ yaviṣṭhamatithiṃ svāhutaṃ juṣṭaṃ janāya dāśuṣe |

he ᵥamṛta maraṇarahita ᵥviśvasya ᵥbhojana kṛtsnasya jagataḥ pālaka ᵥhavyavāhana haviṣo voḍhaḥ ᵥmiyedhya yajñāī evaṃvidha he ᵥagne viśvasya ᵥtrātāraṃ sarvasya jagato rakṣakam ᵥamṛtaṃ maraṇarahitaṃ ᵥyaji- ṣṭham atiśayena yaṣṭāraṃ ᵥtvāmaham anuṣṭhātā ᵥstuviṣpāmi stutiṃ kariṣyāmi || stuviṣpāmi | ‘huñ stutau’ | vyatyayena haḍāgamaḥ | āgamānudāttatve pratyayasvaraḥ | bhojana | karmaphalaṃ bhojayatīti bhojanaḥ | nandyādilakṣaṇo lyuḥ | trātāram | ‘traiṅ pālane’ | ‘ādecaḥ’ iti ātvam | tṛci ‘ekāca upadeśe’ iti itpratiṣedhaḥ | amṛtam | ‘najo jaramaramitramṛtāḥ’ ityuttarapadāyudāttatvam | miyedhya | iyāgama- ścāndasaḥ | yajiṣṭham | yaṣṭaśabdāt ‘tucchandasi’ iti iṣṭhanpratyayaḥ | ‘turiṣṭhemeyaḥsu’ iti tulopaḥ || ||24||

he ᵥyaviṣṭhya yuvatama! tvaṃ ᵥgṛṇate stuvate yajamānāya ᵥsuśaṃsaḥ suṣṭhu śaṃsanīyaḥ ᵥmadhujihvaḥ mādyayit- jvālaḥ ᵥsvāhutaḥ suṣṭhu abhimukhyena hutaḥ man ᵥbodhi asmadabhiprāyaṃ budhyasva | kiṃca ᵥpraskaṇvasya etannāmakasya kaṇvaputrasya maharṣeḥ | ‘praskaṇvaḥ | kaṇvasya putraḥ kaṇvaprabhavaḥ ’ (niru. 3. 17) iti yāska- vacanāt | tasya ᵥjīvase jīvanārtham ᵥāyuḥ ᵥpratiran prakarṣeṇa vardhayan ᵥdaivyaṃ devasambandhinaṃ ᵥjanaṃ ᵥnamasya pūjaya || suśaṃsaḥ | ‘śaṃsu stutau’ | bhāve ghañ | śobhanaḥ śaṃso yasyāsau suśaṃsaḥ | ‘āyudāttaṃ ścāndasa’ ityuttarapadāyudāttatvam | bodhi | ‘budha avagamane’ | loṭo hiḥ | ‘bahula chandasi’ iti vikaraṇasya luk | ‘huśślubhyo hedhiḥ’ iti herdhirādeśaḥ | ‘vā chandasi’ iti apittvasya vika- lpitatvāt laghūpadhaguṇaḥ | dhātoranyalopaśchāndasaḥ | gṛṇate | ‘gṛ śabde’ | laṭaḥ śatṛ | ‘ṛdhādibhyaḥ kśā’ | ‘bhābhyastayorātaḥ’ iti ākāralopaḥ | ‘śataranumaḥ’ iti vibhakterudāttatvam | yaviṣṭhya | gatam | praskaṇvasya | prakṛtirupattiḥ | kaṇvādyasya sa praskaṇvaḥ | ‘praskaṇvahariścandrāvṛṣī’ (pā.sū. 6. 1. 153) iti suḍāgamo nipātitaḥ | bahuvrīhau pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaratvam | pratiran | apūrvastiratirvardhanārthaḥ | namasya | namovarivaścitrahaḥ kyac’ (pā.sū. 3. 1. 19) iti pūjārthe kyac | pratyayasvaraḥ | ‘anyeṣāṃmapi dṛśyate’ iti saṃhitāyāṃ dīrghatvam | daivyam | ‘devādyañ’ (pā. sū. 4. 1. 85) iti tasyedamimyarthe prāgdīvyatīyo yañpratyayaḥ || ka, 41

prātaranuvāke āśvine kratau gāyatrīcchanda-syāśvinaśastre cedaṃ sūktam |

'yā 'devā yāvubhāvaśvinau vakṣyamāṇaguṇayuktau tau stuṣe iti pūrvatrānvayaḥ |
yadyapi sūryācandramasāveva samudrajau tathāpyaśvinoḥ keṣāṃcinmate tadrūpatvāt tathātvam |
'rayīṇāṃ dhanānāṃ 'manottarā manasā tārayitārau 'dhiyā karmaṇā 'vasuvidā nivāsasthānasya lambhayitārau |
pūrvapadāntasya sakārasya hrave sati chāndasam uttvam |

va॒cyante॒ vā̭ṃ ka॒kuhā̭so jūrṇā॒yāmadhi̭ vi॒ṣṭapi̭ | ya॒dvāṃ ra॒tho vi̭bhi॒ṣpatā̭t || 3 || va॒cyantḙ | vā॒m | ka॒kuhā̭saḥ | jūrṇā॒yām | adhi̭ | vi॒ṣṭapi̭ | ya॒t | vā॒m | ra॒thaḥ | vi॒'bhiḥ | pa॒tāt || 3 ||

he aśvinau 'vāṃ yuvayoḥ saṃbandhī 'rathaḥ 'jūrṇāyāṃ nānāśākhaiḥ stutāyām 'adhi 'viṣṭapi svargaloke 'yat yadā 'vibhiḥ aśvaiḥ 'patāt patati gacchati tadānīṃ 'vāṃ yuvayoḥ 'kakuhāsaḥ stutayaḥ 'vacyante asmābhirvacyante |
bravīteryaki 'bruvo vaciḥ' ( pā. sū. 2. 4. 53 ) iti vacyādeśaḥ |
'saṃprasāraṇācca' ityatra 'vā chandasi' ityanuvṛtteḥ parapūrvatvasya pākṣikatvāt yaṇādeśaḥ |
'kakubha śraddhe viduḥ pradhāne ca' ityabhidhānāt prādhānyābhidhāyinā kakubhaśabdena tatpratipādikāḥ stutayo lakṣyante |
haviṣā jāro apāṃ pirpati parpurinarā | pitā kuṭasya carṣaṇi: || 4 || haviṣā | jāra: | apām | pirpati | parpuri: | narā | pitā | kuṭasya | carṣaṇi: || 4 ||
he aśvinau devau vaapāṃ vajāra: svakīyatāpenodakānāṃ jarayitā sūrya: vahaviṣā asmaddattena vapirpati devān pūrayati |
udite sūrye haviṣpradānāt sūryasya pūrakatvaṃ draṣṭavyam |
vaparpuri: uktakrameṇa pūraṇasvabhāva: vapitā pālaka: vakuṭasya vacarṣaṇi: karmaṇo draṣṭā |
atra niruktaṃ- ‘haviṣāpāṃ jarayitā pirpati parpuririti pṛṇātinigamau vā prīṇātinigamau vā pitā kṛtasya karmaṇaścāyitāditya: ’ ( niru. 5. 24 ) iti ||
‘ dārajārau kartari ṇiluka ca ’ ( pā. sū. 3. 3. 20. 4 ) iti ghañanto nipātita: |
liṅtvāt kittve siddhe'pi puna: kakaraṇasāmarthyāt ‘ ṛcchatyṛtām ’ ( pā. sū. 7. 4. 11 ) iti guṇābhāva: |
ādāro vāṃ matīnāṃ nāsatyā matavacasā | pātaṃ somasya dhṛṣṇuyā || 5 || ādāra: | vām | matīnām | nāsatyā | mata'vacasā | pātam | somasya | dhṛṣṇuyā ||5||

he vamatavacasā abhimatastotrau vanāsatyā aśvinau vavāṃ yuvayo: vamatīnāṃ buddhīnām vaādāra: prerako ya: somo'sti vasomasya taṃ somaṃ vapātaṃ yuvāṃ pibatam | kīdṛśaṃ somam | vadhṛṣṇuyā gharṣaṇaśīlam | madakaratvena tīvramityartha: || ādāra: | ‘ dṛ ādare ’ | ādārayatīti ādāra: | ‘ dārajārau kartari ṇiluka ’ iti ghañapratyaya: | thāthādinā uttarapadāntodāttatvam | matīnām | ‘ nāmanpatarasyām ’ iti nāma udāttatvam | matavacasā | matamabhimanaṃ stotrarūpaṃ vaco yayostau | ‘ supāṃ suluk ’ iti vibhakte: ākāra: | pātam | ‘ pā pāne ’ | ‘ bahula chandasi ’ iti śapo luki sati ‘ pāghrā ’ chāyā- dinā pibādeśo na bhavati | somasya | ‘ kriyāgrahaṇaṃ kartavyam ’ iti karmaṇa: saṃpradānatvāt caturthyarthe ṣaṣṭhī | dhṛṣṇuyā | ‘ supāṃ suluk ’ iti vibhakte: yājādeśa: || || 33 ||
yā na: pīraradaśvinā jyotiṣmatī tamastira: | tāmasme rāsāthāmiṣam ||6|| yā | na: | pīrarat | aśvinā | jyotiṣmatī | tama: | tira: | tām | asme iti | rāsāthām | iṣam || 6 ||
he vaaśvinā vajyotiṣmatī rasavīryādirūpajyotiryuktā vayā idaṃ annaṃ vana: asmān vapīrarat pārayet nṛsiṃ prāpayet |
vatama: dāridryarūpamandhakāraṃ vatira: antarhitaṃ vinaṣṭaṃ kṛtvā vatām vaiṣaṃ tādṛśa- mannam vaasme asmabhyaṃ varāsāthāṃ yuvāṃ dattam ||

aḍabhāvaḥ | 'caṅanyatarasyām' (pā. sū. 6.1.218) iti upottamasya dhātvakārasyodāttatve prāpte vyatyayena abhyāsasyodāttatvam | 'yadvṛttānnityam' iti nighātapratiṣedhaḥ | asme | 'supāṃ suluk' iti caturthībahuvacanasya śeādeśaḥ | rāsāthām | 'rā dāne' | chāndase prārthanāyāṃ luṅi vyatyayenātmane- padam | kleḥ sic | 'ekācaḥ' iti iṭpratiṣedhaḥ | pūrvavata aṭabhāvaḥ | 'tiṅaṅatiṅaḥ' iti nighātaḥ ||
ā nau nāvā matīnāṃ yāta̭ pārāya॒ ganta̭ve | yu॒jñāthā̭maśvinā ra॒tham || 7 || ā | naḥ | nāvā | matīnām | yātam | pārāya | gantave | yujñāthām | aśvinā | ratham || 7 ||

he aśvinā matīnāṃ stutīnāṃ pārāya gantave pāraṃ gantuṃ nāvā nau rūpeṇa gamanasādhanena naḥ asmān prati ā yātam samudramadhyādāgacchatam | bhūnāvāgantuṃ rathaṃ bhavatīyaṃ yujñāthāṃ sārtha- kurutam || nāvā | 'sāvekācaḥ' iti vibhakterudāttatvam | gantave | 'tumarthe sesen' iti taven- pratyayaḥ | nittvādāyudāttatvam | yujñāthām | 'yujir yoge' | loṭi āthāmi rudāditvāt śam | 'bhasoralopaḥ' iti akāralopaḥ | pratyayasvaraḥ ||
ari̭traṃ vāṃ di॒vaspṛthu tī॒rthe sindhṷ̄nāṃ ra॒tham | dhi॒yā yṷyuja॒ inda̭vaḥ || 8 || aritram | vām | divaḥ | pṛthu | tīrthe | sindhūnām | ratham | dhiyā | yuyuje | indavaḥ || 8 ||
he aśvinau vāṃ yuvayoḥ divaspṛthu dyulokādapi vistīrṇam aritraṃ gamanasādhanaṃ naurūpaṃ sindhūnāṃ samudrāṇāṃ tīrthe avataraṇapradeśe vidyate iti śeṣaḥ |
indavaḥ somāḥ dhiyā bhavadviṣayeṇa karmaṇā yuyuje yuktā babhūvuḥ ||
liṭi 'irayo re' (pā. sū. 6. 4. 76) iti ireco reādeśaḥ ||
di॒vaska̭ṇvāsa inda॒vo va॒su sindhṷ̄nāṃ pa॒de | svaṃ vṛ॒traṃ ku॒ha dhi̭ttasaḥ || 9 || divaḥ | kaṇvasaḥ | indavaḥ | vasu | sindhūnām | pade | svam | vṛtram | kuha | dhitsathaḥ || 9 ||
sindhūnām apāṃ vṛṣṭirūpāṇāṃ syandanasvabhāvānāṃ pade sthāne'ntarikṣe vasu asmadādinivāsahetubhūtamupaḥkālīṃ jyotirāvirbhūtamiti śeṣaḥ |
asminnavasare yuvāṃ svaṃ vṛtraṃ svakīyaṃ rūpaṃ kuha dhitsathaḥ kutra sthāpayitumicchathaḥ |
'vā ha ca chandasi' (pā. sū. 5. 3. 13) iti ki- śabdāt saptamyarthe hapratyayaḥ |
'sani mīmāghurabhalabhaśakapatapadāmaca is' (pā. sū. 7. 4. 54) iti ākārasya imādeśaḥ |
abhūdu bhā uṃ aṃśave hiraṇyaṃ prati sūryaiḥ | vargyayajjihvayāsitaḥ || 10 || abhūt | ūṃ iti | bhāḥ | ūṃ iti | aṃśave | hiraṇyam | prati | sūryaiḥ | vi | akhyat | jihvayā | asitaḥ || 10 ||
ᵥbhā ᵥu sūryasya dīptistu ᵥaṃśave upaḥkālīnaraśmisādhuyartham ᵥabhūdu prādurbhūtaiva |
ᵥsūryaḥ ca ᵥhiraṇyaṃ ᵥprati svakīyodayena hiraṇyasadṛśo'bhūt |
agniśca ᵥasitaḥ svakīyadīpteḥ sūryapraveśena svayaṃ kṛṣṇo bhūtvā ᵥjihvayā svakīyayā jvālayā ᵥvyakhyat prakāśitavān |
‘pratiḥ pratinidhiprati- dānayoḥ’ (pā. sū. 1. 4. 92) iti prateḥ karmapravacanīyatvam |
vāvasānā vivasvati somasya pītyā girā| manuṣvacchaṃbhū ā gaṃtam ||13|| vavasānā | vivasvati | somasya | pītyā | girā | manuṣ‌vat | śaṃbhū iti śaṃ'bhū | ā | gatam || 13 ||
he śaṃbhū sukhasya bhāvitārāvaśvinau manuṣ‌vat manādiva vivasvati paricaraṇavati yajamāne vavasānā nivāsaśīlau yuvāṃ somasya pītyā somasya pānanimittaṃ girā stutinimittaṃ ca ā gatam āgacchatam ||
yasya niḥśvasitaṃ vedā yo vedebhyo'khilaṃ jagat |
'ayaṃ nāma' iti navamānuvākasya caturthaṃ sūktaṃ daśarcam |
tathā pūrvatra 'āśvinaṃ tu' ityuktatvāt tadvādiparibhāṣayā idamapi sūktamaśvi- devatākam |
'athāśvinaḥ' iti khaṇḍe sūtritam—'imā u vāmayaṃ vām' (āśva. śrau. 4. 15) iti |
ayaṃ vāṃ madhumattamaḥ sutaḥ soma ṛtāvṛdhā |
tamaśvinā pibataṃ tiroahnyaṃ ghṛtaṃ ratnāni dāśuṣe ||
ayam | vām | madhumattamaḥ | sutaḥ | somaḥ | ṛtāvṛdhā | tam | aśvinā | pibatam | tiraḥahnyam | ghṛtam | ratnāni | dāśuṣe || 1 ||
he ṛtāvṛdhā ṛtasya satyasya yajñasya vā vardhayitārau aśvinā aśvinau vāṃ yuvayoḥ 'ayaṃ purovartī 'somaḥ 'sutaḥ abhiṣutaḥ |
'sarve vidhayaśchandasi vikalpyante' iti vacanāt 'ye cābhāvakarmaṇoḥ' (pā. sū. 6. 4. 168) iti prakṛtibhāvābhāve 'alopo'naḥ' iti akāralopaḥ |
'tiro'ntardhau' (pā. sū. 1. 4. 71) iti gativena nipātatvāt avyayatve prādisamāse anyapūrvapadaprakṛtisvaratvam |

trivandhureṇa trivṛtā supeśasā rathenā yātamāśrinā | kaṇvaso vāṃ brahma kṛṇvantyadhvare teṣāṃ su śṛṇutaṃ havam || 2 || trivandhureṇa | trivṛtā | supeśasā | rathena | ā | yātam | aśvinā | kaṇvasaḥ | vām | brahma | kṛṇvanti | adhvare | teṣām | su | śṛṇutam | havam || 2 ||
he 'śvinā 'trivandhureṇa unnatāntarūpacitrivandhanakādyuktena 'trivṛtā apratihatagatitayā lokatraye vartamānanena 'supeśasā śobhanavarṇayuktena 'rathena 'ā 'yātaṃ ihāgacchatam |
'kaṇvasaḥ kaṇva- putrā medhāvina ṛtvijo vā 'vāṃ yuvayoḥ 'adhvare yāge 'brahma stotrarūpaṃ mantraṃ havirlakṣaṇamannaṃ vā 'kṛṇvanti kurvanti |
he ^viśvavedasā sarvajñāvadhinau ^tridhasthe kakṣyātrayarupegāstīrgatayā triṣu sthāneṣvavasthite ^barhiṣi darbhe sthitvā ^madhvā madhureṇa rasena ^yajñaṃ ^mimikṣataṃ sekumicchatam |
he ^aśvinā ^vāṃ yuṣmadartha ^sutasomāḥ abhiputasomayuktāḥ ^abhidhvaḥ abhigatādisayaḥ ^kaṇavāsaḥ ^yuvām ubhau ^hvante āhvayante |
tripu sthāneṣu saha tiṣṭhatīti tridhasthaṃ barhiḥ |
'jasi ca' ityatra 'jasādiṣu chandasi vāvacanam' (pā. sū. 7. 3. 109. 1) iti vacanāt nābhāvābhāvaśca |
yābhiḥ kaṇvamiṣṭibhiḥ prāvataṃ yuvaramaśvinā | tābhiḥ ^śvasmā avataṃ śubhaspatī pātaṃ somṛtāvṛdhā || 5 ||
yābhiḥ | kaṇvam | abhiṣṭibhiḥ | pra | āvatam | yuvam | aśvinā | tābhiḥ | su | asmān | avatam | śubhaḥ | patī iti | pātama | somam | ṛta'vṛdhā || 5 ||

he ^aśvinā ^yuvaṃ yuvāmubhau ^yābhiḥ ^abhiṣṭibhiḥ apekṣitābhiḥ rakṣābhiḥ ^kaṇvaṃ maharṣa ^prāvataṃ rakṣitavantau he ^śubhaspatī śobhanasya karmaṇaḥ pālako ^tābhiḥ rakṣābhiḥ ^asmān anuṣṭhātṛn ^su ^avataṃ suṣṭhu rakṣatam |
'emannādiṣu chandasi pararūpaṃ vaktavyam' (pā. sū. 6. 1. 94. 6) iti pararūpatvam |
'subāmantrita' iti ṣaṣṭhyantasya parāṅ‌vadbhāvāt ṣaṣṭhyāmantritasamudāyasya āṣṭamikaṃ sarvānudāttatvam |
sudāse dastrā vasu bibhratā rathe pṛkṣo vahatamaśvinā |
rayiṃ samudrāduta vā divasparyasme dhattaṃ puruspṛham |
sudāse | dastrā | vasu | bibhratā | rathe | pṛkṣaḥ | vahatam | aśvinā | rayim | samudrāt | uta | vā | divaḥ | pari | asme iti | dhattam | puru'spṛham || 6 ||
he ^dastrā darśanīyāvaśvinau ^sudāse śobhanadānayuktāya rājñe pijavanaputrāya ^rathe ^vasu ^bibhratā yuvāṃ ^pṛkṣaḥ annaṃ ^vahaṃtaṃ prāpitavantau |
'uta 'vā 'divaspari athavā svargāt paryāhṛtya 'puruspṛhaṃ bahubhiḥ spṛhaṇīyaṃ 'rayiṃ dhanam 'asme 'dhattam asmāsu sthāpayatamū |
jitvareṇa uttarapadasyā- dyudāttatve kuduttarapadaprakṛtisvareṇa tadeva śiṣyate |
yannāsatyā parāvati yadvā stho adhi turvaśeṃ | ato rathena suvṛtā na ā gataṃ sākaṃ sūryasya raśmibhiḥ || 7 ||
yat | nāsatyā | parā'vati | yat | vā | sthaḥ | adhi | turva

bahulam ' iti ṅelopaḥ | pṛjantā | ' pṛcī saṃparke ' | śatari rutrāditvāt am | ' bhaloralopaḥ ' iti akāralopaḥ | pratyayasvaraḥ | mukte | ' sukarmapāpa ' ( pā. sū. 3. 2. 89 ) ityādinā karoteḥ bhūte kāle kri | ' hrasvasya piti ' ( pā. sū. 6. 1. 71 ) iti tuk | mudānave | śobhanaṃ dātu dānaṃ yasyāsau sudānuḥ | dānaśabdo nupratyayānta āyudāttaḥ | ' ādyudāttaṃ cchandasi ' iti bahuvrīhau uttarapadādyudāttatvam | sīdantam | ' pad viśaraṇagatyavasādaneṣu ' ||
yena śaśvadūhathurdāśuṣe vasu madhvaḥ somasya pītayai ||
tena | nāsatyā | ā | gatam | rathena | sūryatvacā |
yena | śaśvat | ūhathuḥ | dāśuṣe | vasu | madhvaḥ | somasya | pītayai || 9 ||
sadasi | sīdantyasminniti sadaḥ | asuno nintvādāyudāttatvam | papaśruḥ | ‘pā pāne’ | liṭi ‘āto lopa iṭi ca’ iti ākāralopaḥ | pratyayasvaraḥ | ‘hi ca’ iti nighātapratiṣedhaḥ || ||2||
prātaranuvāke upasthe ṛtau bārhate chandasīdaṃ sūktam |
‘athopasthaḥ’ iti svaṇḍe sūtritaṃ- ‘pratyu adṛśi maha vāmeneti bārhatam’ (āśva. śrau. 4. 14) iti |
saha vāmena na uṣo vyucchā duhitardivaḥ |
saha dyumnena bṛhatā vibhāvari rāyā devi dāsvatī ||
saha | vāmena̭ | naḥ | uṣaḥ | vi | uccha | duhitaḥ | divaḥ | saha | dyumnena̭ | bṛhatā | vibhā'vari | rāyā | devi | dāsvatī || 1 ||
he ‘duhitardivaḥ’ yudevatāyāḥ putri ‘uṣaḥ’ upaḥkāladevate ‘naḥ’ asmadarthaṃ ‘vāmena’ dhanena ‘saha’ ‘vyuccha prabhātaṃ kuru |
he ‘devi tvaṃ ‘dāsvatī’ dānayuktā satī ‘rāyā’ paśulakṣaṇena dhanena saha vyuccha ||

‘subāmantrita parāṅgavatsvare’ ityatra ‘paramapi chandasi’ (pā. sū. 2. 1. 2. 6) iti vacanāt divaḥ ityasya pūrvāṅgabhāve sati ‘āmantritasya ca’ iti ṣaṣṭhyāmantritasamudāyasya āṣṭamikaṃ sarvānudāttatvam |
‘vano ra ca’ iti ṅīp; tatsaṃyogena nakā- rasya rephādeśaḥ |
udīraya prati mā sūnṛtā uṣoda rādho maghonām ||
aśva̭'vatī | gomatīḥ | viśva'suvidaḥ | bhūri̭ | cyavanta | vastave | ut | īraya | prati | mā | sūnṛtāḥ | uṣaḥ | uda | rādhaḥ | maghonām || 2 ||
aśvāvatī: bahuśvopetāḥ gomatī: bahubhirgobhiryuktāḥ viśvasuvidaḥ: kṛtsnasya dhanasya suṣṭhu lambha- yiṣyaḥ upodevatāḥ vastave prajānāṃ nivāsāya bhūri prabhūtaṃ yathā bhavati tathā cyavanta prāptāḥ |

uṣodevate' 'mā 'prati māmuddisya 'sūnṛtāḥ priyahitavācaḥ 'udīraya brūhi | 'maghonāṃ,dhanavatāṃ saṃbandhva 'rāghaḥ dhanaṃ 'coda' asmadarthaṃ preraya || athāvatīḥ | ' mantre somāścendriyaviśvadevasya matau ' ( pā. sū. 6. 3. 131 ) iti pūrvapadasya dīrghatvam | ' vā chandasi ' iti pūrvasavarṇadīrghaniṣedhasya pākṣikasyokteḥ pūrvasavarṇadīrghatvam | cyavanta | ' cyuṅ gatau ' | laṅi ' bahulaṃ chandasyamāṅyoge'pi ' iti aḍabhāvaḥ | vastave | ' vasa nivāse ' | ' tumarthe sesen ' iti tavenpratyayaḥ | nittvādādyudāttatvam | īraya | ' īra gatau kampane ca ' | hetumati ṇic | coda | ' cuda saṃcodane ' | caurādikaḥ | loṭi ' chandasyubhayathā ' iti śapaḥ | ārdhadhātukatvāt ' ṇeraniṭi ' iti ṇilopaḥ | śapaḥ pittvādanudāttatve dhātusvaraḥ | pādāditvāt nighātābhāvaḥ | maghonām | ṣaṣṭhībahuvacane ' śrayuvamaghonāmataddhita ' ( pā. sū. 6. 4. 133 ) iti saṃprasāraṇam ||
uvāsoṣā ucchācca nu devī jīrā rathānām | ye asyā ācaraṇeṣu dadhire samudre na śravasyavaḥ || 3 ||
uvāsa | uṣā | ucchāt | ca | nu | devī | jīrā | rathānām | ye | asyāḥ | ācaraṇeṣu | dadhire | samudre | na | śravasyavaḥ || 3 ||
'asyāḥ upasaḥ 'ācaraṇeṣu āgamaneṣu 'ye rathāḥ 'dadhire śṛtāḥ sajjikkṛtā bhavanti teṣāṃ rathānāmiti pūrvatrā- mvayaḥ |
'śravasyavaḥ dhanakāmāḥ 'samudre 'na yathā samudramadhye nāvaḥ sajjikkṛtya prerayanti tadvat |
ṇali ' limbabhyāsasyobhayeṣām ' ( pā. sū. 6. 1. 17 ) iti abhyāsasya saṃprasāraṇam |
uṣāḥ ityasya vākyāntaragatatvāt tadapekṣyāsya nighāno na bhavati, ' samānavākye nighātayuṣmadasmadādeśā vaktavyāḥ ' ( pā. sū. 8. 1. 18. 5 ) iti vacanāt |
' jorī ca ' ( u. sū. 2. 181 ) iti khapratyayaḥ |
' lyuṭ ca ' ( pā. sū. 3. 3. 115 ) iti bhāve lyuṭ |
1. ḍha-uṣa: upodevane | 2. ḍha -priyahitā: vāca: | 3. ta-pha-codaya; la-sa-codaya | 4. ḍha- purastāt | 5. ḍha-karotītyartha: | 6. ḍha-na iva |
uṣo ye te pra yāmeṣu yuñjate mano dānārya sūryaḥ |
atrāha tatkaṇvaṃ eṣāṃ kaṇvatamo nāma gṛṇāti nṛṇām ||
uṣaḥ | ye | te | pra | yāmeṣu | yuñjate | manaḥ | dānārya | sūryaḥ | atra | aha | tat | kaṇvaḥ | eṣām | kaṇvatamaḥ | nāma | gṛṇāti | nṛṇām || 4 ||
he vuṣaḥ vte tava vyāmeṣu gamaneṣu satsu vye vsūryaḥ vidvāṃsaḥ dānābhijñāḥ vdānāya dhanādi- dānārthaṃ vmanaḥ svakīyaṃ vpra vyuñjate prerayanti |
veṣāṃ dātumicchatāṃ vnṛṇāṃ vtat vnāma dānaviṣaye lokaprasiddhaṃ nāma vkaṇvatamaḥ atiśayena medhāvī vkaṇvaḥ maharṣiḥ vatrāha atraiva uṣaḥkāle vgṛṇāti uccārayati |
yo dātumicchati yaśca nāmagrahaṇena dātāraṃ praśaṃsati tāvubhāvapyapaḥkāle etra tathā kuruta ityupasaḥ stutiḥ ||
ā ghā yorṣeva sūnuryuṣā yāti prabhuñjatī |
ā | gha | yoṣā'iva | sūnuḥ | uṣāḥ | yāti | pra'bhuñjatī | jarayantī | vṛjanam | padvat'vat | īyate | ut | pātayati | pakṣiṇaḥ || 5 ||
vuṣāḥ devī vprabhuñjatī prakarṣeṇa sarvaṃ pālayantī vā vyāti vgha pratidinamāgacchati khalu |
vsūnarī suṣṭhu gṛhakṛtyasya netrī vyopeva gṛhiṇīva |
vvṛjanaṃ gamanaśīlaṃ jaṅgamaṃ prāṇijātaṃ vjarayantī jarāṃ prāpayantī |
kiṃca uṣaḥkāle vpadvat pādayutaḥ prāṇijātam vīyate nidrāṃ parityajya svasvakṛtyārthaṃ gacchati |
pakṣiṇe hūpaḥkāle samutthāya tatra tatra vrajanti ||
gatisamāse ‘kṛdgrahaṇe gatikārakapūrvasyāpi grahaṇam’ (paribhā. 28) iti vacanāt ‘kṛdikā- dakphinaḥ’ (pā. sū. 4. 1. 45 ga.) iti ṅīp |
avidyamānavattve sati ‘ hrasvanuḍbhyāṃ matup ’ iti matupa udāttatvamiti vācyam |
hrasvādityeva siddhe punarnuḍgrahaṇasāmarthyādimā paribhāṣā nāśrīyate iti vṛttāvuktam ( kā. 6. 1. 176 ) |
itarathā hi marutvān ityatrāpi matupa udāttatvaṃ syāt ||
vi yā sujati samarnaṃ vyarthinaḥ padaṃ na vetyordatī |
vayo narkiṣṭe psivāṃsaṃ āsate vyuṣṭau vājinīvati ||
vi | yā | sujati | samarnam | vi | arthinaḥ | padam | na | veti | ordatī | vayaḥ | narkiḥ | te | psivāṃsaḥ | āsate | vi'uṣṭau | vājinī'vati || 6 ||
gṛhārāmādiceṣṭākuśalān puruṣān upaḥkālaḥ śayanādutthāpya svasvavyāpāre prerayatīti prasiddham |

mānuṣāv ᵥabhi manuṣyān‌hyi ᵥrathebhiḥ śatasaṃkhyākaiḥ yuktaiḥ ᵥrathaiḥ ᵥvi ᵥyāti viśeṣeṇa gacchati || ayukta| luṃḍi ‘jhalo jhali’ (pā. sū. 8. 2. 26) iti sico lopaḥ| udayanāt| udayatreti udaya- nam| ‘iṇ gatau’ | adhikaraṇe lyuṭ| kṛduttarapadaprakṛtisvaratvam| subhagā| śobhano bhago yasyāḥ sā| ‘āyudāttaṃ cchandasi’ ityuttarapadādyudāttatvam| mānuṣāv| manoḥ putrā mānuṣāḥ| ‘manojātavantyatī puka ca’ iti añ pugāgamaśca| jittvādādyudāttatvam||
apa dveṣo maghonī duhitā diva uṣā ucchadap sidhaḥ||
viśvam| asyāḥ| nanāma| cakṣase| jagat| jyotiḥ| kṛṇoti| sunarī| apa| dveṣaḥ| maghonī| duhitā| divaḥ| uṣā| ucchat| apa| sidhaḥ|| 8||
ᵥviśvaṃ sarvaṃ ᵥjagat jaṅgamaṃ prāṇijātam ᵥasyāḥ upasaḥ ᵥcakṣase prakāśāya ᵥnanāma prahvī- bhavati|
rātrau tamasi nimagnāḥ sarve janāstannivārayitrīmupasamupalabhya namaskurvantītyarthaḥ|
yasmādeṣā ᵥsunarī suṣṭhu netrī abhimaptaphalasya prāpayitrī upāḥ ᵥjyotiṣkṛṇoti sarvaṃ prakāśayati|
kiṃca ᵥmaghonī maghavati dhanavatī ᵥdivaḥ ᵥduhitā dyulokakāśādutpannā ᵥuṣāḥ ᵥdveṣaḥ dveṣṭṛn ᵥapa ᵥucchat apavarjayati|
tathā ᵥsidhaḥ śoṣayitnan ᵥapa ucchat apavarjayati|
‘idamo'nvādeśe’ iti aśādeśaḥ anudāttaḥ vibhaktiśca suhavādanudātteti sarvādyudāttatvam|
tujādisve hi tutujānaḥ ityādāviva padakāle'pi dīrghaḥ śrūyate|
‘iṇaḥ ṣaḥ’ ityanuvṛttau ‘isusoḥ sāmarthye’ (pā. sū. 8. 3. 44) iti visarjanī- yasya paravam|
uṣā ā bhāhi bhānunā candreṇa duhitardivaḥ|
uṣaḥ| ā| bhāhi| bhānunā| candreṇa| duhitaḥ| divaḥ| āvahantī| bhūri| asmabhyam| saubhagam| vi| ucchantī| diviṣṭiṣu|| 9||
he ᵥdivaḥ ᵥduhitaḥ dyulokasya putra ᵥupaḥ upodevate ᵥcandreṇa sarveṣāmāhlādakena ᵥbhānunā prakāśena ᵥā samantāt ᵥbhāhi prakāśasva|
ᵥdiviṣṭiṣu divaseṣu ᵥbhūri prabhūtaṃ ᵥsaubhagaṃ saubhāgyam
‘ paramapi cchandasi ’ iti diva: ityasya parasya padyantasya pūrvāmantritāṅga- vadbhāve sati padyamāmantritasamudāyasya āṣṭamikaṃ sarvānudāttatvam |
‘ hragasindhvante pūrvapadasya ca ’ iti ubhayapadavṛddhau prāptāyāṃ ‘ sarve vidhayaśchandasi vikalpyante ’ iti vacanāt atrottarapadavṛddhaṃ bhavatīti vṛttāvuktam (kā. 7. 3. 19) |
tasya iṣṭya: epaṇāni gamanāni yeṣu divaseṣu te diviṣṭaya: |
viśvasya hi prāṇanaṃ jīvanaṃ tve vi yaducchasi sūnari |
sā no rathyena bṛhatā vibhāvari śrudhi citramaghe ||
viśvasya | hi | prāṇanam | jīvanam | tve iti | tri | yat | ucchasi | sūnari | sā | na: | rathyena | bṛhatā | vibhā'vari | śrudhi | citra'maghe | havam || 10 ||
he vsūnari uṣodevi vviśvasya prāṇijātasya vprāṇanaṃ cetanaṃ vjīvanaṃ prāṇadhāraṇaṃ ca vtve vhi tvayyeva vartate |
vyat yasmāt tvaṃ vvi vucchasi tamo varjayasi |
he vvibhāvari viśiṣṭaprakāśayukte vsā tādṛśī tvaṃ vna: asmatprati vbṛhatā prauḍhena vrathyena āyāhīti śeṣa: |
tathā he vcitramaghe vicitradhanayukte uṣodevi na: asmadīyaṃ vhavam āhvānaṃ vśrudhi śṛṇu ||
samāse ‘ anita: ’ (pā. sū. 8. 4. 19) iti upasargasthāt2 rakārāt nimittāt2 uttarasya nakārasya ṇatvam |
nanu ‘ anita: ’ iti iṭā nirdeśāt katham ‘ ana ceṣṭāyām ’ ityasya ṇatvam |
tarhi jīvanasya pṛthagupādānāt tenaiva dhātunā ceṣṭā lakṣyate |
‘ nṛ naye ’ ityasmāt ‘ aca i: ’ iti auṇādika ipratyaya: |
gatisamāse kṛdgrahaṇe gatikārakapūrvasyāpi grahaṇāt ‘ kṛdikārādaktina: ’ iti ṅīṣ |
‘ parādiśchandasi bahulam ’ ityuttarapadādyudā- ttatve prāpte ‘ āmantritasya ca ’ iti āṣṭamiko nighāta: |
‘ vano ra ca ’ iti ṅīp; tatsaṃniyogena nakārasya rephādeśaśca |
' bhāve'nupasargasya ' iti apratyayaḥ; tatsaṃniyogena saṃprasāraṇaṃ ca ||

upo vājaṃ hi vaṃsva yaścitro mānuṣe janai | tenā vaha sukṛtau adhvarā~ upa ye tvāṃ guṇanti vahvayaḥ || 11 || urṣaḥ | vājam | hi | vaṃsva | yaḥ | citraḥ | mānuṣe | janai | tena | ā | vaha | sukṛtaḥ | adhvarān | upa | ye | tvā | guṇanti | vahvayaḥ || 11 ||
he upaḥ ' vājaṃ havirlakṣaṇamannaṃ ' hi ' śrutiṣu prasiddhaṃ ' vaṃsva yācasva svīkurvityarthaḥ |
' yaḥ vājaḥ ' citraḥ cāyanīyaḥ ' mānuṣe manuṣye ' jane jāte yajamāne vartate taṃ vājamiti pūrvatrānvayaḥ |
' tena kāra- ṇena ' sukṛtaḥ suṣṭhu kṛtavato yajamānān ' adhvarān hiṃsārahitān yāgān ' upa ' ā ' vaha prāpaya |
' ye yajamānāḥ ' vahvayaḥ yajñanirvāhakāḥ ' tvā tvāṃ ' guṇanti stuvanti tān sukṛta iti pūrveṇa saṃbandhaḥ |
yajamānaiḥ dattaṃ haviḥ svīkṛtya punarapi teṣāṃ yajñaṃ saṃpādayati ||
' ajivyajyośca ' ( pā. sū. 7. 3. 60 ) ityatra caśabdasya anuktasamuccayārtha- tvāt vājo vājamiśratrāpi kṛtvābhāva iti vṛttāyuktatvāt kṛtvābhāvaḥ |
atra yācanavācinā dhātunā taduttarabhāvī svīkāro lakṣyate |
dhvaro hiṃsā nāstyasminniti bahuvrīhau ' namsubhyām ' ityuttarapadāntodāttatvam |

adhvarān ityasya īpsitatamatvāt ' karturīpsita- tamam ' ( pā. sū. 1. 4. 49 ) iti karmasaṃjñā, sukṛta ityasya tu ' akathitaṃ ca ' ( pā. sū. 1. 4. 51 ) iti, ' nīvahoraṃteśca ' ( pā. ma. 1. 4. 51 ) iti dvikarmakeṣu vahateḥ parigaṇitatvāt |
adhvarān ityatra nakārasya saṃhitāyāṃ ' dīrghāṃdaṭi ' iti havam |
' āto'ṭi nityam ' iti pūrvasya ākārasya sānunāsikā |

viśvāndevā~ ā vaha somapītaye'ntarikṣāduṣastvam | sāsmāsu dhā gomadaśvāvadukthyaṃmuṣo vājaṃ suvīryam || 12 || viśvān | devān | ā | vaha | soma'pītaye | antarikṣāt | uṣaḥ | tvam | sā | asmāsu | dhāḥ | go'mat | aśva'vata | ukthyam | upaḥ | vājam | su'vīryam ||12||
he ' upaḥ ' tvaṃ ' somapītaye somapānāya ' antarikṣāt antarikṣalokān ' viśvān sarvān ' devān ' ā ' vaha asmadīyaṃ devayajanadeśaṃ prāpaya |
he ' upaḥ ' sā tādṛśī tvaṃ ' gomat gomantaṃ bahubhirgobhi- ryuktaṃ ' aśvāvat aśvairupetam ' ukthyaṃ praśasyaṃ ' suvīryaṃ śobhanavīryopetaṃ ' vājam annam ' asmāsu ' dhāḥ ||

nidhehi sthāpayetyarthaḥ || dhāḥ | dadhāteḥ ' chandasi luṅlaṅliṭaḥ ' iti prārthanāyāṃ luṅ | ' gatisthā 0 ' iti sico luk | ' bahulaṃ chandasyamāṅyoge'pi ' iti aḍabhāvaḥ | gomat | aśvāvat | ' mantre somā- ślendraya ' iti matupi dīrghatvam | ubhayatra ' supāṃ suluk ' iti vibhakterluk | ukthyam | ukthaṃ stotram | tatra bhavamukthyam | ' bhave chandasi ' iti yat | ' sarve vidhayaśchandasi vikalpyante ' iti ' yato'nāvaḥ ' ityādyudāttatvābhāve ' tisrvaritam ' iti svaritatvam | upaḥ | āmantritāyu- dāttatvam | pādāditvāt nighātābhāvaḥ | suvīryam | śobhanaṃ vīryaṃ yasya | ' vīravīryaṃ ca ' ityuttara- padādyudāttatvam ||
yasyā ruśaṃto arcayaḥ prati bhadrā ardakṣata |
sā nau rayiṃ viśvavāraṃ supeśasamuṣā dadātu sugavyam ||
he 'mahi mahite' pūjanīye vā upodevate 'tvāṃ 'ye 'viddhi ye khalu prasiddhāḥ 'pūrve ciraṃtanāḥ 'ṛṣayaḥ mantradraṣṭāraḥ 'ūtaye rakṣaṇāya |
'avase annāya ca 'juhure juhire āhūtavantaḥ sūktarūpairmantraiḥ stutavanta ityarthaḥ |

he 'upaḥ 'sā tādṛśī tvaṃ 'rādhasā asmābhirdattena havilakṣaṇena dhanena 'śuklena 'śociṣā dīptena tamo nivārayituṃ samarthena tejasā copalakṣitā satī tepāmṛṣīṇāmiva 'naḥ asmākaṃ 'stomān 'abhi stutīrabhilakṣya 'guṇīhi samyak stutamiti śabdaya |
avateḥ ktini 'jvaratvara0' ityādinā vakārasya upadhāyāśca jad |
saṃ nau rāyā bṛhatā viśvapeśā mimikṣva samiḻābhiḥ |
saṃ dyumnena viśvaturā mahi saṃ vājairvājinīvatī ||
saṃ | naḥ | rāyā | bṛhatā | viśva'peśā | mimikṣva | sam | iḻābhiḥ | ā | saṃ | dyumnena | viśva'turā | uṣaḥ | mahi | sam | vājaiḥ | vājinī'vatī || 16 ||
he upaḥ 'naḥ asmān 'rāyā dhanena 'saṃ 'mimikṣva saṃsiñca saṃyojayetyarthaḥ |
uktaṃ ca—' etasminnevārthe devebhyaśca pitṛbhya etyā- kāraḥ ' (niru. 1. 4) iti |
kiṃca he 'mahi mahanīye upodevata 'dyumnena yaśasā 'saṃ mimikṣva |
tathā he 'vājinīvati annasādhanabhūtakriyāyukte 'vājaiḥ annaiḥ asmān 'saṃ mimikṣva |
'bahuvrīhau viśvaṃ saṃjñāyām ' iti vyatyayena asaṃjñāyāmapi pūrvapadānto- dāttatvam |
pratyayasvarasya satiśiṣṭa- tvāt sa eva śiṣyate |
pūrvapadasya asamānavākyasthatvāt 'tiṅaṅatiṅaḥ ' iti nighāto na bhavati, 'samānavākye nighātyumdasmadādeśā vaktavyāḥ ' iti vacanāt |
pūrvatra ' upasthaṃ tu ' ityukta- tvāt idamapi sūktam upastham |
sūyate hi- ' upo bhadrebhiriyānuṣṭubham ' (āśva. śrau. 4. 14) iti |

uṣo bhadrebhir gahi divaścidrocanādadhi | vahantvaruṇapsā uṣa tvā somino gṛham || 1 || uṣaḥ | bhadrebhiḥ | ā | gahi | divaḥ | cit | rocanāt | adhi | vahantu | aruṇapsāḥ | uṣa | tvā | sominaḥ | gṛham || 1 ||
he uṣaḥ uṣodevate bhadrebhiḥ bhandanīyaiḥ 1 śobhanairmārgaiḥ divaḥ antarikṣalokāt |
pūjitāt evaṃvidhā- dantarikṣalokāt ā gahi āgaccha |
he uṣaḥ aruṇapsāḥ aruṇavarṇā gāvaḥ sominaḥ somayuktasya yajamānasya gṛhaṃ devayajanarūpaṃ yajñagṛhaṃ tvā tvām upa vahantu prāpayantu ||
gameloṭi bahulaṃ chandasi iti śapo luk |
ato heḥ iti luk na bhavati, asiddhavadatrā bhāt ityadinā anunāsikalopasyāsiddhatvāt |
psānti bhakṣayanti stanaṃ pibantīti psavo vatsāḥ |
āto lopa iṭi ca iti ākāralopaḥ |
atra vatsānāmā ruṇyapratipādanāt mātṛṇāmapi tathātvaṃ gamyate |
mātṛkaṃ gāvo'nu- harante (pā. ma. 1. 3. 21. 5) iti gonardīyaḥ |
tāsāṃ ca upavāhanatvaṃ nighaṇṭāvuktam- aruṇyo gāva upasām (ni. 1. 15. 7) iti |
aruṇaśabdaḥ arteṃśca (u. sū. 5. 685) iti una- pratyayāntaḥ |
tṛṇākhyāyāṃ cit (u. sū. 3. 339) iyataḥ cit ityanuvṛtterantodāttaḥ |

supeśasaṃ sukharaṃ rathaṃ yamṛṣyasthā uṣastvam | tenā suśravasaṃ janaṃ prāvādya duhitardivaḥ || 2 || supeśasam | sukharam | ratham | yam | adhi'asthāḥ | uṣaḥ | tvam | tena | su'śravasam | janam | pra | ava | adya | duhitaḥ | divaḥ || 2 ||

he uṣaḥ tvaṃ yaṃ ratham adhyasthāḥ adhitiṣṭhasi | kīdṛśaṃ ratham | supeśasaṃ śobhanāvayavaṃ śobhana- rūpayuktaṃ vā | peśa iti rūpanāma (niru. 8. 11) iti yāskaḥ | yadvā | śobhanahiraṇyayuktam | peśaḥ kṛśanam (ni. 1. 2. 6) iti tannāmasu pāṭhāt | sukhaṃ śobhanena khena ākāśena yuktaṃ vistṛtamityarthaḥ | yadvā | sukhahetubhūtam | athavā sukhamiti kriyāviśeṣaṇam | sukhaṃ yathā bhavati tathe- tyarthaḥ | he divaḥ duhitaḥ dyulokasakāśāt utpanna upodevate tena rathena adya asmin kāle suśravasaṃ śobhanahaviryuktaṃ janaṃ yajamānaṃ prāva prakarṣeṇa gaccha 3 || supeśasam | piśa avayave | asmāt asunpratyayaḥ | nitvādādyudāttaḥ | peśaśabdaḥ | śobhanaṃ peśo yasyāmau supeśaḥ | āyudāttaṃ
tiṣṭhateḥ ' chandasi luṅlaṅliṭaḥ ' iti vartamāne luṅi ' gatisthā ' iti sico luk |
' śrava ityannanāma śrūyata iti mataḥ ' ( niru. 10. 3 ) iti yāskaḥ |
' paramapi chandasi ' iti paṣṭhyantasya pūrvamantriātāṅgatvāve sati padadvayasamudāyasya ādyamikaṃ sarvānudāttatvam ||
vayaḥ | cit | te | patriṇaḥ | dvi'pat | catuḥ'pat | arjuna | uṣaḥ | pra | āran | ṛtūn | anu | divaḥ | antaibhyaḥ | pari || 3 ||

he 'arjuna śubhravarṇe 'upaḥ upodekte 'te tava 'ṛtūn gamanānyanulakṣya 'dvipat dvipāt manuṣyādikaṃ 'catuṣpat gavādikaṃ tathā 'patriṇaḥ patravantaḥ pakṣopetāḥ 'vayaścit pakṣiṇaśca 'divaḥ 'antaibhyaḥ ākāśāntebhyaḥ 'pari upari 'prāran prakarṣeṇa gacchanti |
rātrāvanyakāreṇābhibhūtāḥ sarve prāṇinaḥ tvadāgamanantaraṃ ceṣṭāvanto bhavantītyarthaḥ ||
dvau pādāvasyeti ' saṃkhyāsupūrvasya ' ( pā. sū. 5. 4. 140 ) iti pādaśabdasya antyalopaḥ |
ayasmayādittvena bhatvāt ' pādaḥ pat ' ( pā. sū. 6. 4. 130 ) iti patrāvaḥ |
' dvitribhyāṃ pādamūrdhasu bahuvrīhau ' ( pā. sū. 6. 2. 197 ) ityuttarapadāntodāttatvam |
' iṇaḥ ṣaḥ ' ityanu- vṛttau ' idudupadhasya cāpratyayasya ' ( pā. sū. 8. 3. 41 ) iti visarjanīyasya patvam |
na ca paratvenāsya asiddhatvāt ' kupvoḥ kaḥ pau ca ' ( pā. sū. 8. 3. 37 ) iti upadhmānīyādeśaḥ śaṅkanīyaḥ, yena nāprāptinyāyena tasyāpavādatvāt |
' apavādastvapi parampi bādhate eva ' iti vṛttāvuktam |
' chandasi luṅlaṅliṭaḥ ' iti vartamāne luṅi ' satiśāsayatibhyaśca ' iti ceḥ aḍādeśaḥ |
' anulakṣaṇe ' ( pā. sū. 1. 4. 84 ) iti anoḥ karmapravacanīyatvam |
saṃhitāyāṃ ' dīrghādaṭi samānapāde ' iti nakārasya rutvam |
' atrānunāsikaḥ pūrvamya tu vā ' iti roḥ pūrvasya varṇasya sānunāsikatvam |

‘gherṅiti’ (pā. sū. 7. 3. 111) iti guṇābhāve yaṇādeśaḥ | arṇavam | arṇa udakamasminnastīti arṇavaḥ samudraḥ | ‘arṇaso lopaśca’ (kā. 5. 2. 109. 2) iti matvarthīyo vapratyayaḥ | salopaśca | tena śabdena jalāśayavācinā āśrayamātraṃ lakṣyate | pratyayasvaraḥ | vicaranti | cara gatyarthaḥ | adupadeśāt lasārvadhātukānudāttatve dhātusvaraḥ | ‘tiṅi codāttavati’ iti gatiranudāttā | yad- vṛttayogādanighātaḥ | mānupā | ‘śeṣchandasi bahulam’ iti śelopaḥ | bhuje | ‘bhuja pālanā- bhyavahārayoḥ’ | saṃpadādilakṣaṇo bhāve kvip | ‘sāvekācaḥ’ iti vibhakterudāttatvam | maṃheṣṭham | ‘mahi vahi vṛddhau’ | atiśayena maṃhitā maṃheṣṭhaḥ | ‘tucchandasi’ iti iṣṭhanpratyayaḥ | ‘turiṣṭhemayaḥsu’ iti talopaḥ | nittvādādyudāttatvam | arcata | ‘a

iti gateḥ prakṛtisvaratvam | dakṣāsaḥ | ‘ dakṣa vṛddhau ’ | dakṣante ebhiriti dakṣāḥ | karaṇe ghañ | jitvādādyudāttatvam | ‘ ājaserasuku ’ | madacyutam | ‘ cyuṅ gatau ’ | antarbhāvitaṇyarthāt ‘ kip ca ’ iti kip | ‘ hrasvasya piti kṛti ’ iti tuk | śataṃ ṛtavo yasya | bahuvrīhau pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaratvam | javanī | ju iti sautro dhātuḥ | karaṇe lyuṭ | ‘ ṭiḍḍhāṇañ ’ ityādinā ṅīp | litsvareṇa jakārāt parasyodāttatvam | aruhat | ruherlaṅi ‘ kramṛharuhibhyaśchandasi ’ iti cleḥ aḍadeśaḥ ||
tvam | gotram | aṅgiraḥ'bhyaḥ | avṛṇoḥ | apa | uta | atraye | śata'dureṣu | gātu'vit | sasena | cit | vi'mudāya | avahaḥ | vasu | ājau | adrim | vavasānasya | nartayan || 3 ||
he indra 1tvaṃ 2gotram adhyakṣaśabdavantaṃ vṛtrudakasyāvarakaṃ 3 megham 4aṅgirobhyaḥ aṅgirasāmapīṇāmarthāya 5apa 6avṛṇoḥ apavaraṇaṃ kṛtavānasi |
gotraṃ gosamūhaṃ paṇibhirapahṛtaṃ guhāsu nihitam aṅgirobhyaḥ ṛṣibhyaḥ apa avṛṇoḥ guhādvārodghāṭanana prākāśayaḥ |
3śatadureṣu śatadvāreṣu yantreṣvasuraiḥ pīḍāthaṃ prakṣitāya 4gātuvit mārgasya lambhayitābhūḥ |
tathā 5vimadāya 6cit vimadanāmne maharṣaye'pi 7sasena ajñena yuktaṃ 8vasu dhanam 9avahaḥ prāpitavān |
tathā 1ājau saṃgrāme jayārthaṃ 2vavasānasya nivasatonyasyasyāpi stotuḥ 3adriṃ vajraṃ 4nartayan rakṣaṇaṃ kṛtavānasīti śeṣaḥ |
atastva mahimā kena varṇayituṃ śakyate iti bhāvaḥ ||
‘ khala-gorathāt ’ ityanuvṛttau ‘ iniñkavyacvaśca ’ ( pā.sū. 4. 2. 51 ) iti samūhārthe trapratyayaḥ |
tacca yo hyubhayoḥ sthāne bhavati sa labhate'nyatareṇāpi vyapadeśam iti ‘ uraṇ raparaḥ ’ ( pā. sū. 1. 1. 51 ) iti raparaṃ bhavati |
asmāt ‘ kabhimanijanibhāgāpātrā hibhyaśca ’ ( u. sū. 1. 72 ) iti tupratyayaḥ |
‘ sasaṃ namaḥ āyuḥ ’ ( ni.2.7.21 ) iti tannāmasu pāṭhān |
‘ āhave ājau ’ ( ni. 2. 17. 8 ) iti tatra pāṭhāt |
yāskastvevam adriśabdaṃ vyācakhyau—‘ adridāraṇāyatenāpi vātteḥ syāt ’ ( niru. 4. 4 ) iti |

tvamapāmapidhānāvṛṇorapādhārayaḥ parvate dānumadvasuṃ | vṛtraṃ yadindra śavasāvadhīrhimāditsūryaṃ divvārohaya duśe || 4 || tvam | apām | apidhānā | avṛṇoḥ | arpa | adhārayaḥ | parvate | dānumat | vasuṃ | vṛtram | yat | indra | śavasā | avadhīḥ | ahim | āt | it | sūryam | divi | ā | arohayaḥ | duśe || 4 ||
he indra tvam apām udakānām apidhānā apidhānāni ācchādakān meghān apa avṛṇoḥ apāvarīḥ |
tathā parvate parvatati pūrayitavyapradeśayukte svakīyanivāsasthāne dānumat dānu- mato hiṃsāyuktasya |
tādṛśasya vṛtrādeḥ vasu dhanam adhā- rayaḥ |
śatrūn jitvā tadīyaṃ dhanamapahṛtya svagṛhe nyakṣipaḥ ityarthaḥ |
he indra tvaṃ yat yadā śavasā balena vṛtraṃ trayāṇāṃ lokānāmāvarītāram |
tathā ca śāstrāntare samāmnātaṃ- ‘yadimān lokānavṛṇot tadvṛtrasya vṛtratvam’ (tai. saṃ. 2. 4. 12.2) iti |
tathā ca vājasaneyinaḥ samāmananti- ‘so'bhīgomāvabhisaṃbabhūva sarvāṃ vicāṃ sarvaṃ yaśaḥ sarvamannādyaṃ sarvāṃ śriyaṃ sa yatsarvametatsabhavattasmādahiḥ’ iti |
ādit anantarameva divi dyuloke dṛśe draṣṭuṃ sūryam ārohayaḥ |
‘do avakhaṇḍane’ ityasmāt vā ‘dāṇ dāne’ ityasmāt vā ‘dābhyāṃ nuḥ’ iti auṇādiko nupratyayaḥ |

tvaṃ māyābhirapa māyinau'dhamaḥ svadhābhiryye adhi śubhāvarjuhata | tvaṃ pipraurnṛmaṇaḥ prārujaḥ puraḥ pra ṛjiśvāṃ dasyuhatyaiṣvāvitha || 5 || tvam | māyābhiḥ | arpa | māyinaḥ | adhamaḥ | svadhābhiḥ | ye | adhi | śutau | arjuhata | tvam | piprauḥ | nṛmaṇaḥ | pra | arujaḥ | puraḥ | pra | ṛjiśvām | dasyu | hatyaiṣu | āvitha ||5||
māyeti jñānanāma, ‘śacī māyā’ (ni. 3. 9. 9) iti tannāmasu pāṭhāt |
'ye asurāḥ 'svadhābhiḥ havirlakṣaṇairannaiḥ 'śuptau 'adhi śobhamāne svakīye mukhe eva 'ajuhvata ahaupuḥ nāmnī tānasurāniti pūrvaiṇa sambandhaḥ |
' tathā ca kauṣītakibhirāmnāyate— ' asurā vā ātmañjuhvuruddhate'gnau te parābhavan ' iti |
vājasaneyibhirapyāmnātaṃ— ' devāśca ha vā asurāścāspadhanta tato hāsurā abhimānena kasmai ca na juhuma iti sveṣvevāsteṣu juhvataścaraste parābabhūvuḥ ' iti |
tathā he 'nṛmaṇaḥ nṛpu yajamāneṣu rakṣitavyeṣu anugrahabuddhiyukta 'tvaṃ 'piproḥ pūrayitaretannāmno'surasya 'puraḥ purāṇi nivāsa- sthānāni 'pra 'arujaḥ prābhāṅkṣīḥ |
' evaṃ kṛtvā tenāsureṇopadrutam 'ṛjiṣvānam 'ṛjugamanametatsaṃjñakaṃ stotāraṃ 'dasyuhateṣu dasyunāmupakṣakapayitṝṇāṃ hanane yukteṣu saṃgrāmeṣu |
māyāśabdasya vrīhyādiṣu pāṭhāt ' vrīhyādibhyaśca ' iti matvarthīya iniḥ |
' udoṣṭhyapūrvasya ' ityatra ' bahulaṃ chandasi ' ityukta- tvāt utvābhāvaḥ |
' artipiptyośca, bahulaṃ chandasi ' iti abhyāsasya itvam |
' hanasta ca ' (pā. sū. 3. 1. 108) iti bhāve kyappratyayaḥ |
mahantaṃ cidarbudaṃ ni kramīḥ padā sunādeva dasyuhatyāya jajñipe ||
tvam | kutsam | śuṣṇahatyeṣu | āvitha | arandhayaḥ | atithigvāya | śambaram | mahantam | cit | arbudam | ni | kramīḥ | padā | sunāt | eva | dasyuhatyāya | jajñipe ||6||
tathā 'atithigvāya atithibhirgantavyāya divodāsāya 'śambaram etannāmamasuram 'arandhayaḥ hiṃsāṃ prāpayaḥ |
tathā 'mahantaṃ 'cit atipravṛddhamapi 'arbudam etatsaṃ- jñakamasuraṃ 'padā pādena 'ni 'kramīḥ nitarāmākramitrābhūḥ |
yasmādevaṃ tasmāt 'sanādeva cirakālādevā- rabhya 'dasyuhatyāya upakṣapayitṝṇāṃ hananāya 'jajñiṣe |
tve viśvā tarviṣī sadhryagghitā tava rādhaḥ somapīthāya haṣate |
tava vajraścikite bāhvarhito vṛśca śatrorava viśvāni vṛṣṇyā ||
tve iti | viśvā | tarviṣī | sadhryak | hitā | tava | rādhaḥ | soma'pīthāya | haṣate | tava | vajraḥ | cikite | bāhvoḥ | hitaḥ | vṛśca | śatroḥ | ava | viśvāni | vṛṣṇyā || 7 ||
he indra tve tvayi viśvā taviṣī sarvaṃ balaṃ sadhryak sadhrīcīnaṃ aparāṅmukhaṃ yathā bhavati tathā hitā nihitam |
tathā tava rādhaḥ manaḥ somapīthāya somapānāya haṣate hṛṣyati |
kiṃca tava bāhvoḥ hastayoḥ hitaḥ avasthitaḥ vajraḥ cikite asmābhirjñāyate |
ataḥ śatroḥ śātayiturvairiṇaḥ viśvāni sarvāṇi vṛṣṇyā vṛṣṇyāni vīryāṇi ava vṛśca chedanaṃ kuru ||
samāse ‘ sahasya sadhiḥ ’ iti sahaśabdasya sadhryādeśaḥ |
kṛduttarapadaprakṛtisvaratve prāpte ‘ adisadhyorantodāttatvanipātanaṃ kṛtsvaranivṛttyartham ’ ( pā. sū. 6. 3. 95. 1 ) iti vacanāt sadhryādeśaḥ antodāttaḥ |
tasya yaṇādeśe ‘ udāttasvaritayoryaṇaḥ ’ iti parasyānudāttasya svaritatvam |
ityani prāpte vyatyayena śap ātmanepadaṃ ca |
‘ chandasi luṅlaṅliṭaḥ ’ iti vartamāne karmaṇi liṭ |
vi jānīhyāryenye ca dasyavo barhiṣmate randhayā śāsadavratān |
śākīṃ bhava yajamānasya coditā viśvettā tai sadhumādeṣu cākana ||
vi | jānīhi | āryen | ye | ca | dasyavaḥ | barhiṣmate | randhaya | śāsat | avratān | śākīm | bhava | yajamānasya | coditā | viśve | tā | tai | sadhu'mādeṣu | cākana || 8 ||
he indra tvaṃ āryān viduṣaḥ anuṣṭhātṛn vi jānīhi viśeṣeṇa budhyasva |
ye ca dasyavaḥ teṣāmanuṣṭhātṛṇāmupakṣapayitāraḥ śatravaḥ tānapi vi jānīhīti śeṣaḥ |
jñātvā ca barhiṣmate barhiṣā yajñena yuktāya yajamānāya avratān vratamite karmanāma |
ataḥ śākī śaktiyuktastvaṃ yajamānasya coditā prerako
yajñavighātakānasurāntiraskṛtya yajñān yajamānaiḥ sabhyaganuṣṭhāpaya iti bhāvaḥ |
ahamapi stotā ᵛte tava ᵛtā tāni pūrvoktāni karmāṇi ᵛviśvat sarvāṇyeva ᵛsadhamādeṣu sahamadanayukteṣu ᵛyajñeṣu stotuṃ ᵛcākana kāmaye ||
atra ‘ ṣlī gatau vṛta ’ iti vyākaraṇaṃ lvādiparisamāptyarthameva na ṣvādiparisamāptyarthamiti yeṣāṃ darśanaṃ teṣāṃ ‘ pvādīnāṃ hrasvaḥ ’ iti hrasvatvena bhavitavyam |
‘ janī prādurbhāve ’ ityasya tu dīrghoccāraṇamantareṇāpi ‘ ato dīrgho yañi ’ ( pā. sū. 7. 3. 101 ) ityanenaiva dīrghaḥ sidhyati |
‘ jakṣyādyaḥ ṣaṭ ’ ( pā. sū. 6. 1. 6 ) ityabhyastasaṃjñāyāṃ ‘ nābhyastācchatuḥ ’ iti numpratiṣedhaḥ |

‘ vyadhajaporanupasarge ’ ( pā. sū. 3. 3. 61 ) ityatraiva mada iti vaktavye yat ‘ mado'nupasarge ’ iti pṛthagupādānaṃ tat ghañapi pakṣe yathā syāditi nyāsakāreṇa pratyayādītyasyābhidhāṃnuvṛttāvuktam |
‘ chandasi luṅ- laṅliṭaḥ ’ iti vartamāne liṭ |
‘ ṇaluttamo vā ’ ( pā. sū. 7. 1. 91 ) iti ṇitvasya vikalpa- nāt vṛddhayabhāvaḥ |
vṛddhasya cidvardhato dyāmirnakṣataḥ stavāno vṛtrau vi jaghāna saṃdihaḥ ||
anuvratāya | randhayan | arpa'vratān | ā'bhūmiḥ | indraḥ | śrathayan | anābhuvaḥ | vṛddhasya | cit | vardhataḥ | dyām | inakṣataḥ | stavānaḥ | vṛtraḥ | vi | jaghāna | sam'dihaḥ || 9 ||
yaḥ ᵛindraḥ ᵛanuvratāya anukūlakarmaṇe yajamānāya ᵛapavratān apagatakarmaṇaḥ ayajamānān ᵛrandhayan hiṃsayan vaśīkurvan vā tathā ᵛābhūmiḥ |
taiḥ ᵛanābhuvaḥ tadviparītān ᵛśrathayan hiṃsayan vartate |

ᵛvṛddhasya ᵛcit ᵛvardhataḥ pūrvaṃ vṛddhasyāpi punarvardhamānasya ᵛdyāmirnakṣataḥ svargaṃ vyāptavataḥ ᵛstavānaḥ stutiṃ kurvāṇaḥ ᵛvṛtraḥ stutyudviraṇaśīla eta- tsaṃjñaka ṛṣiḥ ᵛsaṃdihaḥ samyagupacitā valmīkavarāḥ ᵛvi ᵛjaghāna |
indreṇa parihatāntarāyaḥ san pṛthivyāḥ sārabhūtaṃ valmīkapālakṣaṇaṃ yajñasaṃbhārāhāpītyarthaḥ |
tathā ca śāstrāntare samāmnātaṃ- ‘ yadvalmīkavapāsaṃbhāro bhavati ūrjameva rasaṃ pṛthivyā avarundhe ’ ( tai. brā. 1. 1. 3. 4 ) iti ||
ṇici ghaṭāditvāt micce ‘ mitāṃ hrasvaḥ ’ iti hrasvatvam |

'nakṣa gatau' | ikāropajanaśchāndasaḥ | yadvā | inakṣatirgatyarthaḥ | prakṛtyantaramanveṣṭavyam | stavānaḥ | 'samyānac stuvaḥ' (u. sū. 2. 246) iti stoterbahulvacanāt nirutpadādapi ānacpratyayaḥ | vyatyayenādyudāttatvam | jaghāna | 'abhyāsācca' iti abhyāsāduttarasya hanterhakārasya kutvam | saṃdihaḥ | 'diha upacaye' | 'kṛtyalyuṭo bahulam' iti bahulavacanāt karmaṇi kip | kṛduttarapadaprakṛtisvaratvam ||

takṣadyatta uśanā sahasā saho vi rodasī majmanā bādhate śarvaḥ | ā tvā vātasya nṛmaṇo manoyuja ā pūryamāṇavahnabhi śravaḥ || 10 || takṣat | yat | te | uśanā | sahasā | sahaḥ | vi | rodasī iti | majmanā | bādhate | śarvaḥ | ā | tvā | vātasya | nṛmaṇaḥ | manaḥyujaḥ | ā | pūryamāṇam | avahan | abhi | śravaḥ || 10 ||
he indra yat yadā uśanā kāvyaḥ sahasā ātmīyena balena te sahaḥ tvadīyaṃ balaṃ takṣat tanukṛtavān |
tadā śavaḥ tvadīyaṃ balaṃ majmanā sarvasya śodhakena svatakṣyeṇa rodasī dyāvāpṛthivyau vi bādhate |
tathā cānyatrājñātaṃ - 'yasya śuṣmādrodasī abhyasetām' (ṛ. saṃ. 2. 12. 1) iti |
rodasī yasmādvṛtrādeḥ bibhītaḥ taṃ bādhate ityarthaḥ |
he nṛmaṇaḥ nṛṣu rakṣitavyeṣu yajamāneṣvanugrahabuddhiyuktendra ā pūryamāṇaṃ pūrvoktena balena ā samantāt pūryamāṇaṃ tvā tvāṃ manoyujaḥ manovyāpāramātreṇa yuktāḥ vātasya vāyoḥ sambandhinaḥ |
evaṃbhūtā aśvāḥ śravaḥ abhi havirlakṣaṇamannamabhilakṣya ā avahan ābhimukhyena prāpayantu ||

mandiṣṭa yaduśane kāvye sacā~ indrau vaṅkū vaṅkutarādhi tiṣṭhati | ugro yayi nirapaḥ srotasā'sṛddhi śuṣṇasya daṃhitā airayatpuraḥ || 11 || mandiṣṭa | yat | uśane | kāvye | sacā | indraḥ | vaṅkū iti | vaṅkutarā | adhi | tiṣṭhati | ugraḥ | yayim | niḥ | apaḥ | srotasā | asṛjat | vi | śuṣṇasya | daṃhitāḥ | airayat | puraḥ || 11 ||
yat yadā indraḥ uśane kāmayamāne kāvye sacā saha mandiṣṭa stuto'bhūt tadānīṃ vaṅkū vaṅkutarā atiśayena kuṭilaṃ gacchantāvaśvau adhi tiṣṭhati |
vaṅku- tarā atiśayena vakraṃ gacchati rathe vaṅkū vakragamanaśīlāvaśvau saṃyojyeti yojanīyam |

indraḥ 'yayiṃ gamanayuktāt meghāt 'srotasā pravāharūpeṇa 'apaḥ 'niḥ 'asujat jalāni niragamayat | tathā 'śuṣṇasya sarvasya śoṣayiturasurasya 'haṃhitāḥ pravṛddhāḥ 'puraḥ nagarāṇi nivāsasthānāni 'vi 'airayat vividhaṃ preritavān || mandiṭa | 'madi stutimodamadasvapkāntigatiṣu ' | luṅi ' bahulaṃ chandasyamāṅ- yoge'pi ' iti aḍabhāvaḥ | uśane | vaśeḥ auṇādikaḥ kyupratyayaḥ | prahijyādinā saṃprasāraṇam | yo- ranādeśaḥ | sacā | ' paca samavāye ' | saṃpadādilakṣaṇo bhāve kvip | ' āḍyājayārāṃ copasaṃkhyānam ' ( pā. ma. 7. 1. 39. 1 ) iti vibhakteḥ āḍādeśaḥ | saṃhitāyāṃ ' āḍeo'nunāsikaśchandasi ' ( pā. sū. 6. 1. 126 ) iti tasya sānunāsikatvam | vaṅkū | ' vaṅgu gatau ' | auṇādika upapratyayaḥ | bahulavacanāt kutvam | vaṅkutarā | atiśayena vaṅkū vaṅkutarā | ' supāṃ suluk ' iti vibhakteḥ ākāraḥ | atra gatisāmānyavācinā gativiśeṣo lakṣyate | yayim | ' yā prāpaṇe ' | ' ādyagamahanajanaḥ ' iti kipratyayaḥ | liṅgātvāt dvivacanahasvatve | ' āto lopa iṭi ca ' iti ākāralopaḥ | pratyayasvaraḥ | ' supāṃ supo bhavanti ' iti pañcamyā amādeśaḥ | haṃhitāḥ | ' hahi vṛddhau ' | idittvāt num | airayat | ' īra preraṇe ' | caurādikaḥ | luṅi āḍāgamaḥ | ' āṭaśca ' ( pā. sū. 6. 1. 90 ) iti vṛddhiḥ ||
ā smā rathḙ vṛṣapāṇḙṣu tiṣṭhasi śaryā̭tasya pra॒bhṛtā॒ yeṣu॒ manda̭se |
indra॒ yathā̭ sutaso̭meṣu cāka॒na̭'nu॒rvāṇa॒ṃ śloka॒mā ro̭hase di॒vi ||
ā | sma | ratha̭m | vṛṣa̭'pāṇḙṣu | tiṣṭhasi | śaryā̭tasya | pra॒'bhṛtā̭ | yeṣṷ | manda̭se | indra̭ | yathā̭ | suta̭'so̭meṣu | cāka॒na̭ḥ | a॒nu॒rvāṇa̭m | śloka̭m | ā | ro̭hase | di॒vi ||12||
atra kaupītakina itihāsamācakṣate—śaryātanāmno rājarṣeryajñe bhṛgugotrotpannaścyavano maharṣirvighnaṃ grahamagṛhṇāt |
evaṃ ca sati 'yeṣu someṣu tvaṃ 'mandase harṣaṃ prāpnoṣi tādṛśāḥ somāḥ 'śaryāṃtasya etannāmno rājarṣeḥ saṃbandhinaḥ 'prabhṛtāḥ prakarṣeṇa saṃpāditāḥ |
ataḥ 'suta- someṣu abhipatasomayukteṣvanyadīyeṣu yajñeṣu 'yathā 'cākanaḥ yathā kāmayase evamasyāpi śaryāṃtasya somān kāmayasva |
tathā sati 'divi dyuloke 'anarvāṇaṃ gamanarahitaṃ sthiraṃ 'ślokaṃ stotralakṣaṇaṃ vaco yaśo vā 'ā 'rohase prāpnoṣi |
imaṃ yajamānaṃ divi dyuloke uktalakṣaṇaṃ yaśaḥ prāpayasi |
' vā bhāvakaraṇayoḥ ' ( pā. sū. 8. 4. 10 ) iti pūrvapadasthānanimittāduttarasya pānaśabda nakārasya ṇatvam |
' sarve vidhayaśchandasi vikalpyante ' iti abhyastasya ādyudāttatvābhāve ' dhāto ' iti dhātvantarasyodāttatvam |
