he indra yāni brahmāṇi stotraśastrarūpāṇi mantrajātāni tava vardhanā vardhayitṛṇi tāni tvā tvāṃ nyupanti hi nitarāṃ prāpnuvantyeva | tatra dṛṣṭāntaḥ | ūrmayaḥ jalapravāhāḥ | hṛdaṃ na | yathā jalāśayaṃ prāpnuvanti tadvat | vadhvā cit sa tvaṣṭā ca devaḥ te tava yujyaṃ yogyaṃ śavaḥ balaṃ vavṛdhe prāvardhayan | api ca abhibhūtyojasaṃ śatrūṇāmabhibhavitṛṇā ojasā balena yuktaṃ vajraṃ tatakṣa tīkṣṇīcakāra || nyupanti | ' kṛpī gatau ' | taudādikaḥ | adupadeśāt lasārvadhātukānudāttatve vikaraṇa- svaraḥ | hi ca iti nighātapratiṣedhaḥ | ūrmayaḥ | ṛ gatau | ṛcchanti gacchantīti ūrmayaḥ | arteṃśca ( u. sū. 4. 634 ) iti mipratyayaḥ | guṇe sati akārasya ukārādeśaśca | pratyaya- svaraḥ | vardhanā | vṛdhu vṛddhau | vartate ebhiriti vardhanā | karaṇe lyuṭ | śeścandasi iti śelopaḥ | tatakṣa | takṣū tvakṣū tanūkaraṇe | liṭi ṇali lisavareṇa grahayāt pūrvasyodāttatvam | pādāditvāt nighātābhāvaḥ | abhibhūtyojasam | abhibhūyate'neneti abhibhūti | karaṇe kin | tādau ca niti0 iti gateḥ prakṛtisvaratvam | abhibhūti ojo yasya | bahuvrīhau pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaratvam ||
jaghanvā~ u haribhiḥ saṃbhṛtakratuvindraṃ vṛtraṃ manuṣe gātuyannapaḥ |
jaghanvān | ū~ iti | haribhiḥ | saṃbhṛtakrato iti saṃbhṛta'krato | indra | vṛtram | manuṣe | gātuyan | apaḥ | aryacchathāḥ | bāhvoḥ | vajram | āyasam | adhārayaḥ | divi | ā | sūryam | dṛśe || 8 ||
he saṃbhṛtakrato saṃpādinkarman saṃpāditajña vā indra manuṣe janāya gātuyan gātuṃ mārga- micchan vṛtraṃ lokānāmāvarakamasuraṃ haribhiḥ aśvairyuktastvaṃ jaghanvān u hatavān khalu |
bāhvoḥ tvadīyayorhastayoḥ āyasam ayomayaṃ vajram aryacchathāḥ agrahīḥ |
sūrya ca divi dyuloke dṛśe draṣṭuṃ sarveṣāsmākaṃ darśanāya ||
1. na-cha-ta-pha-śa-tvaṣṭādeva; dha-tvaṣṭā cit tvaṣṭā ca devaḥ; na-sa- tvaṣṭā cit tvaṣṭā cideva |
kyajantāt śatari adupadeśāt lasārvadhātukānudāttatve kyaca eva svaraḥ śiṣyate |
bṛhat | sva'candram | ama'vat | yat | ukthyam | akṛṇvata | bhiyasā | rohaṇam | divaḥ | yat | mānuṣa'pradhanāḥ | indram | ūtayaḥ | svaḥ | nu'sācaḥ | marutaḥ | amadan | anu ||9||
bṛhat bṛhatsāma stotāro yajamānāḥ 'bhiyasā vṛtrabhayena 'yat yadā 'uvathyan ukthārhaṃ stotrayogyam 'akṛṇvata akurvan |
manuṣyahitasaṃgrāmāḥ 'ūtayaḥ 'svaḥ dyulokasya rakṣitāraḥ 'mahataḥ 'nṛpācaḥ prāṇarūpeṇa nṝn sevamānā bhūtvā 'indram api tenaiva rūpeṇa 'anu 'amadan ānupūrvyeṇa harṣaṃ prāpayan |
tadānīṃ sa indro vṛtravadhaṃ prati udyukto babhūveti śeṣaḥ ||
bhīśabdasya tṛtīyaikavacane chāndasaḥ asugā- gamaḥ tasya udāttatvaṃ ca |
gici 'madī harṣalapanayoḥ' iti ghaṭādiṣu pāṭhāt mittve sati 'mitāṃ hrasvaḥ' iti hrasvatvam |
laḍi 'chandasyubhayathā' iti śapa ārdhadhātukatvāt 'ṇeraniṭī' iti ṇilopaḥ ||
dyauścidasyāmavā~ aheḥ khanādyauyavīdviyasā vajraṃ indra te |
vṛtrasya yadbṛdhnasya rodasī made sutasya śavasābhinacchiraḥ ||
dyauḥ | cit | asya | ama'vān | aheḥ | khanāt | ayodhavīt | bhiyasā | vajram | indra | te | vṛtrasya | yat | bṛdhnasya | rodasī iti | made | sutasya | śavasā | abhinat | śiraḥ ||10||
amavān balavān 'dyauścit dyuloko'pi 'asya 'aheḥ vṛtrasya 'svanāt śabdāt 'bhiyasā bhayena 'ayodhavīt atyarthaṃ pṛthagbhūta āsīt |
abhiṣavādibhiḥ saṃskṛtasya somasya pānena made harṣe jāte sati tvadīyaḥ vajraḥ rodasī dyāvāpṛthivyau bahudhānasya bādhanaśīlasya vṛtrasya śiraḥ yat yadā śavasā balena abhinat acchinat |
tadānīṃ dyuloko bhayarāhityena niścalo babhūveti śeṣaḥ ||
asmāt yaṅ- lugantāt laḍi ‘yaṅo vā’ (pā. sū. 7. 3. 14) iti apṛktapratyayasya īḍāgamaḥ |
tācchīlike cānaśi ‘bahulaṃ chandasi’ iti śapaḥ bhluḥ |
yadirdivandra pṛthivī daśabhujirahāni viśvā tatarnanta kṛṣṭayaḥ |
atrāha te maghavanviśvṛtaṃ saho dyāmanu śavasā barhaṇā bhuvat ||
yat | it | nu | indra | pṛthivī | daśa'bhujiḥ | ahāni | viśvā | tatarnanta | kṛṣṭayaḥ | atra | aha | te | maghavan | tri'śrutam | sahaḥ | dyām | anu | śavasā | barhaṇā | bhuvat ||11||
yadinu yadā khalu pṛthivī daśabhujiḥ daśaguṇitā bhavet yadi vā kṛṣṭayaḥ sarve manuṣyāḥ viśvā sarvāṇi ahāni tatarnanta vimānayeyuḥ |
he maghavan dhanavan indra atrāha atraiva pūrvokte- pveva deśakālakartṛkeṣu te tvadīyaṃ sahaḥ vṛtravadhādikāraṇaṃ balaṃ viśvṛtaṃ vikhyātaṃ prasiddham |
śavasā tvadīyena balena kṛtā barhaṇā vṛtrādvardharūpā kriyā dyāmanu bhuvat anubhavati |
yathā dyaurmahatī tathā tvatkṛtaṃ vṛtrāderhasanamapi mahaditi bhāvaḥ ||
liḍarthe laḍi upratyaye prāpte vyatyayena śap |
‘bahulaṃ chandasi’ iti upratyayasya ślau sati punarapi vyatyayena śap |
tvamasu pari raṃjamo vyomanḥ svarbhūtyojā avase dhṛṣmanaḥ |
cakṛṣe bhūmiṃ pratimānamojaso'paḥ svaḥ paribhūreśyā divam ||
tvam | asya | pāre | rajasaḥ | vi'omanaḥ | svarbhūrti'ojāḥ | avase | dhṛṣat'manaḥ | cakṛṣe | bhūmim | prati'mānam | ojasaḥ | apaḥ | svaḥ | riti svaḥ | pari'bhūḥ | eṣi | ā | divam || 12 ||

he ^dhṛṣanmanaḥ śatrūṇāṃ dharṣakamanoyekendra ^asya asmābhiḥ parihṛyamānasya ^vyomanaḥ vyāptasya antarikṣasya ^rajasaḥ lokasya ^pāre uparipradeśe vartamānaḥ ^svabhūyojāḥ svabhūtabalaḥ ^tvam ^avase asmadrakṣaṇārthaṃ ^bhūmiṃ bhūlokaṃ ^cakre kṛtavānasi |
‘ jvaratvara ’ ityādinā upadhāyā vakārasya ca ūt |
supūvā~t ateḥ : ‘ anyebhyo'pi dṛśyante ’ iti vic |
‘ avyayādāpsupaḥ ’ ( pā. sū. 2. 4. 82 ) iti supo luk |
‘ nyaṅsvarī svaritau ’ ( phi. sū. 74 ) iti svaritatvam |
bhūtāgnyekāhe maruvatīyaśastre nividānāyāt sūktāt purā ‘ tvaṃ bhuvaḥ pratimānam ’ ityeṣā śaṃsanīyā |
tathaivāsūtrayat—‘ śasyamuktaṃ bṛhaspatisavena tvaṃ bhuvaḥ pratimānaṃ pṛthivyāḥ ’ ( āśva. śrau. 9. 5 ) iti |
tvaṃ bhuvaḥ pratimānaṃ pṛthivyā ṛṣvavīrasya bṛhataḥ patirbhūḥ |
tvam | bhuvaḥ | prati'mānam | pṛthivyāḥ | ṛṣva'vīrasya | bṛhataḥ | patiḥ | bhūḥ |
viśvam | ā | prāḥ | antarikṣam | mahi'tvā | satyam | addhā | nakiḥ | anyaḥ | tvā'vān ||13||
kṛtvā darśanīyā vīrā yasya sa tathoktaḥ |
tathā ^antarikṣam antarā kṣāntaṃ dyāvāpṛthivyormadhye vartamāna- mākāśaṃ ^viśvaṃ sarvamapi ^mahitvā mahattvena ^satyam ^āprāḥ niścayena ā samantādāpūrayaḥ |
ataḥ ^tvāvān tvatsadṛśaḥ ^anyaḥ kaścit ^nakiḥ asti nāstīti yadetat tat ^addhā satyameva |
chāndase vartamāne luṅi ‘ bahulaṃ chandasyamāṅyoge'pi ’ iti aḍabhāvaḥ |
‘ vatupkaraṇe yuṣmadasmadbhyāṃ chandasi sādṛśya upasaṃkhyānam ’ ( pā. sū. 5. 2. 39. 1 ) iti sādṛśyarthe vatup |
pratyayasya pittvādanu- dāttatve prātipadikasvara eva śiṣyate |

na yasya dyāvāpṛthivī anu vyaco na sindhavo rajaso antamānuśuḥ | nota svavṛṣṭiṃ madai asya yudhyata eko anyaccakṛṣe viśvamānuṣak || 14 || na | yasya | dyāvāpṛthivī iti | anu | vyacaḥ | na | sindhavaḥ | rajasaḥ | antam | ānuśuḥ | na | uta | sva'vṛṣṭim | madai | asya | yudhyataḥ | ekaḥ | anyat | cakṛṣe | viśvam | ānuṣak ||14||
yasya indrasya vyacaḥ vyāpakaṃ dyāvāpṛthivī dyāvāpṛthivyau na anu ānaśāte prāptumasamarthe babhūvataḥ |
tathā rajasaḥ antarikṣalokasyopari sindhavaḥ syandanaśīlā āpo yasya indrasya tejasaḥ antam avasānaṃ na ānuśuḥ na prāpuḥ |
uta api ca somapānena madai harṣe sati svavṛṣṭiṃ svīkṛtavṛṣṭiṃ vṛtrādiṃ yudhyataḥ yudhyamānasya asya indrasya balasya antaṃ vṛtrādayaḥ na prāpuḥ |
ato he indra ekaḥ tvam anyat svavyatiriktaṃ viśvaṃ sarvaṃ bhūtajātam ānupak ānuṣaktaṃ cakṛṣe |
divo dyāvā (pā. sū. 6. 3. 29) iti dyāvādeśa ādyudātto nipātitaḥ |
apṛthivīrūpamanthipu iti paryudāsāt nottarapade'nudāttādau iti niṣedhābhāvaḥ |
vyaceḥ kuṭāditvamanasi (kā. 1. 2. 1. 1) iti vacanāt ṅittvābhāve saṃprasāraṇābhāvaḥ |

ārcannatra marutaḥ sasmin‌ājau viśve devāso amadannanu tvā | vṛtrasya yaddhṛṣṭimatā vadhena ni tvamindra pratyanaṃ jaghantha || 15 || ārcan | atra | marutaḥ | sasmin | ājau | viśve | devāsaḥ | amadan | anu | tvā | vṛtrasya | yat | dhṛṣṭi'matā | vadhena | ni | tvam | indra | pratyanam | jaghantha ||15||
he indra tvāṃ marutaḥ atra asmin saṃgrāme ārcan prahara bhagavo jahi vīrayasva (ai. brā. 3. 20) ityanena vacanena apūjayana |
sasmin tasmin yadvā sarvasmin ājau saṃgrāme viśve devāsaḥ te sarve dānādiguṇayuktā marutaḥ tvā tvām anu amadan anukrameṇa harṣaṃ prāpayan |
he indra tvaṃ yat yadā dhṛṣṭimatā aṃśayati śatrūniti dhṛṣṭiḥ astriḥ |
adhimattvaṃ ca vajrasya brāhmaṇe samāmnātaṃ—vajro vā eṣa yadūpaḥ so'ṣṭāśriḥ kartavyo'ṣṭāśrivai vajraḥ (ai. brā. 2. 1) iti |
tena vajreṇa vṛtrasya ānaṃ prati ānanaṃ mukhaṃ prati yadvā śvāsahetu ghrāṇaṃ prati ni jaghantha nitarāṃ prāṇāparvīḥ ||
tadaḥ saḥ sau (pā. sū. 7. 2. 106) iti vidhīyamānaṃ satvaṃ vyatyayena saptamyāmati draṣṭavyam |

aneneti ānaṃ ghrāṇam| karaṇe ghañ| ‘ karpānvataḥ ’ ityantodāttatvam| jaghanyaḥ ‘ hana hiṃsāgatyoḥ ’| thali ‘upadeśe'tvataḥ’ iti itpratiṣedhaḥ| ‘ abhyāsācca ’ iti abhyāsāduttarasya hakārasya ghasvam| lirasvareṇa pratyayāt pūrvasyodāttatvam || 14 ||
‘ nyū ṣu ’ iti ekādaśarcaṃ tṛtīyaṃ sūktam|
tathā cānukrāntaṃ—‘ nyū pvekādaśyanye triṣṭubhau ’ iti|
atirātre prathame paryāye brāhmaṇācchaṃsinaḥ śasre etatsūtam|
tathā cāsūtrayadācāryaḥ—‘ nyū ṣu vācamapsu dhūtasya harivaḥ pibeheti yājyā ’ ( āśva. śrau. 6. 4 ) iti ||
nyū ṣu vāca̭ pra ma॒he bha̭rāmahe gi॒ra indra̭āya॒ sada̭ne vi॒vasva̭taḥ |
duro arvasya dura indra gorasi duro yarvasya vasuna inaspatiḥ |
śikṣā naraḥ pradivo arkamarśanaḥ sakhā sakhibhyastamidaṃ gṛṇīmasi ||
duraḥ | arvasya | duraḥ | indra | goḥ | asi | duraḥ | yarvasya | vasunaḥ | inaḥ | patiḥ | śikṣā naraḥ | pradivaḥ | arkam'arśanaḥ | sakhā | sakhibhyaḥ | tam | idam | gṛṇīmasi ||2||

he indra tvam arvasya duraḥ dātā asi | tathā goḥ paścādeḥ duraḥ dātāsi | tathā yarvasya yavāderdhānyajātasya duraḥ dātā asi | vasunaḥ nivāsahetoḥ dhanasya inaḥ svāmī patiḥ sarveṣāṃ pālayitā śikṣā naraḥ | śikṣatidānakarmā (ni. 3. 10. 8) | śikṣāyā dānasya netāsi | pradivaḥ purāṇaḥ | pragatā divo divasā yasmin sa tathoktaḥ | akāmarśanaḥ | kāmān karṣayati nāśayatīti kāmarśanaḥ | na kāmarśano'kāmarśanaḥ | avyayapūrvapadaprakṛtisvarastvam | havi
tasya adupadeśāt lasārva- dhātukasvareṇa anudāttasya ekādeśasvareṇodāttatvam |
' ekādeśasvaro'ntaraṅgaḥ siddho bhavatīti vakta- vyam ' ( pā. sū. 8. 2. 6. 1 ) iti vacanāt tasya siddhatve sati ' śaturanumaḥ 0 ' iti ajādi- vibhakterudāttatvam |
luṅi ' niśridrustubhyaḥ 0 ' ( pā. sū. 3. 1. 48 ) iti caleḥ caḍādeśasya ' nonayatidhvanayati 0 ' ( pā. sū. 3. 1. 51 ) ityā- dinā pratiṣedhaḥ |
' hyantakṣaṇa 0 ' ( pā. sū. 7. 2. 5 ) iti sici vṛddhipratiṣedhaḥ ||
indrḙṇa dasyuṃ daya̭nta indubhi̭ryatadveṣasaḥ sa॒miṣā ra̭bhemahi ||
ebhiḥ | yu'bhiḥ | su'manāḥ | ebhiḥ | indu'bhiḥ | ni'rundhānaḥ | ama̭tim | gobhiḥ | aśminā̭ | indreṇa | dasyum | daya̭ntaḥ | indu'bhiḥ | yuta'dveṣasaḥ | sam | iṣā | ra̭bhemahi || 4 ||

he indra ᳵebhiḥ asmābhirdattaiḥ ᳵyubhiḥ dīptairhavirbhirhavirādibhiḥ ᳵebhirindubhiḥ purovartibhiḥ tubhyaṃ dattaiḥ someśca prītasvam asmākam ᳵamatiṃ dāridryaṃ ᳵgobhiḥ tvayā dattaiḥ paśubhiḥ ᳵaśvinā aśvayuktena dhanena ca ᳵnirundhānaḥ nivartayan ᳵsumnāḥ śobhanamano bhava |

vayam ᳵindubhiḥ asmābhi- dattaiḥ somaiḥ prītena ᳵindreṇa ᳵdasyum upakṣapayitāraṃ śatruṃ ᳵdayantaḥ hiṃsantaḥ ata eva ᳵyutadveṣasaḥ pṛthagbhūtaśatrukā bhūtvā ᳵiṣā indradattena annena ᳵsaṃ rabhemahi saṃrabdhā bhavema |
sarmindra rāyā sa॒miṣā ra̭bhemahi saṃ vā॒jairbheḥ puruścandrā̭bhiryubhiḥ |
saṃ de॒vyā pra̭matya॒ā vīra̭śuṣmayā goa̭grayāśvā̭vatyā ra̭bhemahi ||
sam | indra | rāyā | sam | iṣā | ra̭bhemahi | sam | vājaiḥ'bhiḥ | puru'candraiḥ | abhi'yu'bhiḥ | sam | devyā | pra'matyā | vīra'śuṣmayā | go'agrayā | aśva'vatyā | ra̭bhemahi || 5 ||
he ᳵindra ᳵrāyā dhanena vayaṃ ᳵsaṃ rabhemahi saṃgacchemahi |
ᳵpuruścandraiḥ puruṇāṃ bahūnāmāhlādakaiḥ ᳵabhiryubhiḥ abhito dīpyamānaiḥ |
kiṃca ᳵdevyā dyotamānayā ᳵpramatyā tvadīyayā prakṛṣṭabuddhyā ᳵsaṃ rabhemahi |
vīraṃ viśeṣeṇa śatrūṇāṃ kṣapaṇasamarthaṃ śuṣmaṃ balaṃ yasyāḥ sā tathoktā |

stotṛbhyo dānārthamagre pramukhata eva gāvo yasyāḥ sā tathoktā | 'aśvāvatyā aśvepetayā || rāyā | 'aḍiḍam' ityādinā vibhakterudāttatvam | puruṣannaiḥ | 'hasvācandrottarapade mantre' iti suṭ | bhcutvena śakāraḥ | samāsasvaraḥ | abhidyubhiḥ | abhigatā dyaurdisyeṣām | atra divaśabdo dīptiṃ lakṣa- yati | avyayapūrvapadaprakṛtisvaratvam | devyā | 'udāttayaṇaḥ' iti vibhakterudāttatvam | pramatyā | 'tādau ca niti' iti gateḥ prakṛtisvaratvam | uttarayorbahuvrīhau pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaratvam | 'sarvatra vibhāṣā goḥ' (pā. sū. 6. 1. 122) iti goagrayā ityatra prakṛtibhāvaḥ | aśvāvatyā | 'mantre somā- śvendriya' iti matupi dīrghatvam || 15 ||
te tvā madā amadantāni vṛṣṇyā te somāso vṛtrahatyeṣu satapate |
yatkārave darśa vṛtrāṇyaprati barhiṣmate ni sahasrāṇi barhayaḥ ||
te | tvā | madāḥ | amadan | tāni | vṛṣṇyā | te | somāsaḥ | vṛtrahatyeṣu | satapate | yat | kārave | darśa | vṛtrāṇi | aprati | barhiṣmate | ni | sahasrāṇi | barhayaḥ || 6 ||
he satapate satāṃ pālayitarindra vṛtrahatyeṣu vṛtrahananeṣu nimittabhūteṣu sassu te pūrvoktāḥ madāḥ mādakā marutaḥ tvā tvām amadan amadayan harṣaṃ prāpayan |
tāni pūrvoktāni vṛṣṇyā vṛṣṇaḥ secana- samarthasya tava sambandhīni carupuroḍāśādīni havīṃṣi tvām amadan |
te somāsaḥ prasiddhāḥ somāśca tvām amadan |
yat yadā kārave stutikartre barhiṣmate yajñavate yajamānāya daśa sahasrāṇi apari- mitāni vṛtrāṇi āvarakāṇyupadravajātāni aprati śatrubhirpratitagatastvaṃ ni barhayaḥ nyavadhīḥ |
śapaḥ pittvādanudāttatve ṇica eva svaraḥ śiṣyate |
yudhā yudhamupa ghedeṣi dhṛṣṇuyā purā puraṃ samidaṃ haṃsyojasā |
namyā yadindra sakhyā parāvati nibarhayo namuciṃ nāma māyinam ||
yudhā | yudham | upa | ghe | it | eṣi | dhṛṣṇuyā | purā | puram | sam | idam | haṃsi | ojasā | namyā | yat | indra | sakhyā | parāvati | nibarhayaḥ | namucim | nāma | māyinam ||7||
he indra dhṛṣṇuyā śatrūṇāṃ dharṣakatvaṃ yudhā yuddhena saṃbadhaṃ yudhaṃ yuddham upa ghedeṣi upaiva gacchasi |
śatrūṇāmasurāṇāṃ purā pureṇa nagareṇa saha idaṃ purovarti puraṃ śatrunagaram ojasā balena saṃ haṃsi samyagvināśayasi |
he indra tvaṃ namyā śatrupu namanaśīlena sakhyā sahāyabhūtena vajreṇa parāvati dūra- deśe namuciṃ nāma anayā saṃjñayā prasiddhaṃ māyinaṃ māyāvinamasuraṃ yat yasmāt nibarhayaḥ nita- rāmhiṃsīḥ |

‘jiṣṇuḥ prāgahraye’ | ‘trasigṛdhṛdhṛṣikṣipaḥ knuḥ’ iti knupratyayaḥ | kittvādguṇābhāvaḥ | ‘supāṃ suluk’ iti soḥ yājādeśaḥ | ‘citaḥ’ ityantodāttatvam | purā | ‘pṛ pālanapūraṇayoḥ’ | pūrayati rājñāmabhimatānīti | ‘kvip ca’ iti kvip | ‘udoṣṭhyapūrvasya’ iti uttvam | ‘sāvekācaḥ’ iti vibhaktirudāttā | haṃsi | hanterlaṭi sipi adāditvāt śapo luki ‘naścāpadāntasya jhali’ (pā. sū. 8. 3. 24) iti anusvāraḥ | namyā | ‘ṇamu prahvatve’ | auṇādika inapratyayaḥ | ‘supāṃ suluk’ iti tṛtīyāyā vyādeśaḥ | ṭilopaḥ | satyā | ‘śepo dhyasakhi’ (pā. sū. 1. 4. 7) iti ghisaṃjñāpratiṣedhāt nābhāvābhāve yaṇādeśaḥ | namucim | indreṇa saha yuddhaṃ na muñcatīti namuciḥ | auṇādikaḥ kipratyayaḥ | ‘nabhrāṇnapāt’ ityādinā nañaḥ prakṛtibhāvaḥ | nañ na gatirna ca kārakamiti kuduttarapadaprakṛtisvaratvābhāve avyayapūrvapadaprakṛtisvaratvam | māyinam | māyāśabdasya vrīhādiṣu pāṭhāt matvarthīya iniḥ ||
tvam | karaṃjam | uta | pūrṇayam | vadhīḥ | tejaṣṭhayā | atithigvasya | vartanī | tvam | śatā | vaḍgadasya | abhinat | puraḥ | ananudaḥ | pari'sūtāḥ | ṛjiśdhanā || 8 ||

he indra tvaṃ karaṃjaṃ etatsaṃjñakamasuram uta api ca pūrṇayaṃ etannāmānamasuraṃ ca ati- thigvasya etatsaṃjñasya rājñaḥ prayojanāya tejaṣṭhayā atiśayena tejasvinyā vartanī vartanyā śatrupreraṇa- kuśalayā śaktyā vadhīḥ hatavānasi |
anu paścāt dyati khaṇḍayatīti anudaḥ anucaraḥ |
tādṛśo'nucararahita eka eva tvam ṛjiśdhanā etatsaṃjñakena rājñā pariṣpūtāḥ parito'- vadhvāḥ śatā śatāni śatasaṃkhyākāḥ vaḍgadasya etatsaṃjñakasyāsurasya puraḥ purāṇi nagarāṇi abhinat bibhidiṣe ||
tasmāt ātiśāyanike iṣṭhani ‘vinmatoluk’ iti vino luk |
ṣaṣṭiṃ sahasrā navutiṃ navaṃ śruto ni cakreṇa rathyā duṣpadāvṛṇak ||
tvam | etān | jana'rājaḥ | dviḥ | daśa | abandhunā | su'śravasā | upa'jagmuṣaḥ | ṣaṣṭim | sahasrā | navatim | nava | śrutaḥ | ni | cakreṇa | rathyā | duḥ'padā | avṛṇak ||9||

he indra śrutaḥ viśvataḥ prakhyāta: tvaṃ dvirdaśa viṃśatisaṃkhyākān abandhunā bandhurahitena sahāyarahitena suśravasā etatsaṃjñakena rājñā yuddhārtham upajagmuṣaḥ upagatavataḥ etān evaṃvidhān janarājaḥ janapadānāmadhapatīn |
paṣṭiṃ sahasrā sahasrāṇāṃ paṣṭiṃ navatiṃ nava navasaṃkhyāttarāṃ navatim |
tān rājña īdṛsaṃkhyākānanucaraśca rathyā rathasambandhanā duṣpadā duṣpadadanena |
tvāṃ stuvataḥ suśravaso jaryārthaṃ tvamāgatya tadīyān śatrūnajaipirityarthaḥ ||
samāsāntavidheranitya- tvāt ( paribhā. 84 ) ṭacpratyayābhāvaḥ ( pā. sū. 5. 4. 91 ) |
rājanśabdo ' rājṛ dīptau ' ityasmāt kaninpratyayānta ādyudāttaḥ |
śasi bhasaṃjñāyāṃ ' vasoḥ saṃprasāraṇam ' iti saṃprasāraṇam |
laṅi madhyamaikavacane ' halyābhyaḥ ' iti siṇe lopaḥ |
tvamasmai kutsamatithigvamāyuṃ mahe rājñe yūnai arandhanāyaḥ ||
tvam | āvitha | su'śravasam | tava | ūti'bhiḥ | tava | trāma'bhiḥ | indra | tūrvayāṇam | tvam | asmai | kutsam | atithig vam | āyum | mahe | rājñe | yūnai | arandhanāyaḥ ||10||
he indra tvaṃ tavotibhiḥ tvadīyaiḥ pālanaiḥ suśravasaṃ pūrvoktaṃ rājānam āvitha rakṣita |
tathā tūrvayāṇam etannāmānaṃ rājānaṃ tava trāmabhiḥ tvadīyairekaiḥ pālakairaiḥ āviyeti śeṣaḥ |
kiṃca tvaṃ mahe mahate yūnai taruṇāya asmai suśravase rājñe kutsādīn trīn rājñaḥ arandhanāyaḥ vaśamanayaḥ |
' iṣṭavarṇau prātipadikamya ' ( pā. sū. 6. 4. 155. 1 ) iti iṣṭavadbhāvāt ṭilopaḥ |

ya ucchīndra devagaupāḥ sakhāyaste śivatamā asāma | tvāṃ stoṣāma tvayā suvīrā drāghīya āyuḥ prataraṃ dadhānāḥ || 11 || ye | ut'ṛci | indra | deva'gaupāḥ | sakhāyaḥ | te | śiva'tamāḥ | asāma | tvām | stoṣāma | tvayā | suvīrāḥ | drāghīyaḥ | āyuḥ | pra'taram | dadhānāḥ || 11 ||

he indra ye vayam udaci udakeṃ yajñasamāptau vartamānāḥ devagopāḥ devaiḥ pālitāḥ te tava sakhāyaḥ sakhivadatyantaṃ priyā ata eva śivatamā asāma atiśayena kalyāṇāṃ abhūma, te vayaṃ yajña- samāptyuttarakālamapi tvāṃ stoṣāma mtvāma |
asmābhiḥ stutena tvayā suvīrāḥ śobhanaputravantaḥ santaḥ drāghīyaḥ atiśayena dīrgham āyuḥ jīvanaṃ prataraṃ prakṛṣṭataraṃ yathā bhavati tathā dadhānāḥ dhārayanto bhūyāsam ||

bhāvaḥ || pṛtsu | ‘padādiṣu māṃsṛtsnūnāmupasaṃkhyānam’ (pā. sū. 6. 1. 63. 1) iti pṛtanā- śabdasya pudbhāvaḥ | parīṇaśe | naśatirnyāsikarmā | ‘kṛśyārthe tavaiken’ iti kenpratyayaḥ | nistvādāyu- dāttatvam | ‘nipātasya ca’ iti pūrvapadasya dīrghatvam | nacaḥ | dvitīyārthe prathamā | rorvat | ‘ru śabde’ | yallugantāt laṭaḥ śatṛ | ‘adādivacca’ iti vacanāt śapo luk | śatṛṅittvāt guṇābhāve uvahā- deśaḥ | ‘nābhyastācchatuḥ’ iti numpratiṣedhaḥ | ‘abhyastānāmādiḥ’ ityādyudāttatvam | kathā | ‘thā hatau ca chandasi’ iti kiṃśabdāt prakāravacane thāpratyayaḥ | tasya vibhaktisaṃjñāyāṃ ‘kimaḥ kaḥ’ (pā. sū. 7. 2. 103) iti kādeśaḥ | ārata | ‘ṛ gatau’ | ‘samo gamyucchi0’ ityātmane- padam | chāndase vartamāne laḍi adāditvāt śapo luk | jhasya adādeśaḥ | āḍāgamo vṛddhiśca ||
arcī śakrāya śākine śacīvate śṛṇvantamindraṃ mahayan abhi ṣṭuhi |
yo dhṛṣṇunā śavasā rodasī ubhe vṛṣā vṛṣtvā vṛṣabho nyuñjate ||
arcī | śakrāya | śākine | śacī'vate | śṛṇvantam | indram | mahayan | abhi | ṣṭuhi | yaḥ | dhṛṣṇunā | śavasā | rodasī iti | ubhe iti | vṛṣā | vṛṣ'tvā | vṛṣabhaḥ | ni'uñjate ||2||
he adhvaryo ‘śākine śaktiyuktāya ‘śacīvate prajñāvate ‘śakrāya indrāya ‘arca evaṃvidhamindraṃ pūjaya |
kiṃca ‘stutī: ‘śṛṇvantaṃ samīcīneyaṃ stutiriti jānantaṃ tam ‘indraṃ ‘mahayan pūjayan ‘abhi ‘ṣṭuhi ābhimukhyena tasya stotraṃ kuru |
‘yaḥ indraḥ ‘dhṛṣṇunā śatrūṇāṃ dharṣakeṇa ‘śavasā balena ‘ubhe ‘rodasī dyāvāpṛthivyau ‘nyuñjate nitarāṃ prasādhayati |
sa indraḥ ‘vṛṣā secanasamarthaḥ ‘vṛṣavā vṛṣvenānenaiva secanasāmarthyena ‘vṛṣabhaḥ varṣitā kāmānāṃ yadvā vṛṣṭyudakānām ||
arcī dive bṛhate śūryam vacaḥ svakṣatraṃ yasya dhṛṣato dhṛṣmanaḥ |
bṛhadvā asuro barhaṇā kṛtaḥ puro haribhyāṃ vṛṣabho ratho hi ṣaḥ ||
arcī | dive | bṛhate | śūryam | vacaḥ | sva'kṣatram | yasya | dhṛṣataḥ | dhṛṣ'manaḥ | bṛhat'śravāḥ | asuraḥ | barhaṇā | kṛtaḥ | puraḥ | hari'bhyām | vṛṣabhaḥ | rathaḥ | hi | ṣaḥ ||3||

balavat mana: dhṛpata dhṛṣṭa bhavati | hi ṣa: sa hi sa khalvindra: bṛhacchavā: prabhūtayaśā: asura: śatrūṇāṃ nirasitā | yadvā | asu: prāṇo balaṃ vā | tadvān | ro mavadhrīya: | athavā | asava: prāṇā: tena ca āpo lakṣyante, ‘prāṇā vā āpa:’ (tai. brā. 3. 2. 5. 2) iti śrute: | tān rāti dadātīti asura: | barhaṇā śatrūṇāṃ nirbarhayitā haribhyām adhāmvāṃ pura: kṛta: pūjita: vṛṣabha: kāmānāṃ varṣitā ratha: raṃhaṇaśīla: || śūnyam | ‘tatra sādhu:’ iti yat | ‘sarve vidhayaśchandasi vikalpyante’ iti ‘yato'nāva:’ ityādyudāttatvābhāve ‘tisvaritam’ iti svaritatvam | dhṛpata: | ‘dhiṣvā prāgalbhye’ | vyatyayena śa: | ‘śatrunama:’ iti vibhakterudāttatvam | bṛhacchavā: | bṛhat śravo yasya | bahuvrīhau pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaratvam | asura: | ‘asu kṣepaṇe’ | ‘aseraran’ (u. sū. 1. 42) iti uranpratyaya: | nistvādādyudāttatvam | barhaṇā | ‘supāṃ suluk’ iti vibhakte: ākāra: | pura: | ‘pūrvādhara’ ityādinā asipratyayāntaḥ antodātta: ||
tvaṃ divo bṛhataḥ sānuṃ kopayo'va tmanā dhṛṣatā śambaraṃ bhinat |
yanmāyino vṛndino mandināṃ dhṛṣācchatāṃ garbhastamaśaniṃ pṛttyaṃsi |
tvam | diva: | bṛhataḥ | sānuṃ | kopaya: | ava | tmanā | dhṛṣatā | śambaram | bhinat | yat | māyina: | vṛndina: | mandinā | dhṛṣat | śitām | garbhastam | aśanim | pṛttyaṃsi ||4||
he indra tvaṃ bṛhata: mahata: diva: dyulokasya mānu samucchritamuparipradeśaṃ kopaya: akampaya: |
dhṛpatā śatrūṇāṃ dharpayitrā tmanā ātmanā svayameva śambaram etatsaṃjñamasuram avābhinat avadhī: |
yat yadā vṛndina: śatrūn jetuṃ mṛdubhāvaṃ prāptān |
māyina: māyāvino'surān mandinā hṛṣṭena dhṛpata dhṛpatā prāgalbhyaṃ prāpnuvatā manasā yuktastvaṃ śitāṃ tīkṣṇīkṛtāṃ garbhasta hastena gṛhītām |
tadvatīm aśaniṃ vajraṃ pṛttyaṃsi tānasurān jetuṃ pṛttārūpecchasi |
tadānīṃ bṛhato diva: sānu kopaya: iti pūrveṇānvaya: |
ni yadvākṣi śvasanasya mūrdhani śuṣṇasya cidvṛndino roruvadnāṃ |
prācīnaina manasā barhaṇāvatā yadvā citkṛṇava: kastavā pariṃ |
ni | yat | vṛṇākṣi | śvasanasya | mūrdhani | śuṣṇasya | cit | vṛndina: | roruvan | vanā | prācīnaina | manasā | barhaṇā'vatā | yat | adya | cit | kṛṇava: | ka: | tvā | pariṃ || 5 ||
he indra tvaṃ roruvat meghairarthaṃ śabdayan śvasanasya antarikṣe śvasitīti śvasano vāyu: |
tasya vṛndina: svakiraṇairāphalādīn mṛdubhāvaṃ prāpayataḥ śuṣṇasya cit rasānāṃ śoṣayitrādisyāpi
vāyunā sūryakiraṇaiśca vṛṣṭā āpaḥ sūryasyopari punarvasthāpyante |
nibarhayatīti vadhakarmasu pāṭhāt barhaṇā śatrūṇāṃ hiṃsā tadvatā |
evaṃbhūtena 'manasā yuktastvaṃ 'yat yasmāt 'adyā 'cit adyāpi 'kṛṇavaḥ dharma- kāle sūryasyopari bhaumān rasānavasthāpayasi varṣāsu ca varṣayasīti |
yasmādetat' kuruṣe tasmāt kāraṇāt 'tvā tvāṃ 'pari upari 'kaḥ vartate na ko'pītyarthaḥ |
khapratyayasya satiśiṣṭatvāt tadādeśasya upadeśivadbhāvena īkāra udāttaḥ |
tasya ato lope sati sthānivadbhā- vāt laghūpadhaguṇābhāvaḥ |
nivṛṇakṣi yacchravasanasya mūrdhani śabdakāriṇaḥ śuṣṇyādityasya ca śoṣayit roru- yamāṇo vanānīti vā dhanānīti vā' (niru. 5:15-16) iti |
tvamāvitha naryaṃ turvaśaṃ yadaṃ tvaṃ turvītiṃ vyayaṃ śatakrato |
tvaṃ rathametaṃ kṛlye dhane tvaṃ purau navatiṃ dumbhayo nava |
tvam | āvitha | naryam | turvaśam | yadam | tvam | turvītim | vyayam | śatakrato iti śata'krato | tvam | ratham | etaśam | kṛlye | dhane | tvam | puraḥ | navatim | dumbhayaḥ | nava || 6 ||
he indra 'tvaṃ naryādīn trīn rājñaḥ 'āvitha rarakṣita |
tathā he 'śatakrato bahuvidhakarman bahu- vidhajña vā 'tvaṃ 'vyayaṃ vyayakulajaṃ turvītināmānaṃ' rājānam āvitha ityeva |
api ca 'tvaṃ 'rathaṃ raṃhaṇasvabhāvam etatsaṃjaṃjñamapi 'etaśam etatsaṃjakaṃ 'dhane dhananimitte saṃgrāme 'kṛlye kartavye sati āvitheti śeṣaḥ |
tathā 'tvaṃ śambarasya 'navatiṃ 'nava navottaranavatisaṃkhyākāḥ 'puraḥ purāṇi 'dambhayaḥ vyanī- naśaḥ |

1. ca-tadavasthāpanamindraḥ; na-tādṛgavasthāpanamindraḥ; sa-tadeva sthāpanamindraḥ | 2. ḍha-na-sa-varṣesīti | 3. ḍha-yadetat | 4. śa-vandinaḥ | atra | 5. ta-tha-da-dha-sa-turvīti turvītināmānam | 6. ca-cha-pha- raṃhaṇasvabhāvam etaśam etatsaṃjaṃjñārṣam |

sa ghā rājā sa॒tpa̭tiḥ śṛ॒ṇuva̭jjano॒ rāta̭ha॒vyaḥ prati॒ yaḥ śā॒sami̭nvati | u॒kthā vā॒ yo a̭bhi॒gṛṇā̭ti rā॒dhasā॒ dānṷra॒smā u॒parā̭ pinvate di॒vaḥ || 7 || saḥ | gha | rājā̭ | sa॒t'pa̭tiḥ | śṛ॒ṇuva̭t | ja॒naḥ | rāta̭'ha॒vyaḥ | prati̭ | yaḥ | śā॒sam | i॒nvati̭ | u॒kthā | vā॒ | yaḥ | a॒bhi॒'gṛṇā̭ti | rā॒dhasā̭ | dānṷḥ | a॒smai̭ | u॒parā̭ | pinva̭te | di॒vaḥ ||7||
vsa vgha sa khalu vjanaḥ jātaḥ vrājā rājamānaḥ vsatpatiḥ satāṃ pālayitā yajamānaḥ vśṛṇuvat ātmānaṃ vardhayati |
vyaḥ indraṃ vprati vrātahavyaḥ dattahaviṣ san vśāsam indrakartṛkamanuśāsanaṃ yadvā tasya stutim vinvati vyāpnoti |
vukthā vā ukthāni śastrāṇi vā vyaḥ stotā vrādhasā havirlakṣaṇenānnena saha vabhigṛṇāti tasyābhimukhīkaraṇāya śaṃsati vasmai stotre vdānuḥ abhimataphala- pradātendraḥ vuparā uparān meghān |
sa ca yāskenaiva niruktaḥ- 'upara upalo megho bhavatyaparamante'smintrāṇyyuparatā āpa iti vā ' (niru. 2. 21) iti |
tān meghān vdivaḥ sakāśāt vpinvate secayati dogdhīti yāvat ||

' pyantāt vartamāne luṅi kleḥ caḍādeśe 'saṃprasāraṇaṃ saṃprasāraṇāśrayaṃ ca balīyaḥ' (pā. ma. 6. 1. 17. 2) iti antaraṅgamapi vṛddhyādikaṃ bādhitvā 'ṇau ca śaṃśloḥ' (pā. sū. 6. 1. 31) iti saṃprasāraṇam |
'śāsu anuśiṣṭau' ityasmāt bhāve ghañi 'karṣātvataḥ' ityantodāttatve prāpte vyatyayenādyudāttatvam |

a॒sama̭ṃ kṣa॒trama̭sā ma॒nīṣā॒ pra saṷma॒pā a॒rpasā̭ santu ne॒mai | ye ta̭ indra da॒duṣo॒ vardha̭yanti ma॒hi kṣa॒traṃ stha॒vira̭ṃ vṛ॒ṣṇya̭ṃ ca || 8 || a॒sama̭m | kṣa॒tram | a॒sa॒mā | ma॒nīṣā̭ | pra | saṷma॒pāḥ | a॒rpasā̭ | sa॒ntu | ne॒mai | ye | te | i॒ndra॒ | da॒duṣa̭ḥ | vardha̭yanti | ma॒hi | kṣa॒tram | stha॒vira̭m | vṛ॒ṣṇya̭m | ca || 8 ||
indrasya vkṣatraṃ balam vasamaṃ na kenacit samam |
tathā vmanīṣā buddhiśdha vasamā na kasyāpi buddhayā samānā |
vneme ete vsomapāḥ somasya patāro yajamānāḥ vapasā karmaṇā vpra vsantu pravṛddhā bhavantu |
he vindra vte tava vdaduṣaḥ havirdattavantaḥ vye tvadīyaṃ vmahi mahat vkṣatraṃ balaṃ vsthaviraṃ sthūlaṃ pravṛddhaṃ vvṛṣṇyaṃ vṛṣatvaṃ puṃstvaṃ vca vvardhayanti pravṛddhaṃ kurvanti |
‘tvasamasima- nemetyanuccāni ’ (phi. sū. 78 ) iti sarvānudāttatve prāpte vyatyayenādyudāttatvam |
‘ saṃprasāraṇaṃ saṃprasāraṇāśrayaṃ ca balīyaḥ ’ iti iḍāgamāt pūrvameva saṃprasāraṇam |
‘ ajiraśiśira0 ’ (u. sū. 1. 53 ) ityādinā tiṣṭhateḥ kiracpratyayānto nipātitaḥ |
vyaśruhi tarpayā kāmameṣāmathā manau vasudeyāya kṛṣva |

nadanāt nayaḥ iti vyutpattyā nadīśabdena āpa ucyante |

divaścidasya varimā vi papratha indraṃ na mhā pṛthivī cana prati|
bhīmastuviṣmānghṛṇibhya ātapaḥ śiśīte vajraṃ tejase na vaṃsagaḥ ||

evaṃvidhaḥ sa indraḥ vvajraṃ varjanaśīlamāyudhaṃ vtejase taikṣṇyāya vśiśīte tankaroti tīkṣṇīkaroti|
vananīyagatimān vṛṣabho yathā svaśastre yuddhārthaṃ tīkṣṇīkaroti tadvat ||
‘pratinidhi- pratidāne ca yasmāt’ (pā. sū. 2. 3. 11) iti pañcamī tu chāndasatvāt na bhavati |
‘bhibhī bhaye’ ityasmāt ‘bhiyaḥ puvā’ (u. sū. 1. 145) iti makpratyayaḥ |
anajādāvapi lasārva- dhātuke vyatyayena abhyastāyudāttatvam (pā. sū. 6. 1. 189) |
‘vana paṇa saṃbhaktau’ itya- smāt karmaṇi auṇādikaḥ sapratyayaḥ |

yadvā uruvaiḥ vviśritāḥ vyāptāḥ vnadhaḥ nadīḥ śabda- kāriṇīḥ vṛtreṇāvṛtā āpaḥ varṇavaṃ vna samudra iva vprati vgṛbhṇāti |
sa ca vindraḥ vsomasya pītaye vvṛṣāyate vṛpa ivācarati |
sa indraḥ devatā vīryeṇa ati atiśayita iti pra vekite prakarṣeṇāsmābhirjñātau babhūva |
sa ca ugraḥ ugroṇa indraḥ viśvasmai sarvasmai vṛtravadhādirupāya karmaṇe devaiḥ purohitaḥ purastādavasthāpitaḥ ||
bahuvrīhau ‘ vīravīryau ca ’ ityuttarapadādyudāttatvavidhānasāmarthyāt ‘ yato'nāvaḥ ’ : irayādyudāttatvābhāve ‘ titsvaritam ’ iti svaritatvam |
tasmin hi sati ‘ ādyudāttaṃ vyacchandasi ’ ityanenaiva siddhatvāt punarvīryagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syādityayuktam |
asmāt yaḍantāt cekidyateḥ karmaṇi liṭi atolopayalopau |
puraḥśabdasya asipratyayāntasya ‘ taddhitaścāsarvavibhaktiḥ ’ iti avyayatvena ‘ puro'vyayam ’ iti gatisaṃjñāyāṃ ‘ gatiranantaraḥ ’ iti pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaratvam ||
sa idvanai namasyubhirvacasyate cāru janeṣu prabruvāṇa īndriyam |
vṛṣā chandurbhavati haryato vṛṣā kṣameṇa dhenāṃ maghavā yadinvati ||
saḥ | it | vanai | namasyu'bhiḥ | vacasyate | cāru | janeṣu | pra'bruvāṇaḥ | īndriyam | vṛṣā | chandaḥ | bhatrati | haryataḥ | vṛṣā | kṣameṇa | dhenām | magha'vā | yat | invati || 4 ||
sa it sa evendraḥ vane araṇye namasyubhiḥ namasaḥ stautreṇa pūjayitṛbhirṛṣibhiḥ vacasyate vaca icchan kriyate stūyate ityarthaḥ |
sa cendra ātmīyeṣu janeṣu indriyaṃ svavīryaṃ prabruvāṇaḥ prakaṭayan cāru vartate |
kiṃca saḥ vṛṣā kāmānāṃ vardhakaḥ haryataḥ prepsāvato yiyakṣataḥ chandaḥ upacchandayitā bhavati |
evaṃbhūto yajamānaḥ kṣemeṇa indrakṛtena rakṣaṇena yuktaḥ man yat yadā dhenāṃ stutilakṣaṇāṃ vācam invati prerayati |
maghavā vṛṣā indraḥ kṣemena kṣamakareṇa manasā dhenāṃ yajamānaiḥ kṛtāṃ stutiṃ yasmāt invati vyāpnoti |
‘ indriyamindraliṅgamindradṛṣṭamindrasṛṣṭamindra juṣṭamindradattamiti vā ’ (pā. sū. 5. 2. 93) iti liṅgādiṣvartheṣu indraśabdāt ghacapratyayo nipātyate |

sa inmahārni samithāni mjamanā kṛṇoti yuṣma orjasā janaibhyaḥ | adhā cana śraddhati tviṣīmata indrāya vajraṃ nigharnighate vṛdham || 5 || saḥ | it | mahārni | sam'ithāni | mjamanā | kṛṇoti | yuṣmaḥ | orjasā | janaibhyaḥ | adhā | cana | śrat | dadhati | tviṣi'mate | indrāya | vajram | ni'gharnighate | vṛdham || 5 ||
sa it sa evandraḥ yuṣmaḥ yoddhā mahārni samithāni mahataḥ saṃgrāmān mjamanā sarvasya śodhakena orjasā balena kṛṇoti karoti |
yadā indraḥ vadha hanasādhanaṃ vajram āyudhaṃ medheṣu nigharnighate nihanti |
adhā cana anantarameva tviṣīmate dīsimate indrāya sarve janāḥ śraddhati |
indro balavāniti yaducyate tatsatyameveti sarve pratipadyante |

kṛtavānityarthaḥ || kṛtrimā | ‘ḍukṛñ karaṇe’ | ‘dvitaḥ ktiḥ’ (pā. sū. 3. 3. 88) iti bhāve ktipratyayaḥ | ‘traimaśrityam’ (pā. sū. 4. 4. 20) iti nirvṛttārtha map | tasya pittvādanudāttatve ktipratyayasvara eva śiṣyate | ‘śeṣchandasi bahulam’ iti śeloṃpaḥ | kṣamayā | ‘kṣampū sahane’ | kṣamate prāṇijātakṛtamupadravamiti kṣamā | ‘piñjidādibhyo'ṅ’ (pā. sū. 3. 3. 104) iti aṅ-pratyayaḥ | tataḥ ṭāp | vyatyayena dhātoḥ upadhālopaḥ | chāndasaṃ vibhaktyudāttatvam | yadvā | ayaṃ dhātu-rabhibhavārthaḥ, ‘vaha abhibhave’ iti sahanasyābhibhavārthatvāt | asmāt auṇādiko manin | vyatyayena ṅīliṅatā | ‘manaḥ’ (pā. sū. 4. 1. 11) iti ḍīpo niṣedhe ‘ḍābubhābhyāmanyatarasyām’ (pā. sū. 4. 1. 13) iti ḍāp | ṭilopaḥ | vṛdhānaḥ

ketā:| karmaṇi ghañ| jittvādadyudāttatvam| dambhuvanti| 'dambhu dambhe'| svāditvāt śruḥ| tasya ḍittvāt 'aniditām' iti nalopaḥ| saṃyogapūrvatvena 'huśruvoḥ' iti yaṇādeśābhāve 'aci śrudhātu' ityādinā uvaṅādeśaḥ| bhūrnayaḥ| 'bhṛ bharaṇe'| 'ghṛṇiḥ pṛbhiḥ' ityādau asmāt nipratyayānto nipātyate| ṛta uttvaṃ dīrghaśca| yadvā| 'bhṛ bhaye' ityasmāt 'kṛtlyuṭo bahulam' iti kartari kini 'udoṣṭhyapūrvasya' iti uttvam| 'hali ca' iti dīrghaḥ| 'ṛkāratvādibhyaḥ kinniṣṭhāvadbhyati' (pā. sū. 8. 2. 44. 1) iti niṣṭhāvadbhāvāt natvam| niṣtvādādyudāttatvam||

tvadīyāstanavaḥ 'kartṛbhiḥ vṛtrāderasurasya vadhaṃ kurvadbhirbalakṛtaiḥ karmabhiḥ 'āvṛtāsaḥ āvṛtāḥ|

yasmādevaṃ tasmāt he 'indra 'te tava śarīreṣu 'ṛtavaḥ karmāṇi 'bhūryaḥ bahūni triyante||
ata eva 'kṣiyo dīrghāt' iti niṣṭhā natvābhāvaḥ|
'paha abhibhave' ityasmāt niṣṭhāyāṃ takārādau pratyaye 'tīpasaha' (pā. sū. 7. 2. 48) iti iṭ|
ṭhavadhatvaṣṭvaḍhalopeṣu 'sahivahorodavarṇasya' iti otve prāpte 'sāḍhyai sāḍhvā sāḍheti nigame' (pā. sū. 6. 3. 113) iti nipātanāt ātvam|
'jasādiṣu cchandasi vāvacanam' iti 'acca gheḥ' (pā. sū. 7. 3. 119) iti avatvayorabhāve yaṇādeśaḥ|
'udāttayaṇo halpūrvāt' iti udāttatvaṃ tu chāndasatvāt na pravartate||
'eṣa pra pūrvīḥ' iti ṣaṭkaṃ ṣaṣṭhaṃ sūktaṃ sanvasyāpamaindraṃ jāgatamityuktam|
'viṣuvāndivākīryaḥ' iti khaṇḍe sūtritam- 'eṣa pra pūrvīrvāmadaḥ pra maṃhiṣṭhāya' (āśva. śrau. 8. 6) iti||
eṣa pra pūrvīrava tasyaṃ cṛmriṣa'tyo na yoṣāmṛdayaṃta bhurvaṇiḥ |
dakṣaṃ mahe pāyayate hiraṇyayaṃ rathamāvṛtyā hariyogamṛbhavasam ||

āyasaḥ ayomayavacayuktadehaḥ dudhaḥ duṣṭānāṃ śatrūṇāṃ dhartāsthāpayitā evaṃbhūta indraḥ made somapānena harṣe sati yena balena śuṣṇaṃ sarvasya śoṣakamasuraṃ māyinaṃ māyāvinam ābhuṣu kārāgṛheṣu dāmani bandhake nigaḍe ni ramayat nyavāsa yat |

devī yadi tarviṣī tvāvṛdhotaya indraṃ siṣaktyupasaṃ na sūryaḥ | yo dhṛṣṇunā śavasā bādhate tam iryati reṇuṃ bṛhadaharirvārṇaḥ || 4 || devī | yadi | tarviṣī | tvāvṛdhā | ūtaye | indram | siṣakti | upasam | na | sūryaḥ | yaḥ | dhṛṣṇunā | śavasā | bādhate | tam | iryati | reṇum | bṛhat | ahardisvarniḥ || 4 ||

ᵥyaḥ indraḥ ᵥdhṛṣṇunā dharṣakena ᵥśavasā balena ᵥtamaḥ tamorūpaṃ vṛtrādimasuraṃ ᵥbādhate hinasti ᵥūtaye rakṣaṇāya ᵥtvāvṛdhā svayā stotrā vardhitaṃ tam ᵥindraṃ ᵥdevī ᵥtaviṣī dyotamānaṃ balaṃ ᵥyadi yadā ᵥsipakti samavaiti |

teṣāṃ vyathotpādanena svanayitā śabdayitā indraḥ ᵥreṇuṃ repaṇaṃ hiṃsanaṃ ᵥbṛhat prabhūtam ᵥiryati śatrūn gamayati ||

yathā satatagamanaśīlaḥ aśvaḥ' itastato gacchan śobhate evamagjyālāpi sarvatra gacchantī śobhate iti bhāvaḥ |
tadānīṃ 'divaḥ dyulokasya saṃbandhi 'sānu samucchritamabhraṃ 'stanayan 'na śabdayanniva 'acikradat gambhīraṃ śabdam ātmānama- cīkarat |

vātajūtaḥ : vāyunā preritaḥ | tuvisvaṇiḥ : mahāsvanaḥ evaṃbhūto'gniḥ | juhūbhiḥ : svakīyābhiḥ jihvābhiḥ | sūryā : saraṇaśīlena tejaḥsamūhena ca yuktaḥ san | vṛthā iti anāyāsavacanaḥ | vṛthā anāyā- senaiva ataseṣu unnateṣu vṛkṣepu vi tiṣṭhate viśeṣeṇa tiṣṭhati | he agne yat yadā vaninaḥ vana- sambandhān vṛkṣān dagdhuṃ vṛṣāyase vṛṣadācarasi dahamītyarthaḥ | he ruśadūrme dīptajvāla ajara jarā- rahitāgne te tava ema gamanamārgaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ kṛṣṇavarṇo bhavati || vātajūtaḥ | j iti nauyo dhātuḥ | vātena jūto vātajūtaḥ | kṛtnyā karmaṇi ' iti pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaratvam | vi tiṣṭhate | ' samavapravibhyaḥ sthaḥ ' ityātmanepadam | juhūbhiḥ | ' hu dānādanayoḥ ' | hūyate āsveti juhūḥ | ' huvaḥ bhluvacca ' (u. sū. 2. 218 ) iti kip, cakārān dīrghaḥ | bhluvajtvāt dvirbhāvādi | ' dhātoḥ ' ityantodāttatvam | sūryā | ' sṛ gatau ' | saratīti sṛṇiḥ | ' sṛvibhyāṃ kin ' (u. sū. 4. 489 ) iti nipratyayaḥ | ema | etyaneneti ema mārgaḥ | ' iṇ gatau ' ityasmāt karaṇe auṇādiko manin | niccādādyudāttatvam ||

yathā vananīyagatiḥ vṛṣaḥ goyūthe sarvamabhibhavan vartate tadvat |

ayaṃ vaiśvānaraḥ abhiḥ dasyu rasānāṃ karmaṇāṃ vā upakṣayitāraṃ' rākṣasādikaṃ jaghanvān hatavān |
tathā kāṣṭhāḥ apāṃ sṛṣṭyudakāni adhūnot adhomukhānyapātayat |
śambaraṃ tannirodhakāriṇaṃ mevam ava bhet avābhinat ||
' chandasi luṅlaṅliṭaḥ ' iti vartamāne luṅi ' asyativakti ' ityādinā ceḥ aḍādeśaḥ |
laṅi ' bahulaṃ chandasi ' iti vikaraṇasya luk |

atra niruktaṃ— ' pra bravīmi tanmahitvaṃ mahābhāgayaṃ vṛṣabhasya varṣiturapāṃ yaṃ puravaḥ pūrayi- tavyā manuṣyā vṛtrahaṇaṃ meghahanaṃ sacante sevante varṣakāmā dasyurdasyateḥ kṣayārthāduparasyasyasiśrasā upadāsa- yati karmāṇi tamagnivaiśvānaro anavāthnodapaḥ kāṣṭhā abhinacchambaraṃ megham ' ( niru. 7. 23 ) iti ||
tasya hi varṣakarmaṇā saṃstava upapadyate; na tvagneḥ pṛthivīsthānatvāditi |
tatra tṛtīya- savanaṃ prāpto yajamānaḥ svargaṃ prāpta' iti pṛthivyāḥ pracyuto bhavet |
taccyutiparihārāya āgnimārute'ntimame śastre hotā svargāt bhūmiṃ pratyavarohati |
itaraśāstravat stotriyatvena prārambhamuktvā dyusthānasambandhinā vaiśvānarayeṇa sūktena śastraṃ prārabhate |
tato madhyamasthānasambandhinaṃ rudraṃ marutaśca prati taddevatyasūktapāṭhenāvarohati |
yadyatra vaiśvānaraḥ sūryo na syāt tadānīmavaroho nopapadyate |
viśveṣāṃ narāṇāṃ lokāntaraṃ prati netṛtayā sambandhī vaiśvānaraḥ |
tathā cāstrātaṃ— ' vaiśvānara putraḥ pitre lokakṛjjātavedo vahame sukṛtāṃ yatra lokāḥ ' iti |
viśve sarve narā enamagniṃ yajñādau prīṇayantīti tatsambandhādvaiśvānaraḥ |
viśvān sarvān prāṇinaḥ pratyuto gacchataḥ iti viśvānarau madhyamottamau |
ādityājjāyate vṛṣṭirvṛṣṭerannaṃ tataḥ prajāḥ ' ( manu. 3. 76 ) iti smaraṇāt |
etasarvaṃ yāskena ' vaiśvānaraḥ kasmāt ' ( niru. 7. 21 ) ityādinā bahudhā prapañcitam |

vaiśvānaro mahimnā viśvakṛṣṭirdvājeṣu yajato vibhāvā | śātavaneye śatinībhiragniḥ puruṇīthe jarate sūnṛtāvān || 7 || vaiśvānaraḥ | mahimnā | viśvakṛṣṭiḥ | bharatadvājeṣu | yajataḥ | vibhāvā | śātavaneye | śatinībhiḥ | agniḥ | puruṇīthe | jarate | sūnṛtāvān || 7 ||
viśve sarve manuṣyā yasya svabhūtāḥ sa tathoktaḥ|
'bharadvājeṣu puṣṭikarādilakṣaṇājvarasu yāgeṣu yadvā etatsajñeṣu ṛṣiṣu 'yajataḥ yaṣṭavyaḥ 'vibhāvā viśeṣeṇa prakāśayitā 'sūnṛtāvān|
śatasaṃkhyākān kratūn vanati saṃbhajate iti śatavaniḥ tasya putraḥ śātavaneyaḥ|
tasmin 'puruṇīthe bahūnāṃ netari etatsajñake rājani ca 'śatinībhiḥ bahubhiḥ 'stutibhiḥ 'jarate stūyate||
bahuvrīhau pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaratve prāpte marud- vṛdhādiśvāt pūrvapadāntodāttatvam|
yadi tu 'avyaye nankunipātānāmiti vaktavyam' (pā. sū. 6. 2. 2. 3) iti avyayagrahaṇena tritayaṃ gṛhyeta tarhi bahuvrīhisvaro bhaviṣyati |
mātari antarikṣe śu āśu asati gacchatīti mātariśvā |
asya śāmubhayāsaḥ sacante haviṣmanta uśijo ye ca matīḥ |
asya | śāmu | ubhayāsaḥ | sacante | haviṣmantaḥ | uśijaḥ | ye | ca | matīḥ | divaḥ | cit | pūrvaḥ | ni | asādi | hotā | ā'pṛcchyaḥ | viśapatiḥ | vikṣu | vedhāḥ ||2||
vśāsuḥ śāsituḥ vasya agneḥ vubhayāsaḥ ubhaye'pi devā manuṣyāśca |
stutibhiḥ stotāro yajñairyajamānāśca imamagniṃ śāsitāraṃ vsacante sevante |
vuśijaḥ kāmayamānā devāḥ vhaviṣmantaḥ haviṣā yuktāḥ vye vca vmatīḥ maraṇadharmāṇo yajamānāḥ |
uśijaḥ medhāvinaḥ stotāro haviṣmantaḥ haviryuktāḥ matīḥ yajamānāḥ |
kiṃca ayaṃ vhotā homaniṣpādako'gniḥ vdivaścit ādityādapi vpūrvaḥ upaḥsu vartamāno bhūtvā agnihotrahomārtha vvikṣu yajamāneṣu vnyasādi adhvaryuṇā agnyāyatane nyadhāyi sthāpyate |
vviśapatiḥ viśāṃ prajānāṃ pālayitā vvedhāḥ vidhātābhimaṃtaphalasya kartā ||
'tṛncau śaṃsipidhāsikṣādibhyaḥ saṃjñāyāṃ cānitau' (u. sū. 2.250) iti tṛn iḍāgamābhāvaśca |
āṅpūrvāt asmāt 'chandasi niṣṭayaḥ' (pā. sū. 3. 1. 123) ityādau kyappratyayo nipātitaḥ |
'patyāvaiśvarye' iti pūrvapadaprakṛti- svaratve prāpte 'parādiśchandasi bahulam' ityuttarapadāyudāttatvam ||
yamṛtvijo vṛjane mānuṣāsaḥ paryasvanta āyavo jīrjananta ||
tam | narvyasī | hṛdaḥ | ā | jāryamānam | asmat | sukīrtiḥ | madhu'jihvam | aśyāḥ | yam | ṛtvijaḥ | vṛjane | mānuṣāsaḥ | paryasvantaḥ | āyavaḥ | jīrjananta || 3 ||
navyasī navatarā sukīrtiḥ suṣṭhu kīrtayitrī asat asmākaṃ stutiḥ idaḥ hṛdayasthitāt prāṇāt jāyamānam utpadyamānam |
evaṃbhūtaṃ tam agnim ā aśśyāḥ ābhimukhyena vyāpnotu |
vṛjane saṃgrāme prāpte sati āyavaḥ manuṣyāḥ yam agniṃ jījananta yajñārthamudapādayan |
ṛtvijaḥ ṛtau kāle yaṣṭāraḥ mānupāsaḥ manoḥ putrāḥ prayasvantaḥ havirlakṣaṇā- jhopetāḥ ||
liṅi bahulaṃ chandasi iti vikaraṇasya luk |
adupadeśāt lasārvadhātukānudāttatve caṅa eva svare prāpte vyatyayena abhyastādyudāttatvam ||
uśika | pāvakaḥ | vasuḥ | mānuṣeṣu | vareṇyaḥ | hotā | adhāyi | vikṣu | damūnāḥ | gṛhapatiḥ | damai | ā | agniḥ | bhuvat | rayipatiḥ | rayīṇām || 4 ||
uśika kāmayamānaḥ pāvakaḥ śodhakaḥ vasuḥ nivāsayitā vareṇyaḥ varaṇaśīlaḥ evaṃbhūtaḥ hotā agniḥ vikṣu yajñagṛhaṃ praviteṣu mānuṣeṣu yajamāneṣu adhāyi sthāpyate |
sa ca agniḥ damūnāḥ rakṣasāṃ damanakareṇa manasā yuktaḥ gṛhapatiḥ gṛhāṇāṃ pālayitā ca san dame yajñagṛhe rayipatiḥ dhanādhipatiḥ ā bhuvat ā samantādbhavati |
na kevalamekasya rayerapi tu sarveṣāmityāha rayīṇām iti |
rayīṇāṃ madhye utkṛṣṭaṃ yaddhanaṃ tasya patirityarthaḥ ||
chandasi luṅlaṅliṭaḥ iti vartamāne karmaṇi luṅi cleḥ ciṇādeśe āto yuk ciṇkṛtoḥ iti yugāgamaḥ |
damerūnasiḥ (ḍa. sū. 4. 674) iti auṇādika unasi- pratyayaḥ |
yāskasvāha— damūnā damamanā vā dānamanā vā dāntamanā vāpi vā dama iti gṛhanāma tanmanāḥ syāt (niru. 4. 4) iti |
taṃ tvā vayaṃ patiṃmaye rayīṇāṃ pra śaṃsāmo matibhirgotamāsaḥ |
āśuṃ na vājaṃbharaṃ marjayantaḥ prātarmakṣu dhiyāvaṃsurjamyāta ||
tam | tvā | vayam | patim | agne | rayīṇām | pra | śaṃsāmaḥ | mati'bhiḥ | gotamāsaḥ | āśum | na | vājam'bharam | marjayantaḥ | prātaḥ | makṣu | dhiyā'vasuḥ | jamyāt || 5 ||
he vagne vrayīṇāṃ dhanānāṃ vpatiṃ rakṣitāraṃ tādṛśaṃ vtvā tvāṃ vmatibhiḥ mananīyaiḥ stotraiḥ vpra vśaṃsāmaḥ prakaryeṇa stumaḥ |
vvājaṃbharaṃ vājasya havirlakṣaṇasya bharaṃ bhartāraṃ tvāṃ vmarjayantaḥ mārjayantaḥ |
yathāśmārohantaḥ puruṣāstasya vahanapradeśaṃ hastairnimarjanti tadvat vayamati agnerhavirvahanapradeśaṃ nimṛjantaḥ ityarthaḥ |
tathā ca agnisaṃmārjanaprakaraṇe vājasaneyabhirāmnātam— ‘ vatha vmadhye ’ tūṣṇīmeva triḥ saṃmārṣṭi yathā yuktvā prahi vahati vrajedevametadagniṃ yuktvopakṣipati prahi devebhyo havyaṃ vaha ’ iti |
vdhiyāvasuḥ karmaṇā buddhayā vā prāptadhanaḥ so'gniḥ prātaḥ śrobhūtasya ahnaḥ prātaḥkāle vmakṣu vśīghraṃ vjagamyāta āgacchatu ||
‘ vsaṃjñāyāṃ vbhṛtṛvṛji ’ ( pā. sū. 3. 2. 46 ) iti vājaśabde karmaṇyupapade khacpratyayaḥ |
varudviṣadajantasya vmum ’ ( pā. sū. 6. 3. 67 ) iti mumāgamḥ |
saṃjñāpūrvakasya vidheranityatvāt ‘ vsṛjervṛddhiḥ ’ ( pā. sū. 7. 2. 114 ) iti vṛddhayabhāvaḥ |
adupadeśāt lasārva- dhātukānudāttatve ṇic eva svaraḥ śiṣyate |
liṅi ‘ bahulaṃ chandasi ’ iti śapaḥ śluḥ ||
‘ asmā idu pra tavase ’ iti ṣoḍaśacaṃ caturthaṃ sūktaṃ nodhasa ārṣamaindraṃ traiṣṭubham |
anukrāntaṃ ca— ‘ asmā idu poḻaśa ’ iti |
asya sūktasya nodhā draṣṭā ityetadbrāhmaṇe samāmnāyate—‘ asmā idu pra tavase turāyeti nodhāsta ete prātaḥsavane ’ ( ai. brā. 6. 18 ) iti |
paḻahastotriyāvāpavatsu catu- rviṃśamahātrādivahaḥ su mādhyaṃdine savane brāhmaṇācchaṃsiṣṭhe ‘ brahmaṇa te brahmayujā ’ ityasyā ārambhagīyāyā ūrdhvamahīnasūktasaṃjñametacchaṃsanīyam |
tathā ca sūtritam—‘ asmā idu pra tavase śāmdahi- ritītarāvahīnasūkte ’ ( āśva. śrau. 7. 4 ) iti |
brāhmaṇaṃ ca bhavati—‘ ta ete prātaḥsavane paḻaha- stotriyāścaratvā mādhyaṃdine'hīnasūktāni śaṃsanti ’ iti ||
asmā idu pra tavase turāya prayo na harmi stomaṃ māhina |
asmai | it | ū~ iti | pra | tavase | turāya | prayaḥ | na | harmi | stomam | māhina | ṛcīṣamāya | aghri'gave | oham | indrāya | brahmāṇi | rāta'tamā || 1 ||

'patiḥ samāsa eva' (pā. sū. 1. 4. 8) iti visaṃjñāyāḥ samāsaviṣayatvāt 'verhiti' iti guṇābhāve yaṇādeśaḥ ||

Vmenai mananīye Vparame utkṛṣṭe Vvyoman vividhadharuṇe nabhasi vartamānaḥ Vbhago Vna sūrya iva Vsudaṃsāḥ śobhanakarmendraḥ Vrodasī dyāvāpṛthivyau Vadhārayat apopayat |
tathā ca yāskaḥ—'menā jhā iti strīṇāṃ menā mānayantyenāḥ' (nighaṃ. 3. 21) iti |

ityasya prakārasya takāraśchandasaḥ | sanajā | ‘janī prādurbhāve’ | asmāt bhāve ‘anyeṣvapi dṛśyate’ iti dṛśigrahaṇasya sarvopādhivyabhicārārdhatvāt kevalādapi janerḍapratyayaḥ | sanā nityaṃ jo jananaṃ yayoste sanaje | pūrvapadasya hrasvaśchandasaḥ | evamāditvādantodāttatvam | tadeva bahuvrīhi- svareṇa śiṣyate | ‘supāṃ suluk’ iti vibhakteḥ ākāraḥ | ayāsyaḥ | ‘yasu prayatne’ | yāsaḥ prayatnaḥ | tatra bhavo yāsyaḥ | ‘bhave chandasi’ iti yat | na yāsyo'yāsyaḥ | ‘parādiścandasi bahulam’ ityuttarapadādyudāttatvam | śrutyuktanirvacane tu pṛṣodarāditvāt abhimatarūpasvarasiddhiḥ | mene | masamyekavacanasya ‘supāṃ suluk’ iti śeṣādeśaḥ | ‘śe’ (pā. sū. 1. 1. 13) iti pragṛhyatvam | yadvā | manyate iti menā | pacādyac | ‘naśimanyorallopyatvaṃ vaktavyam
'evaṃbhūta indraḥ 'sakhyaṃ yajamānānāṃ sakhitvaṃ 'sanemi purāṇaṃ 'dādhāra dhārayati poṣayatītyarthaḥ |
kiṃca 'āmāsu 'cit ārdāsu aparipakkāsu goṣu ca 'antaḥ madhye 'pakkaṃ paripakkaṃ 'payaḥ 'dadhiṣe dhārayasi |
tathā 'kṛṣṇāsu kṛṣṇavarṇāsu 'rohiṇīṣu lohitavarṇāsu ca goṣu tadviparītaṃ 'ruṣāt dīpyamānaṃ 'śvetavarṇaṃ payaḥ dadhiṣe ||

sanāyate gortama indra navyamatakṣadbrahma hariyojanāya | sunīthārya naḥ śavasāna nodhāḥ prātarmakṣu dhiyārvasurjamyāta || 13 || sanā'yate | gortamaḥ | indra | navyam | atakṣat | brahma | hari'yojanāya | su'nīthārya | naḥ | śavasāna | nodhāḥ | prātaḥ | makṣu | dhiyā'rvasuḥ | jagmyāt ||13||
sa indraḥ 'sanāyate nitya ivācarati sarveṣāmādyo bhavati |
evaṃbhūtāya tasmai tubhyaṃ 'gotamaḥ gotamasya ṛṣeḥ putraḥ 'nodhāḥ ṛṣiḥ 'navyaṃ nūtanaṃ 'brahma etatsūkarūpaṃ stotraṃ 'naḥ asmadartham 'atakṣat akarot |
ato'smābhiranena stotreṇa stutaḥ san dhiyā buddhayā karmaṇā vā prātavasurundraḥ prātaḥkāle 'makṣu śīghraṃ 'jagmyāt āgacchatu ||
'tvaṃ mahān ' iti navarcaṃ ṣaṣṭhaṃ sūktaṃ nodhasa ārṣaṃ traiṣṭubhamaindram |
samūlahe daśarātre dvitīye chandome marutvatīyaśastre etatsūktam |
'viśvajito'gniṃ naraḥ ' iti khaṇḍe sūtritaṃ—' tāṃ su te kīrtiṃ tvaṃ mahāṃ indra yo ha ' ( āśva. śrau. 8. 7 ) iti ||

tvaṃ mahāṃ indra yo ha śuṣmairdyāvā jajñānaḥ pṛthivī ame dhāḥ | yaddha te viśvā girayaścidbhavā bhiyā duḻahāsaḥ kiraṇa nairjana || 1 || tvam | mahān | indra | yaḥ | ha | śuṣmaiḥ | dyāvā | jajñānaḥ | pṛthivī iti | ame | dhāḥ | yat | ha | te | viśvā | girayaḥ | cit | abhvā | bhiyā | duḻahāsaḥ | kiraṇāḥ | na | airjana ||1||
'yo 'ha yaḥ khalu tvam 'ame asurakṛte bhaye sati 'jajñānaḥ tadānīmeva prādurbhūtaḥ san 'śuṣmaiḥ śatrūṇāṃ śoṣakairātmīyabalaiḥ |
'yaddha 'te yasya khalu tava saṃbandhinvā 'bhiyā bhītyā 'viśvā viśvāni vyāptāni yāni bhūtajātāni 'girayaścit ye ca śiloccayāḥ |
yathā sūryaraśmaya itastato nabhasi kampante tadvat ||
dyāvāpṛthivī ityasya samanapadasya madhye jajñāna ityasya pāṭhaśchāndasaḥ |
ā samantād- vanti majjāvaṃ prāpnuvantīti abhvā mahāntaḥ |
nanpūrvāt bhavateḥ prāthyārthāt ' naji bhuvo ḍit ' iti kapratyayaḥ |

iti kiraṇāḥ | ‘kṛ vikṣepe’ | ‘kṛpvṛjimandidhābhyaḥ kyuḥ’ (u. sū. 2. 239) iti kyupratyayaḥ | yoranādeśe pratyayāyudāttatvam | ‘ṛta iddhātoḥ’ iti hrasvam | pejana | ‘ejṛ kampane’ | laṅi āḍāgamaḥ | sa codāttaḥ | vṛddhiśca ||
ā yaddharī indra vivratā verā te vajraṃ jaritā bāhrordhāt |
ā | yat | harī iti | indra | vi'vratā | veḥ | ā | te | vajram | jaritā | bāhroḥ | dhāt | yena | aviharyatakrato ityaviharyata'krato | amitrān | puraḥ | iṣṇāsi | puru'hūta | pūrvīḥ ||2||
he indra tvaṃ ‘yat yadā ‘vivratā vividhakarmāṇo ‘harī tvadīyāśvau ‘ā ‘veḥ rathe’ āgamanayasi’ rathaṃ yojayasītyarthaḥ |
tadānīṃ ‘te tava ‘bāhroḥ hastayoḥ ‘jaritā stotā ‘vajram ‘ā ‘dhāt stotreṇa sthāpayati |
stotrā stute prayatnamantareṇa vajraṃ tvaddaste dṛśyate ityarthaḥ |
he ‘puruhūta purubhirbahubhiryajamānairāhūta tvaṃ ‘pūrvīḥ bahvīḥ ‘puraḥ asurapurāṇi bhettumabhigacchasītyarthaḥ ||
antarbhāvitaṇyarthāt chāndase laṅi sipi adāditvāt śapo luk |
dadhāteḥ chāndase luṅi ‘gātisthā’0 iti sico luk |
tādṛśaḥ kratuḥ karma yasya sa tathoktaḥ |
na santi mitrāṇyepiti bahuvrīhau ‘naño jaramaramitramṛtāḥ’ ityuttarapadāyudāttatvam |
tvaṃ satya indra dhṛṣṇuretāntvamṛbhukṣā naryastvaṃ ṣaṭ |
tvaṃ śuṣṇaṃ vṛjane pṛkṣa ārṇau yūne kutsāya ghumate sacā han ||
tvam | satyaḥ | indra | dhṛṣṇuḥ | etān | tvam | ṛbhukṣāḥ | naryaḥ | tvam | ṣaṭ | tvam | śuṣṇam | vṛjane | pṛkṣe | ārṇau | yūne | kutsāya | ghumate | sacā | ahan || 3 ||

he indra ‘tvaṃ ‘satyaḥ satsu bhavaḥ sarvotkṛṣṭa ityarthaḥ | ‘etān śatrūnabhigataḥ san ‘dhṛṣṇuḥ teṣāṃ dharṣayitā tiraskartā | kiṃca ‘tvam ‘ṛbhukṣāḥ ṛbhūṇāmadhipatiḥ | teṣu kṛtanivāso vā | yadvā | mahannāmaitat | mahān pravṛddho'si | ‘naryaḥ nṛbhyo hitaḥ | tathā ‘tvaṃ ‘ṣāṭ śatrūṇāmabhibhavitā hantetyarthaḥ | kiṃca | vṛjane ityādinī trīṇi saṃgrāmanāmāni | atra pūrve viśeṣaṇe | ‘vṛjane varjanayukte | saṃgrāme hi vīrāḥ puruṣā varjyante hiṃsyante | ‘pṛkṣe saṃpacanīye vīreḥ yoddhuṃ prāptavye | evaṃvidhe ‘ārṇau saṃgrāme

dyumate dītimate yune taruṇāya kutsāya sacā saha sahāyo bhūtvā śuṣṇaṃ śoṣayitārametatsaṃjamasuuram ahan avadhīḥ | ṛbhukṣāḥ | ṛbhuriti medhāvināma | uru vistīrṇaṃ bhāti | yadvā | ṛtena yajñena bhāti bhavatīti vā ṛbhuḥ | uruśabde ṛtaśabde vopapade bhāterbhavatervā 'mṛgavādayaśca' (u. sū. 1. 38) iti kupratyayaḥ | pūrvapadasya ṛbhāvaśca nipātyate | kṣayatiraiśvaryakarmā | tepāmīṭe iti ṛbhukṣāḥ | yadvā | 'kṣi nivāsagatyoḥ' | teṣu nivasatati 'patestha' (u. sū. 4. 452) iti vidhīyamāna ini- pratyayo bahulavacanātsādāpi bhavati | ṭilopaśca | sau 'pathimadhyṛbhukṣāmāt' (pā.sū. 7. 1. 85) iti āvam | pratyayasvaraḥ | pāṭ | 'saha' abhivave' | 'chandasi sahaḥ' (pā. sū. 3. 2. 63) iti kevalādapi ṇivaḥ | phatvaṃ chāndasam | da
he indra tvaṃ ha tvaṃ khalu dhyat tasya ḍhahasya cit ḍhasya kasyacidapi ariṣyan reṣaṇamicchan evaṃsubhāvo bhavasi |
tathāpi matāṃnāṃ stotaṇāmasmākaṃ śatrubhiḥ ajuṣṭau aprītau sasyām asmata arbate asmadīyāthāyā gantuṃ kāṣṭhāḥ diśaḥ ā sama- ntāt vi vaḥ vivṛtāḥ kuru |
yathā sarvāṃsu dikṣu asmadīyā aśvāḥ pratirodhamantareṇa gacchanti tathā kuru ityarthaḥ |
kiṃca tatratyān amitrān he vajrin vajravacchindra ghaneva ghanena kaṭhinana parvateneva vajreṇa bhathihi abhaya jahītyarthaḥ |
martānāṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ madhye yasmin kasmiṃścittava aprītau satyāṃ tasya śatrordaṇḍasyāpi ariṣyan repaṇaṃ hiṃsanamana icchan vartase |
yasmiṃstu kutsādī prītirasati tasya śatruvadhaṃ cakruṣe |
riṣaśabdāt kyaci 'durastudrvinasyutrṛṣyati ripyati' (pā. sū. 7. 4. 36) iti riṣabhāvo nipātyate |
'mūrtau ghanaḥ' (pā. sū. 3. 3. 77) iti kāṭhinye gamyamāne hanteḥ apratya- yānto nipātyate |
pyantāt loṭi 'bahula chandasi' iti śapo luk ||
tvāṃ ha tyadindrārṇasāto svarmīḻhe nara ājā havante |
tarva svadhāva iyamā saṃmarya ūtirvājeṣvatasāvyā bhūta ||
tvām | ha | tyat | indra | arṇasāto | svaḥḥmīḻhe | naraḥ | ājā | havante | tarva | svadhāvaḥ | iyam | ā | sa'marye | ūtiḥ | vājeṣu | atasāvyā | bhūta || 6 ||
he indra argasātau arṇānāṃ gantūnāṃ yuddhe pravṛttānāṃ purupāṇāṃ sātirlābho yasmin svarmīḻhe |
evaṃbhūte ājā ājau saṃgrāme yat taṃ prasiddhaṃ tvāmeva naraḥ yotukāmāḥ puruṣāḥ sahāyārthaṃ havante āhvayanti |
arṇasa udakasya sātirlābho yasmin vṛtrādiyuddhe tasminnityarthaḥ |
vṛtranirodhakena vṛtreṇa saha varṇārthaṃ tava yuddhaṃ tatra stotāraravāṃ protsāhayantīti bhāvaḥ |
yasmādevaṃ tasmān he svadhāvaḥ he annavan balavan vā indra samaye saṃgrāme tava saṃbandhino iyam ūtiḥ tvadīyamidaṃ rakṣaṇam ā asmadābhimukhyena bhūta bhavatu |
vājeṣu saṃgrāmeṣu yā eṣā ūtiḥ atasāvyā yotṛbhiḥ prāptavyā bhavati ||
'paṇa dāne' ityasmāt bhāve kini 'janamanakhanām' ityanunāsikasya āttvam |
'udake nuṭ ca' (u. sū. 4. 636) iti ateḥ asunapratyayo nuḍāgamaśca |
pīvopa- vasanādīnāṃ chandasi lopo vaktavyaḥ' (pā. ma. 6. 1. 109. 6) iti salopaḥ |
'krandasi luṅ‌luṭaḥ' iti prārthanāyāṃ luṅi 'bahula chandasyamāṅ‌yoge'pi' iti aḍābhāvaḥ ||
tvaṃ ha tyadindra suta yudhyanapuro vajrinurutsāya darde |
barhirna yatsudāse vṛthā vargraho rājannarivaḥ pūrvai kaḥ ||
tvam | ha | tyat | indra | suta | yudhyan | puraḥ | vajrin | puru'kutsāya | dardariti dardeḥ | barhiḥ | na | yat | sudāse | vṛthā | vark | aṃḥ | rājan | varivaḥ | pūrvai | kaḥ ||7||

he vvajrin vajravan vindra vpurukutsāya etatsaṃjyāya ṛṣaye vyudhyan tadīyaśatrubhiḥ saha yuddhaṃ kurvāṇaḥ vtvam eva vtyat tāḥ vsasa vpuraḥ tadīyāni matsaṃlyāni nagarāṇi vdardeḥ vyadārayaḥ abhai- tsīrityarthaḥ |
api ca vsudāse etatsaṃjyāya rājñe vaṃḥ etatsaṃjyāsurasya saṃbandhi vyat dhanamasti tat vvṛthā anāyāsena vbarhirna barhiriva vvark avṛṇak acchinaḥ ityarthaḥ |
tadanantaraṃ vpūrvai tvāṃ haviṣā pūrayate tasmai sudāse he vrājan svāmin indra vvarivaḥ dhanaṃ vkaḥ akārṣīḥ ||
asmāt yaṅlugantāt laḍi sipi ‘adādibacca’ iti vacanāt śapo luk |
laḍi sipi ‘bahulaṃ chandasi’ iti vikaraṇasya luk |
tvaṃ tyāṃ na indra deva citrāmiṣamāpo na pīpayaḥ parijman |
yathā śūra pratyasmabhyaṃ yaṃsi tmanmūrja na viśvadha kṣaradhyai ||
tvam | tyām | naḥ | indra | deva | citrām | iṣam | āpaḥ | na | pīpayaḥ | pari'jman | yathā | śūra | prati | asmabhyam | yaṃsi | tmanā | ūrjam | na | viśvadha | kṣaradhyai || 8 ||
he vdeva dyotamāna vindra vtvaṃ vnaḥ asmākaṃ vcitrāṃ cāyanīyāṃ vtyāṃ tām viṣam annaṃ vpari- jman parito vyāptāyāṃ bhūmau vpīpayaḥ prāvardhayaḥ |
yathā sarvā bhūmirannena paripūrṇā bhavati tathā kurvityarthaḥ |
yathā apo vṛṣṭyudakāni bhūmyāṃ varṣaṇena pravadhayasi tadvat |
bhūmau vartamānasmān yathā apaḥ pāyayasi tadvat citrāmiṣamapi pāyayeti bhāvaḥ |
he vśūra indra vyathā iṣā vtmanam ātmānaṃ jīvam vasmabhyaṃ prati vyaṃsi prayacchasi |
vviśvadha viśvataḥ sarvataḥ vkṣaradhyai kṣaritum vūrjaṃ vna udakamiva |
yathāsmabhyaṃ bahulamudakaṃ prayacchasi tadvatprāṇadhāraṇarūpaṃ jīvanamapi prayacchasīti bhāvaḥ ||
pyantāt chāndase luḍi ‘pyāyaḥ pī’ (pā. sū. 6. 1. 28) iti vyatyayena pībhāvaḥ |

iti ccheḥ caḍādeśaḥ | ṇilopādīni | yadvā | ‘pīṅ pāne’ ityasmāt luḍi caḍi pūrvavat | ‘bahulaṃ chandasyāṅyoge'pi’ iti aḍabhāvaḥ | parijman | jama tirgatikarmā | ‘aja gatikṣepaṇayoḥ’ | ābhyāṃ paripūrvābhyāṃ ‘śvasukṣan’ ityādī kaninpratyayānto nipātitaḥ | ‘supāṃ suluk’ iti saptamyā luk | yaṃsi | ‘yama uparame’ | ‘bahulaṃ chandasi’ iti śapo luk | ramanam | ‘āṅṅo'nyatrāpi chandasi dṛśyate’ (kā. 6. 4. 141. 1) ityātmanaḥ ākāralopaḥ | saṃjñāpūrvakasya vidheranityatvāt upadhādīrghābhāvaḥ | viśvadha | viśvaśabdāttasilaḥ sakāralopo dhatvaṃ ca pṛṣodarāditvāt | kṣaradhyai | ‘kṣara saṃcalane’ | ‘tumarthe sesena’ iti adhyaipratyayaḥ | nittvādādyudāttatvam ||

arkaॉri ta indra gortamebhirbrahmāṇyoktā narmasā haribhyām | supeśasaṃ vājamā bharā naḥ prātarmakṣu dhiyāvasurjagamyāt || 9 || arkaॉri | te | indra | gortamebhiḥ | brahmāṇi | ā'uktā | narmasā | hari'bhyām | su'peśasam | vājam | ā | bhara | naḥ | prātaḥ | makṣu | dhiyā'vasuḥ | jagamyāt || 9 ||
he indra ‘te tava ‘gortamebhiḥ gantṛmairetatsajñairṛtvigbhiḥ ‘akāri stotraṃ kṛtamityarthaḥ |
‘brahmāṇi mantrajātāni ‘namasā havirlakṣaṇena saha ‘haribhyām aśvābhyāṃ yuktāya tubhyam ‘uktā ābhimukhyena uktāni |
bahuvidharūpayuktaṃ ‘vājam annaṃ ‘naḥ asmabhyam ‘ā ‘bhara āhara dehīti yāvat |
dhiyā buddhyā karmaṇā vā prātadhana indraḥ prātaḥkāle asmadrakṣaṇārthaṃ ‘jagamyāt āgacchatu ||
tathā cānukrāntaṃ- ‘vṛṣṇe pannonā mārutaṃ triṣṭubantam’ iti |
sūtritaṃ ca- ‘pṛkṣasya vṛṣṇe vṛṣṇe śardhāya yajñena vardhateyāgnimārutam’ (āśva. śrau. 7. 4) iti |
sūtritaṃ ca- ‘pṛkṣasya vṛṣṇo vṛṣṇe śardhāya n citsahotā ityāgnimārutam’ (āśva. śrau. 7. 7) iti ||

vṛṣṇe śardhāya sumakhāya vedhase nordhaḥ suvṛkti pra bharā marudbhyaḥ | apo na dhīro manasā suhastyo giraḥ samañje vidatheṣvabhuvaḥ || 1 || vṛṣṇe | śardhāya | su'makhāya | vedhase | nordhaḥ | su'vṛktim | pra | bhara | marut'bhyaḥ | apaḥ | na | dhīraḥ | manasā | su'hastyaḥ | giraḥ | sam | añje | vidatheṣu | ā'bhuvaḥ ||1||
he ॰nodhaḥ 'vṛṣṇe kāmānāṃ varṣitre ॰sumakhāya śobhanayajñāya ॰vedhase puṣpaphalādīnāṃ kartre |
vāyau sati hi puṣpāṇi phalāni cotpadyante |
marutāṃ mitarāviṇāṃ ॰śardhāya samūhāya ॰suvṛktiṃ suṣṭhu āvarjakaṃ suṣṭhu pravṛttaṃ vā stotraṃ ॰pra ॰bhara preraya stuhīti yāvat |

yuvāno rudrā ajarā abhogdhanau vavakṣuradhigāvaḥ parvateiva | dṛḻhā cidviśvā bhuvanāni pārthivā pra cyāvayanti divyāni mujmanā ||3|| yuvānaḥ | rudrāḥ | ajarāḥ | abhokū'hanaḥ | vavakṣuḥ | adhigāvaḥ | parvatāḥ'iva | dṛḻhā | cit | viśvā | bhuvanāni | pārthivā | pra | cyāvayanti | divyāni | mujmanā ||3||

'yuvānaḥ : taruṇāḥ 'rudrāḥ : rudraputrāḥ 'ajarāḥ : jarārahitāḥ 'abhogghanaḥ : ye devān havirbhirna bhojayanti teṣāṃ hantāraḥ 'adhigāvaḥ : aṣṭagamanāḥ parairanivāritagatayaḥ 'parvateiva dṛḻhāḥ evaṃbhūtā marutaḥ 'vavakṣuḥ : stotṛṇāmabhimataṃ prāpayitumicchanti |
api ca 'viśvā sarvāṇi 'bhuvanāni sañjātaṃ prāptāni 'pārthivā pṛthivyāṃ bhavāni 'divyāni divi bhavāni ca vasūni 'dṛḻhā 'cit dṛḍhānyapi 'mujmanā |
'jhayo ho'nyatarasyām ' ( pā. sū. 8. 4. 62 ) iti hakārasya dhatvam |
'inhanpūṣāryamṇāṃ śau ' ( pā. sū. 6. 4. 12 ) iti niyamāt dīrghābhāvaḥ |
liṭi usi ' 'amantre ' ( pā. sū. 3. 1. 35 ) iti niṣedhāt āmapratyayābhāve 'ato lopaḥ ' iti akāralopaḥ |

citrairñjibhirvapuṣe vyañjate vakṣaḥsu rukmāṃ adhi yetire śubhe | aṃseṣveṣāṃ ni mimṛkṣuṛṣṭayaḥ sākaṃ jajñire svadhayā divo naraḥ || 4 || citraiḥ | añjibhiḥ | vapuṣe | vi | añjate | vakṣaḥsu | rukmān | adhi | yetire | śubhe | aṃseṣu | eṣām | ni | mimṛkṣuḥ | ṛṣṭayaḥ | sākam | jajñire | svadhayā | divaḥ | naraḥ ||4||
'vapuṣe rūpāya śobhārthaṃ marutaḥ 'citraiḥ : nānāvidhaiḥ 'añjibhiḥ : rūpābhi- vyañjanasamarthairābharaṇaiḥ svaśarīrāṇi 'vyañjate vyaktaṃ kurvanti |
api ca 'eṣāṃ marutām 'aṃseṣu 'ṛṣṭayaḥ : āyudhāni 'ni 'mimṛkṣuḥ : nimṛṣṭāḥ sthitā babhūvuḥ |
tairāyudhaiḥ sahitāḥ 'naraḥ : netāro marutaḥ 'divaḥ : antarikṣāt 'svadhayā svakīyena balena 'sākaṃ saha 'jajñire prādurbabhūvuḥ ||
duhantyūrdhadivyāni dhṛtayo bhūmiṃ pinvanti paryasā pariṃjrayaḥ ||
īśāna'kṛtaḥ | dhunayaḥ | riṣādasaḥ | vātān | vi'dyutaḥ | taviṣībhiḥ | akrata | duhanti | ūrdha | divyāni | dhṛtayaḥ | bhūmim | pinvanti | paryasā | pari'jrayaḥ || 5 ||
^īśānakṛtaḥ stotāramīśānaṃ dhanādhipatiṃ kurvvāṇāḥ ^dhunayaḥ meghādīnāṃ kampayitāraḥ ^riṣādasaḥ riṣātāṃ hiṃsakānāmattāraḥ |
evaṃbhūtā marutaḥ ^taviṣībhiḥ ātmīyarbalaiḥ ^vātān purovātādīn ^vidyutaḥ vidyotamānāstaditaśca ^akrata kurvvanti |
krūvā ca ^pariṃjrayaḥ parito gantāraḥ ^dhṛtayaḥ kampayitāro marutaḥ ^divyāni divibhavāni ^ūdhaḥ ūdhaḥsthānīyānyaprāṇi ^duhanti riktīkurvvanti |
sūtritaṃ ca- ‘agnirnaitā tvaṃ soma kratubhiḥ pinvantyapa iti dhāyyāḥ’ (āśva. śrau. 5. 14) iti ||
atyaṃ na mihe vi nayanti vājinamutsaṃ duhanti stanayantamakṣitam ||
pinvanti | apaḥ | marutaḥ | sudānavaḥ | paryaḥ | ghṛta'vat | tri'dhaiṣu | ā'bhuvaḥ | atyam | na | mihe | vi | nayanti | vājinam | utsam | duhanti | stanayantam | akṣitam || 6 ||
yathā ghṛtaṃ siñcatyevaṃ maruto'pi vṛṣṭiṃ kurvvantīti bhāvaḥ |
^atyaṃ ^na yathā aśvaṃ sādino vinayaṃnti yuddhārthaṃ śikṣanyevaṃ ^vājinaṃ vegavantaṃ meghaṃ ^vi ^nayanti svādhīnaṃ kurvvanti bhrātaḥ |
vibhaktirudāttā | stanayantam | ‘stana śabde’ | curādirdantaḥ | bhato lopasya sthānivadbhāvāt vṛddhayabhāvaḥ’ ||

mahi॒pāsaṷ mā॒yina̭ści॒trabhā̭navo॒ gira̭yo॒ na sva॒rtava̭so॒ raghṷṣyadaḥ | mṛ॒gāi̭va॒ hasti̭na॒ḥ khāda̭thā॒ vanā̭ yada॒ruṇī̭ṣu॒ tavi̭ṣī॒rayṷgdhvam || 7 || mahi॒pāsa̭ḥ | mā॒yina̭ḥ | ci॒tra'bhā̭navaḥ | gira̭yaḥ | na | sva॒rtavasa̭ḥ | raghṷ'syadaḥ | mṛ॒gāḥ'i̭va | hasti̭naḥ | khāda̭tha | vanā̭ | yat | a॒ruṇī̭ṣu | tavi̭ṣīḥ | a॒yu॒gdhvam || 7 ||

ᐁmāyinaḥ prājñāḥ ᐁcitrabhānavaḥ śobhanadīptayaḥ ᐁgirayo ᐁna ᐁsvatavasaḥ parvatā iva svakīyena balena yuktāḥ ᐁraghuṣyadaḥ śīghragamanā he mahat evaṃbhūtaguṇaviśiṣṭāḥ2 yūyaṃ ᐁhastinaḥ hastavantaḥ ᐁmṛgāiva gajā iva ᐁvanā vanāni vṛkṣajātāni ᐁkhādaya bhakṣayatha |
ᐁyat yasmāt ᐁaruṇīṣu aruṇavarṇāsu vaḍavāsu ᐁtaviṣīḥ balāni ᐁayugdhvaṃ saṃyojitavantaḥ |
tasmādbhavatāmiva vāhanasyāpi prabalatvāttatsaṃyuktā bhavantaḥ sarvaṃ bhajantītyarthaḥ ||

siṃhāi̭va॒ nāna̭dati॒ pracḙtasa॒ḥ piśā̭iva॒ supi̭śau॒ viśva̭vedasaḥ | kṣapo॒ jinva̭nta॒ḥ pṛṣa̭tībhi॒rṛṣṭi̭bhi॒ḥ samitsa̭bādha॒ḥ śava̭sā॒hima̭nyavaḥ || 8 || siṃhāḥ'i̭va | nā॒na॒dati̭ | pra'cḙtasaḥ | piśāḥ'i̭va | su'pi̭śau | viśva̭'vedasaḥ | kṣapaḥ | jinva̭ntaḥ | pṛṣa̭tībhiḥ | ṛṣṭi̭bhiḥ | sam'i̭t | su'bā̭dhaḥ | śava̭sā | ahi̭'manyavaḥ ||8||
ᐁpracetasaḥ prakṛṣṭajñānā mahataḥ ᐁsiṃhāiva ᐁnānadati bhṛśaṃ śabdaṃ kurvanti |
yathā siṃhā girigaha- reṣu gambhīraṃ śabdaṃ kurvanti evaṃ marutsu apyāgateṣu gambhīraḥ śabda utpadyate iti bhāvaḥ |
ᐁviśvavedasaḥ sarvajñāḥ ᐁkṣapaḥ śatrūṇāṃ kṣapayitāraḥ ᐁjinvantaḥ stotṛn prīṇayantaḥ ᐁśavasā balena ᐁahimanyavaḥ āhananaśīlamanyuyuktāḥ |
yadvipayaḥ kopo jāyate tasya hanane samarthā ityarthaḥ |
tābhiḥ ᐁṛṣṭibhiḥ āyudhaiśca sahitāḥ santaḥ ᐁsabādhaḥ śatrubhirbādhitān
yajamānān samit samānameva yugapadeva rakṣitumāgacchantīti śeṣaḥ ||
suparvāt ‘ piśa avayave ’ ityasmāt ‘ krip ca ’ iti krip |
‘ pṛṣu secane ’ ‘ vartamāne pṛṣadbṛhanmahajjagaccatṛmṛvakṣa ’ ( u. sū. 2. 241 ) iti śatṛvadbhāvāt ‘ ugitaśca ’ iti ṅīp |
ata eva ‘ śaturanumaḥ ’ iti nadyā udāttatve prāpte ‘ brahanmahattorupasaṃkhyānam ’ iti niyamāt tasyābhāvaḥ ||
ā va॒ndhureṣva॒mati̭rna da̭rśatā vi॒dyunna ta̭sthau ma॒ruto॒ rathḙṣu vaḥ ||
roda̭sī iti | ā | va̭dat | gaṇa॒śriya̭ḥ | nṛṣā̭caḥ | śūra̭āḥ | śa॒vasā̭ | ahi̭'manyavaḥ | ā | va॒ndhureṣṷ | a॒mati̭ḥ | na | da̭rśatā | vi॒dyut | na | ta̭sthau | ma॒ruta̭ḥ | rathḙṣu | vaḥ ||9||

he gaṇaśriyaḥ gaṇaśaḥ śrayamāṇāḥ saptagaṇarūpeṇāvasthitāḥ nṛṣācaḥ nṝn yajamānān haviḥsvī- karaṇāya sevamānāḥ śūrāḥ śauryeṇaivaṃbhūtā he marutaḥ śavasā balena ahimanyavaḥ āhananasvabhāva- kopayuktāḥ santaḥ rodaso dyāvāpṛthivyau ā vadata ā samantācchabdayata |
yuṣmadāgamane sati bhavadīyaśabdena dyāvāpṛthivyau pūrṇe kuruteti bhāvaḥ |
kiṃca he marutaḥ vaḥ yuṣmākaṃ tejaḥ vandhureṣu bandhakācchanimittaṃ sāratheḥ sthānaṃ vandhuramityucyate |
yathā vā darśanīyā vidyunmeghasthā sarvairdṛśyate evaṃ rathe sthitānāṃ yuṣmākaṃ jyotirapi sarvairdṛśyate ityarthaḥ ||
‘ amertiḥ ’ ( u. sū. 4. 499 ) iti auṇā- dikaḥ atipratyayaḥ |
astāra̭ i॒ṣuṃ da̭dhire ga॒rbhasyo̭ra॒nanta̭śu॒ṣmā vṛ̭ṣakhādayo narāḥ ||
vi॒śva'vḙdasaḥ | ra॒yibhi̭ḥ | sa॒m'oka̭saḥ | sa॒m'miślā̭saḥ | tarvi̭ṣībhiḥ | vi॒ra̭pśinaḥ | astāra̭ḥ | i॒ṣum | da̭dhire | ga॒rbhasyo̭ḥ | a॒nanta̭'śu॒ṣmāḥ | vṛ̭ṣa'khādayaḥ | narā̭ḥ || 10 ||
viśvavedasaḥ sarvajñāḥ rayibhiḥ dhanaiḥ samokasaḥ samānanivāsāḥ samavetā vā |
astāraḥ śatrūṇāṃ nirastāraḥ anantaśuṣmāḥ anavacchinnabalāḥ vṛṣakhādayaḥ vṛṣā indraḥ 1. ḍha-bandhanakāchanimittam |

khādiḥ āyudhasthānīyo yeṣāṃ te tathoktāḥ | yadvā | vṛṣā somaḥ khādiḥ khādyaḥ peyo yeṣāṃ te | vajraḥ netāraḥ | evaṃbhūtā marutaḥ | gabhastiriti bāhunāma | gabhastyoḥ bāhoḥ iṣuṃ dadhire | śatrūṇāṃ nirasanāya dhanurbāṇādikamāyudhaṃ dhārayanti | samokasaḥ | ‘uca samavāye ’ | asuni bahulavacanāt kutvamiti ‘oka ucaḥ ke ’ ityatroktam (kā. 7. 3. 65) | bahuvrīhau pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaratvam | maṃmiśvāsaḥ | kapilakādivāt latvam | virapśānaḥ | ‘rapa lapa vyaktāyāṃ vāci ’ | vipūrvātsmāt bahulavacanāt śapratyayaḥ | vividhaṃ śabdaṃ rapantīti virapśāḥ | stotāraḥ | te eṣāṃ santīti virapśānaḥ | yadvā | vividhaṃ rapaṇaṃ virapśam | tadeṣā mastīti | maruto hi vividhaṃ śabdaṃ kurvanti | inipratyayasvaraḥ | astāraḥ | tācchalikaḥ tṛn | iḍabhāvaśchāndasaḥ | nistvādyudāttatvam | anantaśuṣmāḥ | nāstyanto'- syeti anantaḥ | ‘na subhyām ’ ityuttarapadāntodāttatvam | anantaḥ śuṣmo balaṃ yeṣām | bahuvrīhau pūrva- padaprakṛtisvaratvam | vṛṣādayaḥ | ‘khāda bhakṣaṇe ’ | augādika inapratyayaḥ | nṛpaśabdāt kaninpratya- yānta ādyudāttaḥ | bahuvrīhau pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaratvam || || 7 ||

hiraṇyayebhiḥ pa॒vibhi̭ḥ pa॒yovṛ̭dha u॒rjighnanta॒ āpya̭ḥ na॒ parva̭tān | mu॒khā ayā̭saḥ sva॒sṛto̭ dhru॒vacyṷto du॒dhrakṛ̭to ma॒ruto॒ bhrāja̭dṛṣṭayaḥ || 11 || hiraṇyayebhiḥ | pavibhiḥ | payaḥvṛdhaḥ | ut | jighnante | āpyaḥ | na | parvatān | mukhāḥ | ayāsaḥ | svasṛtaḥ | dhruvacyutaḥ | dudhrakṛtaḥ | marutaḥ | bhrājatṛṣṭayaḥ || 11 ||

marutaḥ hiraṇyayebhiḥ suvarṇamayaiḥ | yadvā | hitaramaṇīyaiḥ pavibhiḥ sthānāṃ cakraiḥ parvatān parva- vato metrān yadvā śiloccayān urjighnante ūrdhvaṃ gamayanti | sthānāt pracyāvayantītyarthaḥ | tatra dṛṣṭāntaḥ | padhyaḥ na | yathā pathi gacchan ratho mārge āsthitaṃ tṛṇavṛkṣādikaṃ cūrṇīkṛtyordhvaṃ nayati gama- yati | yadvā | yathā saṃyuktā gāḥ mārgasthita vṛkṣādikaṃ bhagnaṃ kurvanti | kīdṛśā marutaḥ | payovṛdhaḥ payaso vṛṣṭyudakasya vardhayitāraḥ | yadvā pṛṣbheḥ payasā vardhamānāḥ | pṛṣpairvai payaso maruto jātāḥ | (tai. saṃ. 2. 2. 11. 4) | iti śrūyate | makhāḥ | makha iti yajñanāma | tadvantaḥ | ayāsaḥ devayajana- deśaṃ prati gantāraḥ svasṛtaḥ śatrūn prati svayameva saranto gacchantaḥ dhruvacyutaḥ dhruvāṇāṃ niścalānāṃ parva- tādīnāmapi vyāvayitāraḥ dudhrakṛtaḥ dudhraṃ dṛṣṭānāṃ dhārayitāramātmānaṃ kurvāṇāḥ | yadvā | durdharamanyai- rdhartumaśakyamātmānaṃ kurvāṇāḥ | bhrājadṛṣṭayaḥ dīpyamānāyudhāḥ || urjighnante | hantervyatyayenātmanepadam | ‘bahula chandasi ’ iti śapaḥ śluḥ | ‘bahula chandasi ’ iti abhyāsasya itvam | ‘gamahana ’ iyā- dinā upadhālopaḥ | ‘ho hanteḥ ’ iti ghāvam | ‘vyatyayena antādeśaḥ | padhyaḥ | pathi bhavaḥ | ‘bhave chandasi ’ iti yat | ‘nastaddhite ’ (pā. sū. 6. 4. 144) iti ṭilopaḥ | vyatyayenāntasvari- tatvam | yadvā | ‘chandasīvanau ’ iti matvarthīya īnkāraḥ | ‘udāttasvaritayoryaṇaḥ ’ iti vibhakteḥ svaritatvam | ayāsaḥ | ‘aya paya gatau ’ | ayante ityayāḥ | pacādyac | ājaserasuk | dudhra- kṛtaḥ | atra duḥśabdena duṣṭā lakṣyante | ‘dhṛṣ dhāraṇe ’ | duṣṭān dhārayatīti dudhraḥ | mūlavibhujāditvāt (pā. sū. 3. 2. 5. 2) kapratyayaḥ | yadvā | ‘īpsuḥsuṣu ’ iti duḥśabde upapade karmaṇi khal | guṇābhāvaśchāndasaḥ | taṃ kurvantīti dudhrakṛtaḥ | karoteḥ ‘kvip ca ’ iti kvip | rephalopaścāndasaḥ ||
carkṛtyaṃ marutaḥ putsu duṣṭaraṃ ghumantaṃ śuṣmaṃ maghavatsu dhattana |
dhanuspṛtamukyaṃ viśvacarṣaṇi tokaṃ puṣyema tanayaṃ śataṃ himāḥ ||
carkṛtyam | marutaḥ | putsu | duṣṭaram | ghumantam | śuṣmam | maghavatsu | dhattana | dhanuḥspṛtam | ukyam | viśvacarṣaṇim | tokam | puṣyema | tanayam | śatam | himāḥ || 14 ||
he marutaḥ 'maghavatsu havirlakṣaṇadhanayukteṣu yajamāneṣu putraṃ 'dhattana sthāpayata |
'ghumantaṃ dīptimantaṃ 'śuṣmaṃ śatrūṇāṃ śoṣakaṃ balavantaṃ 'dhanuspṛtaṃ dhanānāṃ spṛṣṭāraṃ dhanaiḥ prītaṃ vā 'ukyam |
hemantartūpalakṣitān śataṃ saṃvatsarān jīvantaḥ santaḥ 'puṣyema popayema |
tathā ca brāhmaṇamevamāmnāyate—' śataṃ himā ityāha śataṃ tvā hemantānnindhiṣīyeti vāvaitadāha ' ( tai. saṃ. 1. 5. 8. 5 ) iti ||
'prakṛtigrahaṇe yaṅlugantasyāpi grahaṇam ' ( paribhā. 93. 9 ) iti nyāyena karoteryaṅlugantāt ' vibhāṣā kṛtpvoḥ ' ( pā. sū. 3. 1. 120 ) iti kyap |
' padādiṣu māṃstṛstṛnāmupasaṃkhyānam ' ( pā. sū. 6. 1. 63. 1 ) iti pṛtanāśabdasya pṛdādeśaḥ |
aikādaśinasya mārutasya paśorvapāyāgasya ' nū ṣṭiram ' ityeṣā yājyā |
sūtritaṃ ca—' śucī vo havyā marutaḥ śucīnāṃ nū ṣṭiraṃ masto vīravantam ' ( āśva. śrau. 3. 7 ) iti ||
nū ṣṭiraṃ maruto vīravantamṛtīṣāhaṃ rayimasmāsu dhatta |
nu | sthiram | marutaḥ | vīravantam | ṛtīṣāham | rayim | asmāsu | dhatta | sahasriṇam | śatinam | śuśuvāṃsam | prātaḥ | makṣu | dhiyāvasuḥ | jagamyāt || 15 ||
'ṛtīṣāhaṃ gantṛṇāṃ śatrūṇāmabhibhavitāraṃ evaṃvidhaṃ 'rayiṃ putralakṣaṇaṃ dhanam 'asmāsu 'dhatta sthāpayata |
api cāsmākaṃ rakṣaṇāya dhiyā buddhyā karmaṇā vā prāptadhano marudgaṇaḥ prātaḥkāle 'jagamyāt āgacchatu |

gameluṃḍi ' mantre ghasa ' iti clerluk | ' gamahana ' ityādinā upadhālopaḥ | ' bahulaṃ chandasyamāṅ- yoge'pi ' iti aḍabhāvaḥ | yajantrāḥ | ' aminakṣi ' ityādinā atranpratyayaḥ | nisvādādyudāttatvam ||
ṛtasya devā anu vratā gurbhuvatpariṣṭhidyaurna bhūmaṃ |
vardhantīmāpaḥ panvā suśiśdhimṛtasya yonā garbhe sujātam ||
ṛtasya | devāḥ | anu | vratā | guḥ | bhuvat | pariṣṭhiḥ | dyauḥ | na | bhūmaṃ | vardhanti | īm | āpaḥ | panvā | suśiśdhim | ṛtasya | yonā | garbhe | sujātam ||3||4||
' devāḥ ' ' ṛtasya gatasya palāyitasyāgneḥ ' vratā vratāni karmāṇi gamanāvasthānaśayanādirūpāṇi ' anu ' guḥ anveṣṭumagaman |
tadanantaraṃ ' pariṣṭhiḥ paritaḥ sarvato'nveṣaṇaṃ ' bhuvat abhavat |
indrādayaḥ sarve devā agnerve- ṣaṇāya bhūlokaṃ prāptāḥ ' ityarthaḥ |
' āpaḥ abdevatāḥ ' īm enamudakaṃ praviṣṭamagniṃ ' vardhanti pravardhayanti ' |
ṛtasya yajñasyāsya vā kāraṇabhūte jale ' garbhe garbhasthāne madhye ' sujātaṃ suṣṭhu prādurbhūtam |
tathā ca taittarīyakaṃ - ' sa nilāyata so'paḥ prāviśattaṃ devatāḥ praiṣamaicchan taṃ matsyaḥ prābravīt ' (tai. saṃ. 2. 6. 6. 1) iti ||
' tādau ca niti ' iti gateḥ prakṛti- svaratvam |
' chandasyubhayathā ' iti śapa ārdhadhātukatvāt ' ṇeraniṭi ' iti ṇilopaḥ |
' ādamahajanajanaḥ ' ityatra ' utsargācchandasi ' (pā. sū. 3. 2. 171. 2) iti vacanāt kipratyayaḥ |
liṅgatvāt dvirbhāve ' bahulaṃ chandasi ' iti ukārasya hrasvam |
' suḥ pūjāyām ' (pā. sū. 1. 4. 94) iti soḥ karmapravacanīyatvam |
puṣṭinaṃ ruṇvā kṣitirna pṛthivī girinaṃ bhujaṃ kṣodaḥ na śaṃbhu |
atyo nājmantasargaṃprataktaḥ sindhurna kṣodaḥ ka īṃ varāte ||
puṣṭeḥ | na | ruṇvā | kṣitiḥ | na | pṛthivī | giriḥ | na | bhujam | kṣodaḥ | na | śaṃbhu | atyaḥ | na | ajman | sargaṃprataktaḥ | sindhuḥ | na | kṣodaḥ | kaḥ | īm | varāte ||5||6||
ᵛraṇvā ramaṇīyā sarveṣāṃ hṛdā ᵛpuṣṭirna abhimataphalānābhivṛddhiriva agniḥ sarveṣāṃ ramaṇīyaḥ |
puṣṭireva raṇvā gantavyaḥ śabdanīyaḥ stutyo vā |
yathā puṣṭiḥ prāpyate tadvadagniṣṭe havirbhiḥ prāpyate iti bhāvaḥ |
ᵛpṛthvī vistīrṇā ᵛkṣitirna bhūmiriva agnirapi vistīrṇaḥ sarveṣu bhūteṣu jāṭhararūpeṇāvasthānāt |
ᵛgirinaṃ parvata iva ᵛbhujma sarveṣāṃ bhojayitā |
yathā girau vidyamānaṃ phalamūlādikamāhṛtya sarve bhuñjate tadvadagniāvapi pacantaḥ sarve bhuñjate |
athavā giriyathā durbhikṣe sarvān prāṇino bhunakti svakīyaphala mūlādi- dānena' pālayati tadvadagnipi pāpādanuṣṭhātṛn pramukhti |
tathā cāmnāyate—'agnirmā tasmādenasaḥ pra muñcatu' (tai. saṃ. 1. 8. 5. 3) iti |
yathodakaṃ sukhaṃ karoti tadvadagniḥ sarveṣāṃ sukhakārītyarthaḥ |
añjana saṃgrāme ᵛatyo ᵛna satatagamanaśīlo jātyaśva iva ᵛsargāprataḥ sargeṇa visarjanena pragamitaḥ |
yathā sādinā prapito jātyaśvo hantavyamīpamāśu gacchati tadvadagnirapi stotṛbhiḥ preritaḥ manaḥ śatrūn hantuṃ śīghraṃ gacchatīti bhāvaḥ |
yathā nimnapradeśābhimukho jala- pravāho durnicāraḥ tadvadagnyābhimukho'gnirityarthaḥ |
ato yasmādevaṃ tasmāt ᵛīm enamagniṃ ᵛkaḥ ᵛvarate ko vārayet |
'ipi yudhrīndhi' iti vidhīyamāno mak bahulavacanādasmādapi bhavati |
jāmiḥ sindhūnāṃ bhrāteva svasrāmibhyānna rājā vanāṃnyatti |
yadvātajūto vanā vi vyasthādmihaṃ dāti romā pṛthivyāḥ ||
