' athai- tasyāḥ ' iti khaṇḍe tathaiva sūtritam- ' upa pra jinvanniti trīṇi kā ta upetiriti sūkte ' ( ādha. śrau. 4. 13 ) iti |
tathaiva sūyate- ' etāgneyaṃ gāyatramupasaṃtanuyāta prātaranuvākanyāyena ' ( āśva. śrau. 6. 5 ) iti ||

'upa pra jinvandyuśatīruśantaṃ patiṃ na nityaṃ janayaḥ sanīḻāḥ | svasāraḥ śyāvīmaruṣīmajuṣancitramucchantīmuṣasaṃ na gāvaḥ || 1 || upa | pra | jinvan | uśatīḥ | uśantam | patim | na | nityam | janayaḥ | sa'nīḻāḥ | svasāraḥ | śyāvīm | aruṣīm | ajuṣan | citram | ucchantīm | uṣasam | na | gāvaḥ ||1||
evaṃbhūtā aṅgulayaḥ ˅uśantaṃ kāmayamānamagniṃ ˅janayaḥ jāyāḥ ˅nityam asādhāraṇaṃ ˅patiṃ ˅na bhartāramiva ˅upa ˅pra ˅jinvan |
prīṇayitvā ca ˅citraṃ cāyanīyaṃ pūjanīyaṃ tamagnimabhilambanena ˅ajuṣan asevanta |

tatra dṛṣṭāntaḥ ˅śyāvīṃ śyāvavarṇā rātrisambandhāt kṛṣṇāṃ tataḥ ˅ucchantīṃ sūryakiraṇasambandhāt tamo varjayantīṃ ata eva ˅aruṣīṃ ārocamānāṃ yadvā śubhrarūpayuktām ˅uṣasaṃ ˅na upodevatāṃ ˅gāvaḥ raśmayo yathā sevante tadvat |
yathā raśmaya upasā nityasambaddhā evaṃ sarveṣu yajñeṣvagniparicaraṇenāṅgulayo nityasambaddhā iti tātparyarthaḥ ||
' asu kṣepaṇe ' ityasmāt ' subyaserṛn ' ( u. sū. 2. 253 ) iti knu |
' na padasvasādibhyaḥ ' ( pā. sū. 4. 1. 10 ) iti ṅīppratiṣedhaḥ |
' ruda ' ityanuvṛttau ' bahulaṃ chandasi ' ityantādeśasya ruḍāgamaḥ ||
1. sa-'sarvam' nāsti | 2. la-prāṇijātaṃ gṛhṇāti | astāiva kṣepaka iva devānprati haviḥ prerayati | 3. ca-cha-dha-na-pha-dṛṣṭamātreṇa | 4. ḍha-sūtritam | 5. cha-ta-śa-svasāraḥ | svasāraḥ |
vīḻu ci̭du॒hvā pi॒tarau॒ na u॒kthai rdi̭ ra॒jambha̭ṅgira॒so ravḙṇa |
ca॒kṛ॒di॒vo bṛha̭to gā॒tu॒sme a॒haḥ sva॒rvi॒vi॒duḥ ke॒tumu॒strāḥ ||

vīḻu | ci̭t | du॒hvā | pi॒taraṷ | naḥ | u॒kthaiḥ | a॒drim | ru॒jan | a॒ṅgira̭saḥ | ravḙṇa | ca॒kṛḥ | di॒vaḥ | bṛha̭taḥ | gā॒tum | a॒sme iti̭ | a॒haḥ iti̭ | sva̭ḥ | vi॒vi॒duḥ | ke॒tum | u॒strāḥ ||2||
balavantaṃ dṛḍhamapi 'adrim attāraṃ paṇināmānamasuraṃ 'raveṇa stutiśabdamātreṇaiva 'rujan abhrajan |
mārgaṃ kṛtvā ca 'svaḥ suṣṭhu araṇīyamasurarāhityena sukhena prāpyam 'ahaḥ divasaṃ 'vividuḥ ajānan labdhavanto vā |
tathā 'ketum ahnāṃ ketayitāraṃ jñāpayitāramādityam 'ustrāḥ paṇināpahatā gāśca vividurityanuṣaṅgaḥ ||
' vida jñāne ', ' vidlu lābhe ' iti vā |
dadha̭n | ṛ॒tam | dha॒na॒rya̭n | a॒sya | dhī॒tim | āt | i॒t | a॒ryaḥ | di॒dhi॒vaḥ | vi॒bhra॒trāḥ | a॒tṛ॒ṣya̭ntīḥ | a॒pasa̭ḥ | ya॒nti | a॒ccha | de॒vān | janma̭ | praya̭sā | vardha̭yantīḥ || 3 ||
dhārayitvā ca 'asya agneḥ 'dhītiṃ karma agnihotrādilakṣaṇaṃ 'dhanayan dhanakurvan |
yathā puruṣā dhanaṃ saṃpādayanti tadvadagni- devārthaṃ karma anvatiṣṭhannityarthaḥ |
'ādit aṅgirasāmanuṣṭhānanantarameva 'athaiḥ aryā dhanasya svāminyaḥ 'didhiṣvaḥ tena dhanena dvidhiṣvo'gnīnāṃ dhāraṇa kurvantaḥ |

'vibhratrāḥ āhitāgnīn agnihotrādikarmāṇa viharantyaḥ 'atṛṣyantīḥ vipayāntaratṛṣṇārahitāḥ ata eva 'apasaḥ apasā karmaṇā yuktāḥ evaṃbhūtā yajamānalakṣaṇāḥ prajāḥ 'prayasā havirlakṣaṇenānnena 'devān indrādīn 'janma jātān manuṣyāṃśca 'vardhayantīḥ vardhayantyaḥ sasyaḥ enamagnim 'accha abhimukhyena 'yanti prāpnuvanti paricarantīti yāvat ||
' dudhāñ dhāraṇapoṣaṇayoḥ ', ' po antakarmaṇi ' ityābhyām ' anūdambhūjambakapherūkkancūdidhiṣvaḥ '
jasi 'vā chandasi' iti pūrvasavarṇadīrghasya vikalpitatvāt pūrvasavarṇadīrghaḥ |
apasaśabdā- duspabhasya matvarthīyasya vino 'bahula chandasi' ( pā. sū. 5. 2. 122 ) iti bahulavacanāt luk |
mathīdyadīṃ vibhṛto mātariśvā gṛhegṛhe śyeto jenyo bhūt |

mhe yatpitra ī rasaṃ dive karava tsaratpṛśanyāścikitvān | sṛjadastāṃ dhṛṣatā dvidyumasmai svāyāṃ devo duhitari tviṣiṃ dhāt || 15 || mhe | yat | pitra | īm | rasam | dive | kaḥ | ava | tsarat | pṛśanyaḥ | cikitvān | sṛjat | astāṃ | dhṛṣatā | dvidyum | asmai | svāyām | devaḥ | duhitari | tviṣim | dhāt ||15||

vmhe mahate vpitra pālayitra vdive dyotamānāya devagaṇāya vīm imaṃ vrasaṃ pṛthivyāḥ sārabhūtaṃ haviḥ vyat yadā yajamānaḥ vkaḥ karoti tadānīṃ vpṛśanyaḥ sparśanakuśalo rākṣasādiḥ vcikitvān havīṣi vahantaṃ he agne tvāṃ jānan vava vtsarat svajyātpalāyate |
vastā iṣukṣepaṇaśīlo'gniḥ vdhṛṣatā dharṣakeṇa dhanuṣā vasmai palāyamānāya rākṣasādye vdidyuṃ dīpyamānaṃ bāṇaṃ vsṛjat visṛjati |
vdevaḥ dīvya- māna upaḥkālaṃ prāpto'gniḥ vsvāyāṃ svakīyāyāṃ vduhitari duhitṛvat samanantarabhāvinyāmupasi vtviṣiṃ svakīyāṃ dīptiṃ vdhāt sthāpayati |
tathā ca taittirīyakam- ' udyantaṃ vāvādityamabhiranusarohati tasmādūma evāmerdivā dadṛśe ' ( tai. brā. 2. 1. 2. 10 ) iti |
vkaḥ karoterluṅi ' mantre ghasa ' ityā- dinā calerluk |
' kṛpṛji ' ( u. sū. 2. 239 ) iti vidhīyamānaḥ kyupratyayo bahulavacanā- dasmādapi bhavati |

sva ā yastubhyaṃ dam ā vibhāti namau vo dāśādaśato anu ghūna | vardho agne vayoṃ asya dvirbarhā yāsrāyā sarathaṃ yaṃ junāsi || 16 || sve | ā | yaḥ | tubhyam | dame | ā | vibhāti | namaḥ | vā | dāśāt | uśataḥ | anu | ghūna | vardhaḥ | agne | vayaḥ | asya | dvirbarhāḥ | yāsat | rāyā | sa'ratham | yam | junāsi ||16||
he agne vtubhyaṃ tvāṃ vsve vdame svakīye yajñagṛhe vyaḥ yajamānaḥ |
yathāśāstram vā vvibhāti ā samantāt samidādibhiḥ kāṣṭhaiḥ prajvalayati |
vanu vghūna anudivasam vuśataḥ kāmayamānāya tubhyaṃ vnamo vvā vdāśāt havirlakṣaṇamannaṃ vā dadyāt |
vasya yaja- mānasya he vagne vdvirbarhāḥ dvayormadhyamottamasthānayorhito vardhitasavaṃ vvayaḥ annaṃ vvardho vardhayaiva |
vsarathaṃ rathena sahitaṃ yuyutsuṃ vyaṃ puruṣaṃ vjunāsi yuddhe prerayasi sa puruṣaḥ vrāyā dhanena vyāsat saṃgacchate |
' kriyāgrahaṇaṃ kartavyam ' iti karmaṇaḥ saṃpradānatvāt caturthī |
vṛdheryantāt loṭi ' chandasyubhayā ' iti śapa ārdhadhātukatvāt ' geraniṭī ' iti ṇilopaḥ |

vakṣyamāṇaguṇaviśiṣṭaputrarūpeṇa ᵛjanayat janayatu | ᵛśārdhaṃ balavantam ᵛanavadyam avagharahitaṃ ᵛyuvānaṃ taruṇaṃ jarārahitamityarthaḥ | ᵛsvādhyaṃ śobhanakarmāṇaṃ śobhanaprajñaṃ votpannaṃ putraṃ ᵛsūdayatha yāgādikarmasu prerayatu ca | yadvā | reta ityudakanāma | niṣiktaṃ meghena vṛṣṭyudakam iṣe'jñāya sasyādiniṣpattaye'preryateja ānad vyāpnot vṛṣṭyudakena ᵛbhaumāpreḥ saṃyoge sati hi sasyānyupadyante | kīdṛśaṃ tejaḥ | nṛpatiṃ nṛṇāṃ rakṣakaṃ śuci dīsam | tādṛśena tejasā yukko dhaudīso'bhirabhīke āsannakāle eva śardhādiguṇaviśiṣṭaṃ putraṃ janayatu taṃ ca prerayatu yajñādau || iṣe | ‘ sāvekācaḥ 0 ’ iti vibhakterudāttatvam | nṛpatim | ‘ parādiśchandasi bahulam ’ ityuttarapadādyudāttatvam | ānad | ‘ aśñū vyāptau ’ | laṅi vyatyayena parasmaipadabhamau | āḍāgamaḥ | brahmādiṣve dhuvam | niṣiktam | ‘ picir kṣaraṇe ’ | karmaṇi niṣṭhā | ‘ gatiranantaraḥ ’ iti gateḥ prakṛtisvaratvam | ‘ upasargārtsunoti 0 ’ iti paravam | abhīke | abhipūrvāddhateḥ pacādyaci ṭupodarāditvāt rūpasiddhiḥ | yadvā | ‘ iṇ gatau ’ ityasmāt auṇādikaḥ kavapratyayaḥ | ubhayathāpi dāsībhārāditvāt pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaratvam | svādhyam | ‘ eranekācaḥ 0 ’ iti yaṇādeśaḥ | ‘ udāttasvaritayoryaṇaḥ 0 ’ iti svaritatvam | janayat | janayeryantāt leṭi aḍāgamaḥ | sūdayat | ‘ pūda kṣaraṇe ’ | pūrvavat leṭi aḍāgamaḥ ||
mano na yo'dhvanaḥ sadya etyekaḥ sūtrā sūro vasvaṃ īśe |
rājānā mitrāvaruṇā supāṇī goṣu priyamamṛtaṃ rakṣamāṇā ||
manaḥ | na | yaḥ | adhvanaḥ | sadyaḥ | eti | ekaḥ | sūtrā | sūraḥ | vasvaḥ | īśe | rājānā | mitrāvaruṇā | supāṇī iti su'pāṇī | goṣu | priyam | amṛtam | rakṣamāṇā ||9||
ᵛyaḥ ᵛsūraḥ sūryaḥ ᵛekaḥ ekākī asahāyaḥ san ᵛadhvanaḥ divyān mārgān ᵛsadyaḥ ᵛpati āśu gacchati |
asahāyatvaṃ ca śrūyate- ‘ sūrye ekākī caratītyāha |
asau vā āditya ekākī carati ’ ( tai. brā. 3. 9. 5. 4 ) iti |
śīghragamanaṃ ca smaryate- ‘ yojanānāṃ sahasre dve dve śate dve ca yojane |
ekena nimiṣārdhena kramamāṇa namo'stu te ’ iti |
sa ca sūraḥ ᵛvasvaḥ dhanasya ᵛsatrā sahaiva yugapadeva ᵛīśe īṣṭe |
yo hi śīghraṃ gacchati sa bahudeśeṣvavasthitāni dhanāni prāpnoti |
tathā ᵛrājānā rājamānau ᵛsupāṇī śobhanabāhū ᵛmitrāvaruṇā mitrāvaruṇau asmadīyāsu ᵛgoṣu ᵛpriyaṃ sarveṣāṃ prītikaram ᵛamṛtam amṛtatvasvādubhūtaṃ payaḥ ᵛrakṣamāṇā rakṣantau vartate |
he agne tattadrūpeṇa tvameva vartase iti bhāvaḥ ||
‘ jasādiṣu chandasi vāvacanam ’ iti gherṅiti ’ iti guṇābhāve yaṇādeśaḥ |
mā no agne sakhyā pitryāṇi pra marṣiṣṭhā abhi viduṣkaviḥ san |
namo na rūpaṃ jarimā mināti purā tasyā abhirśasterdhīhi ||
mā | naḥ | agne | sakhyā | pitryāṇi | pra | marṣiṣṭhāḥ | abhi | viduḥ | kaviḥ | san | narmaḥ | na | rūpam | jarimā | mināti | purā | tasyāḥ | abhi'śasteḥ | ardhi | ihi || 10 ||
he agne pitryāṇi pitaraṃ vasiṣṭhamupakramyāgatāni sakhyā sakhitvāni mā pra marṣiṣṭhāḥ mā vināśaya |
yatastvaṃ kaviḥ krāntadarśī san abhi ābhimukhyena viduḥ sarvaṃ vidvān |
jarimā jarā mināti māṃ sūktadraṣṭāraṃ hinasti |
abhirśasteḥ hiṃsāhetoḥ tasyāḥ jarāyāḥ purā adhīhi māṃ budhvasva |
sā yathā na prāpnoti tathā kuru |

ᵥviṣvā viśvāni svāṃni ᵥamṛtāni| hiraṇyanāmaitat| ‘amṛtaṃ hiraṇyam’ (bha. saṃ. 5. 28. 11) iti śruteḥ| sarvāṇi hiraṇyāni stotubhyaḥ ᵥsatrā sahaiva ᵥcakrāṇaḥ kurvan yugapatpratyacchiṣyarthaḥ|| kaḥ| karoteścāndaso luṅ| ‘mantre ghasa’ ᵥ iti cleluṅ| ‘hahathābhyaḥ’ ᵥ iti takāralopaḥ| naryā| nara- śabdāt hitārthe gavādilakṣaṇo yatpratyayo draṣṭavyaḥ (pā. sū. 5. 1. 2)| yadvā| ‘tatra sādhuḥ’ ᵥ iti yat| cakrāṇaḥ| karoterlaṃṭaḥ śānac| ‘bahula chandasi’ ᵥ iti vikaraṇasya bhluḥ| nambevaṃ sati ‘abhya- stānāmādiḥ’ ᵥ ityādyudāttatvaṃ prāpnoti| evam| tarhi liṭaḥ kānajastu| tasyārdhadhātukatvena abhyastādyudāttābhāve cirasvara eva śiṣyate||
asme va॒tsa̭ṃ pa॒ri pa॒ntaṃ na vi̭ndā॒nniccha̭nto vi॒śve amṛ̭tā amṷ̄rāḥ|
śra॒ma॒yuva̭ḥ pa॒dvya̭o dhi॒ya॒ṃdhāsta̭sthuḥ pa॒de pa॒rame cā॒rvagrḙḥ|
asme iti| vatsam| pari| santam| na| vindan| icchantaḥ| viśve| amṛtāḥ| amūrāḥ| śramayuvaḥ| padvyaḥ| dhiyamdhāḥ| tasthuḥ| pade| parame| cāru| agreḥ|| 2||
1 tathā cāmnāyate—‘mamaiva sanvaha havyānme putraḥ pitre lokakṛjātavedaḥ’ (tai. brā. 3. 7. 7. 10) iti|
evaṃvidhamagnim ᵥicchanto ᵥviśve ᵥamṛtāḥ sarve'maraṇadharmāṇo devāḥ ᵥamūrāḥ amuḍhā marutaśca ᵥvindan tamagniṃ nālabhanta|

alabhamānāśca te ᵥśramayuvaḥ havyavāhanasyābhāvena haviṣāmāvāttajjanayena śrameṇa kleśenaikabhītāḥ tasya ᵥagreḥ anveṣaṇāya ᵥpadasyaḥ pādairgacchantaḥ ᵥdhiyaṃdhāḥ dhiyāmagneḥ śayanāsanasthānādilakṣaṇānāṃ karmaṇāṃ dhārayitoraḥ|
evaṃvidhāḥ santaḥ ᵥcāru cāruṇi śobhane'gneḥ ᵥparame uttame'nye ᵥpade|
‘kvibvacipraccha’ ᵥ (u. sū. 2. 215) ityādinā vidhīyamānau kvibdhīghāvasmādapi dhātorbhavataḥ|
‘tatpuruṣe kṛti bahulam’ iti bahulavacanāt dvitīyāyā api aluk|
tisraḥ| yat| agne| śaradaḥ| tvām| it| śucim| ghṛtena| śucayaḥ| saparyān| nāmāni| cit| dadhire| yajñiyāni| asūdayanta| tanvaḥ| sujātāḥ|| 3||

'śucayaḥ śodhayitāro dīkṣā vā maruto he 'agne 'śuciṃ śuddhaṃ dīpyamānaṃ vā 'tvāmit devebhyo nirgataṃ tvāmevohiya 'tisraḥ 'śaradaḥ trīn saṃvatsarān 'ghṛtena ājyena 'yat yadvā 'saparyān pūjāṃ kuryuḥ tadānīṃ tvāmavirabhūḥ |
tadanantaraṃ te marutastvayānugṛhītāḥ santaḥ 'yajñiyāni yajñārhāṇi yajñe prayoktuṃ yogyāni 'nāmāni 'cit nāmānyapi 'dadhire adhārayan |
nāmāni ca taittirīyake samāmnāyante— 'īdṛṅ cānyāruṅ caitādṛṅ ca pratidṛṅ ca mitaśca samitaśca sabharāḥ ' (tai. saṃ. 4. 6. 5. 5) ityādīni |
nāmāni dhārayitvā ca 'sujātāḥ pūrva rūpaṃ parityajya śobhanamamṛtatvaṃ prāptāḥ santaḥ 'tanvaḥ svakīyāni śarīrāṇi 'asūdayanta svargaṃ prāpitavantaḥ |
śasi 'tricaturoḥ striyāṃ tisucatas ' iti pūrvasavarṇadīrghatve prāpte 'aci ra ṛtaḥ ' iti rephā- deśaḥ |
tisrādeśasyāpi sthānivadbhāvenānto- dāttatve 'udāttathaṇo halpūrvāt ' iti śasa udāttatvam |

ā rodasī bṛhatī vevidānāḥ pra rudriyā jabhiri yajñiyāsaḥ | vidanmato nemadhitā cikitvāmṛgni pade parame tasthivāṃsam || 4 || ā | rodasī iti | bṛhatī iti | vevidānāḥ | pra | rudriyā | jabhiri | yajñiyāsaḥ |
vidat | mataiḥ | nemadhitā | cikitvān | agnim | pade | parame | tasthivāṃsam || 4 ||
evaṃbhūtāḥ 'yajñiyāsaḥ yajñārhāḥ devāḥ 'rudriyā rudro'gniḥ devānāsuraiḥ saha yuddhasamaye tairdevaiḥ sthāpitaṃ dhanamapahṛtya gatavantamagni devā āgatya agnisakāśādvalena taddhanamagṛhṇan |
tathā ca taittirīyakaṃ— 'tadabhinyakāmayata tenāpā- kāmata tadevā vijityāvaharatsamānā anvāyan tadasya sahasādissanta so'rodīdyadarodīttadrudrasya tvam ' (tai. saṃ. 1. 5. 1. 1) iti |
tasya rudrasyārhāṇi stotrāṇi 'pra 'jabhiri prajahire cakṣuḥ ityarthaḥ |
sarveṣāṃ devānāṃ ardhabhāgena dhīyate dhāryate iti nemadhita indraḥ |
sarve devā eko'rthaḥ indra eka evāparo'rdhaḥ iti yāvat |
tathā ca taittirīyakaṃ— 'yatsarveṣāmardhamindraḥ prati tasmādindro devatānāṃ bhūyiṣṭha- bhāktamaḥ ' (tai. saṃ. 5. 4. 8. 3) iti |
tenendreṇa sahitaḥ 'mataiḥ marudgaṇaḥ 'parame uttame'nye 'pade sthāne'śvatthādau 'tasthivāṃsaṃ sthitavantam 'agniṃ 'cikitvān jānan 'vidat alabhata ||

vid‌t | ‘vida lābhe’ | luṅi ludittvāt‌ cleḥ aḍādeśaḥ | nemadhitā | dadhāteḥ karmaṇi niṣṭhā | ‘sudhita vasudhita nemadhitā’ (pā. sū. 7. 4. 45) iti dhibhāvo nipātyate | ‘tṛtīyā karmaṇi’ iti pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaratvam | ‘supāṃ suluk’ iti tṛtīyāyā ākāraḥ | tasthivāṃsam | tiṣṭhaterliṭaḥ kasuḥ | ‘vastrekājād‌sām’ iti iḍāgamaḥ ||
‘athottaram’ iti khaṇḍe sūtritaṃ-- saṃjānānā upa sīdannabhijñvā daśabhirvivasvataḥ’ (āśva. śrau. 4. 7) iti ||
saṃjānānā upa sīdannabhijñu patnīvanto namasyai namasyan |
ririkṣāṃsastanvaḥ kṛṇvata svāḥ sakhā sakhyurnimiṣi rakṣamāṇāḥ ||
su'jānānāḥ | upa | sīdan | abhi'jñu | patnī'vantaḥ | namasyam | namasyan | ririkṣāṃsaḥ | tanvaḥ | kṛṇvata | svāḥ | sakhā | sakhyuḥ | ni'miṣi | rakṣamāṇāḥ || 5 ||
he agne tvāṃ saṃjānānāḥ samyagjānanto devāḥ upa sīdan upasīdanti prāpnuvanti |
upasattiṃ kṛtvā ca patnīvantaḥ sapatnīkāḥ santaḥ namasyaṃ namaskārārham abhijñu ābhimukhyenāvasthitajānu- yuktaṃ tvāṃ namasyan apūjayan |

pūjayitvā ca sakhyuḥ mitrasya tava nimiṣi darśane nimittabhūte sati rakṣamāṇāḥ tvayā parirakṣyamāṇāḥ sakhā sakhāyo devāḥ svāḥ tanvaḥ svakīyāni śarīrāṇi riri- kṣāṃsaḥ anaśanādirūpeṇa dīkṣāniyamena riktīkurvantaḥ śoṣayantaḥ kṛṇvata yāgānakurvan |
tebhī rakṣante amṛtaṃ sajoṣaাঃ paśūṃśca sthātścarathaṃ ca pāhi ||
triḥ | sapta | yat | guhyāni | tve | iti | tvat | padā | avidan | ni'hitā | yajñiyāsaḥ | tebhiḥ | rakṣante | amṛtam | sa'joṣaাঃ | paśūn | ca | sthāt | caratham | ca | pāhi || 6 ||
triḥ sapta ekaviṃśatisaṃkhyākāni guhyāni rahasyāni vaidakasamidhigamyāni yat yāni padā padāni |
padyate gamyate svargaḥ ebhiriti vyutpattyā padaśabdenātra yajñā ucyante |
evamekaviṃśatisaṃkhyākāni yajñalakṣaṇāni padāni he agne tve tvayyeva nihitā sthāpitāni |
tathā coktam—‘arthī samartho vidvān śāstreṇāparyudastaḥ karmaṇyadhikārī ² iti |
labdhvā ca ʸtebhiḥ yajñalakṣaṇaiḥ padaiḥ ʸamṛtam amaraṇadharmāṇaṃ tvāṃ ʸrakṣante pālayanti yajanti- dhyarthaḥ |
tairyajamānaiḥ samānaprītitvaṃ ʸpaśūna gavāśvādipaśūna ʸca ʸsthātṝn brīhādisthāvarāṇi ʸcaratha paśuvyatiriktamanyathaprāṇijātamatat tat ʸca ʸpāhi rakṣa |
teṣu hi rakṣiteṣu tvadīyā yāgāḥ kartuṃ śakyante nānyathā |
‘supāṃ suluk’ º iti saptamyāḥ śe ādeśaḥ |
ubhayatra ‘ubhayatharchu’ ʸ (pā. sū. 8. 3. 8) ityubhayathābhāvāt nakārasya rutvābhāvaḥ ||

sarvāṇi jñātavyāni ʸvidvān jñānastvaṃ ʸkṣitīnāṃ yajamānalakṣaṇānāṃ prajānāṃ ʸjīvase jīvituṃ ʸśurudhaḥ kṣudupasya śokasya rodhayitrī- ripo'jñāni ʸānuṣak anuṣaktaṃ satataṃ yathā bhavati tathā ʸtri ʸdhāḥ vidhehi kurvityarthaḥ |
evaṃ yajamānān abhisamṛddhān kṛtvānantaraṃ ʸhavirvāṭ tadaivebhyaḥ dattaṃ havirvahan ʸdūtaḥ ʸabhavaḥ devānāṃ dūto bhavasi |
‘ajiyamiśīṅbhyaśca’ ² (u. sū. 3. 341) iti karmaṇi unan- pratyayaḥ ³ |
svādhyau diva ā sama yahvī rāyo duro vyṛtajñā aṃjānan |
vidadvyaṃ saramā dṛḻahamūrva yenā nu kaṃ mānuṣī bhojate viṭ ||
su'ārcyaḥ | divaḥ | ā | sata | yahvīḥ | rāyaḥ | duraḥ | vi | ṛta'jñāḥ | ajānan | vidat | gavyam | saramā | dṛḻaham | ūrvam | yena | nu | kam | mānuṣī | bhojate | viṭ || 8 ||
'svādhyaḥ śobhanakarmayuktāḥ 'yahīḥ yahyo mahasyaḥ 'sasa gaṅgādhāḥ sasa nadyaḥ 'divaḥ dyulokā- dāgatya bhūyāṃ pravahnantīti śeṣaḥ |
agnī home sati hi tena nṛsaḥ sūryo vṛṣṭiṃ karoti |
tathā 'ṛtajñāḥ kṛtaṃ yajñaṃ jānanto'ṅgirasaḥ 'rāyaḥ valanānnāsureṇapahatasya gorūpasya dhanasya 'duraḥ dvārāṇi gamanamārgān 'ajānantvayā jñātavantaḥ |
svatsādhyena yāgena prīta indro gavāmanveṣaṇāya saramāṃ nāma devaśunīṃ preṣitavān |
sā ca saramā gavāṃ sthānamavagayyendrasya nyavedayat |
adhi śriyaṃ ni dadhuścārumasindivo yadakṣī amṛtā akṛṇvan |
adha kṣaranti sindhavo na suṣṭā: pra nīcīragne aruṣīrajānan ||
adhi | śriyam | ni | dadhu: | cārum | asmin | diva: | yat | akṣī iti | amṛtā: | akṛṇvan | adha | kṣaranti | sindhava: | na | suṣṭā: | pra | nīcī: | agne | aruṣī: | ajānan || 10 ||
^asmin agnau ^cāruṃ śobhanāṃ ^śriyaṃ paritaraṇapariṣecanādirūpāṃ yajñasaṃpadam ^adhi ^ni ^dadhu: yajamānā: sthāpitavanta: |
nidhāya ca ^yat yadā ^akṣī yajñasyājyabhāgalakṣaṇe cakṣuṣī ^akṛṇvan kurvanti |
‘cakṣuṣī vā ete yajñasya yadājyabhāgau’ (tai. saṃ. 2. 6. 2. 1) iti śrute: |
tadānīṃ ^diva: dyulokāt ^amṛtā: amaraṇadharmāṇo devā: yāgasamaye jāta ityavagamyā
yathā vidvacchāsanaṃ sarveṣvanuṣṭheyeṣu tatttatsaṃśayanirṇayāya nīyate tadvadagmirapi sarveṣu yajñeṣu praṇīyate |

yaśca syonaśīḥ sukhaprade gārhapatyāyatanādau śayānaḥ atithirna sukhāsane upaveśitaḥ arghapādyādibhiḥ sakṛto'tithiriva prīṇānaḥ havirbhistarpaṇīyaḥ so'gniḥ vidhataḥ paricarato yajamānasya sanna gṛhaṃ vitārit pravadharyati dadāti vā |
hotā homakartādhvaryustattatkarma- phaleryajamānasya gṛhaṃ yathā vardhayati tadvat |
'vibhāṣā gamahanavidaviśām' iti kasau asya dhātoḥ iṣṭaḥ vikalpitatvāt tatrāpi viśiṣācāryattaudādika eva vidiṃgṛhyate ityuktam (kā. 7.2. 68) |
punaḥ sukhadena samāse kṛdgrahaṇe gatikārakapūrvasyāpi graha- ṇāt kṛduttarapadaprakṛtisvaratvam |
syone sukhakare gārhapatyādisthāne śete iti syonaśīḥ |
devo na yaḥ savitrā satyamanmā kratvā nipātiṃ vṛjanāni viśvā |
purupraśasto amatirna satya ātmeva śevaṃ didhiṣāyyau bhūt |
devaḥ | na | yaḥ | savitrā | satya'manmā | kratvā | ni'pātiṃ | vṛjanāni | viśvā | puru'praśastaḥ | amatiḥ | na | satyaḥ | ātmā'iva | śevaḥ | didhiṣāyyaḥ | bhūt || 2 ||
'devo 'na 'savitā dyotamānaḥ sarvasya prerakaḥ sūrye iva 'yaḥ 'agniḥ 'satyamanmā satyajñāno yathārthadarśī so'gniḥ 'kratvā ātmīyena karmaṇā 'viśvā 'vṛjanāni |
yathā pṛthivyādeḥ svarūpamāgamāpāyiṣu viśeṣeṣu satsvapi svayamaikarūpyeṇa nityaṃ bhavati tadvadagnipyavyāvaceṣu sarveṣu karmasu svayameka eva vyāpya vartate |
paramapremāspadatayā niratiśayānandasvarūpaḥ ātmā yathā sarvān sukhayati |
'etasyaivānandasyānyāni bhūtāni mātrāmupajīvanti' (bṛ. u. 4. 3. 32) 'eṣa hyevānandayāti' (tai.ā. 8.7) iti ca śravaṇāt |
tathā ca taiti- rīyakaṃ- 'vīrahā vā eṣa devānāṃ yo'gnimudvāsayate' (tai. saṃ. 1.5. 2. 1) iti |
de॒vo na yaḥ pṛ̭thi॒vīṃ vi॒śvadhā̭yā u॒pa॒kṣeti̭ hi॒tami̭tro na rā॒jā|
pu॒raḥsa̭daḥ śa॒rmasa̭do na vī॒rā a̭na॒vadyā॒ pati̭juṣṭeva॒ nārī̭ ||
devaḥ| na| yaḥ| pṛthivīm| viśvadhāyāḥ| upakṣeti| hitamitraḥ| na| rājā| puraḥsadaḥ| śarmasadaḥ| na| vīrāḥ| anavadyā| patijuṣṭā iva| nārī || 3 ||
^devo ^na dyotamānaḥ sūrya iva ^yaḥ agniḥ ^viśvadhāyāḥ sarvasya jagato dhartā|
yathā sūryo vṛṣṭyādipradānena sarvaṃ jagat dhatte evamagnirapi yajñādisādhanena kṛtsnasya jagato dhārayitā|
so'gniḥ ^pṛthivīṃ pṛthivyām ^upakṣeti sarveṣāṃ priyaḥ san yajñagṛhādau nivasati|
hitānyanukūlāni mitrāṇi yasya tādṛśo rājā yathā sukhena nivasati tadvat|
yathā sarvajanamitro rājā evamagnirapi sarvajanamitra ityarthaḥ|
yasyāgneḥ ^puraḥsadaḥ purastāt sīdanta upaviśantaḥ puruṣāḥ ^śarmasado ^na ^vīrāḥ pitṛgṛhe vartamānāḥ putrāḥ iva vartante|
pitā putrāniva agniḥ svasya paricārakān rakṣatīti bhāvaḥ|
sā yathā pātivratyena śuddhā satī sarvakarmayogyā bhavati evamagnirapi|
'gatikārakayorapi pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaratvaṃ ca' iti vacanāt kārakapūrvādapi dadhāteḥ 'vahihādhāñbhyaśchandasi' iti asun|
'nunarayorvṛddhiśca' (pā. sū. 4. 1. 73 ga.) iti śārṅgaravādiṣu pāṭhāt ṅīnnanta ādyudāttaḥ|
taṃ tvā॒ naro̭ da॒ma ā ni॒tyami̭ddhama॒gne sa̭canta kṣi॒tiṣṷ dhru॒vāsṷ|
adhi̭ dyu॒mnaṃ ni da̭dhurbhūrya॒sminbha॒rvā vi॒śvayṷrdhu॒raṇī̭ ra॒yīṇām̭ ||
tam| tvā| naraḥ| dame| ā| nityam| iddham| agne| sacanta| kṣitiṣu| dhruvāsu| adhi| dyumnam| ni| dadhuḥ| bhūri| asmin| bharvā| viśvayuḥ| dhuraṇīḥ| rayīṇām || 4 ||
he ^agne ^taṃ ^tvā pūrvoktaguṇaviśiṣṭaṃ ^tvāṃ naraḥ ^yajñasya netāro yajamānāḥ ^dhruvāsu ^kṣitiṣu niścalāsu calanarahitāsu bhūmiṣu|
^dame svakīye yajñagṛhe ^nityam ^iddham anavarataṃ samidbhiḥ prajvalitaṃ kṛtvā ^ā ^sacanta abhilakṣyena sevante|
kiṃca ^asmin agnau ^dyumnaṃ havirlakṣaṇamannaṃ ^bhūri ca puroḍāśādirūpeṇa bahuvidham ^adhi ^ni ^dadhuḥ sthāpitavantaḥ|

yo'gniḥ sa tvaṃ viśvāyuḥ uktaprakāreṇa sarvājño bhūtvā rayīṇāṃ dhanānāṃ dharuṇaḥ dhārayitā abhava | asmabhyaṃ dātuṃ dhanāni dhārayetyarthaḥ || sacanta | ‘ vaca samavāye ’ | chāndaso vartamāne laṭ | ‘ bahulaṃ chandasyamāṅ‌yoge'pi ’ iti aḍabhāvaḥ | bhava | ‘ aco'ntyaṭiḥ ’ iti saṃhitāyāṃ dīrghaḥ | dharuṇaḥ | ‘ dhārerṇiluka ca ’ iti unapratyayaḥ ||
vi pṛkṣo agne maghavāno aśyurvi sūryo darto viśvāyuḥ |
sanem vājaṃ samithedhvaryo bhāgaṃ deveṣu śravase dadhānāḥ ||
vi | pṛkṣaḥ | agne | magha'vānaḥ | aśyuḥ | vi | sūryaḥ | dartaḥ | viśvam | āyuḥ | sanem | vājam | sam'ithedhu | aryaḥ | bhāgam | deveṣu | śravase | dadhānāḥ || 5 ||
he agne maghavānaḥ havirlakṣaṇena dhanena yuktā yajamānāḥ pṛkṣaḥ ajñāni vi aśyuḥ vyāpnu- vantu |
ye ca sūryaḥ vidvāṃsaḥ tvāṃ stuvanti |
dartaḥ ye ca tubhyaṃ havīṃṣi dadataḥ prayacchanto vartante ne sarve viśvamāyuḥ sarvaṃ jīvitaṃ vi aśyuḥ vyāpnuvantu |
vayaṃ ca samithedhu saṃgrāmeṣu aryaḥ areḥ śatroḥ saṃbandhin vājaṃ annaṃ sanem svadanugrahāt saṃjamemahi |
tadana- ntaraṃ deveṣu tvatpramukheṣvindrādiṣu śravase yaśase tad bhāgaṃ havirbhāgaṃ dadhānāḥ sthāpayanto bhūyā- smeti śeṣaḥ ||
ariśabdāt ṣaṣṭhyekavacane ‘ jasādiṣu chandasi vāvacanam ’ iti ‘ gherṅiti ’ iti guṇābhāve yaṇādeśaḥ |
ariśabdaḥ ‘ aca haḥ ’ iti ipratyayāntaḥ anto- dāttaḥ |
ṛtasya hi dhenavo vāvaśānāḥ smad‌bhvīḥ pīpayanta ghubhaktāḥ |
parāvataḥ mumatiṃ bhikṣamāṇā vi sindhavaḥ samayā sasrurādrim ||
ṛtasya | hi | dhenavaḥ | vāvaśānāḥ | smat'ūrbhīḥ | pīpayanta | ghubhaktāḥ | parā'vataḥ | su'matim | bhikṣamāṇāḥ | vi | sindhavaḥ | samayā | sasruḥ | adrim || 6 ||
ṛtasya hi ṛtaṃ devayajanadeśaṃ prāptamiva dhenavaḥ agnihotrādihaviṣāṃ dogdhyo gāvaḥ pīpa- yanta kṣorādilakṣaṇaṃ gamyamapāyayan |
ghubhaktāḥ divā prakāśena saṃbhaktāḥ saṃliṣṭāḥ tejasvinya ityarthaḥ |
api ca sindhavaḥ syandanaśīlā nadyaḥ sumatim asyāgneḥ śobhāmanugrahātmikāṃ buddhiṃ bhikṣamāṇāḥ yācamānāḥ
satyaḥ va adriṃ va samayā adreḥ parvatasya samīpe va parāvataḥ dūradeśāt va vi va sattuḥ viśeṣeṇa gacchanti pravahanti |
' kriyāgrahaṇaṃ kartavyam ' iti karmaṇaḥ saṃpradānatvāt caturthyarthe ṣaṣṭhī |
' na vaśaḥ ' ( pā. sū. 6. 1. 20 ) iti saṃprasāraṇapratiṣedhaḥ |
ata eva lasārvadhātukānudātta- tvābhāve citvara eva śiṣyate |
' ūdhaso'naṅ ' ( pā. sū. 5. 4. 131 ) iti anaṅādeśaḥ samāsāntaḥ |
asmin dhātvarthe gamyamāne ' upasargā- cchandasi dhātvarthe ' ( pā. sū. 5. 1. 118 ) iti vatiḥ |

tve agne sumatiṃ bhikṣamāṇā divi śravo dadhire yajñiyāsaḥ | naktāṃ ca cakrurupasā virūpe kṛṣṇaṃ ca varṇamaruṇaṃ ca saṃ dhuḥ || 7 || tve iti | agne | su'matim | bhikṣamāṇāḥ | divi | śravaḥ | dadhire | yajñiyāsaḥ | naktāṃ | ca | cakruḥ | upasā | virūpe iti vi'rūpe | kṛṣṇam | ca | varṇam | aruṇam | ca | sam | dhuriti dhuḥ || 7 ||
he va agne va sumatiṃ śobhanāmanugrahātmikāṃ buddhiṃ va bhikṣamāṇāḥ yācamānāḥ va yajñiyāsaḥ yajñārhāḥ sarve devāḥ va divi dyotamāne va tve tvayi va śravaḥ havirlakṣaṇamannaṃ va dadhire asthāpayan |
' agnirdevānā- mannādaḥ ' ( tai. brā. 3.1.4.1. ) iti śruteḥ |
tadanantaraṃ tādṛśe haviryuktāyānuṣṭhānāya va virūpe vividharūpe va upasā upaḥkālopalakṣitamahaḥ |
va naktāṃ ca naktaṃ rātriṃ ca va cakruḥ akurvan |
va kṛṣṇaṃ ca va varṇaṃ rātryāṃ śyāmalavarṇamandhakāram ahni va aruṇam ārocanaṃ śvetavarṇaṃ tejaḥ va saṃ dhuḥ samyak sthāpitavantaḥ |

yātrāye martantsuṣūdo agne te syāma maghavāno vayaṃ ca | chāyāva viśvaṃ bhuvanaṃ sisakṣyāpaprivātoradasī antarikṣam || 8 || yān | rāye | martan | suṣūdaḥ | agne | te | syāma | magha'vānaḥ | vayam | ca | chāyā'iva | viśvam | bhuvanam | sisakṣi | āpapri'vān | rodasī iti | antarikṣam ||8||
'yān 'martān manuṣyānasmān 'rāye dhanāya 'suṣvadaḥ abhihotrādikarmasu prerayasi 'te tādṛśāḥ 'vayaṃ 'ca 'maghavānaḥ dhaninaḥ 'syāma bhavema |
'rodasī dyāvāpṛthivyau 'antarikṣaṃ ca 'āpaprivān svatejasā vṛṣṭyudakena vā 'āparitvāṃsaṃ ca 'viśvaṃ 'bhuvanaṃ sarvaṃ jagat 'sisakṣisa sevase anugṛhya sarvaṃ rakṣasītyarthaḥ |
yathā channādeḥ chāyā ātapādijanitaṃ kleśaṃ nivārya rakṣati tadvat |
' it ' ityanuvṛttau ' bahulaṃ chandasi ' iti abhyāsasya hrasva

priyāṇi bhavantu | te tava saṃbandhinaḥ sudhuraḥ suṣṭhu nirvāhakasya | yadvā | śobhanaṃ dhūrvati dāridryaṃ hinastīti sudhuḥ | tādṛśasya śayaḥ dhanasya yamaṃ niyamanaṃ kartuṃ śakema śaktā bhūyāsma | kiṃ kurvantaḥ | devabhaktaṃ devaiḥ saṃbhajanīyaṃ śravaḥ havilakṣaṇamannam adhi dadhānāḥ agnerapari dhārayantaḥ | agnī havirbhirhomaṃ kurvantaḥ ityarthaḥ || ucathāni | 'vaca paribhāṣaṇe' | 'ruvidibhyāṃ kit' (u.sū.3.395) iti vidhīyamānaḥ athapratyayaḥ kittvaṃ ca bahulavacanādasmādapi bhavati | vacyādinā saṃprasāraṇam | juṣṭāni | 'juṣṭapite ca chandasi, nityaṃ mantre' (pā. sū. 6.1. 209 - 210) ityāyudāttatvam | hade | 'padana' ityādinā hṛdayaśabdasya hadādeśaḥ | śakema | 'śak śaknau' | 'liṅyāśiṣyaṅ' | sudhuraḥ | dhurvī hiṃsārthaḥ | 'kvip ca' iti kvip | 'rālopaḥ' iti vakāralopaḥ | 'na pūjanāta' iti samāsāntapratiṣedhaḥ | devabhaktaṃ devabhaktam | 'tṛtīyā karmaṇi' iti pūrvapada- prakṛtisvaratvam || || 20 || || 12 ||
atrānu- kramyate- 'upaprayanto nava gotamo rāhagaṇo gāyatraṃ tu' iti |
prātaranuvākasyāgnaye kratau gāyatre chandasyetadādike dve sūkte |
sūtritaṃ ca- 'āpo revatīḥ kṣayathā hi vasva upaprayanta iti sūkte' (āśva. śrau. 4. 13 ) iti |
sūtritaṃ ca- 'upaprayanta iti tu prathame'hanyājyam' (āśva. śrau. 7. 10 ) iti ||
upaprayanto adhvaraṃ mantraṃ vocemāgnaye | āre asme ca śṛṇvate || 1 || upa'prayantaḥ | adhvaram | mantram | vocema | agnaye | āre | asme iti | ca | śṛṇvate ||1||
adhvaraṃ hiṃsāpratyayārahitamabhiṣṭomādiyajñam 'upaprayantaḥ' upetya prakaryeṇa yanto gacchantaḥ prāsya- vicchedena samyaganutiṣṭhantaḥ ityarthaḥ |
tādṛśā vayam 'agnaye' aṅganādiguṇayuktāya devāya 'mantraṃ manana- sādhanametatsaktarūpaṃ stotraṃ 'vocema' vaktāro bhūyāsmetyāśāsyate |
āre ca dūre'pi sthitasmākaṃ stutīḥ śṛṇvate |
asmāsu prītitiśayena sarvatra pravartamāno'bhirasmadīyameva stotraṃ śṛṇotīti bhāvaḥ ||
yaḥ snīhitīṣu pūryaḥ seṃjagmānāsu kṛṣṭiṣu | arakṣadāśuṣe gayam || 2 || yaḥ | snīhitīṣu | pūryaḥ | sam'jagmānāsu | kṛṣṭiṣu | arakṣat | dāśuṣe | gayam || 2 ||

yaḥ agniḥ 'snīhitīṣu vadhakāriṇīṣu 'kṛṣṭiṣu śatrubhūtāsu prajāsu 'saṃjagmā- nāsu saṃgatāsu satīṣu 'dāśuṣe havīṃṣi dattavate yajamānāya 'gayam dhanam 'arakṣat rakṣati tasmai mantraṃ vocemeti pūrveṇa saṃbandhaḥ ||

iti vadhakarmasu paṭhitaḥ | snehante hiṃsyante prajā ābhiriti snehilayaḥ | karaṇe kin | ‘titutretra- grahādīnāmiti vaktavyam’ (pā. ma. 7. 2. 9. 1) iti vacanāt nigṛhītitirnipaṭhitiritivat iḍāgamaḥ | vyatyayena ekārasya īkārādeśaḥ kino dīrghaśca | niccādāyudāttatvam | saṃjamānāsu | ‘samo gamyuccha0’ iti ātmanepadam | liṭaḥ kānac | ‘gamahana0’ ityādinā upadhālopaḥ | arakṣat | ‘chandasi luṅliṭaḥ’ iti vartamāne laṅ ||
‘prātarvaidhadevyām’ iti khaṇḍe sūtritaṃ- ‘śiṣṭenottarānumata bruvantu jantavaḥ’ (āśva. śrau. 2. 16) iti |
tathā sākamedheṣu marudbhyaḥ krīḍibhyaḥ puroḍāśam ityasyāmiṣṭau evaiṣa prathamājyāgānuvākyā |
sūtritaṃ ca- ‘marudbhyaḥ krīḍibhya uttarota bruvantu jantavaḥ’ (āśva. śrau. 2. 18) iti ||
uta | bruvantu | jantavaḥ | ut | agniḥ | vṛtra'hā | ajani | dhanam'jayaḥ | raṇe'raṇe || 3 ||
^uta anantaraṃ ^jantavaḥ jātāḥ sarve ṛtvijaḥ ^bruvantu tamagniṃ stuvantu |
^vṛtrahā vṛtrāṇāmāvarakāṇāṃ śatrūṇāṃ hantā ^raṇeraṇe sarveṣu saṃgrāmeṣu ^dhanaṃjayaḥ śatrudhanānāṃ jetā ||
yasya dūto asi kṣaye verṣi havyāni vītaye |
yasya | dūtaḥ | asi | kṣaye | verṣi | havyāni | vītaye | dasmata | kṛṇoṣi | adhvaram || 4 ||
he agne ^yasya yajamānasya ^kṣaye devayajanalakṣaṇe gṛhe devānāṃ ^dūtaḥ tvam ^asi bhavasi |
yasya ca ^havyāni carupuroḍāśādīni havīṃṣi ^vītaye devānāṃ bhakṣaṇāya ^verṣi gamayasi |
‘ghiniṛṇvyora ca’ iti upratyayaḥ; tatsaṃyogena vakā- rasya akāraḥ |
tasya ato lope sati sthānivadbhāvāt laghūpadhaguṇābhāvaḥ |
tam | it | su'havyam | aṅgiraḥ | su'devam | sahasaḥ | yaho iti | janāḥ | āhuḥ | su'barhiṣam ||5||
he ᵥsahaso ᵥyaho balasya putra ᵥaṅgiraḥ aṅgādiguṇayuktāgne yo yajamānaḥ pūrvamuktaḥ ᵥtamin tameva yajamānaṃ ᵥsuhavyaṃ śobhanahaviṣkaṃ ᵥsudevaṃ śobhanadaivataṃ ᵥsubarhiṣam |
śobhana- yajñaṃ ca ᵥjanāḥ sarve manuṣyāḥ ᵥāhuḥ kathayanti ||
‘ subāmantritte0 ’ iti parāṅgavadbhāvāt ṣaṣṭhyāmantritasamudāyasya ātmika- māmantritānudāttatvam ||
ā ᵥvahāsi tā~ iha devā~ upa ᵥpraśastaye | havyā suśandra vītayai || 6 || ā | ᵥca | vahāsi | tān | iha | devān | upa | ᵥpraśastaye | havyā | su'candra | vītayai ||6||
he ᵥsuśandra śobhanāhlādanāgne ᵥtān ᵥdevān ᵥiha asmin karmaṇi ᵥupa asmatsamīpaṃ ᵥpraśastaye stutaye ᵥā ᵥvahāsi ᵥca āvaha prāpaya ca |
āgatebhyastebhyaḥ ᵥhavyā havyāni carupuroḍāśādīni havīṃṣi ᵥvītaye bhakṣaṇāya prāpayetyarthaḥ ||
na ᵥyorupandiraśvyaḥ ᵥbhṛṇve rathasya kañcana | ᵥyadagre yāsi ᵥduryam || 7 || na | yoḥ | ᵥupandaḥ | ᵥaśvyaḥ | ᵥbhṛṇve | rathasya | kat | cana | yat | ᵥagre | yāsi | ᵥduryam ||7||

he ᵥagne ᵥyat yadā ᵥdūtayaṃ devānāṃ dūtatvaṃ ᵥyāsi prāpnopi ᵥkañcana kadācana tadānīṃ sarvadāpi ᵥyoḥ gacchatastava ᵥrathasya ᵥaśvyaḥ aśvairupapāditaḥ ᵥupandaḥ śravaṇārhaḥ śabdaḥ ᵥna ᵥbhṛṇve na śrūyate |
‘ yā prāpaṇe ’ ityasmāt ‘ yo dve ca ’ ( u. sū. 1. 21 ) iti auṇādikaḥ kupratyayaḥ |
tathā ca taittirīyāṇāṃ prātiśākhyaṃ ‘ saśabdamupandiramat ’ ( tai. prā. 23. 9 ) iti |
karmaṇi laṭi ‘ śruvaḥ śru ca ’ iti dhyasyayena śruḥ śrabhāvaśca |
ᵥtvotau ᵥvājahyo ᵥ'bhi ᵥpūrvasmādaparaḥ | pra ᵥdāśvā~ ᵥagne ᵥasthāt || 8 || tvā'ūtaḥ | ᵥvājī | ᵥahyaḥ | ᵥabhi | ᵥpūrvasmāt | ᵥaparaḥ | pra | ᵥdāśvān | ᵥagne | ᵥasthāt ||8||

yaḥ puruṣaḥ ᵥpūrvasmāt svasmādadhikārāt ᵥaparaḥ nikṛṣṭo bhavati ha ᵥagne sa idānīṃ ᵥdāśvān tubhyaṃ havīṃṣi dātā san ᵥtvotaḥ tvayā ūtaḥ rakṣitaḥ ᵥvājī annavān ᵥahyaḥ lajjārahitaḥ evaṃbhūtaḥ san ᵥabhi ᵥpra ᵥasthāt aiśvaryamabhiprāpya pratitiṣṭhati sarvotkṛṣṭo bhavatītyarthaḥ ||
uta ghumatsuvīryaṃ bṛhadagne vivāsasi | devebhyo deva dāśuṣe || 9 || uta | ghumat | suvīryam | bṛhat | agne | vivāsasi | devebhyaḥ | deva | dāśuṣe || 9 ||
'uta' api ca he 'deva' dyotamāna 'agne' 'devebhyaḥ' 'dāśuṣe' carupuroḍāśādīni havīṃṣi dattavate tasmai yajamānāya 'bṛhat' prauḍha dhanaṃ 'vivāsasi' gamayitumicchasi prāpayasīti yāvat |
juṣasva saprathastamaṃ vaco devapsarastamam | havyā juhvāna āsani || 1 || juṣasva | saprathaḥtamam | vacaḥ | devapsaraḥtamam | havyā | juhvānaḥ | āsani || 1 ||
he agne 'saprathastamam' atiśayena vistīrṇaṃ 'vacaḥ' stotralakṣaṇamasmadīyaṃ vacanaṃ 'juṣasva' sevasva |
imāni stotralakṣaṇāni havīṃṣi vṛthā mā bhūvan tatsarvaṃ tvadīyena mukhena svīkurvityarthaḥ ||
arthā te aṅgirastamāya vedhastama priyam | vocema brahma sānusi || 2 || arthā | te | aṅgiraḥtamam | agne | vedhaḥtamam | priyam | vocema | brahma | sānusi || 2 ||

he 'aṅgirastama' atiśayenāṅgirobhirguṇayukta | yadvā | aṅgirasāṃ variṣṭha | 'vedhastama' vedhā iti medhāvinām | atiśayena medhāvin 'agne' | atha anantaraṃ 'te' tubhyaṃ 'sānusi' saṃbhajanīyaṃ 'priyaṃ' prītikaraṃ 'brahma' stotraṃ 'vocema' vaktāro bhūyāsma || vocema | 'liḍaśāśipyaṅ' | 'vaca' 'um' iti umāgam | sānasi | 'vana' 'paṇa' 'saṃbhaktau' | 'sānasidharṇasi' ityādau asicapratyayānto nipātyate ||
kastai jāmirjanānāmagne ko dāśvadhvaraḥ | ko hu kasminnasi śritaḥ || 3 || kaḥ | te | jāmiḥ | janānām | agne | kaḥ | dāśuḥadhvaraḥ | kaḥ | hu | kasmin | asi | śritaḥ || 3 ||
‘ uṇādayo bahulam ’ (pā. sū. 3. 2. 1 ) iti bahulavacanāt karmaṇi uṇpratyayaḥ |
kā tu upetirmanaso varāya bhuvadagne śaṃtamā kā manīṣā |
ko vā yajñaiḥ pari dakṣaṃ ta āp kenaṃ vā te manasā dāśema ||
kā | te | upetiḥ | manasaḥ | varāya | bhuvat | agne | śam'tamā | kā | manīṣā | kaḥ | vā | yajñaiḥ | pari | dakṣam | te | āp | kena | vā | te | manasā | dāśema || 1 ||
he agne te tava manaso varāya nivāraṇāya asmāsvavasthāpanāya kā upetiḥ bhuvat kīdṛśamupagamanaṃ bhavet |
manīṣā stutiḥ śaṃtamā tavātiśayena sukhakarī kā kīdṛśī bhavet tavocitā stutirapi nāstītyarthaḥ |
ko vā yajamānaḥ yajñaiḥ tava saṃbandhibhiryāgaiḥ dakṣaṃ vṛddhiṃ balaṃ vā pari āpa paryāptomet |
tavocitān yāgānanuṣṭhāya taiḥ phalaṃ prāpyate ityetadapi durghaṭameveti bhāvaḥ |
upagamanādikaṃ tāvadāstāṃ tasya sarvasya sādhanabhūtaṃ mana evāsmākaṃ durlabhamityāha keneti |
he agne te tubhyaṃ kena manasā kīdṛśyā buddhyā dāśema havīṃṣi prayacchāma |
ehyiha hotā ni pīdādabdhaḥ su puraetā bhūvā naḥ |
arvatāṃ tvā rodasī viśvaminve yajā mahe saumanasāya devān ||
ā | ihi | agne | iha | hotā | ni | sīda | adabdhaḥ | su | puraḥ'etā | bhava | naḥ | arvatām | tvā | rodasī iti | viśvaminve iti viśvam'inve | yaja | mahe | saumanasāya | devān ||2||
iha asmin yajñe hotā devānāmāhvātā san ni pīda upaviśa |
naḥ asmākaṃ puraetā purato gantā su bhava suṣṭhu bhava |
tādṛśaṃ tvāṃ viśvaminve sarvaṃ vyāpavatyau rodasī dyāvāpṛthivyau tvā tvām arvatāṃ rakṣatāṃ |
āgatyopaviśya ca dyāvāpṛthivībhyāṃ rakṣitaśca san mahe mahate saumanasāya saumanasyāya devān dānādiguṇayuktān indrādīn yaja havirbhiḥ pūjaya ||
1. ṭa-ḍha- taiḥ' nāsti | 2. ta-da-dha-sa-upaviśa upaviśya; kṣa-upaviśa upaviśya ca | 3. ṭa-ḍha- aṇ | 4. ṭa-ḍha-sa ca samavāyalakṣaṇe |
pra su viśvātrakṣaso dharṣyagre bharvā yajñānāmabhiśastipāvā |
athā vaha somapatiṃ harimyāmātithyamasmai cakramā sudāne ||
pra | su | viśvān | rakṣasaḥ | dhakṣi | agne | bhava | yajñānām | abhiśasti'pāvā | atha | ā | vaha | soma'patim | hari'bhyām | ātithyam | asmai | cakramā | sudāne ||3||
dagdhvā ca 'yajñānām asmābhiranuṣṭheyānāṃ yāgānām 'abhiśastipāvā abhiśasterhiṃsāyāḥ pātā rakṣitā 'bhava |
'atha anantaraṃ 'somapatiṃ sarveṣāṃ somānāṃ pālakamindraṃ 'haribhyāṃ tadīyāśvābhyām 'ā 'vaha asmadyajñaṃ prāpaya |
āgatāya 'asmai 'sudāne śobhanasya phalasya dātre indrāya 'ātithyam atithyahaṃ satkāraṃ 'cakrama kurmaḥ ||
prajāvatā varcasā vahnirāsā ca huve ni ca satsīha devaiḥ |
verṣi hotramuta potraṃ yajatra bodhi prayantarjanitarvasūnām ||
prajā'vatā | varcasā | vahniḥ | āsā | ā | ca | huve | ni | ca | satsi | iha | devaiḥ | verṣi | hotram | uta | potram | yajatra | bodhi | pra'yantaḥ | janitaḥ | vasūnām || 4 ||
'prajāvatā yajamānebhyo dātavyāpthādiphalopetena 'vacasā stotreṇa sutaḥ san yo'gniḥ 'āsā āsthasthānīyayā jvālayā 'vahniḥ devebhyo haviṣāṃ voḍhā tamabhimam 'ā 'ca 'huve āhvayāmi |
āhūtaḥ san tvam 'iha asmin karmaṇi 'devaiḥ anyaiḥ saha 'ni 'satsi 'ca niṣīda ca |
niṣadya ca he 'yajatra yajanīyāgne 'hotraṃ hotrā kriyamāṇaṃ karma 'uta api ca 'potraṃ potrā kṛtaṃ karmaṃ ca 'verṣi kāma- yasva |
'vasūnāṃ dhanānāṃ 'prayantaḥ prakarṣeṇa niyantaḥ vasūnyasmadāyattāni kurvan 'janitaḥ āhutidvārā sarvasya janayitaragne 'bodhi asmān bodhaya ||
asmāt pyantāt ' chandasyubhayathā ' iti heḥ ārdhadhātukatvāt ' geraniṭī ' iti ṇilopaḥ |
ekādaśinasyāgneya paśoḥ ' yathā viprasya ' ityeṣā paśupuroḍāśasya yājyā |
sūtritaṃ ca ' pradānānām ' iti khaṇḍe - ' yathā viprasya manuṣo havirbhiḥ pra kāravo mananā vakṣyamāṇāḥ ' ( āśva. śrau. 3. 7 ) iti ||
yathā viprasya manuṣo havirbhirdevā~ ayaṃjaḥ kavirbhiḥ kaviḥ san |
evā hotaḥ satyatara tvamadyāgne mandrayā juhvā yajasva ||
yathā | viprasya | manuṣaḥ | havirbhiḥ | devān | ayaṃjaḥ | kavi'bhiḥ | kaviḥ | san | eva | hota riti | satya'tara | tvam | adya | agne | mandrayā | juhvā | yajasva || 5 ||

vkaviḥ krāntadarśā vsan vkavibhiḥ medhābhirvaisvabhiḥ saha vviprasya medhāvinaḥ vmanuṣaḥ manoryajñe vhavirbhiḥ cahapuroḍāśādibhiḥ he agne vyathā vdevān vayaṃjaḥ evameva vhotaḥ homaniṣpādaka vsatyatara atiśayena satsu sādho vagne vtvam vadya asmin yajñe vmandrayā harṣayitvā vjuhvā homasādhana- bhūtayā sucā vyajasva devān havirbhiḥ pūjaya ||
' kathā ' iti pañcacaṃ caturthaṃ sūktaṃ ṛjubhaṃ gotamasyārṣamāgneyam |
kathā dāśemāgne kāsmai devajuṣṭocyate bhāmine gīḥ |
yo martyeṣvamṛta ṛtāvā hotā yajiṣṭha itkṛṇoti devān ||
kathā | dāśema | agnaye | kā | asmai | deva'juṣṭā | ucyate | bhāmine | gīḥ | yaḥ | martyeṣu | amṛtaḥ | ṛta'vā | hotā | yajiṣṭhaḥ | it | kṛṇoti | devān || 1 ||
vasmai vagnaye vkathā vdāśema kathaṃ havīṃṣi dadāma |
athavā ' asmai vbhāmine tejasvane'gnaye vdevajuṣṭā sarvaiḥ devaiḥ sevitavyā vgīḥ vāk stutirapi vkā kīdṛśī vucyate |
tādṛśīṃ stutimapi kartuṃ na śaktā ityarthaḥ |

vamṛtaḥ maraṇarahitaḥ vṛtāvā ṛtavān satyavān yajñavān vā vhotā devānāmāhvātā homaniṣpādako vā vyajiṣṭhaḥ atiśayena yaṣṭā evaṃbhūtaḥ vyaḥ agniḥ vmartyeṣu maraṇadharmasu asmāsu vartamānaḥ san vdevān vit kṛṇoti havirbhiryuktānkarotyeva |
' thā hetau ca chandasi ' iti thāpratyayaḥ |
yo a̭dhva॒reṣu॒ śaṃta̭ma॒ ṛtā̭vā॒ hotā॒ tamu॒ namo̭bhi॒rā kṛ̭ṇudhvam |
a॒gnirya̭de॒mata̭ya॒ de॒vāntsa॒ ca॒ bodhā̭ti॒ mana̭sā॒ yajā̭ti ||
yaḥ | a॒dhva॒reṣṷ | śam'ta̭maḥ | ṛta̭'vā | hotā̭ | tam | ū~ iti̭ | nama̭ḥ'bhiḥ | ā | kṛ॒ṇu॒dhva॒m | a॒gniḥ | yat | veḥ | ma॒ta̭yaḥ | de॒vān | saḥ | ca॒ | bodhā̭ti | mana̭sā | yajā̭ti || 2 ||
'yaḥ agniḥ 'adhvareṣu yāgeṣu 'śaṃtamaḥ atiśayena sukhakārī 'ṛtāvā satyavān yathārthadarśī- tyarthaḥ |
he ṛtvijyamānā yūyaṃ 'tamu tamevāgniṃ 'namobhiḥ stotraiḥ 'ā 'kṛṇudhvam abhimukhīkuruta |
'yat yadā ayam 'agniḥ 'manāya manuṣyāya yajamānārthaṃ 'devān 'veḥ veti gacchati tadānīṃ 'saḥ abhyarcyān sarvān devān 'bodhāti 'ca jānāti ca |
jñātvā ca 'manasā namasā tān 'yajāti havirbhiḥ pūjayati |
'tiṅāṃ niḍo bhavanti ' iti prathamapuruṣaika- vacanasya madhyamapuruṣaikavacanādeśaḥ |
sa hi kratuḥ sa martyaḥ sa sādhurmitro na bhūdadbhutasya rathīḥ |
taṃ medheṣu prathamaṃ devayantīrviśa upa bruvate dasmamārīḥ ||
saḥ | hi | kratuḥ | saḥ | martyaḥ | saḥ | sādhuḥ | mitraḥ | na | bhūt | a॒dbhuta̭sya | rathīḥ | tam | me॒dheṣṷ | pra॒tha॒mam | de॒va॒'yantīḥ | vi॒śaḥ | upa̭ | bru॒va॒te | da॒smam | ā॒rīḥ || 3 ||
'saḥ eva 'martyaḥ mārayitā viśvasyopasaṃhartā 'sādhuḥ sādhayito'pādayitāpi 'saḥ eva 'adbhutasya abhūtasyādbhutasya dhanasya 'rathīḥ rahayitā prāpayitā 'bhūt bhavati |
evaṃbhūto yo'gniḥ 'tam eva 'medheṣu yajñeṣu 'devayantīḥ devayantyo devānātmana icchantyaḥ 'viśaḥ prajāḥ 'prathamam 'upa 'bruvate |
asmāt antarbhāvitaṇyarthāt 'chandasi niṣṭakye ' ityādau nipātanāt yat 'kṛtyalyuṭo bahulam ' iti bahulavacanāt kartari draṣṭavyaḥ |
sa no nṛṇāṃ nṛtamo ridādagmirgiro'vasā vetu dhītim |
tano ca ye maghavānaḥ śaviṣṭhā vājaprasūtā iṣayanta manma ||
saḥ | naḥ | nṛṇām | nṛtamaḥ | ridādaḥ | agniḥ | giraḥ | avasā | vetu | dhītim | tanā | ca | ye | maghavānaḥ | śaviṣṭhāḥ | vājaprasūtāḥ | iṣayanta | manma || 4 ||
nṛṇāṃ yajñasya netṝṇāṃ madhye nṛtamaḥ atiśayena netā ridādaḥ ridānāṃ śatrūṇāmattā bhakṣayitā |
evaṃvidhaḥ saḥ agniḥ naḥ asmākaṃ giraḥ stutīḥ avasā havirlakṣaṇenānnena yuktāṃ dhītiṃ karma ca vetu kāmayatām |
vistṛtena dhanena maghavānaḥ dhanavantaḥ śaviṣṭhāḥ atiśayena balinaśca santaḥ vājaprasūtāḥ prasūtaṃ preritaṃ vājo havirlakṣaṇamannaṃ yaistādṛśā bhūtvā manma abhremananara
pyantāt luhi śleṣaṇādi | joṣam | ' juṣī prītisevanayoḥ ' | bhāve ghañ | jittvādguṇābhāvam || || 25 ||
' abhi tvā ' iti pañcarcaṃ pañcamaṃ sūktaṃ gotamasyārvābhayeyaṃ gāyatram |
tathā cānukrāntam—' abhi tvā gāyatraṃ tu ' iti |
abhi tvā gotamā girā jātavedo vicarṣaṇe | ghumnairabhi pra ṇaunumaḥ || 1 || abhi | tvā | gotamāḥ | girā | jātavedaḥ | vi'carṣaṇe | ghumnaiḥ | abhi | pra | nonumaḥ ||1||
he 'jātavedaḥ jātānāṃ veditaḥ 'vicarṣaṇe viśeṣeṇa sarvasya draṣṭaḥ evaṃbhūtāgne 'tvā tvāṃ 'gotamāḥ asya sūktasya draṣṭā gotama ṛṣiḥ |
tamu tvā gotamo girā rāyaskāmo duvasyati | ghumnairabhi pra ṇaunumaḥ ||2|| tam | ū~ iti | tvā | gotamaḥ | girā | rāyaḥ'kāmaḥ | duvasyati | ghumnaiḥ | abhi | pra | nonumaḥ ||2||
'rāyaskāmaḥ dhanakāmaḥ 'gotamaḥ yamagniṃ 'girā stutyā 'duvasyati paricarati 'tamu tameva tvāṃ 'ghumnaiḥ dyotamānaiḥ stotrairābhimukhyena punaḥpunaḥ stumaḥ ||
' tatpuruṣe kṛti bahulam ' iti bahulavacanāt aluk |
' ataḥ kṛkamikaṃsa- kumbha ' (pā. sū. 8. 3. 46 ) iti visarjanīyasya satvam |
tamu tvā vājasātatamaṅgirasvaddhavāmahe | ghumnairabhi pra ṇaunumaḥ || 3 || tam | ū~ iti | tvā | vāja'sātatam | aṅgirasvat | havāmahe | ghumnaiḥ | abhi | pra | nonumaḥ ||3||
he agne 'vājasātataṃ vājānāmanrānāmatiśayena sanitāraṃ dātāraṃ tameva 'tvā tvām 'aṅgirasvat aṅgirasa iva 'havāmahe āhvayāmaḥ |
' namo'ṅgiromanuṣāṃ vatyupasaṃkhyānam ' (pā. sū. 1. 4. 18. 3) iti bhavena padatvā- bhāvāt rutvābhāvaḥ ||
tamu tvā vṛtrahantamaṃ yo dasyairavadhūnuṣe | ghumnairabhi pra ṇonumaḥ || 4 || tam | ū iti | tvā | vṛtrahantam | yaḥ | dasyan | avadhūnuṣe | ghumnaiḥ | abhi | pra | nonumaḥ || 4 ||

haṃ agne 'dasyan upakṣapayitṛn rākṣasādīn 'yaḥ 'tvam 'avadhūnuṣe avacālayasi sthānāt pracyā- vayasi 'vṛtrahantamaṃ vṛtrāṇāṃ pāpmanām'1 atiśayena hantāraṃ 'tamu 'tvā tameva tvāṃ ghumnairityādi pūrvavat |
padasaṃjñāyāṃ nalope 'nādasya' (pā. sū. 8. 2. 17) iti tampo nud |
'atrānunāsikaḥ pūrvasya tu vā ' iti ūkāraḥ sānunāsikaḥ |
avaucāma rahūgaṇā agnaye madhumadvarcaḥ | ghumnairabhi pra ṇonumaḥ || 5 || avaucāma | rahūgaṇāḥ | agnaye | madhumat | varcaḥ | ghumnaiḥ | abhi | pra | nonumaḥ || 5 ||
'rahūgaṇāḥ rahūgaṇasya putrā vayaṃ gotamāḥ 'agnaye aṅganādi- guṇayuktāya devāya 'madhumadvacaḥ mādhuyepitaṃ vacanam 'avaucāma prāvādima |
tadvacanarūpaiḥ2 'ghumnaiḥ dyotamānaiḥ stotraiḥ punaḥpunarabhi vayaṃ 'abhi 'pra 'ṇonumaḥ ābhimukhyena prakarṣeṇa stumaḥ |
atrānukramyate— 'hiraṇyakeśo dvādaśacau tṛcau traiṣṭubhau pūrvo'gnaye vā madhyamāya' iti |
pūrvatra 'gāyataṃ tu'3 ityu- ktvādidamapi gāyatraṃ sūktam |
prathama- tṛcasya madhyamasthāno vaidyuto'gniḥ śuddhāgnirvā devatā |
prātaranuvā- kasyāgnaye kratau traiṣṭubhe chandasyāśvinaśastre cādyastṛcaḥ |
sūtritaṃ ca—'hiraṇyakeśa iti tisro'pyasya mahata iti sūkte' (āśva. śrau. 4. 13) iti |
kārīryāmagnerdhāmacchado hiraṇyakeśa iti dve ṛcau yājyānuvākye |
sūtritaṃ ca—'hiraṇyakeśo rajaso visāra iti dve tvaṃ tvā cidacyutā dhāmante viśvaṃ bhuvanamadhi śritamiti vā' (āśva. śrau. 2. 13) iti |

hiraṇyakeśo rajaso visāre'hirnirvāteva dhrajīmān | śucibhrājā upaso narvedā yaśasvatīrapsuvo na satyāḥ || 1 || hiraṇyakeśaḥ | rajasaḥ | visāre | ahiḥ | dhuniḥ | vātaḥ'iva | dhrajīmān | śuci'bhrājāḥ | upasaḥ | narvedāḥ | yaśasvatīḥ | apsuvaḥ | na | satyāḥ || 1 ||

ᵛhiraṇyakeśaḥ hitaramaṇīyāḥ keśasthānīyā jvālā yasya sa tathoktaḥ suvarṇavadrocamānajvālo vā ᵛahiḥ āgatya hantā meghānāṃ ᵛvṛniḥ teṣāṃ kampayitā ᵛvātaiva vāyuriva ᵛbhrajīmān śīghragatiyuktaḥ evaṃbhūto vaidyuto'gniḥ ᵛrajasaḥ udakasya ᵛvisāre visaraṇe meghāṅgīmane nimittabhūte sati ᵛśucibhrājāḥ śobhanadīptiḥ san meghājalāni nirgamayituṃ jānāti |
meghādudakasya niḥsāraṇamabhiraiva jānāti upasastu na jānantītyarthaḥ |
ᵛyaśasvatīḥ anayuktā anavarayaḥ ᵛapasyuvaḥ apaḥ karma ātmana icchantyaḥ ᵛsatyāḥ avitathārambhāḥ ᵛna evaṃbhūtāḥ prajā iva |
atra upasāmajñānenābhiḥ praśasyate na tu tā nindante, ‘na hi nindā nindyaṃ nindituṃ api tu stutyaṃ stotum’ iti nyāyāt |

ā teṃ suparṇā aṃminantaṃ evaiḥ kṛṣṇo naunāva vṛṣabho yadīdam | śivābhinaṃ smaryamānābhirāgātpatanti mihaḥ stanayantyaā || 2 || ā | te | su'parṇāḥ | aminantaḥ | evaiḥ | kṛṣṇaḥ | naunāva | vṛṣabhaḥ | yadi | idam | śivābhiḥ | na | smaryamānābhiḥ | ā | agāt | patanti | mihaḥ | stanayanti | abhrā ||2||
he agne ᵛte tava ᵛsuparṇāḥ śobhanapatanā raśmayaḥ ᵛevaiḥ gantṛbhirmarudbhiḥ saha ᵛaminanta ᵛā samantāt meghaṃ hiṃsanti |
prahataśca ᵛkṛṣṇaḥ kṛṣṇavarṇaḥ ᵛvṛṣabhaḥ varṣitā meghaḥ ᵛnaunāva bhṛśaṃ śabdamakarot |

‘yadi yadā ᵛidaṃ īdṛśaṃ karma tadānīṃ ᵛśivābhinaṃ sukhakāriṇībhiḥ ᵛsmayamānābhiḥ hasanavatībhiḥ kāntābhiriva śubhravarṇābhiḥ phenayuktābhiridvidhubhirvā saha ᵛā ᵛagāt vaidyutābhiritaḥ parjanya āgacchati |
tadanantaraṃ ᵛmihaḥ āpaḥ ᵛpatanti divaḥ sakāśāt pravṛṣṭā bhavanti |
ᵛabhrā annāpyadbhiḥ pūrṇā meghāḥ ᵛstanayanti itastataḥ śabdaṃ kurvanti |
‘aṇo'pragṛhyasya’ (pā. sū. 8. 4. 57) iti vaikalpikamavasāne vidhīyamānamanunāsikatvaṃ vyatyayenātra saṃhitāyāmapi draṣṭavyam |
naiteryaḍlantāt liṭi ‘amantre’ (pā. sū. 3. 1. 35) iti niṣedhāt āmapratyayā- bhāvaḥ |

yadīmṛtasya paryasā piyāno naryabhūtasya pṛthivī rajiṣṭhaiḥ | aryamā mitro varuṇaḥ parijmā tvacaṃ pṛśnanyuparasya yonau || 3 || yat | īm | ṛtasya | paryasā | piyānaḥ | naryan | ṛtasya | pṛthubhiḥ | rajiṣṭhaiḥ | aryamā | mitraḥ | varuṇaḥ | parijmā | tvacam | pṛśnanti | uparasa | yonau || 3 ||

'yadīṃ yadāvamagniḥ 'ṛtasya udakasya 'payasā payovatsārabhūtena rasena 'piyānaḥ jagadāpyāyanaṃ kurvan āpyāyitaṃ ca jagat 'ṛtasya udakasya saṃbandhibhiḥ 'rajasaiḥ ṛjutamaiḥ 'pathabhiḥ mārgaiḥ snāna- pānādibhiḥ 'nayan prāpayan vartate tadānīm 'aryamā 'mitro 'varuṇaḥ ca 'pariṣmā parito gantā marudgaṇaśca 'uparasya meghasya 'yonau vṛṣṭyudakotpattisthāne 'tvacaṃ 'pṛñjanti vṛṣṭyudakasyācchādakaṃ pradeśaṃ svakīyairāyudhaiḥ saṃyojayanti udghāṭayantīti yāvat ||
ṛjuśabdāt ichani 'vibhāṣājarcchandasi' ( pā. sū. 6. 4. 162 ) iti ṛkā- sya ratvam |
prātaranuvākasyāgreye ṛtau auṣṇihe chandasyāśvinaśastre ca 'ame vājasya' ityādyāstisra ṛcaḥ |
sūtritaṃ ca-'ame vājasyeti tisraḥ puru tvā tvāmagne' ( āśva. śrau. 4. 13 ) iti ||
agne vājasya gomata īśānaḥ sahaso yaho |
agne | vājasya | go'mataḥ | īśānaḥ | sahasaḥ | yaho iti | asme iti | dhehi | jātavedaḥ | mahi | śravaḥ || 4 ||
he 'sahaso 'yaho balasya putra 'agne 'gomataḥ bahubhirgobhiryuktasya 'vājasya annasya 'īśānaḥ īśvarastvamasi |
ataḥ 'asme asmāsu he 'jātavedaḥ jātadhana jātānāṃ veditarvāme 'mahi prabhūtaṃ 'śravaḥ annaṃ 'dhehi sthāpaya ||
saḥ | idhānaḥ | vasuḥ | kaviḥ | agniḥ | īḻenyaḥ | girā | revat | asmabhyam | puru'anīka | dīdihi || 5 ||
'saḥ 'agniḥ 'idhānaḥ dīpanaśīlaḥ 'vasuḥ nivāsayitā sarveṣāṃ 'kaviḥ krāntadarśanī medhāvī vā 'girā stotrarūpayā vācā 'īḻenyaḥ stotavyo bhavati |
purabhirbahībhiranī- kasthānīyābhirjvālābhiryuktatvāme 'asmabhyaṃ 'revat dhanayuktamannaṃ yathā bhavati tathā 'dīdihi dīpyasva ||
'reśabdāt matupa udāttatvaṃ vaktavyam' ( kā. 6. 1. 176. 1 ) iti matupa udā- ttatvam |
kṣapaḥ | rājan | uta | tmanā | agne | vastauḥ | uta | uṣasaḥ | saḥ | tigmajambha | rakṣasaḥ | daha | prati || 6 ||
he ᵛrājan rājanaśīla ᵛagne ᵛkṣapaḥ kṣapaya |
ᵛuta api ca ᵛtmanā na kevalamanyaireva ātmanā ca tān bādhasva |
ᵛvastauḥ sarvāṇyahāni ᵛuta api ca ᵛuṣasaḥ uṣaḥkālopalakṣitā rātrīḥ |
he ᵛtigmajambha tīkṣṇamukhāgne ᵛrakṣasaḥ rākṣasānutprakrakāreṇa kṣapayitvā ᵛsaḥ eva tvaṃ ᵛprati ᵛdaha pratyekaṃ daha |
asya ca rakṣaḥśabdasya asipratyayāntvāt pratyaya- svara eva śiṣyate ||
prātaranuvākasyāgneye ṛtau gāyatre chandasi ‘avā no agne’ ityādyāḥ ṣaḍṛcaḥ |
sūtritaṃ ca- ‘avā no agna iti ṣaḍbhimīle'gniṃ dṛtam’ (āśva. śrau. 4. 13) iti ||
arva | naḥ | agne | ūtibhiḥ | gāyatrasya | pra'bharmaṇi | viśvāsu | dhīṣu | vandya || 7 ||

ᵛviśvāsu ᵛdhīṣu sarveṣu karmasu ᵛvandya stutya he ᵛagne ᵛgāyatrasya gāyatrasanno gāyatrīcchandaskasya sūktasya vā ᵛprabharmaṇi prabharaṇe saṃpādane nimittabhūte sati ᵛnaḥ asmān ᵛūtibhiḥ tvadīyaiḥ pālanaiḥ ᵛava rakṣa ||
ā nau agne rayiṃ bhara satrāsāhaṃ vareṇyam |
ā | naḥ | agne | rayim | bhara | satrā'sāham | vareṇyam | viśvāsu | pṛtsu | duṣṭaram || 8 ||
he ᵛagne ᵛrayiṃ dhanaṃ ᵛnaḥ asmabhyam ᵛā ᵛbhara prayaccha |
ᵛsatrāsāhaṃ satrā saha yugapadeva dāridryasya nāśakaṃ ᵛvareṇyaṃ sarvairvaivaraṇīyam ᵛviśvāsu ᵛpṛtsu sarveṣu saṃgrāmeṣu ᵛduṣṭaraṃ śatrubhistarītuma- śakyam ||
sūtritaṃ ca- ‘āyuṣkāmeṣṭyāṃ jīvātumantāvā no agne sucetanā’ (āśva. śrau. 2. 10) iti |
ā no̭ a॒gne su॒ceta̭nā ra॒yiṃ vi॒śvāyu॒poṣa̭sam | mā॒rḍīka̭ṃ dhehi jī॒vasḙ || 9 || ā | na̭ḥ | a॒gne | su॒'ceta̭nā | ra॒yim | vi॒śvāyṷ'poṣasam | mā॒rḍīka̭m | dhe॒hi | jī॒vasḙ ||9||

he agne naḥ asmākaṃ jīvase jīvanāya sucetanā śobhanena jñānena yuktaṃ rayiṃ dhanam ā dhehi āsthāpaya | kīdṛśam | mārḍīkam | mārḍīkaṃ sukham | taddhetubhūtam | viśvāyupoṣasaṃ sarvasminnāyuṣi dehādeḥ poṣakam | yāvajjīvamasmadupabhogaparyāptamityarthaḥ || sucetanā | ' citī saṃjñāne ' | auṇādikaḥ upratyayaḥ | ṛduttarapadaprakṛtisvaratvam | viśvāyupoṣasam | viśvamāyuryasmin śarīrādau tadviśvāyu | ' bahuvrīhau viśvaṃ saṃjñāyām ' iti pūrvapadantodāttatvam | tatpuṣṇātīti viśvāyupoṣaḥ | ' gatikārakayorapi pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaratvaṃ ca ' iti asun pratya
ᵛsahasrākṣaḥ asaṃkhyātajvālaḥ ᵛvicaraṇīḥ viśeṣeṇa sarvasya draṣṭā ayam ᵛagniḥ ᵛrakṣāṃsi ᵛsedhati pratiṣedhati |
sa cāmiḥ ᵛukthyaḥ ukthaiḥ śakrairasmābhiḥ stūyamānaḥ san ᵛhotā devānāmāhvātā bhūtvā ᵛgṛṇīte tān stauti ||
' bahuvrīhau savyakṣṇoḥ' iti ṣaṣ samā- sāntaḥ |
' itthā ' iti ṣoḍaśacaṃ saptamaṃ sūktaṃ gautamasyārṣamaindraṃ paṅkticchandaskam |
anukrāntaṃ ca- ' itthā ṣoḍaśandraṃ paṅkta hi ' |
hiśabdayogāt tuhādiparibhāṣayā idumuttare ca dve paṅkticchandaske |
sūtritaṃ ca- ' avitāsītthā hīndra piba tumyamiti marutvatīyam ' (āśva. śrau. 7. 12 ) iti |
' hotrakāṇām ' iti khaṇḍe sūtritam- ' itthā hi soma inmada ubhe yadindra rodasī ' ( āśva. śrau. 7. 4 ) iti |
mahāvrate niṣkevalyasya dakṣiṇapakṣe ' itthā hi ' ityekā |
tathaiva pañcamāraṇyake sūtritam- ' itthā hi soma inmada iti paṅktiḥ ' ( ai. ā. 5. 2. 2 ) iti ||
itthā hi somam inmadai brahmā cakāra vardhanam |
śarviṣṭha vajrinnojasā pṛthivyā niḥ śaśā ahim |
itthā | hi | somam | it | madai | brahmā | cakāra | vardhanam | śarviṣṭha | vajrin | ojasā | pṛthivyāḥ | niḥ | śaśāḥ | ahim | arcan | anu | svarājyam ||1||

he ᵛśaviṣṭha atiśayena balavan ᵛvajrin vajravannindra ᵛitthā ᵛhi itthameva anena śāstroktaprakāreṇaiva ᵛmade madakare harṣakare ᵛsome tvayā pīte sati ᵛbrahmā brāhmaṇaḥ stotā ᵛvardhanaṃ tava vṛddhikaraṃ stotraṃ ᵛcakāra anena sūktena kṛtavān |
atastvam ᵛojasā balena ᵛpṛthivyāḥ sakāśāt ᵛahim āgatya hantāraṃ vṛtraṃ ᵛniḥ ᵛśaśāḥ niḥśeṣaṇa aśāḥ |
mā bādhasveti śāsanaṃ kṛtvā pṛthivyāḥ sakāśāt nirāgamayaḥ ityarthaḥ |
ᵛsvarājyaṃ svasya rājyaṃ rājatvam ᵛanu anu- lakṣya ᵛarcan pūjayan svasya svāmitvaṃ prakaṭayannityarthaḥ ||
laṅi luki prāpte ' bahulaṃ chandasi ' iti śapaḥ bhluḥ |
tatra hi ' rājāse ' ( pā. sū. 5. 1. 128 ga. ) iti paṭhyate |
sa tvāmadad vṛṣaḥ madaḥ somaḥ śyenābhṛtaḥ sutaḥ |
yenā vṛtraṃ niradhayo jaghantha vajrinnojasā arcan anu svarājyam ||
saḥ | tvā | amadat | vṛṣā | madaḥ | somaḥ | śyena'ābhṛtaḥ | sutaḥ | yena | vṛtram | niḥ | adhayaḥ | jaghantha | vajrin | ojasā | arcan | anu | svarājyam ||2||
he indra ᵥtvā tvāṃ ᵥsaḥ ᵥsomaḥ ᵥamadat amadayat harṣaṃ prāpayat |
ᵥvṛpā secanasvabhāvaḥ ᵥmadaḥ madakaro harṣakārī ᵥśyenābhṛtaḥ śyenarūpamāpannayā pakṣyākārayā gāyatryā divaḥ sakāśādāhṛtaḥ ᵥsutaḥ abhiṣutaḥ |
he ᵥvajrin ᵥvajravannindra ᵥyena pītena somena ᵥojasā balakaraṇa ᵥaṅgaḥ antarikṣasakāśāt ᵥvṛtraṃ ᵥniḥ ᵥjaghantha hatavānasi |
asmān ṇici ' madī harṣelpanayoḥ ' iti ghaṭādiṣu pāṭhāt mittve sati 'mitāṃ hrasvaḥ' iti hrasvatvam |
laṅi 'chandasyubhayathā' iti śapa ārdhadhātukatvāt 'ṇeraniṭi' iti ṇilopaḥ |
predbhīhi dhṛṣṇuhi na te vajro ni yaṃsate |
indraṃ nṛmṇaṃ hi te śavo hanau vṛtraṃ jayā apo'rcarnu svarājyam ||
pra | ihi | abhi | ihi | dhṛṣṇuhi | na | te | vajraḥ | ni | yaṃsate | indraṃ | nṛmṇam | hi | te | śavaḥ | hanau | vṛtram | jayāḥ | apaḥ | arcan | anu | svarājyam ||3||

he ᵥindra ᵥprehi prakarṣeṇa gaccha | ᵥabhīhi | hantavyān śatrūnābhimukhyena prāpnuhi | prāpya ca ᵥdhṛṣṇuhi | tān śatrūnabhibhava | ᵥte tavaṃ ᵥvajraḥ ᵥna ᵥni ᵥyaṃsate śatrubhirna niyamyate apratihatagatirityarthaḥ | tathā ᵥte ᵥśavaḥ tvadīyaṃ balaṃ ᵥnṛmṇaṃ nṛṇāṃ puruṣāṇāṃ nāmakamabhibhāvakaṃ ᵥhi yasmādeva tasmān ᵥvṛtram asuraṃ meghaṃ vā ᵥhanaḥ jahi | tato'nantaraṃ 3 tena niruddhāḥ ᵥapaḥ udakauni ᵥjayāḥ jaya | vṛtraṃ haravā tenāvṛtamudakaṃ labhasvetyarthaḥ | anyat samānam || yaṃsate | yameḥ karmaṇi leṭi 'sibbahulam' iti sip | 'leṭo'ḍāṭau' iti aḍāgamaḥ | hanaḥ | loḍarthe chāndaso laṅ | 'bahulaṃ chandasi' iti śapo lugbhāvaḥ | śapaḥ pittvādanudāttatve dhātusvaraḥ śiṣyate | pūrvapadasyāsamānavākyasthatvāt nighātābhāvaḥ | jayāḥ | jayaterleṭi āḍāgamaḥ | pūrvavatsvaraḥ ||
nirindra bhūmyā adhi vṛtraṃ jaghantha nirdivaḥ |
sujā marutvatīriva jīvadhaṃnyā imā apo'rcarnu svarājyam ||
ni | indra | bhūmyāḥ | adhi | vṛtram | jaghantha | niḥ | divaḥ | suja | marutvatīḥ | iva | jīva'dhanyāḥ | imāḥ | apaḥ | arcan | anu | svarājyam ||4||
he ᵥindra ᵥbhūmyāḥ ᵥadhi bhūlokasyopari ᵥvṛtraṃ ᵥniḥ ᵥjaghantha niḥśeṣeṇa hatavānasi |
hatvā ca ᵥimāḥ ᵥapaḥ vṛṣṭyudakāni ᵥava ᵥsṛja adhaḥ pātaya |
1 maruvatīḥ marudbhiḥ saṃyuktāḥ jīvadhanyāḥ jīvāḥ prāṇino dhanyāstṛptā yābhistāḥ |

indro̭ vṛ॒trasya̭ do॒dhata̭ḥ sā॒nuṃ va॒jreṇa̭ hī॒lita̭ḥ | a॒bhi॒kra॒myārva̭ ji॒ghnate॒'paḥ sa॒rmāya̭ co॒daya̭n॒rcanṷ sva॒rājya̭m || 5 || indraḥ | vṛtrasya | dodhataḥ | sānum | vajreṇa | hīlitaḥ | abhi'kramya | ava | jighnate | apaḥ | sarmāya | codayan | arcan | anu | sva'rājyam ||5||
1 hīlitaḥ kuddhaḥ indraḥ 1 abhikramya ābhimukhyena garavā 1 dodhataḥ bhṛśaṃ kampamānasya 1 vṛtrasya 1 sānuṃ samucchritaṃ hanupradeśaṃ 1 vajreṇa 1 ava 1 jighnate praharati |

loṭi hau ‘ chandasi śāyajapi ’ ( pā. sū. 3. 1. 84 ) iti ā
he indra te tava svabhūtāḥ ete jantavaḥ yajamānalakṣaṇā janāḥ viśvaṃ sarvaṃ vārtha sarvaiḥ saṃbhajanīyaṃ haviḥ puṣyanti varṣayanti |
adāśuṣāṃ haviṣāmādatāṃ janānām antaḥ madhye vidya- mānaṃ vedaḥ dhanam arthyaḥ sarveṣāṃ svāmī tvaṃ syaḥ hi paśyasi hi jānāsītyarthaḥ |
teṣām ayaja- mānānāṃ vedaḥ dhanaṃ naḥ asmabhyam ā bhara āhara prayaccheti yāvat |
ayajamāneṣu vidyamānaṃ dhanaṃ yāgānuyuktatvāt vyarthameva bhavet |
atastasya dhanasya sārthakatāya tadīyaṃ dhanamapahṛtya yaja- mānebhyaḥ prayaccheti tātparyarthaḥ |
luṅadīnāmekatra vidhānena arthabhedābhāvāt ityanena prakāreṇāsmābhirdhātuvṛttāvayaṃ dhātumirākṛtaḥ |
pyantāt loṭi ' chandasyubhayathā ' iti śapa ārdhadhātukatvāt ' ṇeraniṭi ' iti ṇilopaḥ |

akṣanmīmadanta harva priyā adhūṣata | astoṣata svabhānavo viprā naviṣṭhayā matī yojā nvindra te harī || 2 || akṣan | amīmadanta | hi | ava | priyāḥ | adhūṣata | astoṣata | svabhānavaḥ | viprāḥ | naviṣṭhayā | matī | yoja | nu | indra | te | harī iti ||2||
he indra tvayā dattāni annāni 'akṣan yajamānā bhuktavantaḥ |
tadanantaraṃ 'svabhānavaḥ svāyattadīsayaḥ 'viprāḥ medhāvinaste 'naviṣṭhayā naviṣṭhatamayā 'matī mayā stutyā 'astoṣata astuvan |
adeluṃḍi ' luṅa- sanorghasu' ( pā. sū. 2. 4. 37 ) iti ghaslādeśaḥ |
yadvā ' chanda- syubhayathā ' iti sicaḥ sārvadhātukatvena ṅitvāt ' kriḍati ca ' iti pratiṣedhaḥ |
asmāt karmaṇi luṅi ' gāṅkuṭādibhyaḥ ' iti sico ṅitvāt guṇā- bhāvaḥ |
karaṇabhūtāyā api stuteḥ svavyāpāre kartṛtvāt tṛc |
sūtritaṃ ca—' āhavanīyaṃ susaṃdṛśaṃ tveti paṅktyā ' ( āśva. śrau. 2. 10 ) iti |

susaṃdṛśaṃ tvā vayaṃ maghavanvandiṣīmahi | pra nūnaṃ pūrṇavandhuraḥ stuto yāhi vaśā~ anu yojā nvindra te harī || 3 || susaṃdṛśam | tvā | vayam | maghavan | vandiṣīmahi | pra | nūnam | pūrṇavandhuraḥ | stutaḥ | yāhi | vaśān | anu | yoja | nu | indra | te | harī iti ||3||
he 'maghavan 'indra 'sumaheśaṃ suṣṭhu anugrahadṛṣṭyā sarvasya draṣṭāraṃ 'havā tvāṃ 'vayaṃ 'vandiṣīmahi stavīmahi' |
asmābhirvandibhiḥ 'stutaḥ tvaṃ 'pūrṇavanturaḥ snotubhyo deyairdhanaiḥ pūritena rathena yuktaḥ san 'vaśān kāmayamānān anyān yajamānānprati 'nūṃ 'pra 'yāhi avaśyaṃ pratiṣṭhasva |
'liḍāśiṣi' (pā. sū. 3. 4. 116) iti tasya ārdhadhātukatvena lasārvadhātukasvarābhāve pratyayādyudāttatvam |
maghavan ityasya 'āmantritaṃ pūrvamavidyamānavat' iti avidyamānavattve sati pādāditvāt nighātābhāvaḥ ||
sa ghā taṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ rathamadhi tiṣṭhāti govidam |
yaḥ pātraṃ hāriyojanaṃ pūrṇamindra ciketati yojā nvindra te harī ||
saḥ | gha | tam | vṛṣaṇam | ratham | adhi | tiṣṭhāti | go'vidam | yaḥ | pātram | hāri'yojanam | pūrṇam | indra | ciketati | yoja | nu | indra | te | harī iti ||4||
'sa 'gha sa khalvinrdaḥ 'vṛṣaṇaṃ kāmābhivarṣakaṃ 'govidaṃ gatrāṃ lambhayitāraṃ 'taṃ 'ratham 'adhi 'tiṣṭhāti īdṛśe rathe'dhritiṣṭhatu ārūḍho bhavatu |
he 'indra 'yaḥ rathaḥ 'hāriyojanam etatsaṃjakaṃ dhānā- miśritaṃ 'pūrṇaṃ somena pūrṇaṃ 'pātraṃ 'ciketati jñāpayati |
'bahulaṃ chandasīti vaktavyam' (kā. 7. 3. 87. 1) iti vacanāt 'nābhyastasyāci piti' iti laghūpadhaguṇapratiṣedho na bhavati ||
yuktaste astu dakṣiṇa uta savyaḥ śatakrato |
tena jāyāmupa priyāṃ mandāno yāhyandhaso yojā nvindra te harī ||
yuktaḥ | te | astu | dakṣiṇaḥ | uta | savyaḥ | śatakrato iti śata'krato | tena | jāyām | upa | priyām | mandānaḥ | yāhi | andhasaḥ | yoja | nu | indra | te | harī iti ||5||
anayottarayā ca pītasomendrasya svagṛhaṃ prati prasthānaṃ pratipādyate ||
‘adernum dhaśca’ (u. sū. 4.645 ) iti asun, dhātoḥ numāgamo dhakārāntādeśaśca |
sūtritaṃ ca—‘yunajima te brahmaṇā keśina harī iti yājyānuvākye anyeṣvahaḥsu’ (āśva. śrau. 6. 11 ) iti |

yunajima te brahmaṇā keśina harī upa pra yāhi dadhiṣe garbhastyoḥ | ucvā sutāso rabhasā amandiṣuḥ pūṣaṇvāntrvajintasamu patnyāmadaḥ || 6 || yunajima | te | brahmaṇā | keśina | harī iti | upa | pra | yāhi | dadhiṣe | garbhastyoḥ | ut | tvā | sutāsaḥ | rabhasāḥ | amandiṣuḥ | pūṣaṇvān | vajrin | sam | ū~ iti | patnyā | amadaḥ || 6 ||
he indra keśina keśayuktau śikhāvantau te tvadīyāvaśvau
he indra yaḥ martyaḥ manuṣyaḥ tavotibhiḥ tvadīyaiḥ rakṣaṇeḥ suprāvīḥ suṣṭhu prakṣito bhavati sa martyaḥ aśvāvati bahubhiraśvairyukte gṛhe vartamānaḥ goṣu prāptavyeṣu prathamaḥ gacchati |
tvaṃ tamit tameva puruṣaṃ bhavīyasā bahuterena bhavitṛtamena vā śatasahasrādisaṃkhyāyuktena vasunā dhanena pṛṇakṣi saṃpṛktaṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ karopi |
vicetasaḥ viśiṣṭajñānahetubhūtāḥ āpaḥ yathā abhitaḥ sarvāṃsu dikṣu mintuṃ samudraṃ pūrayanti tadvat |
bahuśabdāt īyasuni 'bahorlopo bhū ca bahoḥ' iti bahuśabdasya bhūbhāvaḥ īyasunaḥ īkāralopaśca |
atra tu chāndasatvāt īkāralopo na kriyate bhūbhāvaśca kriyate |
apanontrīye hotṛcamase'ṅgiraḥ pūryamāṇe 'āpo na devīḥ' ityetānuvaktavyā |
sūtritaṃ ca—'āpo na devīrupa yanti hotriyamiti samāptya' (āśva. śrau. 5. 1) iti |
brāhmaṇaṃ ca bhavati—'āpo na devīrupa yanti hotriyamiti hotṛcamase samavanīyamānāsvanyāha' (ai. brā. 2. 20) iti |
āpo na devīrupa yanti hotriyam paśyanti vitataṃ yathā rajaḥ |
prācairdevāsaḥ pra ṇayanti devayuṃ brahmapriyaṃ joṣayante varā'iva |
āpaḥ | na | devīḥ | upa | yanti | hotriyam | avaḥ | paśyanti | viḍatatam | yathā | rajaḥ | prācaiḥ | devāsaḥ | pra | nayanti | deva'yum | brahma'priyam | joṣayante | varāḥ'iva || 2 ||
hotriyaṃ hotṛḥ svabhūtaṃ camasaṃ devīḥ devyo dyotamānāḥ āpo na yathā āpaḥ upa yanti upagacchanti tadvadupari vartamānā devā etameva camasaṃ avaḥ avastāt paśyanti |
hotṛcamase asmākaṃ somābhipavāya āpaḥ pūrita iti teṣāṃ dṛṣṭirapyasmin saṃlagnābhūta |
vitataṃ vistīrṇaṃ rajaḥ jyotiḥ sūryasaṃbandhi yathā nirantaramavastāt patati tadvat |
devayuṃ devān kāmayamānametaṃ camasaṃ prācaiḥ prācīnaṃ yadvā prāñcaiḥ pragamanaiḥ uttaravedyabhimukhaṃ homakāle pra ṇayanti |
homārthaṃ praṇītaṃ brahmapriyaṃ brahmaṇā somalakṣaṇena svena saṃsṛptaṃ pūritamityarthaḥ |
yathā varā mameyaṃ bhaviṣyati mameyaṃ bhaviṣyatīti kanyakāṃ sevante evaṃ devā api mamāyaṃ somo mamāyaṃ soma ityasya pārśve vartante ityarthaḥ |
yadā tu rātriparyāye'syā viniyogaḥ tadā 'tvevaṃ' vyākhyeyam |
he indra devya āpo yathā nimnadeśamupagacchanti evaṃ devāsrtvadīyaṃ stotraṃ śṛṇvamāṇāḥ hotriyaṃ hotṛmyandhi dhilyasthānamupagacchanti |
upagatya ca avastāt paśyanti vitataṃ jyotiriva |
devayuṃ devānātman icchantametaṃ śaṃsitāramāgatāḥ sarve devāḥ prācīnaṃ pra ṇayanti amrato dhārayanti |
brahmapriyaṃ stotrapriyaṃ tvaṃ śaṃsantaṃ varāḥ kanyakā iva sevante |
1. kṣa-ṭa-ḍha-sa-prābhyaṃṣu paśuṣu | 2. ca-cha-ta-da-na-pha-śa--'garvati' nāsti | 3. kṣa-homārdham | 4. kṣa-taṃdevam | 5. kṣa-vitataṃ vitatam | 6. kṣa-na-sa-icchantamenam |
ādaṅgirāḥ prathamaṃ dadhire vaya iddhāmayaḥ śamyā ye sukṛtyā |
sarve paṇeḥ samavindanta bhojanamaśvāvantaṃ gomantamā paśuṃ naraḥ ||
bhāt | aṅgirāḥ | prathamam | dadhire | vayaḥ | iddha'agnayaḥ | śamyā | ye | su'kṛtyā | sarvam | paṇeḥ | sam | avindanta | bhojanam | aśva'vantam | go'mantam | ā | paśum | naraḥ ||4||
yadā paṇibhirgāvo'pahatāstadānīm 'aṅgirāḥ aṅgirasaḥ 'prathamaṃ pūrvamagnataḥ 'vayaḥ havirlakṣaṇamannaṃ 'dadhire indrārthaṃ saṃpāditavantaḥ |
'āt anantaraṃ tādṛśāḥ 'ye aṅgirasaḥ 'iddhāmayaḥ prajvalitābhiyuktāḥ santaḥ 'sukṛtyā śobhanakaraṇopetayā 'śamyā karmaṇā śobhanena yāgenendramayajakṣiti śeṣaḥ |
te 'naraḥ yajñasya netāro'ṅgirasaḥ 'paṇeḥ etannāmno'surasya saṃbandhiva 'sarvaṃ 'bhojanaṃ dhanaṃ 'samavindanta samalabhanta |
śobhanaṃ kṛtyaṃ karaṇaṃ yasyāṃ sā tathoktā |
yajñairatharvā prathamaḥ pathastate tataḥ sūryo vratapā vena ājani |
ā gā ājaduśanā kāvyaḥ sacā yamasya jñātamamṛtaṃ yajāmahe ||
yajñaiḥ | atharvā | prathamaḥ | pathaḥ | tate | tataḥ | sūryaḥ | vrata'pāḥ | venaḥ | ā | ajani | ā | gāḥ | ājat | uśanā | kāvyaḥ | sacā | yamasya | jñātam | amṛtam | yajāmahe ||5||
paṇibhirapahatāsu goṣu 'atharvā etatsaṃjaḥ ṛṣiḥ 'yajñaiḥ indradevasyairanuṣṭhitayajñaiḥ 'pathaḥ gosaṃbandhino mārgān 'prathamaḥ 'tate tanute |
'tataḥ tadanantaraṃ 'vratapāḥ vratānāṃ karmaṇāṃ pālayitā 'venaḥ kāntaḥ 'sūryaḥ sūryarūpa indraḥ 'ā 'ajani gavāṃ pradarśanāya āvirabhūt |
tādṛśasyendrasya 'kāvyaḥ kaveḥ putraḥ 'uśanā bhṛguḥ 'sacā asuranirasanāya sahāyo'bhūt |
'yamasya asurāṇāṃ niyamanārthaṃ 'jātaṃ prādurbhūtam 'amṛtaṃ maraṇarahitaṃ tamindraṃ 'yajāmahe havirbhiḥ pūjayāmaḥ ||
'dīpanabudha ' ( pā. sū. 3. 1. 61 ) ityādinā kartari luṅi caleḥ ciṇ |

barhirvā yatsvapatyārya vṛjyate'rko vā ślokamāghoṣate divi | grāvā yatra vadati kārurukthyastasyedindrau abhipitveṣu raṇyati || 6 || barhiḥ | vā | yat | su'apatyārya | vṛjyate | arkaḥ | vā | ślokam | ā'ghoṣate | divi | grāvā | yatra | vadati | kāruḥ | ukthyaḥ | tasya | it | indraḥ | abhipitveṣu | raṇyati ||6||

vsvapatyāya śobhanāpanahetubhūtāya karmaṇe vbarhirvā vyat yadā vvṛjyate chidyate adhvaryuṇā yāgārthamāhriyate varko vā stotraniṣpādako hotā vā vślokaṃ stutirūpāṃ vācaṃ vdivi dyotamāne yajñe yadā vāghoṣate uccārayati |
vyatra yasmin kāle vgrāvā abhipavārthaṃ pravṛttaḥ upalaḥ vvadati śabdaṃ karoti |
ukthasya śaṃsasya śaṃsitā kāruḥ yathābhi- mataśabdaṃ karoti tadvat |
vtasya pūrvoktasya sarvasya vabhipitveṣu abhiprāptiṣu vindraḥ vraṇyati ramate |
pūrvoktānāṃ barhirādīnāmabhiprāptiṣu satīndro raṇyati asmadīyo yāgo bhaviṣyatīti harṣaśabdaṃ karoti ||
adupadeśāt lasāvadhātukānudāttatve yaka eva svaraḥ śiṣyate |
atrānukramyate—‘asāvi viṃśatiḥ palanuṣṭubha auṣṇihāpaṅktagāyatryaṣṭubhāstṛcāḥ : pragāthaḥ ’ iti |
sūtritaṃ ca—‘atha ṣoḍa- yasāvi’ soma indra ta iti stotriyānurūpau ’ ( āśva. śrau. 6. 2 ) iti |
‘ehū ṣu ’ iti khaṇḍe sūtritam- ‘asāvi soma indra ta imamindra sutaṃ piba ’ ( āśva. śrau. 7. 8 ) iti ||

asāvi soma indra te śaviṣṭha dhṛṣṇavā gahi | ā tvā pṛṇaktvindriyaṃ rajaḥ sūryo na raśmibhiḥ || 1 || asāvi | somaḥ | indra | te | śaviṣṭha | dhṛṣṇo | iti | ā | gahi | ā | tvā | pṛṇaktu | indriyam | rajaḥ | sūryaḥ | na | raśmibhiḥ || 1 ||
he vindra vte svadatha vsomaḥ vasāvi abhiputo'bhūt |
he vśaviṣṭha atiśayena balavan ata eva vdhṛṣṇo śatrūṇāṃ dharṣayitarindra vā vgahi devayajanadeśamāgaccha |
āgataṃ ca tvām vindriyaṃ somapāne- notpannaṃ sāmarthyam vā vpṛṇaktu āpūrayatu |
vrajaḥ antarikṣaṃ vraśmibhiḥ kiraṇaiḥ vsūryo vna |

yathā sūryaḥ pūrayati tadvat || śaviṣṭha | śavasvindrādāt iṣṭani ‘ vinmatorluk ’ | ‘ ṭeḥ ’ iti ṭilopaḥ | pādāditvāt nighātābhāvaḥ | gahi | gameloṃṭ ‘ bahulaṃ chandasi ’ iti śapo luk | ‘ anudāttopadeśa ’ ityādinā anunāsikalopaḥ | tasya ‘ asiddhavadatrā bhāt ’ iti asiddhavattvāt heḥ lugabhāvaḥ ||
ṛṣīṇāṃ ca stutīrupa yajñaṃ ca mānuṣāṇām ||
indram | it | harī iti | vahataḥ | apratidhṛṣṭa'śavasam |
ṛṣīṇām | ca | stutīḥ | upa | yajñam | ca | mānuṣāṇām || 2 ||

ā tiṣṭha vṛtrahan rathaṃ yuktā te brahmaṇā harī |
arvācīnaṃ su te mano grāvā kṛṇotu vṛdhanā ||

arvācīnam | su | te | manaḥ | grāvā | kṛṇotu | vṛdhanā || 3 ||
