‘ vacergaśca ’ ( u. sū. 3. 313 ) iti nupratyayo gakārāntādeśaḥ ||
imam | indra | sutam | piba | jyeṣṭham | amartyam | madam |
śukrasya | tvā | abhi | akṣaran | dhārāḥ | ṛtasya | sādane || 4 ||
1. śa-asiddhatvāt | 2. sa- ‘ anyeṣāṃ manuṣyāṇām ’ nāsti | 3. kṣa- ‘ ca ’ nāsti | 4. kṣa-tam |
he ᵛindra ᵛsutam abhiputam ᵛimaṃ somaṃ ᵛpiba |
ᵛjyeṣṭham atiśayena praśastaṃ ᵛmadaṃ madakaraṃ ᵛamartyam amārakam |
tathā ᵛṛtasya yajñasya saṃbandhin ᵛsadane gṛhe vartamānāḥ ᵛśuklasya dīptasyāsya somasya ᵛdhārāḥ tvām ᵛabhyakṣaran ābhimukhyena saṃcalanti tvāṃ prāpnuvanti ᵛsvayamevāgacchantītyarthaḥ |
praśastaśabdāt iṣṭhani ‘jya ca’ ( pā. sū. 5. 3. 61 ) iti jyādeśaḥ |
indāya nūnamarcatokthāni ca bravītana | sutā amatsurindavo jyeṣṭhaṃ namasyatā sahaḥ || 5 ||
indāya | nūnam | arcata | ukthāni | ca | bravītana | sutāḥ | amatsuḥ | indavaḥ | jyeṣṭham | namasyata | sahaḥ || 5 ||
he ṛtvijaḥ ᵛindāya ᵛnūnaṃ kṣipram ᵛarcata pūjanaṃ kuruta |
ᵛukthāni apragītamantrasādhyāni stotrāṇi ᵛca ᵛbravītana brūta |
ᵛsutāḥ abhiputāḥ ᵛindavaḥ somāḥ ca ᵛamatsuḥ āgatamenamindraṃ mattaṃ kurvantu |
anantaraṃ ᵛjyeṣṭhaṃ praśastatamaṃ ᵛsahaḥ sahasvinaṃ balavantaṃ tamindraṃ ᵛnamasyata namaskuruta |
‘lugakārekārarephāśca vaktavyāḥ’ ( pā. sū. 4. 4. 128. 2 ) iti mattvarthīyasya luk |
nakiṣṭradhvītaro harī yadindra yacchase | nakiṣṭānu mujmanā nakiḥ svaśva ānaśe || 6 ||
nakiḥ | tvat | rathiḍataraḥ | harī iti | yat | indra | yacchase | nakiḥ | tvā | anu | mujmanā | nakiḥ | su'aśvaḥ | ānaśe || 6 ||
he ᵛindra ᵛyat yasmāt tvaṃ ᵛharī etatsañjñāvaśvau ᵛyacchase rathe yojayasi tasmāt tvatto'nyaḥ kaścit ᵛrathītaraḥ atiśayena rathavān ᵛnakiḥ nāsti |
ᵛsvaśvaḥ śobhanāśvo'nyaśca tvāṃ ᵛnakiḥ ᵛānaśe na prāpa |
indrasya balādhayorasādhāraṇatvādindrasadṛśo balavānvāne loke kaścidapi nāstītyarthaḥ |
ābhiplāvikepukthyeṣu tṛtīyasavane brāhmaṇācchaṃsinaḥ 'ya eka iddhiyate' itivaikalpikaḥ stotriya- stṛcaḥ |
'eba pu' iti khaṇḍe sūtritam-'sakhāya āśiṣāmahi ya eka iddhiyate' (āśva. śrau. 7. 8) iti |
tathaiva pañcamāraṇyake sūyate-'ya eka iddhiyatana ā yāhyadribhiḥ sutam' (ai. ā. 5. 2. 5) iti ||
ya eka iddhiyate vasu martyāya dāśuṣe |
yaḥ | ekaḥ | it | viḍadyate | vasu | martyāya | dāśuṣe | īśānaḥ | apratiṣkutaḥ | indraḥ | aṅga ||7||

yaḥ | indraḥ | ekaḥ | it eka eva | dāśuṣe havirdattavate | martyāya manuṣyāya yajamānāya vasu dhanaṃ vidayate diśeṣaṇa dadāti | aṅga iti kṣipranāma | apratiṣkutaḥ parairapratiśabditaḥ pratikūlaśabdarahita ityarthaḥ | evaṃbhūtaḥ saḥ indraḥ kṣipram īśānaḥ sarvasya jagataḥ svāmī bhavati || vidyate | 'daya dānagatirakṣaṇahiṃsādāneṣu' | śapaḥ pittvāt anudāttatvam | tiṅaśca lasārvadhātukasvareṇa dhātusvaraḥ eva śiṣyate | yadvṛttayogādanighātaḥ | apratiṣkutaḥ | 'ku śabde' | pratikalaṃ kyate śabdyate iti pratiṣkutaḥ | pāraskarāderākṛtigaṇatvāt muṭ | supāmāditvāt paradham | nanmamāse avyayapūrva- padaprakṛtisvaratvam ||
kadā naḥ śṛśravad gira indro aṅga ||
kadā | martma | arādhasam | padā | kṣumpamiva | sphurat | kadā | naḥ | śṛśravat | giraḥ | indraḥ | aṅga || 8 ||
evaṃvidhaṃ martyaṃ manuṣyam indraḥ padā pādena kṣumpamiva ahicchatrakamiva kadā sphurat sphuriyati vadhiṣyati |
yathā ahicchatraṃ maṇḍalākāreṇa śayānaṃ kaścinnāyāsane hanti evamindro'pi kadā asmacchatrūn haniṣyatītyarthaḥ |
naḥ asmākaṃ yaṣṭṛṇāṃ giraḥ stutilakṣaṇā vācaḥ indraḥ kadā kasminkāle aṅga śīghraṃ śṛśravat śroṣyatīti vitarkyate |

yaściddhi tvā bahubhya ā sutāvā~ āvivāsati| ugraṃ tarpatyate śava indro aṅga||9|| yaḥ | cit | hi | tvā | bahu'bhyaḥ | ā | suta'vān | ā'vivāsati | ugram | tat | patyate | śarvaḥ | indraḥ | aṅga || 9 ||
bahubhyaḥ manubhyebhyaḥ sakāśāt yaściddhi ya eva khalu yajamānaḥ sutāvān abhiṣutasomayuktaḥ san he indra tvā tvām āvivāmati paricarati|
tat tasmai yajamānāya yat ugram udghūrṇa śavaḥ balam indraḥ aṅga kṣipraṃ patyate pātayati prāpayati ||
cāturviṃśike'hani mādhyaṃdine’ savane’ acchāvākasya ‘svādoritthā viṣuvataḥ ’ iti vaikalpikaḥ stotriyastṛcaḥ |
‘hotrāṇām’ iti khaṇḍe sūtritam- ‘yaḥ sannāhā vicarṣaṇiḥ svādoritthā viṣuvataḥ ’ (āśva. śrau. 7. 4.) iti|
‘stome vardhamāne’ iti khaṇḍe sūtritam- ‘svādoritthā viṣuvata upa no haribhiḥ sutam ’ (āśva. śrau. 7. 12) iti||
yā indreṇa mayāverīvṛṣṇā madanti śobhase vasvīranu svarājyām ||
svādoḥ | itthā | viṣuvataḥ | madhvaḥ | pivanti | gauryaḥ | | yāḥ | indreṇa | sa'yāvarīḥ | vṛṣṇā | madanti | śobhase | vasvīḥ | anu | sva'rājyam ||10||
svādoḥ svādubhūtasya rasayuktasya itthā viṣuvataḥ itthamanena prakāreṇa sarvayajñeṣu vyāptiyuktasya madhvaḥ madhurarasasya somasya |
evaṃvidhaṃ somaṃ gauryaḥ gauravarṇa gāvaḥ pivanti yāḥ gāvaḥ śobhase śobhāthaṃ vṛṣṇā kāmābhivarṣakeṇa indreṇa sayāvarīḥ saha yānyo gacchantyaḥ sasyaḥ madanti hṛṣṭā bhavanti |
vasvīḥ payaḥpradānena nivāsakāriṇyastā gāvaḥ svarājyaṃ svasya svakīyasyendrasya yadrājyaṃ rājatvaṃ tadanulakṣyāvasthitā iti śeṣaḥ ||
‘jasādiṣu chandasi vāvacanam’ iti ‘gherḍiti’ iti guṇābhāve yaṇādeśaḥ |
jasi yaṇādeśe ‘udāttasvarita- yoryaṇaḥ’ iti parasyānudāttasya svaritatvam |
'voto guṇavacanāt' ityatra 'guṇavacanāt ṅībādyudāttārtham' (kā. 4. 1. 44. 1) iti vacanāt ṅamuśabdāt ṅīpi yaṇādeśa: |
tā asya pṛśanāyuva: somaṃ śrīṇanti pṛśraya: |
priyā indrasya dhenavo vajraṃ hinvanti sāyakaṃ vasvīranu svarājyam ||
tā: | asya | pṛśana'yuva: | somam | śrīṇanti | pṛśraya: | priyā: | indrasya | dhenava: | vajram | hinvanti | sāyakam | vasvī: | anu | sva'rājyam || 11 ||
vtā: pūrvoktā: vasya indrasya vpṛśanāyuva: sparśanakāmā: vpṛśraya: nānāvarṇā gāva: indreṇa pātavyaṃ vsomaṃ payasā vśrīṇanti miśrīkurvanti |
indro dadhīco asthabhirvṛtrāṇyapratiṣkutaḥ | jaghāna navatīrnava || 13 || indraḥ | dadhīcaḥ | asthabhiḥ | vṛtrāṇi | apratiṣkutaḥ | jaghāna | navatīḥ | nava ||13||
atra śāṭyāyanina itihāsamācakṣate- 'ātharvaṇasya dadhīco jīvato darśanenāsurāḥ parābabhūvuḥ |
agrendraḥ tairasuraiḥ saha yāṃyudhamaśaknuvastamṛpimanvicchan svargaṃ gata iti śruśrāva |
atha papraccha tatratyān neha kimasya kiṃcitpariśiṣṭamaṅgamastīti |
tasmā avo- can asyaitadādaśa śīrṣaṃ yena śirasādhibhyāṃ madhuvidyāṃ prābravīt |
śaryaṇāvad vai nāma kuru- kṣetrasya javanādhaṃ saraḥ syandate |

'apratiṣkutaḥ paraira- pratiśabditaḥ pratikūlaśabdarahitaḥ 'indraḥ ātharvaṇasya 'dadhīcaḥ etatsaṃjñakasya ṛṣeḥ 'asthabhiḥ aśva- śiraḥsambandhibhirasthibhiḥ 'navatīrnava navasaṃkhyākā navatīścottaraaṣṭaśatasaṃkhyākāḥ |
loka- trayavartino devāñjetumādāvāsurī māyā tridhā saṃpadyate |
trividhā' atītānāgatavartamānakālabhedena tatkālavartino devāñjetuṃ punarapi pratyekaṃ triguṇitā bhavati |
punarapyutsāhādiśaktitraya- rūpeṇa traiguṇye sati saptaviṃśatiḥ saṃpadyate |
evaṃ caturbhistraiguṇitamāyāyā daśasu dikṣu pratyeka mavasthāna sati nava navatayaḥ saṃpa- dyante |
patyeka- vacane 'acaḥ' iti akāralope 'cau' iti dīrghatvam |

udāttanivṛttisvareṇa viśvamyudāttatve prāpte tadapavādatayā 'cau' iti pūrvapadasya antodāttatvaṃ prāptam 'agneśchandasyasarvanāmasthānam' (pā. sū. 6. 1. 170) iti punarvibhaktyudāttatvavidhānena tadbādhyate |
'chandasyapi dṛśyate' (pā. sū. 7. 1. 76) iti anajādāvapi asthiśabdasya anaḍādeśaḥ sa codāttaḥ ||
icchannaśvasya yacchiraḥ parvateṣvapaśritam | tadvidaccharyaṇāvati || 14 || icchan | aśvasya | yat | śiraḥ | parvateṣu | apaśritam | tat | vidat | śaryaṇāvati ||14||
'parvateṣu parvavastu giriṣu 'apaśritam apagatya sthitam 'aśvasya aśvasambandhi dadhīcaḥ 'yacchiraḥ 'icchan indro vartate 'śaryaṇāvati etatsaṃjñe 'sarasi 'tat śiraḥ 'vidat ajñāsīt |
jñātvā tadāhṛtya tadīyairasthibhirvṛtrāṇi jaghānati pūrvasyāmṛci sambandhaḥ ||
madhvādiṣu śaryaṇaśabdasya pāṭhāt 'madhvādibhyaśca' (pā. sū. 4. 2. 86) iti cātu- rarthiko matup |
1. kṣa-ṭa-ḍha-trividhā sā | 2. kṣa-saṃpadyante | 3. kṣa-na-saṃpadyante | 4. kṣa-saṃpadyante | 5. kṣa-sa-etatsaṃjñake |
atimūrtenāntyekāhaṃ kartavye pūrvamevaikaṃ māsaṃ mauryāṃ cāndramasībhyāmiṣṭibhyāṃ yaṣṭavyam |
‘ atimūrtenā ’ iti khaṇḍe sūtritam— ‘ atrāha goramanvat navonavo bhavati jāyamānaḥ ’ ( āśva. śrau. 9. 8 ) iti ||
atra | aha | goḥ | amanvat | nāma | tvaṣṭuḥ | apīcyam | itthā | candramasaḥ | gṛhe ||15||

1 atrāha asminneva goḥ gantuḥ candramaso gṛhe maṇḍale tvaṣṭuḥ dīptasyādityasya saṃbandhi apīcyaṃ rātrāvantarhitaṃ svakīyaṃ yat nāma tejaḥ tadādityasya raśmayaḥ itthā itthamena prakāreṇa amanvat ajānan |
tatra pratiphalitāḥ kiraṇāḥ sūrye yādṛśīṃ saṃjñāṃ labhante tādṛśīṃ candreḍapi vartamānā labhante ityarthaḥ |
badrātrā- vantarhitaṃ sauraṃ tejastaccandramaṇḍalaṃ praviśya adnīva neśaṃ tamo nivārya sarvaṃ prakāśayati |
idaṃbhūtatejasā yuktaḥ sūryaśca indra eva dvādaśatvādidyepicandrasyāpi parigaṇitatvāt |
ato'horātrayoḥ prakāśaka indra evetīndrastuteḥ pratīyamānatvādandro devatetyetadupapannaṃ bhavati |
idaṃbhūtasya tejasa āśrayatvena candramasaḥ prādhānyavivakṣayā cāndramasyāmiṣṭau viniyogo'pyupapadyate |
atra niruktam— ‘ athāpyasyaiko raśmi- ścandramasaṃ prati dīpyate tadetenopekṣitavyamādityato'sya dīptirbhavatīti |
supumṇaḥ sūryaśmiścandramā gandharva ityapi nigamo bhavati |
atrāha gauramanvateti ’ ( niru. 2. 6. ), ‘ atra ha goḥ samamaṃsatādityaraśmayaḥ svaṃ nāmāpīcyamapacitamapagamanapihitamantarhitaṃ vā ’ ( niru. 4. 25 ) iti ||
apapūrvāt cinoteḥ ‘ adyādayaśca ’ ( u. sū. 4. 551) iti nipātānāt yat |
thā hetau ca chandasi ’ iti prakāravacane thāpratyayaḥ |
yadi tatredeśabdo nānuvartate tadānīm ‘ idamasthamuḥ ’ ( pā. sū. 5. 3. 24 ) iti thamupratyayaḥ |
‘ anyādāpsupaḥ ’ ( pā. sū. 2. 4. 82 ) iti sublukaṃ bādhitvā ‘ supāṃ suluk ’ iti ḍādeśaḥ |
‘ candre māṅo ḍin ’ ( u. sū 4.667 ) iti asipratyayaḥ |
sarvapṛṣṭhāyāmiṣṭau kāyasya haviṣaḥ ‘ ko adya ’ iti dve ṛcau yājyānuvākye |
sūtritaṃ ca- ‘ kāya daśamaṃ ko adya yuṅke dhuri gā ṛtasyeti dve ’ ( āśva. śrau. 4. 12 ) iti ||
1. kṣa-ṭa-ḍha-na-tadādityaraśmayaḥ | 2. ta-śa-apipūrvāt | 3. ca-pha-apagate | 4. kṣa-ca- cha-ṭa-ḍha-pha-nirgate | 5. kṣa-nānuvartate |
ko adya yuṅkte dhuri gā ṛtasya śimīvato bhāminau durhaṇāyūn |
āsanipnūhatsvasau mayobhūnya eṣāṃ bhṛtyā mṛṇadhatta jīvāt ||
kaḥ | adya | yuṅkte | dhuri | gāḥ | ṛtasya | śimī'vataḥ | bhāminaḥ | duḥ'haṇāyūn | āsan'īpnū | hatsu'arsaḥ | mayaḥ'bhūnū | yaḥ | eṣām | bhṛtyām | ṛṇadhat | saḥ | jīvāt ||16||
▼adya asmin karmaṇi ▼ṛtasya gacchataḥ indrasambandhino rathasya ▼dhuri aśvavahapradeśe ▼gāḥ gatitato'śvān ▼kaḥ ▼yuṅkte ko nāma niyoktuṃ śaknoti |
▼kīdṛśān ▼śimīvataḥ vīryakarmapipatān ▼bhāminaḥ tejasā yuktāna ▼durhaṇāyūn parairduḥsahena krodhena yuktāna |
anugrahītāre indre āgate sati 'ka īṣate śatrūbhītaḥ san? ko nirgacchati na ko'pītyarthaḥ|
indre rakṣe sati bhayamati notpadyate dūre tasya śatrukṛtā hiṃsā|
'anti antike samīpe santam asmākaṃ rakṣakatvena vartamānam indraṃ ka: puruṣa: maṃsate jānāti|
yuddhe sahāyyārthamindre āgate sati 'ka: yajamāna: tokāya putrāya adhi bravat|
he indra asmadīyaṃ putraṃ rakṣetyevaṃrūpamadhivacanaṃ pakṣapātena vacanam|
'uta api ca rāye śatrubhirhriyamāṇāya dhanāya ka: adhi avat|
apahriyamāṇamasmadīyaṃ dhanaṃ rakṣetyadhivacanamapi ko yajamāna: kuryāt|
api ca tanve svakīyāya śarīrāya janāya parijanaya ca ka: adhi avat|
yadā tu kaśabdārbhidheyasya prajāpate: saṃbandhini karmaṇi viniyoga: tadānīṃ parameśvarayoga- dindraśabdena prajāpaterevābhidhīyate|
yathā 'aindryā gārhapatyamupatiṣṭhate' iti viniyogānusāreṇa 'kadā cana' ityasyāmṛci vidyamāna indro gārhapatyaparatayā nīyate tadvat|
adupadeśāt lasārvadhātukānu- dāttatve yaka eva svara: śiṣyate|
tanuśabdāccaturthyekavacane 'jasādiṣu cchandasi vāvacanam' iti 'gherḍiti' iti guṇābhāve yaṇādeśa:|
ko agnimīḍe haviṣā ghṛtena sucā yajātā ṛtubhirdhruvebhi: |
kasmai devā ā vahānāśu homaṃ ko maṃsate vītihotra: ||
ka: | agnim | īḍe | haviṣā | ghṛtena | sucā | yajātā | ṛtu'bhi: | dhruvebhi: | kasmai | devā: | ā | vahān | āśu | homam | ka: | maṃsate | vīti'hotra: | ||18||
indrāya havirnirvāpo'pi sampā- dyaṃ na śakyate|
ko vā indrayāgārthamagniṃ 'sucā juhvā 'dhruvebhi: dhruvairnityai: 'ṛtubhi: vamantādikālerupalakṣitain 'ghṛtena 'haviṣā 'yajātai yajeta|
tābhi: dhruvai: prakṛtau vikṛtau ca anuṣṭheyatayā niśśaleṛtubhi: saha agnimādhyābhāgadevatāṃ ghṛtena haviṣā ca yajeta|
'kasmai yajamānāya 'homa hyātavyaṃ praśastaṃ dhanam 'āśu śīghraṃ 'devā: 'ā vahān āvahanti prayacchanti|
'indra eva dhanasya dātā nānye devā iti indra: 3 stūyate|
bahuvidhena stotreṇa cirakālopāsanena cendra: pratyakṣo bhavati nānyena prakāreṇeti tātparyartha:|

aikāraḥ | vahān | vahaterleṭi āḍāgamaḥ | ' itaśca lopaḥ ' iti ikāralopaḥ | ' saṃyogāntasya ' iti takāralopaḥ | homa | hūyateḥ kṛtāstasya ' āto manin ' iti manin | ' hraḥ ' ityanuvṛttau ' bahulaṃ chandasi ' iti saṃprasāraṇam | yadvā | ' nāmansīman ' ( u. sū. 4. 590 ) ityādī homaśabdo maninpratyayānto nipātyate | maṃste | ' mana jñāne ' | leṭi āḍāgamaḥ | ' sibbahulaṃ leṭi ' iti sip | vītihotraḥ | vī gatyādiṣu | asmāt karmaṇi ' mantre vṛṣa ' ityādinā kin sa codāttaḥ | hotraṃ homaḥ | ' huyāmāśubhasibhyaśvan ' ( u. sū. 4. 607 ) iti vanpratyayaḥ | vītiḥ prāpto homo yena | bahuvrīhau pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaratvam | sudevaḥ | ' nansubhyām ' ityuttarapadāntodāttatvam ||
tvamaṅga pra śaṃsiṣo devaḥ śaviṣṭha martyam |
na tvadanyo maghavannasti marditendra bravīmi te vacaḥ ||
tvam | aṅga | pra | śaṃsipaḥ | devaḥ | śaviṣṭha | martyam |
na | tvat | anyaḥ | maghavan | asti | marditā | indra | bravīmi | te | vacaḥ || 19 ||

aṅga iti abhisubhīkaraṇe | aṅga śaviṣṭha he balavattamendra devaḥ dyotamānaḥ tvaṃ martya maraṇa- dharmāṃ tvāṃ stutavantaṃ puruṣaṃ pra śaṃsipaḥ | masyaganena stutam iti praśaṃsa | he maghavan dhanavan indra tvadanyaḥ tvatto'nyaḥ kaścit marditā sukhayitā na asti | ataḥ kāraṇāt te tubhyamidaṃ stuti- lakṣaṇaṃ vacaḥ bravīmi uccārayāmi || śaṃsipaḥ | ' śaṃsu stutau ' | leṭi sipi āḍāgamaḥ | ' sibbahula leṭi ' iti vikaraṇaśca mip | tasya ārdhadhātukatvāt iḍāgamaḥ | śaviṣṭha | atiśayena śatrasvī śaviṣṭhaḥ | iṣṭhani ' vinmatolu~k ' | ṭeḥ ' iti ṭilopaḥ | marditā | ' mṛḍa sukhane ' | tṛcaḥ iḍāgamaḥ ||
mā te rādhauṃsi mā taṃ ūtayo vaso'smānkadā cana dabhan |
viśvā ca na upamimīhi mānuṣa vasūni carṣaṇibhya ā ||
mā | te | rādhauṃsi | mā | te | ūtayaḥ | vaso iti | asmān | kadā | cana | dabhan | viśvā | ca | naḥ | upamimīhi | mānuṣa | vasūni | carṣaṇibhyaḥ | ā || 20 ||
he vaso nivāsayatirindra te tava saṃbandhīni rājodhyebhiriti rādhauṃsi bhūtāni asmān kadā cana kadācidapi mā dabhan mā vināśayantu |
dhṛtayaḥ kampayitāraḥ te tvadīyā marutaśca mā dabhan |
he mānuṣa manuṣyahitendra carṣa- ṇibhyaḥ mantradraṣṭṛbhyaḥ naḥ asmabhyaṃ viśvā viśvāni sarvāṇi vasūni dhanāni ca ā upamimīhi sarvata āhṛtyāsmatsamīpe kuru |
kiṃśabdāt ' sarvaikānya- kiyattadaḥ kāle dā ' (pā.sū.5.3.15) iti dāpratyayaḥ |

dabhan | 'dambhu dambhe' | loḍarthe chāndase laḍi 'bahulam chandasi' iti vikaraṇasya luk | 'na māṅyoge' iti aḍabhāvaḥ | mimīhi | 'māṅ māne śabde ca' | vyatyayena parasmaipadam | juhotyādi- tvāt śluḥ | 'bhṛjāmita' iti abhyāsasya hrasvam | herdvitvāt 'ghumāsthā' iti ītvam || 8 || 13 ||
tatra 'pra ye' iti dvādaśarcaṃ prathamaṃ sūktaṃ gotamasyārṣam |
tathā cānukrāntam-'pra ye dvādaśa mārutaṃ ha pañcamyante triṣṭubhau' iti |
sūtritaṃ ca-'pra ye śubhante janasya gopā ityāgnimārutam' (āśva. śrau. 7. 7) iti ||
pra ye śubhante janayo na saptayo yāmannudrasya sūnavaḥ sudaṃsasaḥ |
rodasī hi marutaścakrire vṛdhe madanti vīrā vidatheṣu ghṛṣvayaḥ ||
pra | ye | śubhante | janayaḥ | na | saptayaḥ | yāman | rudrasya | sūnavaḥ | sudaṃsasaḥ | rodasī iti | hi | marutaḥ | cakrire | vṛdhe | madanti | vīrāḥ | vidatheṣu | ghṛṣvayaḥ ||1||

ye 'marutaḥ' 'yāman' yāmani gamane nimittabhūte sati 'pra' 'śubhante' prakarṣeṇa svakīyānyaṅgāni alaṃkurvanti 'janayo' 'na' jāyā iva | yathā yoṣitaḥ svakīyānyaṅgānyalaṃkurvanti tadvat | kīdṛśā marutaḥ | 'saptayaḥ' sarpaṇaśīlāḥ 'rudrasya' 'sūnavaḥ' | rodayati sarvamantatkāle iti rudraḥ parameśvaraḥ | tasya putrāḥ | 'sudaṃsasaḥ' śobhanakarmāṇaḥ | etadevopapādayati | 'hi' yasmāt marutaḥ 'rodasī' dyāvāpṛthivyau 'vṛdhe' vṛddhipradānādinā vardhanāya 'cakrire' kṛtavantaḥ | ataḥ sudaṃsasa ityarthaḥ | 'vīrāḥ' viśeṣeṇa śatrukṣepaṇa- śīlāḥ 'ghṛṣvayaḥ' gharṣaṇaśīlāḥ | mahīruhaśiloccayāderbhañjakā ityarthaḥ | 'evaṃbhūtāste marutaḥ 'vidatheṣu' | vidatheṣu yaṣṭavyatayā devāniti vidathā yajñāḥ | teṣu 'madanti' somapānena hṛṣyanti || śubhante | 'śubha śubha dīptau' | bhvādādikaḥ | janayaḥ | jāyante āsvapatyānīti janayo jāyāḥ | 'insarvadhātubhyaḥ' iti inpratyayaḥ | yāman | 'yā prāpaṇe' | 'kṛñyalyuṭo bahulam' iti bahulavacanāt 'āto maninu' iti bhāve manin | 'supāṃ suluk' iti saptamyāḥ luk | sudaṃsasaḥ | daṃsaḥ iti karmanāma | śobhanaṃ daṃso yeṣām | 'sormanyau alopoyasī' ityuttarapadyudāttatvam | cakrire | 'hi ca' iti nighāta- pratiṣedhaḥ | vṛdhe | 'vṛdha vṛddhau' | saṃpadādilakṣaṇo bhāve kvip | 'sāvekācaḥ' iti vibhakterudāttatvam | madanti | 'madī harṣe' | ini prāpte vyatyayena śap | pādāditvāt nighātābhāvaḥ | vidatheṣu | 'vida jñāne' | 'rivibhyāṃ kit' iti athapratyayaḥ | ghṛṣvayaḥ | 'ghṛṣu saṃgharṣe' | 'kṛvighṛṣpi' ityādinā vinpratyayānto nipātyate ||
ta ukṣitāso mahimānamāśata divi rudrāso adhi cakrire sardaḥ |
arcento arkaṃ janayanta indriyamadhi śriyaṃ dhire pṛśnimātaraḥ ||
te | ukṣitāsaḥ | mahimānam | āśata | divi | rudrāsaḥ | adhi | cakrire | sardaḥ | arcentaḥ | arkam | janayantaḥ | indriyam | adhi | śriyaḥ | dhire | pṛśnimātaraḥ ||2||
ye pūrvoktaguṇaviśiṣṭāḥ te marutaḥ ukṣitāmaḥ dairvairabhipiktāḥ santaḥ mahimānaṃ mahattvam āśata āpuvan |
te rudraputrā marutaḥ divi dyotamāne nabhasi sardaḥ sadanaṃ sthānam adhi cakre adhikaṃ sarvotkṛṣṭaṃ kṛtavantaḥ |
arkam arcanīya- mindram arcentaḥ pūjayantaḥ indriyam indrasya liṅgaṃ vīryaṃ janayantaḥ |
‘prahara bhagavo jahi vīrayasva’ (ai. brā. 3. 20) ityevaṃrūpeṇa vākyenotpādayantaḥ |
pṛśnimātaraḥ pṛśnīnāmarūpāyā bhūmeḥ putrā marutaḥ śriyaḥ aiśvaryāṇi adhi dhire ādhikyenādhārayan |
indriya- mindraliṅgamindradṛṣṭam (pā. sū. 5. 2. 93) iti ghañpratyayānto nipātyate |
śrūyate ca- ‘iyaṃ vai pṛśniḥ’ (tai. brā. 1. 4. 1. 5) iti |
kṛta- śchandasi (pā. sū. 5. 4. 158) iti samāsāntasya kapaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ ||
gomātaro yacchubhayante añjibhistanuṣu śubhā dadhire virukamataḥ |
gomātaraḥ | yat | śubhayante | añjibhiḥ | tanuṣu | śubhāḥ | dadhire | virukamataḥ | bādhante | viśvam | abhimātinam | apa | vartmāni | eṣām | anu | rīyate | ghṛtam ||3||

gomātaraḥ gorūpā bhūmirmātā yeṣāṃ te marutaḥ añjibhiḥ rūpābhivyañjakairabharaṇaiḥ yat yadā śubhayante svakīyānyaṅgāni śobhāyuktāni kurvanti tadānīṃ śubhāḥ dīptā marutaḥ tanuṣu svakīyeṣu śarīreṣu virukamataḥ viśeṣeṇa rocamānānalaṅkārān dadhire dhārayanti |
api ca viśvaṃ sarvam abhi- mātinaṃ śatrum apa bādhante hiṃsanti |
eṣāṃ marutāṃ vartmāni mārgānanusṛtya ghṛtaṃ kṣaraṇaśīlamudakaṃ rīyate sravati |
yatra maruto gacchanti vṛṣṭyudakamapi tadanusāreṇa tatra gacchatītyarthaḥ ||
vi ye ārjante surmakhāsa ṛṣibhiḥ pracyāvayanto acyutā cidojasā |
vi | ye | ārjante | su'makhāsaḥ | ṛṣi'bhiḥ | pra'cyavayantaḥ | acyutā | cit | ojasā | manaḥ'juvaḥ | yat | marutaḥ | ratheṣvā | ā | vṛṣa'trātāsaḥ | pṛṣtīḥ | ayugdhvam || 4 ||

ye marutaḥ ṛṣibhiḥ āyudhaiḥ vi bhrajante viśeṣeṇa dīpyante te marutaḥ acyutā cit cyāvayitumaśakyāni dṛḍhāni parvatādīnyapi ojasā svakīyena balena pracyāvayantaḥ prakarṣeṇa cyāvayitāraḥ prerayitāro bhavanti |
he marutaḥ manojuvaḥ manodvegagatayaḥ vṛṣatrātāsaḥ vṛṣṭyudakasecanasamarthasatasaṃghātmakā yūyaṃ ratheṣvā ātmīyeṣu pṛṣtīḥ |
pṛṣtyaḥ iti marudvāhanānāṃ saṃjñā 'pṛṣtyo marutām' ( ni. 1. 15. 6 ) ityuktatvāt |
pṛṣdbhiḥ śvetabindubhiryuktāḥ mṛgīḥ yat yadā ā ayugdhvam ābhimukhyena niyuktā akradhvam |
sarve vidhayaśchandasi vikalpyante iti namsubhyām ityasya pravṛttyabhāve bahuvrīhau pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaratvam |
luṅi dhi ca ( pā. sū. 8. 2. 25 ) iti sakāralopaḥ ||
pra yadratheṣpu pṛṣtīryugdhvaṃ vāje adriṃ maruto raṃhayantaḥ |
pra | yat | ratheṣpu | pṛṣtīḥ | ayugdhvam | vāje | adrim | marutaḥ | raṃhayantaḥ | uta | aruṣasya | vi | syanti | dhārāḥ | carma'iva | uda'bhiḥ | vi | undanti | bhūrma ||5||
he marutaḥ pṛṣtīḥ yat yadā ratheṣpu pra ayugdhvaṃ prāyujataḥ |
vāje anne nimittabhūte sati adriṃ meghaṃ raṃhayantaḥ varṣaṇārthaṃ prerayantaḥ |
uta tadānīm aruṣasya ārocamānasya sūryasya vidyutāmevā sakāśāt vṛṣṭyudakadhārāḥ bhavanti vi ṣyanti vimuñcanti |
vimuktāstāśca dhārāḥ udabhiḥ udakaiḥ carmeva parimitamalaṃ carma yathā aprayatnena kledyate evaṃ bhūma sarvāṃ bhūmiṃ vyundanti viśeṣeṇārdrāṃ kurvanti |
otaḥ śyani ( pā. sū. 7. 3. 71 ) iti okāralopaḥ |
supāṃ suluk iti bhūmiśabdāt uttarasya amaḥ ḍādeśaḥ |
tṛtīyasavane ā vo vahantu iti potuḥ sthitayājyā |
mūdhitaṃ ca-ā vo vahantu saptayo raghuṣyado'meva naḥ suhavā ā hi gantana ( āśva. śrau. 5. 5 ) iti ||
ā vo vahantu sa॒ptayo̭ ra॒ghuṣya॒do ra॒ghuṣva॒vāna̭ḥ pra ji̭gāta bā॒hubhi̭ḥ |
sīda̭tā ba॒rhirṷru va॒ḥ sa॒daskṛ̭taṃ mā॒daya̭dhvaṃ ma॒ruto॒ makṣvo̭ a॒ndhasa̭ḥ ||

ā | vaḥ | vahantu | sa॒ptaya̭ḥ | ra॒ghuṣya॒daḥ | ra॒ghuṣva॒vāna̭ḥ | pra | ji̭gāta | bā॒hubhi̭ḥ | sīda̭ta | ā | ba॒rhiḥ | u॒ru | vaḥ | sa॒daḥ | kṛ॒tam | mā॒daya̭dhvam | ma॒ruta̭ḥ | makṣva̭ḥ | a॒ndhasa̭ḥ ||6||
he marutaḥ ⁷vaḥ yuṣmān ⁷saptayaḥ sarpaṇaśīlā aśvāḥ ⁷ā ⁷vahantu asmadyajñaṃ prāpayantu |
⁷raghuṣvavānaḥ laghu śīghraṃ patanto gacchanto yūyaṃ ⁷bāhubhiḥ svakīyairhastaiḥ asamabhyaṃ dātavyaṃ dhanamāhṛtya ⁷pra ⁷jigāta prakarṣeṇa gacchata |
he ⁷marutaḥ ⁷vaḥ yuṣmākaṃ ⁷sadaḥ sadanaṃ vedilakṣaṇaṃ sthānam ⁷uru vistīrṇaṃ ⁷kṛtam |
tatra yadāstīrṇaṃ ⁷barhiḥ tat ⁷ā ⁷sīdata tasminbarhiṣyupaviśata |
upaviśya ca ⁷makṣvaḥ makṣurasya ⁷andhasaḥ somalakṣaṇasyānnasya² pānena ⁷mādayadhvaṃ tṛptā bhavata ||
tasya pittvena ṅittvābhāvāt ‘ī halyaghoḥ ’ iti ītvābhāvaḥ |
‘ataḥ kukami ’ ( pā. sū. 8. 3. 46 ) iti visarjanīyasya satvam |
tairva̭rdhanta॒ svata̭vaso ma॒hitva॒nā nāka̭ṃ ta॒sthuru॒ru ca̭krire sa॒daḥ |
viṣṇṷrya॒dvāva̭vṛdha॒ṇaṃ ma॒dacyṷtaṃ va॒yo na sī̭da॒nnadhi̭ ba॒rhiṣi̭ pri॒ye ||

te | a̭vardhanta | sva॒tava̭saḥ | ma॒hitva॒nā | ā | nāka̭m | ta॒sthuḥ | u॒ru | ca॒krire | sa॒daḥ | viṣṇṷḥ | yat | ha | ā॒vat | vṛ॒dha॒ṇam | ma॒dacyṷtam | va॒yaḥ | na | sī̭dan | adhi̭ | ba॒rhiṣi̭ | pri॒ye ||7||
vṛddhiṃ prāpya ca ⁷mahitvanā mahimnā mahattvena ⁷nākaṃ svargam ⁷ā ⁷tasthuḥ āsthitavantaḥ |
⁷sadaḥ sadanaṃ nabholakṣaṇaṃ sthānaṃ ca svakīyanivāsāya ⁷uru vistīrṇaṃ ⁷cakrire |

⁷yat yebhyo marudbhyo yadartha ⁷vṛṣaṇaṃ kāmābhivarṣakaṃ ⁷madacyutaṃ madasya harṣasya āsektāraṃ yajñaṃ ⁷viṣṇuḥ ⁷ha ⁷āvata viṣṇurevāgatya rakṣati te marutaḥ ⁷vayo ⁷na pakṣiṇo yathā śīghramāgacchanti evaṃ śīghramāgatya ⁷barhiṣi ⁷adhi asmadīye yajñe ⁷priye prītikare ⁷sīdana sīdantu upaviśantu ||
‘svarito vānudātte padādau ’ ( pā. sū. 8. 2. 6 ) iti ekādeśasya svaritatvam |
bhāvapratyayāduttarasya āṅaḥ vyatyayena nābhāvaḥ udāttatvaṃ ca |
nākamatasthuśca sadaśca vistīrṇaṃ cakrire iti cārthapratīteḥ |

yat | ‘supāṃ suluk’ iti caturthyā luk | āvat | chāndaso vartamāne laṅ | vṛṣaṇam | ‘vā paparvasya nigame’ iti upadhādīrghābhāvaḥ | madacyutam | madaṃ dyotatīti madacyut | ‘dyutir āsecane’ | ‘kip ca’ iti kip | sīdan | liṅarthe leṭi aḍāmagaḥ ||
śūrā̭ive॒dyuyṷdhayo॒ na ja॒rmaya̭ḥ śra॒vasya॒vo na pṛ॒tanā̭su॒ yeti̭re |
bhaya̭nte॒ viśvā॒ bhuva̭nā ma॒rudbhyo॒ rājā̭naiva॒ tveṣa̭saṃdṛśo॒ nara̭ḥ ||
śūrāḥ| iva| yuyudhayaḥ| na| jarmayaḥ| śravasyavaḥ| na| pṛtanāsu| yetire| bhayante| viśvā| bhuvanā| marudbhyaḥ| rājānaḥ| iva| tveṣasaṃdṛśaḥ| naraḥ|| 8||

‘śūrāivet śauyepitā yuyutsavaḥ puruṣā iva ca ‘jarmayaḥ śīghraṃ gacchanto marutaḥ ‘śravasyavo ‘na śravo'nnamātmana icchantaḥ puruṣā iva ‘pṛtanāsu saṃgrāmeṣu ‘yetire prayatnante vṛtrādibhiryuddhe vyāpriyante |
ye ‘naraḥ vṛṣṭyādernetāro marutaḥ ‘rājānaiva rājamānā nṛpataya iva ‘tveṣasaṃdṛśaḥ dīptasaṃdarśanā ugrarūpatayā draṣṭumaśakyā bhavanti tebhya ityarthaḥ ||
tvaṣṭā॒ yadva॒jraṃ su॒kṛta̭ṃ hi॒ra॒ṇyaya̭ṃ sa॒hasra̭bhṛṣṭi॒ṃ svapā̭ a॒varta̭yat |
tvaṣṭā| yat| vajram| sukṛtam| hiraṇyayam| sahasrabhṛṣṭim| svapāḥ| avartayat| dhatte| indraḥ| nari| apāṃsi| kartave| ahan| vṛtram| niḥ| apām| aubjat| arṇavam|| 9||
svapāḥ śobhanakarmā ‘tvaṣṭā viśvanirmātā ‘yadvajram ‘avartayat indraṃ pratyagamayan dattavānityarthaḥ |
evaṃ vajraṃ dhṛtvā tena vajreṇa ‘vṛtraṃ vṛṣṭyudakasyāvarakam ‘arṇavam arṇasodakena yuktaṃ megham ‘ahan avadhīt |
‘apāṃ tena niruddhā apaśca saḥ ‘vaniḥ ‘aubjat niḥ śeṣāyomukhamapātayat pravṛṣṭā akarodityarthaḥ ||

karmaṇi niṣṭhā | ' gatiranantaraḥ ' iti gateḥ prakṛtisvaratvam | hiraṇyayam | hiraṇyaśabdāduttarasya mayaṭo makārasya lopaḥ ' ṛtvyavāstavyavāstva ' ityādī nipātyate | svapāḥ | ' somarnasī alomoṣasī ' ityuttarapadādyudāttatvam | kartave | ' tumarthe sesena ' iti karoteḥ tavenpratyayaḥ | apām | ' kriyāgrahaṇaṃ kartavyam ' iti karmaṇaḥ saṃpradānatvāt caturthyarthe ṣaṣṭhī | ' uḍidam ' iti vibhakterudāttatvam | aubjat | ' ubja ārjave ' | arṇavam | ' arṇaso lopaśca ' ( kā. 5. 2. 109. 2 ) iti matvarthīyo vaḥ salopaśca ||

ūrdhvaṃ nunudre'vataṃ ta orjasā dādṛhāṇaṃ cidbibhidurvivi parvatam | dhamanto vāṇaṃ marutaḥ sudānavo made somasya raṇyāni cakrire || 10 || ūrdhvam | nunudre | avatam | te | orjasā | dādṛhāṇam | cit | bibhiduḥ | vi | parvatam | dhamantaḥ | vāṇam | marutaḥ | sudānavaḥ | made | somasya | raṇyāni | cakrire || 10 ||
gotama ṛṣiḥ pipāsayā pīḍitaḥ san maruta udakaṃ yāyāce |

tadanantaraṃ maruto'dūrasthaṃ kūpamuddhṛtya yatra sa gotama ṛṣistiṣṭhati tāṃ diśaṃ nītvā ṛṣisamīpe kūpamavasthāpya tapāśrai āhāvaṃ ca kṛtvā tasminnāhāve kūpamutsicya tarpipaṃ tenodakena tarpayāñcakruḥ |
kūpanāmasu ca ' avataḥ avaṭaḥ ' ( ni. 3. 23. 7 ) iti paṭhitam |
tam ' ūrdhvam upari yathā bhavati tathā ' orjasā svakīyena balena ' nunudre preritavantaḥ |
evaṃ kūpamutkhāyā ṛṣerāśramaṃ prati nayantaḥ marutaḥ mārgamadhye ' dādṛhāṇaṃ pravṛddhaṃ gatinirodhakaṃ ' parvataṃ ' cit parvatavantaṃ śiloccayamati ' vi ' bibhiduḥ viśeṣeṇa babhañjuḥ |

' sudānavaḥ śobhanadānāste ' marutaḥ ' vāṇaṃ śatasaṃkhyābhiḥ ' tantrībhiryuktaṃ vīṇāviśeṣaṃ ' dhamantaḥ vādayantaḥ ' somasya ' made somapānena harṣe sati ' raṇyāni stutyāni ramaṇīyāni dhanāni ' cakrire stotṛbhyaḥ kurvanti ||
raṇebhāve ' vaśiraṇyorupasaṃkhyānam ' ( pā. sū. 3. 3. 58. 3 ) iti ap |

jihvaṃ nunudre'vataṃ tayā diśāsiñcanutsaṃ gotamāya tṛṣṇaje | ā gacchantīmarvasā citrabhānavaḥ kāmaṃ viprasya tarpayanta dhāmabhiḥ || 11 || jihvam | nunudre | avatam | tayā | diśā | asiñcan | utsam | gotamāya | tṛṣṇaje | ā | gacchantīm | arvāsā | citrabhānavaḥ | kāmam | viprasya | tarpayanta | dhāmabhiḥ || 11 ||
marutaḥ 'avanatam uddhṛtaṃ kūpaṃ yasyāṃ diśi ṛṣivasati 'tayā 'diśayā 'jihva vakraṃ tiryyaṃ 'junude preritavantaḥ |
evaṃ rūpaṃ nītvā kūpyāśrame'vasthāpya 'tṛṇaje tṛpanāya 'gotamāya ṛṣaye tadartham 'utsaṃ jalapravāhaṃ kṛpāduddhṛtya 'aminnan āhāve'vānayan |
evaṃ kṛtvā 'īm ena stotāramapi 'citrabhānavaḥ vicitradīptayaste marutaḥ 'avasā īdṛśena rakṣaṇena saha 'ā 'gacchanti tatsamīpaṃ prāpnuvanti |
prāpya ca 'viprasya medhāvino gotamasya 'kāmam abhilāpaṃ 'dhāmabhiḥ āyudhairdhārakairudakaiḥ 'tarpayanta atarpayan ||

tayā | 'na goścannāvaravarṇa ' iti 'sāvekācaḥ ' iti prāptasya vibhaktyudāttasya pratiṣedhaḥ | diśā | 'sāvekācaḥ ' iti vibhakterudāttatvam | tṛṇaje | 'jitṛpā pipāsāyām ' | 'svapitṛyornajiṅ ' ( pā. sū. 3. 2. 102 ) | pratyayādyudāttatvam | padakārasya śākalyasya svayamabhiprāyaḥ | 'anye'pi dṛśyate ' iti dṛśagrahaṇāt kevalādapi janerḍapratyayaḥ | tṛṣṇā jātā yasya sa tathoktaḥ | 'ṅyāpoḥ saṃjñācchandasorbahuḻam ' iti hrasvatvam | bahuvrīhau pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaratvam | dhāmabhiḥ | dadhāteḥ 'āto manin ' iti manin ||
mārute paśau 'yā vaḥ śarma ' iti haviyo yājyā |
'pradānānām ' iti khaṇḍe sūtritam-'arā ivedcaramā aheva yā vaḥ śarma śaśamānāya santi ' ( āśva. śrau. 3. 7 ) iti ||
yā vaḥ śarma śaśamānāya santi tridhātūni dāśuṣe yacchatārdhi |
asmabhyaṃ tāni maruto vi yanta rayiṃ no dhatta vṛṣaṇaḥ suvīram ||
yā | vaḥ | śarma | śaśamānāya | santi | tridhātūni | dāśuṣe | yacchata | ardhi | asmabhyam | tāni | marutaḥ | vi | yanta | rayim | naḥ | dhatta | vṛṣaṇaḥ | suvīram ||12||
he marutaḥ 'vaḥ yuṣmākaṃ saṃbandhīni 'yā yāni 'śarma śarmāṇi sukhāni gṛhāṇa vā |
'tridhātūni pṛthivyādiṣu triṣu sthāneṣvavasthitāni 'śaśamānāya yuṣmān stutibhirbhajamānāya dātuṃ saṃpāditāni |
pūrvoktalakṣaṇāni śarmāṇi yāni 'santi yāni ca 'dāśuṣe havirdattavate yajamānāya 'adhi 'yacchata adhikaṃ prayacchatha he 'marutaḥ 'tāni sarvāṇi śarmāṇi 'asmabhyaṃ 'vi 'yanta viśeṣeṇa prayacchata |
kiṃca he 'vṛṣaṇaḥ kāmānāṃ varṣitāro marutaḥ 'naḥ asmabhyaṃ 'suvīraṃ śobhanairvīraiḥ putrādibhiryuktaṃ 'rathi dhanaṃ 'dhatta datta ||
atastasya pittvena ṅittvābhāvāt 'anudāttopadeśa ' ityādinā anunāsikalopo na bhavati |
'maruto yasya ' iti daśacaṃ dvitīyaṃ sūktaṃ gotamasyārṣaṃ gāyatraṃ marudevatākam |
vyūhe tṛtīye chandome ābhimārhate śakhe etatsūktam |
'tṛtīyasyāganma mahaḥ ' iti khaṇḍe sūtritaṃ-'maruto yasya hi prāgraye vācamiṣyāmimārutam ' ( āśva. śrau. 8. 11 )
aindrāmāhvayāṃ pradhānasya ' maruto yasya ' ityeṣā anuvākyā|
sūtritaṃ ca- ' aindrāmāhavīṃ bhedakāmā maruto yasya hi kṣaye ' ( āśva. śrau. 2. 11 ) iti|
sūtritaṃ ca- ' maruto yasya hi kṣaye'rā ivedaramā aheva ' ( āśva. śrau. 2. 17 ) iti|
sūtritaṃ ca- ' maruto yasya hi kṣaye'gne patnī- rihā vaha ' ( āśva. śrau. 5. 5 ) iti||
maruto yasya hi kṣaye pāthā divo vimahasaḥ | sa sugopātamo janaḥ || 1 || marutaḥ | yasya | hi | kṣaye | pātha | divaḥ | vimahasaḥ | saḥ | sugopātamḥ | janaḥ || 1 ||

he vimahasaḥ viśiṣṭaprakāśāḥ marutaḥ divaḥ antarikṣalokādāgatya yasya hi yasya khalu yajamānasya kṣaye yajñagṛhe pātha somaṃ pibatha saḥ janaḥ jāto yajamānaḥ sugopātamaḥ śobhanaiḥ pālakairyastaṃ yukto bhavati ||
laṭi ' bahulaṃ chandasi ' iti śapo luk |
śobhano gopā rakṣako yasya sa sugopāḥ |
tamapaḥ pittvādanudāttatve sati bahuvrīhau ' namsubhyām ' ityuttarapadāntodāttatvameva śiṣyate ||
yajñairvā yajñavāhaso viprasya vā matīnām | marutaḥ śṛṇutā havam || 2 || yajñaiḥ | vā | yajña'vāhasaḥ | viprasya | vā | matīnām | marutaḥ | śṛṇuta | havam || 2 ||
he yajñavāhasaḥ yajñasya voḍhāraḥ marutaḥ yūyaṃ yajñairvā |
yajñaiśca yajamānasya matīnāṃ stutīnāṃ saṃbandhanaḥ viprasya vā ayajamānasya medhāvinaśca havam āhvānaṃ śṛṇuta |
yajña- vato yajamānasya yāgarahitasya stotṛśvāhvānamavaśyaṃ bhavadbhiḥ śrotavyaṃ yataḥ bhavanto yajñasya voḍhāraḥ stutipriyāśceti bhāvaḥ ||
' gatikārakarayopi pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaratvaṃ ca ' iti vacanāt ' vahihādhāñbhyaśchandasi ' iti kārakapūrvāt vahaterasun |
' satiśiṣṭasvarabalīyasamanyatra vikaraṇebhyaḥ ' iti vacanāt tiṅa eva svaraḥ śiṣyate |
maruta ityasya āmantritasya ' āmantritaṃ pūrvamavidyamānavat ' iti avidyamānavattvena padāparatvāt nighātābhāvaḥ |
uta vā yasya vājino'nu vipramartakṣata | sa gantā gormati vraje || 3 || uta | vā | yasya | vājinaḥ | anu | vipram | atakṣata | saḥ | gantā | gormati | vraje ||3||
uta vā api ca yasya yajamānasya vājinaḥ havirlakṣaṇākṣopetā ṛtvijaḥ vipraṃ medhāvinaṃ marudgaṇam anu atakṣata haviṣpradānādinā tīkṣṇīkurvanti saḥ yajamānaḥ gormati bahubhirgobhiryukte
'vraje goṣṭhe 'gantā gamanaśīlo bhavati || atakṣata | 'tan svakṣa tankaraṇe ' | chāndaso lak | vyatyayena madhyamaḥ | gantā | gamestācchalikaḥ tṛn ||
asya vīrasya barhiṣi sutaḥ somo diviṣṭiṣu | ukthaṃ madaśca śasyate || 4 || asya | vīrasya | barhiṣi | sutaḥ | somaḥ | diviṣṭiṣu | uktham | madaḥ | ca | śasyate ||4||
'ukthaṃ maruddevatākaṃ śastraṃ 'madaśca madighātunā yuktā 'maruto devāḥ somasya matsanu 'ityādikā mārutī nivit ca asya marudgaṇasya harpāya 'śasyate hotrā paṭhyate |
subhagaḥ sa prayajyavo maruto astu matyaiḥ | yasya prayāṃrsi parṣatha || 7 || subhagaḥ | saḥ | prayajyavaḥ | marutaḥ | astu | matyaiḥ | yasya | prayāṃrsi | parṣatha || 7 ||
he prayajyavaḥ prakarṣeṇa yaṣṭavyāḥ marutaḥ saḥ matyaiḥ matyo yajamānaḥ subhagaḥ astu śobhana- dhano bhavatu |
yasya yajamānasya prayāṃrsi havirlakṣaṇānyannāni parṣatha ātmani siddhyatha svīkurutha ityarthaḥ ||
śaśamānasya vā naraḥ svedasya satyaśavasaḥ | vidā kāmasya venataḥ || 8 || śaśamānasya | vā | naraḥ | svedasya | satyaśavasaḥ | vida | kāmasya | venataḥ || 8 ||

he satyaśavasaḥ avitathabalāḥ naraḥ netāro marutaḥ śaśamānasya yuṣmān stutibhiḥ saṃbhaja- mānasya svedasya stāvaka mantroccāraṇajanitena śrameṇa stridyamānāgātrasya venataḥ | venatiḥ kānti- karmā | kāmayamānasya | vāśabdaḥ samuccaye | evaṃbhūtasya stotuśca kāmasya kāmamabhilāṣaṃ vid labhayata prayacchatetyarthaḥ || śaśamānasya | 'śaśa plutagatau' | tācchīlikāḥ cānaś | svedasya | 'ṣivadā gātraprakṣaraṇe' | antarbhāvitaṇyathāt karmaṇi ghañ | jittvādādyudāttatvam | vida | 'vid lābhe' | loṭi madhyamapuruṣabahuvacanasya vyatyayena ādeśaḥ | 'bahulaṃ chandasi' iti vikaraṇasya luk | jhasya adādeśaḥ | 'lopasta ātmanepadeṣu' iti talopaḥ | pratyayādyudāttatvam | pādāditvāt nighātābhāvaḥ | 'baco'tastiṅaḥ' iti saṃhitāyāṃ dīrghaḥ | kāmasya | tṛjādiṣu pāṭhādādyudāttatvam | 'kriyāgrahaṇaṃ kartavyam' iti karmaṇaḥ saṃpradānatvāt caturthyarthe ṣaṣṭhī ||
yūyaṃ tatsatyaśavasa āviṣkarta mahatvanā | vidhyatā vidyutā rakṣaḥ || 9 || yūyam | tat | satyaśavasaḥ | āviḥ | karta | mahatvanā | vidhyata | vidyutā | rakṣaḥ || 9 ||
he satyaśavasaḥ satyabalā anyairapradhṛṣyabalā marutaḥ yūyaṃ tat vṛtravadhādiṣu prasiddhaṃ yuṣmadīyaṃ māhātmyam āviṣkarta āviṣkṛta prakāśayata |
vidyutā vidyotamānena mahatvanā tena mahattvena māhātmyena rakṣaḥ asmākamupadravakāriṇaṃ rākṣasādikaṃ vidhyata tāḍayata nāśayatetyarthaḥ ||
'idu- dupadhasya cāpratyayasya' (pā. sū. 8. 3. 41) iti āviḥśabde visarjanīyasya patvam |
taśabdasya 'sārvadhātukamapit' iti ṅittve sati 'ṛci tunudhamaśrutad' iti saṃhitāyāṃ dīrghaḥ ||
gṛhatā gṛhaṃ tamo vi yātu viśvamatriṇam | jyotiṣkartā yaduśmasi || 10 || gṛhatā | gṛham | tamaḥ | vi | yātu | viśvam | atriṇam | jyotiḥ | kartā | yat | uśmasi || 10 ||
he mahataḥ 'guhyaṃ guhāyāṃ sthitaṃ sarvatra vyāpya vartamānaṃ 'tamaḥ andhakāraṃ 'gṛhata saṃvṛtaṃ kuruta |
yathā ambhābhirna dṛśyate tathā adarśanaṃ prāpayata vināśayatetyarthaḥ |
'viśvaṃ sarvam 'atriṇam attāraṃ rākṣasādikaṃ 'yāta vividhaṃ yāpayata asmatkāśāt nirgamayata |
guhyaṃ guhāyāṃ śarīrāntargataguhārūpe hṛdaye bhavaṃ tamo bhāvarūpājñānaṃ tadvata vināśayata |
yajjyotiḥ paratattvasākṣātkārarūpaṃ jñānaṃ kāmayāmahe prāṇānādipañcavṛttīrūpā he marutastatkuruta |
śapi laghūpadhaguṇe 'udupadhāyāḥ gohaḥ ' (pā. sū. 6. 4. 89) iti upadhāyā ūkāraḥ |
'pratavakṣasaḥ ' iti ṣaḍcaṃ tṛtīyaṃ sūktaṃ gautamasyārṣaṃ jāgataṃ mārutam |
'atha yathemam ' iti khaṇḍe sūtritaṃ— 'pratavakṣasaḥ pratavaso yajñā yajñā vo agnaye ' (ābha. śrī. 5. 20) iti |
juṣṭatamāso nṛtamāso añjibhirvyānañje ke cidustrāīva stṛbhiḥ ||
pratavakṣasaḥ | pratavasaḥ | virapsinaḥ | anantāḥ | avithurāḥ | ṛjīṣiṇaḥ | juṣṭatamāsaḥ | nṛtamāsaḥ | añjibhiḥ | vi | ānañje | ke | cit | ustrāḥ iva | stṛbhiḥ ||1||
yataḥ 'pratavasaḥ prakṛṣṭabalopetāḥ ata eva 'virapsinaḥ vividhena jayaghoṣeṇopetāḥ |
tṛtīyasavane ṛjīpasyābhibhavāt tatra ca marutaḥ stūyante iti tepāmṛjīṣitvam |

'juṣṭatamāsaḥ atiśayena yaṣṭabhiḥ sevitāḥ 'nṛtamāsaḥ atiśayena medhādenaṃtāraḥ evaṃbhūtā marutaḥ 'stṛbhiḥ svaśarīrasyācchādakaiḥ 'añjibhiḥ rūpābhyañjakairābharaṇaiḥ 'vyānañje nabhasi vyaktā dṛśyante |
'ke 'cit 'ustrā iva 'ye 'kecana sūrya raśmayo yathā nabhasi dīpyante tadvat |
'gatikārakarayorapi pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaratvaṃ ca ' iti asun pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaratvaṃ ca |

( u. sū. 1. 39 ) iti uracpratyayaḥ | atra tu bahulavacanāt dhratvaṃ na kriyate | pūrvavat samāsasvarau | juṣṭamāsaḥ | ' nirya mantre ' iti juṣṭaśabdaḥ ādyudāttaḥ | tata ātiśāyanikasya tamapaḥ pittvādanu- dāttatve sa eva svaraḥ śiṣyate | ānañje | ' añj vyaktimrakṣaṇakāntigatiṣu ' | karmaṇi ' chandasi luṅ- laṅliṭaḥ ' iti vartamāne liṭ | ' ata ādeḥ ' iti abhyāsasya āsvam | ' tasmācchuṅ dvihalaḥ ' ( pā. sū. 7. 4. 71 ) iti nuḍ | vyatyayena upadhālopaḥ | ' iryo re ' | stṛbhiḥ | ' stṛñ ācchādane ' | krip | āgamānuśāsanasyānityatvāt tugabhāvaḥ ||
upahvareṣu yadacidhvaṃ yayiṃva vaya̭iva marutaḥ kena citpṛthā | śrotanti kośā upa vo ratheṣvā ghṛtamukṣatā madhuvarṇamarcate || 2 || upa'hvareṣu | yat | acidhvam | yayi
yadā khalu marutaḥ svakīyān rathān yuñjate aśvairjayanti tadānīmeṣāṃ rathānāṃ saṃbandhiyu parvatāderūrkṣepakeṣu yāmeṣu gamaneṣu 1 bhūmirbhītyā kampate |
yathā bhartrā viyuktā jāyā rājopadravādiṣu satsu nirālambā satī kampate tadvat |

te tādṛśāḥ krīḻayaḥ vihāraśīlāḥ dhunayaḥ calanasvabhāvāḥ bhrājadṛṣṭayaḥ dīpyamānāyudhāḥ evaṃbhūtā marutaḥ dhūtayaḥ parvatādīn dhunvantaḥ mantaḥ mahirava svakīyaṃ mahimānaṃ svayameva panayanta vyavaharanti prakaṭayantītyarthaḥ |
atiṃstusu ityādinā vidhīyamāno man bahulavacanādasmādapi draṣṭavyaḥ |
balādāvardhātuke vikalpa iṣyate (kā. 2. 4. 56. 2) iti vacanāt ajervya- ñpoḥ iti vībhāvābhāvaḥ |
bhyasate rejata iti bhayavepanayoḥ (niru. 3. 21) iti yāskaḥ |
yā prāpaṇe ityasmāt atiṃstusu ityādinā mantratyayaḥ |

sa hi svasṛtpṛṣadśvo yuvā gaṇo'yā īśānastarviṣībhirā vṛtaḥ | asī satya ṛṇayāvānedyo'syā dhiyaḥ prāvitāthā vṛṣā gaṇaḥ || 4 || saḥ | hi | svasṛt | pṛṣad'aśvaḥ | yuvā | gaṇaḥ | ayā | īśānaḥ | tarviṣībhiḥ | ā'vṛtaḥ | asi | satyaḥ | ṛṇa'yāvā | anedhaḥ | asyāḥ | dhiyaḥ | pra'avitā | atha | vṛṣā | gaṇaḥ ||4||
sa hi sa khalu marudgaṇaḥ ayā asya sarvasya jagataḥ īśānaḥ īśānaśīlaḥ bhavati |
pṛṣadśvaḥ pṛṣataḥ śveta- bindvaṅkitāḥ mṛgāḥ aśvasthānīyāḥ yasya sa tathoktaḥ |
yuvā nityataruṇaḥ tavipībhiḥ anyepāsamādhā- raṇairbalaiḥ āvṛtaḥ pariveṣṭitaḥ satyaḥ svakarmārhaḥ ṛṇayāvā stotṛṇāmastyāpagamayitā bahulasya dhanasya dātetyarthaḥ |
evaṃbhūto marudgaṇaḥ asyāḥ dhiyaḥ asmadīyasyāsya karmaṇaḥ atha anantaraṃ prāvitā asi prakarṣeṇa rakṣitā bhavati |
hali lopaḥ (pā. sū. 7. 2. 113) iti idama idrūpasya lopaḥ |
yā prāpaṇe ityasmāt antarbhāvitaṇyarthāt āto manin iti vanip |
pituḥ pratnasya janmanā vadāmasi somasya jihvā pra jigāti cakṣasā |
pituḥ | pratnasya | janmanā | vadāmasi | somasya | jihvā | pra | jigāti | cakṣasā | yat | īm | indram | śami | ṛkān | āśata | āt | it | nāmāni | yajñiyāni | dadhire ||5||
vpratnasya ciraṃtanasya vpituḥ asmākaṃ janakasya rahūgaṇasya sakāśāt yat janma tena vayaṃ vvadāmasi brūmaḥ |
vakṣyamāṇaṃ vṛttāntam asmākaṃ pitopadiṣṭavān ato vayaṃ brūma ityarthaḥ |
vsomasya yajñeṣvabhipatasya somadravyasya vcakṣasā prakāśamānayāhutyā sahitā vjihvā stutirūpā vāk vpra vjigāti marudgaṇaṃ prakarṣeṇa gacchati |

śobhanā khādirbhakṣaṇaṃ yeṣām | ' nansubhyām ' ityuttarapadāntodāttatvam | iṣmin | ' ipa gatau ' | ' iṣi- yudhīntri ' ityādinā mak | tato matvarthīya iniḥ | vide | ' vid lābhe ' | liṭi dvivaṃcanaprakaraṇe ' chandasi veti vaktavyam ' iti dvivaṃcanābhāvaḥ | ' iryo re ' iti iryo rebhāvaḥ || 13 ||
' ā vidyunmadbhiḥ ' iti ṣaḍvaṃ caturthaṃ sūktam |
atrānukramyate— ' ā vidyunmadbhirādhāmnthe prastārapaṅktī pañcamī virāḍpā ' iti |
ādyau pādau jāgatau tṛtīyacaturthau gāyatrau yasyāḥ sā prastārapaṅktiḥ |
sūtritaṃ ca— ' prastārapaṅktiḥ purataḥ ' ( pi. sū. 3. 40 ) iti |
yadi purataḥ purastāt dvau jāgatau pādau syātām anyau gāyatrau sā prastārapaṅktiriti |
āditastrayaḥ pādā ekādaśakā anyo'ṣṭakaḥ sā virāḍpetyucyate |
ā varṣiṣṭhayā na iṣā vayo na patata sumāyāḥ ||
ā | vidyunmat'bhiḥ | marutaḥ | su'arkaiḥ | rathaibhiḥ | yāta | ṛṣṭimata'bhiḥ | aśva'parṇaiḥ |
ā | varṣiṣṭhayā | naḥ | iṣā | vayeḥ | na | patata | su'māyāḥ || 1 ||
he marutaḥ ! mitaṃ nimitamantarikṣaṃ prāpya ravanti śabdaṃ kurvantīti marutaḥ |
athavā mitaṃ svairnimitaṃ meghaṃ prāpya viśuddhātmanā rocamānāḥ |
ye madhyasthāne devagaṇāḥ samājñātāste'sarve marutaḥ ' ākhyāyante |
tathā cāhuḥ- ' sarvā strī madhyasthānā pumān vāyuśca sarvagaḥ |
gaṇāśca sarve maruta iti vṛddhāśāsanam ' iti |
paurāṇikāstavācakṣate- ' mārīcāḥ kaśyapasyamagaṇasaptakā ekonapañcāśatsaṃkhyākā maruto jajñire ' iti |
evaṃbhūtā he marutaḥ ' rathaibhiḥ : ātmīyaiḥ rathaiḥ ' ā yāta asmatadīyaṃ yajñamāgacchata |
vidyutā taḍitā tadbhiḥ svarkaiḥ śobhanagamanaiḥ : ṛṣṭibhiḥ |
aśvaṃ vyāptaṃ parṇaṃ pananaṃ gamanaṃ yeṣām |
māyā iti karmaṇāṃ jñānasya ca nāmadheyam |
pravṛddha- tarayā ' iṣā asmābhyaṃ dātavyenānnena maha ' naḥ |
na pakṣiṇa iva śīghram ' ā patata āpatata āgacchatetyarthaḥ |
atra niruktam- ' athāno madhyasthānā devagaṇāsteṣāṃ prathamāgatāmino bhavanti |

maruto mitarāviṇo vā mitarocino vā mahadravantīti vā ' iti, ' vidyunmadbhirmarutaḥ svarkaiḥ svajñanairiti vā mvarcanairiti vā svarcibhiriti vā rathairyāyāta ṛṣṭibhiraśvaparṇairaśvapatanairvarṣiṣṭhena ca no'nnena vaya ivāpatata sumāyāḥ |
yavāderākṛtigaṇatvena vidyucchabdasya yavādyantarbhāvāt ‘ayavādibhyaḥ’ ityatra anuvṛtteḥ ‘jhayaḥ’ (pā. sū. 8. 2. 10) iti matupo vatvaṃ na pravartate |
tairaruṇebhirvaramā piśaṅgaiḥ śubhe kaṃ yānti rathūtṛbhiraśvaiḥ |
rukmo na citraḥ svadhitīvānpavyā rathasya jaṅghananta bhūm ||
te | aruṇebhiḥ | varam | ā | piśaṅgaiḥ | śubhe | kam | yānti | rathūtṛbhiḥ | aśvaiḥ |
rukmaḥ | na | citraḥ | svadhitiḥ'vān | pavyā | rathasya | jaṅghananta | bhūm || 2 ||

0te pūrvoktā marutaḥ 0aruṇebhiḥ aruṇavarṇaiḥ 0piśaṅgaiḥ piṅgalavarṇairubhayavarṇopetaiḥ 0rathūtṛbhiḥ rathasya prerayitṛbhiḥ 0aśvaiḥ 0varaṃ devānāṃ varītāraṃ 0kaṃ śabdayitāraṃ stuvantaṃ yajamānam 0ā 0yānti āgacchanti |
teṣāṃ marutāṃ gaṇaḥ 0rukmo 0na rocamānaṃ suvarṇamiva 0citraḥ atiśayena darśanīyaḥ 0svadhitīvān |
evaṃvidhagaṇarūpāste marutaḥ 0rathasya 0pavyā cakradhārayā 0bhūm bhūmiṃ 0jaṅghananta atyarthaṃ ghnanti |
stotrarakṣaṇārthamāgatānāṃ teṣāṃ mahatāṃ bhāramasahamānā bhūmiritipīḍitā babhūvetyarthaḥ ||
śriye kaṃ vo ardhi ttanuṣu vāśīrmedhā vanā na kṛṇavanta ūrdhvā |
yuṣmabhyaṃ kaṃ marutaḥ sujātāstuvidyumnāsau dhanayante adrim ||
śriye | kam | vaḥ | ardhi | tanuṣu | vāśīḥ | medhā | vanā | na | kṛṇavanta | ūrdhvā |
yuṣmabhyam | kam | marutaḥ | sujātāḥ | tuvidyumnāsaḥ | dhanayante | adrim || 3 ||
he marutaḥ 'vaḥ yuṣmākaṃ 'tanuṣu śarīradhvaṃsapradeśeṣu 'vāśī: śatrūṇāmākrośakama ārāttyamāyudhaṃ 'śriye 'kam 'īśvaryārtha vartate iti śeṣaḥ |
tādṛśā marutaḥ 'vanā 'na ucchitān vṛkṣasamūhāniva 'medhā medhān yajñān 'ūrdhvā ūrdhvān ekāhāhīnasatrarūpeṇocchitān 'kṛṇvante yajamānaiḥ kārayanti |

he 'sujātāḥ śobhana- jananayuktāḥ 'marutaḥ 'yuṣmabhyaṃ yuṣmadartha 'kaṃ sukhakaram 'adriṃ somābhiṣave pravṛttaṃ prāvāṇaṃ 'tuvidyumnāsaḥ prabhūtadhanā yajamānāḥ 'dhanayante dhanaṃ kurvanti yuṣmākaṃ yāgāya grāvabhirabhipaṇvantītyarthaḥ ||
'chandasyubhayathā' iti ārdhadhātukatvena jhasya aḍittvāt guṇe avādeśaḥ |
ahāni gṛdhrāḥ paryā va āgurīmāṃ dhiyaṃ vākrīyāṃ ca devīm |
brahma kṛṇvanto gortamāso akairūrdhvaṃ nunudra utsadhiṃ pibadhyai ||
ahāni | gṛdhrāḥ | pari | ā | vṛ | ā | aguḥ | imām | dhiyam | vākrīyām | ca | devīm | brahma | kṛṇvantaḥ | gortamāsaḥ | arkaiḥ | ūrdhvam | nunudre | utsadhim | pibadhyai || 4 ||
tṛpitairgautamaiḥ stutā marustebhyo deśāntare vartamānaṃ kūpamukhāyānīya pradaduḥ3 |

aprāyuvaḥ: apragacchantaḥ svakīyaṃ rakṣitavyamaparityajantaḥ ata eva divedive pratidinaṃ rakṣitāraḥ: rakṣāṃ kurvantaḥ evaṃvidhaviśiṣṭāḥ sarve devāḥ: naḥ: asmākaṃ sadam it sadaiva vṛdhe vardhanāya yathā asan bhaveyustathā āgacchantu iti saṃbandhaḥ ||

taduktaṃ yāskena- 'gandharvāḥ pitaro devā asurā rakṣāṃsītyeke catvāro varṇā niṣādaḥ pañcama ityaupamanyavaḥ ' (niru. 3. 8 ) iti |
brāhmaṇe tvevamāmnātaṃ- 'sarveṣāṃ vā etatprajananāmukthaṃ devamanuṣyāṇāṃ gandharvāpsarasāṃ paṇāṃ ca pitṛṇāṃ ca ' (ai. brā. 3. 31 ) iti |
'pañcavidhāḥ pañca janā api 'aditiḥ eva 'jātaṃ jananaṃ prajānāmutpattiḥ sā api 'aditiḥ eva |
asmāt karmaṇi ktini ' ghatisyatimāsthā m ' ( pā. sū. 7. 4. 40 ) iti itvam |
yāskapakṣe tu 'dīṅ kṣaye ' ityasmāt ktini vyatyayena hrasvatvam |
nirdiṣyamānapratinirdiṣyamānayorekatāmāpādayanti sarvamānāni paryāyeṇa talliṅgatāmupādadate ityuddeśya- liṅgatāyā puṃliṅgatvam |
pūrvetra 'vaiśvadevaṃ tu ' ityuktatvāt tuṣṭādiparibhāṣayā idamapi sūktaṃ bahudevatākam |
cāturviṃśike'hani prātaḥsavane maitrāvaruṇasya ' ṛjunītī naḥ 3 ' ityeṣā āra- mbhaṇīyā |
'caturviṃśe ' iti khaṇḍe sūtritam- 'ṛjunītī no varuṇa indra vo viśvataspari ' (āśva. śrau. 7. 2 ) iti |
sūtritaṃ ca- 'ārambhaṇīyāḥ paryāsānddhato'harataḥ śasyānīti hotakā dvitīyādiṣveva ' ( āśva. śrau. 7. 1 ) iti ||
ṛjunītī no varuṇo mitro nayatu vidvān | aryamā devai: sajoṣā: || 1 || ṛju'nītī | naḥ | varuṇaḥ | mitraḥ | nayatu | vidvān | aryamā | devaiḥ | sa'joṣaḥ || 1 ||

aharabhimānī devaḥ 'mitraḥ, 'varuṇaḥ rājyabhimānī ' mitraśca varuṇaśca 'vidvān netavyamuttamaṃ sthānaṃ jānan 'naḥ asmān 'ṛjunītī ṛjunītyā ṛjujanayena kauṭilyarahitena gamanena 'nayatu abhi- mataṃ phalaṃ prāpayatu |
tathā 'devaiḥ anyairindrādibhiḥ 'sajoṣaḥ samānaprītiḥ 'aryamā ahorātravibhāgasya kartā 5 sūryaścāsmānanujagamanenābhimataṃ sthānaṃ prāpayatu ||
te hi vasvo vasavānāste apramūrā mahobhi: | vratā rakṣante viśvāhā || 2 || te | hi | vasvaḥ | vasavānāḥ | te | apramūrāḥ | mahaḥ | ebhiḥ | vratā | rakṣante | viśvāhā ||2||
'te 'hi pūrvoktā mitrādayaḥ 'vasvaḥ vasuno dhanasya 'vasavānāḥ vāsakā ācchādayitāraḥ sarvaṃ jagadutenācchādayantītyarthaḥ |
ataḥ 'te mitrādayaḥ 'apramūrāḥ apramṛcchatā amuḍhāḥ prājñāḥ santaḥ 'mahobhiḥ ātmīyaistejobhiḥ 'viśvāhā sarvāṇyahāni |
sarvairvapyaḥsu 'vratā vratāni jagannirvāha rūpāṇi svakīyāni karmāṇi 'rakṣante pālayanti ||

1. kṣa-janmādhikaraṇaṃ | yadvā jātamutpannaṃ janitvamutpatsyamānaṃ vā yadāsta | 2. kṣa-ṭa-ṭha-sa-itvanpralāyaḥ | 3. kṣa-ṭa-ṭha- 'ṛjunītāṃ naḥ ' iti nāsti | 4. kṣa-ṭe-ṭha-āyā | 5. na-sa-ahorātrasya vibhāgakartā |

anityatvāt numabhāve 'jasādiṣu chandasi vāvacanam' iti 'gherḍiti' iti guṇasya vikalpanādabhāve yaṇādeśaḥ | vasavanāḥ | 'vasa ācchādane' | asmān antarbhāvitaṇyaryāt laṭaḥ śānac | 'bahulaṃ chandasi' iti śapo lugabhāvaḥ | varṇavyāpattyā makārasya vakāraḥ | apramūrāḥ | 'murchā mohasamucchā- yayoḥ' | asmāt saṃpadādilakṣaṇo bhāve kip | 'rāllopaḥ' iti chakāralopaḥ | prakṛṣṭā mūḥ prabhūḥ | tato matvarthīyoraḥ | 'ro ri' ( pā. sū. 8. 3. 14 ) iti rephalopaḥ | na pramūrā apramūrāḥ | avyaya- pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaratvam | rakṣante | 'rakṣa pālane' | vyatyayena taṅ ||
te | asmabhyam | śarma | yaṃsan | amṛtāḥ | martyebhyaḥ | bādhamānāḥ | apa | dviṣaḥ || 3 ||
^amṛtāḥ amaradharmāṇaḥ ^te viśve devāḥ ^martyebhyaḥ maraṇadharmmabhyaḥ ^asmabhyam anuṣṭhātṛbhyaḥ ^śarma amṛtalakṣaṇaṃ sukhaṃ ^yaṃsan yacchantu prayacchantu |
vi naḥ pathaḥ suvitārya ciyanvandrau marutaḥ |
vi | naḥ | pathaḥ | suvitārya | ciyantu | indrāḥ | marutaḥ | pūṣā | bhagaḥ | vandyāsaḥ || 4 ||
^vandyāsaḥ sarvairvandanīyāḥ stotavyā namaskartavyā vā indrādayo devāḥ ^naḥ asmākaṃ ^pathaḥ mārgān ^vi ^ciyantu vicinvantu aśobhanebhyo mārgebhyaḥ sakāśāt pṛthakurvantu |
'gatiranantaraḥ' iti pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaratve prāpte 'sūpamānāt kaḥ' iti uttarapadāntodāttatvam |
tatra caturthe acchāvākātiriktokthe 'uta no dhiyaḥ' ityepā anurūpatṛcasya vaikalpikī tṛtīyā |
sūtritaṃ ca- 'uta no dhiyo goagrā iti vānurūpasyottamā' ( āśva. śrau. 9. 11 ) iti ||
uta | naḥ | dhiyaḥ | go'agrāḥ | pūṣan | viṣṇo iti | evayāvaḥ | kartā | naḥ | svastimataḥ ||5||
he ^pūṣan poṣaka deva he ^viṣṇo vyāpanaśīla deva he ^evayāvaḥ |
he marudgaṇa te sarve yūyaṃ ^naḥ asmākaṃ ^dhiyaḥ asoyāmalakṣaṇāni ṛ. 70
kamāṇi 'goagrāḥ pañcaprāṇi paśupramukhyānyasmatkāśāt aṣṭaiḥ paśubhiryuktāni 'karta kuruta |
aso- ryāmakamarṇaśca paśugrāsihetutvamāmnāyate- 'yasmātpaśavaḥ prameva bhraṃśeran sa etena yajeta' ( tai. brā. 2. 7. 14. 2 ) iti |
asmiñjuppade 'yā prāpaṇe' ityasmāt 'āto manin' iti vanip |
saṃbuddhau 'vana upasaṃkhyānam' ( pā. sū. 8. 3. 1. 1 ) iti nakārasya rūvam |
ṛtvigādyarthamāhṛtaṃ madhuparkaṃ 'madhu vātāḥ' iti tṛcena ṛtvigādiḥ pratigrahītāvekṣeta |
tathā ca sūyate- 'madhu vātā ṛtāyata iti tṛcenāvekṣya' ( āśva. gṛ. 1. 24. 14 ) iti |
madhu vātā ṛtāyate madhu kṣaranti sindhavaḥ | mādhvīrnaḥ santvoṣadhīḥ ||6|| madhu | vātāḥ | ṛtāyate | madhu | kṣaranti | sindhavaḥ | mādhvīḥ | naḥ | santu | oṣadhīḥ ||6||
'ṛtāyate ṛtaṃ yajñamātmana icchate yajamānāya 'vātāḥ vāyavaḥ 'madhu mādhuryopetaṃ karmaphalaṃ 'kṣaranti varṣanti prayacchantītyarthaḥ |
tathā 'sindhavaḥ syandanaśīlā nadyaḥ samudrā vā 'madhu mādhuryo- petaṃ svakīyaṃ rasaṃ kṣaranti' |
evaṃ 'naḥ asmabhyam 'oṣadhīḥ phalapākāntā oṣadhayastāśca 'mādhvīḥ mādhuryopetāḥ 'santu bhavantu |
asmāduttarasya matvarthīyasya 'lukkārekārarephāśca vaktavyāḥ' ( pā. sū. 4. 4. 128. 2 ) iti luk |
opaḥ pākaḥ āsu dhīyate iti oṣadhayaḥ |
madhu naktamutoṣaso madhumatpārthivaṃ rajaḥ | madhu dyaurastu naḥ pitā || 7 || madhu | naktam | uta | uṣasaḥ | madhu'mat | pārthivam | rajaḥ | madhu | dyauḥ | astu | naḥ | pitā ||7||
'uta api ca 'uṣasaḥ uṣaḥ- kālopalakṣitānyahāni ca madhumanti bhavantu |
'pārthivaṃ 'rajaḥ pṛthivyāḥ sambandhī loko'smākaṃ 'madhu- mat mādhuryaviśiṣṭaphalayukto bhavatu |
'pitā vṛṣṭipradānena sarveṣāṃ pālayitā 'dyauḥ dyuloko'pi 'madhu madhuyuktaḥ bhavatu |
'pṛthivyā jājñau' ( pā. sū. 4. 1. 85. 2 ) iti prāgdīvyatīyaḥ apratyayaḥ |
4. kṣa-anyeṣāmapi dṛśyate iti sāṃhitikaṃ dīrghatvam; sa-anyeṣāmapīti saṃhitāyāṃ dīrghatvam |
madhumānno vanaspatirmadhumā~ astu sūryaḥ | mādhvīrgāvo bhavantu naḥ || 8 || madhu'mān | naḥ | vanaspatiḥ | madhu'mān | astu | sūryaḥ | mādhvīḥ | gāvaḥ | bhavantu | naḥ ||8||
^naḥ asmākaṃ ^vanaspatiḥ vanānāṃ pālayitā yūpābhimānī devaḥ ^madhumān mādhuryopetaphalavān ^astu |
^gāvaḥ agnihotrādyarthā dhenavaśca ^naḥ asmākaṃ ^mādhvīḥ mādhuryopetana payasā yuktāḥ ^bhavantu |
śaṃ nau mitraḥ śaṃ varuṇaḥ śaṃ no bhavatvaryamā |
śaṃ na indro bṛhaspatiḥ śaṃ no viṣṇururukramaḥ ||
tvaṃ soma pra ciki taḥ manīṣā tvaṃ ra jiṣṭham anu neṣi panthām |
tava praṇītī pitarau na indo deveṣu ratnamabhajanta dhīrāḥ |
tvam | soma | pra | ciki taḥ | manīṣā | tvam | ra jiṣṭham | anu | neṣi | panthām | tava | pra'nītī | pitarau | naḥ | indo iti | deveṣu | ratnam | abhajanta | dhīrāḥ || 1 ||
he ᵥsoma ᵥtvaṃ ᵥmanīṣā manīṣāsmadīyayā buddhayā ᵥpra ᵥciki taḥ prakarṣeṇa jñātosisi vayaṃ tvāṃ stutibhirajñāsipmetyarthaḥ |
ataḥ ᵥtvaṃ ᵥra jiṣṭham ṛjutamamakuṭilaṃ ᵥpanthāṃ panthānaṃ karmaphalāvāptihetubhūtaṃ mārgam ᵥanu ᵥneṣi asmānanukrameṇa prāpayasi |

kiṃca he ᵥindo undanaśīla sarva jagadamṛtena kledayitaḥ soma ᵥtava ᵥpraṇītī praṇītyā tvatkartṛkena prakṛṣṭanayanena ᵥdhīrāḥ dhīmantaḥ karmavantaḥ prajñāvanto vā ᵥnaḥ asmākaṃ ᵥpitaraḥ ᵥdeveṣu indrādiṣu ᵥratnaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ dhanam ᵥabhajanta asevanta prāpnuvan |
saṃjñāpūrvakasya vidheranityatvāt 'guggo yallukoḥ' iti abhyāsasya guṇābhāvaḥ |
agniṣṭome marutvatīye 'tvaṃ soma kratubhiḥ' ityeṣā dhājyā |
sutritaṃ ca—'agninetā tvaṃ soma kratubhiḥ pinvannaya iti dhājyāḥ' ( āśva. śrau. 5. 14 ) iti |
tvaṃ soma kratubhiḥ sukraturbhūstvaṃ dakṣaiḥ sudakṣo viśvavedāḥ |
tvam | soma | kratubhiḥ | su'kratuḥ | bhūḥ | tvam | dakṣaiḥ | su'dakṣaḥ | viśvavedāḥ | tvam | vṛṣā | vṛṣa'tvebhiḥ | mahi'tvā | yumnebhiḥ | yumnī | abhavaḥ | nṛ'cakṣāḥ || 2 ||
he ᵥsoma ᵥtvaṃ ᵥkratubhiḥ tvatsambandhibhiriṣṭomādikarmabhiḥ ātmīyairyajñairvā ᵥsukratuḥ śobhanakarmā śobhanaprajño vā ᵥbhūḥ bhavasi |
tathā ᵥviśvavedāḥ sarvadhanaḥ ᵥtvaṃ ᵥdakṣaiḥ ātmīyairbalaiḥ ᵥsudakṣaḥ śobhanabalo bhavasi |
tathā ᵥtvaṃ ᵥvṛṣatvebhiḥ vṛṣatvaiḥ kāmābhivarṣarṇaiḥ ᵥmahitvā mahattvena māhātmyena ca ᵥvṛṣā kāmāānāṃ varṣitā mahān bhavasi |
tathā ᵥtvaṃ ᵥnṛcakṣāḥ nṛṇāṃ yajñasya netṛṇāṃ yajamānānāmabhimaṃtaphalasya darśayitā

san vśubhebhiḥ vyunnaiḥ vtairdatairvilekṣagairaiḥ vśubhī vabhavaḥ vprabhūtānno vbhavasi || sukratuḥ | bahuvrīhau ‘ṛtvādyaśca’ ityuttarapadādyudāttatvam | sudakṣaḥ | ‘dakṣa vṛddhau’ | vdakṣyate'neneti vdakṣo vbalam | karaṇe ghañ | vjiravādādyudāttatvam | suśabdena bahuvrīhau ‘ādyudāttaṃ vyacchandasi’ ityuttarapadādyudāttatvam | viśvavedāḥ | vviśvāni vvedāṃsi vyasyāsau | ‘bahuvrīhau vviśvaṃ vsaṃjñāyām’ iti pūrvapadāntodāttatvam | vvṛṣabhebhiḥ | vvṛṣṇo vbhāvo vvṛṣavam | ‘bahulaṃ vchandasi’ iti vbhisaḥ vaisabhāvaḥ | vmahitvā | vmaherauṇādika vinpratyayaḥ | vbhāvapratyayāntāt ‘supāṃ vsuluk’ iti vvibhakteḥ vākāraḥ ||
rājño nu te varuṇasya vratāni bṛhadbhīr tavaṃ soma
yā te dhāmāni divi yā pṛthivyāṃ yā parvateṣvoṣadhīṣvapsu |
tebhirno viśvaiḥ sumanā ahailannrājansòm prati havyā gṛbhāya ||
yā | te | dhāmāni | divi | yā | pṛthivyām | yā | parvateṣu | oṣadhīṣu | apsu | tebhiḥ | naḥ | viśvaiḥ | sumanāḥ | ahailan | rājan | soma | prati | havyā | gṛbhāya || 4 ||
ha soma te tava divi dyuloke yā yāni dhāmāni tejāṃsi vartante |
tathā parvateṣu parvatasthu śiloccayeṣu yāni vartante |
tathā vrīhyādyoṣadhīṣu apsu ca yāni vartante |
tebhiḥ viśvaiḥ taiḥ sarvaistejobhiryuktaḥ sumanāḥ śobhanamanaḥ ahailan akrudhyan he rājan soma rājamāna soma evaṃbhūtastvaṃ havyā asmābhiḥ prattāni havīṃṣi prati gṛbhāya pratigṛhāṇa ||
' oṣadheśca vibhaktāvaprathamāyām ' ( pā. sū. 6. 3. 132 ) iti dīrghaḥ |
' chandasi śāyajapi ' iti hvā pratyayasya śāyajādeśaḥ ||
sūtritaṃ ca - ' agniṃttrāṇi jajñanaditi pūrvasyājyabhāgasyānuvākyā tvaṃ somāsi satpatirityuttarasya ' ( āśva. śrau. 1. 5 ) iti |
evaṃ yatra yatra vātraghnāvājyabhāgau tatra sarvatrāsyā viniyogaḥ |
sūtritaṃ ca - ' tvaṃ somāsi satpatirgaya- sphāno amītrahā ' iti, ' viprāṃso yājyānuvākyānām ' ( āśva. śrau. 4. 8 ) iti ca ||
tvam | soma | asi | satpatiḥ | tvam | rājā | uta | vṛtrahā | tvam | bhadraḥ | asi | kratuḥ ||5||
he soma tvaṃ satpatiḥ asi satāṃ karmasu vartamānānāṃ brāhmaṇānāmadhipatirbhavasi |
' tasmātsomarājāno brāhmaṇāḥ ' ( tai. brā. 1. 7. 4. 2 ) iti śruteḥ |
santaḥ svānādayaḥ patayaḥ pālakā yasya somasya tādṛśo bhavasi |
tathā cāmnāyate - ' svāna ājyelāhate vā amuṣmin loke somamarakṣan ' ( tai. saṃ. 6. 1. 10. 5 ) iti |
tvaṃ api ca rājā rājamānaḥ vṛtrahā vṛtrasyā- surasya śatrorvā hantāsi |
bhadraḥ śobhanaḥ kratuḥ yo'yamabhiṣṭomādiyāgaḥ tvam eva tadrūpo bhavasi |
sāmidhenyai kanāvagrīpomīyasya paśupuroḍāśamanu aṣṭau devasuvāṃ havīṃṣi nirupyante |
tatra somasya vanaspaterhavipaḥ : ' tvaṃ ca soma ' ityeyānuvākyā |
' athāgnīpomīyena ' iti khaṇḍe sūtritaṃ - ' tvaṃ ca soma no vaśo brahmā devānāṃ padavīḥ kavīnām ' ( āśva. śrau. 4. 11 ) iti ||
tvaṃ ca soma no vaśoṃ jīvātūṃ na marāmahe | priyastautro vanaspatiḥ || 6 || tvam | ca | soma | naḥ | vaśaḥ | jīvātūm | na | marāmahe | priya'stautraḥ | vanaspatiḥ ||6||

he soma naḥ asmākaṃ stotṛṇāṃ jīvātūṃ jīvanauṣadhaṃ tvaṃ ca tvaṃ cet vaśaḥ kāmayethāḥ tadānīṃ vayaṃ na marāmahe na mriyāmahe | kīdṛśastvam | priyastotraḥ | priyāṇi stotrāṇi yasya sa tathoktaḥ | bahubhiḥ slotavya ityarthaḥ | vanaspatiḥ vanānāmoṣadhivanaspatirūpāṇāṃ patiḥ pālayitāsi | ‘somo vā oṣadhīnāṃ rājā’ (tai. saṃ. 6. 1. 9. 1) iti śruteḥ || vaśaḥ | ‘vaśa kāntau’ | leṭi sipi adāgamaḥ | āgamānudāttatve dhātusvaraḥ śiṣyate | tvaṃ ceti caśabdaścaṇiti nipātāntaraṃ cedartham | tathogāt ‘nipātairyadyadihanta’ iti nighātapratiṣedhaḥ | jīvātūm | ‘jīva prāṇadhāraṇe’ | ‘jīverātaḥ’ (u. sū. 1. 79) | marāmahe | ‘mṛṅ prāṇatyāge’ | vyatyayena śap ||
āyuṣkāmeṣṭyāṃ dvitīyasyājyabhāgasya ‘tvaṃ soma mahe bhagam’ ityeṣā'nuvākyā |
‘atha kāmyāḥ’ iti khaṇḍe sūtritam- ‘ā no agne sucetunā tvaṃ soma mahe bhagam’ (āśva. śrau. 2. 10) iti ||
tvaṃ soma mahe bhagaṃ tvaṃ yūnaṃ ṛtāyate | dakṣaṃ dadhāsi jīvase || 7 || tvam | soma | mahe | bhagam | tvam | yūnaṃ | ṛta'yate | dakṣam | dadhāsi | jīvase || 7 ||

he soma tvaṃ mahe mahate vṛddhāya ṛtāyate ṛtaṃ yajñamātmana icchate puruṣāya jīvase jīvituṃ dakṣam upabhogasamarthaṃ bhagaṃ dhanaṃ dadhāsi vidadhāsi karoṣi | tathā tvaṃ yūnaṃ taruṇāya ca ṛtāyate jīvituṃ dhanaṃ karoṣi || mahe | mahate | acchadalopaśchāndasaḥ | ‘brahmamahato'pasaṃkhyānam’ iti vibhakterudāttatvam | yūna | ‘śrayuvamaghonāmattaddhite’ iti saṃprasāraṇam | ṛtāyate | ṛtātmana icchati | ‘supa ātmanaḥ kyac’ | ‘na cchandasyaputrasya’ iti ītvadīrghayorniṣedhaḥ | ‘anyeṣāmapi dṛśyate’ iti sāṃhitiko dīrghaḥ | kyajantāt laṭḥ śatṛ | ‘śaturanumo nadyajādī’ iti vibhakterudāttatvam | jīvase | ‘jīva prāṇa- dhāraṇe’ | ‘tumarthe sesena’ iti asepratyayaḥ ||
sūtritaṃ ca- ‘svastyayanāṃ rakṣitavantāvame rakṣā ṇo ahaṃsastvaṃ naḥ soma viśvataḥ’ (āśva. śrau. 2. 10) iti ||
tvaṃ naḥ soma viśvato rakṣā rājanaghāyataḥ | na riṣyeccārvataḥ sakhā || 8 || tvam | naḥ | soma | viśvataḥ | rakṣa | rājan | agha'yataḥ | na | riṣyet | tvā'vataḥ | sakhā ||8||
he soma rājan rājanaśīla tvam aghāyataḥ |
viśvataḥ sarvasmādapi puruṣāt naḥ asmān rakṣa pālaya |
tvāvataḥ svasadṛśasya sakhā sakhyaṃ prāptaḥ puruṣaḥ na riṣyet na vinaśyet kimu vaktavyaṃ tvatsakhā na vinaśyatīti ||

aghaṃ pāpaṃ parepā micchatītyaghāyan | ‘chandasi parecchāyāmapi’ iti kyac | ‘aghāghasyāt’ iti ātvam | riyet | ‘rupa ripa hiṃsāyām’ | svāvataḥ | ‘vatuprakaraṇe yuṣmadasmabhyāṃ chandasi sādṛśya upasaṃkhyānam’ iti vatup | ‘pratyayottarapadayośca’ iti maparyantasya tvādeśaḥ | ‘ā sarvanāmnaḥ’ iti ātvam ||
sūtritaṃ ca- ‘soma yāste mayobhuva iti tisraḥ’ (āśva. śrau. 4. 4) iti |
sūtritaṃ ca- ‘soma yāste mayobhuvo yā te dhāmāni divi yā pṛthivyām’ (āśva. śrau. 2. 9) iti |
sūtritaṃ ca- ‘tvamagne saprathā asi soma yāste mayobhuva iti sannantau’ (āśva. śrau. 10. 6) iti |
soma̭ yāste॒ mayo॒bhuva̭ ū॒taya̭ḥ sa॒nti dā॒śuṣḙ |
soma̭ | yāḥ | te॒ | ma॒ya॒ḥ'bhuva̭ḥ | ū॒taya̭ḥ | sa॒nti | dā॒śuṣḙ | tābhi̭ḥ | na॒ḥ | a॒vi॒tā | bha॒va || 9 ||
he soma te tava saṃbandhinyaḥ dāśuṣe carupuroḍāśādīni dattavate yajamānāya mayobhuvaḥ mayasaḥ sukhasya bhāvayitryaḥ yāḥ ūtayaḥ rakṣāḥ santi vidyante tābhiḥ rakṣābhiḥ naḥ asmākam avitā rakṣatā bhava |
asya utiviśeṣaṇatvena strīliṅgatve ‘bhuvaśca’ (pā. sū. 4. 1. 47) iti ṅīṣ prāpnoti |
tan ‘voto guṇavacanāt’ ityasmāt utaḥ iti taparakaraṇasyānuvartanāt na bhavati |
i॒mam | ya॒jñam | i॒dam | vaca̭ḥ | ju॒ju॒ṣā॒ṇaḥ | u॒pa'ā॒rga॒hi | soma̭ | tvam | na॒ḥ | vṛ॒dhe | bha॒va || 10 ||
he soma tvam imam asmābhiḥ kriyamāṇaṃ yajñam idaṃ vacaḥ idānīṃ kriyamāṇaṃ stuti- lakṣaṇaṃ vacanaṃ jujuṣāṇaḥ sevamānaḥ san upāgahi upāgaccha prācīnavaṃśalakṣaṇaṃ gṛhaṃ prāpnuhi |
prāpya ca naḥ asmākaṃ vṛdhe yajñasya vardhanāya bhava |
‘asiddhavadatrā bhāt’ iti asya asiddhatvāt heḥ lugbhāvaḥ |
sūtritaṃ ca- ‘agniḥ praṇena manmanā soma gīrbhirvā vayam’ (āśva. śrau. 1. 5) iti |
soma̭ | gī॒ḥ'bhiḥ | tvā॒ | va॒yam | vardha̭yāmaḥ | vaca̭ḥ'vida̭ḥ | su॒'mṛ॒ḻī॒kaḥ | na॒ḥ | ā | vi॒śa || 11 ||
he ᵥsoma ᵥtvā ᵥtvā ᵥvacovidaḥ stutilakṣaṇānāṃ vacasāṃ veditāraḥ ᵥvayam anuṣṭhātāraḥ ᵥgīrbhiḥ stutilakṣaṇairvacobhiḥ ᵥvardhayāmaḥ pravṛddhaṃ kurmaḥ |
tādṛśastvaṃ ca ᵥnaḥ asmākaṃ ᵥsumṛḻīkaḥ śobhanaṃ sukhaṃ kurvan san ᵥā ᵥviśa āgaccha ||
' mṛḍeḥ kīkankanau ' ( u. sū. 4. 464 ) iti bhāve kīkanpratyayaḥ |
śobhanaṃ mṛḍīkaṃ yasyeti bahuvrīhau ' nañsubhyām ' ityuttarapadānto- dāttatvam ||
sūtritaṃ ca- ' puṣṭimantāvagninā rayimakṣavadgayasphāno amīvahā ' ( āśva. śrau. 2. 1 ) iti |
evaiva prātaḥkālīnopasadi saumyayāgasya yājyā sāyaṃkālīnāyāṃ svanuvākyā |
sūtritaṃ ca ' athopasat ' iti khaṇḍe- ' tvaṃ somāsi saspatirgayasphāno amīvahā ' ( āśva. śrau. 4. 8 ) iti ||
gayasphānaḥ | amīvahā | vasuvit | puṣṭivardhanaḥ | sumitraḥ | soma | naḥ | bhava ||12||
dhanasya vardhayitā ᵥamīvahā amīvānāṃ rogāṇāṃ hantā ᵥvasuvit stotṝṇāṃ dhanasya lambhayitā prāpayitā ᵥpuṣṭivardhanaḥ puṣṭeḥ saṃpado vardhayitā ᵥsumitraḥ |
śobhanāni mitrāṇi sakhāyo yasya sa tathoktaḥ |
he ᵥsoma tvaṃ ᵥnaḥ asmākam evaṃguṇaviśiṣṭaḥ ᵥbhava ||
soma rārandhi noṃ hṛdi gāvo na yarvaseṣvā |
soma | rarandhi | naḥ | hṛdi | gāvaḥ | na | yarvaseṣu | ā | maryaḥ iva | sve | okye ||13||
he ᵥsoma tvaṃ ᵥnaḥ asmākaṃ ᵥhṛdi hṛdaye ᵥrarandhi ramasva |
yathā gāvaḥ ᵥyavaseṣu śobhanatṛṇeṣu ᵥā ābhimukhyena ramante |
yathā vā martyo maraṇadharmā manuṣyaḥ ᵥsve ᵥokye svakīye okasi gṛhe putrādibhiḥ saha ramate tadvadgammābhirdattena haviṣā nṛmaḥ san asmāsvevāvatiṣṭhasva |
' chandasyubhayathā ' iti heḥ ādhyātukatvena ṅittvābhāvāt ' aditaśca ' iti herdhiḥ |
' serhyapicca ' iti heḥ apittvāt tasyaiva svaraḥ śiṣyate |
' āmantritaṃ pūrvamavidyamānavat ' iti pūrvasyāmantritasya avidyamānavattvāt padātparatvena nighātābhāvaḥ |
' chandasi niṣṭakyaṃ ' ityādau maryaśabdo yatpratyayānto nipātyate |
ucyate samaveyate prāpyate iti okyaṃ gṛham |
yaḥ soma sakhyetarvaṃ rāraṇheva matryaiḥ | taṃ dakṣaḥ sacate kaviḥ || 14 || yaḥ | soma | sakhyetarvaṃ | rāraṇheva | matryaiḥ | tam | dakṣaḥ | sacate | kaviḥ ||14||

ha 'deva dyotamāna 'soma 'tava 'sakhyetardīye sakhitve nimittabhūte sati 'yaḥ 'matryaḥ maraṇadharmā yajamānaḥ 'rāraṇheva raṇati etatsūktarūpeṇa stotreṇa tvāṃ stauti 'taṃ yajamānaṃ 'kaviḥ krāntadarśī 'dakṣaḥ sarvakāryasamarthastvaṃ 'sacate sevase |
' chandasyubhayathā ' iti ārdhadhātukatvāt aci aniṭi lasārvadhātukake vidhīyamānasya abhyastāyudāttattvasyābhāve dhātusvaraḥ śipyate |
uruṣyā ṇo abhirśasteḥ soma ni pāhāṃhasaḥ | sakhā suśeva edhi naḥ || 15 || uruṣya | naḥ | abhirśasteḥ | soma | ni | pāhi | aṃisaḥ | sakhā | suśevaḥ | edhi | naḥ || 15 ||
he 'soma tvaṃ 'naḥ asmān 'abhirśasteḥ abhiśaṃsanāt abhiśāparūpātnindanāt 'uruṣya rakṣa |
.evamasmadīyaṃ pāpaṃ parihala 'suśevaḥ asmabhyaṃ dātavyena śobhanena sukhena yuktaḥ san 'sakhā 'edhi hitakārī bhava ||
tasya ' asiddhavadatrā bhāt ' iti asiddhatvāt ' hujhalyo hedhiḥ ' iti hedhirādeśaḥ ||
grāvastotre ' ā pyāyasva sametu te ' iti tuco viniyuktaḥ |
sūtritaṃ ca- ' ā pyāyasva sametu ta iti tisro sṛjanti tvā daśa kṣipaḥ ' ( āśva. śrau. 5. 12 ) iti |
sūtritaṃ ca- ' ā pyāyasva sametu te saṃ te payāṃsi samu yantu vājāḥ ' ( āśva. śrau. 1. 10 ) iti ||
sūtritaṃ ca- ' ā pyāyasva sametu te saṃ te payāṃsi samu yantu vājā iti camasānāyopādyān ' ( āśva. śrau. 5. 6 ) iti ||
ā pyāyasva sametu te viśvataḥ soma vṛṣṇyam | bhavā vājasya saṃgathe || 16 || ā | pyāyasva | sam | etu | te | viśvataḥ | soma | vṛṣṇyam | bhava | vājasya | sam'gathe || 16 ||
'te tava 'vṛṣṇyaṃ vṛṣatvaṃ vīryaṃ sāmarthyaṃ 'viśvataḥ sarvataḥ 'sametu saṃgacchatāṃ tvayā saṃyuktaṃ bhavatu |
sakhyuryaḥ iti bhāve yapratyayaḥ ' itya- dhikam |

bhavaṃ vṛṣṇyam | ' bhave chandasi ' iti yat | ' alopo'naḥ ' iti akāralopaḥ | ' ye cābhāvakarmaṇeḥ ' iti prakṛtibhāvastu vyatyayena na pravartate | ' yato'nāvaḥ ' ityadyudāttatvam | bhava | ' aco'tastihaḥ ' iti saṃhitāyāṃ dīrghatvam | saṃgathe | ' pātṛdivāci ' ityadinā vidhīyamānaḥ thakpratyayo bahulavacanāt gamerapi bhavati | tāthādinā uttarapadāntodāttatvam ||
ā | pyāyasva | madin'tam | somam | viśvebhiḥ | aṃśu'bhiḥ | bhava | naḥ | suśravaḥ'tamaḥ | sakhā | vṛdhe || 17 ||
he madintam atiśayena madavan soma viśvebhiḥ sarvaiḥ aṃśubhiḥ latāvayavaiḥ ā pyāyasva ā saman
‘uttamaśaśvattabhau sarvatra’ (pā. sū. 6. 1. 160. ga.) iti ucchādiṣu pāṭhāt antodāttatvam |
‘sudhita vasudhita nemadhita dhiṣva dhipīya ca’ (pā. sū. 7. 4. 45) iti dhibhāvo nipātyate ||
sūtritaṃ ca- ‘yā te dhāmāni haviṣā yajantīmāṃ dhiyaṃ śikṣamāṇasya deveti nihite paridadhyāt’ (āśva. śrau. 4. 4) iti |
‘pradānānām’ iti khaṇḍe sūtritam-apāḍhaṃ yutsu pṛtnāsu pṛmi yā te dhāmāni haviṣā yajanti’ (āśva. śrau. 3. 7) iti ||
yā te dhāmāni haviṣā yajanti tā te viśvā paribhūrastu yajñam |
gayasphānaḥ prataraṇaḥ suvīro'vīrahā pra carā soma duryān ||
yā | te | dhāmāni | haviṣā | yajanti | tā | te | viśvā | paribhūḥ | astu | yajñam | gaya'sphānaḥ | pra'taraṇaḥ | su'vīraḥ | avīra'hā | pra | cara | soma | duryān || 19 ||

he soma te tvadīyāni yā yāni dhāmāni śubhrabhṛtitvavasthitāni tejāṃsi haviṣā caruparodāśādinā yajanti yajamānāḥ pūjayanti tā te viśvā svadīyāni tāni sarvāṇi dhāmāni yajñam asmadīyamadhvaraṃ paribhūrastu parito bhāvayitṝn pūritaḥ prāsāni santu |
tvadīyānāṃ teṣāṃ sarveṣāṃ dhāmnāmasmadīyo yajamānaḥ paribhūryajñaṃ prati parigrahītā yāgena svīkartā astu bhavatu |
gayasphānaḥ gayasya gṛhasya dhanasya vā vardhayitā prataraṇaḥ prakarṣeṇa duritāt tārayitā suvīraḥ śobhanaiḥ vīrairyupetaḥ avīrahā |
gaya iti gṛhasya dhanasya ca nāmadheyam |
‘kṛtyalyuṭo bahulam’ iti katari lyuṭi chāndaso yalopaḥ |
mahāpitṛyajñe somasya pitṛmato yāge ‘somo dhenum’ ityeṣā dvitīyānuvākyā |
tatra hokaikasya haviṣo dve dve anuvākye samuccayena vihite |
tathaiva ‘dakṣiṇāgneḥ’ iti khaṇḍe sūtritam- ‘somo dhenuṃ somo arvanatamāśūṃ tvaṃ soma pitṛbhiḥ saṃvidānaḥ’ (āśva. śrau. 2. 19) iti ||

nigame ' (pā. sū. 6. 3. 113) iti nipātanāt ' sahivahoradavarṇasya ' (pā. sū. 6. 3. 112) iti otvābhāvaḥ | ' saheḥ sādaḥ saḥ ' iti ṣatvam | paprim | ' pṛ pālanapūraṇayoḥ ' | ' ādgamahanajanaḥ ' iti kinpratyayaḥ | svarpām | svaḥ svargaṃ sanotīti svarṣāḥ | ' paṇa dāne ' | ' janasanakhana ' iti viṭ | ' viḍnoranunāsikasyāt ' iti ātvam | apsām | apaśabdopapadāt sanoteḥ pūrvavat viṭ | yadvā | ' psā bhakṣaṇe ' | psāti bhakṣayatīti psāḥ | ' kip ca ' iti kip | na vidyate psā asyeti bahuvrīhau ' nabnubhyām ' ityuttarapadantodāttatvam | arepujām | ' janī prādurbhāve ' | pūrvavat viṭ ātvaṃ ca | madama | ' madī harṣe ' | vyatyayena śap ||
tvamimā oṣadhīḥ soma viśvāstvamapo ajanayastvaṃ gāḥ |

( pā. sū. 7. 2. 77 ) iti iḍāgamaḥ | cikitsa | ‘ kita jñāne ’ | ‘ gusijvidbhyaḥ san ’ ( pā. sū. 3. 1. 5 ) | gaviṣṭau | gavāṃ bāṇānāmicchyaḥ eṣaṇāni gamanāni yeṣviti bahuvrīhau pūrvapada - prakṛtisvaratvam || 23 ||
‘ etā u tyāḥ ’ iti aṣṭādaśarcamaṣṭamaṃ sūktaṃ gautamasyārṣam |
tathā cānukrāntam - ‘ etā u tyā būnopasyaṃ caturjagatyādi pañcoṣṇigantaṃ tṛco'ntya āśvinaḥ ’ iti |
prātaranuvāke upasye kratau jāgate chandasyāśvinaśastre ca ‘ etā u tyāḥ ’ iti catasro viniyuktāḥ |
sūtritaṃ ca - ‘ etā u tyā iti catasro jāgatam ’ ( āśva . śrau . 4 . 14 ) iti ||

etā u tyā uṣasaḥ ketumakrata pūrve ardhe rajaso bhānumañjate | niṣkṛṇvānā āyudhānīva dhṛṣṇavaḥ prati gāvo'ruṣīryanti mātaraḥ || 1 || etāḥ | ū~ iti | tyāḥ | uṣasaḥ | ketum | akrata | pūrve | ardhe | rajasaḥ | bhānum | añjate | niḥ|kṛṇvānāḥ | āyudhāni'iva | dhṛṣṇavaḥ | prati | gāvaḥ | aruṣīḥ | yanti | mātaraḥ ||1||
ᵥtyāḥ tāḥ ᵥetāḥ ᵥuṣasaḥ prabhātakālābhimāninyo devatāḥ |
ᵥketum andhakārāvṛtasya sarvasya jagataḥ jñāpakaṃ prakāśam ᵥakrata akṛpata kṛtavatyaḥ |
yasmādevaṃ tasmāt upasaḥ ᵥrajasaḥ antarikṣalokasya ᵥpūrve ᵥardhe prācīnadigbhāge ᵥbhānuṃ prakāśam ᵥañjate vyaktīkurvanti |

ᵥdhṛṣṇavaḥ dharṣaṇaśīlā yoddhāraḥ ᵥāyudhānīva yathā asiprabhṛtīnyāyudhāni saṃskaravanti evaṃ ᵥniṣkṛṇvānāḥ svabhāsā jagatasaṃskurvāṇāḥ ᵥgāvaḥ gamanasvabhāvāḥ ᵥaruṣīḥ ārohamānāḥ ᵥmātaraḥ sūryaprakāśasya nirmātryo jagajjananyo vā upasaḥ ᵥprati ᵥyanti pratidivasaṃ gacchanti |
atra niruktam - ‘ etāstā uṣasaḥ ketumakṛpata prajñānamekasyā eva pūjanārthe bahuvacanaṃ syāt pūrve'rdhe'- ntarikṣalokasya samañjate bhānunā niṣkṛṇvānā āyudhānīva dhṛṣṇavaḥ |
prati yanti gāvo gamanādaruṣīrārocanānmātaro bhāso nirmātryaḥ ’ ( niru. 12.7 ) iti ||
karoterluṅi ‘ mantre ghasa ’ iti cleḥ luk |

udetasaaruṇā bhānavo vṛthā svāyujo aruṣīrgā ayukṣata | arkaṃyuṣāsau vayunāni pūrvathā ruśantaṃ bhānamaruṣīraśiśriyuḥ || 2 || ut | aptan | aruṇāḥ | bhānavaḥ | vṛthā | su'āyujaḥ | aruṣīḥ | gāḥ | ayukṣata | akran | uṣasaḥ | vayunāni | pūrva'thā | ruśantam | bhānam | aruṣīḥ | aśiśriyuḥ ||2||
varuṇā: ārocamānā: vbhānava: auṣasyo dīptaya: vvṛthā anāyāsena svayameva vudapasan udagaman |
tadanantaram vupasa: ca vsvāyuja: sukhena rathe āyoktuṃ śakyā: varupī: śubhavarṇā: vgā: pūrvamusthitān raśmīna īdṛśī: svavāhanabhūtāśrutpadīrgā eva vā vāyukṣata svarathe'yojayan |
evaṃ gobhiryuktaṃ rathamāruhya upasa: vpūrvathā pūrvevatīteṣvaha:sviba vvayunāni sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ jñānāni vakran akārṣu: |
upa:kāle jāte hi sarve prāṇino jñānayuktā bhavanti |
ᵥuṣā: ᵥpeśāṃsi jagatsvāśritāni kṛṇavarṇāni tamāṃsi ᵥadhiādhikyena ᵥvapate chinatti |
sa yathā keśāḥ śeṣeṇa chinatti evamupā apyandhakāraṃ samūlaṃ hinastītyartha: |
sarvairdarśanīyāni rūpāṇyaṣā adhi vapate svātmanyadhikaṃ dhārayati |
evaṃ prathamato'ndhakāraṃ svakiraṇairnirasya ᵥvakṣa: svakīyamura:pradeśam ᵥaporṇute tamasānācchāditaṃ karoti |
ᵥvarjahaṃ2 payasa utpattisthānaṃ dohanasamaye ᵥustrā1 gauryathā3āviṣkaroti tadvat |
ᵥgāvo ᵥna ᵥvrajaṃ yathā gāva: svakīyaṃ goṣṭhaṃ svayameva śīghraṃ vyāmuvanti4 evaṃ svayameva prācīṃ diśaṃ prāpya ᵥviśvasmai ᵥbhuvanāya sarvasmai lokāya ᵥjyoti: ᵥkṛṇavatī prakāśaṃ kurvantī |
evamuntena prakāreṇoṣā: ᵥtama: andhakāraṃ ᵥvi ᵥāva: vivṛtamapaśliṣṭamakarot ||
‘khaśaprakaraṇe vātaśunītilagarbhedhvajadhetṛdajahātibhya upasaṃkhyānam’ (pā. sū. 3. 2. 28. 1) iti agarthaśabdopapadādapi ‘kṛlyuṭo bahulam’ iti bahulavacanāt khaśa |
tasya sārvadhātukatvena kartari śapi juhotyādistvāt ślu: |
prātaranuvākasyopasye ṛnau ‘pratyarci:’ iti aṣṭāvanuvākyā: āśvinaśastre ca |
tathā ca ‘sūtritam—‘pratyarcirityaṣṭau vyupā ā vo divijā iti paṭhiti traiṣṭubham (āśva. śrau. 4. 14) iti ||

pratyacīṃ ruśadasyā adarśi vi tiṣṭhate bārdhate kṛṣṇamabhavam | svarūṃ na peśau vidatheṣvañścitraṃ divo duhitā bhānumaśret || 5 || prati | arci: | ruśat | asyā: | adarśi | vi | tiṣṭhate | bārdhate | kṛṣṇam | abhvam | svarūm | na | peśa: | vidatheṣu | añjan | citram | diva: | duhitā | bhānum | aśret ||5||
ᵥasyā: upasa: ᵥruśat dīpyamānam ᵥarci: teja: ᵥprati ᵥadarśi sarvai: pūrvasyāṃ diśi prathamato dṛśyate6 |
ᵥvi ᵥtiṣṭhate sarvāsu dikṣu vividhamavatiṣṭhate vyāpnotītyartha: |
atiśayena vipulaṃ ᵥkṛṣṇaṃ kṛṣṇavarṇamandhakāraṃ ᵥbādhate apasārayati |
ᵥvidatheṣu yajñeṣu ᵥsvarūṃ ᵥna svarunāmnā śakalena yuktaṃ yūpaṃ yathā ājyena ādhvaryava: ᵥañjan añjanti tadvadbhasi svakīyaṃ ᵥpeśa: rūpam uṣā anakti saṃśliṣṭaṃ karoti |
tadanantaraṃ ᵥcitraṃ cāyanīyaṃ ᵥbhānuṃ sūrya ᵥdivo ᵥduhitā dyulokādutpannoṣā: ᵥaśret asevata ||

vyurṇvatī divo antāṃ abodhyapa svasāraṃ sanutaryuyoti | praminatī manuṣyā yugāni yoṣā jārasya cakṣasā vi bhāti || 11 || vi'ūrṇvatī | diva: | antān | abodhi | apa | svasāram | sanutaḥ | yuyoti | pra'minatī | manuṣyā | yugāni | yoṣā | jārasya | cakṣasā | vi | bhāti || 11 ||
ᵥdiva: nabhasa: ᵥantān prāntān ᵥvyurṇvatī vivṛtāntamasā viyuktān kurvatyuṣā: ᵥabodhi svai: prāṇibhirajñāpi jñātābhūt |

ᵥmanuṣyā manuṣyāṇāṃ sambandhīni ᵥyugāni kṛtatretādīni ᵥpraminatī svagamanagamanābhyāṃ prakarṣeṇa hiṃsantī ᵥjārasya rātrerjarjayitu: sūryasya ᵥyoṣā jāyoṣā: ᵥcakṣasā ātmīyena prakāśena ᵥvi ᵥbhāti viśeṣeṇa prakāśate |

praśūna citrā subhagā prathānā sindhurna kṣoda urviyā vyathait | abhinatī daivyāni vratāni sūryasya ceti raśmibhirdṛśānā || 12 || praśūna | na | citrā | su'bhagā | prathānā | sindhu: | na | kṣoda: | urviyā | vi | athait | abhinatī | daivyāni | vratāni | sūryasya | ceti | raśmibhi: | dṛśānā || 12 ||
ᵥsubhagā śobhanadhanā ᵥcitrā cāyanīyā pūjanīyoṣā: ᵥpraśūna yathā paśūna gopālako'raṇye vistārayati tathā ᵥprathānā tejāṃsi vistārayantī ᵥurviyā urvī mahatī evaṃbhūtā sā ᵥvyathait sava jagat vyāpnot |
saivoṣā: ᵥsūryasya ᵥraśmibhi: kiraṇai: saha ᵥdṛśānā dṛśyamānā satī ᵥceti prajñātā āsīt |
ᵥdaivyāni devasambandhīni ᵥvratāni darśapaurṇamāsādīni karmāṇi ᵥabhinatī ahiṃsatī |
upasa: prādurbhāvānantaraṃ hi agnihotrādīni sarvāṇi karmāṇyanuṣṭhīyante na rātrau |
' na sāyamati devā ajuṣṭam ' ( ṛ. saṃ. 5. 77. 2 ) iti śrute: |

asmāt antarbhāvitaṇyarthāt tācchīlikāḥ cānaś | ‘bahulaṃ chandasi’ iti śapo luk | sindhuḥ | ‘syandū prasravaṇe’ | ‘syandeḥ samprasāraṇaṃ dhaśca’ (u.sū. 1.11) iti upratyayaḥ | ‘nit’ ityanuvṛtterādyudāttatvam | athait | ‘duośva gativṛddhyoḥ’ | luṅi aṅ‌chaurvikalpitatvāt (pā. sū. 3.1.58; 49) caleḥ sic | āgamānuśāsanasyānityatvāt iḍabhāvaḥ | ‘sici vṛddhiḥ’ (pā. sū. 7.2.1) | aniṭtvāt ‘hayantakṣaṇa’ iti vṛddhipratiṣedhābhāvaḥ | ‘bahulaṃ chandasi’ (pā. sū. 7.3.97) iti īḍāgamābhāvaḥ | ‘skoḥ saṃyogādyoḥ’ iti salopaḥ | ceti | ‘citī saṃjñāne’ | karmaṇi luṅi ‘bahulaṃ chandasamāṅ‌yoge'pi’ iti aḍabhāvaḥ | haśānā | dṛśeḥ karmaṇi laṭaḥ śānaś | ‘bahulaṃ chandasi’ iti vikaraṇasya luk ||
prātaranuvākasyopasthe ṛtāvauṣṇihe chandasi ‘upastaccitram’ iti tṛce viniyuktaḥ āśvinaśastre ca |
‘athosthaḥ’ iti khaṇḍe sūtritam- ‘upastaccitramā bhareti tisra auṣṇiham’ (āśva. śrau. 4. 14) iti ||

idānīṃ prabhātasamaye 'iha asmin deśe 'asme asmākaṃ 'revata dhanayuktaṃ karma yathā bhavati tathā 'vyuccha neśaṃ tamo nivāraya ||

ᵛgomat bahubhirgobhiryuktaṃ ᵛhiraṇyavat hitaramaṇīyadhanayuktaṃ ca yathā bhavati tathā ᵛsamanasā samānamanaskau santau yuvāṃ yuṣmadīyaṃ ᵛratham ᵛarvāk avācīnam asmadīyagṛhamabhimukhaṃ ᵛni ᵛyacchatam āvartayatam ||

ᵛupabudhaḥ upasi prabuddhā adhvāḥ ᵛiha asmin yāge ᵛsomapītaye somapānāya ᵛdasā śatrūṇāmupakṣa- payitārāvaśvinau ᵛā ᵛvahantu ānayantu |
ᵛdevā devanaśīlau dānādiguṇayuktau vā ᵛmayobhuvā mayasa ārogyapradasya sukhasya bhāvayitārau2 |

‘agnīṣomau’ iti dvādaśacaṃ navamaṃ sūktaṃ gotamasyārṣam | āditastisro'nuṣṭubhaḥ | navamyādyāstisro gāyatryaḥ | aṣṭamī jagatau triṣṭubhā | śiṣṭāḥ pañca triṣṭubhaḥ | agnīṣomau devatā | tathā cānukrāntam-
' agnīṣomau dvādaśāgnīṣomīyamādyāstisro'nuṣṭubha upānyāstisro' gāyatryo'ṣṭamī' jagatī vā ' iti |
sūtritaṃ ca-' agnīṣomāvimaṃ su me yuvametāni divi rocanānīti tṛcau ' ( āśva. śrau. 3. 8 ) iti ||
agnīṣomāvimaṃ su me śṛṇutaṃ vṛṣaṇā harvam |
prati sūktāni haryataṃ bhavataṃ dāśuṣe maryaḥ ||
agnīṣomau | imam | su | me | śṛṇutam | vṛṣaṇā | harvam | prati | su'uktāni | haryatam | bhavatam | dāśuṣe | maryaḥ || 1 ||
^vṛṣaṇā vṛṣaṇau kāmānāṃ varṣitārau ha ^agnīṣomau ^imam idānīṃ prayujyamānaṃ ^me madīyaṃ ^havam āhvānaṃ ^su ^śṛṇutaṃ samyagavagacchatam |
^sūktāni śobhanāni stutilakṣaṇānyasmābhiḥ kṛtāni vacāṃsi ^prati ^haryataṃ pratyekaṃ kāmayethām |
tadanantaraṃ ^dāśuṣe carupuroḍāśādīni dattavate yajamānāya ^maryaḥ mayasaḥ sukhasya dātārau ^bhavatam ||
dvandve ' īdagneḥ somavaruṇayoḥ ' ( pā. sū. 6. 3. 27 ) iti īttvam |
' agneḥ stustomasomāḥ ' ( pā. sū. 8. 3. 82 ) iti padatvam |
' devatādvandve ca ' ityubhayapadaprakṛtisvare prāpte ' āmantritasya ca ' ityādyudāttatvam |
' bhāve'nupasargasya ' iti hyateḥ aṇ samprasāraṇaṃ ca |
yadā paurṇamāsyāmagnīṣomāvupāṃśuyājasya devatā tadānīm ' agnīṣomā yo adya ' iti tarayānu-vākyā |
sūtritaṃ ca ' uktā devatāḥ ' iti khaṇḍe—' agnīṣomā yo adya vāmānyaṃ divo mātariśvā jabhāra ' ( āśva. śrau. 1. 6 ) iti ||
agnīṣomā yo adya vāmidaṃ varcaḥ saparyati |
tasmai dhatta suvīryaṃ gavāṃ poṣaṃ svaśvaryam ||
agnīṣomā | yaḥ | adya | vām | idam | varcaḥ | saparyati | tasmai | dhattam | suvīryam | gavām | poṣam | su'aśvaryam || 2 ||

he ^agnīṣomau ^yaḥ yajamānaḥ ^adya asmin karmaṇi ^vāṃ yuvābhyāṃ yuṣmadartham ^idaṃ stutilakṣaṇaṃ ^vacaḥ vākyaṃ ^saparyati pūjitaṃ karoti ^tasmai yajamānāya ^gavāṃ paśūnāṃ ^poṣam abhivṛddhiṃ ^dhattaṃ prayacchatam |
' sāvekācaḥ ' iti prāptasya vibhaktyudāttatvasya ' na gośvannāvavarṇa ' iti pratiṣedhaḥ ||
agnīṣomā ya āhutiṃ yo vāṃ dāśādviṣkṛtima |
agnīṣomā | yaḥ | ā'hutim | yaḥ | vām | dāśāt | haviḥ'kṛtima | saḥ | pra'jayā | su'vīryam | viśvam | āyuḥ | vi | aścavat || 3 ||
he agnīṣomau yaḥ yajamānaḥ āhutim ājyāhutiṃ vāṃ yuvābhyāṃ dāśāt dadyāt |
athavā haviḥ- kṛtiṃ haviṣā carupuroḍāśādinā kṛtām āhutiṃ yaḥ yajamāno dadyāt |
saḥ yajamānaḥ prajayā putrapautrādinā yuktaṃ suvīryaṃ śobhanavīryayuktaṃ viśvaṃ sarvam āyuḥ jīvanaṃ vyaśvavat vyāpnotu |
juhoteḥ ktini ' tādau ca ' iti gateḥ prakṛtisvaratvam |
agnīṣomā ceti tadvīryaṃ vāṃ yadamuṣṇītamavasaṃ paṇiṃ gāḥ |
agnīṣomā | ceti | tat | vīryam | vām | yat | amuṣṇītam | avasam | paṇim | gāḥ | ava | atitaram | bṛsayasya | śeṣaḥ | avindatam | jyotiḥ | ekam | bahubhyaḥ || 4 ||
he agnīṣomau vāṃ yuvayoḥ tat vakṣyamāṇaṃ vīryaṃ sāmarthyaṃ ceti asmābhirjñātamabhūt |
yat yena vīryeṇa gāḥ avasaṃ gorūpamannaṃ paṇiṃ paṇeḥ |
' śeṣa ityapatyanāma śiṣyate prayatnaḥ ' ( niru. 3. 2 ) iti yāskaḥ |
tathā cāmnāyate- ' tasmājjñabhyamānādagnīṣomau nirakrāmatāṃ prāṇāpānau vā enaṃ tadajahitām ' ( tai. saṃ. 2. 5. 2. 4 ) iti |
tato vṛtravadhaാനntaraṃ jyotiḥ dyotamānaṃ sūryam ekaṃ nabhasi gacchantaṃ bahubhyaḥ janebhyo bahunāmarthāya avindatam alpasthānām |
etat sarvaṃ yena vīryeṇa kriyate tadasmābhirjñātamityarthaḥ ||
luḍi ' ciṇ bhāvakarmaṇoḥ ' ( pā. sū. 3. 1. 66 ) iti cleḥ ciṇādeśaḥ |
' iṇbhīkāpāśalyatimarcibhyaḥ kan ' ( u. sū. 3. 123 ) iti kanpratyayaḥ |
agnīṣomīyasya paśorvapāpuroḍāśahaviṣāṃ 'yuvametāni' iti ādyāstisra ṛcaḥ krameṇa yājyāḥ |
'uktā devatāḥ' iti khaṇḍe sūtritaṃ- 'yuvametāni divi rocanānīndrāgnī avasā gatam' (āśva. śrau. 1. 6) iti ||
yuvametāni divi rocanānyamiśra soma sakratū adhattam |
yuvam | etāni | divi | rocanāni | agniḥ | ca | soma | sakratū iti sa'kratū | adhattam | yuvam | sindhūn | abhi'śasteḥ | avadyāt | agnīṣomau | amuñcatam | gṛbhītān || 5 ||
he soma tvam amiśra sakratū samānakarmāṇau santau 'yuvaṃ yuvāṃ 'rocanāni rocanānāni dīpyamānāni 'etāni asmābhirniśi dṛśyamānāni tārāmahādīni jyotīṃpi 'divi dyuloke 'adhattam adhārayatam |
indro vṛtraṃ hatvā brahmahatyāyā bhītaḥ san pṛthivyāṃ vṛkṣeṣu strīṣvapsu ca tāṃ brahmahatyāṃ nyāmākṣīt tāsāmapāṃ śuddhignīṣomābhyāṃ jāteti |
brahmahatyāṃśena pāpena 'gṛbhītān gṛhītānākrāntān 'sindhūn nadīviśeṣān he 'agnīṣomau yuvām 'abhiśasteḥ abhiśasyamānādabhitaḥ prakaṭhitāt 'avadyāt tasmāt pāpāt 'amuñcataṃ muktavantau |
vṛtraḥ indreṇa hataḥ san nadīṣu papāta |
tato mṛtena vṛtraśarīreṇa nadyaḥ sarvā duṣṭā babhūvuḥ |
tathā ca taittarīyakama--'indro vṛtramahan so'po'bhyadhriyata tāsāṃ yanmedhyaṃ yajñiyaṃ sadaivamāsīttadapodakrāmat' (tai. brā. 3. 2. 5. 1) iti |
ānyaṃ divo mātariśvā jabhārāmadhādanyaṃ pari śyeno adreḥ |
agnīṣomā brahmaṇā vāvṛdhānoruṃ yajñāya cakrathuru lokam ||
