āpaśca mitraṃ dhiṣaṇā ca sādhandevā agniṃ dhārayandraviṇodām ||
saḥ | pratnathā | sahasā | jāyamānaḥ | sadyaḥ | kāvyāni | baṭ | adhatta | viśvā | āpaḥ | ca | mitram | dhiṣaṇā | ca | sādhan | devāḥ | agnim | dhārayan | draviṇaḥ'dām || 1 ||

sahasā balena jāyamānaḥ nirmanthanenotpadyamānaḥ saḥ agniḥ sadyaḥ tadānīmutpatyanantarameva pratnathā pratna iva ciraṃtana iva viśvā viśvāni sarvāṇi kāvyāni kaveḥ krāntadarśinaḥ pragalbhasya karmāṇi baṭ satyam adhatta adhārayat |
pūrvaṃ vidyamāna ivābhirūpatisamakālameva svakīyaṃ havirvahanādikaṃ sarvaṃ kāryamakarodityarthaḥ |
imamagniṃ vaiśvānararūpeṇa vartamānaṃ meghevvavasthitāḥ āpaśca dhiṣaṇā
'ca yā mādhyamikī vāk sā ca 'mitra sakhibhūtaṃ 'sādhan sādhayanti kurvanti |
tamimaṃ 'draviṇodāṃ draviṇasya dhanasya dātāram 'agni 'devāḥ ṛtvijaḥ 'dhārayan gārhapatyādirūpeṇa dhārayanti |
devā 'evendrādaya imamagniṃ draviṇodāṃ havilakṣaṇasya dhanasya dātāraṃ kṛtvā dūtye dhārayan dhārayanti |
sa pūrvayā nividā kavyatāyorimāḥ prajā aṃjanayanmanūnām |
vivasvatā cakṣasā dyāmpaśca devā agni dhārayandraviṇodām |
saḥ | pūrvayā | nividā | kavyatā | āyoḥ | imāḥ | prajāḥ | aṃjanayat | manūnām | vivasvatā | cakṣasā | dyām | apaḥ | ca | devāḥ | agnim | dhārayan | draviṇaḥ'dām ||2||

'saḥ agniḥ 'pūrvayā prathamayā 'abhidaṃvedaḥ' ityādikā 'nividā 'kavyatā guṇiniṣṭhaguṇā- bhidhānalakṣaṇāṃ stutiṃ kurvatā 'āyoḥ manoḥ saṃbandhinokthena ca stūyamānaḥ so'gniḥ 'manūnāṃ saṃbandhinauḥ 'imāḥ 'prajāḥ 'ajanayat udapādayat |
manunā stutaḥ san mānavīḥ sarvāḥ prajā ajanayadityarthaḥ |
tathā ' 'vivasvatā vivāsanavatā viśeṣeṇācchādayatā 'cakṣasā ātmīyena tejasā 'dyāṃ dyulokam 'apaśca antarikṣaṃ ca vyāpnotīti śeṣaḥ |
ūrjaḥ putraṃ bharataṃ supradātuṃ devā agni dhārayandraviṇodām |
tam | īḻata | prathamam | yajña'sādham | viśaḥ | ārīḥ | ā'hutam | ṛñjānam | ūrjaḥ | putram | bharatam | supra'dānum | devāḥ | agnim | dhārayan | draviṇaḥ'dām || 3 ||
he 'viśaḥ sarve manuṣyāḥ 'ārīḥ agniṃ svāminaṃ gacchantyo yūyaṃ 'tam agnim 'īḻata studhvam |
'prathamaṃ sarveṣu deveṣu mukhyaṃ 'yajñasādhaṃ yajñasya darśapūrṇamāsādeḥ sādhakaṃ niṣpādakaṃ 'āhutaṃ havirbhistarpitaṃ 'ṛñjānaṃ stotraiḥ prasādyamānaṃ 'ūrjaḥ annasya 'putram |

agnerannaputratvam | 'bharataṃ haviṣyo bhaṃtāram | yadvā | prāṇarūpeṇa sarvāsāṃ prajānāṃ bhaṃtāram | śrūyate ca- 'svadehe' vā eṣa prāṇo bhūtvā prajā bibharti tasmādeṣa bharataḥ' iti | 'sapradānuṃ sarpaṇaśīladānayukpham | avicche- dena dhanāni prayacchantamītyarthaḥ | devāḥ ityādi gatam || īḻata | 'īḍa stutau' | loṭi vyatyayena parasmai- padam | 'bahulaṃ chandasi' iti śapo lugabhāvaḥ | yajñasādham | yajñaṃ sādhayatīti yajñasāt | sādhayateḥ kip | 'geraniṭi' iti ṇilopaḥ | ārīḥ | 'ṛ gatau' | 'sūcisūtri' (pā. ma. 3. 1. 22. 3) ityādinā yaṅ | 'yaḍe'ci ca' iti caśabdena bahulagrahaṇānukarṣaṇāt anaimittiko luk | pratyayalakṣaṇena dvirbhāve uradavahalādiśeṣau | 'rumako ca lki' iti ruk | yaḍlugantāt auṇādikaḥ

'naktoṣāsā rātrirahaśca 'varṇaṃ svakīyaṃ svarūpam' 'āmemyāne parasparaṃ punaḥpunarhaṃsanyau 'samīcī saṃgate saṃśliṣṭe 'evaṃbhūte ahastriyāme 'ekaṃ 'śiśum ahaḥ putramagniṃ 'dhāpayate havīṃṣi pāyayate |
'rukmaḥ rocamānaḥ so'gniḥ 'dyāvākṣāmā dyāvāpṛthivyoḥ 'antaḥ madhye 'vi 'bhāti viśeṣeṇa prakāśate |

asmāt ṇyantāt 'nigaraṇa- calana' ' (pā. sū. 1. 3. 87) iti prāptasya parasmaipadasya 'pādiṣu gheṭa upasaṃkhyānam' ' (pā. sū. 1. 3. 89. 1) iti vacanāt 'na pādyāḍyām' ' (pā. sū. 1. 3. 89) iti pratiṣedhaḥ |
adupadeśāt lasārvadhātukānudāttatve ṇica eva svaraḥ śiṣyate |
'uda īt' ' (pā. sū. 6. 4. 139) iti vidhīyamānam ītvaṃ sama uttarasyāpyantevyatyayena bhava- tīti |
rāyo buṣnaḥ saṃgamano vasūnāṃ yajñasya keturmanuṣasādhano veḥ |
amṛtatvaṃ rakṣamāṇāsa enaṃ devā agniṃ dhārayandraviṇodām ||
rāyaḥ | buṣnaḥ | sam'gamanaḥ | vasūnām | yajñasya | ketuḥ | manuṣa'sādhanaḥ | veḥ | amṛta'tvam | rakṣamāṇāsaḥ | enam | devāḥ | agnim | dhārayan | draviṇaḥ'dām || 6 ||

'vasūnāṃ nivāsahetūnāṃ' dhanānāṃ 'saṃgamanaḥ saṃgamayitā stotṝṇāṃ prāpayitā 'yajñasya darśapūrṇamāsādeḥ 'ketuḥ keta- yitā jñāpayitā 'veḥ ātmānamabhigacchataḥ puruṣasya 'manasādhanaḥ mananīyasyābhilaṣitasya sādhayitā 'amṛtatvaṃ svakīyāmaratvaṃ 'rakṣamāṇāsaḥ pālayantaḥ 'devāḥ 'enaṃ dhanasya dātāram 'agniṃ dhārayanti |

nū ca purā ca sadanaṃ rayīṇāṃ jñātasya ca jāyamānasya ca kṣām | sutaśca gopāṃ bhavataśca bhūrerdevā agniṃ dhārayandraviṇodām || 7 || nu | ca | purā | ca | sadanam | rayīṇām | jñātasya | ca | jāyamānasya | ca | kṣām | sutaḥ | ca | gopām | bhavataḥ | ca | bhūreḥ | devāḥ | agnim | dhārayan | draviṇaḥ'dām ||7||
nū ca iti nipātasamudāyaḥ adya ityasyārthe |
'nū ciditi nipātaḥ purāṇavayornū ca' ( niru. 4.17 ) iti yāskaḥ |

'nū 'ca adya asminkāle 'purā 'ca 'rayīṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ dhanānāṃ 'sadanam āvāsasthānaṃ 'jātasya utpannasya kāryajātasya 'jāyamānasya utpadyamānasya 'ca 'kṣāṃ nivāsayitāraṃ 'sataśca sarvatra 'vidyamānasvabhāvasya nityasya cākāśādeḥ 'bhavataśca sañjātaṃ prāptavataḥ 'bhūreḥ asaṃkhyātasya anyasya ca bhūtajātasya 'gopāṃ gopāyitāraṃ rakṣitāraṃ 'draviṇodāṃ dhanapradaṃ evaṃguṇaviśiṣṭam 'agniṃ 'devāḥ 'dhārayan havirvāhatvena dhārayanti |
' verapṛktalopādhala lopo balīyān ' iti pūrvaṃ ' lopo vyorvali ' iti yalopaḥ |
na ca ṇilopasya sthānivattvaṃ, ' na padāntadvivacanavareyalopaḥ ' iti pratiṣedhāt |
draviṇodā draviṇasturasya draviṇodāḥ sanarasya pra yaṃsat |
draviṇodā vīravatīmiṣaṃ no draviṇodā rāsate dīrghamāyuḥ ||
draviṇaḥ'dāḥ | draviṇasaḥ | turasya | draviṇaḥ'dāḥ | sanarasya | pra | yaṃsat |
draviṇaḥ'dāḥ | vīravatīm | iṣam | naḥ | draviṇaḥ'dāḥ | rāsate | dīrgham | āyuḥ || 8 ||
'draviṇodāḥ draviṇasya dhanasya balasya vā dātā agniḥ 'turasya svaramāṇasya calato jaṅgamasya 'draviṇasaḥ dhanasya balasya vā ekadeśaṃ 'pra 'yaṃsat asmabhyaṃ prayacchatu |
tathā 'draviṇodāḥ 'sanarasya sananīyasya saṃbhajanīyasya sthāvararūpasya dhanasyaikadeśaṃ prayacchatu |
api ca 'draviṇodāḥ 'vīravatīṃ vīraiḥ putrādibhiḥ yuktam 'iṣam annaṃ 'naḥ asmabhyaṃ prayacchatu |
evā no agne samidhā vṛdhāno revatpāvaka śravase tri bhā hi |
tanno mitro varuṇo māmahantāmaditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ ||
eva | naḥ | agne | sam | idhā | vṛdhānaḥ | revat | pāvaka | śravase | tri | bhā hi | tat | naḥ | mitraḥ | varuṇaḥ | māmahantām | aditiḥ | sindhuḥ | pṛthivī | uta | dyauḥ || 10||
he śādhaka agne evamasmābhirdattena samidādidravyeṇa vṛdhānaḥ vardhamānaḥ san naḥ asmākaṃ dhanayuktāyānnāya viśeṣeṇa prakāśasva |
asmākaṃ tat annaṃ mitrādayaḥ mamahantāṃ pūjayantāṃ rakṣantvityarthaḥ |
tathā sindhuḥ abdevatā dyāvāpṛthivyau ca mamahantām ||
'apa naḥ' iti aṣṭacaṃ caturthaṃ sūktaṃ kutsasyārṣaṃ gāyatram |
tathā cānukrāntam - 'apa no'ṣṭau śucaye gāyatram' iti |
dīrghajihnī nāma rākṣasī sarvān yajñān babādhe |
tāṃ hantumindro'śaktaḥ san sarvasya mitrabhūtaṃ kutsama- bravīdeṣā tvayā hantavyeti |
taṃ vāgabhyavadat anucitamidaṃ tvayā caritaṃ yattvaṃ sarveṣāṃ mitrabhūtaḥ san krūmakārpīriti |
sa ṛṣiranena sūktenāgniṃ stutvā śoka mapāgama- yat |
tathā ca tāṇḍakam - 'dīrghajihnī vā idaṃ rakṣo yajñahā yajñavālirahyacarat tāmindraḥ kayā cana māyayā hantuṃ nāśaṃsat atha ha sumitraḥ kutsaḥ kalyāṇa āsa tamabravīt' (tā. 13. 6. 9) ityādi |
ata eva hi sūtrakāreṇa bhāradvājena daśame'hani kartavye śāntikarmaṇi yajurvede paṭhitametatsūktaṃ viniyujyate - 'nava' ca suvāhutīrapa naḥ śoṣucadagham' iti ||
apa | naḥ | śoṣucat | agham | agne | śuśudhi | ā | rayim | apa | naḥ | śoṣucat | agham || 1 ||
he agne naḥ asmākam aghaṃ pāpam apa śoṣucat asmato nirgatvāsamadīyaṃ śatruṃ śocayatu |
api cāsmākaṃ rathi dhanam ā samantāt śuśudhi prakāśaya |
aghaṃ śoṣucacca rayiṃ śuśudhi ceti cārthapranīteḥ : 'cādilope vibhāṣā' iti nighātapratiṣedhaḥ |
2. ṭa-ṭha- 'śuciguṇayukto'gniḥ' śuddhābhirvā devatā; na-śuci- guṇako'gnidevatā; kṣa- 'śucitvaguṇayukto'gniḥ' śuddhābhirvā devatā |
sukṣetriyā sugātuyā vasuyā ca yajāmahe| apa naḥ śoṃśucadagham || 2 || sukṣetriyā | sugātuyā | vasuyā | ca | yajāmahe | apa | naḥ | śoṃśucat | agham || 2 ||
‘sukṣetriyā śobhanakṣetrecchayā ‘sugātuyā śobhanamārgecchayā ‘vasuyā ‘ca’ dhanecchayā nimitta- bhūtayā ca ‘yajāmahe agniṃ havirbhiḥ pūjayāmaḥ |
pra yadbhandiśca eṣāṃ prāsmākāṃsya surayaḥ | apa naḥ śoṃśucadagham || 3 || pra | yat | bhandiśca | eṣām | pra | asmākāṃsaḥ | ca | surayaḥ | apa | naḥ | śoṃśucat | agham ||3||
‘yat yathā ‘eṣāṃ stotaṇāṃ madhye'yaṃ kutsaḥ ‘pra ‘bhandiśca prakarṣeṇa stotutamaḥ evam ‘asmā- kāsaḥ āsmākīnāḥ ‘surayaḥ stotāraḥ ‘ca prakarṣeṇa stotṛttamā bhavanti |
‘bhadi kalyāṇe subhe ca’ iti tu’ dhātuḥ |
sthāni- vadādeśo'pi makārāt parasya ākārasya udāttatvam |
ṣaṣṭhībahuvacane'smākaṃśabdasya madhyodāttasya dṛṣṭatvāt sa eva ācāryeṇa anidiśyate ||
pra yattai agne sūryo jāyemahi pra tai vayam | apa naḥ śoṃśucadagham || 4 || pra | yat | te | agne | sūryaḥ | jāyemahi | pra | te | vayam | apa | naḥ | śoṃśucat | agham ||4||
he ‘agne ‘yat yasmāt ‘te tava ‘sūryaḥ stotāraḥ prajāyante putrapautrādirūpeṇa bahuvidhā bhavanti tataḥ ‘vayaṃ ca ‘te tava stotāraḥ santaḥ ‘pra ‘jāyemahi putrapautrādibhirūpeṇa bhavema ||

1. kṣa-na-sa- ‘ca’ nāsti | 2. kṣa-ṭa-ṭha- ‘haviṣā’ nāsti | 3. ga-ā | 4. a-ṭa-ṭha-ma- aghaṃ pāpam | 5. kṣa-ṭa-ṭha-ma- ‘apa’ nāsti | 6. a-ṭa-ṭha- ḍiyājādeśaḥ | 7. kṣa-ṭa-ṭha-bhavanti iti | 8. kṣa-sa- ‘tu’ nāsti | 9. kṣa-ṭa-ṭha-sa-chāndaso'ṇpratyayasya luk | ata eva vṛddhayabhāvaḥ na-chāndaso'ṇ- pratyayasya lopaḥ | āgamānuśāsanasyānityatvāt vṛddhayabhāvaḥ | 10. kṣa-ṭa-ṭha-prāyaṇa |

pra yadagneḥ sahasvato viśvato yanti bhānavaḥ | arpa naḥ śośucadagham || 5 || pra | yat | agneḥ | sahasvataḥ | viśvataḥ | yanti | bhānavaḥ | arpa | naḥ | śośucat | agham ||5|| sahasvataḥ sahanavataḥ śatrūnabhibhavataḥ | agneḥ | bhānavaḥ dīptayaḥ | viśvataḥ sarvataḥ sarvesmādapi pradeśāt | pra yanti prakarṣeṇocchanti | yat yasmādevaṃ tasmāttenābhritejasā asmadīyam aghaṃ naśyatu | yanti | 'iṇo yaṇ' (pā. sū. 6. 4. 81) iti yaṇādeśaḥ ||

tvaṃ hi viśvatomukha viśvataḥ paribhūrasi | arpa naḥ śośucadagham || 6 || tvam | hi | viśvataḥ'mukha | viśvataḥ | pari'bhūḥ | asi | arpa | naḥ | śośucat | agham ||6|| he agne tvaṃ hi tvaṃ khalu viśvatomukhaḥ sarvatojvālaḥ | tava mukhasthānīyānāṃ jvālānāṃ na kutrāpi pratihatirasti | ato he viśvatomukha agne viśvataḥ sarvataḥ sarvasmādupadravajātāt paribhūḥ rasi asmākaṃ parigrahītā bhava | rakṣako bhavetyarthaḥ | anyat samānam ||

dviṣo no viśvatomukhāti nāvevaṃ pāraya | arpa naḥ śośucadagham || 7 || dviṣaḥ | naḥ | viśvataḥ'mukhāti | nāveva | pāraya | arpa | naḥ | śośucat | agham ||7|| he viśvatomukha sarvatomukhāgne nāveva nāvā nadīmiva dviṣaḥ śatrūn naḥ asmān ati pāraya atikramayya śatrurahitaṃ pradeśaṃ prāpaya || nāveva | 'sāvekācaḥ' iti vibhakterudāttatvam | pāraya | 'pāra tīra karmasamāsau' ||

sa naḥ sindhumiva nāvāti parṣā svastaye | arpa naḥ śośucadagham || 8 || sa | naḥ | sindhum'iva | nāvā | ati | parṣa | svastaye | arpa | naḥ | śośucat | agham ||8|| pūrvokta evārthaḥ punarapi dāḍharyāya prārthyate | he agne maḥ tvaṃ naḥ asmān nāvā nāvā sindhu- miva nadīmiva svastaye kṣamārtham ati parṣa śatrūn atikramayya pālaya | śatrurahitaṃ pradeśam asmān prāpayetyarthaḥ | tvatprasādāt naḥ asmākam aghaṃ pāpaṃ ca apa śośucat asmatto'pakramyāsmacchatruḥ śokayukto bhavatu || nāvā | 'āṅyājayārāṃ copasaṃkhyānam' (pā. ma. 7. 1. 19. 1) iti tṛtīyāyā akārādeśaḥ | 'upottamaṃ riti' (pā. sū. 6. 1. 217) iti akārasya udāttatvam |

2. kṣa-ṭa-ṭha- 'he ame tvaṃ hi......anyattasmān' ityasya sthāne he viśvato- mukha sarvato vyāptajvālāme tvaṃ hitameva viśvataḥ sarvataḥ sarvasmādupadravajātāt paribhūrasi asmākaṃ parigrahī- tāsi bhava rakṣakī bhavetyarthaḥ |
6. kṣa-ṭa-ṭha-pāpamapa śośucat asmatto'tikramya śokayukte (kṣa-anyatra śokayukte ) bhavatu |
parṇa | ' pṛ pālanapūraṇayoḥ ' | loṭi ' bahulaṃ chandasi ' iti śapaḥ ślorabhāvaḥ | ' sibbahula leṭi ' iti bahulavacanāt sip | guṇaḥ | ' aco'tastinhaḥ ' iti dīrghatvam || || 5 ||
' vaiśvānarasya ' iti tṛcaṃ pañcamaṃ sūktaṃ kutsasyārṣaṃ traiṣṭubham |
tathā cānukrāntam- ' vaiśvānarasya tṛcaṃ vaiśvānarīyam ' iti |
' vyūhaśceta ' iti khaṇḍe sūtritam- ' vaiśvānarasya sumatau ka īṃ vyaktāḥ ' ( āśva. śrau. 8. 8 ) iti ||
vaiśvānarasya sumatau syām rājā hi kaṃ bhuvanānāmabhiśrīḥ |
ito jāto viśvamidaṃ vi caṣṭe vaiśvānaro yatate sūryeṇa ||
vaiśvānarasya | sumatau | syām | rājā | hi | kam | bhuvanānām | abhiśrīḥ | itaḥ | jātaḥ | viśvam | idam | vi | caṣṭe | vaiśvānaraḥ | yatate | sūryeṇa || 1 ||
'vaiśvānarasya viśeṣāṃ narāṇāṃ lokāntaranetratvena svāmitvena vā sambandhino'gneḥ 'sumatau śobha- nāyāmanugrahātmikāyāṃ buddhau 'syām anugrāhyatvena vartamānā bhavem |
sa hi vaiśvānaraḥ 'abhiśrīḥ abhiśrayaṇīyaḥ ābhimukhyena sevitavyaḥ 'san 'bhuvanānāṃ sarveṣāṃ bhūtajātānāṃ 'rājā svāmī bhavati |
yaḥ 'vaiśvānaraḥ agniḥ 'itaḥ 'asmādagnidvayāt jātamātra eva 'idaṃ sarvaṃ jagat 'vi 'caṣṭe viśeṣeṇa paśyati prātarhayatā 'sūryeṇa ca 'yatate saṃyatate saṃgacchate |
' udyantaṃ vāvā- dityamabhiranusamārohati ' ( tai. brā. 2. 1. 2. 10 ) iti taittarīyakam |
tayoḥ saṃgamanaṃ dṛṣṭvā 'vaiśvānaro yatate sūryeṇa ' iti arpibhūte |
tathā ca yāskaḥ- ' amuto'mukhya raśmayaḥ prādurbhavantīto'syādhipastayorbhāṃsoḥ saṃsaṃgaṃ dṛṣṭvamavakṣyat ' ( niru. 7. 23 ) iti |
evaṃbhūtasya mahānubhāvasya vaiśvānarasya sumatau syāmeti saṃbandhaḥ ||
' nare saṃjñāyām ' ( pā. sū. 6. 3. 129 ) iti pūrvapadasya dīrghatvam |
' tādau ca ' iti gateḥ prakṛtisvare prāpte ' mantrin ' ityādinā uttarapadāntodāttatvam |
nanu tatra ' kārakāt ' ityanuvṛtteruttarasya kino na prāpti |
śobhanaṃ mananaṃ yasyāṃ buddhau sā sumatiḥ |
tasyāṃ vaiśvānarasya havipaḥ ' pṛṣṭho divi ' iti yājyā |
' cāturmāsyāni ' iti khaṇḍe sūtritaṃ- ' pṛṣṭho divi pṛṣṭho agniḥ pṛthivyāṃ parjanyāya pragāyata ' ( āśva. śrau. 2. 15 ) iti ||
1. kṣa-ṭa-ṭha-vaiśvānaraguṇaviśiṣṭo'gniḥ | 2. kṣa-ṭa-ṭha-lokānāṃ vā netṛtvena | 3. kṣa-ṭa-ṭha-sevanīyaḥ | 4. kṣa-ṭa-ṭha-vaiśvānara itaḥ |
pṛ॒ṣṭo di॒vi pṛ॒ṣṭo a॒gniḥ pṛ॒thivyā̭m pṛ॒ṣṭo vi॒śvā oṣa̭dhīrā vi̭veśa |
vai॒śvā॒na॒raḥ sa॒hasā̭ pṛ॒ṣṭo a॒gniḥ sa no̭ di॒vā sa ri॒paḥ pā̭tu na॒ktam ||

pṛ॒ṣṭaḥ | di॒vi | pṛ॒ṣṭaḥ | a॒gniḥ | pṛ॒thivyā̭m | pṛ॒ṣṭaḥ | vi॒śvāḥ | oṣa̭dhīḥ | ā | vi॒veśa̭ | vai॒śvā॒na॒raḥ | sa॒hasā̭ | pṛ॒ṣṭaḥ | a॒gniḥ | saḥ | naḥ | di॒vā | saḥ | ri॒paḥ | pā॒tu | na॒ktam ||2||
ayaṃ vaiśvānaraḥ 'agniḥ 'divi dyuloke ādityātmanā 'pṛṣṭaḥ saṃspṛṣṭaḥ yadvā nipikko nihito vartate |
tatrā 'pṛthivyāṃ bhūmau gārhapatyādirupeṇa 'pṛṣṭaḥ saṃspṛṣṭo nihito vā |
tathā 'viśvāḥ sarvāḥ 'oṣadhīḥ 'pṛṣṭaḥ saṃspṛṣṭaḥ saḥ agniḥ 'ā 'viveśa pākārthamantaḥ praviṣṭavān |
antaḥpraviṣṭena pārthive- nāgninā 'hi' sarvā oṣadhayaḥ pacyante |
'sahasā pareyāmāsādhāraṇena balena 'pṛṣṭaḥ saṃspṛṣṭaḥ vaiśvānaraḥ 'naḥ : asmān 'divā ahni 'ripaḥ hiṃsataḥ śatroḥ 'pātu rakṣatu |
tanno̭ mi॒tro varṷṇo māmahantā॒madi̭tiḥ si॒ndhuḥ pṛ̭thi॒vī u॒ta dyauḥ ||
vai॒śvā॒na॒ra | tava̭ | tat | sa॒tyam | a॒stu | a॒smān | rā॒yaḥ | ma॒gha॒vāna̭ḥ | sa॒cantām | tat | naḥ | mi॒traḥ | varṷṇaḥ | ma॒mahantām | adi̭tiḥ | si॒ndhuḥ | pṛ̭thi॒vī | u॒ta | dyauḥ ||3||
he 'vaiśvānara 'tava 'tat tvadīyaṃ tat asmābhiḥ kriyamāṇaṃ karma 'satyamastu avitathaphalaṃ bhavatu |
evaṃ yadasmābhiḥ prārthitaṃ 'naḥ asmadīyaṃ 'tat 'mitraḥ aharabhimānī devaḥ 'varuṇaḥ rājya- bhimānī 'aditiḥ ardīnā devamātā 'sindhuḥ syandanaśīladakābhimānī devaḥ |
' jātavedasaṃ ' iti ekarcaṃ ṣaṣṭhaṃ sūktaṃ marīciputrasya kaśyapasyārṣaṃ traiṣṭubham |
tathā cānukrāntam-' jātavedasameta jātavedasyametadanekayaikabhyāṃsi sūkta- sahasrametattu kaśyapārṣam ' iti |
sūtritaṃ ca-' jātavedasaṃ sunavāma somamityāgnimārate jātavedasyānām ' (āśva. śrau. 7. 1) iti ||
1. kṣa-ṭa-ṭha-hi pārthivābhinā | 2. kṣa-ṭa-ṭha-sa- sa vaiśvānaraḥ | 3. kṣa-ṭa-ṭha-na-sa- ' maghavantaḥ ' nāsti | 4. kṣa-ṭa-ṭha-dhanadānāṃprayāḥ | 5. kṣa-ṭa-ṭha- jātavedagurṇāviśaṣṭho'gniḥ |
vya: indra: vvṛṣā kāmānāṃ varṣitā vvṛṣyebhi: vṛṣṇi bhavairvīryai: vsamokā: samyak samaveta: saṃgataḥ vmaha: mahataḥ vdiva: dyulokasya vpṛthivyā: prathitāyā bhūme: vca vsannād īśvara: vsatīn- satvā |
udakasya saravā sādayitā gamayitā vbhareṣu vhavya: sarvai: stotṛbhirāhvātavya: evaṃbhūta: vmarutvān marudbhiryukta: vsa: vindra: vna: asmākam vūtī ūtaye rakṣaṇāya vbhavatu ||
' ye cābhāvakarmaṇe: ' iti prakṛtibhāvavastu vyatyayena na bhavati |
' mo rāji sama: ' ( pā. sū. 8. 3. 25 ) iti rājatau kibante uttarapade samo makārasya makārādeśa: |
sade: antarbhāvi- taṇyarthāt ' pra īrasayostad ca ' ( u. sū. 4. 556 ) iti auṇādiko vanip tuḍāgamaśca |
yasyānāḥ sūryasyeva yāmo bharebhare vṛtrahā śuṣmo asti |
vṛṣantamḥ sakhibhiḥ svebhirevairmarutvā no bhavatvindra ūtī ||
yasya | anāḥ | sūryasyeva | yāmaḥ | bhare'bhare | vṛtrahā | śuṣmaḥ | asti | vṛṣantamḥ | sakhibhiḥ | svebhiḥ | evaiḥ | marutvān | naḥ | bhavatu | indraḥ | ūtī || 2 ||
vyasya indrasya vyāma: gati: vanāsa: parairaprāpto vsūryasyeva |
yathā sūryasya gatirapyenaṃ prāptuṃ śakyate tadvat |

vsvebhi: ātmīyai: vevai: gamanaśīlai: vsakhibhi: mitrabhūtairmarudbhi: saha vvṛṣantam: ati- śayena kāmānāṃ varṣitā vbharebhare sarveṣu saṃgrāmeṣu vvṛtrahā śatrūṇāṃ hantā vśuṣma: sarvepāmasurāṇāṃ śoṣaka: evaṃbhūto ya: indra: vasti vidyate sa: vmarutvān vindra: vna: asmākaṃ rakṣaṇāya vbhavatu |
' avisamivisuṣibhya: kit ' ( u. sū. 1. 141 ) iti mapratyaya: |
vṛṣaśabdāduttarasya tamapo ' nādyasya ' ( pā. sū. 8. 2. 17 ) iti nuḍ |
divo na yasya retaso dughānāḥ panthāso yanti śavasāparītāḥ |
taraddveṣāḥ sāsuhiḥ pausyaibhirmarutvā no bhavatvindra ūtī ||
divaḥ | na | yasya | retasaḥ | dughānāḥ | panthāsaḥ | yanti | śavasā | arpara'itāḥ | taraddveṣāḥ | sasahiḥ | pausyaibhiḥ | marutvān | naḥ | bhavatu | indraḥ | ūtī || 3 ||
vasya indrasya vapanthāḥ raśmayaḥ varetasaḥ vṛṣṭyudakāni vaduhānāḥ duhantaḥ pravarṣantaḥ vayanti nirgacchanti dyulokāditastataḥ prasaranti |
yathā dyotamānasya sūryasya kiraṇā vṛṣṭiṃ kurvantaḥ nabhaḥsthalābhirgacchanti tadvat |
vaśavasā balena sahitāḥ vaapa- rītāḥ parairanabhigatāḥ |
so'yam indraḥ vataradveṣaḥ dveṣāṃsi śatrūṃstaran jitaśatruka ityarthaḥ |
vapausyebhiḥ balaiḥ vasasahiḥ śatrūṇāmabhibhavitā evaṃbhūtaḥ vamahasvān vaindraḥ vanaḥ asmākaṃ rakṣaṇāya vabhavatu ||
‘surībhyāṃ tud ca’ (u. sū. 4. 641) iti asun tuḍāgamaśca |
vsunubhirna putrairiva vrudrebhiḥ rudraputrairmarudbhiryuktaḥ vṛdhvā mahān evaṃbhūtaḥ vsaḥ indraḥ vnṛpāhe nṛbhiḥ puruṣaiḥ soḍhavye saṃgrāme vamitrān śatrūn vsasadvān abhibhūtavān |
api ca vsanīḻebhiḥ samānanilayairmarudbhiḥ saha vśravasthāni |
taddhetubhūtānyudakāni vtūrvan meghāt pracyāvayan vmarutvān vindraḥ asmākaṃ rakṣaṇāya vbhavatu ||
‘ śaki sahośca ’ (pā. sū. 3. 1. 99) iti karmaṇi yat |
‘ anyeṣāmapi dṛśyate ’ iti saṃhitāyāṃ dhātvakārasya dīrghatvam |
sa ma̭nyu॒mīḥ sa॒mada̭nasya॒ kartā॒smākai̭bhi॒ḥ sūrya̭ sa॒nat |
saḥ | ma̭nyu॒mīḥ | sa॒mada̭nasya | kartā̭ | a॒smākai̭bhiḥ | nṛ॒bhi̭ḥ | sūrya̭m | sa॒nat | a॒smin | a॒han | sa॒t'pati̭ḥ | purṷ'hūtaḥ | marṷtvān | naḥ | bhava̭tu | indra̭ḥ | ū॒tī || 6 ||
śatrubhirpahatāsu goṣu taiḥ saha yuddhādhaṃ vinirgatāḥ ’ ṛtrādhādayo'nena sūktenendramastuvan |
vsaḥ indraḥ vmanyumīḥ manyoḥ kopasya nirmātā |

api ca vsamadanasya saṃgrā- masya vkartā vsatpatiḥ satāṃ pālayitā vpuruhūtaḥ bahubhiryajamānairāhūtaḥ evaṃguṇaviśiṣṭaḥ saḥ vasmin vahan asmin divase vasmākebhiḥ āsmākaiḥ2 asmadīyaiḥ vnṛbhiḥ puruṣaiḥ vsūrya sūryaprakāśaṃ vsanat saṃbhaktaṃ karotu |
sa ca vmarutvān vindraḥ asmākaṃ rakṣaṇāya vbhavatu ||
‘ sahasya saḥ saṃjñāyām ’ (pā. sū. 6. 2. 78) iti sabhāvāḥ |
‘ tasminniti ca yuṣmākāsmākau ’ iti aṇi asmacchabdasya asmākādeśaḥ |
ta॒mūta̭yo॒ raṇya̭ccha॒rasā̭tau॒ taṃ kṣema̭sya॒ kṣita̭ya॒ḥ kṛṇva̭ta॒ trām |
sa vi॒śvasya̭ ka॒ruṇa̭sya॒ ī॒śe eko̭ marṷtvānno॒ bhava̭tvindra॒ ū॒tī ||
tam | ū॒taya̭ḥ | raṇya̭t | sa॒ra'sā̭tau | tam | kṣema̭sya | kṣita̭yaḥ | kṛṇva̭ta | trām | saḥ | vi॒śvasya̭ | ka॒ruṇa̭sya | ī॒śe | eka̭ḥ | marṷtvān | naḥ | bhava̭tu | indra̭ḥ | ū॒tī || 7 ||
'tam indraṃ 'śūrasātī śūrairvīrapuruṣaiḥ saṃbhajanīye saṃgrāme 'utayaḥ gantāro mahataḥ 'raṇayan rama- yanti |
'prahara bhagavo jahi vīrayasva' ityevarūpaṃ śabdamindramuddiśya kurvanti |
api ca 'kṣitayaḥ manuṣyāḥ 'tam indraṃ 'kṣamasya rakṣaṇīyasya' sarvasya dhanasya 'trāṃ trātāraṃ rakṣatāraṃ 'kṛṇavata kurvanti |
'saḥ indraḥ 'viśvasya sarvasya 'karuṇasya abhimataphala- niṣpādanarūpasya karmaṇaḥ 'ekaḥ asahāya eva 'īśe īṣṭe |
tapsanta śarvasa utsaveṣu naro naramarvase taṃ dhanāya |
so andhe cittarmsi jyotirvidanamurutvābho bhavatvindra ūtī ||
tam | apsanta | śarvasaḥ | ut'saveṣu | naraḥ | naram | avase | tam | dhanāya | saḥ | andhe | cit | tarmsi | jyotiḥ | vidat | murutvān | naḥ | bhavatu | indraḥ | ūtī ||8||
'naraḥ netāraḥ stotāraḥ 'śarvasaḥ balasya saṃbandheṣu 'utsaveṣu saṃgrāmeṣu 'naraṃ jayasya netāraṃ 'tam indram 'apsanta āmuvanti |
yasmāt 'saḥ indraḥ 'tamasi dṛṣṭipratibandhake 'andhe 'cit ādhyānarahite citta- vyāmohakare'pi saṃgrāme 'jyotiḥ vijayalakṣaṇaṃ prakāśaṃ 'vidat lambhayati |
sa suvyena yamati vrādhataścitta dakṣiṇe saṃgṛbhītā kṛtāni |
sa kīriṇā citsarnitā dhanāni murutvābho bhavatvindra ūtī ||
saḥ | suvyena | yamati | vrādhataḥ | cit | saḥ | dakṣiṇe | sam'gṛbhītā | kṛtāni | saḥ | kīriṇā | cit | sarnitā | dhanāni | murutvān | naḥ | bhavatu | indraḥ | ūtī ||9||
vsa: indra: vsavyena vāmahastena ekahastena vvrādhataścit hiṃsataḥ vmahataḥ vśatrūnapi vyamati niyama- yati |
tathā vsa: indra: vdakṣiṇe dakṣiṇapārśvasthena vhastemaikena vyajamānai: vkṛtāni havīṃṣi vsaṃgṛbhītā v saṃgṛhṇāti |
api ca vsa: indra: vkīriṇā vcit kīrtayitvā stotrā ca stutaḥ san vdhanāni vsanitā pradānaśīlo bhavati |
ṇici amantatvāt mittve ‘mitāṃ hrasva:’ iti hrasvatvam |

yuddhāthaṃ marudbhiḥ 1 saha yat yadā samajāti saṃgacchate | teṣām ubhayavidhānām apām indraṃ prāuvatāṃ puruṣāṇāṃ tokasya putrasya tanayasya taruputrasya ca jeṣe jayaprāsaye saḥ indraḥ bhavati | kimu vakta- vyam asmākaṃ stotṛmānāṃ jayo bhavatīti | anyat samānam | samajāti | ‘ aja gatikṣepaṇayoḥ ’ | leṭi āḍāgamaḥ | jeṣe | ‘ ji jaye ’ | auṇādikaḥ sapratyayaḥ | caturthyarthe saptamī | yadvā | ‘ jeṣ ṇeṣ preṣ gatau ’ | ‘ kip ca ’ iti kip | ‘ sāvekācaḥ ’ iti vibhakterudāttatvam ||
sa vajrabhṛtsyuhā bhīma ugraḥ sahasracetāḥ śatanītha ṛvvā |
camīṣo na śavasā pāśvajanyo marutvānno bhavatvindra ūtī ||
saḥ | vajra'bhṛt | dasyu'hā | bhīmaḥ | ugraḥ | sahasra'cetāḥ | śata'nīthaḥ | ṛvvā | camīṣaḥ | na | śavasā | pāśvajanyaḥ | marutvān | naḥ | bhavatu | indraḥ | ūtī || 12 ||

saḥ indraḥ vajrabhṛt anyairdhartumaśakyasya vajrasya bhartā dasyuhā dasyunāmupakṣapayitṛṇāmasurāṇāṃ hantā bhīmaḥ sarveṣāṃ bhayahetuḥ ugraḥ udūrṇatejāḥ sahasracetāḥ bahuvidhajñānaḥ sarvajña ityarthaḥ |
śatanīthaḥ bahustutirbahuvidhaprāpaṇo vā ṛvvā uru bhāsamāno mahān vā camīṣo na camvāṃ camase rasātmanāvasthitaḥ soma iva śavasā balena pāśvajanyaḥ |
gandharvā apsaraso devā asurā rakṣāṃsi pañca janāḥ |
evaṃbhūtaḥ saḥ marutvān indraḥ naḥ asmākaṃ rakṣaṇāya bhavatu |
‘ bhīmādayo'pādāne ’ ( pā. sū. 3. 4. 74 ) iti apādāne ‘ bhiyaḥ puvvā ’ ( u. sū. 1. 145 ) iti mak |
‘ hanikuṣinīramikāśibhyaḥ kthan ’ ( u. sū. 2. 159 ) iti kthanpratyayaḥ |
bhavārthe ‘ bahirdevapañcajanyabhyaśceti vaktavyam ’ ( kā. 4. 3. 58. 1 ) iti jyapratyayaḥ |
tasya vajraḥ krandati smatsvarṣā divo na tveṣo rathaḥ śimīvān |
taṃ sacante sanayastaṃ dhanāni marutvānno bhavatvindra ūtī ||
tasya | vajraḥ | krandati | smat | svaḥ'sāḥ | divaḥ | na | tveṣaḥ | rathaḥ | śimī'vān | tam | sacante | sanayaḥ | tam | dhanāni | marutvān | naḥ | bhavatu | indraḥ | ūtī || 13 ||
tasya indrasya vajraḥ kuliśaḥ smat bhṛśaṃ krandati śatrunākandayati rodayatītyarthaḥ |
ya indraḥ svarṣāḥ śobhanasyodakasya dātā divo na divaḥ saṃbandhī sūrya iva tveṣaḥ dīptaḥ rathaḥ śabdasya garjanalakṣaṇasya kartā śimīvān |
1. kṣa-ṭa-ṭha-gacchadbhiḥ | 2. kṣa-ṭa-ṭha-tadā eṣām; sa-tadā teṣām | 3. kṣa-kimucyate | 4. kṣa-ṭa-ṭha-indro marutvān |

tam indraṃ sanaya: dhanasya dānāni sacante sevante | tathā taṃ dhanāni ca sevante | sa: mahasvān indra: na: asmākaṃ rakṣaṇāya bhavatu | krandati | 'kadi kradi kdi āhlāne rodane ca' | 'chandasyu- bhayathā' iti śapa ārdhadhātukatvāt 'geraniṭī' iti ṇilopa: | svarṣā: | supūrvāt arte: vic | sucha arti gacchatīti svarudakam | tsanotīti svarṣā: | 'paṇa dāne' | 'janasanakhanakramagamo viṭ' | 'viḍvanoranunāsikasyāt' iti ātvam | 'sanoterana:' (pā. sū. 8. 3. 108) iti ṣatvam | tvepa: | 'tripa dīptau' | pacādyac | ravata: | 'ru śabde' | 'śīṅśapiragamaviñjīviprāṇibhyo'tha:' (u. sū. 3. 393) iti athapratyaya: | guṇāvādeśau | sanaya: | sanoterbhāṃce auṇādika ipratyaya: ||
yasyārjasaṃ śarvasā māna̭mukthaṃ paribhujadrodasī viśvataḥ sīm |
yasya | arjasam | śarvasā | mānam | uktham | pari'bhujat | rodasī iti | viśvataḥ | sīm | sa: | pāriṣkṛt | ṛtu'bhi: | mandasāna: | marutvān | na: | bhavatu | indra: | ūtī || 14 ||

yasya indrasya ukthaṃ praśastaṃ 'śavasā mānaṃ balena sarvasaṃ paricchedakaṃ sarveṣāṃ balasyopamānabhūtaṃ vā rodasī dyāvāpṛthivyau viśvataḥ sīṃ sarvata: 'ajasam anacarataṃ paribhujat parita: sarvato bhunakti pālayati sa: indra: ṛtubhi: asmābhi: kṛtayajñai: mandasāna: modamāna: san pāriṣpat asmān duritāt pārayatu ||
na yasya̭ devā de॒vatā na martā̭ ārṣcana śarva̭so a॒ntamā̭puḥ |
sa pra॒rikā̭ tva॒rkṣā kṣa॒mo di॒vaśca̭ marutvā̭nno bhavatvindra̭ ūtī ||
na | yasya | devā: | devatā | na | martā: | āpu: | cana | śarvasa: | antam | āpu: | sa: | pra'rikā | tvarkṣā | kṣama: | diva: | ca | marutvān | na: | bhavatu | indra: | ūtī ||15||
devatā devasya dānādiguṇayuktasya yasya indrasya śavasa: balasya antam avasānaṃ devā: vasvādyā devagaṇā: na āpu: na ānaśire tathā martā: manuṣyā: āpaścana āpo'pi na prāpu: |
sa: tādṛśa indra: tvarkṣā śatrūṇāṃ tanūkarttā ātmīyena balena kṣama: pṛthivyā: divaśca svargasya ca prarikā prakarṣeṇa recako bhavati |

'naḥ asmākam 'ūtī ūtaye rakṣaṇāya 'bhavatu || devatā | deva eva devatā | 'devāttal' iti svārthe tal | 'supāṃ suluk' iti ṣaṣṭhyā luk | martāḥ | 'mṛṅ prāṇatyāge' | 'asihasi' ityādinā tanpratyayaḥ | niśvādādyudāttatvam | prarikā | 'ricir virecane' | 'anyebhyo'pi dṛśyante' iti kanip | anyavikāraśchāndasaḥ | tvakṣā | 'takṣū svaśva tanūkaraṇe' | asun | niśvādādyudā- ttatvam | imaḥ | kṣamā iti pṛthivīnām | 'āto dhātoḥ' ityatra 'ātaḥ' iti yogavibhāgāt dṛṣṭisiddhiḥ | ityabhidhānāt ḍasi bhasaṃjñāyāmākāralopaḥ | yadvā | 'kṣamāyī vidhūnane' | asmāt 'kip ca' iti kip | verapṛktalopāt pūrva vali lopaḥ | anyat samānam | udāttanivṛttisvareṇa vibhakteḥ udāttatvam || || 10 ||
vṛṣaṇavantaṃ bibhratī dhūrṣu rathaṃ mandrā ciketa nārhuṣīṣu vikṣu ||
rohit | śyāvā | sumat'aṃśuḥ | lalāmī | dhukṣā | rāye | ṛjva'aśvasya | vṛṣaṇ'vantam | bibhratī | dhūḥ'su | ratham | mandrā | ciketa | nārhuṣīṣu | vikṣu || 16 ||
'sumadaṃśuḥ sumat svataḥ 'prāṃśuḥ ' uktaṃ ca yāskena- 'sumat svayamityarthaḥ ' ( niru. 6. 22) iti |

ati- dīrghāvayavā 'lalāmīḥ puṇḍravatī aśvabhūṣaṇayuktā vā 'dhukṣā divi dyuloke kṛtanivāsā 'ṛjvāśvasya etatsaṃjasya' rājarṣeḥ 'rāye dhanārthaṃ 'vṛṣaṇavantaṃ vṛṣṇā sektrā indreṇa yuktaṃ 'rathaṃ 'dhūrṣu yugasambandhiṣu vahanapradeśeṣu 'bibhratī vahantī 'mandrā sarveṣām āhlādakarī' aśvapaṅktiḥ 'nāhuṣīṣu |
etaccatta indra vṛṣṇa ukthaṃ vārṣāgirā ābhi gṛṇanti rādhaḥ |
etat | tyat | te | indra | vṛṣṇe | uktham | vārṣāgirāḥ | ābhi | gṛṇanti | rādhaḥ | ṛjva'aśvaḥ | praṣṭi'bhiḥ | ambarīṣaḥ | saha'devaḥ | bhayamānaḥ | surādhāḥ || 17 ||
1. kṣa-ṭha-iti vacanāt | 2. kṣa-ṭa-ṭha-lohitavarṇā | 3. kṣa-sa-khata etra | 4. sa-aṃśuḥ | 5. kṣa-sa-etatsaṃjakasya | 6. sa-madakārī | ka. 78

he indra vṛṣṇe kāmānāṃ varṣituḥ te tava vyat tat etat ukthaṃ stotraṃ rādhaḥ saṃrādhakaṃ svastrī- tihetu vāpāṃgirāḥ vṛpāgiro rājñaḥ putrā ṛtrādyādayaḥ abhi gṛṇanti ābhimukhyena vadanti| vāpā- girā ityanat vivṛṇoti| ṛtrāśvaḥ etatsaṃjño rājarṣiḥ ṛṣṭibhiḥ pārśvasthaiḥ anyairṛṣibhiḥ sahendramastaut| ke ne pārśvasthāḥ| ambarīṣādayaścatvāro rājarṣayaḥ || vāpāgirāḥ| ‘tasyāpatyam’ (pā. sū. 4. 1. 92) iti aṇapratyayaḥ| gṛṇanti| ‘gṛ śabde ’| ‘pvādīnāṃ hrasvaḥ ’ iti hrasvatvam| rādhaḥ| ‘ rādha sādha saṃsiddhau ’| rāpnoti samṛddho bhavatyaneneti rādhaḥ| karaṇe'sun| ṛtrāśvaḥ| ṛtrāḥ gatimanto'śvā yasya sa tathoktaḥ| ambarīṣaḥ| ‘ abi śabde ’| auṇādika iṣanpratyayaḥ (u. sū. 4. 469)| sahadevaḥ| deveḥ maha vartate iti sahadevaḥ| ‘ vopasarjanasya ’ iti vikalpanāt samāvābhāvaḥ| bhayamānaḥ| ‘ abhi bhaye ’| asmāt antarbhāvitaṇyarthāt vyatyayena śānac| ‘ bahulaṃ chandasi ’ iti śapaḥ ślorabhāvaḥ| adupadeśāt lasārvadhātukānudāttatve dhātusvara eva śiṣyate| suvajraḥ| rādhaḥ iti dhananāma| śobhanaṃ rādho yasya| ‘ sormanasī alomopasī ’ ityuttarapadādyudāttatvam ||

dasyuṃchamyū~śca puruhūta airvaihatvā pṛthivyāṃ śarvā ni barhīt| sanatkṣetraṃ sakhibhiḥ śvintyebhiḥ sanatsūryaṃ sanadapaḥ suvajraḥ || 18 || dasyū~n| śimyūn| ca| puruhūtaḥ| airvaiḥ| hatvā| pṛthivyām| śarvā| ni| barhīt| sanat| kṣetram| sakhibhiḥ| śvintyebhiḥ| sanat| sūryam| sanat| apaḥ| suvajraḥ ||18||

puruhūtaḥ bahubhiryajamānairāhūta indraḥ airvaiḥ gamanaśīlairmarudbhiryuktaḥ san pṛthivyāṃ bhūmau varta- mānān dasyū~n upakṣapayitṝn śatrūn śimyūṃśca śamayitṝn vadhakāriṇo rākṣasādīṃśca hatvā prahṛtya tadanantaraṃ śarvā hiṃsakena vajreṇa ni barhīt avadhīt|
evaṃ śatrūñchirasya śvintyebhiḥ śvetavarṇairalaṃkāreṇa dīptaiḥ sakhibhiḥ mitrabhūtairmarudbhiḥ saha kṣetraṃ śatrūṇāṃ svabhūtāṃ bhūmiṃ sanat sama- bhākṣīt|
tathā vṛtreṇa tirohitaṃ sūryaṃ tasya vṛtrasya hananena sanat abhajata prāptavānityarthaḥ|
tathā suvajraḥ śobhanavajrayukta indro vṛtreṇa niruddhāḥ apaḥ vṛṣṭyudakāni sanat samabhajata ||

viśvāhendro̭ adhi॒vaktā no̭ a॒stvapa̭rihṛtāḥ sanu॒yām vā॒jam | tanno̭ mi॒tro varṷṇo māmahantā॒madi̭tiḥ | sindhṷḥ pṛthi॒vī uta॒ dyauḥ || 19 || viśvā̭ḥ | indra̭ḥ | a॒dhi॒'vaktā | na̭ḥ | a॒stu | a॒pa॒ri'hṛtā̭ḥ | sanu॒yām | vā॒jam | tat | na̭ḥ | mi॒traḥ | varṷṇaḥ | ma॒ma॒hantām | adi̭tiḥ | sindhṷḥ | pṛthi॒vī | uta | dyauḥ || 10 ||
vayaṃ ca ^aparihṛtāḥ akuṭilagatayaḥ santaḥ ^vājaṃ havirlakṣaṇamannaṃ ^sanuyāma saṃbhajā- mahe |
yadanena sūktenāsmābhiḥ prārthitaṃ ^tat mitrādayaḥ mamahantāṃ pūjitaṃ kurvantu ||
‘vana paṇa saṃbhaktau’ ityasmāt vā vyatyayena upratyayaḥ ||
tathā cānukrāntaṃ — ‘pramandina ekādaśa kutsa ādhā garbhasāvi- ṇyupaniṣaccatriṣṭubhantam’ iti |
‘viśvajitaḥ’ iti khaṇḍe sūtritaṃ—‘pra mandina imā u sveti marutvatīyam’ (āśva. śrau. 8.7.) iti ||

pra mandinḙ pi॒tuma̭rcatā va॒co yaḥ kṛ॒ṣṇaga̭rbhā ni॒raha̭nṛ॒jiśvā̭ | a॒va॒syava̭: vṛ॒ṣaṇa̭ṃ va॒jrada̭kṣiṇaṃ ma॒rutva̭ntaṃ ma॒rutva̭ntaṃ su॒khyāya̭ hvāmahe || 1 || pra | mandinḙ | pi॒tu'ma̭t | a॒rcata | vaca̭ḥ | yaḥ | kṛ॒ṣṇa'ga̭rbhā | niḥ'a̭han | ṛ॒jiśvā̭ | a॒va॒syava̭ḥ | vṛ॒ṣaṇa̭m | va॒jra'da̭kṣiṇam | ma॒rutva̭ntam | su॒khyāya̭ | hvāmahe || 1 ||
he ṛtvijaḥ ^mandine stutimate stotrāyendrāya ^pitumat havirlakṣaṇenānnenopetaṃ ^vacaḥ stutilakṣaṇaṃ vacanaṃ ^pra ^arcata prakarṣeṇoccārayata |
^yaḥ indraḥ ^ṛjiśvā etatsaṃjñakena rājā sakhyā sahitaḥ san ^kṛṣṇagarbhāḥ kṛṣṇo nāma kaścidasuraḥ |
kṛṣṇamasuraṃ hatvā putrāṇām api ^anupatyarthaṃ garbhaṇīstasyā bhāryāḥ apyavadhīdityarthaḥ |
^avasyavaḥ rakṣaṇecchavo vayaṃ ^vṛṣaṇaṃ kāmānāṃ varṣitāraṃ ^vajradakṣiṇaṃ vajrayuktena dakṣiṇahastenopetaṃ taṃ ^marutvantam indraṃ ^sakhyāya sakhyuḥ karmaṇe ^hvāmahe āhvayāmahe ||
1. kṣa-tathoktam | 2. kṣa-sa- ‘sanuyāma’ ityasyānantaraṃ ‘prayacchāma | yadvā indreṇa dattaṃmannam’ ityadhikam | 3. kṣa-ṭa-ṭha--nipātaḥ | 4. kṣa-ṭha-ṭha-na-sa- ‘api’ nāsti |

‘hasnuhubhyāṃ matup’ iti matupa udāttatvam | kṛṣṇagarbhāḥ kṛṣṇona niṣiktāḥ garbhāḥ yāsu tāstathoktāḥ | ‘parādiśchandasi bahulam’ iti pūrvapadāntodāttatvam | avasyavaḥ | averauṇādiko bhāve'sun | avaḥ icchati avasyati | ‘supa ātmanaḥ kyac’ | ‘kyācchandasi’ iti upratyayaḥ | vṛṣaṇam | ‘vā papūrvasya nigame’ iti vikalpanādupadhādīrghābhāvaḥ | sakhyāya | sakhyuḥ karma sakhyam | ‘sakhyuryaḥ’ iti yapratyayaḥ | havāmahe | hvejo laṭi ‘bahulaṃ chandasi’ iti saṃprasāraṇam ||
yo vyaṃsaṃ jahaṣāṇena manyunā yaḥ śambaraṃ yo ahanpiprumavratam |
indro yaḥ śuṣṇamaśuṣaṃ nyāvṛṇakmarutvantaṃ sakhyāya havāmahe ||
yaḥ | vi'aṃsam | jahaṣāṇena | manyunā | yaḥ | śambaram | yaḥ | ahan | piprum | anratam | indraḥ | yaḥ | śuṣṇam | aśuṣam | ni | avṛṇak | marutvantam | sakhyāya | havāmahe ||2||
^yaḥ indraḥ ^jahaṣāṇena pravṛddhena ^manyunā krodhena ^vyaṃsaṃ vigatabhujaṃ vṛtram ^ahan avadhīt |
tathā ^avrataṃ vratasya yāgādeḥ karmaṇo virodhinaṃ ^piprum etatsaṃjamasuraṃ ca ^yaḥ indro'vadhīt |
kiṃca ^yaḥ indraḥ ^aśuṣaṃ śoṣakarahitaṃ ^śuṣṇaṃ sarvasya jagataḥ śoṣakametatsaṃjñamasuraṃ ^ni ^avṛṇak nyavarjayat |
yasya dyāvāpṛthivī pauṃsyaṃ mahadasya vrate varuṇo yasya sūryaḥ |
yasyendrasya sindhavaḥ saścati vrataṃ marutvantaṃ sakhyāya havāmahe ||
yasya | dyāvāpṛthivī iti | pauṃsyam | mahat | yasya | vrate | varuṇaḥ | yasya | sūryaḥ | yasya | indrasya | sindhavaḥ | saścati | vratam | marutvantam | sakhyāya | havāmahe || 3 ||
api ca ^sūryaḥ api ^yasya indrasya vrate vartate |
1. la-vyatyayena pūrvapadāntodāttatvam | 2. kṣa-sa-hatavān | 3. kṣa-ṭa-ṭha-yaṇādeśaḥ , sa-yaṇādeśa | 4 kṣa-sa-niyamarūpe |

vacanavyatyayaḥ | gacchanti | saśratigaṃtikarmā | indreṇā'nuśiṣṭāḥ pravahantītyarthaḥ | taṃ maruvantam indraṃ sakhyāya āhvayāmahe || dyāvāpṛthivī | dyauśca pṛthivī ca dyāvāpṛthivyau | ‘divo dyāvā’ iti dyāvādeśaḥ | sa cādyudātto nipātitaḥ | pṛthivīśabdo ṅīṣpratyayāntaḥ antodāttaḥ | ‘devatādvandve ca’ ityubhayapadaprakṛtisvaratvam | ‘vā chandasi’ iti pūrvasavarṇadīrghaḥ ||
yo aśvānāṃ yo gavāṃ gopatirvṛśī ya āritaḥ karmiṇakarmaṇi sthiraḥ |
vīḻościdindro yo asunvato vadha marutvantaṃ sakhyāya havāmahe ||
yaḥ | aśvānām | yaḥ | gavām | go'patiḥ | vṛśī | yaḥ | āritaḥ | karmiṇa'karmaṇi | sthiraḥ | vīḻoḥ | cit | indraḥ | yaḥ | asunvataḥ | vadhaḥ | marutvantam | sakhyāya | havāmahe || 4 ||
api ca yaḥ indraḥ karmiṇakarmaṇi sarveṣu karmasu sthiraḥ naiśahyenāvatiṣṭhamānaḥ |
yaḥ ca indraḥ asunvataḥ sunvatāṃ yāgānuṣṭhātṛṇāṃ virodhinaḥ vīḻościt dṛḍhasyāpi śatroḥ |
vadhaḥ hantā taṃ marutvantam indraṃ sakhyāya āhvayāmahe ||
‘yaḍo'ci ca’ ityatra caśabdena bahulaprahaṇātnukardhanādainikamittike luki pratyayalakṣaṇena ‘sanyaṅoḥ’ iti ṛ ityetasya dvivacane uradatva- halādiśeṣayoḥ |
‘kṛtyalyuṭo bahulam’ iti bahulavacanāt ‘hanaśca vadhaḥ’ iti kartari ap vadhādeśaśca |
yo viśvasya jagataḥ prāṇataspatiyau brahmaṇai prathamo gā avindat |
indro yo dasyu~radharā~ avātarnmarutvantaṃ sakhyāya havāmahe ||
yaḥ | viśvasya | jagataḥ | prāṇataḥ | patiḥ | yaḥ | brahmaṇai | prathamaḥ | gāḥ | avindat | indraḥ | yaḥ | dasyūna | adharān | ava | atart | marutvantam | sakhyāya | havāmahe || 5 ||
3. kṣa-ṭa-ṭha-sa- ‘udāttatvam’ ityasthānantaraṃ ‘vadhair prakṛtyantarāt pacādyaci rūpam’ ityādhikam |

'yaḥ indraḥ 'viśvasya 'jagataḥ gacchataḥ 'prāṇataḥ praśvasataḥ prāṇijātasya 'patiḥ svāmī 'yaḥ ca 'brahmaṇa nājhaṇajātibhyo'ṅgirobhyaḥ 'prathamaḥ anyebhyo devebhyaḥ pūrvabhāvī san paṇibhirapahatāḥ 'gāḥ 'avindat alabhata |
anyebhyo devebhyaḥ pūrvameva tairasurairdudhvā gāḥ svayamalabhatetyarthaḥ |
api ca 'yaḥ 'indraḥ 'dasyūna upakṣapayitṛnsurān 'adharān nikṛṣṭān kṛtvā 'avātirat avadhīt |
'vartamān pṛṣadvrahmanmaha- jagaccatracca' ( u. sū. 2. 241 ) iti atiprasrayānto nipātito jagacchabda ādyudāttaḥ |
yaḥ śūrairhavyo yaśca bhīrubhiyoṃ dhāvadbhirhūyate yaśca jigyubhiḥ |
indraṃ yaṃ viśvā bhuvanābhi saṃdṛdhmarutvantaṃ sakhyāya havāmahe ||
yaḥ | śūraibhiḥ | havyaḥ | yaḥ | ca | bhīru'bhiḥ | yaḥ | dhāvat'bhiḥ | hūyate | yaḥ | ca | jigyu'bhiḥ | indram | yam | viśvā | bhuvanā | abhi | sam'dadhuḥ | marutvantam | sakhyāya | havāmahe ||6||
api ca 'yaḥ indraḥ 'dhāvadbhiḥ parājayena palāyamānaiḥ 'hūyate rakṣārthamāhūyate |
'yaṃ ca 'indraṃ 'viśvā 'bhuvanā sarvāṇi bhūta- jātāni sveṣu sveṣu kāryeṣu 'abhi 'saṃdadhuḥ : abhimukhyena sthāpayanti |
dvivacane ' sannaliṭojeḥ ' iti abhyāsāduttarasya jakārasya kutvam |
bhisi ayasmayāditvena bhavāt ' vasoḥ saṃprasāraṇam ' iti saṃprasāraṇam |
rudrāṇameti pradiśā vicakṣaṇo rudrebhiryoṣā tanute pṛthu jrayaḥ |
indraṃ manīṣā abhyarcati śrutaṃ marutvantaṃ sakhyāya havāmahe ||
rudrāṇām | eti | pra'diśā | vi'cakṣaṇaḥ | rudrebhiḥ | yoṣā | tanute | pṛthu | jrayaḥ | indram | manīṣā | abhi | arcati | śrutam | marutvantam | sakhyāya | havāmahe ||7||
1 kṣa-ṭa-ṭha-sa-viśvasya sarvasya | 2 kṣa-ṭa-ṭha-havāmahe | 3 kṣa-ṭa-ṭha-havāmahe | 4 kṣa-guṇaḥ | 5 kṣa-ṭa-ṭha-vegitāyāṃ gatau gamyamānāyām |
ᵛvicakṣaṇa: sūryātmanā prakāśamāna indra: ᵛrudrāṇāṃ rudraputrāṇām adhyātmaṃ prāṇarūpeṇa vartamānānāṃ marutām|
prāṇā hi śarīrāt nirgatā:’ santo bandhujanān rodayanti|
’ ᵛpradiśā pradeśena manuṣyebhya: pradānena saha ᵛeti antarikṣe gacchati|
tathā cāmnāyate--‘yo'sau tapañjedita sa sarveṣāṃ bhūtānāṃ prāṇānādāyodeti’ (tai. ā. 1. 14. 1) iti|
api ca ᵛrudrebhi: adhibhūtaṃ vartamānai: rudraputrairmarudbhi: ᵛyoṣā mādhyamikī vāk ᵛpṛthu vistīrṇaṃ ᵛjraya: vegaṃ ᵛtanute vistārayati|
tairmarudbhi: saha vartamānaṃ ᵛśrutaṃ prakhyātaṃ sūryātmānam ᵛindraṃ ᵛmanīpā stuti- lakṣaṇā vāk ᵛabhyarcita ābhimukhyena stauti|
tad‌indra ᵥadhā anantaraṃ ᵥmarudbhiḥ saptagaṇarūpaistatsaṃjñairdevaiḥ ᵥsagaṇaḥ gaṇasahitaḥ san ᵥasmin vartamāne ᵥyajñe ᵥbarhiṣi āstīrṇe darbhe upaviśya ᵥmādayasva tṛpto bhava ||
liṭi kādiniyamaprāptasya iṭaḥ ' anityamāgamaśāsanam ' iti vacanādabhāvaḥ ||
mādayasva harirbhirye ta indra vi vyasva śipre vi sṛjasva dhenaiṃ |
ā tvā muśiprā harayo vahantuśanhavyāni prati no jupasva ||
mādayasva | harirbhiḥ | ye | te | indra | vi | vyasva | śipre iti | vi | sṛjasva | dhene iti | ā | tvā | suśiprā | harayaḥ | vahantu | uśan | havyāni | prati | naḥ | jupasva || 10||
he ᵥindra ᵥharibhiḥ aśvaiḥ saha ᵥmādayasva tṛpto bhava |
ᵥye ᵥte tava svabhūtāstadarthaṃ ᵥśipre hanū saṃhate ᵥvi ᵥvyasva somapānārthaṃ vivṛte kuru |
tathā ᵥdhene pānasādhanabhūte jihvopajihvike ᵥvi ᵥsṛjasva somapānārthaṃ visṛṣṭi kuru |
śobhanaśiprendra ᵥtvā tvāṃ ᵥharayaḥ aśvāḥ ᵥā ᵥvahantu asmadīyaṃ yajñaṃ prāpayantu |
tvaṃ ca ᵥuśan asmān kāmayamānaḥ ᵥnaḥ asmākaṃ ᵥhavyāni havīṃṣi ᵥprati ᵥjupasva pratyekaṃ sevasva mā udāsiṣṭhāḥ ||
' otaḥ ini ' ( pā. sū. 7. 3. 71 ) iti okāra- lopaḥ |
maruttastautrasya vṛjanasya gopā vayamindreṇa sanuyāma vājam |
tanno mitro varuṇo māmahantāmaditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ ||
marutstautrasya | vṛjanasya | gopāḥ | vayam | indreṇa | sanuyāma | vājam | tat | naḥ | mitraḥ | varuṇaḥ | māmahantām | aditiḥ | sindhuḥ | pṛthivī | uta | dyauḥ || 11||
marudbhiḥ saha stotraṃ yasya sa marutstotraḥ |
tasya ᵥvṛjanasya śatrūṇāṃ kṣetrurindrasya sambandhinaḥ ᵥgopāḥ gopāyanīyāḥ rakṣaṇīyāḥ ᵥvayaṃ tena ᵥindreṇa ᵥvājam annaṃ ᵥsanuyāma labhemahi |
yadetadasmābhiḥ prārthitaṃ ᵥnaḥ asmadīyaṃ ᵥtat mitrādayo dyāvāpṛthivyau ca ᵥmamahantāṃ pūjitaṃ kurvantu ||
' imāṃ te ' iti ekādaśacaṃ navamaṃ sūktaṃ kutsasyārṣamaindram |
tathā cānukrāntam-' imāṃ te'nyā triṣṭup ' iti |
imāṃ te dhiyaṃ pra bhare maho mahīmasya stotre dhiṣaṇā yatta ānaje |
tamutsave ca prasave ca sāsahimandrai devāsaḥ śarvasāmadannu ||
imām | te | dhiyam | pra | bhare | mahaḥ | mahīm | asya | stotre | dhiṣaṇā | yat | te | ānaje | tam | ut'save | ca | pra'save | ca | sāsahima | indram | devāsaḥ | śarvasā | amadan | anu ||1||
he indra 'mahaḥ mahataḥ 'te tava 'imām idānīṃ kriyamāṇāṃ 'mahīṃ mahatīm atyantotkṛṣṭāṃ 'dhiyaṃ stutiṃ 'pra 'bhare prakarṣeṇa saṃpādayāmi |
'te tatra 'dhiṣaṇā svadīyā buddhiḥ 'asya mama stotuḥ 'stotre stutau 'yat yasmāt 'ānaje aktā saṃśliṣṭāmīt |
'sāsahiṃ śatrūṇāmabhibhavitāraṃ pūrvoktaṃ 'tam 'indraṃ 'devāsaḥ karmasu dīyantaḥ ṛtvijaḥ 'śavasā stutibhiḥ kīrtitena balena 'anu 'amadan anukrameṇa harṣa prāpayan |
'utsave 'ca utsavārthamabhivṛddhayarthaṃ 'prasave 'ca dhanānāṃ vṛṣṭyudakānāṃ vā utpattyarthaṃ ca ||
'mardā harṣa- lapanayoḥ' iti ghaṭādiṣu pāṭhāt 'mitāṃ hrasvaḥ' iti hrasvatvam |
'chandasyubhayathā' iti śapa ādhe- dhātukatvāt 'ṇeraniṭi' iti ṇilopaḥ ||
asya śravo nadyaḥ sapta bibhrati dyāvākṣāmā pṛthivī darśataṃ vapuḥ |
asme sūryācandramasābhicakṣe śraddhe kamindra carato vitarturam ||
asya | śravaḥ | nadyaḥ | sapta | bibhrati | dyāvākṣāmā | pṛthivī | darśatama | vapuḥ | asme iti | sūryācandramasā | abhi'cakṣe | śraddhe | kam | indra | carataḥ | vitarturam ||2||
'asya indrasya 'śravaḥ yaśaḥ kīrtiṃ 'sapta 'imaṃ me gaṅge' ityasyāmṛci prādhānyena pratipāditā gaṅgādyāḥ saptasaṃkhyākāḥ 'nadyaḥ 'bibhrati dhārayanti |
vṛtrahanena indrasya yat vṛṣṭeḥ pradātṛtvaṃ taptabhūtajalopetā nadyaḥ prakaṭayantītyarthaḥ |
antarikṣaṃ cāsya sūryātmanā vartamānasyendrasya 'darśataṃ sarvaiḥ prāṇibhirdarśanīyaṃ 'vapuḥ |
kiṃca he 'indra 'asme asmākam 'abhicakṣe draṣṭavyānāṃ padārthānāmābhimukhyena prakā- śanārthaṃ 'śraddhe 'kaṃ śraddhārtham |
cakṣuṣā dṛṣṭe hi vastuni idaṃ satyamiti śraddhopyate |
tadubhayārthaṃ sūryācandramasau 'vitarturaṃ parasparavyatihāreṇa taraṇaṃ punaḥpunargamanaṃ yathā bhavati

tathā carataḥ | vartate | tvamedha tadrūpaḥ san vartase ityarthaḥ || asya | 'ūḍidam' iti vibhakte- rudāttatvam | cāvākṣāmā | gauśca kṣāmā ca | 'divo dyāvā' iti dyāvādeśaḥ | 'supāṃ suluk' iti vibhakteḥ ḍādeśaḥ | 'devatādvandve ca' iti ubhayapadaprakṛtisvaratvam | darśitam | 'mṛdṛśi' ityādinā atac | sūryācandramasā | sūryaśca candramāśca | 'devatādvandve ca' iti pūrvapadasya ānaḍādeśaḥ | 'supāṃ suluk' iti vibhakteḥ ākāraḥ | candramaḥśabdo dāsībhārāditvāt pūrvapadaprakṛtisvareṇa madhyodāttaḥ | ato 'devatādvandve ca' iti prāptasya ubhayapadaprakṛtisvarasya 'nottarapadenudāttādāvapṛthivī' iti pratiṣedhaḥ | abhicakṣe | cakṣeḥ prakaśanārthāt saṃpadādilakṣaṇe bhāve kvip | tādarthye caturthī | śraddhe | dṛśigrahaṇāt dhatāterbhāve vic | caturthyekavacane 'āto dhātoḥ' iti ākāralopaḥ | udāttanivṛtti- svareṇa vibhakterudāttatvam | vitanuṃram | tarateryalaṅgantāt auṇādikaḥ kurac | 'bahulaṃ chandasi' iti utvam ||
taṃ smā rathaṃ maghavannāveṃ sātaye jaitraṃ yaṃ te anumadāma saṃgame |
ājā ne indra manasā puruṣṭuta tvāyaddharyau maghavañcharma yaccha naḥ ||
tam | sma | ratham | magha'van | ā | ve | sātaye | jaitram | yam | te | anu'madāma | sam'game | ājā | naḥ | indra | manasā | puru'stuta | tvāyat'bhyaḥ | magha'van | śarma | yaccha | naḥ ||3||
he maghavan dhanavan indra sātaye asmākaṃ dhanalābhāya taṃ rama tameva rathaṃ prāva preraya vartaya |
naḥ asmākaṃ manasā buddhyā puruṣṭuta bahuśaḥ stutendra te tava svabhūtaṃ jaitraṃ jayaśīlaṃ yaṃ rathaṃ saṃgame śatrubhiḥ saha saṃgamane ājā yuddhe sati anumadāma vayamankrameṇa stumaḥ |
api ca he maghavan tvāyaddhayaḥ tvāṃ kāmayamānebhyaḥ naḥ asmabhyaṃ śarma sukhaṃ yaccha dehi ||
'ava rakṣaṇagati- kānti-' ityuktvād atra atra gatyarthaḥ |
adupadeśāt lasārvadhātukānudāttatve gati kyacā saha~kādeśe 'ekādeśa udāttena' iti tasya udāttatvam ||
vayaṃ jayema tvayā yujā vṛtaṃmasākamaṃśamudavā bharaibhare |
asmabhyamindra varivaḥ sugaṃ kṛdhi pra śatrūṇāṃ maghavanvṛṣṇyā ruja ||
vayam | jayema | tvayā | yujā | vṛtam | asmākam | aṃśam | ut | ava | bharai'bhare | asmabhyam | indra | varivaḥ | su'gam | kṛdhi | pra | śatrūṇām | magha'van | vṛṣṇyā | ruja ||4||
1. kṣa-ṭa-ṭha-ḍabhayapadaprakṛtisvaratvam | 2. kṣa-kura-pratyayaḥ | 3. kṣa ṭha-ṭha-sa-pravartaya | 4. kṣa-ṭa-ṭha-sa-ājā ājau |
he indra yujā asmābhiryuktena sahāyabhūtena tvayā vṛtaṃ āvṛṇvantaṃ śatruṃ vayaṃ stotāraḥ jayema abhibhavema|
api ca bharebhare saṃgrāmesaṃgrāme asmākam aṃśam asmadīyaṃ bhāgam udava śatrukṛtapīḍā- parihāreṇotkṛṣṭaṃ rakṣa|
tathā he indra varivaḥ dhanam asmabhyaṃ sugaṃ sugamaṃ suprāpaṃ kṛdhi kuru|
tathā he maghavan śatrūṇām asmadupadravakāriṇāṃ vṛṇyā vṛṇyāni vīryāṇi pra ruja prabhaṅgudhi bādhasve- tyarthaḥ |

nānā hi tvā harvamānā janā ime dhanānāṃ dhartarvasā vipunyavaḥ | asmākaṃ smā rathamā tiṣṭha sātaye jetraṃ hīndra nibhṛtaṃ manastava || 5 || nānā| hi| tvā| harvamānāḥ| janāḥ| ime| dhanānām| dhartaḥ| avasā| vipunyavaḥ| asmākam| sma| ratham| ā| tiṣṭha| sātayai| jetram| hi| indra| ni'bhṛtam| manaḥ| tava ||5||
he dhanānāṃ dhartaḥ gohiraṇyādirūpāṇāṃ dravyāṇāṃ dhārayitaḥ indra vipunyavaḥ |
stotāraḥ ime janāḥ avasā rakṣaṇena hetunā tvā havamānāḥ tvāmāhvayantaḥ nānā hi vibhinnaḥ khalu|
teṣāṃ madhye asmākaṃ sma asmākameva sātaye dhanadānāya ratham ā tiṣṭha āroha|
he indra nibhṛtam avyākulaṃ tava manaḥ cittaṃ jaitraṃ hi jayaśīlaṃ khalu|

gojitā bāhū amitakratuḥ simaḥ karmankarmañchatamūrtiḥ khajaṃkaraḥ | akalpa indraḥ pratimānamojasā janā vi hyante sipāsavaḥ || 6 || go'jitā| bāhū iti| amita'kratuḥ| simaḥ| karman'karman| śatam'ūtiḥ| khajam'karaḥ| akalpaḥ| indraḥ| prati'mānam| ojasā| artha| janāḥ| vi| hyante| sipāsavaḥ ||6||
he indra tava bāhū hastau gojitā jayena gavāṃ lambhitārau|
tvaṃ ca amitakratuḥ aparicchanna- jñānaḥ simaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ|
tathā ca śākhāyanakaṃ- sima iti vai śreṣṭhamācakṣate iti|
karmankarman stotṝṇāṃ karmaṇikarmaṇyapyabhyaste śatamūrtiḥ bahuvidharakṣaṇopetaḥ khajaṃkaraḥ |
ojasā sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ yadojo balamasti tena sarvaiṇa pratimānaṃ pratiniścitatvena mīyamānaḥ|
yasmāddevaguṇaviśiṣṭaḥ indraḥ atha ataḥ kāraṇāt sipāsavaḥ dhanaṃ labdhukāmāḥ janāḥ vi hyante vividhamāhvayanti |
kṣamapriya- madeṇa ca ( pā. sū. 3. 2. 44 ) iti caśabdasyānuktasamuccayārthatvāt khajaśabdopapadādapi

karoteḥ khac | ' arudvipadajantasya ' iti mum | kṛduttarapadaprakṛtisvaratvam | akalpaḥ | ' nambumyām ' ityuttarapadāntodāttatvam | siṣāsavaḥ | ' vana ṣaṇa saṃbhaktau ' | sani ' ' sanīvantardha ' iti vikalpanāt iḍabhāvaḥ | ' janasanakhanāṃ sañjhaloḥ ' iti ātvam | dvivacanādi | ' sanāśaṃsabhikṣa uḥ ' ( pā. sū. 3. 2. 168 ) iti upratyayaḥ | sati śiṣṭatvāt tasyaiva svaraḥ śiṣyate ||
uttai śatārnamadhavannucca bhūyasa utsahasrādririce kṛṣṭiṣu śravaḥ |
amātraṃ tvā dhiṣaṇā titiviṣe mahadhā vṛtrāṇi jighnase puraṃdara ||
ut | te | śatāt | maghavan | ut | ca | bhūyasaḥ | ut | sahasrāt | ririce | kṛṣṭiṣu | śravaḥ | amātram | tvā | dhiṣaṇā | titiviṣe | mahadhā | aṃdha | vṛtrāṇi | jighnase | puram'dara || 7 ||
he maghavan dhanavannindra kṛṣṭiṣu stotṛṣu manuvyeṣu svayā dīyamānaṃ śravaḥ yadannamasti tat śatāt śatasaṃkhyākāddhanāt ut ririce udriktamadhikaṃ bhavati |
api ca bhūyasaḥ śatasaṃkhyākādapi bahutarāddhanāt ut ririce adhikaṃ bhavati |
api ca amātraṃ mātrayayattyā rahitaṃ parigaṇitumaśakyaiḥ sarvairgairadhikaṃ tvāṃ mahī mahanī dhiṣaṇā asmadīyā stutilakṣaṇā vāk titiviṣe dīpayati |
he puraṃdara śatrūṇāṃ purāṃ dārayitarindra atha stutyanantaraṃ vṛtrāṇi āvarakān śatrūn jighnase haṃsi vināśayasi ||
' khaci hrasvaḥ ' ( pā. sū. 6. 4. 94 ) iti hrasvatvam |
' vācyamapuraṃdarau ca ' ( pā. sū. 6. 3. 69 ) iti nipātanāt am ||
atīdaṃ viśvaṃ bhuvanaṃ vavakṣithāśatrurindra januṣā sanādasi ||
triviṣṭa'dhātu | prati'mānam | ojasaḥ | tisraḥ | bhūmīḥ | nṛ'pate | trīṇi | rocanā | ati | idam | viśvam | bhuvanam | vavakṣitha | aśatruḥ | indra | januṣā | sanāt | asi || 8 ||
he nṛpate nṛṇāṃ pālayitarindra tvam ojasaḥ sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ balasya pratimānaṃ pratinidhirasi |
yathā ' tridhātu pañcadhātu vā śulbaṃ karoti ' iti |
yathā triviṣṭadviguṇitā rajjuḥ dvatīyasī evamindro'pi dṛḍhatara ityarthaḥ |
kiṃca tvaṃ tisro bhūmīḥ trīn lokān trīṇi rocanā trīṇi tejāṃsi divi ādityākhyam antarikṣe vaidyutarūpamagniṃ
pṛthivyām āhavanīyādirūpeṇa vartamānaṃ pārthivamagnim evaṃ trīn lokān trīṇi tejāṃsi ca va ati vava- sthitha atiśayena voḍhumicchasi |
api ca i idaṃ va viśvaṃ sarvaṃ va bhuvanaṃ bhūtajātaṃ cātivoḍhumicchasi |
sarvasya jagataḥ pālanena tvameva sarveṣāṃ nirvāhakaḥ bhavamītyarthaḥ |
yasmāt he va indra tvaṃ va sanāt cirakālādārabhya va jatuṣā janmanā janmaprabhṛti va atruḥ sapanarahitaḥ va ami ||
tridhā triprakāreṇa viṣṭyā praveśanena vidhīyate kriyate iti triviṣṭadhātuḥ triguṇitā rajjuḥ |
dhājaḥ sitani- gamimasi ( u. sū. 1. 69 ) ityādinā kameṇa tunpratyayaḥ |
atra daṭharajuvācakaḥ śabdastadvataṃ dātthya lakṣayitvā tadvati pratimāne vartate |
śasi tricaturoḥ striyām iti tistrādeśaḥ antodāttaḥ |
he indra tvaṃ jigetha śatrūn jayasi |
tathā dhanā śatrubhyo'pahatāni dhanāni na harodhitha nāvaruṇatsi |
he mavavan dhanavannindra arbheṣu alpeṣu ājā ājiṣu saṃgrāmeṣu mahatsu ca prauḍhepu saṃgrāmeṣu ca avase asmākaṃ rakṣaṇārtham ugram urdūrṇam adhikabalaṃ tvāṃ saṃ śiśīmami stotraistīkṣṇīkurmaḥ |
atha anantaraṃ he indra tvaṃ havaneṣu yuddhārthamāhvāneṣu sasṛ āgamya naḥ : asmān codaya saṃgrāmeṣu preraya |
liṭi thali krādi- niyamān prāptasya iṭaḥ acastāsvathyalyaniṭo nityam (pā. sū. 7. 2. 61) iti pratiṣedhaḥ |
‘agniṃ vāvādityaḥ sāyaṃ praviśati tasmādagniṃrātraktaṃ dadṛśe’ iti śruteḥ |
‘ukhantaṃ vāvādityamabhiranusamārohati tasmādūma evāpredivā dadṛśe’ (tai. brā. 2. 1.2. 9-10 ) iti śruteḥ |
yathā samane saṃgrāme yudhyamānayoḥ ubhayoḥ ^keturdhvajo dhvajāntareṇa saṃyujyate tadvat ||
sa dhārayatpṛthivīṃ praprathacca vajreṇa hatvā nirapaḥ sarsarja |
saḥ | dhārayat | pṛthivīm | praprathat | ca | vajreṇa | hatvā | niḥ | apaḥ | sarsarja | ahan | ahim | abhinat | rauhiṇam | vi | ahan | viḍaṃsam | maghavā | śacībhiḥ ||2||
api ca ^vajreṇa āyudhena hantavyān vṛtrādīn ^hatvā ^apaḥ ṛtūdakāni ^niḥ ^sarsarja meghācchirgamayāmāsa |
api ca ^maghavā dhanavānindraḥ ^śacībhiḥ ātmīyairyuddhakarmabhiḥ ^vyaṃsaṃ vigatabhujaṃ vṛtrāsuram ^ahan avadhīt ||
‘ṇāviṣṭhavatprātipadikasya kāryam’ (pā. sū. 6. 4. 155. 1 ) iti vacanāt ‘ra ṛto °halāderlaghoḥ’ (pā. sū. 6. 4. 161 ) iti ṛkārasya ratvam |
na^ ṇilopasya sthānivattvaṃ, ‘na padānta° ’ ityādinā svaravidhiṃ prati tanniṣedhāt |
sa jāturdharmā śraddhān ojaḥ puro vibhindancaradi dāsīḥ |
saḥ | jātuḥdharmā | śrutdhrdhān | ojaḥ | puraḥ | vi'bhindan | acarat | vi | dāsīḥ | vidvān | vajrin | dasyave | hetim | asya | āryam | sahaḥ | vardhaya | dyumnam | indra ||3||
1. kṣa-ṭa-ṭha-na-sa-anyadekam | 2. kṣa-ubhayoḥ senayoḥ | 3. kṣa-sa-sthirām | 4. kṣa-ṭa-ṭha-sa-yadvā prathayaterluṅi | 5. kṣa-na-sa-dvivacanam | 6. kṣa-na ca |
vojaḥ ojasā balena niṣpannaṃ kāryaṃ vśraddhānaḥ ādarātiśayena kāmayamānaḥ vevaṃbhūtaḥ vsaḥ indraḥ vdāsīḥ dasyusambandhīni vpuraḥ purāṇi vvibhindan vināśayan vvi vacaran vividhamagacchan |
he vvajrin vajravan indra vvidvān stutīḥ vijānaṃstvam vasya stotuḥ vdamyave upakṣayakāriṇe śatrave vhetim āyudhaṃ visṛjeti śeṣaḥ |
'anyeṣvāpi dṛśyate' iti dṛśagrahaṇāt sarvopādhivyabhicārārthatvāt kevalādapi ḍapratyayaḥ |

tadasyedaṃ paśyatā bhūri puṣṭaṃ śradindrasya dhattana vīryam | sa gā avindatso avindaścāntasa oṣadhīḥ so apaḥ sa vanāni || 5 || tad | asya | idam | paśyata | bhūri | puṣṭam | śrat | indrasya | dhattana | vīryam | saḥ | gāḥ | avindat | saḥ | avindat | aśvān | saḥ | oṣadhīḥ | saḥ | apaḥ | saḥ | vanāni ||5||
he ṛtvigyajamānalakṣaṇā janāḥ asya indrasya tat idaṃ vīryaṃ puṣṭaṃ pravṛddham |
ata eva bhūri vistīrṇaṃ paśyata ālokayata |
tasmai ca vīryāya śrat dhattana bahumānaṃ kuruta |
saḥ indraḥ paṇibhirapahatāḥ gāḥ yena vīryeṇa avindat alabhata |
tathā tairapa- hatān aśvān saḥ indro yena avindat |
api ca saḥ indraḥ oṣadhīḥ oṣadhyupalakṣitāṃ sarvāṃ bhūmiṃ yena vīryeṇālabhata |
nathā vṛtreṇa niruddhāḥ apaḥ vṛṣṭyudakāni saḥ indro yenālabhata |
tathā vanāni vananīyāni saṃbhajanīyāni dhanāni saḥ indro yena vīryeṇa prāpnot ||

bhūrikarmaṇe vṛṣabhāya vṛṣṇe satyaśuṣmāya sunavāma somam | ya āhatyā paripanthīva śūro'ryajano vibhajaneti vedaḥ || 6 || bhūrikarmaṇe | vṛṣabhāya | vṛṣṇe | satya'śuṣmāya | sunavāma | somam | yaḥ | ā'hatya | pari'panthī'iva | śūraḥ | arya'janaḥ | vi'bhajan | eti | vedaḥ || 6 ||

bhūrikarmaṇe bahuvidhena śatruvadhādirūpeṇa karmaṇā yuktāya vṛṣabhāya vṛṣabhavata sarveṣu deveṣu śreṣṭhāya vṛṣṇe secanasamarthāya satyaśuṣmāya avitathabalāyendrāya tadarthaṃ somaṃ sunavāma homāryaṃ rasarūpaṃ kara- vāma |
śūraḥ śauryopetaḥ yaḥ indraḥ āhatya dhanaviṣayamādaraṃ kṛtvā ayajvanaḥ ayajamānasya vedaḥ dhanaṃ vibhajan tasmāt ayajamānādvibhaktaṃ kurvannapaharan eti |
paripanthīva yathā mārganirodhakaścauro gacchatāṃ puṇyapuruṣāṇāṃ dhanaṃ balātkāreṇapahṛtya gacchati tadvat ||
tasya sthāni- vadbhāvena kṛttve sati hrasvasya piti kṛti iti tuk |
chandasi paripanthiparipariṇī paryavasthātari (pā. sū. 5. 2. 89) iti inipratyayānto nipātyate ||

tadindraṃ prevaṃ vīryaṃ cakrartha yatsasantaṃ vajreṇābodhayo'him | anu tvā patnīrhaṣitaṃ vayaśca viśve devāso amadannu tvā || 7 || tat | indra | pra | eva | vīryam | cakrartha | yat | sasantam | vajreṇa | abodhayaḥ | ahim | anu | tvā | patnīḥ | haṣitam | vayaḥ | ca | viśve | devāḥ | amadan | anu | tvā || 7 ||
'sasantaṃ svapantaṃ madonmattam 'ahiṃ vṛtraṃ 'vajreṇa kuliśena 'yat yena vīryeṇa tvam 'abodhayaḥ |
prabuddhaḥ' san mayā saha yuddhaṃ karotviti 'hapitaṃ tādṛśasya vṛtrasya hananena 'prāsaharṣaṃ svām 'anu paścāt 'patnīḥ devapattyaḥ 'amadan harṣa prāptāḥ |
api ca 'vayaśca gamanaśīlā mahato'pi tathā 'viśva 'devāsaḥ anye ca sarve devāḥ 'tvām 'anu paścāt amadan amādyan ||
śuṣṇaṃ pipruṃ kuyavaṃ vṛtramindra yadāvadhīrvi puraḥ śambarasya |
tannau mitro varuṇo māmahantāmaditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ ||
yathāśvaḥ svāno hepāśabdaṃ kurvan svakīyaṃ sthānaṃ śīghramāgacchati tadvat |
ᵥvayaḥ aśvabandhanārthān raśmīna ᵥvimucya rathādviśliṣya tathā ᵥaśvān rathe yojitāṃśca turagān ᵥavasāya vimucya |
atra niruktam- ‘avasāyāṃścāniti syatirūpasṛṣṭe vimocane ’ ( niru. 1. 17 ) iti |
ᵥdoṣā rātrī ᵥvastoḥ ahani ca ᵥvahiyasaḥ ādarātiśayena voḍhṛn ||
ciyanti rathena saha saṃgacchante iti viśabdena raśmayaḥ ucyante |
‘ turibhemeyaḥsu ’ iti ṭalope kartavye ḍhatvadhatvaṣṭutvaḍhalopānāmasiddhatvāt tadāśritasya osvasyāpyabhāve ṭalopa eva kriyate ||
o tye nara indramṛte gune cittāntsṛdho adhvano jagamyāt |
devāso manyuṃ dāsasya śrumanate na ā vakṣantasuvitāya varṇam ||
o iti | tye | naraḥ | indram | ūtayai | guḥ | nu | cit | tān | sṛdhaḥ | adhvanaḥ | jagamyāt | devāsaḥ | manyum | dāsasya | śrumana | te | naḥ | ā | vakṣan | suvitāya | varṇam || 2 ||
ᵥye te ᵥnaraḥ yajñasya netāro yajamānāḥ ᵥūtaye rakṣaṇāya ᵥindram ᵥo |

teṣāṃ 'vaḥ yuṣmākaṃ saṃbandhi stotṛviṣayam 'ṛtaṃ satyaṃ 'kat kasmin deśe vartate |
api ca 'pratnā cirakālīnā 'vaḥ yuṣmākaṃ saṃbandhinī 'āhutiḥ mayā pūrvamanu- ṣṭhito yāgaḥ 'ka kutrāsīt |
īdṛgbhūtaduḥkhānubhavena mayā pūrvamanuṣṭhito yāgasamūho yuṣmāpta prāpnodityanu- mime |
kadaryamṇo mahaspathāti krāmema duṣṭyau vittaṃ me asya raudasī ||
kat | vaḥ | ṛtasya | dharṇasi | kat | varuṇasya | cakṣaṇam | kat | aryamṇaḥ | mahaḥ | pṛthā | āti | krāmema | duḥ'dhryaḥ | vittam | me | asya | rodasī iti ||6||
he devāḥ vaḥ yuṣmākaṃ saṃbandhanaḥ¹ ṛtasya satyasya abhimatphalaprāpaṇasya dharṇasi dhāraṇaṃ kat kutra gatam |
varuṇasya aniṣṭanivārakasya devasya cakṣaṇam anugrahadṛṣṭyā darśanaṃ kat kva gatam |
mahaḥ mahato mahānubhāvasya aryamṇaḥ arīṇāṃ niyantuḥ etatsaṃjñakasya devasya saṃbandhanā pathā śobhanamārgeṇa iṣṭa- deśaprāpaṇaṃ kat kva gatam |
ato vayaṃ duṣṭyaḥ durdhiyaḥ pāpabuddhīn asmadaniṣṭācaraṇaparān śatrūn ati krāmema atitarema |
taiḥ kṛtādaramāt kūpapātālalakṣaṇāt duḥkhatvāt vayamuttīrṇā bhavema |
'dhye ca' iti tatra pāṭhāt duro rephasya utvam uttarapadādeḥ dhutvaṃ ca |
ahaṃ so asmi yaḥ purā mute vadāmi kāniṃ cit |
taṃ mā vyantyādhyo3 vṛko na tṛṣṇajaṃ mṛgaṃ vittaṃ me asya raudasī ||
aham | saḥ | asmi | yaḥ | purā | sute | vadāmi | kāniṃ | cit | tam | mā | vyanti | ā'dhyaḥ | vṛkaḥ | na | tṛṣṇa'jam | mṛgam | vittam | me | asya | rodasī iti || 7 ||
he devāḥ purā pūrvasmin kāle sute yuṣmadyāgārthaṃ some'bhipute kāni cit katipayāni stotrāṇi yaḥ ahaṃ vadāmi uktavānasmi saḥ evāham asmi na tu anyaḥ kaścit |
taṃ tādṛśaṃ mām ādhyaḥ abhilaṣitaputrādyaprāptyā janitā mānarayo vyathāḥ vyanti bhakṣayanti |
tṛṣṇajaṃ jātatṛṣṇaṃ pipāsantam udakaṃ prati gacchantaṃ mṛgaṃ vṛko na yathā araṇyasthā madhyemārgaṃ bhakṣayati tadvat |
'jasādiṣu cchandasi vāvacanam' iti 'jasi ca' iti guṇasya vikalpanāt abhāve yaṇādeśaḥ |
padakārastvevaṃ manyate—‘anyeṣvapi dṛśyate’ iti dṛśagrahaṇasya sarvopādhivyabhi- cāratvāt kevalādapi janerḍapratyayaḥ|
mū॒ṣo na śi॒śnā vya̭danti mā॒dhya॒ḥ stotā̭raṃ te śatakrato॒ vita̭ṃ me a॒sya ro̭dasī ||
sam| mā| tapanti| abhitaḥ| sapatnīḥ| iva| parśavaḥ| mūṣaḥ| na| śiśnā| vi| adanti| mā| ādhyaḥ| stotāram| te| śatakrato iti śata'krato| vittam| me| asya| rodasī iti || 8 ||
he indra parśavaḥ pārśvasthīni atra sāmarthyāt parśusthānīyāḥ|
1 kūpabhittayaḥ ‘mā mām abhitaḥ sarvataḥ ‘saṃ tapanti samyak pīḍayanti|
samānaḥ ekaḥ patiryāsāṃ tāḥ sapatnyo yathaikaṃ patirmabhitaḥ pīḍayanti|
he 3 śatakrato bahuvidhakarman bahuvidhaprajña vā indra 3 te tava 3 stotāraṃ mām 3 ādhyaḥ asaṃpadyamānairyāgadānādibhirūtpāditāḥ mānasasyaḥ pīḍāḥ 4 vyadanti vividhaṃ bhakṣayanti|
4 mūṣo 4 na yathā mūṣikāḥ 4 śiśnā śiśnāni kuvindena vāyitāni annarasena āliptāni 4 sūtrāṇi bhakṣayanti|
yathā svakīyāni pucchāni ghṛtatailādibhāṇḍe prakṣipya ūrdhvamutkṛṣya vyadanti lihantītyarthaḥ|
na caitat he indra tava stoturyāyyam|
atra niruktaṃ—‘saṃtapanti māmabhitaḥ sapatnya ivemāḥ parśavaḥ kūpaparśvaḥ|
1 ‘kṛvādīnāṃ ke dve bhavata iti vaktavyam’ (kā. 6. 1. 12. 1) iti dvivacanam|
a॒mī ye sa॒pta ra̭śmaya॒statrā̭ me॒ nābhi̭ratā॒tā|
tri॒tastadvḙda॒ ādhya॒ḥ sa jā॒mitvā̭ya॒ rebha̭ti॒ vita̭ṃ me a॒sya ro̭dasī ||
amī| ye| sapta| raśmayaḥ| tatra| me| nābhiḥ| ātātā| tritaḥ| tat| veda| ādhyaḥ| saḥ| jāmitvāya| rebhati| vittam| me| asya| rodasī iti ||9||
1. sa-pārśvasthānīyāḥ| 2. kṣa-parasparaṃ vā pāḍayanti tadvat; ṭha-tadvat| 3. ca-dha-dha-mā mām| 4. kṣa-sa-lisāni|
ye 'amī dyuloke vartamānāḥ saptasaṃkhyākāḥ 'raśmayaḥ sūryasya kiraṇāḥ santi 'tatra teṣu sūrya raśmivadhyātmaṃ saptaprāṇarūpeṇa vartamāneṣu 'me madīyā 'nābhiḥ 'ātātā saṃbaddhā |
'tritaḥ tīrthanamastiraskṛtājñānaḥ 'āhyaḥ apāṃ putraḥ ṛṣiḥ 'tat pūrvoktaṃ vṛttāntaṃ 'veda jānāti 'nānyaḥ |
amī ye pañcokṣaṇo madhye tasthurmaho divaḥ |
devatrā nu pravācyaṃ sandhrīcīnā ni vavṛturvitaṃ me asya raudasī ||
amī iti | ye | pañca | ukṣaṇaḥ | madhye | tasthuḥ | mahaḥ | divaḥ | devatrā | nu | pravācyam | sandhrīcīnāḥ | ni | vavṛtuḥ | vittam | me | asya | rodasī iti || 10 ||
' tacca indrastadruṇastadapristadarthamā tasravitā cano dhāt ' ( ṛ. saṃ. 1. 107. 3 ) ityardhena pratipāditāḥ pañcasaṃkhyākā devāḥ |
tathā ca śāṭyāyanakam - ' etānyeva pañca jyotīṃṣi yānyeva lokeṣu dīpyante |
agniḥ pṛthivyāṃ vāyurantarikṣe ca ' ādityo divi candramā nakṣatre vidhudapsu ' iti |
taittirīye'pyevamāmnātam - 'agniḥ pṛthivyāṃ vāyurantarikṣe sūryo divi candramā dikṣu nakṣatrāṇi svaloke ' ( tai. ā. 1. 20. 1 ) iti |

'ye 'amī pañcasaṃkhyākā devāḥ 'maho 'divaḥ mahato vistīrṇasya dyulokasya 'madhye 'tasthuḥ tiṣṭhanti āsate 'devatrā deveṣu 'nu kṣipraṃ 'pravācyaṃ praśaṃsanīyaṃ devānāṃ yogyaṃ madīyaṃ stotraṃ prati 'sandhrīcīnāḥ sahāñcanto yugapadāgacchantaste devāḥ madīyaṃ paricaraṇaṃ svīkurvanti ' |
' sahasya sadhiḥ ' ( pā. sū. 6. 3. 95 ) iti sadhyādeśaḥ |
suparṇā eta āsate madhya ārodhane divaḥ |
te sedhanti pṛtho vṛkaṃ tarantaṃ yahtīrapo vittaṃ me asya raudasī ||
suparṇāḥ | ete | āsate | madhye | ārodhane | divaḥ | te | sedhanti | pṛthaḥ | vṛkam | tarantam | yahtīḥ | apaḥ | vittam | me | asya | rodasī iti || 11 ||
ārodhane sarvasyāvarake vyāse divaḥ antarikṣasya madhye āsate vartante |
te sūryaraśmayaḥ pathaḥ mārgāt vṛkam araṇyasthānaṃ sedhanti niṣedhanti nivārayanti |
kūpa- patanātpūrvaṃ tritaṃ dṛṣṭvā enaṃ bhakṣayituṃ kaścidaraṇyasthā mahatī nadī titīrṣuḥ ājagāma |
sa ca sūryaraśmīn dṛṣṭvā ayamavasaro na bhavatīti nivṛtte |
yahvatīrage mahadantarikṣaṃ pathaḥ pathā dvādaśāśyātmanā2 mārgeṇa tarantaṃ vṛkaṃ candramasaṃ sūryaraśmayo niṣe- dhanti |
ahani hi sūryaraśmibhiḥ niruddhaścandramā niṣprabho dṛśyate |

navyaṃ tadukathyaṃ hitaṃ devāsaḥ supravācanam | ṛtamarṣanti sindhavaḥ satyaṃ tātān sūryo vittaṃ me asya raudasī || 12 || navyam | tat | ukthyam | hitam | devāsaḥ | supravācanam | ṛtam | arpanti | sindhavaḥ | satyam | tatān | sūryaḥ | vittam | me | asya | rodasī iti || 12 ||
ukthyaṃ praśasyaṃ stutyahaṃ supravācanaṃ suṣṭhu ṛtvigbhirvācayituṃ śakyam evaṃbhūtaṃ tat bhavadīyaṃ balaṃ hitaṃ yuṣmāsu nihitam |
ato yuṣmadīyena balena sindhavaḥ syandanaśīlā nadyaḥ ṛtam udakam arpanti ālasyarāhityena sarvadā prerayanti |
tathā sūryaḥ satyaṃ sarvadā vidyamānaṃ svīyaṃ tejaḥ tatān ātanauti vistārayati |
asmān ṇyantāt 'anyebhyo'pi dṛśyate' iti khaltheṃ yuc |

agre tav tyudukathyaṃ deveṣvastyāpyam | sa naḥ sutto manuṣvadā devānyakṣi viduṣṭaro vittaṃ me asya raudasī || 13 || agne | tave | tyat | ukthyam | deveṣu | asti | āpyam | saḥ | naḥ | suttaḥ | manuṣvat | ā | devān | yakṣi | viduṣṭaraḥ | vittam | me | asya | rodasī iti || 13 ||
he ᵥagne ᵥtava ᵥukthyaṃ praśastyaṃ ᵥdhat‌ śrutiprasiddham‌ ᵥāpyam‌ |
tasmāt ᵥsaḥ tādṛśaḥ ᵥviduṣṭaraḥ viduttarastvaṃ ᵥnaḥ asmākaṃ yajñe ᵥsattaḥ nipaṇṇaḥ san ᵥdevān tānindrādīn ᵥā śāstramaryādayā ᵥyakṣi yaja havirbhiḥ pūjaya |
‘nabho'stromanuṣāṃ vyupasaṃlyanam’ (pā. sū. 1. 4. 18. 3) iti bhāvena padatvābhāvāt ratvādya- bhāvaḥ |
vidusśabdāt tarapi ayasmayādivena bhatvāt ‘vamoḥ saṃprasāraṇam’ iti saṃprasāraṇam |

satto hotā manuṣyadā devā acchā viduṣṭaraḥ | agnirhavyā suṣūdati devo deveṣu medhiro vittaṃ me asya raudasī || 14 || sattaḥ | hotā | ᵥmanuṣyat | ā | ᵥdevān | acchā | ᵥviduḥstaraḥ | agniḥ | havyā | suṣūdati | devaḥ | ᵥdeveṣu | medhiraḥ | ᵥvittam | ᵥme | ᵥasya | ᵥraudasī iti || 14 ||

ᵥmanuṣyat manorivāsmākaṃ yajñe ᵥsattaḥ niṣaṇṇaḥ ᵥhotā devānāmāhvātā ᵥviduṣṭaraḥ vidustaraḥ ᵥdevaḥ dānādiguṇayuktaḥ ᵥdeveṣu sarveṣvindrādiṣu madhye ᵥmedhiraḥ medhāvī evaṃbhūtaḥ ᵥagniḥ tān ᵥdevān ᵥacchā ābhimukhyena ᵥhavyā havyāni asmadīyāni havīṃṣi |

brahmā kṛṇoti varuṇo gātuvidaṃ tamīṃmahe | vyūrṇoti hṛdā matiṃ narvyo jāyatāmṛtaṃ vittaṃ me asya raudasī || 15 || brahma | kṛṇoti | varuṇaḥ | ᵥgātu'vidam | tam | ᵥīmahe | vi | ᵥūrṇoti | hṛdā | ᵥmatim | ᵥnarvyaḥ | ᵥjāyatām | ṛtam | ᵥvittam | ᵥme | ᵥasya | ᵥraudasī iti || 15 ||

yaḥ ᵥvaruṇaḥ aniṣṭasyaᵥ nivārayitā devaḥ ᵥbrahma parivṛtaṃ tadrakṣaṇarūpaṃ karma ᵥkṛṇoti karoti ᵥtaṃ tādṛśaṃ ᵥgātuvidaṃ gātormārgasya duḥkhanivārakasyaᵥ lambhayitāraṃ varuṇam ᵥīmahe abhimataphalaṃ yācāmahe |

īmahe iti yājakarmā| tasmai varuṇāya ayamasmadīyaḥ stotā hadā hṛdayena mati mananīyāṃ stutiṃ vyūrṇoti vivṛṇoti prakāśayati uccārayatītyarthaḥ | so'yaṃ navyaḥ stutyo varuṇo'smākam ṛtaṃ jāyatāṃ navyabhūto'stu || brahma | ‘ anyeṣāmapi dṛśyate ’ iti sāṃhitiko dīrghaḥ | gātuvidam | ‘ vidla lābhe ’ | antarbhāvitaṇyarthān kip | īmahe | ‘ īṅ gatau ’ | ‘ bahulaṃ chandasi ’ iti vikaraṇasya luk | hadā | ‘ paṭana ’ ityādinā hṛdayaśabdasya hadādeśaḥ || || 22 ||
asau yaḥ panthā ādityo divi pravācyaṃ kṛtaḥ |
na sa devā atikrame taṃ martāso na paśyatha vittaṃ me asya rodasī ||
asau | yaḥ | panthāḥ | ādityaḥ | divi | pra'vācyam | kṛtaḥ | na | saḥ | devāḥ | ati'krame | tam | martāsaḥ | na | paśyatha | vittam | me | asya | rodasī iti || 16 ||
‘ sūryadvāreṇa te virajāḥ prayānti ’ (mu. u. 1. 2. 11) iti śruteḥ |
evaṃbhūtaḥ yaḥ asau ādityaḥ divi dhuloke pravācyaṃ prakaraṇa vacanaṃ yathā bhavati tathā kṛtaḥ nirmitaḥ |
yathā sarvaiḥ prāṇibhirdṛśyate tathā vartamānaḥ ityarthaḥ |
he devāḥ saḥ ayamādityo yuṣmābhirapi na atikrame atikramituṃ na śakyaḥ |
mati hi sūrye vasantādyaḥ kālā niṣpadyante |
evaṃ ca mati he martāsaḥ : pāpakṛto manuṣyāḥ taṃ mahānubhāvaṃ sūryaṃ na paśyatha sūryaṃ na jānītha |
etacca kūpe pātayitvā nirgatau ekatadvitau prati nindanam |
ahameva mantradraṣṭā taṃ sūryaṃ jānāmi pāpakṛtau yuvāṃ na jānīthaḥ iti ||
vakterṇyantāt ‘ aco yat ’ iti bhāve yat |
tacchuśrāva bṛhaspatiḥ kṛṇvanhūraṇādu ru vittaṃ me asya rodasī ||
tritaḥ | kūpe | ava'hitaḥ | devān | havate | ūtaye | tat | śuśrāva | bṛhaspatiḥ | kṛṇvan | ahūraṇāt | uru | vittam | me | asya | rodasī iti ||17||

aruṇavarṇaḥ ^3 lohitavarṇaḥ ^v vṛkaḥ araṇyaśvā ^v sakṛt ^v ekavāraṃ ^v pathā ^v yantaṃ mārgeṇa gacchantaṃ māṃ ^v dadarśa ^v hi dṛṣṭavān |
^v nicāyya dṛṣṭvā ca māṃ jighṛkṣuḥ san ^v ujihīte utcchati sma ^v |
yathā takṣaṇajanitapṛṣṭhakleśaḥ naṣṭā vardhikaḥ tadapanodanāya ūrdhvābhimukho bhavati tadvat |
he ^v dyāvāpṛthivyau madīyamidaṃ duḥkhaṃ ^v vittaṃ jānītam" |
aruṇaḥ : ārocamānaḥ kṛtsnasya jagataḥ prakāśakaḥ māsakṛt māsārdhamāsatvena- saṃvatsarādīn kālaviśeṣān kurvan |
sa candramāḥ ākāśamārge ^4 yantaṃ gacchantaṃ nakṣatragaṇaṃ dadarśa |
nakṣatragaṇameva dadarśa na kṛpapatitaṃ māmityanādaro dyotyate |
atra māsakṛt iti yāskaḥ ekaṃ padaṃ manyate śākalyastu padadvayam |
atra niruktaṃ- 'vṛka- ścandramā bhavati vivṛtajyotiṣko vā vikṛtajyotiṣko vā vikrāntajyotiṣko vā |
aruṇa ārocanaḥ ^9 māsakṛnmāsānāṃ cārdhamāsānāṃ ca kartā bhavati candramā vṛkaḥ |
yathā yantaṃ dadarśa nakṣatragaṇamabhijihīte nicāyya yena yena yokṣyamāṇo bhavati candramāstakṣṇavaśca pṛṣṭharogī' (niru. 5. 20-21) iti ||

1. kṣa-sa-etatsaṃjjñakaḥ | 2. kṣa-duḥkhāprasihetubhūtā | 3. kṣa-sa-aruṇaḥ aruṇavarṇaḥ | 4. kṣa-sma ' nāsti | 5. kṣa-ṭha-ṭha-'he...jānītam ' nāsti | 6. kṣa-sa-pathā ākāśamārgeṇa | 7. kṣa-ṭa-ṭha-tadbhāryāḥ | 8. kṣa-ṭa-ṭha- punaḥpaśyamānāḥ sakṛdeva paśyati | 9. kṣa-sa-ārocamānaḥ | ka. 82

varaṇe ' | ' sutrabhūṣupimubhyaḥ kin ' ( u. sū. 3. 321 ) iti kamapratyayaḥ | jihīte | ' ohāṅ gatau ' | jauhotyādikaḥ | ' bhṛjāmit ' iti abhyāsasya itvam | nicātya | ' cāyu pūjāniśā- manayoḥ ' | atra ' darśanārthau dhātūnāmekārthatvāt ' | ' samāse'napūrve kvo lyap ' | pṛṣṭāmayī | ' rapṛśā saṃsparśane ' | spṛśyate'neneti spṛṣṭiḥ | chāndaso varṇalopaḥ | pṛṣṭāvamayaḥ pṛṣṭāmayaḥ | tadvān pṛṣṭāmayī ||

enāṅgūṣeṇa vayamindravanto'bhi vyāṃma vṛjane sarvavīrāḥ | tanno mitro varuṇo māmahantāmaditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ || 19 || enā | āṅgūṣeṇa | vayam | indra'vantaḥ | abhi | syāma | vṛjane | sarvavīrāḥ | tat | naḥ | mitraḥ | varuṇaḥ | mamahantām | aditiḥ | sindhuḥ | pṛthivī | uta | dyauḥ || 19 ||

enā anena āṅgūṣeṇa āghoṣaṇayogyeṇa stotreṇa hetubhūtena indravantaḥ anugrāhakakendreṇa yuktāḥ sarvavīrāḥ sarvairviraiḥ putraiḥ pautrādibhiścopetāḥ santaḥ vayaṃ vṛjane saṃgrāme abhi vyāma śatrūnabhi- bhavema |
tat idamasmadīyaṃ vacanaṃ mitrādayaḥ mamahantāṃ pūjayantu pālayantvityarthaḥ |
' dvitīyāṭauḥ svenaḥ ' ( pā. sū. 2. 4. 34 ) iti tṛtīyāyām idama enādeśaḥ |
asteḥ prārthanāyāṃ liṅi bhasoralopaḥ iti akāralopaḥ |
upasargādādhuryāmasti- ryaccaparaḥ ( pā. sū. 8. 3. 87 ) iti ṣatvam |
tatra ' indram ' iti saptakaṃ prathamaṃ sūktam |
atrānukramyate- ' indraṃ mitraṃ sasa triṣṭubhantam ' iti |
tritastu vāviśiṣṭatvāt tatraiva vika- lpito nānuvartate |

indraṃ mitraṃ varuṇamagnimutaye mārutaṃ śardho aditiṃ havāmahe | rathaṃ na durgādvasavaḥ sudānavo viśvasmānno aṃhaso niṣpipartana || 1 || indram | mitram | varuṇam | agnim | ūtaye | mārutam | śardhaḥ | aditim | havāmahe | ratham | na | duḥ'gāt | vasavaḥ | su'dānavaḥ | viśvasmāt | naḥ | aṃhasaḥ | niḥ | pipartana || 1 ||
ūtaye rakṣaṇāya vayamindrādīn mārutaṃ śardhaḥ marutsamūha rūpaṃ balaṃ ca havāmahe āhvayāmahe |
vasavaḥ nivāsayitāraḥ sudānavaḥ śobhanadānāḥ indrādayaḥ viśvasmāt sarvasmāt aṃhasaḥ pāpāt 1. kṣa-ṭa-ṭha-niśāmanaṃ darśanam |

na: asmān niṣpipartana nirgamaya pālayata | tatra dṛṣṭāntaḥ | rathaṃ na durgāt | gantumaśakyājjighnakṣatāt sthānāt sārathayo yathā rathaṃ pālayanti tadvat || pipartana | pṛ ityeke | loṭī tasanasanathanāśca iti tasya tanabādeśaḥ | pinvena ṅittvābhāvāt guṇaḥ | artapiparyośca iti abhyāsasya itvam ||
ta ādityā ā gatā sarvatātaye bhūta devā vṛtratūryeṣu śaṃbhuvaḥ |
rathaṃ na durgādvasavaḥ sudānavo viśvasmānno aṃṃhaso niṣpipartana ||
te | ādityāḥ | ā | gata | sarvatātaye | bhūta | devāḥ | vṛtratūryeṣu | śam'bhuvaḥ | ratham | na | duḥ'gāt | vasavaḥ | su'dānavaḥ | viśvasmāt | naḥ | aṃṃhasaḥ | niḥ | pipartana ||2||
he ādityāḥ aditaḥ putrāḥ devāḥ te yūyaṃ sarvatātaye sarvairvīrapuruṣaistatāya vistāritāya yuddhāya |
saṃgrāmeṣu śaṃbhuvaḥ sukhasya bhāvayitāraḥ bhūta bhavata ||
gameloṭi bahulaṃ chandasi iti śapo luk ||
avantu naḥ pitaraḥ supravācanā uta devī devaputre ṛtāvṛdhā |
rathaṃ na durgādvasavaḥ sudānavo viśvasmānno aṃṃhaso niṣpipartana ||
avantu | naḥ | pitaraḥ | su'pravācanāḥ | uta | devī | iti | devaputre iti deva'putre | ṛta'vṛdhā | ratham | na | duḥ'gāt | vasavaḥ | su'dānavaḥ | viśvasmāt | naḥ | aṃṃhasaḥ | niḥ | pipartana || 3 ||
na: asmān pitaraḥ abhiprāyatādayaḥ avantu rakṣantu |
uta api ca devaputre devāḥ sarve putrasthānīyā yatoste ṛtāvṛdhā ṛtasya satyasya yajñasya vā vardhayitavyau devī devanādiguṇayukte dyāvāpṛthivyau asmān rakṣatām |
narāśaṃsaṃ vājinaṃ vājaryaniśca kṣayadvīraṃ pūṣaṇaṃ sumnairīmahe |
rathaṃ na durgādvasavaḥ sudānavo viśvasmānno aṃṃhaso niṣpipartana ||
narāśaṃsam | vājinam | vāja'yan | iha | kṣayat'vīram | pūṣaṇam | sumnaiḥ | īmahe | ratham | na | duḥ'gāt | vasavaḥ | su'dānavaḥ | viśvasmāt | naḥ | aṃṃhasaḥ | niḥ | pipartana ||4||

1. kṣa-ṭa-ṭha- 'devāḥ' nāsti | 2. kṣa-bhavata | gatamanyat | 3. kṣa-ṭa-ṭha-sa- 'luk' ityasyā- nantaraṃ 'anudāttapadeśatyādinā anunāsikalopaḥ | bhūta | bahulaṃ chandasi iti śapo luk' ityadhikam | 4. kṣa-dānādiguṇayukte | 5. kṣa-ṭa-ṭha-rakṣatam |
ᵛnarāśaṃsaṃ naraiḥ śaṃsanīyaṃ ᵛvājinam aśvavantampri ᵛvājayan upavājayan prajvalayan ᵛiha asmin kāle staumīti śeṣaḥ |
tathā ᵛkṣayadvīram atibalinaṃ yasmin sarve vīrāḥ kṣīyante ᵛevaṃrūpaṃ ᵛpūṣaṇaṃ poṣakaṃ devaṃ ᵛsuṣṭhuḥ sukhakaraiḥ stotrairhetubhūtaiḥ ᵛīmahe yācāmahe abhīṣṭaṃ prārthayāmahe |
tasya ‘chandasyubhayathā’ iti ārdhadhātu- katvena ṅittvābhāvāt guṇāyādeśau |
‘ato guṇe’ iti pararūpatve ‘ekādeśa udāttena’ iti ekādeśa udāttaḥ |
bṛhaspatiṃ sadaminnaḥ sugaṃ kṛdhi śaṃ yoratte manurhitaṃ tadīmahe |
rathaṃ na durgādvasavaḥ sudānavo viśvasmānno aṃṃhaso niṣpipartana |
bṛhaspati | sadam | it | naḥ | sugam | kṛdhi | śam | yoḥ | yat | te | manuḥ'hitam | tat | īmahe | ratham | na | duḥ'gāt | vasavaḥ | su'dānavaḥ | viśvasmāt | naḥ | aṃṃhasaḥ | niḥ | pipartana || 5 ||
ᵛbṛhaspate ᵛsadamint sadaiva ᵛnaḥ asmākaṃ ᵛsugam sukhanāmaitat |
api ca ᵛte tava svabhūtaṃ ᵛśaṃ śamanīyānāṃ rogāṇāmupaśamanaṃ ᵛyoḥ pṛthakartavyānāṃ bhayānāṃ yāvanaṃ pṛthakaraṇaṃ ᵛmanurhitaṃ manunā brahmaṇā hitaṃ tvayavyavasthāpitam |
ᵛevaṃvidhaṃ śamanaṃ yāvanaṃ ca ᵛyat asti ᵛtadīmahe yācāmahe |
śaṃ yoḥ ityetat padadvayaṃ yāskenaivaṃ vyākhyātaṃ- ‘śamanaṃ ca rogāṇāṃ yāvanaṃ ca bhayānām’ (niru. 4. 21) iti |
indraṃ kutsoṃ vṛtrahaṇaṃ śacīpatiṃ kāṭe nibaॉḻaha ṛṣirahūtayai |
rathaṃ na durgādvasavaḥ sudānavo viśvasmānno aṃṃhaso niṣpipartana |
indram | kutsaḥ | vṛtra'hanam | śacī'patim | kāṭe | ni'baॉḻahaḥ | ṛṣiḥ | ahūta | ūtaye | ratham | na | duḥ'gāt | vasavaḥ | su'dānavaḥ | viśvasmāt | naḥ | aṃṃhasaḥ | niḥ | pipartana || 6 ||

kāṭeḥ iti kūpanāma | tasmin ᵛnibaॉḻahaḥ nipātitaḥ³ ᵛkutsaḥ ᵛṛṣiḥ ᵛūtaye rakṣaṇāya ᵛindram ᵛahūta āhvayati⁴ sma⁵ | kīdṛśam | ᵛvṛtrahaṇaṃ vṛtrāṇāṃ śatrūṇāṃ hantāraṃ ᵛśacīpatim | śacīti karmanāma | sarveṣāṃ karmaṇāṃ pālayitāram | yadvā | śacyā” devyāḥ” bhartāram || śacīpatim | vanaspatyādipu pāṭhādubhaya- padaprakṛtisvaratvam | śacīśabdaḥ śāṅgaravādikīnanta ādyudāttaḥ | nibaॉḻahaḥ | ‘bāha prayatne’ |
' kṣubdhasvānta ' ( pā. sū. 7. 2. 18 ) ityādī bhṛśārthe iḍabhāvo nipātyate |
atra ca bāḍhaśabdo bhṛśatvopate ' patane sāmarthyādvartate |
' lipisīcihaśca ' ( pā. sū. 3. 1. 53 ) iti luṅi caleraḍādeśaḥ |
tannau mitro varuṇo māmahantāmaditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ ||
daivaiḥ | naḥ | devī | aditiḥ | ni | pātu | devaḥ | trātā | trāyatām | aprai'yucchan | tat | naḥ | mitraḥ | varuṇaḥ | māmahantām | āditiḥ | sindhuḥ | pṛthivī | uta | dyauḥ || 7 ||
