' yajño devānām ' iti tṛcaṃ dvitīyaṃ sūktaṃ kutsasyārṣaṃ traiṣṭubhaṃ vaiśvadevam |
yajño devānāṃ pratyeti sumnamādityāso bhavatā mṛḻayantaḥ |
yajñaḥ | devānām | prati | eti | sumnam | ādityāsaḥ | bhavata | mṛḻayantaḥ | ā | vaḥ | arvācīm | sumatiḥ | vavṛttyāt | aṃhaḥ | cit | yā | varivovittarā | ata | ||1||
api ca ha ^ādityāsaḥ ādityāḥ ^mṛḻayantaḥ asmān sukhayantaḥ ^bhavata |
tathā ^vaḥ yuṣmākaṃ ^sumatiḥ śobhanā matiḥ bhadrānu- grahaparā ^buddhiḥ ^arvācīṃ asmadabhimukhī ^ā ^vavṛttyāt āvartatām |
' āmantritaṃ pūrvamavidyamānavat ' iti ādityāsa iti pādādau vartamānasya āmantritasya avidyamānavattvenāsya pādāditvāt ' apādādau '
yadvā ! devānāṃ sambandhī yā ( kṣa-yo'tha ) ^yajñaḥ so'smākaṃ sumnaṃ sukhaṃ pratyeti ( kṣa-prati ) prāpnotu ( kṣa - prāpnoti ) ityadhikam |

iti paryudāsān nighātābhāvaḥ | mṛḍayantaḥ | ‘ mṛḍa sukhane ’ | pyantāt laṭaḥ śatṛ | śap | ‘ chandasyu - bhayathā ’ iti śatṛḥ ārdhadhātukatvena adupadeśāt lasārvadhātukānudāttatvābhāve śatṛḥ svaraḥ śiṣyate | vavṛttyāt | ‘ vṛt vartane ’ | liṅi vyatyayena parasmaipadam | ‘ bahulaṃ chandasi ’ iti śapaḥ pluḥ | aṃhoḥ | ‘ ahi gatau ’ | iditvāt num | auṇādika upratyayaḥ | varivovittarā | ‘ vid lābhe ’ | asmādantarbhā- vitaṇyarthāt krip | tata ātiśāyanikaḥ tarap | asat | ‘ asa bhuvi ’ | leṭi aḍagamaḥ ||

upaṃ no devā avasā gama̭ntvaṅgira̭sāṃ sāma̭bhiḥ stūya̭mānāḥ | indra̭ indri॒yairmarṷto maru॒dbhirā̭di॒tyairno॒ arditi॒ḥ śarma̭ yaṃsat || 2 || upa̭ | na॒ḥ | de॒vāḥ | ava̭sā | ā | gama̭ntu | aṅgira̭sām | sāma̭bhiḥ | stūya̭mānāḥ | indra̭: | indri॒yaiḥ | marṷtaḥ | maru॒dbhaḥ | ādi॒tyaiḥ | na॒ḥ | arditi̭ḥ | śarma̭ | yaṃsat || 2 ||
devāḥ dānādiguṇayuktāḥ sarve devāḥ avasā rakṣaṇenāsmabhyaṃ dātavyenānnena vā yuktāḥ naḥ asmān stotṛn upa ā gamantu upāgacchantu prāpnuvantu |
kathaṃbhūtāḥ ? aṅgirasām etatsaṃjñakānā- mṛṣīṇāṃ saṃbandhibhiḥ sāmabhiḥ pragītairmantraiḥ stūyamānāḥ |
tathā mahataḥ saptagaṇarūpā ekonapañcāśatsaṃkhyākāḥ ‘ īdṛk cānyādṛk ca ’ ityevamādimānā devāḥ marudbhiḥ svāvayavabhūtaiḥ prāṇāpānādirūpeṇa vartamānaiḥ vāyubhiḥ sahāmānāgacchantu |
tathā aditiḥ akhaṇḍanīyā adīnā vā devamātā ādityaiḥ svakīyaiḥ putraiḥ saha naḥ asmabhyaṃ śarma sukhaṃ yaṃsat yacchatu |
loṭi ‘ bahulaṃ chandasi ’ iti śapo luk |
‘ chandasyubhayathā ’ iti śeṣaḥ ārdhadhātukatvena hitvabhāvāt ‘ gamahana ’ ityādinā upadhālopābhāvaḥ |

tanna indrastadvaruṇastadagnistada̭ryamā tatsa̭vitā cano̭ dhāt | tanno̭ mi॒tro varṷṇo māmahantāmadi̭tiḥ sindhṷḥ pṛthi॒vī uta dyaṷḥ || 3 || tat | na॒ḥ | indra̭: | tat | varṷṇaḥ | tat | agni̭: | tat | arya̭mā | tat | sa̭vitā | cana̭ḥ | dhāt | tat | na॒ḥ | mitra̭: | varṷṇaḥ | mamahantām | adi̭tiḥ | sindhṷḥ | pṛthi॒vī | uta | dyaṷḥ || 3 ||
tat tādṛśaṃ canaḥ annaṃ naḥ asmabhyam indraḥ dhāt dadhātu dadātu |
tat idamitrādibhirdattasmadīya- mannaṃ mitrādayaḥ mamahantāṃ pūjayantu pālayantvityarthaḥ ||
‘ cāyarese hasvaśca ’ ( u. sū. 4. 639 ) iti asun nuḍāgamaśca dhātorhrasvatvaṃ ca |
‘ ya indrāgnī ’ iti trayodaśarcaṃ tṛtīyaṃ sūktaṃ kutsasyārṣaṃ traiṣṭubhamaindrāgnam |
tathā cānukrāntaṃ- ‘ ya indrāgnī sasaunaindrāgnaṃ tu ’ iti |
ya indrāgnī citratamaṃ ratho vāmabhi viśvāni bhuvanāni caṣṭe |
tenā yāta surathaṃ tasthivāṃsāthā somasya pibataṃ sutasya ||
ya: | indrāgnī iti | citra'tamam | ratha: | vām | abhi | viśvāni | bhuvanāni | caṣṭe | tena | ā | yātam | su'ratham | tasthivāṃsā | atha | somasya | pibatam | sutasya || 1 ||
he indrāgnī citratama: atiśayena cāyanīya: vāṃ yuvayo: sambandhī ya: ratha: viśvāni bhuvanāni bhūtajātāni abhi caṣṭe ābhimukhyena paśyati |
sarathaṃ samānamekaṃ rathaṃ tasthivāṃsā yugapadeva āsthitavantau yuvāmāgacchataṃ na paryāyeṇetyartha: |
atha āgamananantaraṃ sutasya ṛtvigbharabhiputaṃ somasya somaṃ svāṃśalakṣaṇaṃ tadekadeśaṃ vā pibatam |
‘ yuṣmadasmado: ṣaṣṭhīcaturthī ’ (pā. sū. 8. 1. 20) ityādinā ṣaṣṭhīdvivacanasya vāmādeśa: |
‘ āto lopa iṭi ca ’ iti ākāralopa: |
kriyāgrahaṇaṃ kartavyam ’ iti karmaṇa: sampradānatvāt caturthyarthe ṣaṣṭhī ||
tāvā~ ayaṃ pātave somo astvaramindrāgnī manase yuvabhyām ||
yāvat | idam | bhuvanam | viśvam | asti | uru'vyacā: | varimatā | gabhīram | tāvān | ayam | pātave | soma: | astu | aram | indrāgnī iti | manase | yuvabhyām ||2||

viśvaṃ sarvam idaṃ bhuvanaṃ jagat yāvat asti yāvatpramāṇaṃ bhavati | kīdṛśam | uruvyacā: vistīrṇavyāpanam | sarvavyāpakamityartha: | tathā varimatā varimaṇā uruvenādhamīyena gauraveṇa gabhīraṃ gāmbhīryopetam | he indrāgnī pātave yuvābhyāṃ pātuṃ soma: | tāvān astu tāvatpramāṇo bhavatu | tathā manase yuvayoran:karaṇāya araṃ sa soma: paryāpto bhavatu || uruvyacā: | ‘ vyaca vyājīkaraṇe ’ | asun |
1. kṣa-ṭa-ṭha-sa-sarvāṇi bhūtajātāni 2. kṣa-sa-avasthitavantau | 3. kṣa-ṭa-ṭha-na tu | 4. kṣa-ṛtvigbha- rabhiputasya | 5. kṣa-ṭa-ṭha-rathaśceti | 6. kṣa-yāvatparimāṇam | 7. kṣa-ṭa-ṭha-sa-ayaṃ soma: |
‘svamornapuṃsakāt’ (pā. sū. 7. 1. 23) iti sorluki prāpte ‘supāṃ suluk’ iti vyatyayena ḍādeśaḥ |
‘pṛthvā- dibhya imanijvā’ iti uraśabdāt tasya bhāvaḥ ityarthe imanic |
‘vālamūlalaghvalamṅagulīnāṃ vā lo ramāpadyata iti vaktavyam’ (pā. ma. 8. 2. 18) iti latvavikalpaḥ |

cakrāthe hi sadhryagḍāmaṃ bhadraṃ saṃśrīcīnā vṛtrahaṇā uta sthaḥ | tāvindrāgnī sadhryaśvā niṣadyā vṛṣṇaḥ somasya vṛṣaṇā vṛṣethām || 3 || cakrāthe iti | hi | sadhryak | nāma | bhadram | saṃśrīcīnā | vṛtrahaṇau | uta | sthaḥ | tau | indrāgnī iti | sadhryaśvā | niṣadyā | vṛṣṇaḥ | somasya | vṛṣaṇā | ā | vṛṣethām || 3 ||
ha ‘indrāgnī ‘bhadraṃ kalyāṇaṃ ‘nāma svakīyaṃ nāmadheyaṃ ‘sadhryak mahagatamindrāgnī ityevaṃ saṃyuktaṃ ‘cakrāthe yuvāṃ kṛtavantau |
‘uta api ca he ‘vṛtrahaṇau vṛtrasyāsurasya hantārauvindrāgnī ‘sadhrīcīnā sahāvantau vṛtravadhārthaṃ saṃgatau ‘sthaḥ bhavataḥ |

‘hi yasmādevaṃ tasmāt he ‘vṛṣaṇā kāmānāṃ varṣitārāvindrāgnī ‘tau yuvāṃ sadhryañcau sahitāveva santau ‘nipadya vedyāmupaviśya ‘vṛṣṇaḥ sektuḥ ‘somasya ātmīyaṃ bhāgam ‘ā ‘vṛṣethāṃ svakīye udare āsiñcethām ||

samiddheṣvāmiśvānānjānā yatasrucā barhirtistarāṇā | tīvraḥ somaḥ pariṣaktebhirarvāgendrāgnī saumanasāya yātam || 4 || samiddheṣvāmi | agnim | ānajānā | yatasrucā | barhiḥ | ū~ iti | tistarāṇā | tīvraḥ | somaḥ | pariṣaktebhiḥ | arvāk | ā | indrāgnī iti | saumanasāya | yātam || 4 ||

‘agniṣu gārhapatyādiṣu anvādhānādinā ‘samiddheṣu samyagdīpteṣu satsu ‘ānajānā havīṃṣyā- jyenāantī ‘yatasrucā tadanantaraṃ yāgārthaṃ gṛhītasrucau ‘barhiḥ vedyāṃ bahirapi ‘tistarāṇā āstīrṇaṃ kṛtavantau adhvaryupratiprasthātārāvevaṃbhāvabhūtām |
tathā sati he indrāgnī ‘tīvraiḥ kṣipraṃ madakaraiḥ

ᵛpariviktebhiḥ paritaḥ sarveṣu grahacamasādiṣvāsiktaiḥ ᵛsomaiḥ hetubhūtaiḥ ᵛarvāk asmadabhimukham ᵛā ᵛyātam āgacchatam | kimartham | ᵛsaumanasāya saumanasyāya asmākamanugrahāyetyarthaḥ || ānajānā | ‘abjū vyaktiprakṣaṇagatiṣu’ | liṭaḥ kānac | ‘aniditām’ iti nalopaḥ | dvarbhāve ‘ata ādeḥ’ iti abhyāsasya dīrghaḥ | ‘tasmādbhudvihalaḥ’ iti advihalo'pi vyatyayena nuḍ | tistirāṇā | ‘stṛñ ācchādane’ | pūrvavat kānac | ‘ṛta iddhātoḥ’ iti itvam | dvarvacane ‘śarpūrvāḥ khayaḥ’ | ‘supāṃ suluk’ iti sarvatra vibhakteḥ ākāraḥ | cittatvādantodāttatvam ||
yā voṃ pratnāni sakhyā śivāni tebhiḥ somasya pibataṃ sutasya |
yāni | indrāgrī iti | cakrathuḥ | vīryāṇi | yāni | rūpāṇi | uta | vṛṣṇyāni | yā | vām | pratnāni | sakhyā | śivāni | tebhiḥ | somasya | pibatam | sutasya || 5 ||
ha ᵛindrāgrī ᵛyāni ᵛvīryāṇi vṛtravadhādirūpāṇi ᵛcakrathuḥ kṛtavantau yuvāṃ ᵛyāni ca ᵛrūpāṇi nirūpyamāṇāni gavāśādīni bhūtajātāni kṛtavantau |
indraḥ sūryā- tmanā vṛṣṭiṃ ᵛyajñamiśrāhutidvārā vṛṣṭyutpādakaḥ |
ᵛuta api ca yāni ᵛvṛṣṇyāni vṛṣṭi bhavāni vṛṣṭipradānādirūpāṇi karmāṇi kṛtavantau |
tathā ᵛvāṃ yuvayoḥ saṃbandhāni ᵛpratnāni ciraṃtanāni ᵛśivāni śobhanāni ᵛyā yāni ᵛsakhyā sakhittvāni santi |
ᵛtebhiḥ taiḥ sarvaiḥ sahitau yuvāṃ ᵛsutasya ᵛsomasya abhiṣutaṃ somaṃ ᵛpibatam |
‘sāvekācaḥ’ iti prāptasya vibhaktyudāttatvasya ‘na gośvansāvavarṇa’ iti pratiṣedhaḥ |
yadarvaṃ prathamaṃ vāṃ vṛṇāno'yaṃ somo asurairno vihavyaḥ |
tāṃ matyāṃ śraddhābhyā hi yātamā somasya pibataṃ sutasya |
yat | arvam | prathamam | vām | vṛṇānaḥ | ayam | somaḥ | asuraiḥ | naḥ | viḍahavyaḥ | tām | satyām | śraddhām | abhi | ā | hi | yātam | artha | somasya | pibatam | sutasya || 6 ||

ha indrāgrī ᵛprathamaṃ karmopakrame eva ᵛvāṃ yuvāṃ ᵛvṛṇānaḥ saṃbhajamānaḥ ᵛyadarvaṃ somena praṇayipyā- rmāti yadavocaṃ ᵛsakhyā yathārthāṃ ᵛtāṃ ᵛśraddhāṃ śraddhayādarātiśayena kṛtāmuktim ᵛabhi abhilakṣya ᵛā ᵛhi ᵛyātam āgacchatameva nodāsāthām |
tathā sati ᵛasuraiḥ haviṣāṃ prakṣepakairṛtvigbhiḥ ᵛayaṃ ᵛnaḥ asmākaṃ ᵛsomaḥ ᵛvihavyaḥ viśeṣeṇa hotavyo bhavati itarathā vyarthaḥ syāt |

‘ābhyastayorātaḥ’ iti ākāralopaḥ | asuraiḥ | ‘asu kṣepaṇe’ | ‘aseran’ (u. sū. 1. 42) iti uranpratyayaḥ | vihavyaḥ | ‘hu dānādanayoḥ’ | ‘aco yat’ | guṇaḥ | ‘dhātostanimittasyaiva’ iti avādeśaḥ | ‘yato'nāvaḥ’ ityādyudāttatvam | kṛduttarapadaprakṛtisvaratvam ||

yadindrāgnī madathaḥ sve duroṇe yahūtrāṇi rājani vā yajatrā | ataḥ pariṃ vṛṣaṇāvā hi yātamā somasya pibataṃ sutasya || 7 || yat | indrāgnī iti | madathaḥ | sve | duroṇe | yat | brahmāṇi | rājani | vā | yajatrā | ataḥ | pariṃ | vṛṣaṇau | ā | hi | yātam | artha | somasya | pibatam | sutasya || 7 ||
yajatrā yaṣṭavyau he indrāgnī sve duroṇe svakīye gṛhe nivāsasthāne yat yadi madathaḥ hṛṣyathaḥ |
yat yadi vā brahmāṇi brāhmaṇe anyasmin yajamāne haviḥsvīkaraṇāya āgatya hṛṣyathaḥ |
yadi vā rājani kṣatriye yuddhe sāhāyyaṃ kartumāgatya hṛṣyathaḥ |
ataḥ pari parito'smāt sarvasmāt sthānāt ha vṛṣaṇau kāmānāṃ varṣitārāvindrāgnī ā yātam hi āgacchatameva |

yadindrāgnī yaduṣu turvaśeṣu yadduhuṣu anuṣu puruṣu sthaḥ | ataḥ pariṃ vṛṣaṇāvā hi yātamā somasya pibataṃ sutasya || 8 || yat | indrāgnī iti | yaduṣu | turvaśeṣu | yat | duhuṣu | anuṣu | puruṣu | sthaḥ | ataḥ | pariṃ | vṛṣaṇau | ā | hi | yātam | artha | somasya | pibatam | sutasya || 8 ||
he indrāgnī yat yadi yaduṣu niyateṣu paraṃpāmahiṃsa- keṣu manuṣyeṣu sthaḥ bhavataḥ vartante |
yadi vā turvaśeṣu hiṃsakeṣu manuṣyeṣu vartante |
yat yadi vā duhuṣu drohaṃ pareṣāṃmupadravamicchatsu manuṣyeṣu vartante |
yadi vā anuṣu prāṇatsu sakalaiḥ prāṇyutkeṣu jñātṛvvanuṣānuṣu manu- vyeṣu |
tathā puruṣu kāmaiḥ pūrayitavyeṣvanyeṣu stotṛjaneṣu yadi bhavataḥ |
ataḥ sarvasmāt sthānāt he kāmābhivarṣakāvindrāgnī āga- cchatam |
3. a - sa - ‘pibatam’ ityasyāntaram etat (sa-idama) narukārthamataṃ vyākhyānam |
aitihāsikapakṣe tu yaduturvaśādayaḥ pañca rājāno śrayāteḥ putrāḥ |

‘ana prāṇane’ | ‘anaśra’ (u. sū. 1. 8) iti vibhīyamāna upratyayo bahulavacanādasmādapi bhavati | ‘nit’ ityanuvṛtterādyudāttatvam | purupu | ‘pūrī āpyāyane’ | pūryante iti pūravaḥ | auṇādika upratyayaḥ ||
yadindrāgrī avamasyāṃ pṛthivyāṃ madhyasyāṃ paramasyāmuta thaḥ |
ataḥ pariṃ vṛṣaṇāvā hi yātamā sormasya pibataṃ sutasya ||
yat | indrāgnī iti | avamasyām | pṛthivyām | madhyasyām | paramasyām | uta | sthaḥ | ataḥ | pariṃ | vṛṣaṇau | ā | hi | yātam | artha | somasya | pibatam | sutasya || 9 ||
yathā ‘yo dvitīyasyāṃ tṛtīyasyāṃ pṛthivyāmsyāyupā nāmnā’ (tai. saṃ. 1. 2. 12. 1) iti |
‘uta api ca ‘paramasyāṃ utkṛṣṭāyāṃ dūre vartamānāyāṃ pṛthivyāṃ dyuloke yadi vā vartante |
ataḥ pariṃ vṛṣaṇāvā hi yātamā sormasya pibataṃ sutasya ||
yat | indrāgnī iti | paramasyām | pṛthivyām | madhyasyām | avamasyām | uta | sthaḥ | ataḥ | pariṃ | vṛṣaṇau | ā | hi | yātam | artha | somasya | pibatam | sutasya || 10 ||
pūrvaṃ bhūmyādiṣu triṣu lokeṣu yāvindrāgnī tāvāgacchatā- mityuktam |
idānīṃ nu yuṣmatsu avarānukrameṇa vartamāneṣu triṣu lokeṣu yāvindrāgnī vartate tāvāgacchatā- miti prārthyate ||
ataḥ pariṃ vṛṣaṇāvā hi yātamā sormasya pibataṃ sutasya ||
yat | indrāgnī iti | divi | sthaḥ | yat | pṛthivyām | yat | parvateṣu | oṣadhīṣu | apsu | ataḥ | pariṃ | vṛṣaṇau | ā | hi | yātam | artha | somasya | pibatam | sutasya || 11 ||
he indrāgnī divi dyuloke yat yadi sthaḥ bhavataḥ |
yadi vā pṛthivyāṃ bhūloke yadi vā parvateṣu metrādiṣu meghepu vā |
tathā opadhīṣu tilamāṣavrīhyādiṣu apsu udakeṣu cānugrāhakatayā yadi vā sthaḥ |
he kāmābhivarṣakau yuvām ataḥ sarvasmāt sthānādāgacchatam |
opaḥ pāka āsu dhīyate iti opadhayaḥ |
yadindrāgnī uditā sūryasya madhye divaḥ svadhayā mādayaithe |
ataḥ pari vṛṣaṇāvā hi yātamā somasya pibataṃ sutasya ||
yat | indrāgnī iti | ut'ītā | sūryasya | madhye | divaḥ | svadhayā | mādayaithe iti | ataḥ | pari | vṛ
vi havyaṃ manasā vasya icchannindrāgnī jñāsa uta vā sajātān |
nānya yuvatpramatirasti mahyaṃ ma vāṃ dhiyaṃ vājayantīmatakṣam ||
vi | hi | ahavyam | manasā | vasyaḥ | icchan | indrāgnī iti | jñāsaḥ | uta | vā | sa'jātān | na | anyā | yuvat | pra'matiḥ | asti | mahyam | saḥ | vām | dhiyam | vājayantīm | atakṣam || 1 ||
he indrāgnī vasyaḥ praśastaṃ dhanam icchan kāmayamāno'haṃ jñāsaḥ jñātṝn uta vā api vā sajātān samānajanmāno jñātivyatiriktā bāndhavāḥ |
tāṃśca manasā buddhyā vi havyaṃ yuvā- meva jñātirūpeṇa bandhurūpeṇa ca vyāpnāsipam |
api ca yuvat yuvā- bhyām anyā anyena kenacin mahaṃ dattā pramatiḥ prakṛṣṭā buddhiḥ na asti |
madīyā yaiṣā prakṛṣṭā buddhiḥ sā yuvābhyāmeva dattā |

apadhya tanmīṃtā | uta vā ghā syālādapi ca syālāt syāt āsannaḥ saṃyogeneti maidānāḥ | syālā- jānāvanatīni vā | lājā lājateḥ syaṃ rūpaṃ syateḥ | śarpamaśanapavanaṃ śṛṇāteḥ śastrātervā | atha somasya pradānena yuvābhyāmindrāgnī stomaṃ janayāmi nabhyaṃ navataram ' (niru. 6. 9) iti || aśvam | 'śru śravaṇe' | laṅi uttamapuruṣaikavacane 'bahulaṃ chandasi' iti vikaraṇasya luk | bhūridāvattarā | 'ḍudāñ dāne' | 'āto maninu' iti vanip | atiśayena bhūridāvā bhūridāvattaraḥ | 'bhūridābhastuḍkavyaḥ' (pā. sū. 8. 2. 17. 2) iti tarapaḥ tuda | padasaṃjñāyāṃ nalopaḥ | 'supāṃ suluk' iti vibhakte- rākāraḥ | gha | 'ṛci tunudha' ityādinā saṃhitāyāṃ dīrghatvam | atha | 'nipātasya ca' iti | prayanī | 'yama uparame' | ktini 'anu
yuvābhyāṃ devī dhiṣaṇā madāyendrāgnī somamṛśatī sunoti |
tārśvinā bhadrahastā supāṇī ā dhāvataṃ madhunā pṛktamapsu ||
yuvābhyām | devī | dhiṣaṇā | madāya | indrāgnī iti | somam | uśatī | sunoti | tau | aśvinā | bhadrahastā | supāṇī iti su'pāṇī | ā | dhāvatam | madhunā | pṛktam | apsu || 4 ||
he indrāgnī yuvābhyāṃ madāya yuvayordhāya devī dyotamānā uśatī yuvāṃ kāmayamānā dhiṣaṇā mantrarūpā vāk somam abhipuṇoti |
dhiṣaṇā adhiṣavaṇacarma dyotamānaṃ tadyavayormedaṃ kāmayamānaṃ sat somamabhipuṇoti |
aindrāgnya paśorhavipaḥ ' pra carṣaṇibhyaḥ ' ityeṣā yājyā |
' pradānānām ' iti khaṇḍe sūtritaṃ- ' pra carṣaṇibhyaḥ pṛtanāhaveṣvā devo yānu savitā suratnaḥ ' ( āśva. śrau. 3. 7 ) iti ||
pra carṣaṇibhyaḥ pṛtanāhaveṣu pra pṛthivyā riricāthe divaśca |
pra sindhubhyaḥ pra giribhyo mahitvā pendrāgnī viśvā bhuvanānyanyā ||
pra | carṣaṇibhyaḥ | pṛtanā'haveṣu | pra | pṛthivyāḥ | riricāthe iti | divaḥ | ca | pra | sindhubhyaḥ | pra | giribhyaḥ | mahitvā | pra | indrāgnī iti | viśvā | bhuvanā | ani | anyā || 6 ||

vpṛtanāhaveṣu pṛtanāsu saṃgrāmeṣu rakṣaṇārthamāhvaneṣu satsu ha vindrāgnī āgatavantau yuvāṃ vcarṣaṇibhyaḥ sarvebhyo'pi manuṣyebhyaḥ vmahitvā mahattvena vpra vriricāthe atiricyethe sarvādhikau bhavata ityarthaḥ |
tathā vpṛthivyāḥ sarvasyā bhūmeśca vpra riricāthe |
api ca he indrāgnī vviśvā vbhuvanā sarvāṇi bhūtajātāni vanyā utkadhyatiriktāni yāni santi tānyatītya vpra riricāthe adhikau bhavataḥ ||
hvaḥ ' bhāve'nupasargasya ' iti ap saṃprasāraṇaṃ ca |
laṭgeva ' bahulaṃ chandasi ' iti vikaraṇasya śruḥ |
pūrvokta eva paśau ' ā bharatam ' ityeṣā puroḍāśe'syānuvākyā |
sūtritaṃ ca-- ' ā bharataṃ śikṣataṃ vajrabāhū ubhā vāmindrāgnī āhuvadhyai ' ( āśva. śrau. 3. 7 ) iti ||
ā bharataṃ śikṣataṃ vajrabāhū asmā~ indrāgnī avataṃ śacībhiḥ |
ime nu te raśmayaḥ sūryasya yebhiḥ sapitvaṃ pitarau na āsan ||
ā | bharatam | śikṣatam | vajrabāhū iti vajra'bāhū | asmān | indrāgnī iti | avatam | śacībhiḥ | ime | nu | te | raśmayaḥ | sūryasya | yebhiḥ | sa'pitvam | pitarau | na | āsan || 7 ||

he vvajrabāhū vajrahastau vindrāgnī 'ā vbharatam asmadarthaṃ dhanamāharatam | āhṛtya ca vśikṣataṃ asmabhyaṃ dattam | śikṣitadānakarmā | api ca vasmān anuṣṭhātṛn vśacībhiḥ | karmaṇāmaitat | ātmīyaiḥ ||
kiṃca sūryātmana indrasya yebhiḥ raśmibhiḥ yaiḥ arcibhiḥ naḥ asmākaṃ pitaraḥ pūrvapuruṣāḥ saptvaṃ sahasrasya sthānam āsan brahmalokamagacchan|
te raśmayaḥ ime nu idānīmasmābhi- rhayamānā eta eva khalu|
tathā ca śrūyate- 'agniṃ vāvādityaḥ sāyaṃ praviśati tasmādagniṃraśmyarkaṃ dadṛśe' (tai. brā. 2. 1. 2. 9) iti|
tasmāna sūryasya raśmīnāṃ stavanenendrāgnyorubhayorapi stutiḥ middhā|
asmān saśabdopa- padāt 'kṛtyārthe tavaikena' iti tvanpratyayaḥ|

puraṃdaraṃ śikṣitaṃ vajrahastāmā~ indrāgrī avataṃ bharaiṣu| tanno mitro varuṇo māmahantāmaditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ || 8 || puraṃ'darā| śikṣitam| vajra'hastā| asmān| indrāgrī iti| avatama| bharaiṣu| tat| naḥ| mitraḥ| varuṇaḥ| māmahantām| aditiḥ| sindhuḥ| pṛthivī| uta| dyauḥ ||8||
he vajrahastā hastena gṛhītavajrau puraṃdarā asurapurāṇāṃ dārayitārau indrāgrī śikṣitam asma- dapekṣitaṃ dhanaṃ prayacchatam|
api ca bharaiṣu saṃgrāmeṣu ammān avataṃ rakṣatam|
yadanena sūktena prārthitaṃ tat asmadīyaṃ mitrādyaḥ mamahantāṃ pūjayantām||
'tataṃ me' iti navarcaṃ pañcamaṃ sūktaṃ kutsasyārṣaṃ ṛbhudevatākam|
tathā cānukrāntaṃ- 'tataṃ navābaṃ tu pañcamamantye triṣṭubhau' iti||
sūtritaṃ ca 'tṛtīyasya' iti khaṇḍe- 'tataṃ me apa iti vaiśvadevam' (āśva. śrau. 7. 7) iti||

tataṃ me apastadu tāyate punaḥ svādiṣṭhā dhītirucathāya śasyate| ayaṃ samudra iha viśvadaivyaḥ svāhākṛtasya sam tṛṣṇuta ṛbhavaḥ || 1 || tatam| me| apaḥ| tat| ū~ iti| tāyate| punariti| svādiṣṭhā| dhītiḥ| ucathāya| śasyate| ayam| samudraḥ| iha| viśvadaivyaḥ| svāhā'kṛtasya| sam| ū~ iti| tṛṣṇuta| ṛbhavaḥ ||1||
1. kṣa-samavetattvamagacchan; sa-samave (vai) nṛtvamagacchan 2. kṣa-nighātapratiṣedhaḥ 3. kṣa-ṭa-hastai 4. kṣa-tanmitrādayo rakṣantu|
ha ṛbhavaḥ me mayā apaḥ agniṣṭomādirūpaṃ karma tataṃ vistāritaṃ bahuśaḥ pūrvamanuṣṭhitam |
tadu tadeva punaḥ tāyate vistāryate anuṣṭhīyate ityarthaḥ |
tatra svādiṣṭhā svāhutamā atiśayena prītikarī prītiḥ stutiśca ucathāya stutyāya śasyate paṭhyate |
api ca iha asminyāge samudraḥ samundana- śīlaḥ artha somarasaḥ viśvebhyaḥ sarvebhyo devebhyaḥ paryāpto yathā bhavati tathā saṃpāditaḥ |
tasya svāhā- kṛtasya svāhākāreṇa prakṣitasya somasya pānena samu tṛpṇutaḥ samyageva tṛptā bhavata ||
āpaḥ karmākhyāyāṃ hrasvo nud vā iti asun dhātorhrasva |
bahuvrīhau viśvaṃ saṃjñāyām iti vyatyayenasaṃjñāyāmapi pūrvapadāntodāttatvam |
svāhāśabdasya ūrdhvāditvena gatitvān ( pā. sū. 1. 4. 61 ) gatiranantaraḥ iti pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaratvam |
ṛbhava ityanena saṃhitāyām ṛtvakaḥ iti prakṛtibhāvaḥ ||
ābhogayaṃ pra yadicchantu aitanāpākāḥ prāśvo mam ke cidāparyaḥ |
ābhogayam | pra | yat | icchantaḥ | aitana | apākāḥ | prāśvaḥ | mama | ke | cit | āparyaḥ | saudhanvanāsaḥ | caritasya | bhūmanā | agacchata | savituḥ | dāśuṣaḥ | gṛham || 2 ||

he ṛbhavaḥ apākāḥ paripakvajñānāḥ prājñaḥ pūrvakālīnāḥ mama āpayaḥ prāpayitāro madīyā jñātayaḥ ke cit evaṃbhūtā ye kecana yūyam ābhogayam upabhogyaṃ somam icchantaḥ yat yadā pra etana tapaścaritumaraṇyaṃ gatavantaḥ |
taduktaṃ yāskena- 'ṛbhu- viṣvā vāja iti sudhanvana āṅgirasasya trayaḥ putrā babhūvuḥ ' ( niru. 11. 16 ) iti |
kutso'pyā- ṅgirasaḥ atastena madīyā jñātaya ityuktam |

he saudhanvanāsaḥ sudhanvanaḥ putrāḥ tadānīṃ caritasya samupājitasya tapasaḥ bhūmanā bhūmnā bahutvena dāśuṣaḥ havīṃṣi dattavataḥ savituḥ somābhipavaṃ kurvato yajamānasya saṃbandha yajagṛham agacchata tapasā labdhasomāḥ santaḥ kṛtapānāḥ yūyaṃ gatavantaḥ |
dāśuṣaḥ prātaḥsavanādipvaganyādibhirupasāritebhyaḥ ṛbhubhyaḥ somapānaṃ dattavataḥ savituḥ gṛhaṃ nivāsa- sthānaṃ tṛtīyasavanātyamacchata prāptāḥ |
etatasarvam ' ārbhavaṃ śaṃsati ' ( ai. brā. 3. 30 ) ityādau tripaṣṭamāmnātm ||
āṅpūrvā- dujeraugādikaḥ karmaṇi ipratyayaḥ kuruvaṃ ca |

yābhiḥ | śucantim | dhana'sām | su'saṃsadam | tasam | gharmam | omyā'vantam | atraye | yābhiḥ | pṛśni'
he vvṛṣaṇā kāmānāṃ varṣitārāvaśvinau vyābhiḥ vśacībhiḥ karmabhiḥ prajñābhivāṃ vparāvṛjam etannāmakamurṣi paṅguṃ mantamapaṅguma kurutam |
tathā vandhaṃ dṛṣṭirahitaṃ santamāśvamṛṣi vcakṣase prakāśāya samyak cakṣuṣā darśanāya yābhirutibhiḥ vpra vkṛthaḥ prakarṣeṇa kuruthaḥ |
yābhiśca vśroṇaṃ viguṇajānukamevav saptamṛṣim vetave gantuṃ pra kṛthaḥ prakarṣeṇa kṛtavantau |
api ca vyābhiḥ ūtibhiḥ vvartikāṃ caṭaka- sadṛśasya pakṣiṇaḥ striyaṃ vgrasitāṃ vṛkeṇa prastām vamuñcataṃ vṛkāsyānnirmuktāma kurutam |
yāskapakṣe tu vṛkeṇa vivṛtajyotiṣkeṇa sūryeṇa yābhirstāṃ vartikāṃ pratyahamāvartamānāmupasaṃ tasmādamocayatam iti yojyam |
etacca 'caritraṃ hi verivacchedi parṇam' (ṛ. saṃ. 1. 116. 15) ityatra vispaṣṭayiṣyate |
'yābhiḥ ca 'aśvyam aśvasya putraṃ 'preṇiṃ stuteḥ prerayitāraṃ 'vaśam etatsaṃjñam 'ṛṣim 'āvatam arakṣatam |

kukṣīvantaṃ stotāraṃ yābhirāvataṃ tābhīrū ṣu ūtibhiraśvinā gatam ||
yābhiḥ | sudānū iti sudānū | auśijāya | vaṇije | dīrghaśravase | madhu | kośaḥ | akṣarata | kukṣīvantam | stotāram | yābhiḥ | āvatam | tābhiḥ | ū~ iti | su | ūtibhiḥ | aśvinā | ā | gatam || 11 ||
uśijasaṃjñā 'dīrghatamasaḥ patnī tasyāḥ putro dīrghaśravā nāma kaściddhiraṇāvṛttyā jīvanārthamakarot vāṇijyam |

he 'sudānū śobhanadānāśvinau 'auśijāya uśijaputrāya 'vaṇije vāṇijyaṃ kurvate 'dīrghaśravase ' etatsaṃjñāya ṛṣaye 'yābhiḥ yuṣmadīyābhiḥ ūtibhiḥ hetubhūtābhiḥ 'kośaḥ meghaḥ 'madhu mādhuryopetaṃ vṛṣṭi- jalam 'akṣarat asravat yuṣmatprasādādapekṣitā vṛṣṭirjātetyarthaḥ |
api ca uśijaḥ putraṃ 'stotāraṃ 'kakṣī- vantam etatsaṃjñamṛṣiṃ 'yābhiḥ ūtibhiḥ 'āvatam arakṣatam |
yābhī rasāṃ kṣodasrodaḥ pipinnathurnuśaṃ yābhī rathamāvartaṃ jiṣe |
yābhistriśokaṃ ustriyā udārjata tābhīrū ṣu ūtibhiraśvinā gatam ||
yābhiḥ | rasām | kṣodasā | udaḥ | pipinnathuḥ | anuśam | yābhiḥ | ratham | āvatam | jiṣe | yābhiḥ | triśokaḥ | ustriyāḥ | ut | ājata | tābhiḥ | ū~ iti | su | ūtibhiḥ | aśvinā | ā | gatam || 12 ||
'rasā nadī bhavati rasateḥ śabdakarmaṇaḥ ' (niru. 11. 25) iti yāskaḥ |
he aśvinau 'yābhiḥ ūtibhiḥ hetubhūtābhiḥ 'rasāṃ nadīmāvṛttyā jalarahitāṃ 'kṣodasā kūlāni saṃrpaṣatā 'udaḥ udakena 'pipinnathuḥ yuvāṃ pūritavantau |
1. kṣa-etatsaṃjñakam | 2. kṣa-tābhiḥ prāgvat | 3. kṣa-ṭa- uśijasaṃjñā yā | 4. kṣa-ṭa- 'aśvinau' nāsti | 5. kṣa-ṭa-sa-dīrghaśravase prathitayaśāse | 6. kṣa-ṭa-sa-saṃprasāraṇaṃ ca |

ūtibhiḥ ᵛāvatam agamayatamam | api ca ᵛyābhiḥ ūtibhiḥ kaṇvaputraḥ ᵛtriśokaḥ ṛṣiḥ ᵛustriyāḥ apahatāḥ ² gāḥ ᵛudjāta udagamayat asurasakāśāt lebhe | ᵛtābhiḥ sarvābhiḥ ᵛūtibhiḥ saha asmānapyāgacchatam || kṣodasā | ' kṣudir saṃpeṣaṇe ' | auṇādikaḥ asun | udraḥ | tṛtīyaikavacanasya ' supāṃ supo bhavanti ' iti śasādeśaḥ | ' pahan ' ityādinā udakaśabdasya udanbhāvaḥ | bhasaṃjñāyām ' alopo'naḥ ' iti akāralopaḥ | pipinvathuḥ | ' pivi secane ' | idittvāt num | jiṣe | ' ji jaye ' | ' tumarthe sesena ' iti ksepratyayaḥ | udājata | ' aja gatikṣepaṇayoḥ ' ||

yābhiḥ sūrya̭ pari॒yātha̭ḥ pa̭rā॒vati̭ ma॒ndhātā̭ra॒ṃ kṣaitra̭patye॒ṣvāva̭tam | yā॒bhirvvipra̭ṃ pra॒ bhara̭dvā॒jamāva̭ta॒ṃ tābhi̭rū॒ ṣu ū॒tibhi̭ra॒śvinā̭ ga॒tam || 13 || yābhiḥ | sūrya̭m | pari॒yātha̭ḥ | pa॒rā॒vati̭ | ma॒ndhātā̭ram | kṣaitra̭patye॒ṣu | āva̭tam | yābhiḥ | vipra̭m | pra | bhara̭dvā॒jam | āva̭tam | tābhiḥ | ū~ iti̭ | su | ū॒tibhi̭ḥ | a॒śvinā̭ | ā | ga॒tam || 13 ||
he aśvinau ᵛparāvati dūradeśe sthitaṃ ᵛsūryaṃ tamarūpeṇa svarbhānunāvṛtamādityaṃ tasmāttamaso mocayituṃ ᵛyābhiḥ ūtibhiḥ ᵛpariyāthaḥ yuvāṃ parito gacchathaḥ |
api ca ᵛyābhiḥ ūtibhiḥ ᵛvipraṃ medhāvinaṃ ᵛbharadvājam ṛṣibhannapradānena ᵛpra ᵛāvataṃ prakarṣeṇārakṣatam |

yā॒bhirma̭hā॒mata̭thi॒gvaṃ ka̭śo॒juva̭ṃ di॒vodā̭sa॒ṃ śamba̭ra॒hatyḙ ā॒va̭tam | yā॒bhiḥ pu॒rbhidyai॒ trasa̭da॒syumāva̭ta॒ṃ tābhi̭rū॒ ṣu ū॒tibhi̭ra॒śvinā̭ ga॒tam || 14 || yābhiḥ | ma॒hā॒m | a॒ti॒thi॒gvam | ka॒śa॒ḥjuva̭m | di॒va॒ḥdā॒sam | śamba̭ra॒hatyḙ | ā॒va̭tam | yābhiḥ | pu॒ḥbhidyai̭ | trasa̭da॒syum | ā॒va̭tam | tābhiḥ | ū~ iti̭ | su | ū॒tibhi̭ḥ | a॒śvinā̭ | ā | ga॒tam || 14 ||
he aśvinau ᵛmahāṃ mahāntam ᵛatithigvam atithibhirgantavyaṃ ᵛkaśojuvam asurabhītyā udakaṃ praveṣṭuṃ gantāram evaṃbhūtaṃ ᵛdivodāsam etatsaṃjakaṃ rājarṣi ᵛśambarahatye |
tasya hanane⁴ viṣayabhūte sati ᵛyābhiḥ ūtibhiḥ ᵛāvatam arakṣatam |
api ca ᵛyābhiḥ ūtibhiḥ ᵛpurbhidyai purāṇi⁶ nagarāṇi bhidyante'sminniti pūrbhidyaḥ saṃgrāmaḥ |
tasmin ᵛtrasadasyum etatsaṃjakamṛṣiṃ purukutsa- putram ᵛāvatam arakṣatam |

1. kṣa-ṭa-sa-agamayatamam | abatiratatra gatyarthaḥ | 2. kṣa-sa-asuraiḥ apahatāḥ | 3. ṭa-tadvānasuraḥ śambaraḥ | 4. kṣa-ṭa-badhe | 5. kṣa-ṭa-sa-yuvāṃ arakṣatam | 6. kṣa-ṭa-puraḥ | 7. kṣa-ṭa-rājarṣim | 8. kṣa-samānam | ka. 86
'hanasta ca' iti hanterbhāve kyap; tatsaṃyogena takārāntādeśaśca|

yābhirvṛtraṃ vipipānamupastutaṃ kaliṃ yābhirvittajāni duvasyarthaḥ| yābhiryaścamuta pṛthimāvataṃ tābhirū ṣu ūtibhiraśvinā gatam || 15 || yābhiḥ| vatram| vi'pipānam| upa'stutam| kalim| yābhiḥ| vitta'jānim| duvasyarthaḥ| yābhiḥ| vi'aśvam| uta| pṛthima| āvatam| tābhiḥ| ū~ iti| su| ūti'bhiḥ| aśvinā| ā| gatam || 15 ||
he aśvinau vatraṃ vikhanasaḥ putrametatsaṃjñamṛṣi vipipānaṃ viśeṣeṇa pārthivaṃ rasaṃ pibantaṃ yābhiḥ ūtibhiḥ arakṣatam|
tathā vitta- jāni labdhabhāryaṃ kalim etatsaṃjñamṛṣiṃ yābhiḥ ūtibhiḥ duvasyathaḥ rakṣathaḥ|
uta api ca vyaśvaṃ vigatāśvaṃ pṛthima etatsaṃjñaṃ vainaṃ rājarṣi yābhiḥ ūtibhiḥ āvatam arakṣatam|
vittā labdhā jāyā yena sa tathoktaḥ|

yābhirnarā śayave yābhiratraye yābhiḥ purā marnave gātumīṣathuḥ| yābhiḥ śārīrājataṃ syūmaraśmaye tābhirū ṣu ūtibhiraśvinā gatam || 16 || yābhiḥ| narā| śayave| yābhiḥ| atraye| yābhiḥ| purā| marnave| gātum| īṣathuḥ| yābhiḥ| śārī| ājatam| syūmaraśmaye| tābhiḥ| ū~ iti| su| ūti'bhiḥ| aśvinā| ā| gatam || 16 ||
he narā netārāvaśvinau purā pūrvasminkāle śayave etatsaṃjñakāya ṛṣaye gātuṃ duḥkhanirgamana- lakṣaṇaṃ mārgaṃ yābhiḥ ūtibhiḥ īṣathuḥ yuvāṃ vāñchitavantau kṛtavantādityarthaḥ|
1. kṣa-ṭa-sa-vainyam| 2. ta-da-śa-yalopaḥ| 3. kṣa-pūrvapadasyānatodāttatve| 4. kṣa-'kiṃ' nāsti| ca-ṭa-sa-sāmarthyam|
tathā 'agnaye ṛṣaye śatadvāre yantragṛhe'suraiḥ pīḍyamānāya saṃtāpakāriṇaḥ agneḥ' śītanodakena śītakaraṇalakṣaṇaṃ gātuṃ duḥkhanirgamanahetubhūtaṃ mārgaṃ 'yābhiḥ' ūtibhirvāmiṣṭavantī |
etacca 'himenāgniṃ ghraṃsamavāraye- thām' (ṛ. saṃ. 1. 116. 8) ityādau prasiddham |
tathā 'manave etannāmne rājardhaye 'yābhiḥ ūtibhiḥ yavādidhānyavapanādirūpaṃ gātuṃ dāridryanirgamanahetuṃ mārgaṃ yuvāṃ kṛtavantaḥ |
tathā ca mantrāntaraṃ- 'yavaṃ vṛkeṇāśvinā vapantā' (ṛ. saṃ. 1. 117. 21) iti |
api ca 'syūmaraśmaye syūtaḥ saṃbadvaḥ' raśmidīptiryasya tasmai etatsaṃjakāya ṛṣaye 'yābhiḥ ūtibhiḥ' 'śārīḥ |
liṭi athusi 'asavarṇa' (pā. sū. 6. 4. 78) iti paryudāsāt abhyāsasya iyaḍādeśābhāve savarṇadīrghaḥ |

yābhiḥ paṭharvā jaṭharasya mujannāgninādīṃdekṣita iddho ajamnā | yābhiḥ śaryātamavatho mahādhane tābhīrū pu ūtibhiraśvinā gatama || 17 || yābhiḥ | paṭharvā | jaṭharasya | mujannā | agniḥ | na | adīdet | citaḥ | iddhaḥ | ajamn | ā | yābhiḥ | śaryātam | avathaḥ | mahādhane | tābhiḥ | ū~ iti | su | ūtibhiḥ | aśvinā | ā | gatam || 17 ||
he aśvinau 'jaṭharasya' 'jaṭharamudaraṃ bhavati jagdhamasminnīyate' (niru. 4. 7) iti yāskaḥ |
jaṭharopakṣitasya śarīrasya 'mujannā balena yuktaḥ san 'paṭharvā etatsaṃjo rājarṣiḥ 'ajamn |
ajamni saṃgrāme yuṣmadīyābhiḥ 'yābhiḥ ūtibhiḥ 'ā samantāt 'adīdet adīvyata |
1. kṣa-ṭa-ameḥ sakāśāt | 2. kṣa-ya-śītīkaraṇalakṣaṇam | 3. kṣa-ṭa-dāridryanirgamanahetubhūtam | 4. kṣa-saṃtataḥ 5. kṣa-ṭa-maninpratyayaḥ | 6. ṭa-kāṣṭhairutpacitaḥ |
yābhi̭ra॒ṅgiro॒ mana̭sā ni॒ra॒ṇyatho'graṃ ga̭cchatho vi॒vare॒ goa̭rṇasaḥ |
yābhi̭rma॒nuṃ śūra̭mi॒ṣā sa॒māva̭rtaṃ tābhi̭rū ṣu ū॒tibhi̭ra॒śvinā॒ gata̭m ||

yābhi̭: | a॒ṅgira̭ḥ | mana̭sā | ni॒'ra॒ṇyatha̭ḥ | a॒gram | ga̭cchathaḥ | vi॒'varḙ | go'a̭rṇasaḥ | yābhi̭: | ma॒num | śūra̭m | i॒ṣā | sa॒m'ā॒va̭rtam | tābhi̭: | ū~ iti̭ | su | ū॒ti'bhi̭: | a॒śvinā̭ | ā | gata̭m || 18 ||
he aṅgiraḥ¹ aṅgirasāṃ gotraja tvamaśvinau stuhi |
he aśvinau manasā mananīyena stotreṇa prītau santo yuvāṃ yābhiḥ¹ ūtibhiḥ¹ niraṇyathaḥ¹ stotṝn nitarāṃ ramayathaḥ |

tathā goarṇasaḥ¹ gorūpasyārṇasya dhanasya paṇibhirguhāyāṃ nihitasya vivare¹ vivaraṇe guhādvārasyodghāṭanana prakāśane viṣayabhūte sati yābhiḥ¹ ūtibhiḥ¹ saha yuvām agraṃ sarvebhyo devebhyaḥ purastāt gacchathaḥ |
api ca śūraṃ¹ vīryavantaṃ manum¹ iṣā pṛthivyāmusena yathāvidhānarūpeṇāstrena yābhiḥ¹ ūtibhiḥ¹ samā- vataṃ¹ samyagarakṣatam |
yābhi̭: su॒dāsa̭ ū॒hathṷḥ su॒devya̭ṃ tābhi̭rū ṣu ū॒tibhi̭ra॒śvinā॒ gata̭m ||

yābhi̭: | patnī̭: | vi॒'madā̭ya | ni॒'ū॒hathṷḥ | a॒gha | vā | yābhi̭: | a॒ruṇī̭: | a॒śi̭kṣatam | yābhi̭: | su॒dāsa̭: | ū॒hathṷḥ | su॒devya̭m | tābhi̭: | ū~ iti̭ | su | ū॒ti'bhi̭: | a॒śvinā̭ | ā | gata̭m || 19 ||
he aśvinau vimadāya¹ etannāmne ṛṣaye yābhiḥ¹ yuṣmadīyābhiḥ ūtibhiḥ¹ patnīḥ¹ bhāryāḥ¹ puru- mitrasya duhitaraṃ nyūhathuḥ¹ nitarāṃ yuvāṃ prāpitavantau |
tathā yābhiḥ¹ ūtibhiḥ¹ aruṇīḥ¹ aruṇavarṇāḥ ārohamānā gāḥ ā ābhimukhyena aśikṣitam¹ adattam |
tathā pijavanaputrāya¹ sudāse¹ kalyāṇadānāya rājñe sudevyaṃ¹ praśastaṃ dhanaṃ yābhiḥ¹ ūtibhiḥ¹ ūhathuḥ¹ prāpitavantau |

1. kṣa-aṅgirogotrajāta | 2. ṭa-kāraṇabhūtena | 3. kṣa-bhāryām | 4. kṣa-sa-padapūraṇaḥ | 5. kṣa-ṭa- api ca | 6. kṣa-ṭa-sudevyaṃ śobhano devaḥ sudevaḥ | tatra bhavam; sa-śobhanadevaḥ sudevaḥ | tatra bhavaṃ sudevyam |

yābhiḥ śaṃtātī bhavatho dadāśuṣe bhujyuṃ yābhiravatho yābhiradrigum | omyāvatīṃ subharāmṛtastubhaṃ tābhirū ṣu ūtibhiraśvinā gatam || 20 || yābhiḥ | śaṃtātī iti śam'tātī | bhavathaḥ | dadāśuṣe | bhujyum | yābhiḥ | avathaḥ | yābhiḥ | adri'gum || omyā'vatīm | su'bharām | ṛta'stubham | tābhiḥ | ū~ iti | su | ūti'bhiḥ | aśvinā | ā | gatam || 20 ||
he aśvinau vdadāśuṣe havīṃṣi dattavate yajamānāya vyābhiḥ ūtibhiḥ vśaṃtātī sukhasya kartārau vbhavathaḥ |
vyābhiḥ ca ūtibhiḥ vbhujyuṃ tugrasya putram vavathaḥ |
‘adriguścāpāpaśra ubhau devānāṃ śamitārau’ ( tai. brā. 3. 6. 6. 4 ) iti śruteḥ |

yābhina̭raṃ goṣu॒yudhaṃ nṛ॒pāhe॒ kṣetra̭sya sā॒tā ta॒naya̭sya jinvathaḥ | yābhī rathā̭ ava॒tho yābhirva̭sta॒tābhī̭ṣu ū॒tibhi̭raśvinā ga॒tam || 22 || yābhiḥ | nara̭m | goṣu॒'yudha̭m | nṛ॒'pāhḙ | kṣetra̭sya | sā॒tā | ta॒naya̭sya | jinvathaḥ | yābhiḥ | rathā̭n | ava॒thaḥ | yābhiḥ | arva̭taḥ | tābhiḥ | ū~ iti̭ | su | ū॒ti'bhi̭ḥ | a॒śvinā̭ | ā | ga॒tam || 22 ||
he aśvinau goṣuyudhaṃ goviṣayaṃ yuddhaṃ kurvantaṃ naraṃ yajñasya netāraṃ yajamānaṃ yābhiḥ ūtibhiḥ nṛpāhe nṛbhiḥ soḍhavye saṃgrāme jinvathaḥ prīṇayathaḥ rakṣathaḥ ityarthaḥ |
tanayasya dhanasya ca sātā sātaye saṃbhajanārthaṃ yābhiḥ ūtibhiḥ yajamānaṃ rakṣathaḥ |

turvanti: | auṇādika itipratyaya: | dabhītim | ' dambhu dambhe ' | auṇādika: kītipratyaya: | dhvasantim | ' dhvaṃsu gatau ca ' | auṇādiko jhipratyaya: | ' aniditām ' iti nalopa: | ' jho'ntaḥ ' | puruṣantim | puru sanoti dadātīti puruṣanti: | ' kiccakau ca saṃjñāyām ' iti kit | ' na kici dīrghaśca ' iti anunāsikalopapādīrghayorniṣedha: ||
a॒ma॒sva॒tīma॒śvinā॒ vāca̭ma॒sme kṛ॒taṃ no̭ da॒strā vṛṣa̭ṇā manī॒ṣām |
a॒dyu॒tye'va̭se॒ ni hva̭ye॒ vāṃ vṛ॒dhe ca̭ no॒ bhava̭ta॒ṃ vāja̭sā॒tau ||
a॒ma॒sva॒tīm | a॒śvinā̭ | vāca̭m | a॒sme iti̭ | kṛ॒tam | naḥ | da॒strā | vṛṣa̭ṇā | manī॒ṣām | a॒dyu॒tyai | a॒va॒se | ni | hva̭ye | vām | vṛ॒dhe | ca̭ | naḥ | bhava̭tam | vāja̭sā॒tau || 24 ||
he aśvinau vaasme asmākaṃ vavācam vaamasvatīm |
tathā vana: asmākaṃ vamanīṣāṃ buddhiṃ he vavṛṣaṇā kāmānāṃ varṣakau vadastrā śatrūṇā- mupakṣapayitārāvaśvinau vedārthajñānasamarthāṃ kurutam |
api ca yasmāt yuvāmevaṃguṇaviśiṣṭau tasmāt vavāṃ yuvām vaavase rakṣaṇāya vani vahvaye nitarāmāhvaye |
vaadyutye dyotanarahite prakāśanarahite rātre: paścime yāme |
tasmin kāle hi prātaranuvākāśvinaśastrayoridaṃ sūktaṃ paṭhyate |
āhūtau vaca yuvāṃ vavājasātau vājasyānnasya saṃbhajane |
saṃgrāme vana: asmākaṃ vavṛdhe vardhanāya vabhavatam ||
' āpa: karmākhyāyāṃ hrasva nuṭ ca vā ' iti asun nuṭgamaśca |
' tasau matvarthe ' iti aśvena padatvābhāvāt hrasvādya- bhāva: |
karoterloṭi ' bahulaṃ chandasi ' iti vikaraṇasya luk |
tanno̭ mi॒tro varṷṇo māmahantā॒madi̭ti: sindhṷ: pṛthi॒vī u॒ta dyau: ||
dyubhi̭: | a॒ktubhi̭: | pari̭ | pā॒ta॒m | a॒smān | a॒ri॒ṣṭebhi̭: | a॒śvinā̭ | saubha̭gebhi: | tat | naḥ | mi॒tra: | varṷṇa: | ma॒ma॒ha॒ntām | a॒di̭ti: | sindhṷ: | pṛ॒thi॒vī | u॒ta | dyau: ||25||
he aśvinau vadyubhi: divasai: vaaktubhi: rātribhiśca vaasmān stotṛn vapari vapātaṃ parito rakṣataṃ sarvadāsmān rakṣatamityartha: |
tathā vaariṣṭebhi: ahiṃsitai: vasaubhagebhi: subhagatvāpādakairdhanai: asmān rakṣatam |

pūjayamnu | utaśabdaḥ samuccaye || śubhiḥ | ‘diva ut’ iti utvam | ‘divo jhal’ (pā. sū. 1. 1. 183) iti ‘sāvekācaḥ’ iti prāptasya vibhaktyudāttatvasya pratiṣedhaḥ | ariṣṭebhiḥ | ‘riṣa hiṃsāyām’ | ‘niṣṭhā’ iti ktaḥ | namsamāse avyayapūrvapadaprakṛtisvaratvam 1 | ‘bahulaṃ chandasi’ iti bhisaḥ aisabhāvaḥ | aśvinā | ‘supāṃ suluk’ iti vibhakteḥ ākāraḥ | ‘āmantritasya ca’ iti sarvānudāttatvam | saubhagebhiḥ | śobhano bhagaḥ śrīryasyāsau subhagaḥ | tasya bhāvaḥ saubhagam | ‘subhagāmmanye’ ityudāttādiṣu pāṭhāt ampatyayaḥ | ‘hrasvasinvante pūrvapadasya ca’ iti ubhayapadavṛddhirna bhavati, tasya ‘sarve vidhayaśchandasi vikalpyante’ iti vikalpitatvāt | pūrvavat aisabhāvaḥ | ‘pinyādirnityam’ ityādyudāttatvam || || 37 ||

īyuḥ | te | ye | pūrva̭tarāma | apaśyan | vi'ucchantīm | upasam | martyāsaḥ || asmābhiḥ | oṃ iti | nu | prati'cakṣyā | abhūt | o iti | te | yanti | ye | aparīṣu | paśyān || 11 ||
ya martyāsaḥ maraṇadharmāṇo manuṣyāḥ vyucchantī vivāsayantīṃ parvatarāma atiśayena pūrvaṃ viprakṛṣṭām upasam apaśyan dṛṣṭavantaḥ te manuṣyāḥ īyuḥ gatāḥ |
tathā asmābhiḥ api nu idānīṃ praticakṣyā prakarṣeṇa draṣṭavyā abhūt jātā |
tathā aparīṣu bhāvinīṣu rātriṣu ye manuṣyāḥ etāmuṣasaṃ paśyān paśyanti te |
'dvivacane'ci' iti tasya sthānivadbhāvāt dvibhāve 'dīrgha iṇaḥ kiti' (pā. sū. sū. 7. 4. 69) iti abhyāsasya dīrghatvam |
yāva̭dye॒ṣā ṛ॒tapā॒ ṛ॒tejā̭ḥ su॒mnāva̭rī su॒nṛtā̭ ī॒raya̭ntī |
yavat'dveṣāḥ | ṛta'pāḥ | ṛte'jāḥ | sumna'varī | sūnṛtāḥ | īrayantī | su'maṅgalīḥ | bibhratī | deva'vītim | iha | adya | uṣaḥ | śreṣṭhatamā | vi | uccha || 12 ||
yāvayanti asmattaḥ pṛthakkṛtāni dveṣāṃsi dveṣṭṛṇi rākṣasādīni yathā sā tathoktā |
na hyuṣyasi jātāyāṃ rākṣasādyo'vatiṣṭhante yataste niśācarāḥ |
ṛtapāḥ ṛtasya satyasya yajñasya vā pālayitrī ṛtejāḥ yajñārthaṃ prādurbhūtā |
satyāmuṣasi ahani1 yāgā anuṣṭhīyante ato2 yajñārthaṃ jāte- tyucyate3 |
devavītiṃ devaiḥ kāmyamānaṃ yajñaṃ bibhratī dhārayantī he uṣaḥ śreṣṭhatamā uttamena prakāreṇātipraśastā tvam iha asmin devajanadeśe adya asmin yāgasamaye vyuccha vivāsaya ||

lasārvadhātukānudāttatvābhāvāt pratyayasvara eva śiṣyate | punarvahuvrīhau sa eva svaraḥ | chāndasaḥ pada- kālīno hrasvaḥ | ṛtapāḥ | ṛtaṃ pāti rakṣatīti ṛtapāḥ | 'pā rakṣaṇe' | vic | ṛtejāḥ | ṛte nimitta- bhūte' jāyate iti ṛtejāḥ | 'janī prādurbhāve' | 'janasanakhanakramagamo viṭ' | 'viṣṇoranunāsika- syāt' iti ātvam | 'tatpuruṣe kṛti bahulam' iti aluk | sumnāvarī | 'chandasīvanipau' iti matvarthīyo vanip | 'vano ra ca' iti ḍīp nakārasya rephādeśaśca | 'anyeṣāṃmapi dṛśyate' iti dīrghaḥ | vyatyayena pratyayādyudāttatvam | sumnalīḥ | 'sumnallān saṃjñāyām' (pā. sū. 4.1.41. ga.) iti gaurādiṣu pāṭhāt ḍīṣ | 'sarve vidhayaśchandasi vikalpyante' iti 'halḍyābbhyaḥ' iti sulopasya vikalpitatvāt abhāve hrasvavisargau | devavītim | 'vī gatiprajananakāntyaśanakhādaneṣu' | devavītaye kāmyate iti devavītiryajñaḥ | karmaṇi ktin | dāsībhārāditvāt pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaratvam ||

śaśvatpuroṣā vyuvāsa dveyarthau aghedaṃ vyāvo maghonī | atho vyucchāduttarau anu dyūnajarāmṛtā carati svadhābhiḥ || 13 || śaśvat | purā | uṣāḥ | vi | uvāsa | devī | atho iti | agha | idam | vi | āvaḥ | maghonī | atho iti | vi | ucchāt | ut'nerān | anu | cūna | ajarā | amṛtā | carati | svadhābhiḥ ||13||
devī devanaśīlā uṣāḥ purā pūrvasminkāle śaśvat nityaṃ satataṃ vyuvāsa vyaucchan |
atho anantaram atha asmin kāle maghānī dhanavatī uṣāḥ tamasā tirohitam idaṃ sarvaṃ jagat vyātraḥ vivāsitaṃ prakāśanena tamasā viyuktamakarot |
atho anantaram uttarān ūrdhvatarān bhāvinaḥ dyūna divasān anulakṣya āgāmīṣvapi divaseṣu vyucchāt vyucchati vivāsayati |
ataḥ kālatrayavyāpinī sopāḥ ajarā jarārahitā sarvadaikarūpā amṛtā maraṇarahitā ca satī svadhābhiḥ ātmīyaisnejobhiḥ saha carati vartate ||
tasmādeva3 dhātolrḍi 'bahula chandasi' iti vikaraṇasya luk |

vyañjibhirdiva ātāsvadyaudarpa kṛṣṇāṃ nirṇijaṃ devyāvaḥ | prabodhayantyaruṇebhirrairoṣā yāti suyujā rathena || 14 || vi | añjibhiḥ | divaḥ | ātāsu | adyaut | arpa | kṛṣṇāṃ | niḥ'nirjam | devī | āvṛtyāvaḥ | prabodhayantī | aruṇebhiḥ | aśvaiḥ | ā | uṣāḥ | yāti | suyujā | rathena || 14 ||
1. kṣa-ṭa-ṭha-nimitte | 2. ta-da-śa-saptamyā aluk | 3. ṭha-asmādeva | 4. kṣa-ṭa-ṭha-'anu... uttarapadādyudāttatvam' nāsti | pṛ. 88
ātatāsu vistīrṇāsu dikṣu uṣāḥ ^agnibhiḥ vyañkaiḥ prakāśakaiḥ tejobhiḥ ^vi ^adyaut vidyotate prakāśate |
api ca ^aruṇebhiḥ aruṇaiḥ lohitavarṇaiḥ ^aśvaiḥ vyāpanaśīlaiḥ svakīyaiḥ kiraṇaisturagairvā ^sayujā samyaguktena ^rathena ^uṣāḥ ^ā ^yāti āgacchati |
sūtritaṃ ca- ‘ā dyāṃ tanoṣi raśmibhirāvahantī poṣvā vāryāṇi na tā arvā rejukakāṭo aśnute’ (āśva. śrau. 6. 14) iti ||

āvahantī poṣvā vāryāṇi citraṃ ketuṃ kṛṇute cerkitānā | īyuṣīṇāmupamā śaśvatīnāṃ vibhātīnāṃ prathamoṣā vyadhait || 15 || ā'vahantī | poṣvā | vāryāṇi | citram | ketum | kṛṇute | cerkitānā | īyuṣīṇām | upa'mā | śaśvatīnām | vi'bhātīnām | prathamā | uṣāḥ | vi | adhait || 15 ||

^poṣvā yāvajīvaṃ poṣaṇasamarthāni ^vāryāṇi varaṇīyāni dhanāni ^āvahantī asmabhyamānayantī ^cekitānā sarvaṃ janaṃ ^prajñāpayantī ^uṣāḥ ^citraṃ vicitramāśraryabhūtaṃ cāyanīyaṃ vā ^ketuṃ prajñāpakaṃ raśmiṃ kṛsnajagatprakāśanasamarthaṃ ^kṛṇute svātmanaḥ prakāśāt kurute |

saiṣā ^īyuṣīṇāṃ gamanavatīnāṃ^2 pūrvaniṣpannānāṃ ^śaśvatīnāṃ bahūnāmupasām ^upamā^3 upa samīpe nirmitopamānabhūtā vā ^vibhātīnāṃ viśeṣeṇa prakāśa- mānānāmāgāminīnām upasāṃ ^prathamā ādyā evaṃbhūtoṣāḥ ^vyadhait tejasā pravṛddhāsīt ||
‘ dīrgha iṇaḥ kiti ’ iti abhyāsasya dīrghatvam |
laṅi ‘ bahulaṃ chandasi ’ iti vikaraṇasya luk |
udī̭rdhvaṃ jīvo a॒surna ā॒gādapa̭ prāgā॒ttaṃ ā jyo̭ti॒reti |
ā॒raikpanthāṃ yā॒tave sū॒ryāyā̭ga॒nma yatra॒ prati̭ra॒nta ā॒yuḥ ||
ut | ī̭rdhvam | jī॒vaḥ | a॒suḥ | naḥ | ā | a॒gāt | apa̭ | pra | a॒gāt | tama̭ḥ | ā | jyo̭tiḥ | e॒ti || ā॒raik | panthā̭m | yā॒tave | sū॒ryāya̭ | a॒ga॒nma | yatra̭ | pra॒ti॒ra॒ntai | ā॒yuḥ || 16 ||

he manuṣyāḥ 'udīrdhvaṃ śayanaṃ parityajya udgacchata | 'naḥ asmākam 'asuḥ śarīrasya prerayitā 'jīvaḥ jīvātmā 'āgāt āgatavān | 'tamaḥ 'apa 'prāgāt apakrāntam | upamaḥ prakāśe sati sarva- jīvanavyāpārayogaḥ | tasmāt paramātmarūpatayā sa ca jīvastadeva 'jyotiḥ 'ā 'gati āgacchati | 'sūryāya sūryasya 'mārgam 'āraik viviktīkaroti | 'yātave gamanāya | tasmin deśe 'aganma gacchāmaḥ 'yatra yasmin deśe 'āyuḥ | ajhanāmaṃtat | annaṃ 'pratirante | prapūrvastiratirvardhanārthaḥ | udārā dānena pravardhayanti' || 'īrdhvam | 'īra gatau' | ādādiko'nudāttat | 'āraik | 'ricir virecane' | laṅi 'bahula̭ chandasi' iti vikaraṇasya luk | guṇe vyatyayena ītvam | panthām | dvitīyāyāmapi 'pathimadhyubhukṣāmāt' iti vyatyayena ātvam | aganma | gamelaṅi 'bahula̭ chandasi' iti vikaraṇasya luk | 'mvośca' (pā. sū. 8. 2. 65) iti makārasya nakāraḥ ||
syūma̭nā vā॒ca udi̭ryati va॒hniḥ stavā̭no re॒bha u॒ṣaso॒ vibhā̭tīḥ |
syūma̭nāḥ | vā॒caḥ | ut | ī॒rya̭ti | va॒hniḥ | stavā̭naḥ | re॒bhaḥ | u॒ṣasa̭ḥ | vi॒bhā॒tīḥ | a॒dya | tat | u॒ccha॒t | gṛ॒ṇa॒te | ma॒ghoni̭ | a॒sme iti̭ | ā॒yuḥ | ni | di॒dī॒hi | pra॒jā'va̭t || 17 ||
stotā 'upaso 'vibhātīḥ tamaso'panodanena prakāśamānā upadevatāḥ 'stavānaḥ stuvan 'vācaḥ vedarūpāyāḥ saṃvandhinī 'syūmanāḥ syūmāni anusyūtāni saṃtatāni ukthāni 'udiyarti' udgamayati uccārayati |
ato he 'maghoni maghavati' upaḥ 'adya asmin samaye 'gṛṇate stuvate tasmai puruṣāya 'taduccha |
dṛṣṭinirodhakatayā prasiddhaṃ naiśaṃ tamo vivāsaya varjaya |
1. sa-tamaḥ ajñānam apa prāgāt; kṣa-ṭa-ṭha-tamaḥ rātrikṛtadhvāntamapi apa prāgāt prakarṣeṇa apagatam |
2. kṣa-ṭa-ṭha-yasmājjyotiḥ auṣasaṃ tejaḥ eti āgacchati api ca uṣāḥ sūryāya yātave yātuṃ panthānaṃ panthānaṃ mārgam āraik aricat recitavatī kalpitavatī |
udārā dānena pravardhayanti; sa-uṣasaḥ prakāśe sati sarva- jīvanavyāpārayogaḥ |
tasmāt paramātmarūpatayā sa ca jīvaḥ tadeva jyotiḥ upeti jyotiḥ ā eti āgacchati yasmindeśe gacchāmaḥ yatra yasmindeśe sūryāya yātave rakṣakāya panthām āraik arecitavatī |
3. kṣa-ṭa-ṭha-stutīnām 4. kṣa-ṭa-ṭha- syūmanā sāmabhiranustutāni ukthāni udiyarti |

dīdihi nitarāṃ prakāśaya | dīdeticchāndaso dīptikarmā | prayacchetyarthaḥ || syusanā | tantusantāne | ' anyebhyo'pi dṛśyante ' iti diśrahaṇasya sarvopādhivyabhicārārthatvāt karmaṇi manin | ' chūḥ śū ' iti ūṭ | ' āḍyājayārāṃ copasaṃkhyānam ' (pā. ma. 7. 1. 39. 1) iti vibhakteḥ āḍādeśaḥ | yadvā | auṇādiko bhāve mak | pāmādilakṣaṇe matvarthīyo naḥ | bandhanayuktāni ityarthaḥ | ' śe śchandasi bahulam ' iti śeloṃpaḥ | vyatyayenādyudāttatvam | vācaḥ | ' sāvekācaḥ ' iti ṅam udāttatvam | iyarti | ' ṛ gatau ' | jauhotyādikaḥ | ' atipiparyośca ' iti abhyāsasya hrasvam | stavānaḥ | ' ṣṭuñ stutau ' | śānaci adāditvāt śapo luk | tasya ' chandasyubhayathā ' iti ārdhadhātukatvena ṅittvābhāvāt guṇāvādeśau | vyatyayenādyudāttatvam | vibhātīḥ | ' śatarunnamo nathajādī ' iti ṅīp udāttatvam | gṛṇate | ' gṛ śabde ' | krayādikaḥ | ' pvādīnāṃ hrasvaḥ ' | pūrveṇa sūtreṇa vibhakterudāttatvam | aste | ' supāṃ suluk ' iti caturthyāḥ śeādeśaḥ ||

yā gormatīrupasaḥ sarvavīrā vyucchanti dāśuṣe martyāya | vāyoriva sūnṛtānāmudarke tā aśvadā aśvavat somasutvā || 18 || yāḥ | gormatīḥ | upasaḥ | sarvavīrāḥ | vi'ucchanti | dāśuṣe | martyāya | vāyoḥ'iva | sūnṛtānām | ut'arke | tāḥ | aśvadāḥ | aśvavat | soma'sutvā || 18 ||
dāśuṣe havīṃṣi dattavate martyāya manuṣyāya yajamānāya gomatīḥ : gomasyo bahubhirgobhiryuktāḥ : sarvavīrāḥ : sarvaiḥ saraṇasamarthaiḥ vīraiḥ śūrairyuktāḥ : yāḥ : upasaḥ : dyucchanti tamo varjayanti |
vāyoriva vāyuvastrīghraṃ pravartamānānāṃ sūnṛtānāṃ stutirūpāṇāṃ vācām udarkai samāsau aśvadāḥ : aśvānāṃ dātrīḥ : tāḥ : upasaḥ : somasutvā somānāmabhiṣotā yajamānaḥ : aśvavat vyāpnotu |

mātā devānāmidateranīkaṃ yajñasya keturbṛhatī vi bhāhi | praśastikṛdbrahaṇe no vyūcchā no janai janaya viśvavāre || 19 || mātā | devānām | aditaiḥ | anīkam | yajñasya | ketuḥ | bṛhatī | vi | bhāhi | praśasti'kṛt | brahmaṇe | naḥ | vi'uccha | ā | naḥ | janai | janaya | viśva'vāre || 19 ||
upasi sarve devāḥ stutyā prabodhyante ataḥ sā tajjananavatī ityucyate |
ata eva aditeḥ devānāṃ mātuḥ anīkaṃ pratyanīkam |
yathendrā- śrayatvāt mukhaṃ prakāśakam evamuṣāḥ bhūmeḥ prakāśayitrītyarthaḥ |
v yajñasya v ketuḥ ketayitrī jñāpayitrī v bṛhatī mahatī satī v vi v bhāhi prakāśasva |
api ca v praśastikṛt samyak stutamiti praśaṃsanaṃ kurvantī v naḥ asmadīyāya v brahmaṇe mantrarūpāya stotrāya v yuccha vivāsaya |
tadanantaraṃ he v viśvavāre sarvairvarṇanīye uṣaḥ v naḥ asmān v jane janapade v ā v janaya ābhimukhyena prādurbhāvaya avasthāpayetyarthaḥ |
tanno mitro varuṇo māmahantāmaditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ |
yat | citram | apraḥ | upasaḥ | vahanti | ījānāya | śaśamānāya | bhadram | tat | naḥ | mitraḥ | varuṇaḥ | māmahantām | aditiḥ | sindhuḥ | pṛthivī | uta | dyauḥ ||20||
v citraṃ cāyanīyaṃ v apraḥ āsabhyaṃ v yat dhanam v upaso v vahanti ānayanti v ījānāya havirbhiḥ iṣṭavate v śaśamānāya stutibhiḥ saṃbhajamānāya puruṣāya v bhadraṃ bhajanīyaṃ tat bhavatīti śeṣaḥ |
yadyanena sūktenāsmābhiḥ prārthitaṃ tat mitrādayaḥ ṣaḍdevatāḥ v māmahantāṃ pūjitaṃ kurvantu |
‘āpaḥ karmālyāyāṃ hrasvo nud ca vā’ iti bahulagrahaṇāt akarmālyāyāmapi asun; dhātorhasvā nuḍāgamaśca |
tasya lasārvadhātukatvā- bhāvāt adupadeśāt lasārvadhātukasvarābhāve citsvara eva śiṣyate |
‘imā rudrāya’ iti ekādaśaṃ navamaṃ sūktaṃ kṛtsnasyārtham |
tathā cānukrāntam- ‘imā ekādaśa raudraṃ dvitriṣvantyam’ iti |
tathā ca suśritaṃ- ‘kadrudrāyemā rudrāya te pitarimā rudrāya sthiradhanvane gira iti sarvarudrayeṣu diśāmupasthānam’ ( āśva. gṛ. 4. 9. 21 ) iti |
imā rudrāya tavase kapardineṃ kṣayadvīrāya pra bharāmahe matīḥ |
yathā śamasaddvipade catuṣpade viśvaṃ puṣṭaṃ grāme asminnanāturam |
imāḥ | rudrāya | tavase | kapardineṃ | kṣayadvīrāya | pra | bharāmahe | matīḥ | yathā | śam | asat | dvipade | catuṣpade | viśvam | puṣṭam | grāme | asmin | anāturam ||1||

rudrāya | rodayati sarvamantakāle iti rudraḥ | yadvā | rut saṃsārakhyaṃ duḥkham | tat drāvayati apagamayati vināśayatīti rudraḥ | yadvā | rutaḥ śabdarūpāḥ | upaniṣadaḥ | tābhirbhūyate gamyate pratipādyate
rut śabdātmikā vāṇī tatpratipādyā ātmavidyā vā |
kadācit devāsurasaṃgrāme anyātmako rudro dairvinikṣiptaṃ dhanamapahṛtya nirgān |
asurān jitvā devā enamanviṣya dṛṣṭvā dhanamapaharan |
tathā ca taittarīyakaṃ- ' so'rodīdyadarodīttadrudrasya rudratvam ' ( tai. saṃ. 1. 5. 1. 1 ) iti |
tasmai ' rudrāya 'matīḥ mananīyāḥ 'imāḥ stutīḥ 'pra 'bharāmahe prakarṣeṇa niṣpādayāmaḥ |
'tavase pravṛddhāya 'kapardine jaṭilāya 'kṣayadvīrāya kṣayanto vinaśyanto vīrā yasmin tādṛśāya |
kṣayantaḥ prāsaiśvaryā vīrā marudgaṇāḥ putrā yasya tasmai |
'yathā yena prakāreṇa 'śaṃ śamanīyānāṃ rogāṇā- mupaśamanaṃ 'dvipade asmadīyāya manuṣyāya 'catuṣpade gavāśvaprabhṛtaye ca 'asat bhavet |
āturā rugṇāḥ taiḥ rahitaṃ sat 'puṣṭaṃ pravṛddhaṃ bhavatu ||
'roderṇi lk ca ' ( u. sū. 2. 179 ) iti rak |
'chandasyubhayathā ' iti śatṛḥ ārṣadhātu katvena adupadeśāt lasārvadhātukānudāttatvābhāvāt tasyaiva svaraḥ śiṣyate |
ekadeśavikṛtasya ananyatvāt ( paribhā. 37 ) 'dvitribhyāṃ pādanmūrdhasu bahuvrīhau' iti uttarapadādyudāttatvam |
pūrvapadaṃ ca ' traḥ saṃkhyāyāḥ ' ( phi. sū. 28 ) ityādyudāttam ||
rudradevasya paśau vapāpuroḍāśayoḥ : 'mṛḻā no rudra ' ityādike dve anuvākye |
tathā ca sūtritaṃ- ' mṛḻā no rudrota no mayaskṛdhi iti dve ā te pitarmarutāṃ sumnametu ' ( āśva. śrī. 3. 8 ) iti ||
mṛḻā nau rudrota no mayaskṛdhi kṣayadvīrāya namasā vidhema te |
yacchaṃ ca yośca manurāyeje pitā tadaśyāma tava rudra praṇītiṣu ||
mṛḻa | naḥ | rudra | uta | naḥ | mayaḥ | kṛdhi | kṣayat'vīrāya | namasā | vidhema | te | yat | śam | ca | yoḥ | ca | manuḥ | āyeje | pitā | tat | aśyāma | tava | rudra | praṇītiṣu ||2||
'uta api ca tadanantaraṃ 'naḥ asmākaṃ 'mayaḥ sukhaṃ 'kṛdhi kuru |

api ca 'pitā utpādakaḥ 'manuḥ svakīyābhyaḥ prajābhyaḥ 'śaṃ rogāṇāṃ śamanaṃ 'yośca bhayānāṃ yāvanaṃ ca 'yat etat dvayaṃ 'āyeje devebhyaḥ sakāśāt prāpya dattavān he 'rudra 'tava 'praṇītiṣu prakṛṣṭanayaneṣu satsu 'tat vayaṃ 'aśyāma vyāpnuyāma ||
karoterloṭi ' bahulaṃ chandasi ' iti vikaraṇasya luk |
' ataḥ kṛkami ' iti mayaso visarjanīyasya satvam |

‘kriyāgrahaṇaṃ kartavyam’ iti karmaṇaḥ saṃpradānatvāt caturthī | vidhema | ‘vidha vidhāne’ | taudādikaḥ | āyeje | ‘yaja devapūjāsaṃgatikaraṇadāneṣu’ | liṭi saṃjñāpūrvakasya vidheranityatvāt saṃprasāraṇābhāve etvā- bhyāsalopau | aśyāma | ‘aśnu vyāptau’ | vyatyayena parasmaipadam | ‘bahula chandasi’ iti vikaraṇasya luk ||
aśyāma te sumatiṃ devayujyayā kṣayadvīrasya tava rudra mīḍhvaḥ |
sumnāyannit viśo asmākamā carāriṣṭhavīrā juhavāma te haviḥ ||
aśyāma | te | sumatim | devayujyayā | kṣayadvīrasya | tava | rudra | mīḍhvaḥ | sumnāyan | it | viśaḥ | asmākam | ā | cara | ariṣṭhavīrāḥ | juhavāma | te | haviḥ ||3||

he mīḍhvaḥ sektaḥ kāmābhivarṣaka nityataraṇa vā rudra kṣayadvīrasya kṣapitapratipakṣasya maharddhiyuktasya vā tava sumatiṃ śobhanāṃ kalyāṇīmanugrahātmikāṃ buddhiṃ te tvatsambandhino vayaṃ devayujyayā devayāgena svahevatyena yajñena aśyāma prāmavāma |
tvaṃ ca asmākaṃ viśaḥ prajāḥ abhilakṣya ā cara āgaccha |
tāsāṃ prajānāṃ sukhamicchanneva sukhaprada eva bhavetyarthaḥ |
ariṣṭā ahiṃsitā vīrā yeṣāṃ tathābhūtāḥ santaḥ te tubhyaṃ haviḥ carupuroḍāśādikaṃ juhavāma codite ādhāre prakṣipāma ||
śobhanaṃ mananaṃ yasyāṃ buddhau sā sumatiḥ |
‘chandasi niṣṭakye’ ityādau yajeḥ yaprāyayo nipātyate strīliṅgatā ca |
‘devasudyayoryujapi kāṭhake’ (pā. sū. 7. 4. 38) iti vidhīyamānam ātvaṃ vyatyayena atrāpi draṣṭavyam ||
tveṣaṃ vayaṃ rudraṃ yajñasādhaṃ vaḍuṃkuṃ kuvimavase ni hayāmahe |
āre asmadyaṃ heḻo asyatu sumatimidvayasyā vṛṇīmahe ||

avase rakṣaṇāya rudraṃ mahādevaṃ ni hayāmahe nitarāmāhvayāmaḥ |
tathā ca taittirīyake- ‘devā vai yajñā- dudramantarāyan’ ityupakramyāmnātaṃ- ‘sviṣṭhaṃ vai na idaṃ bhaviṣyati yadimaṃ rādhayiṣyāma iti tasviṣṭhakṛtaḥ sviṣṭhakṛttvam’ (tai. saṃ. 2. 6. 8. 3) iti |

sa ca rudro 'daivyaṃ devasya' dyotamānasya' saṃbandhanaṃ 'helaḥ krodhaṃ 'asmata 'āre asamato dūradeśe 'asyatu prerayatu | 'asya mahādevasya 'sumatimti śobhanāmanugraharūpāṃ buddhimeva 'vayam 'ā 'vṛṇīmahe ābhi- mukhyena saṃbhajāmahe || yajñasādham | yajñaṃ sādhayatīti yajñasāt | 'pidh saṃrāddhau ' | ' sidhyaterapāra- laukike ' iti ātvam | yadvā | ' rādha sādha saṃsiddhau ' | asmāt ṇyantāt kip | vaṅkukam | ' vaki kauṭilye ' | auṇādika upratyayaḥ | ni hayāmahe | ' nisamupavibhyo hvaḥ ' | hvayātmanepadam | daivyam | ' daivādyañau ' ( pā. sū. 4. 1. 85. 3 ) iti prāgdīvyatīyo yañ | asyatu | ' asu kṣepaṇe ' | daivādikaḥ | vṛṇīmahe | ' vṛṅ saṃbhaktau ' | kaiyādikaḥ ||

sa ca maheśvaraḥ 9 tān samānarūpān samānavayasaḥ samānālaṃkārān putrān kṛtvā gauryai pradadau taveme putrāḥ santu iti |
ataḥ sarveṣu mārateṣu sūkteṣu maruto rudraputrā iti stūyante |

mā nau mahāntamuta mā nau arbhakaṃ mā na ukṣantamuta mā na ukṣitam |

mā nastoke tanaye mā na āyau mā no goṣu mā no aśveṣu rīriṣaḥ | vīrānmā no rudra bhāmito vadhīrhaviṣmantaḥ sadamittvā havāmahe || 8 || mā | naḥ | toke | tanaye | mā | naḥ | āyau | mā | naḥ | goṣu | mā | naḥ | aśveṣu | rīriṣaḥ | vīrān | mā | naḥ | rudra | bhāmitaḥ | vadhīḥ | haviṣmantaḥ | sadam | it | tvā | havāmahe || 8 ||
he rudra naḥ asmākaṃ tokādiviṣaye mā riripaḥ mā hiṃsīḥ |
putrapautravyatirikto yo'smadīyaḥ manuvyastasmin goṣu paśvādiṣu aśveṣu ca mā riripaḥ hiṃsāṃ mā kṛthāḥ |
tathā he rudra vīrān vikrāntān śauryo- petān asmadīyān bhāmitaḥ kruddhaḥ san mā vadhīḥ mā hiṃsīḥ |
vayaṃ ca haviṣmantaḥ havi- rbhiryuktāḥ santaḥ sadamit sarvadaiva tvā havāmahe āhvayāmahe ||
devasuvāṃ haviḥṣu rudrasya paśu pateryāge 'upa te stomān' ityādi ke yājyānuvākye |
sūtritaṃ ca- 'upa te stomānpaśupā ivākaramiti dve' (āśva. śrau. 4. 11) iti ||

upa te stomānpaśupā ivākaraṃ rasvā pitarmarutāṃ sumnamusme | bhadrā hi te sumatirmṛḻayattamāthā vayamava itte vṛṇīmahe || 9 || upa | te | stomān | paśupaḥ | iva | ā | akaram | rasva | pitaḥ | marutām | sumnam | asme | iti || bhadrā | hi | te | sumatiḥ | mṛḻayattamā | atha | vayam | avaḥ | it | te | vṛṇīmahe || 9 ||
he rudra stomān stutirūpānmantrān te tubhyam upa ā akaram upāharomi samarpayāmi |
yathā paśūnāṃ pālayitā gopaḥ prātaḥkāle svasmai samarpitān paśūn sāyaṃkāle svāmibhyaḥ pratyarpayati evaṃ tvatkāśālābhān stutirūpānmantrān stutisādhanatayā tubhyaṃ pratyarpayāmītyarthaḥ |
he marutāṃ pitaḥ marutsaṃjñānāṃ devānām utpādaka rudra no'smabhyaṃ sumnaṃ sukhaṃ rasva dehi |
api ca te tvadīyā sumatiḥ kalyāṇī buddhiḥ mṛḻayattamā atiśayena sukhayittamā |
yasmādevaṃ tasmāt atha anantaraṃ vayaṃ te tvadīyam avaḥ rakṣaṇaṃ vṛṇīmahe saṃbhajāmahe ||
'paramapi chandasi' iti parasyāḥ ṣaṣṭhyāḥ pūrvāmantritānupraveśe sati 'āmantritasya ca' iti padadvayamapyanudāttam |

1. kṣa-ṭa-ṭha-antodāttam | 2. sa-yo'smadīyo manuvyastasmin hiṃsāṃ mā kṛthāḥ | api ca naḥ asmākaṃ goṣu aśveṣu ca hiṃsāṃ mā kṛthāḥ | 3. kṣa-ṭa-ṭha-asmadīyān janān | 4. kṣa-ṭa-ṭha-marutsaṃjñā- nām | 5. kṣa-ṭa-ṭha-janaka | 6. kṣa-ṭa-ṭha-kalyāṇā |
tasya ‘chandasyubhayathā’ iti ārdhadhātukatvāt lasārvadhātukānudāttatvābhāve pratyayasvara: śiṣyate |

āre tḙ go॒ghnamu॒ta pū॒ruṣa॒ghnaṃ kṣaya̭dvīra su॒mnamu॒sme tḙ astu | mṛ॒ḻā ca̭ no॒ adhi̭ ca brūhi de॒vādhā̭ ca na॒ḥ śarma̭ yaccha dvi॒barhā̭ḥ || 10 || āre | te | go'ghnam | uta | puruṣa'ghnam | kṣayat'vīra | sumnam | asme iti | te | astu | mṛḻa | ca | naḥ | adhi | ca | brūhi | deva | ardha | ca | naḥ | śarma | yaccha | dvi'barhāḥ || 10 ||

he kṣayadvīra kṣapitasarvaśatrujana rudra te tvadīyaṃ goghnaṃ yatrohananaṃ yadvā gohanasādhanamāyudham uta api ca puruṣaghnaṃ puruṣahananaṃ tatsādhanamāyudhaṃ vā tadubhayam āre dūre asmatto viprakṛṣṭadeśe bhavatu |
asme asmāsu te tvadīyaṃ sumnaṃ sukham astu bhavatu |
api ca na: asmākaṃ mṛḻa sukhasiddhayarthaṃ prasanno bhava |
he deva dyotamāna rudra na: asmān adhi brūhi ca |
adhivacanaṃ pakṣapātena vacanaṃ ‘brāhmaṇāyādhi brūyāt’ (tai. saṃ. 2. 5. 11. 9) iti yathā |
adha ca atha anantaraṃ ca dvibarhāḥ dvayo: sthānayo: pṛthivyāmantarikṣe ca parivṛḍha: |
sa tvaṃ na: asmabhyaṃ śarma sukhaṃ yaccha dehi |
asmāt ‘ghañarthe kavidhānam’ iti bhāve karaṇe vā kapratyaya: |
dvayo: sthānayo: barhate pravadhate iti dvibarhā: |

arvo̭cāma॒ namo̭ a॒smā a॒vasya̭vaḥ śṛṇotu॒ no॒ hava̭ṃ ru॒dro ma̭ru॒tvān | tanno̭ mi॒tro varṷṇo māmahantā॒madi̭tiḥ si॒ndhuḥ pṛ̭thi॒vī u॒ta dyauḥ || 11 || arvocāma | nama: | asmai | avasyava: | śṛṇotu | na: | havam | rudra: | marutvān | tat | na: | mitra: | varuṇa: | māmahantām | aditi: | sindhu: | pṛthivī | uta | dyau: || 11 ||

avasyava: ava: avaṃ rakṣaṇaṃ vā icchanto vayam avocāma etatsūktarūpaṃ stotramavādiṣma | asmai rudrāya nama: namaskāro'stu | marutvān marudbhi: svakīyai: putrairyukta: rudra: ca na: asmākaṃ havam āhvānaṃ śṛṇotu svīkarotu | yadasmābhiruktaṃ na: asmadīyaṃ tat sarvaṃ mitrādaya: ṣaḍdevatā: mamahantāṃ pūjayantu | utaśabdo'pyarthe || avocāma | ‘brū vyaktāyāṃ vāci’ | luṅi ‘bhuvo vaci:’ | ‘asyativakti’ ityādinā caleraḍādeśa: | ‘vaca um’ iti umāgama: | avasyava: | ‘ava rakṣaṇe’ | bhāve asun | ‘supa ātmana: kyac’ | ‘kyācchandasi’ iti upratyaya: | havam | ‘bhāve'nupasargasya’ |
‘citram’ iti ṣaḍcaṃ daśamaṃ sūktaṃ kutsasyārṣaṃ’ traiṣṭubhaṃ sūryadevatākam2 |
sūtritaṃ ca- ‘citraṃ devānāṃ namo mitrasya ’ (āśva. śrau. 6. 5) iti ||
āditastitra ṛcaḥ sauryasya paśoḥ vapāpuroḍāśahaviṣāṃ kramenānuvākyāḥ |
tathā ca sūtritaṃ- ‘citraṃ devānāmudagādanīkamiti pañca śaṃ no bhava cakṣasā śaṃ no ahā ’ (āśva. śrau. 3. 8) iti |
ati- mūrttināmni ekāhe śunāsīrye3 parvaṇi ca sūryasya havipaḥ : ‘citraṃ devānām ’ itya

sūryo devīmuṣasaṃ rocamānāṃ maryo na yoṣāmabhyeti paścāt | yatrā naro devayanto yugāni vitanvate prati bhadrāya bhadram || 2 || sūryeḥ | devīm | uṣasam | rocamānām | maryaḥ | na | yoṣām | abhi | eti | paścāt | yatra | naraḥ | devayantaḥ | yugāni | vitanvate | prati | bhadrāya | bhadram || 2 ||

tatsūryasya devatvaṃ tanmahitvaṃ madhyā karturvirtataṃ saṃ jabhāra |
tat | sūryasya | deva'tvam | tat | mahi'tvam | madhyā | kartauḥ | vi'rtatam | sam | jabhāra | yadā | it | ayukta | haritaḥ | sadha'sthāt | āt | rātrī | vāsaḥ | tanute | simasmai || 4 ||
ᵛsūryasya sarvaprerakasya² ādityasya ᵛtat ᵛdevatvam īśvaratvam |
ᵛmahitvaṃ mahattvaṃ māhātmyaṃ ca ᵛtat eva |
prārabdhāparisamāptasya³ ṛbhvādilakṣaṇasya karmaṇaḥ ᵛmadhyā aparisamāpte eva tasmin karmaṇi ᵛvitataṃ vistīrṇaṃ svakīyaṃ raśmijālam astaṃ gacchan sūryaḥ ᵛsaṃ ᵛjabhāra asmāllokān svātmanyupasaṃharati |
karmakaraśca pravṛtta-maparisamāptameva ᵛvisṛjati astaṃ yantaṃ sūrya dṛṣṭvā |
īdṛśaṃ svātantryaṃ mahimā ca sūryavyatiriktasya kasyāsti |
ᵛyadet yasminneva kāle ᵛharitaḥ rasaharaṇaśīlān svaraśmīna vā ᵛsadhasthāt sahasthānāt asmāt pārthivalokādādāya ᵛayukta anyatra saṃyuktān karoti |
yadaivāsau svaraśmīnrān vā sadhasthāt saha tiṣṭhantamiti sadhastho rathaḥ |
ᵛāt anantarameva ᵛrātrī niśā ᵛvāsaḥ ācchādayituṃ tamaḥ ᵛsimasmai |

atra nihaktaṃ- 'tatsūryasya devatvaṃ tanmahitvaṃ madhye yatkarmaṇāṃ kriyamāṇānāṃ vitataṃ saṃhiyate yadā'sau ayukta haraṇānādiyyaraśmīna harito'thānīti vātha rātrī vāsastanute simasmai vāsaramaharayuvatī sarvasmāt' (niru. 4. 11) iti ||
udiccena ktvāpratyaye iṣṭo vikalpanāt 'yasya vibhāṣa' iti id-pratiṣedhaḥ |

ayukta | yujerlaṅi ‘jhalo jhali’ iti mico lopaḥ | sadhasthāt | ‘ghañarthe kavidhānam’ iti adhikaraṇe kapratyayaḥ | ‘sadha mādasthayośchandasi’ iti sadhādeśaḥ | dāsībhāditvāt pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaratvam | rātrī | ‘rātrerbhājasau’ iti ṅīp ||
tanmitrasya varuṇasyābhicakṣe sūryo rūpaṃ kṛṇute dyaurupasthe |
tat | mitrasya | varuṇasya | abhicakṣe | sūryaḥ | rūpam | kṛṇute | dyauḥ | upasthe | anantam | anyat | ruśat | asya | pājaḥ | kṛṣṇam | anyat | haritaḥ | sam | bharanti || 5 ||

tat tadānīm udayasamaye mitrasya varuṇasya etadubhayopalakṣitasya sarvasya jagataḥ abhicakṣe ābhimukhyena prakāśanāya dyoḥ nabhasaḥ upasthe upasthāne madhye sūryaḥ sarvasya prerakaḥ savitā rūpaṃ sarvasya nirūpakaṃ prakāśakaṃ tejaḥ kṛṇute karoti |
api ca asya sūryasya haritaḥ rasaharaṇaśīlā raśmayaḥ haridvarṇāḥ 1 aśvā vā anantam avasānarahitaṃ kṛtsnasya jagato vyāpakaṃ ruśat dīpyamānaṃ śvetavarṇaṃ pājaḥ |
balayuktam atibalasyāpi naiśasya tamaso nikāraṇe samartham anyat tamaso vilakṣaṇaṃ tejaḥ: saṃ bharanti ahani svakīyāgamanena niṣpādayanti |
tathā kṛṣṇaṃ kṛṣṇavarṇam anyat tamaḥ svakīyā- pagamanena rātrau |
asya raśmayo'pyevaṃ kurvanti kimu vaktavyaṃ tasya māhātmyamiti sūryasya stutiḥ ||
‘pāterbale jud ca’ ( u. sū. 4. 642 ) iti asun juḍāgamaśca |
adyā devā uditā sūryasya niraṃhasaḥ pipṛtā niravadyāt |
tanno mitro varuṇo māmahantāmaditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ ||
adya | devāḥ | ut'itā | sūryasya | niḥ | ahaṃsaḥ | pipṛta | niḥ | avadyāt | tat | naḥ | mitraḥ | varuṇaḥ | māmahantām | aditiḥ | sindhuḥ | pṛthivī | uta | dyauḥ || 6 ||
he devāḥ dyotamānāḥ sūryaśmayaḥ adya asminkāle sūryasya ādityasya uditā udite udaye sati itastataḥ prasaranto yūyam asmān aṃhasaḥ pāpāt niḥ pipṛta niṣkṛṣya pālayata |
yadida- masmābhiruktaṃ naḥ asmadīyaṃ tat mitrādayaḥ ṣaḍdevatāḥ mamahantāṃ pūjayantu anumanyantām |
2. kṣa-ṭa-ṭha-yadidamasmābhiḥ prārthitaṃ tanmitrādayaḥ ṣaḍdevatāḥ pālayantu ( ṭa-pūjayantu ) |

bhūlokasyādhiṣṭhātrī dyauḥ ghulokasya | utaśabdaḥ samuccaye || agra | ‘nipātasya ca’ iti saṃhitāyāṃ dīrghatvam | uditā | utpūrvāt eterbhāve kin | ‘supāṃ suluk’ iti ḍādeśaḥ | ‘tādau ca’ iti gateḥ prakṛtisvaratvam | pipṛt | ‘pṛ pālanapūraṇayoḥ pṛ ityeke’ | loṭi juhotyāditvāt śapaḥ bhluḥ | dvivaṃcanoradavahalādiśeṣāḥ | ‘artipiparyośca’ iti abhyāsasya hrasvam | ‘sārvadhātukamapit’ iti taśabdasya ḍittve sati ‘ṛci tunudha’ ityādinā saṃhitāyāṃ dīrghaḥ || 7 || || 16 ||
uśanā- stana kāvyasya mahimnā dāṣṭrā dīrghatamasa ādiḥ kakṣīvān asya sūktasya ṛṣiḥ |
tathā cānukrāntaṃ- ‘nāsatyābhyāṃ pañcādhikā kakṣīvāndaivatatamasa uśikaprasūta āśvinaṃ vai’ iti |
prātaranuvākasya āśvine kratau traiṣṭubhe chandasi idamādīni trīṇi sūktāni |
‘athāśvinaḥ’ iti khaṇḍe sūtritaṃ- ‘prāvāṇeva nāsatyābhyāmiti trīṇi’ (āśva. śrau. 4. 15) iti |
āśvinaśastre caitāni śasyāni ‘prātaranuvākanyāyena’ (āśva. śrau. 6. 5) iti atidiṣṭatvāt ||
nāsatyābhyāṃ barhiriva pra vṛṅkte stomā~ iyarmiryaveva vātaḥ |
yāvarmegāya vimudāya jāyāṃ senājuvā nyuhtū rathena ||
nāsatyābhyām | barhiḥ'iva | pra | vṛṅkte | stomān | iyarmi | agniyā'iva | vātaḥ | yau | arbhagāya | viḍmadāya | jāyām | senā'juvā | ni'ūhatuḥ | rathena || 1 ||
barhiriva yathā kaściyajamāno yāgārthaṃ barhiḥ pra vṛṅkte prakarṣeṇa anyūnānatiriktaṃ yāgāya paryāptaṃ darbhaṃ vṛṅkte chinatti saṃgadayatīti yāvat |
evamahaṃ nāsatyābhyām aśvibhyāṃ stomān stutīḥ iyarmi saṃgadayāmi |
yathā agniyāṇi agneṣu meghedhvavasthitānyudakāni vātaḥ vāyuḥ varṣaṇārthaṃ bahuśaḥ prerayati evamaham aśvibhyāṃ stotrāṇi iyarmi bahuśaḥ prerayāmi |

kīdṛśāvaśvinau ? arbhagāya bālāya svayaṃvaralabdhabhāryāya vimadāya etat- saṃjñāyaṃ rājarṣaye madhyamāgaṃ svayaṃvarārthamāgateḥ tām alabhamāneranyairnṛpaiḥ saha yoddhumaśaknuvate'pi tasmai senājuvā śatrusenāyāḥ prerakeṇa śatrubhiḥ duṣṭāpeṇa rathena yau aśvinau jāyāṃ bhāryāṃ parairanu- krāntāṃ nyuhtuḥ śatrujihvasya tadīyaṃ gṛhaṃ prāpayāmāsatuḥ |
1. kṣa-ṭa-ṭha-sūtritaṃ ca | 2. kṣa-ṭa-ṭha-āśvinaśastreyetāni | 3. kṣa-ṭa-ṭha-etatsajñakāya | 4. kṣa-ṭa-ṭha-na-sa-parairānākrāntām | 5. kṣa-ṭa-na-sa-agniyā iva; ṭha-agniyā |

gakāra: | apara āha | arbhamalaṃ gāyati śabdayatītyarbhaga: | ‘kai gai śabde’ | ‘gāpoṣṭak’ (pā. sū. 3. 2. 8 ) | ‘āto lopa iṭi ca’ iti ākāralopa: | tadetat padakṛta: śākalyasya abhimatam | senājuvā | ju iti sautro dhāturtyartha: | asmādantārbhāvitaṇyantāt ‘kvivvicapraccha’ ityādinā kvidīrghau | tanvādisvāduvaṅ (pā. sū. 6. 4. 77. 1) | nyūhatu: | ‘vaha prāpaṇe’ liṭi anusi yajāditvāt saṃprasāraṇam | ‘yadvṛttāntyam’ iti nighātapratiṣedha: ||
tadrāṃsabho nāsatyā sahasramājā yamasya pradhane jigāya ||
vīḻupattamabhi: | āśuhemabhi: | vā | devānām | vā | jūtabhi: | śāśadānā | tat | rāṃsabha: | nāsatyā | sahasram | ājā | yamasya | pradhane | jigāya || 2 ||

he vnāsatyā aśvinau evaṃbhūtaiśca vdevānām indrādīnāṃ vjūtibhi: preraṇaiśca vśāśadānā śāśayamānayo: athyarthaṃ preryamāṇayoryuvayorvāhanabhūto ya: vrāsabha: prajāpatinā datta: sa: vyamasya vaiva- svatasya prītikare vpradhane prakīrṇadhanopate vājā ājo saṃgrāme vtat śatrūṇāṃ vsahasraṃ vjigāya jita- vān |
vaivasvato hi bahūnāṃ maraṇahetunā saṃgrāmeṇa tuṣṭo bhavati |
jetavyatvena prajāpatinā nihitaṃ ṛkpasahavaṃ^ śīghragamanayuko rāsabho jigāya jayenālabhata |
anyebhya:^ devebhya: pūrvamevājiṃ prāpya yuvāṃ jayaṃ prāpayāmāsa |
tathā cāsmincarthe ‘prajāpativai somāya rājñe duhitaraṃ prāyacchat’ (ai. brā. 4. 7) ityādi kaṃ brāhmaṇamanusaṃdheyam |
tugro ha bhujyumaśvinodameghe rathi na kaścinmamuvā~ arvāhā: |
tugra: | ha | bhujyum | aśvinā | udameghe | rathim | na | ka: | cit | mamu'vān | arvā | ahā: | tam | ūhathu: | naubhi: | ātman'vatībhi: | antarikṣaprudbhi: | apa'udakābhi: || 3 ||
1. ṭha-sa-anabhitam | 2 kṣa-ṭa-ṭha-ṛcāṃ sahasram | 3. kṣa-ṭa-ṭha-anyebhyo'pi | 4. kṣa-ṭa-ṭha- balavatpatanti utpatantīti | 5. kṣa-ṭa-ṭha-sa-‘tai:’ nāsti | 6. kṣa-ṭa-ṭha-pata gaitā | hi gatau | ī. 90
sa ca dvīpāntaravartibhiḥ śatru- bhiratyantamupadrutaḥ san teṣāṃ jayāya svaputraṃ bhujyuṃ senayā saha nāvā prāhaiṣīt |
sā ca nauḥ madhyesamudra- matidūraṃ gatā vāyuvaśena bhinnā āsīt |
tadānīṃ saḥ bhujyuḥ śīghram aśvinau tuṣṭāva |
tau ca stutau senayā sahitam ātmīyāsu nauṣu āropya pitustamasya samīpaṃ tribhirahorātraiḥ prāyāmāsaturiti |
tumraḥ khalu pūrvaṃ śatrubhiḥ pīḍitaḥ san tajayārtham udameghe |
udakairmihyate sicyate iti udameghaḥ samudraḥ tasmin bhujyum etatsaṃjñaṃ priyaṃ putram avāhāḥ |
maghavān śriyamāṇaḥ san dhanalobhī kaścit manuṣyaḥ rayiṃ na yathā dhanaṃ parityajati tadvat |
he aśvinau taṃ ca bhujyuṃ madhyesamudraṃ nimagnaṃ naubhiḥ pitṛ- samīram ūthuḥ yuvāṃ prāpitavantau |
antarikṣapṛbhiḥ atisvacchatvādantarikṣe jalasya upariṣṭādeva gantrībhiḥ apodakābhiḥ suśliṣṭatvāt apagatodakābhiḥ apraviṣṭodakābhirityarthaḥ ||

udameghe | miha secane | karmaṇi ghañ | nyaṅkādīnāṃ ca (pā. sū. 7. 3. 53) iti kutvam | udakasyodaḥ saṃjñāyām (pā. sū. 6. 3. 50) | thāthādinā uttarapadāntodāttatvam | magha- vān | mṛ prāṇatyāge | liṭaḥ kasuḥ | kādiniyamāt prāptasya iṭaḥ vasvekājād‌sām iti niyamāt abhāvaḥ | ahāḥ | ohāk tyāge | luṅi tipi caleḥ sic | āgamaśāsanasyānityatvāt majiṭo na kriyate | bahulaṃ chandasi iti iḍabhāvaḥ | hrasvatvādyaḥ iti tilopaḥ | svaravisargau | yadvā | mantre ghasa iti clerluk | clerluksattvāt iṇ na kriyate | naubhiḥ | sāvekācaḥ iti vibhakterudāttatvam | ātmanvatībhiḥ | ātmano matup | mādupadhāyāḥ iti vatvam | ano nud (pā. sū. 8. 2. 16) iti nud | nalopaḥ | hrasvanḍbhyāṃ matup iti matupa udāttatvam | anta- rikṣapṛbhiḥ | mṛ gatau | kip ca iti kip ||
samudrasya dhanvan‌ārdrasya pāre tribhī rathaiḥ śatapadbhiḥ palakṣaiḥ ||
tisraḥ | kṣapaḥ | triḥ | ahā | ativrajat'bhiḥ | nāsatyā | bhujyum | ūhatuḥ | patatraiḥ | samudrasya | dhanvan | ārdrasya | pāre | tribhī | rathaiḥ | śatapadbhiḥ | ṣaṭ'aśvaiḥ || 4 ||

he nāsatyau senayā saha udake nimagnaṃ bhujyuṃ tisraḥ kṣapaḥ trisaṃkhyākā rātrīḥ triha trivāramāvṛttānyahāni ca ativrajadbhiḥ atikramya gacchadbhiretāvantaṃ kālamativyāpya vartamānāḥ patatraiḥ patadbhiḥ tribhiḥ trisaṃkhyākaiḥ rathaiḥ ūhatuḥ yuvāmūḍhavantau |
samudrasya ambu- rāśaumadhye dhanvan dhanvani jalavarjite pradeśe ārdrasya udakenādrībhūtasya samudrasya pāre tīradeśe ca |
aci ra ṛtaḥ iti rephā- deśe udāttayaṇo halpūrvāt iti vibhakterudāttatvam |
1. sa-ha khalu | 2. kṣa-ṭa-ṭha-dhanalobhāt | 3. kṣa-ṭa-ṭha-upariṣṭhāt | 4. kṣa-ṭa-apagata- jalābhiḥ | 5. kṣa-ṭa-ṭha-kālamabhivyāpya | 6. kṣa-ṭa-ṭha-nsa-tathā ārdrasya |

yadvā| śasi ‘ātaḥ’ iti yogavibhāgādātopi ākāralopaḥ| ahā| ‘śecchandasi bahulam’ iti śelopaḥ| patatraiḥ| ‘pattṛ gatau’| ‘paterañcu’ (u. sū. 1. 116)| dhanvan| ‘dhavi-gairyarathaḥ’| idiṣṭatvāt num| ‘kaninyuvṛṣi’ ityādinā kanina| ‘supāṃ suluk’ iti saptamyā luk| śatapadbhiḥ| śataṃ pādā yeṣām| ‘saṃkhyāsupūrvasya’ iti pādaśabdasyānyalopaḥ samāsāntaḥ| ayamasyādisvena bhatvāt ‘pādaḥ pat’ iti padyāvaḥ| yadvā| pādasamānārthaḥ| pacchabdaḥ prakṛtyantaraṃ draṣṭavyam||
anārambhaṇe| tat| abīrayethām| anāsthāne| agrabhaṇe| samudre| yat| aśvinau| ūhathuḥ| bhujyum| astam| śata'aritrām| nāvam| ātasthi'vāṃsam||5||

he aśvinau anārambhaṇe ālambanarahite samudre tat karma abīrayethām| vikrāntaṃ kṛtavantau yuvām| anārambhaṇatvameva spaṣṭīkaroti| anāsthāne| āsthīyate asmin iti āsthāno bhūpradeśaḥ| tadahite sthātumaśakye jale ityarthaḥ| agrabhaṇe agrahaṇe| hastena grāhyaṃ śākhādikamapi yatra nāsti tasmin ityarthaḥ| kiṃ punastatkarma| bhujyuṃ samudre mamaṃ śatāritrāṃ bahuritrāṃ nāvam| yaiḥ kāṣṭhaiḥ pārśvato bahurjala-loḍane sati nauḥ śīghraṃ gacchati tāni aritrāṇi| īdṛśīṃ nāvam ātasthivāṃsam āsthitavantamārūḍha-vantaṃ kṛtvā astam| gṛhaṇamaitat| pitustṛptasya gṛhaṃ prati yat ūhathuḥ| tatprāpagamanayairduḥśakaṃ yuvāṃ samudramadhye kṛtavantādityarthaḥ| anārambhaṇe| ārabhyate ityārambhaṇam| ‘kṛtyalyuṭo bahulam’ iti karmaṇi lyuṭ| ‘nañsubhyām’ ityuttarapadāntodāttatvam| abīrayethām| ‘śūra vīra vikrāntau’| curādirātmanepadī| anāsthānāgrabhaṇayoḥ pūrvavat lyuṭsvarau| arthaṃ tu viśeṣaḥ| hmahomaiḥ iti bhavam| astam| asyate asmin sarvamistyastaṃ gṛham| ‘asihasi’ ityādinā tanpratyayaḥ| śatāritrām| ‘ṛ gatau’| ‘artilūtrasū’ (pā. sū. 3. 2. 184) iti karaṇe inapratyayaḥ| bahuvrīhau pūrvapada-prakṛtisvaratvam|| || 8 ||
tadvau dātraṃ mahi kīrtenyaṃ bhūtapaido vājī sadamiddhavyo aryaḥ||
yam| aśvinā| dadathuḥ| śvetam| aśvam| agha'aśāya| śaśvat| itaḥ| svasti| tat| vām| dātram| mahi| kīrtenyam| bhūta| paidaḥ| vājī| sadam| it| havyaḥ| aryaḥ||6||

<sup>v</sup>yena' rathena <sup>v</sup>sukṛtaḥ śobhanaṃ yāgaṃ kurvato yajamānasya <sup>v</sup>duroṇaṃ devayajanalakṣaṇaṃ gṛhaṃ <sup>v</sup>gacchathaḥ |
he <sup>v</sup>narā netārā- vaśvinau <sup>v</sup>tena rathena <sup>v</sup>asmabhyam asmākaṃ <sup>v</sup>vatiḥ vartanādhikaraṇaṃ gṛhaṃ <sup>v</sup>yātam āgacchatam ||
minantā dasyoraśivasya māyā anupūrvaṃ vṛṣaṇā codayantā ||
ṛṣim | narau | ahaṃsaḥ | pāñca'janyam | ṛbīsāt | atrim | muñcathaḥ | guṇena | minantā | dasyoḥ | aśivasya | māyāḥ | anu'pūrvam | vṛṣaṇā | codayantā || 3 ||
he <sup>v</sup>narau netārī <sup>v</sup>vṛṣaṇā kāmānāṃ varṣi- tārau aśvinau <sup>v</sup>pāñcajanyam |
svarbhānunā gṛhīta- mamuṃ sūrya mocayantau atriḥ sarveṣāṃ hitācaraṇāt tatrabhavaḥ ityucyate |
tādṛśam <sup>v</sup>ṛṣim <sup>v</sup>aṃhasaḥ pāparūpāt <sup>v</sup>ṛbīsāt śatadvāre yantragṛhe atreḥ pīḍārtham asuraiḥ prakṣiptaṃ tuṣāmeḥ sakāśāt <sup>v</sup>guṇena indriyavargeṇa
minantā śatrūn hiṃsantau dasyoḥ upakṣapayituḥ aśivasya duḥkhakāriṇaḥ asurasya sambandhinīḥ tasmin agnau prayuktāḥ māyāḥ ca anu- pūrvam ānupūrvyeṇa codayantā prerayantau nivārayantau |
aśvaṃ na gūḻahamaśvinā durevairrṣi narā vṛṣaṇā rebhampsu |
saṃ taṃ riṇītho viprutaṃ daṃsobhirna vāṃ jūryanti pūryā kṛtāni ||
aśvam | na | gūḻaham | aśvinā | duḥevaiḥ | ṛṣim | narā | vṛṣaṇā | rebham | apsu | sam | tam | riṇīthaḥ | vi'prutam | daṃsobhiḥ | na | vām | jūryanti | pūryā | kṛtāni || 4 ||

narā netārau vṛṣaṇā kāmānāṃ varṣakau he aśvinau durevaiḥ duṣṭāpairasuraiḥ apsu kūpastheṣūdakeṣu gūḻahaṃ nigūḍhaṃ nikhātaṃ rebham ṛṣiṃ kūpādujjhīya vimutaṃ viśiṣṭāvayavaṃ tam aśvaṃ na vyādhitamaśvamiva daṃsobhiḥ ātmīyaiḥ bheṣajyarūpaiḥ karmabhiḥ saṃ riṇīthaḥ samadhattam |
vāṃ yuvayoḥ sambandhiāni pūryā ciraṃtanāni kṛtāni karmāṇi na jūryanti na hi jīrṇāni bhavanti |
suṣupvāṃsaṃ na nikṛterupasthe sūryaṃ na dastrā tamasi kṣiyantam |
śubhe rukmaṃ na darśataṃ nikhātamudapūthuraśvinā vandanāya ||
suṣupvāṃsam | na | niḥ'ṛteḥ | upa'sthe | sūryam | na | dastrā | tamasi | kṣiyantam | śubhe | rukmam | na | darśatama | ni'khātam | ut | ūpathuḥ | aśvinau | vandanāya || 5 ||
nikṛteḥ pṛthivyāḥ upasthe utsaṅge suṣupvāṃsaṃ suptavantaṃ puruṣamiva kūpamadhye śayānaṃ sūryaṃ na sūryamiva tamasi kūpāntargatāndhakāre kṣiyantaṃ nivasantaṃ sūryamiva teja- svinamityarthaḥ |

śubhe śobhārthaṃ nirmitaṃ rukmaṃ na rocamānaṃ suvarṇamayābharaṇamiva darśataṃ darśanīyam evaṃ guṇaviśiṣṭaṃ kūpe asuraiḥ nikhātaṃ vandanāya vandanamarpi he dastrā darśanīyavāśvinau yuvām udapūthaḥ uddhṛtavantau |

1. kṣa-ṭa-ṭha-putrapautrādigaṇena | 2. ca-cha-ṇa-da-dha-la-ānupūrvyeṇa anukrameṇa | 3. kṣa-ṭa-ṭha- ‘hi’ nāsti | 4. kṣa-ṭa-ṭha-sa-divāditvāt | 5. kṣa-ṭa-ṭha-kūpāntargate andhakāre | 6. kṣa-ṭa-ṭha-sūryavat taijasvinaṃ sthitamityarthaḥ | 7. kṣa-sa-śobhanārtham | ka. 12
tad vāṃ narā śastyaṃ pajriyeṇa kukṣīvatā nāsatyā pariṃjaman |
śaphādaśvasya vājino janāya śataṃ kumbhā~ asiñcataṃ madhūnām ||
tat | vām | narā | śastyam | pajriyeṇa | kukṣīvatā | nāsatyā | pari'jaman | śaphāt | aśvasya | vājinaḥ | janāya | śatam | kumbhān | asiñcatam | madhūnām || 6 ||

he narā netārī nāsatyāvaśvinau pariṃjaman parigamane abhīṣṭasya prāpaṇe nimittabhūte sati pajriyeṇa pajrāṇām aṅgirasāṃ kule jātena kukṣīvatā mayā vāṃ yuvayoḥ saṃbandhva tat karma śastyam prakarveṇa śaṃsanīyam |
yat janāya apekṣamāṇāya puruṣāya vājinaḥ vegavataḥ nadīyasya aśvasya śaphāt nirgataiḥ madhūnāṃ madhubhiḥ śatasaṃkhyākān kumbhān asiñcatam aruyatam |
yuvaṃ narā stuvate kṛṣṇiryāya viṣvāpṃ dadathurviśvakāya |
ghoṣāyai cit pitṛṣade duroṇe patiṃ jūryantyā aśvināvadattam ||
yuvam | narā | stuvate | kṛṣṇiryāya | viṣvāpm | dadathuḥ | viśvakāya | ghoṣāyai | cit | pitṛ'sade | duroṇe | patim | jūryantyā | aśvinau | adattam || 7 ||
he narā netārī aśvinau yuvam yuvāṃ stuvate stotraṃ kurvate kṛṣṇiryāya kṛṣṇākhyasya putrāya viśvakāya viṣvāpm dadathuḥ |
sā kṛṣṇi satī kasmaicidvarāya adattā pitṛgṛhe niṣaṇṇā jīrṇā āsīt |
sā aśvinoranugrahāt naṣṭakuṣṭhā satī patiṃ lebhe |

he aśvinau pitrā saṃbandhe duroṇe svakīyajanakagṛhe kuṣṭharogeṇa bhartāramaprāpya pitṛṣade pitṛsamīpe niṣaṇṇāyai jūryantyai jarāṃ prāpuvatyai ghoṣāyai cit etatsaṃjjñāyai brahmavādinyai api rogopaśamanena patiṃ bhartāram adattaṃ yuvāṃ dattavantau ||
1. kṣa-ṭa-ṭha-sa-śaphāt khurāt | 2. kṣa-ṭa-ṭha-praśastyam | 3. kṣa-ṭa-ṭha-na-sa- ' viṣvāpṃ dadathuḥ ' nāsti | 4. sa-dadathuḥ dattavantau | 5. kṣa-ṭa-ṭha-sa-viśaraṇagatyasādanadeṣu |

yuvaṃ iyāvāya ruśatīmadattaṃ mahaḥ kṣoṇasyāśvinā kaṇvaya | pravācyaṃ tadvṛṣaṇā kṛtaṃ vāṃ yanārṣadāya śravo abhyadhattam || 8 || yuvam | iyāvāya | ruśatīm | adattam | mahaḥ | kṣoṇasya | aśvina | kaṇvaya | pra'vācyam | tat | vṛṣaṇā | kṛtam | vām | yat | nārṣadāya | śravaḥ | adhi'adhattam ||8||
he aśvinau 'yuvaṃ yuvāṃ 'iyāvāya kuṣṭharogeṇa śyāmavarṇāya ṛṣaye 'ruśatīṃ dīptavat śriyam' 'adattam prāyacchatam |
api ca 'kṣoṇasya kṣoṇāya yaḥ 'dadhirāhityena gantumaśaktaḥ 'san 'ekasminneva sthāne nivasati 'tasmai 'kaṇvāya ṛṣaye 'mahaḥ tejaḥ taijasaṃ cakṣurindriyam adattamiti śeṣaḥ |
tathā he 'vṛṣaṇā kāmānāṃ varṣitārau 'vāṃ yuvayoḥ 'tat 'kṛtaṃ karma 'pravācyaṃ prakarṣeṇa vācanīyaṃ śaṃsanīyam |
'nārṣadāya nṛpadaḥ putrāya badhiraya ṛṣaye 'śravaḥ śravaṇendriyaṃ 'yat 'adhyadhattaṃ dattavantaḥ sthaḥ iti yat tadityarthaḥ |
brāhmaṇasya parīkṣārthamasurāḥ kaṇvamṛṣiṃ gūḍhe tamasi nidadhuḥ |
atraiva sthitaḥ san 'vyuṣṭāmupasaṃ vijānīhi yadi tvaṃ brāhmaṇo'sīti |
'vṛṣyāṃ harmyasya upari vīṇāṃ vādayantau āvām āgamiṣyāvaḥ |
he vṛṣaṇā kāmānāṃ varṣitārāvaśvinau vāṃ yuvayoḥ 'takṛtaṃ karma pravācyaṃ praśaṃsanīyaṃ yanārṣadāya nṛpadaḥ putrāya kaṇvāya kṣoṇasya |
mahaḥ ' mahataḥ kṣoṇasya śravaḥ śabdam adhyadhattam upaso vijñānārtham adhikam akurutam ||
pakṣāntare tu mahacchabdāt ṣaṣṭhyekavacane chāndasaḥ alopaḥ |
pakṣāntare tu 'dukhu śabde' ityasmādauṇādikaḥ na pratyayaḥ |

puru varpāsyaśvinā dadhānā ni pedavaṃ ūhathurāṣṭamaśvam | sahasrāṃ vājinamapratītamihenaṃ śrutyaṃ tarutram || 9 || puru | varpāṃsi | aśvina | dadhānā | ni | pedave | ūhathuḥ | āśum | aśvam | sahasra'sām | vājinam | apratītam | ahi'hanam | śrutyam | tarutram || 9 ||
ātmīyaiḥ 'karmabhiḥ kṛtāni rūpāṇi 'dadhānā dhārayantau yuvām 'āśuṃ śīghragāminam 'aśvaṃ 'pedave pedunāmne stuvate 'ni 'ūhathuḥ nitarāṃ prāpitavantau dattavantādityarthaḥ |
'sahasrāṃ sahasrasaṃkhyākasya dhanasya sanitāraṃ dātāraṃ 'vājinaṃ balavantam ata eva 'apratītaṃ śatrubhirpratigatam 'ahihanam ahinām āgatya hantṛṇāṃ

1. ca-da-dha-pha-śriyam | 2. kṣa-ṭa-ṭhana-sa- 'yaḥ' nāsti | 3. na-gantumaśakāya | 4. na- nivasate | 5. sa-tasmai nivasate | 6. kṣa-ṭa-ṭhana- 'śaṃsanīyaṃ' nāsti 7. kṣa-ṭa-ṭhasa-brūhi. iti | 8. kṣa-ṭa-ṭha-tasya mahaḥ | 9. kṣa-ṭa-ṭha-acchabdalopaḥ |

śatrūṇāṃ śatrunvā hantāram | śravasyam | śrava: śravaṇīyam stotram | tatra bhavam | stutiviṣayamityartha: | tarutraṃ taritāram || vapāṃsi | ‘vṛṣ varaṇe’ | ‘vṛṣhībhyāṃrūpasvāñjayo: puvacca’ (u. sū. 4. 640) ityasun pugāgamaśca | dadhānā | dadhāterlaṃṭa: śānac | ‘abhyastānāmādi:’ ityādyudātta- tvam | sahasrasām | ‘paṇu dāne’ | ‘janasanakhana’ iti viṭ | ‘viḍnoranunāsikasyāt’ iti ātvam | śravasyam | śrava:śabdāt ‘bhave chandasi’ iti yat | ttisvarita: | tarutram | ‘tṛ plavana- taraṇayo:’ | ‘aśvitrādibhya inottrau’ (u. sū. 4. 612) iti utrapratyaya: | nyatyayenādyudātta- tvam | yadvā | ‘asitarambhita’ ityādau nipātanāt tunnantāt taruśabdāt amiṃ saṃjñāpūrvakasya vidhe: anityatvāt guṇābhāve yaṇ | nisvareṇādyudāttatvam ||
etāni vāṃ śravasyā sudānu brahmajuṣaṃ sadanaṃ rodasyo: |
yadvāṃ prajāsau aśvinā harvante yātamiṣā ca viduṣe ca vājam ||
etāni | vām | śravasyā | sudānu iti sudānu | brahma | ājuṣam | sadanam | rodasyo: | yat | vām | prajāsa: | aśvinā | harvante | yātam | iṣā | ca | viduṣe | ca | vājam || 10 ||
he sudānu śobhanadānau aśvinau vāṃ yuvayo: sambandhīni etāni samanantararokāni vīryāṇi śravasyā śravaṇīyāni sarvairjñātavyāni bhavanti |
tathā ca taittarīyakam— ‘ime aśvinā saṃvatsaroṃbhivaidhānara:’ (tai. saṃ. 5. 6. 4. 1) iti |
tayo: yuvayo: sadanaṃ stotusamīpe niveśanāṃ prasādanahetubhūtaṃ vā ājuṣam āghoṣaṇīyaṃ brahma mantrarūpaṃ stotraṃ niṣpannamiti śeṣa: |

yat yadā prajāsa: aṅgirastvaṃ gotrotpannā yajamānā he aśvinau vāṃ yuvāṃ harvante stutibhi: ātmarakṣaṇārtham āhvayanti tadānīm iṣā dātavyannena saha ā yātam āgacchataṃ ca viduṣe yuṣmadiṣṭayaṃ stotraṃ jānate mahyaṃ ca vājam annaṃ balaṃ vā prayacchatamiti śeṣa:||
sunormānaināśvinā gṛṇānā vājaṃ viprāya bhuraṇā radantā |
agastye brahmaṇā vāvṛdhānā saṃ viśrpalāṃ nāsatyāriṇītam ||
suno: | mānaina | aśvinau | gṛṇānā | vājam | viprāya | bhuraṇā | radantā | agastyai | brahmaṇā | vavṛdhānā | sam | viśrpalām | nāsatyā | ariṇītam || 11 ||
bhuraṇā bhatārau poṣakau nāsatyā satyasvabhāvau he aśvinau suno: kumbhāt prasūtasya agastyasya khelapurohitasya sambandhanā mānena stutyasya paricchedakena stotreṇa gṛṇānā stūyamānau viprāya

vibhāṣā ' iti drūpatiṣedhaḥ | ' janasanakhanāṃ samjhaloḥ ' iti āśvam | ' gatiranantaraḥ ' iti gateḥ prakṛtisvaratvam | ahan | ' supāṃ suluk ' iti sasyagā luk | ' na ḍisaṃbuddhayoḥ ' iti nalopapratiṣedhaḥ ||
yu॒vaṃ cya॒vāna̭ma॒śvinā॒ jara̭nta॒ṃ puna̭ryu॒rvāṇa̭ṃ ca॒krathu॒ḥ śacī̭bhiḥ |
yu॒vo rathḙ duhi॒tā sū॒rya̭sya॒ saha॒ śriyā॒ nāsa̭tyā॒vṛṇī̭ta |
yu॒vam | cya॒vāna̭m | a॒śvinā̭ | jara̭ntam | puna̭ḥ | yu॒rvāṇa̭m | ca॒krathṷḥ | śacī̭bhiḥ | yu॒voḥ | rathḙm | duhi॒tā | sū॒rya̭sya | saha̭ | śriyā̭ | nāsa̭tyā | a॒vṛṇī̭ta || 13 ||
he aśvinau 1 yuvaṃ yuvāṃ 2 śacībhiḥ ātmīyaiḥ bheṣajallakṣaṇaiḥ karmabhiḥ 3 jarantaṃ jīryantaṃ 4 cyavānaṃ stutīnāṃ cyāvayitāram etatsaṃjaṃ 5 ṛṣiṃ 6 yuvānaṃ punaryuvatvopetaṃ 7 cakrathuḥ kṛtavantau |
api ca he nāsatyau aśvinau 8 yuvoḥ yuvayoḥ 9 rathaṃ 10 sūryasya 11 duhitā sūryākhyā 12 śriyā 13 saha ṛksahasrarūpāyā 2 saṃpadā kāntyā vā saha 14 avṛṇīta samabhajata āgatyārūḍhavatītyarthaḥ |
' ā vāṃ rathaṃ duhitā ' ( ṛ. saṃ. 1. 116. 17 ) ityatra likhitamākhyānam atrāpi draṣṭavyam |
yuṣmacchabdāt ṣaṣṭhīdvivacane vyatyayena ' yo'ci ' iti yavābhāve sati ' śeṣe lopaḥ ' iti dakāralopaḥ |
yu॒vam | tu॒grāya̭ | pu॒rvyebhi̭ḥ | a॒rvaiḥ | puna̭ḥ | ma॒nyau | a॒bhava̭tam | yu॒vānā̭ | yu॒vam | bhu॒jyum | arṇa̭saḥ | niḥ | sa̭mu॒drāt | vi'da̭bhiḥ | ṷ̄hathuḥ | ṛ॒jebhi̭ḥ | a॒śvaiḥ || 14 ||
he 5 yuvānā duḥkhānāṃ yāvayitārau aśvinau 6 yuvaṃ yuvāṃ 7 pūrvyebhiḥ |

pūrvakālīnaiḥ ciraṃtanaiḥ 8 evaiḥ stutyaṃ prati gantṛbhiḥ stotraiḥ 9 tugrāya bhujyurjanakasya saṃndhibhiḥ 10 punarmanyau yathā bhujyoḥ samudragamanātpūrva yuvāṃ stotavyau tathā punarapi idānīṃ stotavyau 11 abhavatam |

yadā yuvāṃ samudra- madhye senayā saha nimagnaṃ 12 bhujyuṃ tugrasya putram 13 arṇasaḥ arṇasvataḥ prauḍhodakayuktāt 14 samudrāt amburāśeḥ sakāśāt 15 vibhiḥ gantṛbhiḥ naubhiḥ 16 ṛjebhiḥ śīghragatiyuktaiḥ 17 aśvaiḥ ca 18 niruhathuḥ nirgamayya pitṛsamīpaṃ prāpitavantau tadānīṃ punarapyatiśayena stotavyau jātāvityarthaḥ |
' tumro ha bhujyum ' ( ṛ. saṃ. 1. 116. 3 ) ityatroktamākhyānam atrāpyanusaṃdheyam |
‘sarve vidhayaśchandasi vikalpyante’ iti vibhaktyudāttasya vikalpanāt abhāvaḥ |

ajauhavīdaśvinā taugyo vāṃ proḻahaḥ samudramavyathirjanvān | nirūhathuḥ suyujā rathena manojavasā vṛṣaṇā svasti || 15 || ajauhavīt | aśvinā | taugyaḥ | vām | pra'ūḻahaḥ | samudram | avyathiḥ | jagnvān | niḥ | tam | ūhathuḥ | suyujā | rathena | manaḥ'javasā | vṛṣaṇā | svasti || 15 ||
he aśvinau ᵥvāṃ yuvāṃ ᵥtaugyaḥ tugraputraḥ ᵥproḻahaḥ pitrā prāptaḥ ᵥsamudram aṃdhīva ᵥjagnvān bhujyuḥᵡ udake nimagno'pi ᵥavyathiḥ vyathāṃ pīḍām aprāpta eva san ᵥajauhavīt stutibhirāhayat |
ᵥtam āhvātāraṃ he ᵥmanojavasā manovad‌vegayuktau ᵥvṛṣaṇā kāmābhivarṣakāvaśvinau ᵥsuyujā suṣṭhuyuktenaᵌ ᵥrathena ᵥsvasti kṣemaṃ yathā bhavati tathā ᵥnirūhathuḥ |
manaso java iva javo yayoḥ tau tathoktau |

ajauhavīdaśvinā vartikā vāmāsano yatsīmamuṃśvataṃ vṛkasya | vi jyuṣā yayathuḥ sānvadrairjātaṃ viṣvācau ahaṃtaṃ viṣeṇaṃ || 16 || ajauhavīt | aśvinā | vartikā | vām | āsanaḥ | yat | sīm | amuṃśvatam | vṛkasya | vi | jyuṣā | yayathuḥ | sānu | adraiḥ | jātam | viṣvācaḥ | ahaṃtam | viṣeṇam || 16 ||
‘āsano vṛkasya’ (ṛ. saṃ. 1. 116. 14) ityarthaṃ yaduktaṃ tadatra pūrvārdhena pratipādyate |
ᵥvartikā caṭakasadṛśasya pakṣiṇaḥ strī vṛkeṇa araṇyaśunā grastā satī he aśvinī ᵥvāṃ yuvāṃ tadā ᵥajauharvāt āhūtavatī ᵥyatsīṃ yadā khalu ᵥvṛkasya ᵥāstaḥ āsyāt ᵥamuṃśvataṃ vartikāṃ amocayatam |

api ca yuvāṃ ᵥjyuṣā jayaśīlena rathena ᵥadreḥ parvatasya ᵥsānu samucchritapradeśaṃ ᵥvi ᵥyayathuḥ śatrubhirveṣṭitaṃ jāhuṣākhyaṃ stotāraṃ śatrusamūhāgniṃmasya tena saha anyairgantumaśakyaṃ parvatāgraṃ gantavantaḥ- vityarthaḥ |
tathā ᵥviṣvācaḥ vividhagatiyuktasya etatsaṃjñasya asurasya ᵥjātam utpannamapatyaṃ ᵥviṣeṇa kṣavedenaᵐ ᵥahaṃtaṃ yuvāṃ hatavantau |
1. kṣa-ṭa-ṭha-sa-jagnvān gatavān | 2. kṣa-ṭa-ṭha- ‘bhujyuḥ’ nāsti | 3. ca-cha-ṇa-pha-suṣṭhu śobhanaiḥ adhyuktena | 4. sa-jalena |
tena grastā satī sā he aśvinau yuvām ajohavīt āhvayata |

'vā chandasi' iti ami pūrvasya vikalpanādabhāve yaṇādeśaḥ |

ᵥsaḥ ca ᵥvāṃ yuvābhyāṃ pravargyavidyāṃ madhuvidyāṃ ca vakṣyāmīti purā kṛtāṃ pratijñām ᵥṛtāyan satyāmātmānamicchan ᵥmadhu madhuvidyāṃ ᵥtvāṣṭraṃ tvaṣṭrindrāllabdhaṃ ᵥpra ᵥvocat proktavān |

vṛṣaṇā kāmānāṃ varṣitārau he aśvinau yuva yuvāṃ bhuramāṇaṃ vibhiḥ aśvaiḥ niyamāṇaṃ gataṃ samudre nimagnaṃ bhujyuṃ tumaputraṃ svayuktibhiḥ svayameva yujyamānaiḥ aśvaiḥ nauviśeṣaiḥ nivahantā nitarāṃ vahantau pitṛbhya ā |

he aśvinau yuvaṃ yuvāṃ rebham ṛṣiṃ parivṛte: paritaḥ prerakādupadravāt kūpapatanādvā uruvyathaḥ rakṣataḥ |
tathā agnaye ṛṣaye paritasaṃ paritastaptaṃ gharmam asuraiḥ pīḍārthaṃ prakṣitaṃ dīpyamānaṃ tupāmiṃ himena śītenodakena avārayethām |
haviṣā mantraye bhakṣayitre agnaye paritasaṃ sūryakiraṇaiḥ satataṃ gharmam |
api ca śayo: etatsaṃjasya ṛṣeḥ gavi nivṛttaprasavāyā dhenau avasaṃ rakṣakaṃ payaḥ yuvaṃ yuvāṃ pipyathuḥ pravardhitavantau |
tathā jīrṇāṅgaḥ vandanaḥ ṛṣiḥ dīrgheṇa āyuṣā pra tāri yuvābhyāṃ pravardhitaḥ |
he aśvinau ^parāvati dūradeśe samudramadhye ^svasya ^pituḥ tugrasya ^tyajasā tyāgena ^nivrādhitaṃ pīḍitaṃ bhujyuṃ kṛpamāṇaṃ yuvāṃ ^stuvantam ^agacchatam |

kanyeva tanvā śaśadānā eṣi devi devamiyakṣamāṇam | saṃsmayamānā yuvatiḥ purastādāvirvakṣāṃsi kṛṇuṣe vibhātī || 10 || kanyā'iva | tanvā | śaśadānā | eṣi | devi | devam | iyakṣamāṇam | sam'asaṃsmayamānā | yuvatiḥ | purastāt | āviḥ | vakṣāṃsi | kṛṇuṣe | vi'bhātī || 10 ||
tanvā śarīreṇa śaśadānā śaśādhamānā spaṣṭatāṃ prāpnuvatī |
‘kanyā kamanīyā bhavati keyaṃ netavyeti vā’ ( nigha. 4. 15 ) iti yāskaḥ |
sā yathā janāntike vivasanā saṃcarati tathā he upastvaṃ kanyā kamanīyā apragalbhā satī tanvā śarīreṇa śaśadānā spaṣṭatāṃ gacchantī dṛśyase |
paścāt pragalbhā satī he devi devanaśīle iyakṣamāṇaṃ yaṣṭumicchantaṃ abhimataṃ dātumicchantaṃ vā devaṃ dyotanasvabhāvaṃ sūryyarūpaṃ priyam eṣi gacchasi |

tataḥ paścāt yuvatiḥ yauvanopetā satī purastāt patyuḥ sūryyasya purataḥ saṃsmayamānā sam īṣat hasantī hāsyaṃ kurvatī vibhātī atyantaṃ bhāsamānā vakṣāṃsi vakṣopalakṣitānavayavān āviḥ kṛṇuṣe prakaṭīkaroṣi |
yathā loke pragalbhā yoṣit purastāt priyatamasya purataḥ saṃsmayamānā dantapradarśanāya īṣaddhasanaṃ kurvatī vakṣāṃsi vakṣopalakṣitāni gopyāna bāhumūlastanādīni āviṣkaroti tathā tvamapītyarthaḥ |
purastāt pūrvasyāṃ diśi saṃsmayamānā smitopamaprakāśaṃ kurvatī yuvatiḥ sarveṣu bhāveṣu miśraṇaśīlā vakṣāṃsi |

tāṃ tu sabhyāḥ vicārya yadīyaṃ rikthaṃ labhate cet akṣaiḥ saṃtāḍya tadīyaṃ dhanaṃ vitaranti |
tathaivamapi dhanānāṃ prīṇanasādhanānāṃ prakāśānāṃ 5sanaye lābhāya gartamākāśaṃ sūryanivāsasthānamārohati |

yathā ca loke suvāsā dukūlādiśobhanavasanā svalaṃkṛtā pūrvaṃ rajodharmasamaye malinavastrā satī snānānantaraṃ śobhanavastrābharaṇādinā śobhamānā viśeṣeṇa patiṃ bhogāya kāṃkṣantī tena saha saṃkrīḍate tathā iyam7 uṣāḥ9 atinaiśena 6 andhakāreṇāvṛta- tvāt malinavasanāpi prabhāte svatejasāvṛtatvāt suvasanā satī patisthānīyena sūryeṇa sākaṃ saṃkrīḍamānā 7hyaiva hasaneva 7apsaḥ dantasthānīyāni rūpāṇi nīlapītādīni |
yathā loke kācit ramaṇīyā yoṣit smitavyājena dantān vivṛṇute tathaivamapi sarvāṇi rūpāṇi prakāśayatītyarthaḥ |
ayaṃ mantro nirukte spaṣṭaṃ vyākhyātaḥ- ‘atrātṛkeva puṃsaḥ pitṛnetyabhimukhī saṃtānakarmaṇe piṇḍadānāya na patiṃ gartārohiṇīva dhanalābhāya dākṣiṇājī |
taṃ tatra yāputrā yāpatikā sārohati tāṃ tatrākṣairāghnanti mā rikthaṃ labhate’ iti, ‘jāyeva patye kāmayamānā suvāsā ṛtukālepūṣā hasaneva dantānvivṛṇute’ ( niru. 3. 5 ) iti ca ||
