paṇaya iva lubdhakāḥ ᐁabudhyamānāḥ yāgādīn akurvāṇā adānaśīlā asacchatravaḥ ᐂsasantu svapantu dīrghanidrā bhavantu śriyantāmityarthaḥ |
tathā ca mantrāntaraṃ- 'sasantu tyā arātayo bodhantu śūra rātayaḥ' (ṛ. saṃ. 1. 29. 4) iti |
kiṃca he ᐃmaghoni asmaddhavirbhistadvati he uṣaḥ ᐄmaghavatyaḥ havirlakṣaṇāśvavatyo yajamānebhyasteṣāmartha ᐆrevat dhanavat samṛddhimat ᐇuccha vibhāhi |
kiṃca he ᐈsūnṛte suṣṭhu manuṣyāṇāṃ netri devi ᐉjarayantī sarvaprāṇinaḥ kṣapayantī tvaṃ ᐊstotre stutikartre yajamānāya tadartha ᐋrevat dhanavat samṛddhayartham uccheti śeṣaḥ2 ||

utte vayaścidaterapaptannaraśca ye pitṛbhājau vyuṣṭau | amā sute vahasi bhūri vāmamuṣo devi dāśuṣe martyāya || 12 || ut | te | vayaḥ | cit | vasteḥ | apaptan | naraḥ | ca | ye | pitṛbhājaḥ | vi'uṣṭau | amā | sute | vahasi | bhūri | vāmam | uṣaḥ | devi | dāśuṣe | martyāya || 12 ||
vte tava vvyuṣṭau satyāṃ vvayaścit gamanavantaḥ pakṣiṇo'pi |
vvasateḥ nivāsasthānādīdādeḥ vut ūrdhvam vapasanna patanti |
kiṃca vnaraśca manuṣyāśca vpitṛbhājaḥ aśvavanto'nnārthinaḥ kṛṣi-vāṇijyādikatāraḥ svasvavyāpārārtham utunmukhā apasanna gacchanti |
tathā 2 mantrāntaraṃ- ‘paddhadīyata utpātayati pakṣiṇaḥ’ (ṛ. saṃ. 1. 48. 5) iti |
evaṃ satyāṃ he vdevi devanśīle upodecate vamā gṛhe devayajanālye vsate tiṣṭhate yajamānāya tadartham |
ameti gṛhanāma ‘amā dame’ (ni. 3. 4. 11) iti tannāmasu paṭhitavān |
amā saha hayamānenāgninā saha nivasate yajamānāya |
vmartyāya manuṣyāya vdāśuṣe havirdattavate yajamānāya vbhūri 3 vāmaṃ bahu śobhanaṃ dhanaṃ vvahasi prāpayasi 3 ||

astauduṃ stomyā brahmaṇā me'vīvṛdhadhvamuśatīruṣasaḥ | yuṣmākaṃ devīravasā sanema sahasriṇaṃ ca śatinaṃ ca vājam || 13 || astaudum | stomyāḥ | brahmaṇā | me | avīvṛdhadhvam | uśatīḥ | uṣasaḥ | yuṣmākam | devīḥ | avasā | sanema | sahasriṇam | ca | śatinam | ca | vājam || 13 ||
evaṃ sūktadvayoktarītyā 4 bahudhā stutvā tāṃ ca stutimanayā nivedayitvā svābhīṣṭaṃ prārthayate |
yato yūyaṃ tādṛśyaḥ ataḥ vme matsvabhūtena vbrahmaṇā sūktadvayagatamantrarūpeṇa stotreṇa vastaudum stutā bhavata |
kiṃca he vuṣāsaḥ upasaḥ vuśatīḥ stotṛn asmān asmatsamṛddhiṃ vā kāmayamānā yūyam vavīvṛdhadhvam asmān pravardhayata |
kiṃca he vdevīḥ devyo devanśīlāḥ vyuṣmākam vavasā yuṣmatsambandhanā rakṣaṇena vayaṃ vsahasriṇaṃ sahasrasaṃkhyākam abhīṣṭaṃ dhanaṃ vsanema labhemahi |
tathā vśatinaṃ vca vvājaṃ śatasaṃkhyākam aparimitaṃ dhanaṃ sanema |
yuṣmatkṛtena śatasahasraparimitadhanādirūparakṣaṇena vayamapi arthibhyaḥ śatasahasraparimitasya dhanasya sanitāro bhavemetyarthaḥ ||

prabhūtaṃ vāmaṃ vananīyaṃ dhanakanakādikaṃ rūpaṃ vahasi dadāmi |

‘prātā ratnam’ iti saptarcaṃ pañcamaṃ sūktaṃ kākṣīvatam |

prātā ratnaṃ prātaritvā dadhāti taṃ cikittvānpratigṛhṇā ni dhatte |
tene prajāṃ vardhayamāna āyu rāyaspoṣeṇa sacate suvīraḥ ||

dīrghatamasaḥ kakṣovānṛṣiḥ brahmacaryaṃ cariyanva vedābhyāsāya gurukule cirakālamuṣitvā vedān samyagadhītya vratāni ca caritvā tenānujñātaḥ punaḥ svagṛhaṃ prati prayāsyan madhye mārge rātrau viśrāntaḥ |
prabhāte bhāvavyasya putraḥ svanayo nāma rājā anucaraiḥ saṃkrīḍamānaḥ akasmāt kakṣovataḥ antikamāsāda |
taṃ ca rājā pāṇi gṛhītvā svakīye āsane upaveśya asya saundaryamavagatya svakanyāpradānamanāḥ papraccha bhagavan kasya putraḥ kiṃnāmā tvamiti |
sa ca pṛṣṭo mātaraṃ pitaraṃ ca svavṛttāntaṃ ca ācacakṣe |

sa ca rājā saṃbhāgyaḥ ityavagatya mudita- manāḥ svagṛhaṃ prāpya asmai madhuparkamāracayya vastramālyādibhiḥ pūjayitvā sarathā daśa kanyāḥ śata- niṣkāndaśatāṃ puṃgavānāṃ śataṃ gavāṃ paṣṭyuttarasahasraṃ punarekādaśatāṃśca prādāt |
sa ca sarvamanukrameṇa prati- gṛhya dīrghatamaso'ntikamāgatya tasmai prādarśayat ||

yadyasau kaliṅgasyasya rājñaḥ putrastathāpi tena kaliṅgena svayaṃ vṛddhatvāt apatyotpādanāya sāmarthyamalabhamānena tadutpādanāya yācito dīrghatamā ṛṣiḥ uśigrāmikām apatyo- tpādanāya preṣitāyā rājamahilyā atijaraṭhena maharṣiṇā saha rantuṃ lajjāmanayā svasvābharaṇairalaṃkṛtya svapratinidhitvena preṣitām uśigrāmikāṃ yoṣitaṃ dāsīmityavagatya mantrapūtena jalenābhiṣicya ṛṣiputrīṃ kṛtvā tayā saha reme |
etatsarvamasmābhiḥ pūrvādhyāye ‘nāsatyābhyām’ (ṛ. saṃ. 1. 116) ityatra sūkte vistareṇa pratipāditam |
ataḥ asya kṣatriyasaṃbandhāt kakṣovāniti nāma upapannam |
dīrghatamasaḥ paramarṣeḥ utpannatvena brāhmaṇatvāt pratigraho'pi upapanna eva |
nanu anukramaṇyāṃ ‘svanayasya dānastutiḥ’ iti ‘dānatuṣṭo bhāvavyaṃ tuṣṭāva’ iti cobhayatra stotavyaṃ bhinnamevānugamyate ityucyate |
uttarasūktasya prathamāyām ṛci ‘adhikṣiyato bhāvavyasya’ iti dātṛbhāvavyasya śrūyamāṇatvāt tatprāthamyamupajīvya pṛthagupāttam |

he agne ᵥdevatrā deveṣu madhye atiśayena tvaṃ ᵥviśvasmai sarvasmai ᵥiṣudhyate havirātmana icchate indrādaye |
ᵥhavyaṃ tattaddevatāmuddiśya prasaṃ puroḍāśādikam ᵥohiṣe sarvato vahasi |
kiṃca ayamagniḥ ᵥviśvasmai ᵥsukṛte śobhanayajñakartre yajamānāya ᵥvāraṃ sarvairvarnīyaṃ kṣudādinivārakaṃ vā annādikam ᵥṛṇavati gacchati karotītyarthaḥ|
kiṃca ayam ᵥagniḥ ᵥdvārā svargyābhimatadvā- rāṇi8 vyuṇavati vivṛṇoti|
sa mānuṣe vṛjane śaṃtamo hito'miryajñeṣu jenyo na vispatiḥ priyo yajñeṣu vispatiḥ |
sa ntrāsate varuṇasya dhūrtarmaho devasya dhūrteḥ |

itaradevebhyo havyaṃ voḍhuṃ yathā prabhavati tathā nitarāṃ prāptāḥ |
viśvāyuṃ sarvatra prāṇijīvanaṃ viśvavedasaṃ sarvaprajñaṃ hotāraṃ devānāmāhvatāraṃ yajataṃ yajanīyaṃ kaviṃ sarvajñam ||
īra preraṇe, īra gatau ’ ityanyatamasya liṭi rūpam ||
kiṃca devāsaḥ devanaśīlā ṛtvijaḥ raṇvam atipravṛddhayā śabdayantam avase araya rakṣaṇāya vasuyavaḥ vasukāmāḥ santaḥ |
gīrbhiḥ stutibhiḥ raṇvaṃ raṇayantaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ vā vasuyavaḥ vasu havīrūpamajñam apraye pradātumātmana icchanto nyairire |
prīto yathā dhanaṃ prayacchati tathā havirādinā prāptā ityarthaḥ ||
‘ yaṃ tvaṃ ratham ’ ityekādaśacaṃ tṛtīyaṃ sūktam |
‘ prapā vo asme ’ ityādike dve atiśakyau pañcākṣaropetatvāt |
‘ pāhi naḥ ’ iti anyā aṣṭiḥ catuḥpañcākṣaropetatvāt |
tathā cānukramaṇikā- ‘ yaṃ tvamekādaśa pañcyaindavī prapāvo'tiśakyāvaṣṭirityasyā ’ iti |
daśarātrasya ṣaṣṭhe'hani mahasvatīye śakhe etasūktaṃ ‘ padyasya ’ iti khaṇḍe sūtritaṃ- ‘ yaṃ tvaṃ rathamindra sa yo mṛṣā ’ ( āśva. śrau. 8. 1 ) iti ||
yaṃ tvaṃ rathamindra medhasātaye'pākā santamiśira praṇayasi prānavadya nayasi |
sākṣākamanavadya tutujāna vedhasāmāṃ vācaṃ na vedhasām ||

he indra iṣira yajñamanaśīla tvaṃ medhasātaye yajñasya dānāya lābhāya vā yaṃ yajamānaṃ prati rathaṃ praṇayasi prāpayasi ||
he indra saḥ vakṣyamāṇaguṇaviśiṣṭastvaṃ śrudhi asmadāhvānaṃ stotraṃ vā śṛṇu |
yaḥ sma yaḥ khalu tvaṃ nṛbhiḥ manuṣyaireva sañjiḥ paścādevamapyairmarudbhiḥ |
indrasya marutāṃ sahāyyam ‘indro marudbhiḥ ’ (tai. saṃ. 6. 5. 5. 1), ‘maruto hainaṃ nājahuḥ ’ (ai. brā. 3. 20 ) ityādiṣu prasiddham |
taiḥ sahitaḥ san ‘kāsu cit pṛtanāsu sarvāsu prauḍheṣvāpi saṃgrāmeṣu bharahataye bharaṇaviśiṣṭāddānayuktāya pratartye prakṛṣṭahiṃsanāya |
bharahataye ‘śuro bhava prahara ’ ityevamādibharaṇayuktāhānāya pratartye ca śūrāṇāṃ prakṛṣṭavadhāya ca |
nṛbhiḥ netṛbhiryajamānaiḥ prārthitaḥ san pratartye śatrūṇāṃ pāpānāṃ vā prakṛṣṭahiṃsanāya dakṣāyyaḥ asi samartho'si |
kiṃca yaḥ tvaṃ śūraiḥ śauryopetairmarudbhiḥ anyairmatairvā sahitaḥ san svaḥ svayameva sanitā saṃgrāmamayasya 2 anyasya vā manīṣitasya saṃbhaktāsi |
satyapi teṣāṃ sāhāyye anyanairapekṣyeṇaiva tarutā asi ityarthaḥ |
yaḥ ca tvaṃ vipraiḥ medhāvibhirmarudbhiḥ stutaḥ san vājaṃ tarutā tebhyo'jñasya dātāsi |
taṃ tādṛśaṃ vājinaṃ gamanavantaṃ pṛkṣaṃ havilakṣaṇānnavantaminadram īśānāsaḥ samyagabhyarthayituṃ samarthā ṛtvijaḥ iradhanta saṃrādhanti 3 sevante |
vājinaṃ vejanavantaṃ gamanavantaṃ pṛkṣaṃ ghāsādyannavantam arya na aśvamiva |
taṃ yathā samarthāḥ svādughāsapradānādinā poṣayanti tadvat |
arya ityadhanāma ‘aryaḥ hayaḥ ’ (ni. 1. 14. 1 ) iti tannāmasu paṭhitatvāt |
dasmo hi ṣmā vṛṣaṇaṃ pivrvāsi tvacaṃ kaṃ cidyāvīraraiṃ śūra martyaṃ parivṛṇakṣi martyam |
mitrāya vocaṃ varuṇāya saprathaḥ sumḻīkāya saprathaḥ |

tathā asmaddhisakān śatrūnapi punaḥ 'na 'vakṣati na vahati ||

ārāt saṃnihināt iha lokāt pāhi pālaya |
dūrāt ayāgakāle svarge eva uṣitvā asmān pāhi pālaya3 |
sadā sarvakālaṃ5 yāgakāle6 ayāgakāle dūre'ntike ca abhiṣṭibhiḥ abhita eṣaṇaiḥ pāhi samyak paripālaya ||
tvaṃ ne indra rāyā tarṷpasograṃ ci̭ccvā mahimā sa̭kṣadavase ma॒he mi॒traṃ nā̭rvase |

antyā 'sa no navyebhi: ' ityeṣā triṣṭup śiṣṭā atyaṣṭaya: |
atra triṣṭubantaparibhāṣā nāśrīyate 'sarvamādhyam' iti viśeṣeṇa pratijñā- tatvāt |

'mahāvratasya pañcaviṃśatim' iti khaṇḍe śaunakena sūtritam- 'endra yāhyupa na: parāvata indrāya hi dyauramuro anajhata' ( ai. ā. 5. 1. 1 ) iti |
endraṃ yāhyupa naḥ parāvato nāyamacchā vidathānīva satpatirastaṃ rājeva satpatiḥ |
havāmahe tvā vayaṃ paryasvantaḥ sute sacā |

kośena siktaṃ kośa- sthānīyena daśāpavitreṇa śodhitam |

yathā adhyannaṃ tṛṣito vaṃsago vananīyagamana: śīghragāmī puruṣa: āhāvādikamāgatya pibati tadvat |
vrajaṃ yathā tamasuraṃ jitvā dvāram udghāvya labdhavān tadvat somaṃ 'siṣāsan saṃbhaktumicchan ||

tathā kṛtvā 'ipaḥ ipyamāṇāni vrīhyādyannāni 'parīvṛtāḥ bhūmau parito vyāsānyakarot|
vajreṇa meghaṃ bhittvā jalavarṣeṇa sasyādisamṛddhiṃ kṛtvā vrīhyādikaṃ bhūmau vyāsamakarodityarthaḥ|
yataḥ ayamevaṃ kṛtavān ataḥ somasvīkāro yuktaḥ ||
dādṛhāṇo vajramindro garbhastyoḥ kṣaveva tigmamarsenāy saṃ iyadahihatyāy saṃ iyat |
tathaiva vṛkṣaṃ vaninī ni vṛścasi paraśveva ni vṛścasi ||

yathā paraśunā kaścicchinatti vṛkṣaṃ tathā tvamapi utkaiścividhairbalaiḥ nitarāmasmadveṣiṇaṃ vṛścasi ||
tvaṃ vṛthā nṛdya indra sartave'cchā samudramaṃsṛjo rathauiva vājayato rathauiva |

kiṃca he indra te tava ardhaśataśatrusenājarūpaṃ mahadapi tat iti su manāyati astyalamidamiti suṣṭhu manyate ||

parucchedaḥ sarvo loko vā manāyati suṣṭhu saṃbhāvayati stītītyarthaḥ |

aśrum iti mahannāma, ‘ambhraṇaḥ māhinaḥ’ (ni. 3. 3. 16) iti tatra pāṭhāt |
na kevalaṃ tamekaṃ kintu sarva rakṣaḥ rakṣaṇa- nimittabhūtaṃ rākṣasādikaṃ ni barhaya niṣūdaya |

‘ṣaṣṭhasya ’ iti khaṇḍe sūtritam- ‘avarmaha indra vṛṣandindra ’ (āśva. śrau. 8. 1) iti |
avarmaha indra dādṛhi śrudhī naḥ śuśoca hi dyauḥ kṣā na bhīṣāṃ adrivo ghṛṇāt bhīṣāṃ adrivaḥ |
apūruṣaghno apratīta śūra satvabhistramaiḥ śūra satvabhiḥ |

‘mo rāji samaḥ kṣau’ iti samo makārasya makāraḥ |

etayoḥ ahorātrābhimānidevatvāt ahorātradvārā vṛṣṭyutpādakatvāt ‘ahorātre vai mitrāvaruṇāvahorātrābhyāṃ khalu vai parjanyo varṣati’ ( tai. saṃ. 2. 1. 7. 3 ) iti śrutervṛṣṭyanujñāpradatvaṃ prasiddham |
kiṃca etau yajñeyajñe sarveṣvapi yajñeṣu upastutā sarvairṛtvigbhiḥ stūyamānau |
saṃjñā- pūrvakasya vidheraniyatatvāt ‘osi ca’ ( pā. sū. 7. 3. 104 ) iti guṇābhāve ‘ato guṇe’ iti pararūpatvam |

kiṃca tayoḥ devatvaṃ nū cit devabhāvo'pi na ādhṛṣe ādharṣaṇāyogyaḥ |
‘nū ciditi nipātaḥ purāṇanavyoḥ’ ( niru. 4. 17 ) iti yāskenoktatvāt |

adarśi gāturave varīyasī panthā ṛtasya samayaṃta raśmibhiścakṣurbhargasya raśmibhiḥ | dyukṣaṃ mitrasya sārdanamaryamṇo varuṇasya ca | arthā dadhāte bṛhadukthyaṃ 1 varye upastutyai bṛhadaryaḥ || 2 || adarśi | gātuḥ | uravai | varīyasī | panthāḥ | ṛtasya | sam | ayaṃta | raśmibhiḥ | cakṣuḥ | bhargasya | raśmibhiḥ || dyukṣam | mitrasya | sadanam | aryamṇaḥ | varuṇasya | ca | artha | dadhāte iti | bṛhat | ukthyam | varyaḥ | upastutyam | bṛhat | varyaḥ || 2 ||
vgātuḥ gamanaśīlā vvarīyasī urutarā 1 uṣāḥ vurave vistīrṇāya yāgāya gamanādivyāpārāya2 vadarśi sarvairdṛṣṭā abhūt |
tathā vṛtasya gamanaśīlasyādityasya vpanthāḥ mārgaḥ ākāśalakṣaṇaḥ vraśmibhiḥ vsamayaṃta prakāśaiḥ saṃgato'bhūt |
vbhargasya sarvabhajanīyasya etannāmakasya devasya vraśmibhiḥ vcakṣuḥ sarvaprāṇināṃ locanaṃ samayaṃta saṃgatambhūt |
vmitrasya prakāśakāritvāt sarvajanamitrasya vsadanaṃ gṛhamantarikṣaṃ vdyukṣaṃ dīsānāṃ nivāsasthānaṃ raśmibhiḥ samayaṃta saṃgatambhūt |
kiṃca vvaruṇasya tamonivārakasya etannāmakasya devasya sadanaṃ tathābhūta |
yadyapi sūryasya ekatve'pi upādhibhedena bhedāt pṛthak stutiḥ tathā yadyapi tribhirapi prakāśyamapyantarikṣamekaṃ tathāpi prakāśakānāṃ bhedāt tridhā stuyate |
vatha ataḥ kāraṇāt uditatvādeva vukthyaṃ stutyaṃ vbṛhat prabhūtaṃ vvayaḥ havirlakṣaṇamannaṃ vdadhāte dhārayataḥ |
vbṛhat stomādinā mahastotraṃ vvayaḥ havirlakṣaṇamannaṃ ca dadhāte ||

vai pṛthivī yāvatī vediḥ ' (tai. saṃ 2. 6. 4. 1) iti śruteḥ |
tathā ᵥsvarvatīṃ yajñaniṣpattidvārā svargavatīṃ īdṛśīṃ tām ᵥā ᵥsacce mitrāvaruṇau saṃgatī bhavataḥ |

ᵥādityā aditaḥ putrau ᵥdānupatī dānasya ājyādipradānasya svāminau abhimatadānasya pālayitārau vā ||
ᵥmitraḥ ca ᵥvaruṇaḥ ca tāvubhau devau |

tathā rājānā karatho yadīmaha ṛtāvānā yadīmahe ||

‘ supumā yātam ’ iti tṛcātmakaṃ caturthaṃ sūktaṃ pārucchepam atiśākaraṃ pathyakṣaropetatvāt |
atra athaṣṭiparibhāṣā nāśrīyate ‘ atiśākaram ’ iti viśeṣitatvāt |
daśarātrasya ṣaṣṭhe'hani prātaḥsavane praugaśastre idaṃ sūktaṃ mitrāvaruṇadevatyaṃ tṛtīyatṛcam |
sūtritaṃ ca— ‘ stīṇaṃ barhiriti tṛcau supumā yātamdribhiḥ ’ ( āśva. śrau. 8. 1 ) iti |
tathā asminneva maitrāvaruṇasya prasthitayājyāyāḥ purastāt ācā prakṣepaṇīyā |
‘ paṣṭhasya prātaḥsavane ’ iti khaṇḍe sūtritaṃ— ‘ supumā yātamdribhiḥ ’ ( āśva. śrau. 8. 1 ) iti ||
supumā yātamdribhirgośrīṃtā matsurā ime somāso matsurā ime |
'āśiramava nayati saśukravāya ' ( tai. saṃ. 6. 1. 6. 5 ) iti śruteḥ ||
ima ā yātmindavaḥ somāso dadhyāśiraḥ sutāso dadhyāśiraḥ |
uta vāmuṣasau budha sākaṃ sūryasya raśmibhiḥ ||
suto mitrāya varuṇāya pītaye cārukṛtāya pītaye ||

pṛkṣo vapuḥ pitumānitya ā śaye dvitīyamā saptaśivāsu mātṛṣu| tṛtīyamasya vṛṣabhasya dohase darśapramatiṃ janayantu yoṣaṇaḥ|| 2|| pṛkṣaḥ| vapuḥ| pitumān| nityaḥ| ā| śaye| dvitīyam| ā| saptaśivāsu| mātṛṣu| tṛtīyam| asya| vṛṣabhasya| dohase| darśapramatim| janayantu| yoṣaṇaḥ|| 2||
ayamagniḥ ᵥpṛkṣaḥ annasādhakaḥ pākādinā ᵥvapuḥ vapuṣmān śarīrābhivṛddhihetuḥ ᵥpitumān havi- rlakṣaṇānnayuktaḥ ᵥnityaḥ śāśvataḥ|
īdṛśaḥ san prathamaṃ pṛthivīsthānaḥ san ᵥā ᵥśaye āśete|
dāha- pākādi laukikaṃ karmaṃ yājñadikaṃ karmaṃ ca nirvartayan dhruvo bhūmau vartate ityarthaḥ|
tathā ᵥsaptaśivāsu ᵥmātṛṣu saptalokaśivakarīṣu mātṛsthānīyāsu hitakarīṣu vṛṣṭiṣu ᵥdvitīyam ᵥā śete|
ᵥasya ᵥvṛṣabhasya varṣiturasyaiva vidyutāgneḥ sahāyatvena saṃbandhinye ᵥdohase dogdhe ādityastho- dakasya varṣayitre ādityaraśmaye||
asya vṛṣabhasya varṣituḥ prasiddhasyādityasya saṃbandhinye dogdhe raśmaye tatpravṛttyartham|
ādityaraśmayo dharmakāle bhūmisthamudakamākṛṣya sūrya prāpya tatra cirakālaṃ dhṛtvā punarantarikṣaṃ prāpya megheṣu sthitvā varṣakāle’ varṣantīti prasiddham|
īdṛśaṃ tristhānamapi mahābhāgaṃ ᵥyoṣaṇaḥ miśraṇaśīlāḥ sarvā diśaḥ ᵥjanayanta utpādayanti|

'sunvate svadarthamabhivaṃ kurvate yajamānāya tathāgārthaṃ 'ratnaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ haviḥ 'devatātaṃ deveṣu tāyamānaṃ vistāryamāṇam 'invasi vyāpnoṣi |
invatiḥ vyāptikarmā, 'invati nanakṣa' (ni. 2. 18. 1) iti tannāmasu pāṭhāt |

sahasaḥputra yuvan niyatataruṇa 'mahiratna asmatpradeyamahamaraṇīyadhana 'navyaṃ navataraṃ stutyaṃ vā 'taṃ tādṛśaṃ havirbhujaṃ 'tvā 'tvāṃ 'vayaṃ yajamānāḥ 'kāre śabde stotralakṣaṇe 'nu kṣipraṃ 'dhīmahi sthāpayāmaḥ |
asme rayiṃ na svarthaṃ dmūnasaṃ bhagaṃ dakṣaṃ na papṛcāsi dharṇisim |
raśmīriṃva yo yamati janmanī ubhe devānāṃ śaṃsamuta ā ca sukratuḥ ||
asme iti | rayim | na | su'artham | dmūnasam | bhagam | dakṣam | na | papṛcāsi | dharṇisim | raśmīn'iva | yaḥ | yamati | janmanī iti | ubhe iti | devānām | śaṃsam | ṛte | ā | ca | su'kratuḥ || 11 ||
he agne tvam ᵛasme asmāsu ᵛsvarthaṃ suṣṭhu araṇīyaṃ ᵛdmūnasaṃ damanīyam upāyaryam||
ᵛrayiṃ ᵛna ᵛpapṛcāsi dhanaṃ yathā saṃpṛṇakṣi |
tathā ᵛbhagaṃ sarvairbhajanīyaṃ ᵛdakṣaṃ ᵛna utsāhavantaṃ prabuddhaṃ vā ᵛdharṇisiṃ vidyādidhāraṇakuśalaṃ putraṃ yathā papṛcāsi saṃpṛṇakṣi ubhayamapi dadāmītyarthaḥ ||
agniḥ ᵛraśmīriṃva svakīyān raśmīn yathā ᵛyamati niyamayati vistārayati tadvat saḥ ᵛubhe ᵛjanmanī jananādhārabhūtī ubhau lokau ihalokaparalokau yamati niyacchati |
tathā ᵛsukratuḥ śobhanakarmā ayam ᵛṛte asmadīyayajñe ᵛdevānāṃ devasambandhinaṃ ᵛśaṃsaṃ stavaṃ ᵛca ᵛā yamati āyacchati sarvadā dadāti |
uta naḥ sudyotmā jīrāśvo hotā mandraḥ śṛṇavaccandrarathaḥ |
sa nau neṣanneṣataimaramūrognirvārmāṃ suvitaṃ vasyo accha ||
uta | naḥ | su'dyotmā | jīra'aśvaḥ | hotā | mandraḥ | śṛṇavat | candra'rathaḥ | saḥ | naḥ | neṣat | neṣat'tamaiḥ | amūraḥ | agniḥ | vāmam | suvitam | vasyaḥ | accha ||12||
naḥ asmān śrāvayet deveṣu madhye pratyāpayet ||
ᵛjīrāśvaḥ śīghraga manāśvaḥ ᵛhotā devānāmāhvātā ᵛmandraḥ madanaśīlaḥ ᵛcandrarathaḥ suvarṇamayarathopetaḥ |
kiṃca ayam ᵛamūraḥ amūḍhabalaḥ ᵛvasyaḥ vasanīyaḥ ᵛsaḥ prasiddhaḥ ᵛagniḥ ᵛnepataiḥ atyarthaṃ netṛbhiḥ karmabhiḥ stotrairvā ᵛnaḥ asmān uta ᵛnepat api nāma nayet |
ᵛvāmaṃ vananīyaṃ ᵛsuvitaṃ suṣṭhu prāpyaṃ sarvaiḥ kāṅkṣaṇīyaṃ svargam ᵛaccha ābhimukhyena prāsu nepat ||
a॒mī ca॒ ye ma॒dhavāno̭ va॒yaṃ ca॒ miha̭ṃ na sū॒ro a॒ti ni॒ṣṭanyuḥ ||
a॒stā॒vi | a॒gniḥ | śi॒mī'va̭dbhiḥ | a॒rkaiḥ | sā॒mrājyā̭ya | pra॒tūrda̭dhānaḥ | a॒mī iti̭ | ca॒ | ye | ma॒dha'vāna̭ḥ | va॒yam | ca॒ | miha̭m | na | sū॒raḥ | a॒ti | niḥ | ta॒ta॒nyuḥ || 13 ||
ayamagniḥ śimīvadbhiḥ haviṣpradānādikarmavadbhiḥ arkaiḥ arcanasādhanamantraiḥ astāvi stuto'smābhiryajamānaiḥ |
śimīti karmanāma, 'śimī śaktiḥ' (ni. 2. 1. 24) iti tannāmasu pāṭhāt |
kiṃca imamagnim ca purovartamāna ṛtvijaḥ putrādayo vā ye vayaṃ ca pūrvaṃ stutatvena prasiddhā vayamapi ati atyarthaṃ niṣṭanyuḥ śabdayantu ||
itaḥ paramapi asmatputrapautrādayo vayaṃ ca agniṃ stuma ityarthaḥ |
mihaṃ mehanaśīlaṃ meghaṃ yathā sūraḥ sūryo vṛṣṭyarthaṃ śabdayati tadvat ||
dvitīyādīnāṃ tanūnapānnarāśaṃsa iha barhirdevīdvāra upāsānaktā daivyau hotārī pracetasī tisro devyaḥ sarasvatīḻābhāratyastathā vanaspatiḥ svāhākṛtirityetāḥ krameṇa devatāḥ |
tisro devya ityasya vivaraṇaṃ sarasvatīḻābhāratya iti |
ataḥ sa eva devateti kāthakyasya matam |

nirukte kiṃdevatāḥ prayājānuyājā iti chandodevatā^4 ityādipakṣāntaraṃ bahudhā pradarśya tadarthe brāhmaṇādi codāhṛtya itare pakṣā arthavādā āgneyā eveti siddhāntitam, 'atha kiṃdevatāḥ prayājānuyājāḥ' (niru. 8. 21) ityādinā ||
'ekādaśa prayājāḥ^5' iti khaṇḍe sūtritaṃ- 'samiddho agheti sarveṣāṃ yatharṛṣi vā' (āśva. śrau. 3. 2) iti |

sami̭ddho a॒gna ā va̭ha de॒vā~ a॒dya yata̭sruce | ta॒ntuṃ ta̭nuṣva pū॒rvyaṃ suta̭somāya dā॒śuṣe || 1 || sa॒m'iddhaḥ | a॒gne | ā | va॒ha | de॒vān | a॒dya | yata̭'sruce | ta॒ntum | ta॒nu॒ṣva | pū॒rvyam | suta̭'somāya | dā॒śuṣe || 1 ||

1. kṣa-na-ṭa-sāmrājyam | 2. kṣa-jha-1-ja-ṭa-tanotiḥ | 3. kṣa-ja-ṭa-samiddho'gnirvā | 4. kṣa-ja-ṭa-chandodevatā ṛtudevatāḥ; cha-jha-jha-chandodevatā ṛtudevatā vā | 5. kṣa-jha-1-ja-ṭa-brāhmaṇāni | 6. kṣa-ū-jha-na-ṭa-praiṣikāṇi ca | ṛ. 112
he agne samiddhaḥ samyagdīpitaḥ etannāmakastvam adya asmin yāgadine devān haviṣāṃ bhoktṛn adyādīn ā vaha asmadyajñaṃ prati prāpaya |
āvāhya ca sutasomāya yāgārthamabhiṣutasomāya dāśuṣe havirdattavate |
yadyapi idānīmevāhūyante devāḥ tathāpi pūrvānuṣṭhānāpekṣayā bhāvyapekṣayā vā dāśuṣe ityucyate |
havirdatre vā yajamānāya tadartha pūrvya pūrvebhyo devebhyo hitaṃ pūrvakālīnaṃ vā tantuṃ yajñaṃ tanuṣva vistāraya ||

ghṛtavantaṃmupa māsi madhumantaṃ tanūnapāt | yajñaṃ viprasya māvataḥ śaśamānasya dāśuṣaḥ || 2 || ghṛta'vantam | upa | māsi | madhu'mantam | tanū'napāt | yajñam | viprasya | mā'vataḥ | śaśamānasya | dāśuṣaḥ || 2 ||
‘tanūnapāt ājyam’ iti kāthakyapakṣe tanvo gāvo bhogānāṃ tāsu jāyamānatvāt |
tābhyaḥ utpannaṃ kṣīraṃ kṣīrāta sarpiḥ iti ājyasya naptṛtvam |
etannāmaka he agne viprasya medhāvinaḥ śaśamānasya śaṃsamānasya tvāṃ stuvataḥ dāśuṣaḥ havirdattavataḥ māvataḥ matsahaśasya yajamānasya ||
ghṛtavantaṃ kṣaradājyopetaṃ madhumantaṃ mādhuryopetaṃ somādimadhuradravyeṇa tadvantaṃ yajñam upa upetya mā sinirmimīṣe mito bhavasi vā |

śuciḥ pāvako ad‌bhuto madhvā yajñaṃmimi‍kṣati | narāśaṃsastridhā divo devo deveṣu yajñiyaḥ || 3 || śuciḥ | pāvakaḥ | ad‌bhutaḥ | madhvā | yajñam | mimi‍kṣati | narāśaṃsaḥ | triḥ | ā | divaḥ | devaḥ | deveṣu | yajñiyaḥ || 3 ||
deveṣu madhye śuciḥ śuddho dīpto vā pāvakaḥ annasya apatasya śodhayitā ad‌bhutaḥ abhūta iva adyakṣaṇe bhavitā |

devaḥ dyotanaśīlaḥ yajñiyaḥ yajñasaṃpādanāhaḥ īdṛśaḥ narā śaṃsaḥ naraiḥ karmanetṛbhirṛtvigbhiḥ śaṃsanīyo'gniḥ divaḥ dyulokādāgatya madhvā madhureṇa rasena yajñam asmadīyaṃ triḥ ā mimi‍kṣati trivāraṃ samantāt siñcati svadayatītyarthaḥ |
madhureṇa phalena triḥ ā mimi‍kṣati yojayatītyarthaḥ |
‘narāśaṃso yajñaḥ’ iti kāthakyapakṣe yajñābhimānī devo dyotamāno dyulokādāgatya anuṣṭhīyamānaṃ yajñaṃ triḥ ā mimi‍kṣati |

īḻito agma ā vahendraṃ citramiha priyam | iyaṃ hi tvā matirmācchā sujihva vacyatai || 4 || īḻitaḥ | agne | ā | vaha | indram | citram | iha | priyam | iyam | hi | tvā | matiḥ | mama | accha | sujihva | vacyatai || 4 ||
he 'gne 'īḻitaḥ sarvaiḥ stutyaḥ iṇnāmakamasvam 'iha asmin yajñe 'citraṃ cāyanīyaṃ priyaṃ prīṇa- yitāram asmān haviḥsvīkartuṃ vā prītiyuktam 'indram 'ā vaha āhvaya |
he 'sujihva ghṛtapānena śobhanajvāla 'iyaṃ 'mama 'matiḥ mananasādhanā stutirūpā vāk 'tvā tvām 'accha ābhimukhyena prāptuṃ 'vacyate matirevāsmadīyocyate ||
vacyaiki ‘saṃbhramāraṇācca’ iti pūrvarūpasya ‘vā chandasi’ iti vikalpitatvāt abhāve yaṇ ||

śucirdeveṣvarpitā hotrā marutsu bhāratī | iḻā sarasvatī mahī barhiḥ sīdantu yajñiyāḥ || 9 || śuciḥ | deveṣu | arpitā | hotrā | marutsu | bhāratī | iḻā | sarasvatī | mahī | barhiḥ | sīdantu | yajñiyāḥ || 9 ||
śuciḥ śuddhā marutsu viruddhalakṣaṇayā amaraṇepu deveṣu dyotanaśīleṣu ratotṛpu marutsu ṛtvikṣu vā arpitā niyatā hotrā homaniṣpādikā bhāratī bharatasyādityasya sambandhinī ghusthānā vāk |
tathā iḻā pārthivī praiṣādirūpā mahī mahatī sarasvatī |
tadvatī stanitādirūpā mādhyamikā ca vāk etāstisraḥ tristhānavāgabhimānidevatāḥ yajñāḥ yajñārhaḥ satyaḥ barhiḥ stīrṇa sīdantu upaviśantu ||

tasturīpamadbhutaṃ puru vāraṃ puru tmanā | tvaṣṭā poṣāya vi ṣyatu rāye nābhā no asmayuḥ || 10 || tat | naḥ | turīpam | adbhutam | puru | vā | aram | puru | tmanā | tvaṣṭā | poṣāya | vi | syatu | rāye | nābhā | naḥ | asmayuḥ || 10 ||
naḥ asmadartha tat tādṛśaṃ turīpaṃ tūrṇa vyāpi adbhutaṃ sadya āvirbhavat abhūtamiba sat |
puru vāraṃ bahūnāṃ prāṇināmarthāya eva aram alaṃ samartham |
tvaṣṭāśabdo yāskenaivaṃ vyākhyātaḥ—'tvaṣṭā tūrṇamadbhuta iti nairuktāstveṣevāṃ syādvṛddhikarmaṇasvakṣatervā syātkarotikarmaṇaḥ' (niru. 8. 13) iti |

tannāmako vaidyuto'gniḥ asmayuḥ asmān kāmayamāno devaḥ naḥ poṣāya asmatpuṣṭaye rāye samṛddhaye ca nābhā nābhau vṛṣṭyabandhake meghasya nābhisthāne avasthitam utkalakṣaṇamudakaṃ vi vyatu vividhaṃ gamayatu |
2. kṣa-ṅa-jha-ña-jña-ja-ṭa-' upaviśantu ' ityasyānantaraṃ ' tisraḥ ityatra tisṛbhyo jasa iti jasa udāttatvam ' ityadhikam |
avasṛjan | upa | tmanā | devān | yakṣi | vanaspate | agniḥ | havyā | susūdati | devaḥ | deveṣu | medhiraḥ || 11 ||
he vanaspate vanānāṃ pālaka yūpābhimānideva agne 'avasṛjan svairaṃ vartayan ṛtvijaḥ svasvakarmasu vyāpārayan 'tmanā ātmanā 'devān havirbhujaḥ 'upa 'yakṣi upetya yaja ||
'devaḥ dyotamānaḥ 'medhiraḥ medhāvān 'agniḥ āhavanīyaḥ 'deveṣu ubhayeṣāṃ madhye 'havyā havīṃṣi 'susūdati prerayati svīkaroti ||
pūṣṇvate | marutvate | viśvadevāya | vāyave | svāhā | gāyatravepase | havyam | indrāya | kartana || 12 ||
'marutvate marudbhistaddhate 'viśvadevāya sarvadevasaṃbandhāya 'vāyave gamanaśīlāya vāyudevāya ca tathā 'gāyatravepase vepa iti rūpanāma |
gāyatravepo rūpaṃ yasya tādṛśāya 'indrāya 'havyaṃ haviḥ pradātuṃ 'svāhā 'kartana svāhākāraṃ kuruta ṛtvijaḥ ||
indrā gahi śrudhī havaṃ tvāṃ havante adhvare ||
svāhā'kṛtāni | ā | gṛhi | upa | havyāni | vītaye | indra | ā | gṛhi | śrudhi | havam | tvām | havante | adhvare || 13 ||
svāhā ityevaṃpūrvā kṛtiḥ karaṇamuccāraṇaṃ yakṣyamāṇadevatānāṃ tāḥ svāhā- kṛtayaḥ |
1. kṣa-a-ṭa-susūdati | 2. kṣa-a-ṭa-svīkaroti vā | 3. kṣa-jha-ma1-a-ṭa-itarasāmopalakṣakaḥ | 4. kṣa-ṅa-ma1-ma-ṭa-svāhāntam; jha-jha-svāhutam |
tadvi: upetya v vītaye bhakṣaṇāya v ā v gahi āgaccha |
tathā he v indra v ā v gahi stotrāṇyabhilakṣya āgaccha |
āgamya v havam asmadīmāhvānaṃ v śrudhi śṛṇu |
yataḥ v tvām v adhvare ahiṃsātmake yāge v havante āhvayanti ṛtvija: ataḥ śrudhi |
iyate: ‘bahula chandasi v’ iti saṃprasāraṇam v |
‘pra tavyasīm v’ iti aṣṭacaṃ caturthaṃ sūktaṃ dīrghatamasam |
tathā cānukrāntaṃ—‘pra tavyasīmaṣṭāvāgneyaṃ nu tat triṣṭubantam v’ iti |
agniṣṭome āgnimārute śastre idaṃ sūktaṃ jātavedasyanividvānīyam |
‘atha yathemam v’ iti khaṇḍe sūtritaṃ—‘pra tavyasīṃ navyasīmāpo hi v’ iti tisra: v (āśva. śrau. 5. 20) iti |
daśarātrasya prathame'yahani v jātavedasyanividvānam āśvamedhike madhye'hani ca nividvānam |
tathā ca ācāryātideśa:—‘aikāhikānyupasaṃhārasya teṣu nivido dadhyādevamevāgnimārute v’ (āśva. śrau. 10. 10) iti |

pra tavyasīṃ navyasīṃ dhītimagnaye vāce matiṃ sahasa: sūnave bhare | apāṃ napādyo vasubhi: saha priyo hotā pṛthivyāṃ nyasīdadṛtviya: || 1 || pra | tavyasīm | navyasīm | dhītim | agnaye | vāca: | matim | sahasa: | sūnave | bhare | apām | napāt | ya: | vasubhi: | saha | priya: | hotā | pṛthivyām | ni | asīdat | ṛtviya: || 1 ||
aham v agnaye v tavyasīṃ tavīyasīm atiśayena vardhayitrīma |
v navyasīṃ navatarāmpūrvāṃ v dhītiṃ yāgalakṣaṇām v uttaguṇaṃ karma v pra v bhare prakarṣeṇa karomi |
tathā uktalakṣaṇaṃ v vāco v matiṃ stutirūpaṃ karma bhare |
v sahasa: balasya v sūnave putrāya |
kiṃca v ya: agni: v apāṃ v napāt tāsāṃ naptā |
athavā apāṃ na pātayitā vaidyutāmirūpeṇa pravartatvāditi bhāva: |

tathā v priya: yajamānasya prīṇayitā priyatamo vā tasya v hotā homaniṣpādaka: so'gni: v ṛtviya: prāptakāla: prāptapradānasamaya: san v pṛthivyāṃ vedilakṣaṇāyāṃ v vasubhi: nivāsayogyairgavādidhanai: sahita: v nyasīdat nitarāṃ sīdati |

sa jāyamāna: parame vyomannāviramirbhavanmātariśvane | asya kratvā samidhānasya majmanā pra dyāvā śoci: pṛthivī arocayat || 2 || sa: | jāyamāna: | parame | vi'aumani | ātri: | agni: | abhavat | mātariśvane | asya | kratvā | sam'idhānasya | majmanā | pra | dyāvā | śoci: | pṛthivī iti | arocayat || 2 ||
1. kṣa-jña-1-ba-ṭa-upa upetya | 2. kṣa-na-ṭa-śapi saṃprasāraṇam | 3. ca-prathame'yahani | 4. ca-jña-pha-yāgalakṣaṇam |

vsa: pūrvokta: vagni: vjāyamāna: araṇībhyāmuspadyamāna: kāṣṭheṣu vā prādurbhūta: san tadānīmeva vparame utkṛṣṭe vvyomani vividharakṣaṇavati vediśe vmātariśvane antarikṣasaṃcāriṇe vāyave prathamam vāvi: vabhavat pratyakṣo'bhūt |
athavā mātari phalasya nirmātari yaṣṭe dhrasita ceṣṭe iti mātariśvā yajamāna: |
kiṃca vsamidhānasya’ indhanai: samyagvardhamānasya agne: 2 vmajmanā |
balavatā vkṛtvā ṛtunā karmaṇā jvālanādidhyāpāreṇa 3 vśoci: 4 vdyāvā vpṛthivī cāṃ ca pṛthivīṃ ca vpra varocayat prakarṣeṇādīpayat |

ᵛacittaṃ cittāviṣayaṃ ᵛbrahma parivṛḍham utkūrūpaṃ karma ᵛmitre ᵛvaruṇe ca ubhayoḥ ᵛdhāma tejaḥsthānaṃ ᵛyuvānaḥ miśrayantaḥ tayordhāmni āropayantaḥ tathā ᵛpra ᵛgṛṇantaḥ yuvayoḥ tejaḥ- prabhavamiti prakarṣeṇa⁶ stuvantaḥ |
manuṣyāḥ sūryasya nirālambā ntarikṣasaṃcārarātmakaṃ karma varuṇamitrayoradhīnam iti stuvantītyarthaḥ ||
ā | dhenavaḥ | māmateyam | arvanyaḥ | brahmapriyam | pīpayan | asmin | ūrdhan | pitvaḥ | bhikṣeta | vayunāni | vidvān | āsā | ā'vivāsan | aditima | uruṣyeta ||6||

ᵛmāmateyaṃ mamatāyāḥ putraṃ dīrghatamasaṃ māṃ ᵛbrahmapriyaṃ parivṛḍhasya karmaṇaḥ priyatamaṃ parivṛḍhasyāgreḥ prīṇayitāraṃ vā ᵛavantīḥ avantyaḥ prīṇayantyaḥ ᵛdhenavaḥ gāvaḥ ᵛasmin svakīye ᵛūrdhan ūdhasi ᵛā ᵛpīpayan savaṃta āpyāyayantu ||
ūdhogatena kṣīreṇa yuvābhyāṃ pradeyena no'smān rakṣanti ityarthaḥ |

evaṃ pradattahaviḥ ᵛvayunāni anuṣṭhānaviṣayajñānāni ᵛvidvān jānan hutaśeṣo bhakṣaṇīya ityavagacchan dīrghatamāḥ ᵛpitvaḥ⁹ pitorhutaśiṣṭasya annasya tādṛśam ᵛāsā āsyena bhakṣayituṃ ᵛbhikṣeta yāceta yuṣmān |
kiṃca ᵛvivāsan yuvāṃ paricaran ᵛaditima akhaṇḍitam anyūnametatkarma¹⁰ ᵛuruṣyeta¹⁰ |
yathā śiṣṭaṃ bhikṣeta yathā ca karma samāpanena rakṣeta tathā apīyayantyarthaḥ ||
10. kṣa-ṅa-jha1-a-ṭa-annametatkarma uruṣyeta rakṣeta; jha-anyenaitatkarma uruṣyeta rakṣeta |
sūtritaṃ ca- 'ā vāṃ mitrāvaruṇā havyajuṣṭimā yāta mitrāvaruṇā' (āśva. śrau. 3. 8) iti |

ā vāṃ mitrāvaruṇā havyajuṣṭiṃ namasā devāvarvasā vavṛtyām | asmākaṃ brahma pṛtanāsu sahyā asmākaṃ vṛṣṭirdivyā supārā || 7 || ā | vām | mitrāvaruṇā | havyajuṣṭim | namasā | devau | avasā | vavṛtyām | asmākam | brahma | pṛtanāsu | sahyāḥ | asmākam | vṛṣṭiḥ | divyā | supārā || 7 ||
he devau devanaśīlau mitrāvaruṇā mitrāvaruṇau vāṃ yuvāṃ havyajuṣṭiṃ haviḥsevāṃ namasā nama- skāropalakṣitena stotreṇa avasā rakṣaṇena nimittabhūtena ā vavṛtyām āvartayeyam |
namaskāreṇa avasā anena ca ā vavṛtyām |
kiṃca he mitrāvaruṇau asmākaṃ saṃbandha brahma idānīṃ kriyamāṇaṃ parivṛḍhaṃ karma pṛtanāsu saṃgrāmeṣu sahyāḥ sahāt śatrūn abhibhūyāt |
kiṃca asmākaṃ divyā divi bhavā vṛṣṭiḥ supārā suṣṭhu pārayitrī' bhavatviti śeṣaḥ |
'yajāmahe vām' iti caturṛcaṃ caturdaśaṃ sūktaṃ dairghatamasaṃ traiṣṭubhaṃ maitrāvaruṇam |
yajāmahe vāṃ mahaḥ sajoṣo havyebhirmitrāvaruṇā namobhiḥ |
ghṛtairghṛtasnū adha yadvāmasme adhvaryavo na dhītibhirbharenti |
yajāmahe | vām | mahaḥ | sajoṣaḥ | havyebhiḥ | mitrāvaruṇā | namaḥ'bhiḥ ||
ghṛtaiḥ | ghṛtasnū iti ghṛta'snū | adha | yat | vām | asme iti | adhvaryavaḥ | na | dhīti'bhiḥ | bharanti || 1 ||
he ghṛtasnū ghṛtasya srāvayitārau mitrāvaruṇau mahaḥ mahāntau vāṃ yajāmahe pūjayāmoṃ yaja- mānāḥ ṛtvijaśca |
adha api ca yat yasmāt kāraṇāt
2. kṣa-bha-ṭa-ghṛtasya ājyasya srāvayitārau; kṣa1-ājyasya srāvayitārau 3. kṣa-ṅa-jha-jña-na-ṭa-namaskāropalakṣitaiḥ stotraiḥ |
ghṛtaiḥ kṣaraṇadravyaiḥ kṣīrājya- somādibhiśca (kṣa-na-ṭa-kṣīrājyasomādirūpairbhiśca ?) yuvāṃ samyak yajāmahe pūjayāmaḥ; jha-namaskāropalakṣitaiḥ stotraiḥ |
te'pi dhītibhiḥ karmabhiḥ svakīyaiḥ bharanti poṣayanti tasmāt yajāmahe ||
prastutirvāṃ dhāma na prayuktiryāmi mitrāvaruṇā suvṛktiḥ |
anakti yajñau vidatheṣu hotā sumnaṃ vāṃ sūrirvṛṣaṇāviyakṣan ||
pra'stutiḥ | vām | dhāma | na | pra'yuktiḥ | ayami | mitrāvaruṇā | su'vṛktiḥ | anakti | yat | vām | vidatheṣu | hotā | sumnam | vām | sūriḥ | vṛṣaṇau | iyakṣan || 2 ||
he mitrāvaruṇau vāṃ yuvayoḥ saṃbandhino yāgasya prastutiḥ prastāvanā karomīti saṃkalpa eva na prayuktiḥ krūranaprayogo na saṃpannaḥ |
tāvataiva yuvayoḥ dhāma tejaḥsthānam ayāmi prāpnomi |
yat yadā tu vidatheṣu yajñeṣu vāṃ yuvāṃ hotā homanispādako'yamadhvaryuḥ anakti haviṣā āgacchati homaṃ karotītyarthaḥ |
hotā devānāmāhvātā etannāmakaḥ ṛtvik śastrādinā vām anakti vyañjayati |
tadā sūriḥ yuṣmanmāhātmyavit iyakṣan yāgaṃ kartumicchan ahaṃ he vṛṣaṇau kāmānāṃ varṣitārau vāṃ yuvayoḥ sumnaṃ yuṣmatsaṃbandhi sukhaṃ devatvalakṣaṇam ayāmīti śeṣaḥ ||
hinoti yajñau vidathai saparyantas rātahavyo mānuṣo na hotā ||
pīpāya | dhenuḥ | aditiḥ | ṛtāya | janāya | mitrāvaruṇā | haviḥ'de | hinoti | yat | vām | vidathai | saparyan | saḥ | rāta'havyaḥ | mānuṣaḥ | na | hotā || 3 ||
he mitrāvaruṇā mitrāvaruṇau ṛtāya yuṣmatsaṃbandhidhajñāya havirdeṃ haviṣo dātre ||
janāya yajamānāya ca dhenuḥ prīṇayitrī gauḥ aditiḥ adīnā bahukṣīrā satī pīpāya kṣīreṇa punaḥpunaḥ āpyāyatām ||
yat yadā saḥ prasiddhaḥ rātahavyaḥ etannāmā rājā saparyan stutyā pūjayan mānuṣaḥ hotā na manuvyasya yajamānasya saṃbandhī etannāmaka ṛtvigiva vidathe yajñe vāṃ hinoti havirādinā prīṇayati |
1. kṣa-ṅa-jha-ña-ṭa-yuvāṃ asme asmadīyā adhvaryavo na adhvaryo'pi |
yat yena prakāreṇa vā yuvāṃ adhvaryavo na adhvarya iva dhītibhiḥ yuṣmadīyeḥ karmabhiḥ asme asmān asmadīyaṃ yāgaṃ vā bharanti bharathaḥ |
uta vāṃ viśva maghāsvandho gāba āpaśca pīpayanta devīḥ |
uto nau asya pūrvyaḥ patirdanvītaṃ pātaṃ paryasa ustriyāyāḥ ||
uta | vām | viśva | maghāsu | andhaḥ | gābaḥ | āpaḥ | ca | pīpayanta | devīḥ | uto iti | naḥ | asya | pūrvyaḥ | patiḥ | dan | vītam | pātam | paryasaḥ | ustriyāyāḥ ||4||

^uta api ca he mitrāvaruṇau ^vāṃ yuvām ^andhaḥ adanīyamannaṃ payorūpaṃ puroḍāśādirūpaṃ vā ^devīḥ dyotanaśīlāḥ ^gāvaḥ ^āpaśca vrīhādipravardhakānyudakāni ca ^maghāsu yuṣmābhirmadanīyāsu ^viśva prajāsu yajamānalakṣaṇāsu tāsāmabhivṛddhayartha ^pīpayanta āpyāyayantu |
^uto api ca ^naḥ asmatsambandhinaḥ ^asya yajñasya ^pūrvyaḥ pūrvakālīnaḥ ^patiḥ pālako'gniḥ ^dan dātā bhavatīti śeṣaḥ |
tathā ca mantrāntaraṃ- 'yadindrāpnī avamasyāṃ pṛthivyāṃ madhyamasyāṃ paramasyāmuta sthaḥ ' (ṛ. saṃ. 1. 108. 9) iti |
taittirīye'pi- 'yo'syāṃ pṛthivyāmasyāyuṣā' ityupakramya 'yo dvitīyasyāṃ tṛtīyasyāṃ pṛthivyām' (tai. saṃ. 1. 2. 12. 1) iti |
kiṃca ᵥyaḥ ca viṣṇuḥ ᵥuttaram unnatataramativistīrṇaṃ ᵥsadhasthaṃ sahasthānaṃ lokatrayāśraya- bhūtamantarikṣam ᵥaskabhāyat teṣāmādhāratvena stambhitavān nirmitavānityarthaḥ |
yo viṣṇuḥ pārthivāni pṛthivīsambandhīni rajāṃsi pṛthivyā adhastanasalokān vimame vividhaṃ nirmitavān |
raja:śabdo lokavācī, ' lokā rajāṃsyucyante ' iti yāsnenoktatvāt |
kiṃca yaścottaram unnatataram uttarabhāvinaṃ sadhasthaṃ sahasthānaṃ puṇyakṛtāṃ saha- nivāsayogyaṃ bhūrādilokasasakam askabhāyat rambhitavān sṛṣṭavānityarthaḥ ||
skambheḥ ' stambhustambhu ' iti vihitasya bhaḥ ' chandasi śāyajapi ' iti vyatyayena śāyajādeśaḥ ||
athavā pārthivāni pṛthivīnimittakāni rajāṃsi lokān vimame |
sadhastham upāsakānāṃ sahasthānaṃ satyalokamaskabhāyat skambhitavān dhruvaṃ sthāpita- vānityarthaḥ |
ᵥtredhā ᵥvicakramāṇaḥ trikāraṃ svasṛṣṭān lokānvividhaṃ kramamāṇaḥ |
viṣṇostredhā bhramaṇam ' idaṃ viṣṇurvi cakre ' (ṛ. saṃ. 1. 22. 17) ityādidhrutiṣu prasiddham |
ata eva ᵥurugāyaḥ urubhiḥ mahadbhiḥ' gīyamānaḥ atiprabhūtaṃ gīyamāno vā |
ya evaṃ kṛtavān tādṛśasya viṣṇorvīryāṇi pra vocam ||
' somātireke ' iti khaṇḍe sūtritaṃ- 'pra tadviṣṇuḥ stavate vīryeṇeti stotriyānurūpau ' (āśva. śrau. 6. 7) iti |
' vājapeyenādhipatyakāmaḥ' ' iti khaṇḍe sūtritaṃ- 'pra tatte adya śipiviṣṭa nāma pra tadviṣṇuḥ stavate vīryeṇa ' (āśva. śrau. 9. 9) iti ||
pra tadviṣṇuḥ stavate vīryeṇa mṛgo na bhīmaḥ kucaro giriṣṭhāḥ |
pra | tat | viṣṇuḥ | stavate | vīryeṇa | mṛgaḥ | na | bhīmaḥ | kucaraḥ | giriṣṭhāḥ | yasya | uruṣu | triṣu | vi'kramaṇepu | adhi'kṣiyanti | bhuvanāni | viśvā || 2 ||
sa mahānubhāvaḥ ᵥvīryeṇa svakīyena vīrakarmaṇā pūrvoktarūpeṇa ᵥstavate stūyate sarvaiḥ ||
yathā svavirodhino mṛgayitā siṃhaḥ ᵥbhīmaḥ bhītijanakaḥ ᵥkucaraḥ kutsitāhiṃsādikartā durgamapradeśagantā vā ᵥgiriṣṭhāḥ parvatādyunnatapradeśasthāyī sarvaiḥ stūyate |
asminnarthe niruktaṃ- ' mṛgo na bhīmaḥ kucaro giriṣṭhāḥ |
mṛga iva bhīmaḥ kucaro giriṣṭhā mṛgo mārgetikarmaṇo bhīmo bibhyatyasmā-
kucara iti caratikarma kutsitamatha cehavatābhidhānaṃ kāyaṃ na caratīti vā |
girikṣā girisyāyī giriḥ parvataḥ samudrorṇo bhavati parvavān parvataḥ parva punaḥ pṛṇāteḥ prīṇātervā ’ (niha. 1. 20 ) iti |
tadvadayamapi mṛgo'nveṣṭā śatrūṇāṃ bhīmo bhayānakaḥ sarveṣāṃ bhayapādānabhūtaḥ |
kiṃca kucaraḥ śatruvadhādikutsitakarmakartā kuṣu sarvāsu bhūmiṣu lokatraye saṃcārī vā tathā girikṣāḥ girivat ucchritaloka- sthāyī’ |
kiṃca ‘yasya viṣṇoḥ ’ uruṣu vistīrṇeṣu trisaṃkhyākeṣu ’ vikramaṇepu pādaprakṣepeṣu ’ viśvā’ sarvāṇi ’ bhuvanāni bhūtajātāni ’ adhikṣiyanti āśritya nivasanti sa viṣṇuḥ stūyate |
evaṃ caturdaśa lokān viśvā bhuvanāni sarvāṇyapi tatratyāni bhūtajātāni |
pṛthivyasejorūpadhātutrayaviśiṣṭaṃ yathā bhavati tathā dhādhāra dhatavān |

chāndogyāraṇyake- 'tattejo'sṛjata tadannamamajata tā āpa aikṣanta' iti bhūtatrayasṛṣṭimṛtvā 'hantāha- mimāstisro devatāstāsāṃ trivṛtaṃ trivṛtamekaikāṃ karavāṇi' (chā. u. 6. 3. 2-3. ) ityādinā trivṛtkaraṇasṛṣṭirupapāditā |
'athātithyā' iti khaṇḍe sūtritam-'idaṃ viṣṇurvi cakrame tadasya priyambhi pātho aśyāma' (āśva. śrau. 4. 5) iti |
tada̭sya॒ pri॒yambhi॒ pātho̭ a॒śyāma॒ naro॒ yatra̭ de॒vaya̭vo॒ mada̭nti |
u॒ru॒kra॒masya॒ sa hi bandhṷri॒tthā viṣṇo॒ḥ padḙ pa॒rame॒ madhva॒ utsa̭ḥ |
tad | asya | priyam | abhi | pāthaḥ | aśyāma | naraḥ | yatra | devayavaḥ | madanti | urukramasya | saḥ | hi | bandhuḥ | itthā | viṣṇoḥ | pade | parame | madhvaḥ | utsaḥ || 5 ||
asya mahato viṣṇoḥ priyaṃ priyabhūtaṃ tat sarvaiḥ sevyatvena prasiddhaṃ pāthaḥ |
yatra sthāne devayavaḥ devaṃ dyotanasvabhāvaṃ viṣṇu- mātmānamicchanto yajñadānādibhiḥ prāptumicchantiḥ naraḥ madanti tṛptimanubhavanti |

urukramasya atyadhikaṃ sarvaṃ jagadākramamāṇasya tattadātmanā ata eva viṣṇoḥ vyāpakasya parameśvarasya parame utkṛṣṭe nirātiśaye kevalasukhātmake pade sthāne madhvaḥ madhurasya utsaḥ niṣyando vartate |
śrutkṣṇājarābharaṇapunarāvṛttyādibhayaṃ nāsti saṃkalpamātreṇa amṛtakulyādibhogāḥ prāpyante tādṛśamityarthaḥ |
itthā itthamuktaprakāreṇa sa hi bandhuḥ sa khalu sarveṣāṃ sukṛtānāṃ bandhubhūto hitakaraḥ vā taratha padaṃ prāptavatāṃ na punarāvṛtteḥ |
tā vā̭ṃ vā॒stūnyṷśmasi॒ gama̭dhyai॒ yatra॒ gāvo̭ bhū॒riśvā̭ a॒yāsa̭ḥ |
a॒trāha॒ tadurṷgā॒yasya॒ vṛṣṇa॒ḥ parama̭ṃ pa॒damava̭ bhāti॒ bhūri̭ |
tā | vām | vāstūni | uśmasi | gamadhyai | yatra | gāvaḥ | bhūriśṛṅgāḥ | ayāsaḥ | atra | aha | tat | urugāyasya | vṛṣṇaḥ | paramam | padam | ava | bhāti | bhūri || 6 ||
he patnījamānī¹ ²vāṃ yuṣmadarthaṃ ³tā tāni gantavyatvena² prasiddhāni ⁴vāstūni sukhanivāsayogyāni sthānāni ⁵gamadhyai yuvayoḥ ³gamanaya ³usmasi kāmayāmahe |
⁶yatra yeṣu vāstuṣu ⁷gāvaḥ raśmayaḥ ⁸bhūriśṛṅgāḥ atyantonnatyupetā bahubhirāśrayaṇīyā vā ⁷ayāsaḥ ayanā gantāro'tivistṛtāḥ |

⁷atrāha atra khalu vāstvādhārabhūte dyuloke ⁷urugāyasya bahubhirmahātmabhirgātavyasya stutasya ⁷vṛṣṇaḥ kāmānāṃ varṣiturviṣṇostatādṛśaṃ sarvatra ⁷purāṇādiṣu ⁷gantavyatvena prasiddhaṃ ⁷paramaṃ niratiśayaṃ ⁷padaṃ sthānaṃ ⁷bhūri atiprabhūtam ⁷ava ⁷bhāti svamahimnā sphurati |

iti vyākhyāṇena vyākhyātaḥ -‘tāni vāṃ vāstūni kāmayāmahe gamanāya yatra gāvo bhūriśṛṅgā bahuśṛṅgā bhūriti bahuno nāmadheyaṃ prabhavatīti sata: śṛṅgaṃ śrayatervā śṛṇotervā śnātervā śaraṇādyotatamiti vā śiraso nirgatamiti vāyāso'yanāḥ |
tatra tadurugāyasya viṣṇormahāgateḥ paramaṃ padaṃ parādhyasthamavabhāti bhūri |
‘pra vaḥ pāntam’ iti ṣaṭkaṃ ṣoḍaśaṃ sūktaṃ dairghatamasaṃ jāgatam |
pra vaḥ pāntamandhaso dhiyāyate muhe śūrrāya viṣṇave cārcata |
pra | vaḥ | pāntam | andhasaḥ | dhiyā'yate | muhe | śūrrāya | viṣṇave | ca | arcata | yā | sānuni | parvatānām | adābhyā | mahaḥ | tasthatuḥ | arvātā'iva | sādhunā || 1 ||
he adhvarvādyaḥ ⁷vaḥ yuṣmākaṃ saṃbandhi ⁷pāntaṃ pālanasvabhāvaṃ pātavyaṃ vā ⁷andhasaḥ andhaḥ somarūpamannaṃ ⁷pra ⁷arcata prakarṣeṇa saṃpādayata |
⁷dhiyāyate stutiricchate ⁷mahe mahate ⁷śūrrāya vikrāntāyendrāya ⁷viṣṇave vyāpakāyaitannāmakāya devāya ⁷ca |
⁷yā yau indrāviṣṇū ⁷parvatānāṃ prīṇavatāṃ pūraṇavatāṃ vā |
parvataśabdo yāskenainaṃ niruktaḥ- ‘parvavān parvataḥ parva punaḥ pṛṇāteḥ prīṇātervā’ iti |
⁷adābhyā adambhanau parairanabhibhāvyau ata eva ⁷mahaḥ mahantau |
⁷sādhunā abhimatadeśa- prāpaṇasamarthena ⁷arvatā⁶ vegavatāśvena ⁷iva |
tena yathā abhyucchritaṃ pradeśamārohati tadvaduccaṃ padamārūḍhau |
tathā ca sūtritaṃ- ‘vegamithā samaraṇaṃ śimīvatoriti vā yājyā ’ ( āśva. śrau. 6. 7 ) iti ||

1. jha-dampatī patnījamānī | 2. ca-taraṇitvena; jha-mantavyatvena | 3. ca-vāṃ yuvayoḥ | 4. kṣa-ja-ṭa-sarvaitihāsapurāṇādiṣu | 5. ka-kha-ja-ṇa-ta-pha-va-saṃbandhinām | 6. kṣa-ṅa-ma-ṭa-satyaloke | 7. kṣa-ṅa-ja-ṭa-meghanāma | parvata giririti tannāmasu (ṅa-nāmasu) | 8. kṣa-ṅa-jha-1-ja-ṭa-arvatā pavanavattā |

‘te hi’ iti pañcarcaṃ caturthaṃ sūktaṃ dairghatamasaṃ jāgataṃ dyāvāpṛthivyam |
caturviṃśe'hani vaiśvadevaśastre dyāvāpṛthivyanividvānametatsūktaṃ—‘te hi dyāvāpṛthivī yajñasya vo rathyamiti vaiśvadevam ’ (āśva. śrau. 7 4) iti sūtritatvāt |
tathā pṛṣṭhayābhilavaṣaḍa- hayordvitīyo'hani vaiśvadeve dyāvāpṛthivyaṃ nividvānīyaṃ , ‘cāturviṃśakaṃ tṛtīyasavanam ’ (āśva. śrau. 7. 6) iti ābhilavike dvitīyo'hani atidiṣṭatvāt |
ābhilavikāt dvitīyo'haḥ pṛṣṭhayasya dvitīyo'hani etatsūktamadideśataḥ prāptaṃ , ‘pṛṣṭhayasyābhilavanekte ahanī ādye ādhāyam ’ (āśva. śrau. 7. 10) iti sūtritatvāt |
‘saṃsthiteṣvāśvināya ’ ityatra sūtritaṃ—‘te hi dyāvāpṛthivī viśvaśaṃbhuvā viśvasya devīmṛcayasya ’ (āśva. śrau. 6. 5) iti |
te hi dyāvāpṛthivī viśvaśaṃbhuva ṛtāvarī rajaso dhārayatkavī |
sujanmanī dhiṣaṇe antarīyate devo devī dharmaṇā sūryaḥ śuciḥ ||

ato'smābhiḥ śeṣo na pātavya iti nindāṃ kuryuḥ tān hanāmeti yadā abravīt ityarthaḥ |
tathā bṛhaspatiḥ; jha1-ratha upaājata ratha upagamat prāptavān tathā ca bṛhaspatiḥ |

niścarmaṇo gārmariṇīta dhītibhiryā jarantā yuvaśā tākṛṇotana | saudhanvanā aśvādaśmatakṣata yuktvā rathamurpa devā ayātana || 7 || niḥ | carmaṇaḥ | gām | ariṇīta | dhīti'bhiḥ | yā | jarantā | yuvaśā | tā | akṛṇotana | saudhanvanāḥ | aśvāt | aśvam | atakṣata | yuktvā | ratham | urpa | devān | ayātana ||7||
he ᵥsaudhanvanāḥ yūyaṃ ᵥniścarmaṇaḥ mṛtāyāḥ goḥ sakāśāt utkṛttāccarmaṇaḥ ᵥgāṃ nūtanāṃ niḥ ᵥariṇīta niragamayata utpāditavanta ityarthaḥ |
tenaiva carmaṇā saṃvītāṃ tatsadṛśīmanyāṃ dhenuṃ kṛtavanta ityarthaḥ |
yadyapi pūrvameva aśvādīnāṃ viniyogaḥ uktaḥ tathāpi teṣāmatyantaduḥkhasaṃpādatvajñāpanāya punarāha |
na kevalaṃ gokaraṇameva api ca ᵥyā ᵥjarantā yau jīrṇau pitarau ᵥtā tau ᵥyuvaśā yuvānau ᵥakṛṇotana akurūta |
kiṃca ᵥaśvādaśvam ekena vidyamānenāśvena aśrāntaram ᵥatakṣata prayatnena saṃpāditavantaḥ |
yasmādevaṃ kṛtavantastasmāt ᵥrathaṃ yuṣmadīyaṃ ᵥyuktvā aśvairyojayitvā ᵥdevān indrādīn ᵥupa ᵥayātana devasamīpaṃ prāpnuta ||

idamudakaṃ pibatetyabravītanedaṃ vāṃ ghā pibatā muñjenerjanam | saudhanvanā yadi tatheva haryatha tṛtīyai ghā sarvane mādayādhvai || 8 || idam | udakam | pibata | iti | abravītana | idam | vā | gha | pibata | muñja'nerjanam | saudhanvanāḥ | yadi | tat | na'iva | haryatha | tṛtīyai | gha | sarvane | mādayādhvai || 8 ||
idānīmṛṣiḥ devairuktamarthaṃ tān saṃbodhaya yūyam ṛbhūna evamuktavantaḥ stha iti anuvācayatiᵂ |
he ᵥsaudhanvanāḥ sudhanvanaḥ putrāḥ yūyam ᵥidamudakaṃ somalakṣaṇaṃ ᵥpibatetyabravītana ityuktavantaḥ ||
bravīteṅi madhyamabahuvacanasya tasya tanabādeśe pittvāt ‘ dhruva īd ’ ( pā. sū. 7. 3. 93 ) ||
tata āhatatvāt tena muñjatena śodhitaṃ apagatatṛṇamityarthaḥ |
he ṛbhavaḥ yūyaṃ ᵥtat ubhayasavanasaṃbandhi somapānakāryaṃ ᵥneva ᵥharyatha naiva kāmayatha |
haryatiḥ kāntikarmā, ‘ haryati uśika ’ ( ni. 2. 6. 10 ) iti tatkarmasu pāṭhāt |
ᵥtṛtīyai ᵥsavane tu ᵥmādayādhvai atyarthaṃ tṛptāḥ bhavatha |
‘ ṛbhavo devāḥ somasya mattan ’ iti tṛtīyasavane teṣāṃ somapānasadbhāvāt |
he saudhanvanāḥ yūyaṃ devatvaṃ prāpya devayajanaṃ prati somapānāya rathenāgatya śrāntānprātaḥsavane idamudakaṃ somalakṣaṇaṃ pibatetyabravītana |
tatra yadi necchathaᵅ idaṃ vā muñjenerjanaṃ muñjena dūṣitaṃᶺ vājinaṃ pibatetyabravītana paścāt tat dvayaṃ yadi neva haryatha he aśvā yūyaṃ tṛtīyai savane mādayādhvai |
8. kṣa-ṅa-jha1-na-ṭa-‘ vājinapracārāt ’ ityasyānantaraṃ ‘ vājibhyo vājinamityādinā anyatra eṣāṃ vājinasaṃbandhāt ’ ityadhikam |
āpo bhūryiṣṭhā ityeko abravīdagnirbhūryiṣṭha ityanyo abravīt |
vadhryantīṃ bahubhyaḥ ekau abravīttā vadantaścamasā~ arpiśata ||
āpaḥ | bhūryiṣṭhāḥ | iti | ekaḥ | abravīt | agniḥ | bhūryiṣṭhaḥ | iti | anyaḥ | abravīt | vadhryantīm | bahubhyaḥ | pra | ekaḥ | abravīt | ṛtā | vadantaḥ | camasān | arpiśata ||9||
camasacaturdhākaraṇakāle kimiti satyaṃ vadanto vyabhajanniti tadāha |
2 āpo bhūryiṣṭhāḥ 3 iti 4 abravīt nahi udakāt praśastaṃ lokopakārakaṃ tattvāntaramasti |
apāmeva śreṣṭhatvam ‘apa eva sasarjādau’ (manu. 1. 8) ityādi- śāstrāt |
āntaraṃ bāhyaṃ ca dāhapākabhukjaraṇā- divyāpāreṇa agnereva jagannirvāhakaratvādagnereva bhūryiṣṭhatvam ityeva manyate |
vadha- riti rephāntaḥ api 6 vajranāma, ‘vadhaḥ arkaḥ ’ (ni. 2. 20. 7) iti tannāmasu pāṭhāt |
yadyapīyaṃ svavadhārthaṃ vajraṃ svayameva nāpekṣate tathāpi vṛṣṭyartham indravatreṇa 9 hyyamānatvāt tadicchatītyupacaryate |
bahubhyaḥ tepāmarthāya vadhryantīṃ vadhamātmana icchantīṃ bhūmim |
tāmeva 7 ekaḥ 8 bahubhyaḥ saṃvādibhyaḥ 6 śreṣṭhatām 7 abravīt |
evam 7 ṛtā ṛtāni uktarūpāṇi yathārthāni vākyāni 8 vadantaḥ parasparaṃ bruvantaḥ 9 camasān 7 arpiśata avayavino'kuruta caturdhā vyabhajata ityarthaḥ |
idameva ṛtavadanam apekṣya ṛbhuśabdaṃ vyācakṣāṇo yāskaḥ- ‘ṛbhava uru bhāntīti vartena bhāntīti vartena bhavantīti vā’ (niru. 11. 15) ityuktatvāt |
śroṇāmekaṃ udakaṃ gāmavāṃjati māṃsamekaḥ piṃśati sunayābhṛtam |
ā nimucaḥ śukadeko apārbharatika sviṃtaputrebhyaḥ pitarā upāvatuḥ ||
śroṇām | ekaḥ | udakam | gām | ave | ajati | māṃsam | ekaḥ | piṃśati | sunayā | ā'bhṛtam | ā | ni'mṛcaḥ | śukat | ekaḥ | apa | abharat | kim | svit | putrebhyaḥ | pitarau | upa | āvatuḥ || 10 ||
atra ṛbhava eva ṛtvigrūpeṇa sthitvā sarvatra yajñaṃ nirvahantītyāha |
śoṇavarṇam 7 udakaṃ rudhiram 8 ekaḥ ṛbhuṣu madhye ṛtvik 7 gām
8. ṅa-tāmeva ekaṃ (?) bahubhyaḥ avādibhyaḥ; kṣa-ja-ṭa-tāmeva ekaḥ bahubhyaḥ avādibhyaḥ |

tathā ^eka: ^māṃsaṃ ^sūjayā chedanasādhanena svadhitinā ^ābhṛtaṃ saṃpāditaṃ ^piśati hṛdayajihvākṣabhakṣādhākāreṇa āhataṃ saṃpāditaṃ māṃsaṃ piśati avayavīkaroti svadhitinā tatadavayavān vibhajatītyarthaḥ |
atha ^eka: ^ninnuca: niḥśeṣeṇa chinnāt māṃsāt ^śakṛt kukṣisyaṃ jarattaṇam ubadhyanāmakam ^apābharat apāharannirasanāya |
evamvidhūpeṇa sthitebhyaḥ ^putrebhyaḥ purutrātṛbhyaḥ putrasthānīyebhya ṛbhubhyaḥ sarveṣvanuṣṭhiteṣu ^pitarā yajñasya pālayitārau jāyāpatī ^kiṃ ^svit ^upāvataḥ kiṃ nu khalu prābhṛtaḥ ||
aparaḥ sūnayā māṃsavikriyeṇa ābhṛtaṃ saṃpāditaṃ māṃsaṃ piśati |
apara ā ninnucaḥ astamayādarvāgeva śakṛt gopurīṣaṃ harati |
evam ṛbhubhiranuṣṭhite sati kiṃ khidetasmāt paricaraṇāt anyat putrebhyaḥ sakāśāt upāvataḥ upagacchetāmiti ||
ud‌tas‌vasmā akṛṇotanā tṛṇai nivatas‌vapaḥ svapasyayā naraḥ |
agauhasya yadasastanā gṛhe tadaghedamabhavo nānaṃ gacchatha ||
ud‌ta'su | asmai | akṛṇotan | tṛṇam | nivata'su | apaḥ | suḍa'apasyayā | naraḥ | agauhasya | yat | asastana | gṛhe | tat | agha | idam | abhavaḥ | na | anu | gacchatha || 11 ||
purāṇaprasiddhān^ sudhanvanaḥ putrān karmaṇā devaratvaṃ prāsavataḥ ṛbhūn stutvā vedaprasiddhayā sūrya-raśmarūpān ṛbhūn idānīṃ stauti |

tathā ca yāsko nirukte purāṇaprakriyāsiddhānṛbhūn bahudhā nirucya tadudāharaṇatvena^ 'viṣṭī śamī' ityetāmudāhrāya 'ādityaraśmayo'pyṛbhava ucyante' (niru. 11. 16) ityuktvā tasminnarthe etāmṛcamudājahāra |
he ^ṛbhavaḥ uru prabhūtaṃ bhāsamānāḥ ṛtena ādityena bhāsamānā vā ṛtenodakena udakārthamupagantā^ vā |
udakārthaṃ bhavanamapi raśmīnāṃ dharmakāle bhūmigatāṃ sāramādāya punaḥ varṣakāle^ pravarṣantīti prasiddham |
tathāvidhāḥ ^naraḥ prakāśavṛṣṭyudakādernetāraḥ : yūyam ^ud‌tasu ukteṣu pradeśeṣu mervādiṣu ^tṛṇaṃ vrīhyādidirūpam ^asmai prāṇijātāya tadupakārārtham ^akṛṇotan kṛtavantaḥ stha ||
tathā ^nivarasu pravaṇadeśeṣu asmai eva ^apaḥ udakāni akṛṇotan akurūta |
śobhanaṃ karma ebhiḥ kṛtamiti yathā^ yajamānāḥ stuvanti tadicchetyarthaḥ |
kiṃca yūyam ^agauhasya agrāhasyādityasya ^gṛhe maṇḍale ^yat yāvatkālam ^asastana suptavantaḥ stha rātrī nirvyāpārāstiṣṭhatha ||
^tat tāvantaṃ kālam ^agha ahani ^idam idānīṃ ^nānu ^gacchatha anusṛtya na gacchatha |
yāvantaṃ kālaṃ rātrī sūrye nigūḍhā vartante tāvantameva kālam ahantyapi nānugacchathetyarthaḥ |

agopanīyasya tasya gṛhe antarikṣe yat yāvat kālam asastana vṛṣṭim adṛṣṭvā svāpama kuruta tattāvantaṃ kālam adyadānīṃ varṣasamaye idaṃ sasyābhivardhanavṛṣṭipravāha rūpaṃ karma nānu gacchatha anusṛtya na prāpnutha |
yāvantaṃ kālaṃ vivarṣatha tāvantameva kālaṃ pravarṣathetyarthaḥ ||
saṃsimīlya yadbhuvanā paryasarpat ka svittātyā pitarā va āsatuḥ |
arśapat yaḥ kurasnaṃ va ādade yaḥ prābravītpro tasmā abravītana ||
saṃsimīlya | yat | bhuvanā | pari'asarpat | ka | svit | tātyā | pitarā | vaḥ | āsatuḥ | arśapat | yaḥ | kurasnam | vaḥ | ā'dade | yaḥ | pra | abravīt | pro iti | tasmai | abravītana ||12||
he ṛbhavaḥ raśmayaḥ yūyaṃ yat yadā bhuvanā bhūtajātāni saṃmīlya saṃmīlanaṃ kṛtvā jaladhara- paṭalairācchādya paryasarpata paritaḥ sarpaṇaṃ kurutha varṣathetyarthaḥ |
tātyā tatkā- līnau pitarā jagataḥ pālakau sūryācandramasau ka svit āsatuḥ kutra khalu tiṣṭhataḥ |
kiṃca īdṛśān vaḥ yuṣmān yaḥ ko'pi vṛṣṭipratibandhakārī rākṣasādiḥ kurasnam |
yuṣmadīyaṃ hastam ādade gṛhṇāti pratirodhaṃ karoti tam arśapat nāśayatha |
yaḥ ca prābravīt prakarṣeṇa vācā nirunde tasmai pro naiva abravītana prakarṣeṇa bhartsanādiśabdaṃ kurutha |
yo nūnaṃ stauti taṃ prakarṣeṇa stutetyarthaḥ ||
supuṣvāṃsaṃ ṛbhavastadapṛcchatāgohya ka idaṃ nau abubudhat |
supuṣvāṃsaḥ | ṛbhavaḥ | tat | apṛcchata | agohya | kaḥ | idam | naḥ | abubudhat | śrānam | bastaḥ | bodhayitāram | abravīt | saṃvatsare | idam | adya | vi | ahyata ||13||
he ṛbhavaḥ raśmyātmakāḥ yūyaṃ supuṣvāṃsaḥ ādityamaṇḍale svapanto varṣaṇāya |
tamādityaṃ tat vākyam apṛcchata praśnaṃ kurutha |
he agohya kenacidagopanīyāditya svāmin naḥ asmadīyam idaṃ karma varṣaṇarūpaṃ kaḥ abubudhat bodhayati prerayati sāhāyyaṃ karoti |
bodhayitāraṃ prerayitāraṃ śrānam abravīt antarikṣe śvasantaṃ vāyuṃ prāvādīt |
atha vāyusahāyyena varṣanto yūyaṃ saṃvatsare pūrṇe adya idānīm idaṃ jagat vyaruhyata vividhaṃ prakāśitavantaḥ |
pūrvaṃ sūryācandramasau yathā na dṛśyete tathā varṣivā idānīṃ varṣakāle'tīte viśvaṃ jagat vyaktaṃ kuruthetyarthaḥ |
divā yānti maruto bhūmyāgirayaṃ vātau antarikṣeṇa yāti |
adriyānti varuṇaḥ samudrayuṣmā icchantaḥ śavaso napātaḥ ||
divā | yānti | marutaḥ | bhūmyā | agniḥ | ayam | vātaḥ | antarikṣeṇa | yāti | adri | yāti | varuṇaḥ | samudraiḥ | yuṣmān | icchantaḥ | śavasaḥ | napātaḥ || 14 ||
he śavasaḥ vṛṣṭikārakasya balasya napātaḥ napātayitāraḥ ṛbhavaḥ yuṣmān icchantaḥ vṛṣṭyanu- kūlacikīrṣayā yuṣmānevecchantiḥ sarve devā āyānti |
marutaḥ vṛṣṭyanukūlāḥ devāḥ divā ghulokāt yānti āgacchanti ||
bhūmyā bhumeḥ sakāśāt agniḥ yāti āgacchati ||
ayaṃ vātaḥ sarvadā saṃcārī vāyuḥ antarikṣeṇa yāti antarikṣādāyāti |
tathā varuṇaḥ āvarako jalābhimānī devaḥ samudraiḥ samudratvasvabhāvaiḥ adbhiḥ tābhya āyāti |
yadvā pūrvaṃ vṛṣṭisāhāyyāya āgatā ete devāḥ kṛtakāryā
etanmahannāma' indraviśeṣaṇaṃ ‘ṛbhukṣāḥ ukṣā’ ( ni. 3. 3. 10 ) iti tannāmasu pāṭhāt |
‘upā vā aśvasya medhyasya śiraḥ’ ( vṛ. u. 1. 1. 1 ) ityādi- śruteḥ |
evaṃ- vidhasyāśvasya mahānubhāvasya ^vīryāṇi vīrakarmāṇi sāmarthyāni ^vidye vedanasādhane yajñe ^pravakṣyāmaḥ prakarṣeṇa brūmaḥ |
ato mā pari ryan prayuta anugṛhṇantvityarthaḥ ||

yannirṇijā rekaṇasā prāvṛtasya rātiṃ gṛbhītāṃ mukhato nayanti | suprāṅjo memyaddviśtrūpa indrāpūṣṇoḥ priyamparyeti pārthaḥ || 2 || yat | niḥ'nirjā | rekaṇasā | prāvṛtasya | rātim | gṛbhītām | mukhataḥ | nayanti | su'prāṅ | ajaḥ | memyat | viśva'rūpaḥ | indrāpūṣṇoḥ | priyam | arpi | eti | pārthaḥ ||2||
‘nirṇig vatriḥ’ ( ni. 3. 7. 1 ) iti, ‘rekaṇaḥ riktham’ ( ni. 2. 10. 2 ) iti ca tannāmasūktatvāt ||
rūpavatā hiraṇyavatābharaṇena ^prāvṛtasya sarvato veṣṭitasya aśvasya ^mukhataḥ purastāt ^gṛbhītāṃ gṛhītāṃ ^rātiṃ dātavyāṃ dātavyatvena gṛhītām ajāṃ^ 2 ^nayanti ṛtvijaḥ |
^viśvarūpaḥ bahuvarṇopetaḥ kṛṣṇa- grīvaḥ kṛṣṇalalāmo vā naikavarṇaḥ 4 ityarthaḥ |
‘āgneyaḥ kṛṣṇagrīvaḥ’ ( tai. saṃ. 5. 5. 22 ) ityuktatvād agneḥ priyam |

'ubhe hyṛṣirvibhyataḥ' (ṛ. saṃ. 1. 95. 5) ityuktatvāt 'ahorātre iti vāraṇī iti vā' (niru. 8. 15) iti yāskena araṇī bibhyaturityuktatvāt araṇisambandhaḥ agnereveti gamyate |
varvatā araṇavatā aśvena 'saha vsauśravasāya devānāṃ śobhanānnanimittam vabhi 'jinnavati prītihetukaṃ' karoti' |
atrā̭ pū॒ṣṇaḥ pra̭tha॒mo 'bhāga eti ya॒jñaṃ de॒vebhya̭ḥ prati॒veda̭ya॒njaḥ ||

ete sarve ᵥtena prasiddhena ᵥsvaraṃkṛtena suṣṭukaraṇīyaṃ kṛtena svalaṃkṛtena vā uccārasauṣṭhavādinā suṣṭu saṃpāditena ᵥsvena suṣṭu iṣṭena ᵥyajñena ᵥvakṣaṇāḥ abhito ghṛtakulyādīn ᵥpravahaṇasvabhāvāḥ ᵥprasiddhā nadīrvā ᵥā ᵥpṛṇadhvaṃ sarvataḥ pūrayata yajñaṃ samyagbhivartya phalaṃ sādhayatetyarthaḥ ||
yūpavaskā uta ye yūpavāhāśvapālaṃ ye aśvayupāya takṣati |
ye carvate pacanaṃ saṃbharantyuto teṣāmabhibhūtirna invatu ||
yūpa'vaskāḥ | uta | ye | yūpa'vāhāḥ | capālam | ye | aśva'yupāya | takṣati | ye | ca | arvate | pacanam | sam'bharanti | uto iti | teṣām | abhi'bhūtiḥ | naḥ | invatu ||6||
ᵥuta ᵥye ca ᵥyūpavāhāḥ chidrasya voḍhāraḥ |
ᵥye ᵥca ᵥarvate araṇavate aśvaya ᵥpacanaṃ pākasādhanaṃ kāṣṭhabhāṇḍādikaṃ ᵥsaṃbharanti |
ᵥuto api ca ᵥnaḥ asmatsambandhināṃ ᵥteṣām ṛtvijām ᵥabhibhūtiḥ saṃkalpaḥ sarvathā karaṇīyamiti ᵥbuddhiḥ ᵥinvatu vyāpnotu ||
invativyāptivacanaḥ ‘ invati nankṣa ’ iti tadvacaneṣu pāṭhāt ||
upa prāgātsumanamai'dhāyi manma devānāmāśā upa vītapṛṣṭhaḥ |
anvainaṃ viprā ṛṣayo madanti devānāṃ puṣṭe cakrumā subandhum ||
upa | pra | agāt | su'mat | me | adhāyi | manma | devānām | āśāḥ | upa | vīta'pṛṣṭhaḥ | anu | enam | viprāḥ | ṛṣayaḥ | madanti | devānām | puṣṭe | cakruma | su'bandhum || 7 ||
ᵥmanma mananīyaṃ phalaṃ ᵥsumat ᵥupa ᵥprāgāt upaitu |
phalabhūtaḥ aśvaḥ āgataḥ sa ca mayā ᵥghṛtaḥ ᵥityarthaḥ |

ᵥyaḥ ca ᵥāmasya apakasya ᵥkraviṣaḥ māṃsasya ᵥgandhaḥ ᵥasti leśo'sti |
pākasya samaye yatkiṃcidadhyama- pakasya ca leśo'sti āmagandho'sti |
ᵥtat sarvaṃ ᵥśamitāraḥ viśasanakartāraḥ ᵥsukṛtā ᵥkṛṇvantu sukṛtam' uktadoṣarahitaṃ kurvantu |
ᵥuta api ca ᵥmedhaṃ medhyaṃ yajñārhaṃ paśvavayavaṃ ᵥśrṛtapākaṃ devayogyapākopetaṃ yathā bhavati tathā ᵥpacantu pitṛmanuṣyādiyogyam atipakam īṣatpakaṃ ca mā kurvantvityarthaḥ ||
mā tadbhūyāmā śriṣanmā tṛṇeṣu devebhyastaduśaddhayau rātarmastu ||
yat | te | gātrāt | ᵥagninā | ᵥpuṣyamānāt | ᵥabhi | śūlam | ni'hatasya | ava'dhāvati | mā | tat | bhūyām | ā | śriṣat | mā | tṛṇeṣu | devebhyaḥ | tat | uśat'bhyaḥ | ᵥrātam | astu || 11 ||

tathā ᵥnihatasya niḥśeṣeṇa hatasya tava yadaṅgaṃ rasarūpaṃ ᵥśūlam abhilakṣya avadhāvati nirgacchati |
ᵥtat tadaṅgaṃ ᵥbhūmyāṃ ᵥmā ᵥā ᵥśripat āśliṣṭaṃ mā bhūt ||
pākasamaye tathā ᵥmā ᵥtṛṇeṣu viśasanasamaye darbhepu ᵥmā apagacchatu |
nahi tatpatitaṃ kutra gacchatviti cet ucyate |
ᵥtat tādṛśam ᵥuśadbhyaḥ kṛtsnaṃ haviḥ kāmayamānebhyaḥ ᵥdevebhyaḥ ᵥrātaṃ dattam ᵥastu ||
ye vājinaṃ paripaśyanti pakaṃ ya īmāhuḥ surabhinirhareti |

ye | ᵥvājinam | pari'paśyanti | pakam | ye | īm | āhuḥ | surabhiḥ | niḥ | hara | iti | ye | ca | arvataḥ | māṃsa'bhikṣām | upa'āsate | uto iti | teṣām | abhi'gūrtiḥ | naḥ | invatu || 12 ||
ᵥye ᵥpakaṃ ᵥvājinam aśvam aśvāvayavaṃ ᵥparipaśyanti paritaḥ pāvanabuddhyā³ ᵥīkṣante |
ᵥya ᵥīṃ ye cainaṃ ᵥsurabhiḥ⁵ śobhanagandhaḥ ᵥataḥ ᵥnihaṃra kiṃcidapyasmabhyaṃ dehi ᵥiti ᵥāhuḥ |

'ukhāyāḥ sthālyāḥ 'nīkṣaṇaṃ pākaparīkṣāsādhanaṃ kāṣṭhaṃ tathā 'yā yāni 'pātrāṇi 'yūṣṇaḥ rasasya kathitasya 'āsecanāni āsecanasādhanāni tathā 'ūṣmaṇyā ūṣmannivāraṇārhāṇi pātrāṇi tathā 'carūṇāṃ pātrāṇāṃ māṃsapūrṇānām 'apidhānā api- dhānāni tatsādhanāni tathā 'aṅgāḥ hṛdayādyavayavaṅganasādhanāḥ 'vetasaśākhāḥ 'sūnāḥ avadāna- sādhanāḥ svadhityādayaḥ etam 'aśvam aśvāvayavaṃ 'pari 'bhūṣanti parito bhūṣayanti svasvavyāpāreṇa mādhyantītyarthaḥ |

iṣṭaṃ vītamibhigūrtaṃ varṣaṭkṛtaṃ taṃ devāsaḥ prati gṛbhṇantyaśvam ||
mā | tvā | agniḥ | dhvanayīt | dhūma'gandhiḥ | mā | ukhā | ārjantī | abhi | vitta | jaghniḥ | iṣṭam | vītam | ami'gūrtam | varṣaṭ'kṛtam | tam | devāsaḥ | prati | gṛbhṇanti | aśvam || 15 ||
he aśva tvā tvā dhūmagandhiḥ dhūmena vyāptaḥ agniḥ mā dhvanayīt mā dhvanayat |
he pacyamānā- śrāvayava tvā tvāṃ dhūmagandhirdharmā dhvanayīt |
kiṃca ārjantī atyantābhisaṃyogena dīptā ukhā sthālī mā abhi vitta abhito mā cīcalat tāpāti- śayena mā nīnaśadityarthaḥ ||
taṃ tādṛśam aśvam iṣṭaṃ hotṛmipitaṃ vītaṃ homāya ānītam abhigūrtam ābhimukhyena pradānāya udyatam ||
iṣṭaṃ prayājairāprītaṃ vītaṃ paryagnikṛtamabhi- gūrtaṃ ‘ye yajāmahe ’ ityāgūryuktam |
vaṣaṭkṛtaṃ vaṣaṭkāreṇa devasaṃskṛtam evaṃbhūtaṃ taṃ devāsaḥ devāḥ prati gṛbhṇanti pratigṛhṇanti ||
yat | aśvāya | vāsaḥ | upa'stṛṇanti | adhīvāsam | yā | hiraṇyāni | asmai | sam'dānam | arvantam | padīṃśam | priyā | deveṣu | ā | yamayanti || 16 ||

tathā asmai aśvāya yā yāni hiraṇyāni sauvarṇarājatakāṃsyāni kalpayanti |
arvato'śvasya saṃdānaṃ śirobandhanaṃ padīṃśaṃ pādeṣu praviṣṭaṃ pādabandhanam |

pathibhiḥ śobhanagamanasādhanairmāgaiḥ devayānalakṣaṇaiḥ devān it api devāneva prāpnoṣi|
te tvāṃ voḍhuṃ harī etannāmānau indrasyāśvau te tava yukjā rathe yuktau abhūtāṃ bhaviṣyataḥ|
tathā pṛṣatī pṛṣatau mahatāṃ vāhanabhūtau yukjā abhūtāṃ yuktau bhaviṣyataḥ|
tathā rāsabhasya aśvavāhanasya etannāmakasyāśvasya bhuri sthāne vartamānaḥ kaścit vājī upāsthāt upasthāsyati vahatītyarthaḥ|
rāsabhasya bhānoḥ dhuri vartmani yukto vājī aśvaḥ upasthāsyati devatvaṃ gacchatastatra gamanāya indrāyathaḥ svasvavāhanāni preṣayantītyarthaḥ|
tattadevabhāvamāpannaṃ tvāṃ tāni tāni vāhanāni vahanti||
upākaraṇakāle avaghrāṇavartane yadyaśvo na kuryāt tadaiṣā naimittikī yajamānavācanāthāṃ bhavati|
tathā ca sūtritaṃ- 'sugavyaṃ no vājī svaśvyamiti yajamānaṃ vācayet' (āśva. śrau. 10. 8) iti||
sugavyaṃ no vājī svaśvyaṃ puṃsaḥ putrān uta viśvāpuṣaṃ rayim|
anāgāstvaṃ no aditiḥ kṛṇotu kṣatraṃ no aśvo vanatāṃ haviṣmān||

uta api ca viśvāpuṣaṃ rayiṃ viśvapoṣaṇasamarthaṃ dhanam|

'yadakrandaḥ' iti trayodaśacaṃ saptamaṃ sūktaṃ dairghatamasaṃ traiṣṭubham|
āśvamedhike madhyame'hani upakaraṇāyāvasthitam aśvam ādhyābhirekādaśabhiḥ stauti|
tathā ca 'trīṇi sutyāni' iti khaṇḍe sūtritaṃ- 'tamavasthitamupākaraṇāya yadakranda ityekadaśabhiḥ stautyapraṇavan' (āśva. śrau. 10. 8) iti||
yadakranda: prathamaṃ jāyamāna udyantsamudrāduta vā purīṣāt |
śyenasya pakṣā hariṇasya bāhū upastutyaṃ mahiṃ jātaṃ tai arvana ||
yat | akranda: | prathamam | jāyamāna: | ut'yan | samudrāt | uta | vā | purīṣāt | śyenasya | pakṣā | hariṇasya | bāhū iti | upa'stutyam | mahi | jātam | te | arvana ||1||
he ˇarvana araṇakuśalāśva ˇte tava ˇjātaṃ janma jamanam ˇupastutyam upetya sarvai: stotavyam ||
udakasamundanāpādānāt ˇyakṣagandharvādiṃsamodanādhikaraṇāt vā antarikṣāt ˇprathamaṃ pūrvaṃ ˇjāyamāna: utpanna: |
'utta ˇvā athavā ˇpurīṣāt sarvakāmānāṃ pūrakāt udakāt prathamam ˇudyan jāyamāna: |
sa tādṛśastvaṃ yat yasmāt ˇakranda: mahāśabdamakaro: yajamānamanugrahītum |
kiṃca te ˇpakṣā patanasādhanau pakṣau ˇśyenasya pakṣāvivaˇ |
yamena dattaṃ trita enamāyunagindraṃ enaṃ prathamo adhyatiṣṭhat |
yamena | dattam | trita: | enam | ayunak | indra: | enam | prathama: | adhi | atiṣṭhat | gandharva: | asya | raśanām | agṛbhṇāt | sūrāt | aśvam | vasava: | ni: | ataṣṭa || 2 ||
ˇyamena niyāmakanāmnā ˇdattam ˇenam aśvaṃ ˇtrita: pṛthivyādiṣu triṣu sthāneṣu vartamāna: strīṇatamo vā vāyu: ˇayunak rathe yojitavān |
kiṃca ˇenam aśvam ˇindra: ˇprathama: prathama: prakṛṣṭatama: |
sa ca asya aśvasya ˇraśanāṃ niyamana- rajum ˇagṛbhṇāt agrahīt |
īdṛśo'śva: kuta: samutpanna: iti cet ucyate |
he ˇvasava: raśmaya: yūyaṃ ˇsūrāt ādityāt ˇaśvam ˇevaṃmahānubhāvaṃ ˇnirataṣṭa ni:śeṣeṇa sādhu saṃpāditavanta: |
yūyaṃ sūrādādityāt aśvam ˇenaṃ nirataṣṭa atakṣata |
1. cha-jha1-udakasamundanāt | 2. cha-jha1-śyenapakṣāviva | 3. kṣa-ṭha-jha1-ja-ṭa-enaṃ mahānubhāvam | 4. kṣa-ṭha-jha1-ja-ṭa-aśvaṃ vyāptam |

asi yamo arkādityo arvanasi trito guhena vratena | asi somena samayā vipṛkta āhuste trīṇi divi bandhanāni || 3 || asi | yamaḥ | asi | ādityaḥ | arvana | asi | tritaḥ | guhena | vratena | asi | somena | samayā | vi'pṛktaḥ | āhuḥ | te | trīṇi | divi | bandhanāni || 3 ||
he arvana tvaṃ yamaḥ asi niyamitā amirasi |
tathā guhena vratena gopanīyayena durnirūpeṇa vā karmaṇā |
tena tritaḥ triṣu sthāneṣu tāyamāno vāyuḥ asi |
athavā guhena vratena gopanīyayena karmaṇā yogādisādhanarūpeṇa trita etannāmakaḥ ṛṣirasi |
kiṃca he aśva tvaṃ somena samayā saha vipṛktaḥ |
he aśva evaṃrūpa te tava divi dhuloke āditye vā vartamānasya trīṇi bandhanāni utpattikāraṇāni āhuḥ purāvidaḥ |

trīṇi ta āhurdivi bandhanāni trīṇyapsu trīṇyantaḥ samudre | uteva me varuṇaśchantasyarvan yatrā ta āhuḥ paramaṃ janitram || 4 || trīṇi | te | āhuḥ | divi | bandhanāni | trīṇi | apsu | trīṇi | antaḥ | samudre | uta'iva | me | varuṇaḥ | chanti | arvana | yatra | te | āhuḥ | paramam | janitram || 4 ||
he arvana te tava divi bandhanāni trīṇi āhuḥ tāni pūrvamuktāni |
tasmin trīṇi vṛṣṭyutpattinimittāni megho vidyut stanitamiti |
api ca he arvana aśva varuṇaḥ pāpasya vārakaḥ phalasyāvarjayitā vā tvaṃ me mahyaṃ chanti kathayasi |
te tava paramaṃ janitraṃ niratiśayaṃ janma ||
yatra yeṣu triṣukteṣu sthāneṣu āhuḥ kathayanti |
3. kṣa-ṅa-jha-1-ja-ṭa- ' gṛhītatvāt ' ityasthānantaraṃ ' yadvā ādityadakṣotpatteruktatvāt tādabhedena aśvo'pyāditya ucyate |
tādṛśatvaṃ candreṇa saha samayā kālena vyavadhāyakena vipṛkto'pi (kṣa-ja-ṭa- vipṛkto viyojitā'si ) ' ityadhikam |
atrā̭ te bha॒drā ra̭śa॒nā a̭paśya॒mṛta̭sya॒ yā a̭bhirakṣanti॒ gopā̭ḥ ||
imā | te | vājin | ava'mārjanāni | imā | śaphānām | saniḥ | ni'dhānā | atra | te | bhadrāḥ | raśanāḥ | apaśyam | ṛtasya | yāḥ | abhi'rakṣanti | gopāḥ || 5 ||

he 'vājin aśva 'te sambandhīni 'avamārjanāni aṅgasaṃśodhakāni sthānāni 'imā imānyuktāni dyulokādīni kiṃca 'sanituḥ yāgasambhaktaḥ tava 'imā imāni 'śaphānāṃ nidhānāni sthānāni2 saṃcāra- pradeśā ityarthaḥ |
kiṃca 'atra eva 'te tava 'bhadrāḥ bhandanīyāḥ kalyāṇāḥ3 'raśanāḥ grīvādiṣu saṃyuktāḥ rajjūḥ atra 'apaśyam eṣūkteṣu sthāneṣu apaśyam |

atrā te rūpamuttamamapaśyaṃ jigīṣamāṇamiṣa ā pade goḥ | yadā te marto anu bhogamānaḻādidagrasiṣṭha oṣadhīrjīgaḥ || 7 || atra | te | rūpam | utta'tamam | apaśyam | jigīṣamāṇam | iṣaḥ | ā | pade | goḥ | yadā | te | marttaḥ | anu | bhogam | ānaṭ | āt | it | grasiṣṭhaḥ | oṣadhīḥ | ajīgariti ||7||
evaṃ gamanānantaraṃ he aśva te tava uttamam uttastvarūpeṇotkṛṣṭatamaṃ rūpam atra asmin yāgadeśe apaśyaṃ paśyāmi |
goḥ bhūmyāḥ pade sthāne devasthāne devayajanapradeśe ājidhāvanasthāne vā iṣaḥ ||
iṣam iṣyamāṇam annam annāni vā ā sarvataḥ jigīṣamāṇaṃ gantumi- cchantam |
he aśva te tava yadā marttaḥ manuṣyaḥ bhogaṃ bhoktavyamannam anu ānaṭ ||
ādit anantaraṃ tadānīmeva tadanugrahāt vilambamakṛtvā grasiṣṭhaḥ mahāntṛṇayeva grasitutamaḥ bhakṣayitutamaḥ san oṣadhīḥ annāni ajīgaḥ bhakṣayasi |
mahānu- bhāvo'pi tvaṃ laukikāśvavat tucchena puruṣeṇa dīyamānaṃ svalpaṃ bhakṣyam anugrahāt svīkaroṣītyarthaḥ ||

anu tvā ratho anu maryo arvananu gāvo'nu bhagaḥ kunīnām | anu vātāstvaṃ sakhyamīyuranu devā mamire vīryaṃ te || 8 || anu | tvā | rathaḥ | anu | maryaḥ | arvana | anu | gāvaḥ | anu | bhagaḥ | kunīnām | anu | vātāsaḥ | tava | sakhyam | īyuḥ | anu | devāḥ | mamire | vīryam | te || 8 ||
idānīṃ kṛtsnasya lokasyāpi mukhyaḥ iti prataupādayati |
he arvana gamanaśīlāśva tvā tvām anu anusṛtya rathaḥ gacchati |
tathā maryaḥ martyaḥ tvā tvām anu ||
tathā kanīnāṃ kanyakānāṃ strīṇāṃ bhagaḥ bhāgyaṃ saundaryaṃ tvadaṅgam anu |
tathā vātāsaḥ vātāḥ saṃghāramakāḥ anye aśvasamūhāḥ vasvādi- devagaṇāḥ vā tvām anu anusṛtya tava sakhyam īyuḥ sakhibhāvaṃ gacchanti |
devāḥ ṛtvijo dyotamānā devā vā tvāmanusṛtya te vīryaṃ vīrakarma mamire stutyā mānti |
ataḥ sarvoḍapi tvām anusaraḥ tvaṃ tu sarvasya śreṣṭha ityarthaḥ ||

hiraṇyaśṛṅgo'yau asya pādā manojavā avara indra āsīt | devā idastasya haviradyamāyanyo arventaṃ prathamo adhyatiṣṭhat || 9 || hiraṇya'śṛṅgaḥ | aryaḥ | asya | pādāḥ | manaḥ'javāḥ | avaraḥ | indraḥ | āsīt | devāḥ | it | asya | haviḥ'adyam | āyan | yaḥ | arventam | prathamaḥ | adhi'atiṣṭhat ||9||
ayamaśvaḥ ᵥhiraṇyaśruḥ hitaramaṇīyaśruo vā unnataśirasko hṛdayaramaṇaśrusthānīyaśiroruho vā ᵥasya ᵥpādāḥ ᵥayaḥ ayomayāḥ ayaḥpiṇḍasadṛśā ityarthaḥ |
īdṛśasyāśvasya sāmarthya prati manovegaḥ ᵥindraḥ api ᵥavaraḥ nikṛṣṭaḥ ᵥāsīt |
kiṃca ᵥasya aśvasya ᵥhavirayaṃ haviṣaḥ adanaṃ bhakṣaṇam |
adanayogyaṃ havirvā apekṣya ᵥdevā ᵥit sarve'pi devāḥ ᵥāyana prāptāḥ |
ᵥyaḥ indraḥ ᵥarvantaṃ 1 prathamaḥ prathamabhāvī san ᵥadhyatiṣṭhat adhiṣṭhitavān svahaviṣyena 2 svakīyatvena vā āśritavānityarthaḥ |
īrmāntāsaḥ silikamadhyamāsaḥ saṃ śūraṇāso divyāso atyāḥ |
īrma'antāsaḥ | silika'madhyamāsaḥ | sam | śūraṇāsaḥ | divyārsaḥ | atyāḥ | haṃsāḥ'iva | śreṇiśaḥ | yatante | yat | ākṣipaḥ | divyam | ajmam | aśvāḥ || 10 ||
ᵥīrmāntāsaḥ īritāḥ preritāḥ antāḥ yeṣāṃ te tathoktāḥ |
ᵥsilikamadhyamāsaḥ saṃsṛtāḥ saṃgatāḥ madhyapradeśāḥ yeṣāṃ te tathoktāḥ |
tādṛśaḥ pṛthuḥ anto jaghanapradeśo yeṣāṃ te tādṛśāḥ |
saṃsṛtaḥ saṃgataḥ saṃlagno madhyabhāgo yeṣāṃ te tādṛśāḥ |
śīghradhāvanāya śreṇiśaḥ paṅktībhūya ᵥsaṃ ᵥyatante samyak yatnaṃ kurvanti |
te yathā śreṇībhūtāḥ īrmāntāsaḥ ityādyuttarūpāḥ santaḥ antarikṣe gamanāya yatante tadvat |
ᵥyat yadā ᵥaśvāḥ ᵥdivyam ᵥajmaṃ gamanaṃ gantavyaṃ vā mārgam ᵥākṣipaḥ dhyāpnuvanti tadā |
ayaṃ mantro yāskenaiva vyākhyātaḥ--‘īrmāntāḥ samīritāntāḥ pṛthvantā vā silikamadhyamāḥ saṃsṛtamadhyamāḥ śīrṣamadhyamā vā api vā śira ādityo bhavati yadanuśete sarvāṇi bhūtāni madhye caiṣāṃ tiṣṭhati |
śūraḥ śavatergatikarmaṇe divyā divijā atyā atanāḥ |
śreṇiśaḥ iti śreṇī śrayateḥ samāśritā bhavanti |

tava śarīraṃ patayiṣṇvarvatava cittaṃ vātaiva dhajīmān | tava śṛṅgāṇi viṣṭhitā purutrāraṇyeṣu jarbhurāṇā caranti || 11 || tava | śarīram | patayiṣṇu | arvan | tava | cittam | vātaḥiva | dhajīmān | tava | śṛṅgāṇi | vi'sthitā | puru'trā | araṇyeṣu | jarbhurāṇā | caranti || 11 ||
he arvan tava śarīraṃ patayiṣṇu patanaśīlaṃ vyāptamityarthaḥ |
tathā tava cittaṃ manaḥ vāta- iva dhajīmān śīghragamanavāyuriva tadvacchīghragamanaanukūlamityarthaḥ |
kiṃca tava śṛṅgāṇi śiraso nirgatāḥ śṛṅgasthānīyāḥ keśāḥ purutrā puru bahuṣu pradeśeṣu viṣṭhitā viṣṭhitāni vividhaṃ sthitāḥ |
kiṃca ta eva araṇyeṣu jarbhurāṇā manoharaṇi pūryamāṇāni vā evaṃbhūtāḥ keśāḥ caranti |
atra aśvasya śṛṅgābhāvāt taddujñatāni tejāṃsi parigṛhyante ||
āśvamedhike madhyame'hani adhrigupraiṣe ' mā no mitraḥ ' iti sūkkānantaram ' upa prāgācchasanam ' iti dve ṛcau śaṃsanīye |
sūtritaṃ ca- ' upa prāgācchasanamiti dve ' ( āśva. śrau. 10. 8 ) iti ||

upa prāgācchasanaṃ vājayarvā devadrīcā manasā dīdhyānaḥ | ajaḥ puro nīyate nābhirasyānu paścātkavayau yanti rebhāḥ || 12 || upa | pra | agāt | śasanam | vājī | arvā | devadrīcā | manasā | dīdhyānaḥ | ajaḥ | puraḥ | nīyate | nābhiḥ | asya | anu | paścāt | kavayaḥ | yanti | rebhāḥ ||12||
ayam arvā araṇakuśalaḥ vājī aśvaḥ śasanaṃ viśāsanasthānam upa prāgāt upapraiti |
devadrīcā manasā devān gacchatā manasā dīdhyānaḥ dhyāyan |
devān asmadavayavena arcāmi devatvaṃ prāpnomīti vā manasi dhyāyan |
kiṃca asya puraḥ purastāt nābhiḥ nahanaṃ bandhubhūta ityarthaḥ |
evaṃbhūtaḥ ajaḥ puraḥ nīyate purataḥ prāpyate anu anusṛtya paścāt anantaram |
atra yadyapyubhayoḥ paryavasito'rthaḥ eka eva tathāpi ajāśvobhayāna- taryavaprakaṭanāya padadvayam |
kavayaḥ anucānāḥ rebhāḥ stotāraḥ ṛtvijaḥ yanti gacchanti |
' ye vā anūcānāste kavayaḥ ' iti śruteḥ |
kavaya iti medhāvināma, ' kaviḥ manīpī ' ( ni. 3. 15. 10 ) iti tannāmasu paṭhitatvāt |
rebhaḥ iti stotṛnāma, ' rebhaḥ jaritā ' ( ni. 3. 16. 1 ) iti tatra pāṭhāt ||
upa prāgātparamaṃ yatsadhasthamarvāk accha pitaraṃ mātaraṃ ca |
adyā devāñjuṣṭatamo hi gamyā athā śāste dāśuṣe vāryāṇi ||
upa | pra | agāt | paramam | yat | sadha'stham | arvāk | accha | pitaram | mātaram | ca | adya | devān | juṣṭa'tamaḥ | hi | gamyāḥ | atha | ā | śāste | dāśuṣe | vāryāṇi ||13||
yat paramam utkṛṣṭaṃ sadhasthaṃ sahasthānaṃ sukṛtibhirekanivāsayogyaṃ svargākhyaṃ yadasti tat |
pitaraṃ mātaraṃ ca accha ābhimukhyena prāptum |
he aśva adya asmin kāle juṣṭatamaḥ prītatamaḥ svargaṃ prāpnomīti harṣayuktaḥ ityarthaḥ |
hiśabdo yajñe upayuktasya pakṣoḥ svargaprāpteḥ ‘sabharyo'nu sakhā sayūthyaḥ ’ (tai. saṃ. 1. 2. 4. 2 ) ityādimantrāntaraprasiddhadyotanārthaḥ |
yadvā puruṣasya vyayasya ā śāste prārthaye yajamānārtham ||

atreyamanukramaṇikā—‘asya dvipañcāśadalpastvaṃ tvetatsaṃśayothāpanapraśnaprativākyānyatra prāyeṇa jñānamokṣākṣarapraśaṃsā ca pañcapādaṃ sākaṃjānāṃ yadvāyatre'yaṃ sa śaṅke sasārdhagarbhā gauririti jagathyaḥ |
etadantaṃ tu vaiśvadevaṃ tasyāḥ samudrā iti vācaḥ samudrā āpo'kṣaraṃ sā prastārapaṅktiḥ śakyamiti śakadhūma ukṣāṇaṃ pṛśnimiti somaḥ |

trayaḥ keśina ityagniḥ sūryo vāyuśca keśinaścatvāri vāgvāca indraṃ mitraṃ sauryo dvādaśeti saṃvatsarasaṃsthaṃ kālacakravarṇanaṃ yaste sarasvatyai yajñena sādhyebhyaḥ parānuṣṭup saurī parjanyābhidevatā vānyā sarasvate sūryā vā’ iti |
asmin sūkte prāyeṇa saṃśayothāpanādayo bahavo'rthāḥ pratipādyante |
‘pañcapādaṃ pitaraṃ’, ‘sākaṃjānāṃ sasathaṃ’, ‘yadvāyatre adhi’, ‘ayaṃ sa śaṅke’, ‘sasārdhagarbhāḥ’, ‘gaurīmimāya’ iti pañcajagatyaḥ |
purataḥ pūrvārdhe dvādaśākṣarī gāyatrī tato dvādaśākṣarī gāyatrī sā prastārapaṅktiḥ iti sūtrārthaḥ |
1. kṣa-na-ṭa-svargaprāptau | 2. kṣa-na-ṭa-puruṣavyayasyaḥ | 3. kṣa-ṅa-jha1-na-ṭa-sūktamalpastvam | 4. ca-bahustvanam | 5. kṣa1-brahmasākṣātkārarūpamokṣasya | ṛ. 123
' samānametat ' ityasyā: sūrya: parjanyo vāgnayo vā devatā |
' divyaṃ suparṇam ' ityasyā: sarasvatī sūryo vā devatā |
kṛtsnasūktasya viniyogaṃ śaunaka āha—'steyaṃ kṛtvā dvijo mohāt trirātropoṣita: śuci: |
sūktaṃ jahavāsyavāmīyaṃ kṣipraṃ mucyeta kilbiṣāt ' (ṛgvi. 1. 144) iti |
mahāvrate vaiśvadeva- śastre vaiśvadevaṃ nividvānaṃ dviprātikam |
pañcamāraṇyake sūtritam—' asya vāmasya palitasya hoturiti salilasya dairghatamasa ekacatvāriṃśat (ai. ā. 5. 3. 2 ) iti |
asya vāmasya palitasya hoturasya bhrātā madhyamo astyaśna: |
tṛtīyo bhrātā ghṛtapṛṣṭho asyātrāpaśyaṃ viśvapatiṃ saptaputram |
‘vāyunā vai gautama sūtreṇāyaṃ ca loka: paraśca loka: sarvāṇi ca bhūtāni saṃkhāāni’ (bṛ. u. 3. 7. 2) iti śrute: |
tadeva pṛṣṭhaṃ sparśakaṃ1 vā yasya sa tādṛśa: |
atra eṣu madhye viśvapatiṃ viśāṃ prajānāṃ patim |
sasaputraṃ sasa lokā: putrā yasya tādṛśam |
sasa rasānāṃ sanamayitāro raśmayo yasya tādṛśaḥ saptarṣibhiḥ stūyamāno vā ādityo vahati dhārayati amayatītyarthaḥ|
tisro nābhisthānīyāḥ saṃdhyāḥ saṃbaddhā vā traya ṛtavo yasya tattādṛśam|
tadviśiṣṭaṃ cakraṃ cakravat punaḥpunaḥ paribhramamāṇaṃ saṃvatsarākhyaṃ cakram ajaraṃ maraṇarahitam²|
na hi kadācidapi kālo mriyate 'anādinidhanaḥ kālaḥ' iti smṛteḥ|
idaṃ saṃvatsarākhyaṃ cakraṃ nānākālāvayavopetam ayamādityaḥ punarāvartayati³|
saṃvatsarādyarthā- cīnānāṃ tatraivāntarbhāvāt tataḥ yugādīnāṃ tadāvṛttisādhyatvāt saṃvatsarasya cakratvena nirūpaṇam|
yatra yasmin cakre imā viśvā bhuvanā imāni sarvāṇi bhūtā

ko dadarśa prathamaṃ jāyamānamasthanvantaṃ yadanusthā bibharti | bhūmyā asurasṛgātmā kva svitko vidvāṃsamupa gātpraṣṭumetat || 4 || kaḥ | dadarśa | prathamam | jāyamānam | asthanvantam | yat | anusthā | bibharti | bhūmyāḥ | asuḥ | asṛk | ātmā | kva | svit | kaḥ | vidvāṃsam | upa | gāt | praṣṭum | etat ||4||

jīvasya bhogārthatvāt paramātmanā’ sṛṣṭaiḥ⁹ mahābhūtaiḥ ārabdhatvāt tasyopa- labdhisthānatvācca ubhayorapi samānaḥ |
tādṛśaṃ samānaṃ vṛkṣaṃ pari pasvajāte parivajataḥ āśrayata: |
na ca jīvasya vastutaḥ īśvaratve kathaṃ jīvabuddhyā saṃsāraśokau iti vācyaṃ tayomohakṛtatvāt |
tathā ca ātharvaṇikāḥ amuṃ mantram āmnāya asya sandehanivartakamuttaraṃ mantramevāmānanti |

yadgāyatre adhi gāyatramāhitaṃ traiṣṭubhādvā traiṣṭubhaṃ niratakṣata | yadvā jagajjagatyāhitaṃ padaṃ ya ittadviduste amṛtatvamānaśuḥ || 23 || yat | gāyatre | adhi | gāyatram | ā'hitam | traiṣṭubhāt | vā | traiṣṭubham | niḥ'atakṣata | yat | vā | jagat | jagati | ā'hitam | padam | ye | it | tat | viduḥ | te | amṛta'tvam | ānaśuḥ || 23 ||
adhi upari tatra gāyatram āgneyaṃ padam āhitam |
prathamasṛṣṭatvāt gāyati trāyate ca iti vyutpattyā ca prajāpatermukhāt gāyatryā saha utpannatvāt bhaktyā agnirapi gāyatraḥ |

tathā ^traiṣṭubhāt dvitīyatvāt vṛṣṭijanyavidyudrūpatriṣṭobhayuktāt antarikṣāt ^traiṣṭubhaṃ stobhayuktam' ūrdhvādhastiyryallakṣaṇa- stomatrayopetaṃ vāyuṃ ^niratakṣata sādhu saṃpāditavanto devāḥ iti yadagni |
^vā athavā ^jagati sarvairgantavye unnatatame vā tṛtīyabhūte dyuloke ^jagat gamanaśīlam ādityākhyaṃ ^padam ^āhitam iti ^yat asti |
^tat idaṃ triṣu sthāneṣu trayāṇāmagnyādīnāṃ padādhānaṃ ^ya ^it ye narāḥ ^viduḥ jānanti ^te eva ^amṛtatvamānaśuḥ amararūpaṃ padamāpnuvanti |
gāyatre prātaḥsavane adhi upari gāyatraṃ chandaḥ padamāhitamiti yat |
tathā traiṣṭubhāt mādhyaṃdināt savanāt traiṣṭubhaṃ chando niratakṣata tatra āhitamiti yat |
jagati tṛtīyasavane jagat jāgataṃ padamāhitamiti yat |
tattādṛśaṃ savanatrayeṣu chandastrayasaṃsthānaṃ ye narā viduḥ yajamānā viduḥ jānanti te amṛtatvaṃ jñānānuṣṭhānadvāreṇa^ mokṣam ānaśuḥ āmuvanti |
'gāyatraṃ prātaḥsavanaṃ traiṣṭubhaṃ mādhyaṃdinaṃ savanaṃ jāgataṃ tṛtīyasavanam' (tai. saṃ. 2. 2. 9. 5-6) iti śruteḥ |
tādṛśe prātaḥsavane adhi upari gāyatram aṣṭākṣarātmakam āhāvapratigararūpaṃ gāyatraṃ padamāhitam |
tathā hotā 'śaṃsāvom' iti tryakṣareṇa tathā 'śaṃsāmodeṃvom' iti pañcākṣareṇa adhvaryuḥ pratigṛṇāti |
tacca aṣṭākṣaraṃ gāyatrīsadṛśaṃ tasyāḥ api pādasya aṣṭākṣaratvāt |
tathā savanānte^ api śaṃsanānantaram^ 'ukthaṃ vāci' iti

1. ha-jha1-triṣṭobhayuktam; kṣa-ja-ṭa tristobhayuktam | 2. kṣa-la-ṭa-padādhīnam | 3. ca-ityadhi- lokaṃ lokapratipādakam | athādhiyajñaṃ yajñapratipādakam | 4. jha1- athavā | 5. kṣa-u-jha 1 jha-ṭa-jñātvā anuṣṭhānadvāreṇa | 6. kṣa-jha1-ja-ṭa-savanantare'pi hotā svasvānantaram | ka. 125
tathā traiṣṭubhāt mādhyaṃdinasavanāt traiṣṭubham 2 āhāvapratigaraṇarūpaṃ padaṃ niratakṣata ṛtvijaḥ |
tathā mādhyaṃdinasavane hotā 'adhvaryo śoṃsāvom' iti āhvayate ṣaḍakṣareṇa adhvaryuśca 'śaṃsāmodaivom' iti pañcākṣareṇa pratigṛṇāti |

tathā paścādapi śaṃsanānantaramāha 'ukthaṃ vāci indrāya devebhyaḥ' iti |
evaṃ triṣu chandaḥsu triṣu gāyatrādisavaneṣu gāyatrādicchandayapadapratiṣṭhāpanam |
etatsarvam aitareyabrāhmaṇe 'devaviśaḥ kalpayitavyāḥ' (ai. brā. 3. 12 ) iti khaṇḍe vispaṣṭamāmnātam |

evam ajānantaḥ anuṣṭhānemāpi phalaṃ na prāpnuvantītyarthaḥ |

paścādanyonyā taduttarayorgāyati ityatideśataḥ prāptaṃ tisṛṣu gānam |
arka- śabdo jātyabhiprāyaḥ sarvān mantrān gāyatrādibhiḥ chandobhiḥ |

athavā vākaṃ sūktam etāvadbhistriṣṭubhiḥ upanibaddhamidaṃ sūktamiti |

gāyatrasya samidhastisra āhustato mhā pra ririce mahitvā ||
jagato | sindhum | divi | astabhāyat | ratham'tare | sūryam | pari | apaśyat | gāyatrasya | sam'idhaḥ | tisraḥ | āhuḥ | tataḥ | mhā | pra | ririce | mahitvā || 25 ||
tena brahmā sṛṣṭikāle sindhuṃ syandanaśīlamudakasya syandakaṃ vā ādityaṃ divi dyuloke astabhāyan sambhitavān |
‘jāgato vā eṣa ya eṣa tapati’ iti śrutiḥ |
‘rathaṃtare etannāmake sāmni stambhitaṃ sūrya paryapaśyat paridṛṣṭavān prajāpatiḥ |
‘asau vāva svardṛk’ (ai. brā. 4. 10) iti hi śrutiḥ |
‘rathaṃtare prastūyamāne samīlayet svardṛśaṃ prati vīkṣeta’ (tā. brā. 7. 7. 15) iti sāmabrāhmaṇena |
gāyatrasya gāyatryāmutpannasya sāmnaḥ samidhaḥ samidhanāḥ tisraḥ vibhaktīḥ āhuḥ pādatrayamāhurityarthaḥ |
tataḥ hanoḥ mhā balena mahitvā mahattvena pra ririce paricyate |
tasya tisro mūrtīḥ āhuḥ krameṇa aṣṭākṣaraikādaśākṣaradvādaśākṣaraiḥ gāyatrītriṣṭubjagatyātmikāḥ |
yammādevaṃ tatastasmādgāyatrī chandasāṃ kaniṣṭhā satī mhā balena mahattvena pra ririce sarvāṇi chandāṃsyatikrāmati yenaiva balena somamāhṛtavatī tādṛśenaiva bhavanti ||
pravarye gharmadhugāhvānakāle ‘upa hvaye’ ityādike dve ṛcau |
‘upa hvaye sudughāṃ dhunametāmiti dve’ (āśva. śrau. 4. 7) iti sūtritatvāt ||
sa ca madhyāhrakālīnaḥ tasminkāle sūryaḥ tejasvī dṛśyate |
taṃ ca karmakāle sarvadā vā janaḥ (ṅa-janāḥ) paripaśyati (ṅa-paripaśyanti) |
