yasmādevaṃ tasmāt va te eva va vipaścitaḥ buddhiyuktāḥ va paribhuvaḥ sarvatra vyāsāśca va yadvā |
sapta mahadahaṃkārau pañca tanmātrāṇīti militvā saptasaṃkhyāni tattvāni |
kāraṇabhūtāni tānyeva viṣṇoryāstasya puruṣasya vidharmeṇi pradiśā pradeśena tiṣṭhanti |
na vi jānāmi yadidamasmi ninyaḥ saṃnaddho manasā carāmi |
na | vi | jānāmi | yat'iva | idam | asmi | ninyaḥ | sam'naddhaḥ | manasā | carāmi | yadā | mā | ā | agan | prathama'jāḥ | ṛtasya | āt | it | vācaḥ | aṃśuve | bhāgam | asyāḥ || 37 ||
ahaṃ va yadivedaṃ yadīdaṃ viśvam va asmi kṛtsnaḥ prapañco'pyahamevāsmi |
nāmarūpāṃśam aparamārthaṃ tyaktvā sarvatra anugato'sti bhāti priyabhiti yo'yaṃ saccidānandākāro'sti so'hamasmīti va na va vi va jānāmi |
kārya- kāraṇayorbhedāt kṛtsnaprapañcasyāpi brahmānanyatvena brahmaivāvagame prapañcajātampi svasvarūpameva va bhavati |
‘idaṃ sarvaṃ yadayamātmā’, ‘brahmaivedaṃ sarvaṃ’, ‘ātmaivedaṃ sarvaṃ’, ‘sa īkṣata bahu syāṃ prajāyeya’ ityādi śrutibhyaḥ |
yadidaṃ va yadāparokṣyajñānaṃ sarvaikāmyarūpamānubhavikamasti tadiva va tadevāhamasmi |
ānubhavikaṃ sārvārmyaṃ yadasti tanna vi jānāmi na prāpto'smi |
śāstrajanitaṃ sārvārmyaṃ jātaṃ na tu ānubhavikamityarthaḥ |
va saṃnaddhaḥ avidyākāmakarmmabhiḥ samyagbaddho veṣṭitaḥ ata eva va manasā yukto bhāvanāsahiṣṇunā bahirmukhena vikṣiptena cetasā yuktaḥ saṃcarāmi saṃsāre |
yāsko'pi imaṃ paridevanārthatvenodājahāra ‘athāpi paridevanā kasmāccidvāvān na vi jānāmi yadidamasmi’ (niru. 7. 3) iti |
bahirmukhacetasaḥ va svarūpāparijñānajanitaṃ duḥkhamanyatra śrūyate ‘parāñci khāni
^ṛtasya paramārthasya parasya brahmaṇaḥ ^prathamajāḥ prathamonamepaḥ prathamopannaśritapratyakapravaṇajanitaḥ anubhavaḥ |

sa yadā māṃ māṃ prāpnoti ^ādit anantarameva avyavadhānena ^asyāḥ ^vācaḥ aikātmyapratipādikāyā upaniṣadvāco yadidamasmītyuktāyā vā ^bhāgaṃ bhajanīyaṃ śabdabrahmaṇā vyāptavyaṃ paraṃ brahmapadam ^aśubhe prāpnomi |
cittasya bahirmukhatāṃ parityajya antarmukha- taiva adhuḥsaṃpādā’ |
sā yadā syāt tadānīmeva svarūpaṃ draṣṭuṃ suśakaṃ bhavati paścādvilambābhāvāt |
yathā giriśikharāt patan pāṣāṇo'vilambena patati tadvat |
cittapratyaṅmukhatvasya duḥśakāvamapi tatraiva śrūyate- ‘ kaściddhīraḥ pratyagātmānamaikṣadāvṛttacakṣuramṛtatvamicchan ’ (ka. u. 2. 4. 1) iti ||
apāṅ prāṅeti svadhayā gṛbhīto'martyo martyena sayoniḥ |
tā śaśvantā viṣūcīnā viyantā nyanyaṃ cikyurna ni cikyuranyam ||
apāṅ | prāṅ | eti | svadhayā | gṛbhītaḥ | amartyaḥ | martyena | sayoniḥ |
tā | śaśvantā | viṣūcīnā | vi'yantā | ni | anyam | cikyuḥ | na | ni | cikyuḥ | anyam ||38||
^amartyaḥ amaraṇadharmā ayamāramā ^martyena maraṇadharmaṇā bhūtātmanā dehena ^sayoniḥ samāna- sthānaḥ |
yatra paricchedako deho'sti tatra sarvatra so'yamapi tiṣṭhatītyarthaḥ^2 |
tena gṛhītaḥ san ^apāṅ eti aśukaṃ karmaṃ kṛtvā adho gacchati |

paramātmaiva sūkṣmaśarīropādhikaḥ san nānāvidhakarmaṃ kṛtvā tadbhogāya jīvasaṃjñāṃ labdhvā śarīratrayeṇa saṃbaddho lokāntareṣu saṃcarati sthūlasūkṣmo- bhayaśarīraparigraheṇa loke^6 guṇatrayānvitaḥ san paribhramati |
tathā ca śrūyate- ‘ guṇānvayo yaḥ phala- karmakartā tasyaiva sa copabhoktā |
sa viśvarūpatriguṇacitravartmā prāṇādhipaḥ saṃcarati svakarmabhiḥ ’ (śve. u. 5. 7) iti |
sthūlaśarīrapakṣe'pi sāttvikajāteḥ^8 tatkaraṇānāṃ bhūtasūkṣmāṇāṃ sadbhāvāt tatra śarīrasambandha upapadyate |
^viṣūcīnā iha loke sarvatragamanau ^viyantā tattatphalabhogāya sarvatra lokāntareṣu gacchantau vartate |
tatra narāḥ ^anyaṃ^9 bhūtātmānaṃ ^ni ^cikyuḥ nitarāṃ^10 viśeṣeṇa paśyanti jānanti^11 |
kecana vivekinaḥ kartṛtvabhoktṛtvopeto dehāti- riktaḥ kaścidasti ityanumimate |

1. ṅa-jha1-duḥsaṃpādā | 2. kṣa-jha1-jaṭa-tiṣṭhatītyarthaḥ | 3. kṣa-jha1 a-ṭa-utpattimatasahavāsena | 4. kṣa-jha1-na-ṭa-gṛbhīto gṛhīta ucyate | 5. kṣa-jha1-a-ṭa-sthūla śarīram | 6. kṣa-jha1-na-ṭa-iha loke | 7. ka-jha1-bhūtātmaparamātmānau | 8. kṣa-jha1-na-ṭa-samitajāteḥ sahavāsaḥ; jha1-samatvijāteḥ sahavāsaḥ | 9. ṅa-jha1-bhādhyam | 10. kṣa-jha-ña-niḥśeṣeṇa; jha1-niḥśeṣeṇa nitarām | 11. kṣa-jha1-na-ṭa-jānanti vā |
ṛco akṣare parame vyoman yasmindevā adhi viśve niṣeduḥ |
yastanna veda kimṛcā kariṣyati ya ittadvidusta ime samāsate ||
ṛcaḥ | akṣare | parame | vi'oman | yasmin | devāḥ | adhi | viśve | ni'seduḥ | yaḥ | tat | na | veda | kim | ṛcā | kariṣyati | ye | it | tat | viduḥ | te | ime | sam | āsate || 39 ||
atra ṛkaśabdena ṛkpradhānabhūtāḥ sāṅgāparavidyātmakāścatvāro⁴ vedā ucyante⁵ |
ṛgādīnāmaparavidyātvaṃ muṇḍake śrūyate- 'dve vidye veditavye' iti pratijñāya 'tatrāparā ṛgvedo yajurvedaḥ sāmavedaḥ' (mu. u. 1. 1. 5) ityādinā |
tasyāḥ saṃbandhine akṣare adṛśyādiguṇake⁶ kṣararahite'naśvare nitye sarvatra vyāpte brahmaṇi |

akṣaraśabdasya brahmavācakatvam 'etadvai tadakṣarasya praśāsane gārgi' (bṛ. u. 3. 8) , 'yathā tadakṣaramadhigamyate' (mu. u. 1. 1. 5) , 'yenākṣaraṃ puruṣaṃ veda satyam' (mu. u. 1. 2. 13) ityādi śrutiṣu prasiddham |
⁷sarvairvedaiḥ khalu brahma adhigamyate 'taṃ tvaupaniṣadaṃ puruṣaṃ pṛcchāmi' (bṛ. u. 3. 9. 26) ityādi śruteḥ |
yadyapi itarabhāgānāṃ yāgādiviṣayatvaṃ tathāpi buddhiśuddhayutpādanadvārā⁹ vedasādhanatvena brahmaviṣayatvaṃ bhaviṣyati 'vedānuvacanena brāhmaṇā vividipanti' (bṛ. u. 4. 4. 22) ityādi śruteḥ |
⁷parame utkṛṣte niratiśaye ⁷vyoman vyomani vyomasadṛśe |
niradhiṣṭhā na kasyacidasti svādhyastasya sarvasyādhiṣṭhānatvena rakṣakatvāt |
⁷yasmin paramātmani ⁷viśve sarve ⁷devāḥ ⁷adhi ⁷niṣeduḥ |
utkalakṣaṇe vastuni ṛgupalakṣitāḥ sarve sāṅgā vedāḥ paryavasitā ityarthaḥ |
yo marthaḥ ⁷tat tādṛśaṃ devādīnāṃ svarūpalābhāspadaṃ kṛtsnavedatātparyapratipādyaṃ yadvastu ⁷na ⁷veda na jānāti sa marthaḥ ⁷ṛcā pūrvoktena ṛgādiśabdajālena ⁷kiṃ ⁷kariṣyati |
prayojanābhāvāt sarvasyāpi vedasya naiṣphalyāt iti bhāvaḥ |
athavā yo'kṣarama- vididhvā karmaṇāṃ kartā bhavati yāgādīnanulatiṣṭhati tena kiṃcidapi karma kṛtaṃ na bhavatītyarthaḥ |
⁷ya ⁷it ye eva ⁷tat tattvaṃ ⁷viduḥ jānanti ⁷ta ⁷ime ⁷samāsate te eva ime jñātāraḥ samāsate samyaktiṣṭhanti |
ye viduḥ it ye jānantyeva nānutiṣṭhanti |
matrādadhikānāṃ yāgānāmabhāvāt teṣāmapi phalam etajjñānenaiva prāptaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ |
‘ṛgbhiḥ pūrvāhṇe divi devaḥ’, ‘ādityo vā eṣa etanmaṇḍalaṃ tapati tatra tā ṛcaḥ’ ityādiśruteḥ |
tasya saṃbandhini akṣare parame vyoman ityuktalakṣaṇe brahmaṇa ‘ya eṣo'ntarāditye hiraṇmayaḥ puruṣo dṛśyate’ ityādiśrutyuktasvarūpe yasmin sarve devā dyotamānā raśmayo niṣeduḥ vartante |
ya’ etanna veda saḥ 2 kevalyā ṛcā kiṃ kariṣyati3 |
ye jānanti bhāvayanti ta eva vidvāṃsaḥ samāsate |
bhūmyāṃ sukhena rogādirahitā bhoginaḥ santaścirakālaṃ jīvanti |
ṛco'kṣare ṛgupalakṣitasarvavedasaṃbandhini akṣare praṇavarūpe oṃkāre avināśini sarvavedeṣu vyāpte vā |
praṇavasya sarvavedasāratvaṃ brāhmaṇe śrūyate-‘tanvedānabhyatapattebhyo'bhitastebhyaśca varṇā ajāyantākāra ukāro makāra iti tānekadhā samabharat tadetadomiti’ (ai. brā. 5. 32) iti |
na hi praṇavādadhikaṃ kiṃcinmantrajātamatasti trikālātītasya brahmaṇaḥ pratipādakatvāt |
‘yaccānyat trikālātītaṃ tadapyoṃkāra eva’ (mā. u. 1), ‘omiti brahma’ (tai. ā. 7. 8) ityādiśruteḥ |

vedānāṃ praṇavasya sthānapratinidhibhāvaḥ saṃbandhaḥ ‘ya ṛco'dhīte’ ityādyupakramya ‘yaḥ praṇavamadhīte sa sarvamadhīte omiti pratipadyata etadvai yajurṛyīṃ vidyāṃ pratyeyā vāgetaparamamakṣaram’ (tai. ā. 2. 11. 4) ityādiśruteḥ |
yasmin viśve sarve devā adhi niṣeduḥ |
praṇavasya sarvamantrātmakatvāt mantreṣu sarvadevatānāṃ nivāsāt sarvadevanivāsatvam |
ata eva jīvāpekṣayā parame utkṛṣṭe nirupādhike vyoman viśeṣeṇa sarvādhiṣṭhānatvena rakṣe vyomasadṛśe vā |
yasmin paramātmani devā gamanavanto vyavaharanti5 vā indriyasaṃjñakā viśve sarve'dhi niṣeduḥ niṣīdanti āśritya vartante |
yastatra veda na jānāti upādhyaṃśaparityāge tadeva svarūpamiti na paśyati sthūlaḥ6 janaḥ kimutrā kariṣyati |
kevalena jīvena7 jīvabhāvena7 kiṃ phalaṃ prāpsyati |
agnihotrārthā dhenuryadikutsitaṃ śabdaṃ kuryāt tadānīṃ ‘sūyavasāt’ ityanayā yavasādikaṃ prayacchet |
tathā ca sūtritaṃ-‘vāśyamānāya yavasaṃ prayacchet sūyavasādbhagavatī hi bhūyāḥ’ (āśva. śrau. 3. 11) iti |
sūtritaṃ ca-‘sūyavasādbhagavatī hi bhūyā iti paridadhyāt’ (āśva. śrau. 4. 7) iti ||

4. kṣa-jha-1-ja-ṭa-jīvaparameśvarayoḥ aupādhikāṃśāṃśavicchinnajñānavicchinnābhāsanivāsādibhāvaḥ (jha-aupā- dhikasyavicchinnāvābhāsavimbadibhāvaḥ) saṃbandhaḥ sopādhikasya jīvasya saṃbandhini paramātmanītyarthaḥ |

suyavasādbhagavatī hi bhūyā atho vayaṃ bhagavantaḥ syāma | addhi tṛṇamaghnye viśvadānīṃ piba śuddhamudakamācarantī || 40 || suyavasa'at | bhaga'vatī | hi | bhūyāḥ | atho iti | vayam | bhaga'vantaḥ | syāma | addhi | tṛṇam | aghnye | viśva'dānīm | piba | śuddham | udakam | ā'carantī || 40 ||
ahanīyate he gauḥ tvaṃ ᵥsuyavasāt śobhanayavastasya tṛṇādikasya attrī satī ᵥbhagavatī |
ᵥatho anantarameva ᵥvayaṃ yajamānā api ᵥbhagavantaḥ 'prabhūtaṃ dhanena tadvantaḥ ᵥsyāma |
atha ekavāraṃ pūrvamuktamidānīṃ sarvadā kartavyamiti prārthyate |
ᵥviśvadānīṃ viśvakālaṃ sarvadā ᵥtṛṇam ᵥaddhi bhakṣaya |
ᵥācarantī sarvatoᵥ nirgacchantī ᵥśuddhaṃ nirmalam ᵥudakaṃ ᵥpiba |
atha mantro yāskenaiva vyākhyātaḥ- ' suyavasādinī bhagavatī hi bhavāyedānīṃ vayaṃ bhagavantaḥ syāmāddhi tṛṇamaghnye sarvadā piba ca śuddhamudakamācarantī' (niru. 11. 44) iti ||

gaurīrmimāya salilāni takṣatyekapadī dvipadī sā catuṣpadī | aṣṭāpadī navapadī babhūyuṣī sahasrākṣarā parame vyoman || 41 || gaurīḥ | mimāya | salilāni | takṣatī | eka'padī | dvi'padī | sā | catuḥ'padī | aṣṭā'padī | nava'padī | babhūyuṣī | sahasra'akṣarā | parame | vi'omana || 41 ||
ᵥekapadī ekapādopetā ekādhiṣṭhānā meghe vartamānā gamanasādhanena vāyunā ekapadā vā ᵥdvipadī meghāntarikṣābhyadhiṣṭhānā |
atha ᵥaṣṭāpadī digdipekṣayā aṣṭādopetā aṣṭādhiṣṭhānā ᵥnavapadī uparidipekṣayā sūryeṇa ᵥvā ᵥnavadidhiṣṭhānā ᵥbabhūyuṣī evaṃbhūtā ||
pratiṣṭhātāniᵥ ghaṭādidravyāṇi takṣatī tattadācakaravena niṣpādayantī ekapadī avyākṛtatvena ekapratiṣṭhānāᵥ ekarūpā vā ātmanāᵥ dvipadī susikkabhedena pādadvayavatī catuṣpadī
nāmākhyātopasarganipātabhedena aṣṭāpadī āmantritasahitāṣṭabhedena' aṣṭapadī' navapadī babhūvuṣī sādhyayairaktai- raṣṭabhiḥ' navapadī|

athavā sanābhikeṣu uraḥkaṇṭhādiṣu navasu padeṣu bhavanti paścādbahuvidhābhivyaktimupeyuṣī parame vyoman utkṛṣṭe hṛdayākāśe mūlādhāre sahasrākṣarā anekākāreṇa dhyātā anekadhvaniprakārā bhavatī- tyarthaḥ|

ayaṃ mantraḥ ācāryeṇaiva vyākhyātaḥ-' gaurīmimāya salilāni takṣatī kurvatyekapadī madhyamena dvipadī madhyamena cādityena ca catuṣpadī digbhiraṣṭāpadī digbhiścāntaradigbhiśca navapadī digbhiścāntara- digbhiścākṣareṇa ca sahasrākṣarā bahudakā parame vyomane' ( niru. 11. 40 ) iti|
tasyāḥ samudrā adhi vi kṣaranti tena jīvanti pradiśaścatasraḥ|
tasyāḥ| samudrāḥ| adhi| vi| kṣaranti| tena| jīvanti| pradiśaḥ| catasraḥ| tataḥ| kṣarati| akṣaram| tat| viśvam| upa| jīvati || 42 ||
vtasyāḥ uktāyā goḥ sakāśāt vsamudrāḥ vṛṣṭyudakasamandanādhikaraṇabhūtā meghāḥ|
vadhi adhikaṃ prabhūtamudakaṃ vvi kṣaranti vividhaṃ kṣaranti|
vtataḥ paścāt tat vakṣaram udakaṃ vkṣarati sasyādikamutpādayatītyarthaḥ|
vtat sasyādikaṃ vviśvaṃ jagat vupa vjīvati|
ayamapi yāskena vyākhyātaḥ--' tasyāḥ samudrā adhivikṣaranti varṣanti meghāstena jīvanti digāśrayāṇi bhūtāni tataḥ kṣaratyakṣaramudakaṃ tatsarvāṇi bhūtānyupajīvanti' ( niru. 11. 41 ) iti|
śakamayam| dhūmam| ārāt| apaśyam| viṣuvatā| puraḥ| enā| avareṇa| ukṣāṇam| pṛśnim| apacanta| vīrāḥ| tāni| dharmāṇi| prathamāni| āsan || 43 ||
vśakamayaṃ śakamayaṃ śuṣkagomayasaṃbhūtaṃ vdhūmam vārāt nātidūre vapaśyam dṛṣṭavānasmi|
divā dhūmasya dūre dṛśyamānatvāt sa eva darśanaviṣayatayā uktaḥ|
vviṣuvatā dhyāsimatā venā anena vavareṇa nikṛṣṭena dhūmena vparaḥ parastāt tatkāraṇabhūtamagnimapaśyam|
kiṃca vukṣāṇaṃ phalasya sektāraṃ vpṛśniṃ śuklavarṇam|
prāpnute tena^ phalamiti svayaṃ prābhuta iti vā pṛśvirlīrūpaḥ somaḥ|
sa ca kriyāsāmānyavacanaḥ atra aucityāt abhipaveṇa saṃpāditavanta ityarthaḥ|
tassādhanāni ᵛdharmāṇi anuṣṭhānāni ᵛprathamāni pratamāni prakṛtāni phalaparyavasāyīni ᵛāsan saṃpāditānyabhavan |
soma ukṣābhavat pūrvaṃ taṃ devāḥ śakṛtāpacan |
yajñārthe taddravo dhūmo megha āsīt taducyate |
trayaḥ keśinaṃ ṛtuthā vi vakṣate saṃvatsare vapata eke eṣām |
viśvamekoṃ abhi caṣṭe śacībhirdhājirekasya dadṛśe na rūpam ||
trayaḥ | keśinaḥ | ṛtuthā | vi | vakṣate | saṃvatsare | vapate | ekaḥ | eṣām | viśvam | ekaḥ | abhi | caṣṭe | śacībhiḥ | dhājiḥ | ekasya | dadṛśe | na | rūpam ||44||
te ca ᵛṛtuthā kālekāle ᵛvi ᵛvakṣate vividhalakṣaṇāṃ bhūmiṃ paśyanti |
ᵛeṣāṃ madhye ᵛekaḥ agniḥ ᵛsaṃvatsare atīte sati saṃvatsaraṃ ᵛvapate dāhena keśasthānīyauṣadhivanaspatyādike 2 chedanaṃ 3 nāpitakāryaṃ karoti |
ᵛekaḥ anyaḥ ādityaḥ ᵛviśvaṃ sarvaṃ jagat ᵛśacībhiḥ svakīyaiḥ prakāśavṛṣṭyādibhiḥ ᵛabhi ᵛcaṣṭe sarvataḥ paśyati |
ᵛekasya vāyoḥ ᵛdhājiḥ gatiḥ ᵛdadṛśe dṛśyate sarvaiḥ ᵛna ᵛrūpam apratyakṣatvāt |
sparśa- śabdadhṛtikampaliṅgaiḥ 4 gamyate 5 iti hi nyāyavido vadanti |

ayamapi mantro yāskena evaṃ vyākhyātaḥ- ‘trayaḥ keśina ṛtuthā vicakṣate kāle kāle'bhivipaśyanti saṃvatsaraṃ vapata eka eṣāmityagniḥ pṛthivīṃ dahati sarvameko'bhivipaśyati karmabhirādityo gatirekasya dṛśyate na rūpaṃ madhyamasya ’ (niru. 12. 27) iti ||
vāgdevasye paśau ‘ catvāri vāk ’ iti haviṣo'nuvākyā |
‘ catvāri vākparimittā padāni yajñena vācaḥ padavīyamāyan ’ (āśva. śrau. 3. 8 ) iti sūtritatvāt ||
catvāri vākparimittā padāni tāni vidurbrāhmaṇā ye manīṣiṇaḥ |
guhā trīṇi nihitā neṅgayanti turīyaṃ vāco manuṣyā vadanti ||
catvāri | vāk | pari'mitā | padāni | tāni | viduḥ | brāhmaṇāḥ | ye | manīṣiṇaḥ | guhā | trīṇi | ni'hitā | na | iṅgayanti | turīyam | vācaḥ | manuṣyāḥ | vadanti || 45 ||
ᵛvāk vācaḥ kṛtsnāyāḥ ᵛpadāni ᵛcatvāri ᵛparimittā parimitāni |
loke yā vāgasti sā caturvidhā vibhaktetyarthaḥ |

he indra 7vṛṣabha varṣitaḥ tvaṃ 7bhūri 7cakrtha prabhūtaṃ kṛtavānasi satyameva |
tathāpi 7asme asmākaṃ 7samānebhiḥ samānaiḥ 7yujyebhiḥ asmābhiryuktaiḥ 7paustyaibhiḥ puṃsaḥ karmabhiḥ sāmarthyaiva cakrtha |
he indra balavattama vayaṃ 7bhūrīṇi 7hi svakṛtādapi prabhṛtāni karmāṇi 7kṛṇavāma kṛtavantaḥ sma |
he marutaḥ yat3 yasyaiva tat tasyaiva bhavatu3 |
tarhi ahaṃ ca yūyaṃ ca sahaiva kratvā karmaṇā yadvaśāma yat vṛṣṭikarmaṃ kāmayāmahe tasmādudakaṃ samānamevetyarthaḥ |
vardhī vṛtraṃ maruta indriyeṇa svena bhāmena taviṣo babhūvān |
ahametā marnave viśvaścandrāḥ sugā apaścakara vajrabāhuḥ ||
vardhīm | vṛtram | marutaḥ | indriyeṇa | svena | bhāmena | taviṣaḥ | babhūvān | aham | etāḥ | marnave | viśvaścandrāḥ | sugāḥ | apaḥ | cakara | vajrabāhuḥ || 8 ||
he 7marutaḥ 7aham6 indraḥ 7indriyeṇa 7svena 7bhāmena kopena 7taviṣaḥ balavān 7babhūvān bhūtaḥ saṃpannaḥ |
7manave manorathāya 7etāḥ 7viśvaścandrāḥ sarvālhādakāḥ 7sugāḥ sugamanāḥ sarvatra nadyādiṣu gamanaśīlāḥ 7apaḥ vṛṣṭyudakani 7cakara cakāra kṛtavānasmi |
svena bhāmena udakavarṣaṇajātakopena (ṅa-jha1-udakavarṣaṇajātakopena ) taviṣo balavān babhūvān |

anuttamā tai maghavankirnu naṃ tvāvā~ asti devatā vidānaḥ | na jāyamāno narśate na jāto yāni kariṣyā kṛṇuhi pravṛddha || 9 || anuttam | ā | te | maghavan | nakiḥ | nu | na | tvāvān | asti | devatā | vidānaḥ | na | jāyamānaḥ | narśate | na | jātaḥ | yāni | kariṣyā | kṛṇuhi | pravṛddha || 9 ||
smṛtavanto vayam idānīṃ ^maghavan ^te tvayā ^anuttam aprairitaṃ ^nakirnu naivāsti |
kiṃca he ^pravṛddha atibala ^jāyamānaḥ ^jātaḥ vā kaściddevo martyo vā tvaṃ ^yāni vṛtravadhādīni ^kariṣyā kartavyāni ^kṛṇuhi kuruṣe tāni ^na ^naśate na vyāpnoti |
he marutaḥ mā mām atra asmin udakotpādanaviṣaye stoma: stotram amandan mādayati modayate vā |
he nara: sakhāya: yūyaṃ me mama yat śrutyaṃ sarvai: śrotavyaṃ brahma parivṛḍhameghadhāraṇādirūpaṃ cakraṃ kṛtavantaḥ |
indrāya parameśvaryaguṇakāya vṛṣṇe abhimavatavarṣitre sumnāya śobhanāyāgāya sasye yuṣmābhi: samānalyānāya tanūbhi: anekaśarīrarupetāya mahaṃ mama tanve madīyaśarīrapoṣāya bhavatu |

evedete prati mā rocamānā anedya: śrava eṣo dardhānā: | saṃcakṣyā marutaścandravarṇā acchānta me chadayāthā ca nūnam || 12 || eva | it | ete | prati | mā | rocamānā: | anedya: | śrava: | ā | irṣa: | dardhānā: | sam'cakṣyā | marutaḥ | candravarṇā: | acchānta | me | chadayātha | ca | nūnam || 12 ||
he marutaḥ evait evameva ete yūyaṃ mā māṃ prati rocamānā: madripeye saṃpriyamāṇā māṃ sthāpayanto vā anedya: anantikasthaṃ bhava: kīrtim iṣa: ca dadhānā: |
suvarṇavarṇā yūyaṃ me māṃ saṃcakṣya samyakprakāśaya nūnaṃ niścayam acchānta yaśobhirācchāditavantaḥ chadayātha ācchādayatha ca |
māṃ prati sarvadā rocamānā mayyeva kīrtimahaṃ ca dadhānā matkṛtai: karmabhirmāmeva stutetyartha: ||

ko nvatra maruto māmahe va: pra yātana sakhīracchā sakhāya: | manmāni citrā apivātayanta eṣāṃ bhūtū narvedā ma ṛtānām || 13 || ka: | nu | atra | marutaḥ | mamahe | va: | pra | yātana | sakhīn | accha | sakhāya: | manmāni | citrā: | api'vātayanta: | eṣām | bhūtū | narvedā: | me | ṛtānām || 13 ||
he marutaḥ yuṣmān atra loke ka nu khalu martya: mamahe pūjayati |
he sakhāya: sarvasya sakhivapriyakāriṇa: santaḥ sakhīn haviṣpradānena sakhibhūtān yajamānān accha ābhimukhyena prāptuṃ pra yātana gacchata |
he citrā: cāyanīyā: yūyaṃ manmāni mananīyāni dhanāni apivātayantaḥ saṃpūrṇaṃ prāpayantaḥ bhūta bhavata |
kiṃca me madīyānām eṣām ṛtānām avittānāṃ navedā: bhūta jñātāro bhavata ||
1. kha-ca-jha-pha-karma ca kṛtavantaḥ stha; ta-cakra kṛtavantaḥ stha |
ā yadṷva॒syāhṷvase na kā॒rura॒smāñca̭ke mā॒nyasya̭ me॒dhā |
o ṣu va̭rtta ma॒ruto॒ vipra̭macchemā bra॒hmāṇi̭ ja॒ritā॒ vau a̭rcat ||
ā | yat | du॒va॒syāt | du॒va॒sai | na | kā॒ruḥ | a॒smān | ca॒kre | mā॒nyasya̭ | me॒dhā | o iti̭ | su | va̭rtta | ma॒ruta̭ḥ | vipra̭m | accha̭ | i॒mā | bra॒hmāṇi̭ | ja॒ritā̭ | vaḥ | a̭rcat || 14 ||
he marutaḥ 'duvasyāt yuṣmatparicaraṇāīāt stotrāt tena stotreṇa 'duvase paricaraṇāya paryāptā 'kāruḥ kartrī stutikuśalā 'mānyasya mānanīyasya viduṣaḥ 'medhā buddhiḥ 'asmān 'vṛ iti saṃpratyarthe |
yasya niḥśvasitaṃ vedā yo vedebhyo'khilaṃ jagat |
tatra ' tannu ' ityetat dvitīyaṃ sūktaṃ pañcadaśarcam |
atrānukramaṇikā- ' taccavagasyo mārutaṃ hi dvitridhuvantaṃ mitrāvaruṇayordīkṣitayorurvaśīmapsarasaṃ dṛṣṭvā vāsatīvare kumbhe reto'patattato'gasyavasiṣṭhāvajāyetām ' iti |
' sūktasaṃkhyānuvartata ānvaryāḥ sūktasaṃkhyāyāḥ ' (anu. 12. 1) iti paribhāṣitatvāt pañcadaśarcam |
' mārutaṃ hi ' ityuktatvāt tubhyādiparibhāṣayā idamādisūktatrayaṃ marudevatākam |
tannu vocāma rabhasāya janmane pūrva mahitvaṃ vṛṣabhasya ketave |
tat | nu | vocāma | rabhasāya | janmane | pūrvam | mahitvam | vṛṣabhasya | ketave | aidhā'iva | yāman | marutaḥ | tuvi'svanaḥ | yudhā'iva | śakrāḥ | taviṣāṇi | kartana || 1 ||
he marutaḥ vayaṃ yuṣmadīyaṃ tat tādṛśaṃ prasiddhaṃ pūrvaṃ pūrakaṃ pūrvatanaṃ vā mahitvaṃ māhātmyaṃ nu kṣipraṃ vocāma brūmaḥ |
rabhasāya rabhasayuktāya janmane veṣāṃ prādurbhāvāya veṣāṃ saṃnidhānāya ityarthaḥ |

he tuviṣvaṇaḥ gamanasaṃrambheṇa prabhūtadhvaniyuktā he śakrāḥ sarvamapi kartuṃ śaktāḥ yūyaṃ yāman yāmani yāgamane prastute sati aidheva aidhāni edhaḥsambandhīni tejāṃsīva prāpyeṇa mahattvena taviṣāṇi balāni sāmarthyāni kartana kuruta tastuma ityarthaḥ |
yudheva yuddhena tacchuddhanimittaṃ yathā taviṣāṇi kurutha tadvat ||
nityaṃ na sūnuṃ madhu bibhrat upa krīḻanti krīḻā vidatheṣu dhṛṣṇavaḥ |
nakṣanti rudrā avasā namasvin na mardhanti svatavaso haviṣkṛtam ||
nityam | na | sūnum | madhu | bibhrataḥ | upa | krīḻanti | krīḻā | vidatheṣu | dhṛṣṇavaḥ | nakṣanti | rudrāḥ | avasā | namasvin | na | mardhanti | sva'tavasaḥ | haviḥ'kṛtam || 2 ||
athavā vṛṣabhasya vṛṣṭyutpādakasya varṣituḥ meghasya ketave ' ityadhikam |

nityaṃ na sūnum aurasaṃ priyaṃ putramiva madhu madhuraṃ haviḥ bibhrataḥ dhārayanto marutaḥ vidadhepu yāgeṣu dhṛṣṇvayaḥ rakṣaḥprabhṛtīnāṃ dharṣakāḥ santaḥ krīḻāḥ krīḍanaśīlāḥ upa upetya krīḻanti viharanti |
marutāṃ rudraputratvaṃ purāṇepu tapasā tuṣṭau pārvatīparameśvarī marutaḥ putratvena svīcakraturiti prasiddham |
namaskinaṃ namaskāropa- lakṣitastotropetaṃ haviṣkṛtaṃ havipaḥ kartāraṃ yajamānam avasā rakṣaṇena tarpaṇena vā nimittabhūtena nakṣanti vyāpnuvanti |
kiṃca svatavasaḥ svāyattabalā maruto yajamānaṃ na mardhanti na saṃgrāmayanti na kleśayantītyarthaḥ ||

yasmā̭ ū॒rmāso̭ a॒mṛtā̭ arā̭sata rāya॒spoṣa̭ṃ ca ha॒viṣā̭ dadā॒śuṣḙ | u॒kṣantya̭smai ma॒ruto̭ hi॒tāi̭va pu॒ru rajā̭ṃsi pa॒ryasā̭ mayo॒bhuva̭ḥ || 3 || yasmai | ūrmāsaḥ | amṛtāḥ | arāṃsata | rāyaḥ | poṣam | ca | haviṣā | dadāśuṣe | ukṣanti | asmai | marutaḥ | hitāḥ'iva | puru | rajāṃsi | paryasā | mayaḥ'bhuvaḥ || 3 ||
yasmai yajamānāya haviṣā dadāśuṣe somādihavirdattavate haviṣā prītāḥ umāsaḥ aviptāraḥ amṛtāḥ amaraṇadharmāṇo marutaḥ rāyaspoṣaṃ dhanasya puṣṭim |

asmai yajamānāya hitāiva hitācaraṇāḥ sakhāya iva santaḥ mayobhuvaḥ sukhasya bhāvayitāraḥ marutaḥ rajāṃsi lokān puru prabhūtaṃ yathā bhavati tathā payasā udakena sasyādyupattyartham ukṣanti siñcanti ||

ā ye rajā̭ṃsi ta॒viṣī̭bhi॒ravya̭ta pra॒ va e॒vāma̭ḥ sva॒ryatā̭so a॒dhrajaṋ | bha॒yante॒ viśvā॒ bhuva̭nāni ha॒umryā ci॒tro vo॒ yāma̭ḥ pra॒yatā̭svṛ॒ṣṭiṣṷ || 4 || ā | ye | rajāṃsi | taviṣībhiḥ | avyata | pra | vaḥ | evāsaḥ | svaryatāsaḥ | adhrajan | bhayante | viśvā | bhuvanāni | humyā | citraḥ | vaḥ | yāmaḥ | pra'yatāsu | ṛṣṭiṣu || 4 ||

he marutaḥ yuṣmatsaṃyandhinaḥ ye evāsaḥ evāḥ aśvaviśeṣāḥ taviṣībhiḥ svakīyairbalairvṛṣṭi- pradānādirūpaiḥ rajāṃsi lokān ā avyata sarvata āvṛṇvanti te vaḥ yuṣmākam evāsaḥ aśvāḥ svayatāsaḥ svayameva sārathinā vinaiva yuktāḥ pra adhrajan prakarṣeṇa gacchanti vyāpnuvanti |
kiṃca yuṣmadāgamanāt viśvā bhuvanāni sarvāṇi bhūtajātāni viśvā humyā sarvāṇi harmyāṇi ca bhayante bibhyati patanāt |
yasmādevaṃ tasmāt vo yāmaḥ citraḥ cāyanīyaḥ |
ṛṣṭiṣu yuddhasthāsu hetiṣu prayatāsu prakarṣeṇodhatāsu satīṣu |
āyudheṣudhṛteṣu yathā janā bibhyati tadvadyuṣmadāgamanāt bibhya- tītyarthaḥ ||

yattveṣayāmā nadayanta parvatāndivo vā pṛṣṭhaṃ naryā acyucyavuḥ | viśvo vo ajarmanbhayate vanaspatī rathīyantīva pra jihīta oṣadhiḥ || 5 || yat | tveṣa'yāmā | nadayanta | parvatān | divaḥ | vā | pṛṣṭham | naryāḥ | acyucyavuḥ | viśvaḥ | vaḥ | ajarman | bhayate | vanaspatiḥ | rathīyantī'iva | pra | jihīte | oṣadhiḥ || 5 ||

marutaḥ 'tveṣayāmāḥ pradīptagamanāḥ 'yat yadā 'parvatān parvatato girergahvarāṇi pūrakān meghān vā 'nadayanta nādayanti 'vā athavā 'divaḥ dyotanātmakasyāntarikṣasya 'pṛṣṭham uparibhāgaṃ 'naryāḥ narebhyo hitāḥ 'acyucyavuḥ gacchanti tadā 'vaḥ yuṣmatsambandhini 'ajarman gamane nimittabhūte sati 'viśvaḥ 'vanaspatiḥ vanasya pālayitā vṛkṣasamūhaḥ 'bhayate bibheti |
tathā 'oṣadhiḥ priyaṅguvīhvādiḥ 'pra 'jihīte prakarṣeṇa gacchati svasthānāt itastataścalatītyarthaḥ |

yūyaṃ ne ugrā marutaḥ sucetunāriṣṭagrāmāḥ sumatiṃ pipartana | yatrā vo dvidyurdati krivirdatī riṇāti paśvaḥ sudhiteva barhaṇā || 6 || yūyam | naḥ | ugrāḥ | marutaḥ | su'cetanāḥ | ariṣṭa'grāmāḥ | su'matim | pipartana | yatra | vaḥ | dvidyut | radati | kriviḥ'datī | riṇāti | paśvaḥ | sudhitā'iva | barhaṇā || 6 ||
he 'ugrāḥ udbhaṭabalāḥ 'marutaḥ 'yūyaṃ 'sucetanā śobhanacetasā 'ariṣṭagrāmāḥ ahiṃsitasaṃghāḥ sastaḥ 'naḥ asmākaṃ 'sumatiṃ śobhanabuddhiṃ 'pipartana pūrayata 'kasminkāle iti taducyate |
'yatra yasmin kāle 'vaḥ yuṣmatsambandhini 'krivirdatī vikṣepaṇaśīladantī 'didyut hetiḥ 'radati vilikhati meghasaṃsthāyāṃ 'paśvaḥ paśūṃśca 'riṇāti reyati hinasti |
vāyau vāti sati paśavaḥ śīryante iti prasiddham |
'sudhitā suhitā suṣṭhu preritā 'barhaṇā hetiḥ tatsādhanā hetīrvā yathā riṇāti tadvat ||

pra skumbhadeṣṇā anavabharādhasolātuṇāsau vidatheṣu suṣṭutāḥ | arcentyarkaṃ madirsya pītayai viduvīrasya prathamāni pausyā || 7 || pra | skumbha'deṣṇāḥ | anavabhra'rādhasaḥ | alātuṇāsaḥ | vidatheṣu | su'stutāḥ | arcenti | arkam | madirsya | pītayai | viduḥ | vīrasya | prathamāni | pausyā || 7 ||
'pra 'skumbhadeṣṇāḥ prakarṣeṇa stambhitadānāḥ | aviratadānā ityarthaḥ | 'anavabharādhasaḥ aṣṭahavirādidhanāḥ | rādha iti dhananāma | 'alātuṇāsaḥ | nakārasya sthāne lakāraḥ || anātuṇāsaḥ
evaṃrūpā mahataḥ vidyeṣu yāgeṣu arkam arcanīyamindraṃ svasakhībhūtam arcanti pūjayanti stutyādinā saṃbhāvayantītyarthaḥ |
kimarthaṃ madirasya mādanasādhanasya somasya pītaye pānāya |
te mahataḥ vīrasya vividhaṃ śatrūṇāmīrakasya indrasya prathamāni pratamāni mukhyāni pauṃsyā puṃsvāni vṛtravadhādirūpāṇi viduḥ jānanti ||
janaṃ yamugrāstavaso virapśinaḥ pāthanā śaṃsāttanayasya puṣṭiṣu ||
śatabhujibhiḥ | tam | abhihuteḥ | aghātat | pūḥ'bhiḥ | rakṣata | marutaḥ | yam | āvata | janam | yam | ugrāḥ | tavasaḥ | virapśinaḥ | pāthana | śaṃsāt | tanayasya | puṣṭiṣu || 8 ||
asaṃkhyātabhogavadbhiḥ pūbhiḥ pālanaiḥ jetavyaiḥ śatrūṇāṃ nagarairvā taṃ rakṣata pālayata |
yam janam abhihuteḥ abhibhavakāraṇāt kuṭilasvabhāvāt aghātat pāpāt āvata arakṣata |
kiṃca he ugrāḥ udghūrṇatejaso he tavasaḥ balavanto vegavanto vā he virapśinaḥ |
vividhā rapśānaḥ stottāro yeṣāṃ te tathoktā he tādṛśā yūyaṃ yaṃ ca janaṃ pāthana pātha rakṣata |
putrādīnāṃ puṣṭiṣu poṣepu nimittabhūteṣu śaṃsāt abhiśaṃsanāt |
viśvāni bhadrā maruto ratheṣu vo mithaspṛdhyeva taviṣāṇyāhitā |
aṃseṣvā vaḥ prapayeṣu khādayo'kṣau vaścakrā samayā vi vavṛte ||
viśvāni | bhadrā | marutaḥ | ratheṣu | vaḥ | mithaspṛdhyeva | taviṣāṇi | āhitā | aṃseṣu | ā | vaḥ | prapayeṣu | khādayaḥ | akṣau | vaḥ | cakrā | samayā | vi | vavṛte || 9 ||
he mahataḥ vaḥ yuṣmatsambandhiratheṣu radhasādhaneṣu viśvāni bhadrā sarvāṇi kalyānāni bhogayogyāni dravyāṇyasmabhyaṃ pradeyāni phalāni vā āhitāni |
mithaspṛdhyeva balābhivyaktāt parasparaspardhāviṣayāṇi taviṣāṇi balāni aṃseṣvākalakṣaṇānyāyudhāni vā āhitāni |
pragatāḥ panthāno yeṣu viśrāma- sthāneṣu tāni prapadhāni |
pragataḥ panthā yaisteṣu pādāgreṣu khādayaḥ sthirā ābharaṇaviśeṣā āhitāḥ |
kiṃca akṣau vaḥ yuṣmatsambandhī rathyaḥ akṣaḥ vakrā tatropanibaddhāni cakrāṇi samayā samīpe teṣāṃ parisare vi vavṛte viśeṣeṇa vartate |
yasmādevaṃ devayajanagamanasādhanāni santi tasmāt śīghra- māgacchadhvamityabhiprāyaḥ ||

bhūrīṇi bhadrā nayaiṣu bāhuṣu vakṣaḥsu rukmā rabhasāso añjayaḥ | aṃseṣvetāḥ paviṣu kṣurā adhi vayo na pakṣānyanu śriyo dhire || 10 || bhūrīṇi | bhadrā | nayaiṣu | bāhuṣu | vakṣaḥsu | rukmāḥ | rabhasāsaḥ | añjayaḥ | aṃseṣu | etāḥ | paviṣu | kṣurāḥ | adhi | vayaḥ | na | pakṣān | vi | anu | śriyaḥ | dhire || 10 ||
te marutaḥ ॰nayaiṣu narebhyo hiteṣu ॰bāhuṣu bhujeṣu ॰bhūrīṇi prabhṛtāni ॰bhadrā bhadrāṇi kalyāṇāni dhanāni stotṛbhyo dātuṃ ॰dhire dadhire dhārayanti |
evamete marutaḥ sarvāṅgeṣu ॰śriyaḥ lakṣmīḥ anukramena ॰vi dhire vividhaṃ dhārayanti |

mahantau mahā vimvo vibhūtayo dūredṛśo ye divyā iva stṛbhiḥ | mandrāḥ sujihvāḥ svaritāra āsabhiḥ saṃmiśrā indre marutaḥ pariṣṭubhaḥ || 11 || mahantaḥ | mahā | viḍabhvaḥ | viḍabhūtayaḥ | dūre'dṛśaḥ | ye | divyāḥ | iva | stṛbhiḥ | mandrāḥ | sujihvāḥ | svaritāraḥ | āsabhiḥ | sammiśrāḥ | indre | marutaḥ | pariṣṭubhaḥ || 11 ||
stra iti nakṣatranāma ‘ ṛkṣāḥ stṛbhiriti nakṣatrāṇām ’ ( niru. 3. 20 ) iti niruktatvāt |
divi bhavā devāḥ stṛbhiḥ svapuṣpakabhūtaistejaḥpuñjairnakṣatrairyathā dūre dṛśya- mānā bhavanti tadvat |
kiṃca ॰mandrāḥ mādanāḥ ॰sujihvāḥ śobhanajihvāḥ ॰āsabhiḥ āsyaiḥ ॰svari- tāraḥ śabdayitāraḥ |
‘ maruto hyenaṃ nājahuḥ ’ ( ai. brā. 3. 20 ) iti śruteḥ |
evaṃ mahābhāgā ye mahataḥ santi te'smadyajñam āgacchantīti śeṣaḥ ||

tadvaḥ sujātā maruto mahitvanaṃ dīrghaṃ vo dātramaditeriva vratam | indraścana tyajasā vi huṇāti tajjanāya yasmai sukṛte arādhvam || 12 || tat | vaḥ | sujātāḥ | marutaḥ | mahitvanam | dīrgham | vaḥ | dātram | aditaḥ | iva | vratam | indraḥ | cana | tyajasā | vi | huṇāti | tat | janāya | yasmai | sukṛte | arādhvam || 12 ||
he sujātāḥ śobhanajananāḥ he mahataḥ vaḥ yuṣmadīyaṃ mahitvanaṃ mahattvaṃ tat tādṛk khalu |
vaḥ yuṣmākaṃ dātraṃ dānaṃ vṛṣṭyādirūpaṃ dīrgham atyāyatamavicchinnam |
kiṃca he marutaḥ yūyaṃ yasmai sukṛte śobhanayāgādikarmaṇe yajamānāya yadabhimataṃ dhanam arādhyaṃ tat indraḥ ca indro'pi tyajasā tyāgena na vi huṇāti na vihurati kauṭilyaṃ na karoti ||
cana ityayaṃ yadyapi nipātadvayasamudāyarūpa eko nipāta: tathāpyavayavavibhāgena caśabdaḥ samuccaye naśabdo niṣedhe'dhigantavyaḥ ||
^tat ^iṣṭim eṣaṇaṃ gamanam ^ebhiryajñaiḥ idānīṃ kriyamāṇaiḥ stotrādirūpaiḥ pūjanaiḥ ^abhi ābhimukhyena ^aśyāṃ vyāpnuyām ||
eṣa vaḥ stomo maruta iyaṃ gīrmāndāryasya mānyasya kāroḥ |
eṣā yāsīṣṭa tanvaṃ vayāṃ vidyāmeṣaṃ vṛjanaṃ jīradānum ||
eṣaḥ | vaḥ | stomaḥ | marutaḥ | iyam | gīḥ | māndāryasya | mānyasya | kāroḥ | ā | iṣā | yāsīṣṭa | tanvai | vayām | vidhāma | iṣam | vṛjanam | jīradānum || 15 ||
sūktopakramaprabhṛti kriyamāṇāṃ stutiṃ marudbhyaḥ samarpya svābhīṣṭamāśāste |
he ^marutaḥ ^eṣaḥ ^stomaḥ idānīṃ kṛtaṃ stotraṃ ^vaḥ yuṣmākaṃ yuṣmadarthamityarthaḥ |
te vmarutaḥ vavobhiḥ rakṣaṇaiḥ sahitāḥ vnaḥ asmān vaccha abhimukhyena vā vyāntu āga- cchantu |
śobhanaprajñā eva marutaḥ vjyeṣṭhaiḥ vvṛṣṭidaiḥ vvā jyeṣṭhaiḥ praśastatamaiḥ 2 maṇisuktādidharnaiśca sahitā ā yāntu |
vatha atha veṣāṃ marutāṃ vbat yasmāt vniyutaḥ etannāmakāḥ vparamāḥ utkṛṣṭā aśvāḥ vsamudrasya vcit |
samudrasyāpi vbāre parāṃsmīstīre vdhanayanta dhanadhāraṇaṃ vahanaṃ kurvanti |
mimyakṣa yeṣu sudhitā ghṛtācī hiraṇyanirṇiguparā na ṛṣṭiḥ |
guhā carantī manuṣo na yoṣā sabhāṃvatī vidadhyaiva saṃ vāk ||
mimyakṣa | yeṣu | sudhitā | ghṛtācī | hiraṇya'nirṇin | uparā | na | ṛṣṭiḥ | guhā | carantī | manuṣaḥ | na | yoṣā | sabhā'vatī | vidadhyā'iva | sam | vāk || 3 ||
vsudhitā suṣṭhu nihitā suṣṭhu hitā vā loke vghṛtācī ghṛtaṃ kṣaraṇaśīlamudakamañjantī vhiraṇya- nirṇiṅ hitaramaṇīyarūpā |
evaṃrūpā vṛṣṭiḥ viśuddhāsyāyudhaviśeṣo vā vuparā vna meghamāleva vyeṣu marutsu vsaṃ vmimyakṣa |
vguhā nigūḍhā guhāyāṃ vā antarikṣe v carantī |
sā yathā suveṣā antaḥ- pure eva madhye carati tadvat |
saivaṃrūpā yeṣu mimyakṣa te maruto devayajanamābacchantvityarthaḥ ||
parā śubhā ayāsau yuvyā sādhāraṇyeva marutau mimiksuḥ |
na raudasī arpa nudanta ghorā juṣantu vṛdhaṃ sakhyāya devāḥ ||
parā | śubhāḥ | ayāsaḥ | yuvyā | sādhāraṇya'iva | marutaḥ | mimiksuḥ | na | raudasī iti | arpa | nudanta | ghorāḥ | juṣanta | vṛdham | sakhyāya | devāḥ || 4 ||
vśubhāḥ śobhanālaṃkārāḥ 7 vayāsaḥ abhigantāraḥ vmarutaḥ vyavyā miśraṇaśīlayā vidyutā vparā vmimiksuḥ |
yathā loke sādhāraṇyā kriyā saṃgatā yuvāno reto muñcanti tadvat |
evaṃ kurvantaḥ vghorāḥ ativṛṣṭipradānena bhayaṃkarānte vraudasī dyāvāpṛthivyau vna vapa vnudanta |

1. ka-kha-jha-pha-ete | 2. jha1-prabhūtadyotamānaiḥ | 3. jha1-ume | 4. jha1-dṛṣṭāntatvena | 5. jha1- antarikṣe vā | 6. jha1-sabhāṃvatī janasaṃghasamīpaṃ gacchantī varṣākāle | āvirbhāve dṛṣṭāntaḥ | 7. jha1-śobhanālaṃkārādinā dīptāḥ |
apare tu marutāṃ striyo rodasīti nāmadheyamityāhuḥ |
kiṃtu Vdevāḥ modayitāro mādayitāro vā marutaḥ Vsalyāya Vvṛdhaṃ vṛddhiṃ Vjuṣanta sevante |
dyāvāpṛthivīpakṣe sakhyāya jagatāṃ sakhibhāvāya tayorvṛddhiṃ kurvantītyarthaḥ ||

joṣadyadīṃsuryā sacadhyai virṣitastukā rodasī numaṇāḥ | ā sūryaiva vidhato rathe gatveṣapratīkā nabhaso netyā || 5 || joṣat | yat | īm | asuryā | sacadhyai | virṣitastukā | rodasī | numaṇāḥ | ā | sūryā'iva | vidhataḥ | ratham | gāt | tveṣa'pratīkā | nabhasaḥ | na | ityā || 5 ||
Vrodasī marutpatnī vidyut vā etannāmikeyamapi Vīm enaṃ marutsaṃghaṃ Vjopat sevate ||

teṣāṃ svabhūtā Vvirṣitastukā viśiṣṭakeśasaṃghā viprakīrṇakeśasaṃghā vā saṃbhogavaśena tathā Vnumaṇāḥ nṛṣu netṛṣu marutsu mananavatī manuṣyeṣu vā vṛṣṭipradānamanoyuktā Vtveṣapratīkā dīptaprakramā dīptāvayavā |
īdṛśī devī Vvidhataḥ paricarato marutsaṃghasya Vratham Vā Vgāt āgacchati vyāpnoti |
vidhataḥ sūryasya rathaṃ tveṣapratīkā Vsūryeva sūryapatnīva |
sūryasya duhitā aśvinoḥ rathamivāsa yā ārohati tadvat |
antarikṣādityayoḥ sādhāraṇo'yaṃ nabhaḥśabdaḥ ‘nabha iti padaṃ sādhāraṇāni’ ( ni. 1. 4. 6 ) ityuktatvāt |

āsthāpayanta yuvatiṃ yuvānaḥ śubhe nimiṣlāṃ vidatheṣu pajām | arko yaddhau maruto haviṣmāṇgārdārtha sutasomo duvasyan || 6 || ā | asthāpayanta | yuvatim | yuvānaḥ | śubhe | nimiṣlām | vidatheṣu | pajām | arkaḥ | yat | vaḥ | marutaḥ | haviṣmān | gāyat | gātham | suta'somaḥ | duvasyan || 6 ||
Vyuvānaḥ miśrayanto niyatataruṇā vā marutaḥ Vyuvatiṃ miśrayantīṃ niyatataruṇīṃ vā vidyudrūpāṃ rodasyāṃ striyam Vāsthāpayanta āsthāpayanti |
Vyat yadā he Vmarutaḥ Vvaḥ yuṣmān Varkaḥ ||
arcanasādhanamantropetaḥ stotā vā Vhaviṣmān pradeyādyādihaviryuktaḥ Vsutasomaḥ homāya abhiṣutasomo'yaṃ yajamānaḥ Vduvasyan paricaran Vgārtha gāntavyaṃ stotraṃ Vgāyat gāyati |

pra taṃ vivakmi vakmyo ya eṣāṃ marutāṃ mahimā satyo asti | sacā yadīṃ vṛṣamaṇā ahaṃsyuḥ sthirā cijjanīrvahate subhāgāḥ || 7 || pra | tam | vivakmi | vakmyaḥ | yaḥ | eṣām | marutām | mahimā | satyaḥ | asti | sacā | yat | īm | vṛṣamanāḥ | ahaṃsyuḥ | sthirā | cit | janīḥ | vahate | subhāgāḥ ||7||
eṣāṃ marutāṃ yaḥ mahimā mahattātiśayaḥ vakmyaḥ sarvaiḥ stutyaḥ satyaḥ abādhyo'moghaḥ asti taṃ pra vivakmi pravacmi varṇayāmi |
yat yasmāt īm eteṣāṃ sambandhinī rodasī vṛṣamaṇāḥ vṛṣṭyādivarpaṇamanaskā ahaṃsyuḥ ahaṃkāravatī |
atyantavinaśvarā īdṛśī devī subhāgāḥ śobhanabhāgyapetāḥ janīḥ jananaśīlāḥ prajāḥ vṛṣṭyupattīrvā vahate dhārayati |

pānti mitrāvaruṇāvavadyāccaryata īmayamo apraśastān | uta cyavante acyutā dhruvāṇi vāvṛdha ī maruto dātivāraḥ || 8 || pānti | mitrāvaruṇau | avadyāt | caryate | īm | ayamo iti | apraśastān | uta | cyavante | acyutā | dhruvāṇi | vavṛdhe | īm | marutaḥ | dātivāraḥ || 8 ||
he marutaḥ yuṣmatsambandhino devāḥ mitrāvaruṇau ahorātryabhimānidevau ayamo |
ayamā u iti nipātasamudāyātmakam ekaṃ padam |
ete trayo'pi īm amuṃ lokaṃ yajñaṃ vā avadyāt garhāt ayathā'nuṣṭhānāt jagatyakṣe vyavahārapratibandharūpāt pānti rakṣanti |
tathā eteṣām apraśastān kṣīṇānapi padārthān cyavate cātayanti nāśayanti |
uta api ca etaiḥ preritāni acyutā acyutānyadhyāvīni ata eva dhruvāṇi avicalāni meghasthodakāni cyavante dyāva- yanti vā ete |
‘ ahorātre vai mitrāvaruṇāvahorātrābhyāṃ khalu vai parjanyo varṣati ’ iti śrute |
he marutaḥ yuṣmadīyaḥ īm ayaṃ kālaḥ dātivāraḥ pradeyajalaḥ khaṇḍitamegho vā yadā vavṛdhe vardhate |
tadā mitrādayo devā yuṣmadanukūla- vyāpāreṇa jagat rakṣantītyarthaḥ |
dātivāro dattvaraṇīyahavilakṣaṇadhano yajamānaḥ he marutaḥ īm enānyuṣmānvavṛdhe vardhayati yadā tadetyarthaḥ ||

nahī nu vo maruto antyasme ārāttācchiccharvaso antamāpuḥ | te dhṛṣṇunā śavasā śuśuvāṃso'rṇo na dveṣo dhṛṣatā pari ṣuḥ || 9 || nahi | nu | vaḥ | marutaḥ | anti | asmai | iti | ārāttāt | cit | śavasaḥ | antam | āpuḥ | te | dhṛṣṇunā | śavasā | śuśuvāṃsaḥ | arṇaḥ | na | dveṣaḥ | dhṛṣatā | pari | ṣuḥ || 9 ||
he marutaḥ vaḥ śavasaḥ yuṣmākaṃ sambandhino balasya antam avasānam anti antike ārāt kvacit dūrādapi |
asme asmāsu madhye eke'pi nu kṣipraṃ nahi āpuḥ naiva khalu prāpnuvanti |
te khalu marutaḥ dhṛṣṇunā dharṣakeṇa śavasā balena śūśuvāṃsaḥ vardhamānāḥ ata eva dhṛpatā parābhibhāvakena sāmarthyena dveṣaḥ dveṣṭṛn pari dhuḥ paribhavanti vaśīkurvanti |
tathā ca sūtraṃ- ‘ vayamaghendrasya preṣṭhā ityastaṃ yāsyāditye ’ ( āśva. gṛ. 2. 6. 14 ) iti ||

vayamaghendrasya preṣṭhā vayaṃ śro vaucemahi samarye | vayaṃ purā mahit ca no anu dyūna ṛbhukṣā nurāma nu syāt || 10 || vayama | agha | indrasya | preṣṭhāḥ | vayama | śvaḥ | vocemahi | sa'marye | vayama | purā | mahit | ca | naḥ | anu | dyūna | tat | naḥ | ṛbhukṣāḥ | nurāma | anu | syāt || 10 ||
atha asmin dine vayaṃ yattāraḥ : indrasya devasya preṣṭhāḥ priyatamā bhavema |
priyatamā vayama indrasya mahattvaṃ vocemahi stotuṃ samarthā bhūyāsma |
kiṃca vayaṃ śvaḥ parasminnapi dine samarye |
saha maryāḥ maryāḥ ṛtvijo yasmin sa samaryo yajñaḥ tasmin |
kiṃca vayaṃ purā pūrvasminnatīte'pi kāle mahi mahaddhalaṃ naḥ asmadarthaṃ vocemahi |
atīte āgāmini ca divase sarvadā vocemahi |
‘ ṛbhukṣāḥ ukṣā ’ ( ni. 3. 3. 10 ) iti tannāmasu pāṭhāt |
mahānindraḥ narāṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ madhye naḥ asmān anu syāt anu bhavatu anukūlamabhimataprado vā bhavatu ||

eṣa vaḥ stomau maruta iyaṃ gīrmāndāryasya mānyasya kāroḥ | eṣā yāsīṣṭa tunvaṃ vayāṃ vidyāmeṣaṃ vṛjanaṃ jīradānum || 11 || eṣaḥ | vaḥ | stomaḥ | marutaḥ | iyam | gīḥ | māndāryasya | mānyasya | kāroḥ | ā | iṣā | yāsīṣṭa | tunvai | vayām | vidyāma | iṣam | vṛjanam | jīra'dānum || 11 ||
‘ yajñayajñā ’ iti daśamaṃ caturthaṃ sūktamāgastyaṃ mārutam |

ya॒jñāya̭jñā va॒ḥ sama̭nā tu॒turva॒ṇirdhi॒yaṃ vo̭ de॒vyā ṷ dadhiṣve | ā vo̭'rvā॒rcaḥ su॒vi॒tāya̭ ro॒dasyo̭rma॒he va̭vṛ॒tyāma̭va॒se su॒va॒ktibhi̭ḥ || 1 || ya॒jña'a̭rthajñā | vaḥ | sa॒ma॒nā | tu॒turva॒ṇiḥ | dhi॒yam | dhi॒yam | vaḥ | de॒vyāḥ | ū~ iti̭ | da॒dhi॒ṣve | ā | vaḥ | a॒rvā॒rcaḥ | su॒vi॒tāya̭ | ro॒dasyoḥ | ma॒he | va॒vṛ॒tyām | a॒va॒se | su॒va॒kti'bhi̭ḥ || 1 || he marutaḥ vvaḥ vsamanā samīkṛtinyūnādhikābhāvalakṣaṇā vyajñāyajñā sarveṣvapi yajñeṣu turvaṇiḥ turvaṇiśvaramāṇā saṃbhajamānā bhavata | 'turvaṇistūrṇavatiḥ' ( niru. 6. 14 ) iti yāskaḥ | tattadāgāvasare āgatya haviḥ svīkṛtya vaikalyaparihāreṇa samaṃ kuruthetyarthaḥ | kiṃca vvaḥ yūyaṃ vdhiyaṃ- dhiyaṃ yuṣmatsambandhivṛṣṭipradānādirūpaṃ sarvaṃ karma vdevyāḥ devān prāpayitāra eva santaḥ vdadhiṣve dhārayatha dhārayadhve vā | devārthahavirāśutpādanāya vṛṣṭiṃ kuruthetyarthaḥ | yasmādevaṃ kurutha tasmāt vvaḥ yuṣmān varvācaḥ asmadabhimukhān vā vvavṛtyām āvartayāmi | kimartham | vrodasyoḥ dyāvā- pṛthivyoḥ vmahe mahate vavase rakṣaṇāya prīṇanāya vā | tadapi kimarthamiti | vsuvitāya suṣṭhu vyāptāya | kaiḥ sādhanaiḥ | vsuvaktibhiḥ śobhanāvarjanaiḥ stotraiḥ ||

va॒trāso̭ na ye sva॒jāḥ sva॒rtava̭sa i॒ṣaṃ sva̭ra॒bhijā̭yanta dhūtayaḥ | sa॒ha॒sri॒yāso̭ a॒pāṃ no̭rma॒ya ā॒sā gā॒vo va॒ndyā̭so no॒kṣaṇa̭ḥ || 2 || va॒trāsa̭ḥ | na | ye | sva॒jāḥ | sva॒rtava̭saḥ | i॒ṣam | svaḥ | a॒bhi'jā̭yanta | dhūtayaḥ | sa॒ha॒sri॒yāsa̭ḥ | a॒pām | na | ū॒rmaya̭ḥ | ā॒sā | gā॒vaḥ | va॒ndyā̭saḥ | na | u॒kṣaṇa̭ḥ || 2 || vye marutaḥ vvatrāso vna | vatririti rūpanāma | rūpavanta iva | te yathā prakṛṣṭā lakṣyante tadvat | yadvā | arūpā api sarūpā iva | vsvajāḥ svayameva svasmāt vā jāyamānāḥ | ananyahetukāḥ ityarthaḥ | vdhūtayaḥ kampanaśīlāḥ santi te viṣam annaṃ havirlakṣaṇamasādhanaṃ sasyādikaṃ vā vsvaḥ svargaṃ ca vabhijñāyanta abhilakṣya prādurbhavanti | te dṛṣṭāntamukhena śrūyante | vapāṃ vnormayaḥ udakā- nāmūrmaya iva vsahasriyāsaḥ sahasrasaṃmitāḥ | tathā vvandyāsaḥ bahukṣīrādipradatvena stutyāḥ | vgāvaḥ vna gāva iva vāsā samīpe eva vukṣaṇaḥ vṛṣṭyudakasya sektāraḥ | tādṛśā marutaḥ prādurbhavantītyanvayaḥ ||

so॒māso̭ na ye su॒tāstṛ॒tāṃśa̭vo ha॒tsu pī॒tāso̭ du॒vaso̭ nā॒satḙ | e॒ṣāṃma̭seṃṣu ra॒śmiṇī̭va ra॒rabhe॒ hastai̭ṣu khā॒diś ca॒ kṛti̭śca॒ saṃ da̭dhe || 3 || so॒māsa̭ḥ | na | ye | su॒tāḥ | tṛ॒ta'a̭ṃśavaḥ | ha॒tsu | pī॒tāsa̭ḥ | du॒vasa̭ḥ | na | ā॒satḙ | ā | e॒ṣām | a̭seṃṣu | ra॒śmiṇī̭'iva | ra॒rabhḙ | hastai̭ṣu | khā॒diḥ | ca | kṛti̭ḥ | ca | sam | da॒dhe || 3 ||
1. kṣi- ' ityanantaraṃ ' svatavasaḥ svayaṃbalāḥ ( svāyattabalāḥ ) avahāya ( asahāyāḥ ) ityarthaḥ ' ityadhikam |

yathā vallī- rūpāḥ somā abhiṣavātpūrvamāpyāyanena tṛsāvayavāḥ santaḥ paścāt sutāḥ abhiṣutāḥ rasabhūtāḥ ^pītāsaḥ pītāḥ santaḥ ^hṛtsu pātṛṇāṃ hṛdayeṣu ^duvaso ^na ^āsate paricaranta ivāsate tadvat ye maruto yajñe āhūtā- stṛsāvayavā bhavanti dhyāyamānāḥ santo hṛtsu hṛdayeṣu duvaso na paricaranta ivāsate |
prāṇādi- rūpeṇa śarīre sthitāḥ duvasaḥ paricaranta iva gamanādiceṣṭāḥ kurvanta āsate |
kiṃca ^hasteṣu ^khādiḥ hastatrāṇakaḥ ^ca ^kṛtiḥ kartanī ^ca khaḍgalatādiṣva^ ^saṃ ^dadhe saṃdhīyate sabhya
te yathā ākāṅkṣyante tathā yuṣmān annādiprāptaye puhyaiṣā: bahuvidhaṃ phalamicchan yajamāna: stotrairbahuprakāramākārayatītyartha:|
ahandya: ahi bhava etaśa: na aśva iva|
sa yathā śikṣakaṇa nānāprakāraṃ prāpyate tadvat ||
kaṃ svidasya rajaso mahasparaṃ kāvaraṃ maruto yasminnāyaya |
yakyāvayatha vithureva saṃhitaṃ vyadriṇā patatha tveṣamarṇavam ||
kaṃ| svida| asya| rajasa:| maha:| param| kaṃ| avaram| maruta:| yasmin| ā'yaya| yat| vyavayatha| vithurā'iva| sam'hitam| vi| adriṇā| patatha| tveṣam| arṇavam||6||
he marutaḥ yūyaṃ yasmin udake nimittabhūte sati āyaya āgacchata asya rajasa: vṛṣṭyudakasya lokasya vā maha: mahata: paraṃ pāramantaṃ kaṃ svit|
tathā avaram avāgbhāga: ādiśca kaṃ svit|

yan yadā yūyaṃ vithureva vithurāṇi śithilāni tṛṇānīva saṃhitam ekabhūtamudakaṃ vyāvayatha svasthānāt cālayatha tadā adriṇā vajreṇa tveṣaṃ dīptam arṇavam udakavantaṃ meghaṃ vi patatha viśīrṇaṃ pātayatha ||
sātirna vo'mavatī svarvatī tveṣā vipākā marutaḥ pipiṣvati |
bhadrā vo rāti: pṛṇato na dakṣiṇā pṛthuñjrayī asuryaiva jajñatī ||
sāti:| na| va:| ama'vatī| sva:'vatī| tveṣā| vi'pākā| maruta:| pipiṣvati| bhadrā| va:| rāti:| pṛṇata:| na| dakṣiṇā| pṛthu'jrayī| asuryā'iva| jajñatī || 7 ||
he marutaḥ va: yuṣmākaṃ saṃbandhinī sātirna saṃbhaktiriva yuṣmatsaṃbhajanaṃ yathā praśastaguṇaṃ tadvat va: rāti: vṛṣṭyādivipayā amavatī amādyavatī indrādisahāyavatī|

kiṃca supraketebhiḥ śobhanajñānairmarudbhiḥ saha sasahiḥ śatrūṇāmabhibhavitā san dadhānaḥ asmadabhima tasya dhārayitā bhaveti śeṣaḥ |

he marutaḥ 'sudānavaḥ śobhanadānāḥ yūyaṃ 'tṛṇaskandasya tṛṇavat calanasvabhāvasya śuṣyamāṇasya vā mama 'viśaḥ putrabhṛtyādirūpāḥ prajāḥ 'nu kṣipraṃ 'pari 'vṛṅkta parivarjayata bādhāparihāreṇa rakṣata |
samūhne daśarātre tṛtīye chandome maruvatīyaśastre etatsūtam |
‘viśvanito'bhinaraḥ’ iti khaṇḍe sūtritaṃ- ‘tṛtīyasyendraḥ svāhā gāyatsāma’ (āśva. śrau. 8. 7) iti ||
gāyatsāma̭ nabha॒nya॒ṃ yathā̭ ve॒rarcā̭m tadvā॒vṛdhā̭na॒ṃ sva̭rvat |
gāvo̭ dhe॒nava̭rhi॒ṣya̭da॒bdhā ā ya॒tsa॒māna̭ṃ di॒vyaṃ vi̭vā॒sān ||
gāyat | sāma | nabhanyam | yathā | veḥ | arcām | tat | vavṛdhānam | svaḥ'vat | gāvaḥ | dhenavaḥ | barhiṣi | adabdhāḥ | ā | yat | sānam | divyam | vivāsān || 1 ||
he indra 'nabhanyaṃ nabhasthaṃ nabhasi bhavaṃ nabhovyāpinaṃ hiṃsakaṃ vā rākṣasādikasya |
tādṛśaṃ 'sāma he indra 'yathā 'veḥ yena prakāreṇa vetsi tathā 'gāyat gāyadyudātā |
'tat tasmāt yataḥ stauti tataḥ kāraṇāt 'vavṛdhānaṃ vardhamānaṃ 'svarvat phalabhūtena svargeṇa tadvacchraṃ yathā veḥ tathā 'arcāma pūjayāma śaṃsāmetyarthaḥ |
tadullakṣaṇaṃ sāma vavṛdhānaṃ sarvatra yathā bhavati tathā arcāma |
kiṃca 'dhenavaḥ dogdhyaḥ 'adabdhāḥ ahiṃsitāḥ 'gāvaḥ 'yat 'barhiṣi 'samānaṃ sīdantaṃ 'divyaṃ divi bhavamindraṃ tvām 'ā 'vivāsān |
āgatya paricaranti kṣīraṃ duhanti tathā arcāma ||
ardhṛ॒ṣā vṛ̭ṣa॒bhiḥ sve॒daha̭vyairmṛ॒go nā॒śro a̭ti॒ yajjṷgu॒ryāt |
pra ma̭nda॒yurma̭nā॒ gūrtā॒ hotā̭ bha॒rate॒ mayo̭ mi॒thunā॒ yaja̭traḥ ||
ardhṛṣā | vṛṣabhaiḥ | svaḥ'havyaiḥ | mṛgaḥ | na | aśnaḥ | ati | juguryāt | pra | mandayuḥ | manām | gūrtaḥ | hotā | bharate | mayaḥ | mithunā | yajatraḥ || 2 ||
'yat yasmāt 'abhaḥ vyāpakaḥ pānā- rthaṃ dhāvan 'mṛgo 'na hariṇādirivāyamindraḥ akṣo'śanaśīlaḥ san 'ati 'juguryāt athyamupayuṅkte havirbhakṣaṇāya |
1. kṣa1-kiṃva yasmāt adabdhā ahiṃsitā dhenavo nūtanaprasavā gāvo barhiṣi yajñe tadarthaṃ divyaṃ sānaṃ devayajanasādhanam |
ayamindro yat yathā abhro mṛga iva ati juguyāt bhakṣayet tathā arcatītyarthaḥ |

kiṃca he gṛrta ugrṇendra manāṃ mananaṃ stotramicchatāṃ devānāṃ mandyuḥ stutiyuktaḥ maryaḥ hotā mānuṣaḥ etannāmakaḥ ṛtvik yajatraḥ yāganiṣpādakaḥ san mithunā mithunāni yugmarūpāṇi yājyāpuronuvākyādīni mithunau vā jāyāpatirūpaḥ san pra bharate prakarṣeṇa saṃpādayati tasmādarcatītyarthaḥ ||
nakṣaddhotā pari srmi tā yanbharadbharmā śaradaḥ pṛthivyāḥ |
krandaddhaśvo naryamāno ruvadraurantardūtau na rodasī caradvāk ||
nakṣat | hotā | pari | srmi | tā | yan | bharat | garbham | ā | śaradaḥ | pṛthivyāḥ | krandat | ardhaḥ | naryamānaḥ | ruvat | gauḥ | antaḥ | dūtaḥ | na | rodasī iti | carat | vāk ||3||
hotā homaniṣpādako'yamagniḥ mitā parimitā sapta sadanāni gārhapatyādisthānāni pari yan parito gacchan nakṣat vyāpnoti |
vyāpya ca śaradaḥ saṃvatsarasambandhinaṃ pṛthivyāḥ bhūmyāśca sambandhinaṃ garbha garbhasthānīyamannaṃ havilakṣaṇam ā bharat āharati svīkaroti |
saṃvatsarasambandhinaṃ vasantādikāle jyoti- ṣṭomādiṣu dīyamānaṃ pārthivaṃ havirbharat |
vasante vasante jyotiṣā yajeta iti śruteḥ |
kiṃca gauḥ gantā udgato vṛṣa iva ruvat rauti śabdayate |
dūto na vārtā- haro dūta iva rodasī rodasyordyāvāpṛthivyoḥ antaḥ madhye rodasyorantarā vāk stūyamānaḥ stuvan vā devān carat carati gacchati |
haviḥsvīkārāya pṛthivīṃ tatprāpaṇāya dyulokaṃ ca paribhramatītyarthaḥ ||
vaneḥ kartari karmaṇi vā kvivaci ityādinā kvibdhīrghaḥ saṃprasāraṇābhāvaśca ||
tā karmāṣatarāsmai pra cyautnāni devayanto bharante |
tā | karma | arṣatarā | asmai | pra | cyautnāni | deva'yantaḥ | bharante | jujoṣat | indraḥ | dasma'varcāḥ | nāsatyā'iva | sugmyau | rathe'sthāḥ || 4 ||
tā tāni aṣatarā arṣatarāṇi vyāptarāṇi vā havīṃṣi asmai indrāya tadartha karma kurmaḥ saṃpādayāmaḥ ||
kubhchandase vartamānārthe luṭhi mantre ghasa iti chelu~k |
cyautnāni cyāvayitṝṇi haṭhāni stotrāṇi karmāṇi svakīyāni sāmarthyāni vā devayantaḥ devānātmana icchanto yajamānāḥ pra bharante prakarṣeṇa saṃpādayanti |
dasmavarcāḥ darśanīyatejāḥ śatrupakṣayaṇabalo vā nāsatyāveva nāsatyāviva 1. ka-parimita parimitāni |
2. kṣā-harṣātiśayāt tadā nayamānaḥ nayan deveṣu havirbharam |
tāvica sugamyaḥ sugamyaḥ sukhena gantuṃ śakyaḥ ratheṣṭhāḥ rathe vartamāna evaṃbhūtaḥ san yujopat asmatkṛtaṃ stotrādi karma sevatām ||
tamu duhīndraṃ yo ha satvā yaḥ śūroṃ maghavā yo ratheṣṭhāḥ |
tam | ū~ iti | stuhi | indram | yaḥ | ha | satvā | yaḥ | śūraḥ | maghavā | yaḥ | rathesthāḥ | pratīcaḥ | cit | yodhīyān | vṛṣaṇvān | vavṛtraḥ | cit | tamasaḥ | vihantā || 5 ||
tamu tameva indraṃ stuhi he hota: stuti kuru |
yo ha ya: khalu satvā atiprabhūtabala: |
kiṃca pratīcaścit pratyabhimukhaṃ yo'hurapi yodhīyān yoddhuttama: ||
pratipūrvāddhante: kinantān lusamakārān jhasi acaḥ iti akāralope cī iti dīrgha: |
vṛṣā te vajra uta te vṛpā ratha: (ṛ. saṃ. 2. 16. 6) iti hi nigama: |
tathā vavṛtraścittamasa: āvarakasyāpi tamaso meghāde: vihantā viśeṣeṇa ghātaka: |
pra yaditthā mahinā nṛbhyo astyaṃ rodasī kṛkṣaye nāsmai |
saṃ vivya indro vṛjanaṃ na bhūmā bharti svadhāvā~ opaśamiva dyām ||
pra | yat | itthā | mahinā | nṛbhyaḥ | asti | aram | rodasī iti | kṛkṣaye iti | na | asmai | sam | vivye | indraḥ | vṛjanam | na | bhūma | bharti | svadhāvān | opaśam iva | dyām || 6 ||

yat ya: indra: mahinā mahattvena svaiśvaryeṇa nṛbhya: netṛtvya: karmanirvāhakebhyo yajamānebhya: pra asti prabhavati iṣṭe svargādipradāne rakṣitum asmai rakṣakāyandrāya rodasī dyāvāpṛthivyau kṛkṣaye kakṣayate satī saṃcārāya na araṃ nālaṃ na paryāpta |
jagato'dhīśasyendrasya saṃcārayālpatvāt dyāvāpṛthivyau na paryāpta ityartha: |
ayam indro vṛjanaṃ na bhūma bhūmiṃ bhūtāni vā vṛjanaṃ na vṛjanamiva ||
tadica tathathā āvṛṇoti tathātmapi svatejasā saṃ vivye samyagāvṛṇoti lokatrayam |
kiṃcāyaṃ svadhāvān annavān vṛṣṭilakṣaṇodakavān vā dyāṃ divaṃ bharti bibharti |
parasparaṃ samīpe vartamānaṃ kṣiyantarikṣākhyaṃ lokadvayam opaśam |

samatsu tvā śūra sutāmuraṇaṃ prapathinaṃtamaṃ paritaṃsayadhyai | sajoṣasa iṃdraṃ made kṣoṇīḥ sūri cidye anumadanti vājaiḥ || 7 || samatsu | tvā | śūra | sutām | urāṇam | prapathinaṃtamam | pari'taṃsayadhyai | sa'joṣasaḥ | iṃdram | made | kṣoṇīḥ | sūrim | cit | ye | anu'madanti | vājaiḥ || 7 ||

he śūra śauryopatendra samatsu saṃgrāmeṣu satāṃ tvāmevāśritya vartamānānāṃ prāṇinām urāṇam uruṇyatiprabhūtāni balādīni kurvāṇaṃ prapathinaṃtamaṃ prakṛṣṭamārgaṃtamaṃ sukṛtāmuttamamārgabhūtam indraṃ śatrūṇāṃ dārakaṃ tvā tvāṃ paritaṃsayadhyai avataṃsīkartuṃ bhūṣaṇīkartum |
made tava madārtha ca sajoṣasaḥ saha sevamānāḥ samānaprītayo vā kṣoṇīḥ kṣoṇyo viśaḥ parijanā mahataḥ prayatnante |
ye vājaiḥ balaiḥ anumadanti anukūlaṃ mādayanti saṃgrāme mahattastameva svāminaṃ kṛtvā mādayanti harṣayantītyarthaḥ |

ye yajamānā vājairhavirbhirmādayanti te samānaprītiyuktāstva manuṣya- bhūtā ṛtvijo yajamānabhūtāḥ prajāḥ samatsu sahamādanasthāneṣu yāgeṣūktalakṣaṇaviśiṣṭaṃ tvāmeva pūjayituṃ tava mādāya ca prayatnante ||

evā hi te śaṃ sarvanā samudra āpo yatta āsu madanti devīḥ | viśvā te anu joṣyā bhūdrauḥ sūrīścidyadi dhiṣā veṣi janān || 8 || eva | hi | te | śam | sarvanā | samudre | āpaḥ | yat | te | āsu | madanti | devīḥ | viśvā | te | anu | joṣyā | bhūt | gauḥ | sūrīn | cit | yadi | dhiṣā | veṣi | janān ||8||
he indra evā hi evaṃ hi sati te tava saṃbandhīni savanāni |
yat yadi devīḥ devyaḥ dyotamānāḥ āpaḥ samudre udakasamudravaṇāpādānabhūte'ntarikṣe āsu prajāsu nimittabhūtāsu te tvāṃ madanti mādayanti ||
yadā prāṇyupakārārthaṃ varṣaṇāya tvāṃ prerayanti vṛṣṭyudakāni tadā khalu tava somayāgāḥ sukhakarā bhavanti |
kiṃca he indra viśvā gauḥ sarvāpi stotraśastrarūpā vāk te tvām anukrameṇa joṣyā joṣaṇāhā prīṇayitrī bhūt bhavati |
yadi sūrīścin stotrādiprerayitṝn stotrajanānapi dhiṣā dhiṣayā prajñayā vṛṣṭipradānarūpeṇa karmaṇā vā veṣi kāmayase tadā sarvāpi stutistvadarthā bhavati ||

asāṃ yathā susakhāya ena svabhiṣṭyo narāṃ na śaṃsaiḥ | asyathā nu indrau vandaneṣṭāsturo na karma naryamāna ukthā || 9 || asām | yathā | su'sakhāyaḥ | ena | su'abhiṣṭayaḥ | narām | na | śaṃsaiḥ | asav | yathā | naḥ | indraḥ | vandanesthāḥ | turaḥ | na | karma | naryamānaḥ | ukthā || 9 || ka. 132
he ᵥena ina īśvara indra ᵥyathā ᵥsusakhāyaḥ śobhanatvadrūpasahāyavantaḥ ᵥasāma bhūyāsma kiṃca ᵥsvabhiṣṭyaḥ śobhanābhyeṣṇāḥ śobhanābhīṣṭāsāāma |

ᵥnaḥ asmabhyam ᵥindraḥ ᵥvandiṣṭāḥ asmastatau vartamānaḥ san ᵥture ᵥna tvaramāṇa iva naḥ asmākaṃ ᵥkarma ᵥukthā ukthaiḥ śaṃsaiḥ ᵥnayamānaḥ phalaṃ prāpayan stutyā tuṣṭaḥ san asmadīyena karmaṇā phalaprāpayitā ᵥyathā ᵥasat bhavet |
mitrāyuvo na pūrṇti suśiṣṭau madhyāyuva upa śikṣanti yajñaiḥ |
vi'spardhasaḥ | narām | na | śaṃsaiḥ | asmākam | asat | indraḥ | vajra'hastaḥ | mitra'yuvaḥ | na | pūḥ'patim | su'śiṣṭau | madhya'yuvaḥ | upa | śikṣanti | yajñaiḥ || 10 ||
ᵥnarāṃ netṝṇāṃ madhye saspardhān narān yathā ᵥvispardhasaḥ kurvanti sakhibhūtāḥ tadvayamapīndraṃ ᵥśaṃsaiḥ stutibhiḥ sakhāyo vayaṃ taṃ tathā kurmaḥ |
sa ca ᵥvajrahastaḥ virodhiśikṣaṇāya sarvadā vajradhārī ᵥindraḥ asmākam ᵥasat |

kiṃca ᵥmitrāyuvo ᵥna mitrecchavo hitaiṣiṇa iva ᵥsuśiṣṭau suśāsane vartamānaṃ ᵥpūrṇti puraḥ svāminaṃ yathā abhimatadānena pūjayanti tathā ᵥmadhyāyuvaḥ asmākaṃ śriyāṃ yaśasāṃ ca madhye'vasthitaṃ kāmayamānā adhvarvādyayaḥ ᵥyajñaiḥ yajñasādhanairhaviḥstotrā- dibhiḥ ᵥupa ᵥśikṣanti upetya yajante |
tīrthe nācchā tātṛṣāṇamokau dīrgho na sidhramā kṛṇotyadhvā |
yajñaḥ | hi | sma | indram | kaḥ | cit | ṛndhan | juhurāṇaḥ | cit | manasā | pari'yan | tīrthe | na | accha | tātṛṣāṇam | okaḥ | dīrghaḥ | na | sidhram | ā | kṛṇoti | adhvā || 11 ||
ᵥkaścit ᵥyajñaḥ yajñavān yajñānuṣṭhāyī ᵥṛndhan vardhayan bhavati |
ᵥjuhurāṇaścit kuṭilagatistu kaścit ᵥmanasā kevalena ᵥpariyan parito gacchan laukikaviṣayādikaṃ dhyāyan vartate |
ᵥtīrthe prasiddhe mārge ᵥaccha abhimukhyena samīpe vartamānam ᵥokaḥ pānīyādikaṃ sadanaṃ ᵥtātṛṣāṇaṃ pipāsāyuktaṃ yathā avilambena prīṇāti |
ᵥdīrgho ᵥna vakratvenātidūraḥ ᵥadhvā mārga iva |
sa yathā ᵥsidhraṃ phalaṃ pānīyādirūpaṃ phalārthinaṃ vā puruṣam ᵥā ᵥkṛṇoti arvākaroti nīcaiḥ karoti varjayatītyarthaḥ |
tasmādyajñamārgaṃ jānāno vakro dūre paribhramati nendraṃ tarpayati |
mo ṣū ṇa indrātra pṛtsu deverasti hi ṣmā te śubhminnavayāḥ |
mahaścidyasya mīḻahuṣo yuvyā haviṣmato maruto vandate gīḥ ||
mo iti | su | naḥ | indra | atra | pṛtsu | devaiḥ | asti | hi | sma | te | śubhmin | avayāḥ | mahaḥ | cit | yasya | mīḻahuṣaḥ | yuvyā | haviṣmataḥ | marutaḥ | vandate | gīḥ || 12 ||
he indra atra pṛtsu eṣu upasthiteṣu saṃgrāmeṣu vṛdhyartha meghajayeṣu devaiḥ marudādibhiḥ saha naḥ asmān mo ṣu maiva syākṣīriti śeṣaḥ |
he śubhmin balavannindra asti hi sma te asti hi sma tava khalu |
avayāḥ avayajanam ava- yujya pṛthakkṛtya yajanaṃ havirbhāgo'sti |
kevalaṃ marudbhya edha dīyate nāsmabhyam ataḥ kathaṃ yotsyāmīti na mantavyamityarthaḥ |
avayāḥ śatrūṇāṃ varjanaya gantā vajro'sti te |
yasya mama yuvyā phalenendreṇa vā saha miśrayantī gīḥ stutiśastrādirūpā vāk mahaścin mahato'pi mīḻahuṣaḥ sektṛn haviṣmato dattahaviṣā tadvataḥ maruto vandate stauti ||
atha trayodaśyā sūktādimārabhya kṛtāṃ stutiṃ nigamamaya phalaṃ prārthayate ||
eṣa stoma indra tubhyamasme etenaṃ gātuṃ hariva vido naḥ |
ā nau vavṛtyāḥ suvitārya deva vidyāmeṣaṃ vṛjanaṃ jīradānum ||
eṣaḥ | stomaḥ | indra | tubhyam | asme iti | etena | gātum | harivaḥ | vidaḥ | naḥ | ā | naḥ | vavṛtyāḥ | suvitārya | deva | vidhāma | iṣam | vṛjanam | jīradānum || 13 ||
he indra eṣa stomaḥ idānīṃkāritaprakāraḥ stotraviśeṣaḥ tubhyaṃ tvadartham |
he harivaḥ haribhyāṃ tadbalindra etena stotreṇa gamanena vā naḥ asmadīyaṃ gātuṃ devayajanamārgaṃ vidaḥ vidasva |
viditvā ca he deva suvitārya suhitāya śobhanagamanāya vā naḥ asmān ā vavṛtyāḥ āvartasva asmākaṃ pratyāgaccha |
‘ tvaṃ rājā ’ iti daśarcaṃ daśamaṃ sūktamāgatasyamaindraṃ traiṣṭubham |
‘ aindrāṇi traiṣṭubhānyamarucchaddānyāvaperan ’ ( āśva. śrau. 7. 12 ) iti sūtram ||
tvaṃ rājendra ye ca devā rakṣā nṛnpāhyasura tvamasmān |
tvam | rājā | indra | ye | ca | devāḥ | rakṣa | nṝn | pāhi | asura | tvam | asmān | tvam | sat'patiḥ | magha'vān | naḥ | tarutraḥ | tvam | satyaḥ | varsavānaḥ || 1 ||
he indra tvaṃ rājā adhipatiḥ sarvasya jagataḥ |
kiṃca ye devāḥ marudādayaḥ santi teṣāmapi viśeṣeṇa |
ato he asura śatrūṇāṃ nirasitaḥ tvaṃ nṝn asmān karmanetṝn yajamānān rakṣa pālaya |

tvaṃ ca satpatiḥ satāṃ mataḥ karmaphalasya vā pātā maghavā dhanavān naḥ asmākaṃ tarutraḥ tārayitā pāpāt kiṃca tvaṃ sasyaḥ abādhyaḥ sasyaphalo vā vasavānaḥ svatejasā sarvaṃ chādayan vasūni vā kurvan stotṛbhyaḥ sahodāḥ sahaso balasya dātā bhaveti śeṣaḥ ||
dano viśaṃ indra mṛdhavācaḥ sapta yatpuraḥ śarma śāradīrdarta |
ṛṇopo anavadyārṇā yūne vṛtraṃ purutsāya randhīḥ ||
danoḥ | viśaḥ | indra | mṛdha'vācaḥ | sapta | yat | puraḥ | śarma | śāradīḥ | darta | ṛṇoḥ | apaḥ | anavadya | arṇaḥ | yūne | vṛtram | puru'kutsāya | randhīḥ || 2 ||
he indra tvaṃ vṛtrasambandhdhasurāṇāṃ purabhedanasamaye mṛdhavācaḥ marṣavacanāḥ viśaḥ tadīyāḥ prajāḥ śarma sukhaṃ yathā bhavati tathā danaḥ adamanaḥ ||
sapta puraḥ etatsaṃsyakāḥ purīḥ darta adārayaḥ ||
' rāsasya ' ( pā. sū. 8. 2. 24 ) iti niyamāt talopābhāvaḥ ||
tathā kṛtvā he anavadya kātaratvānandin he indra arṇaḥ arṇaśīlāḥ apaḥ tadīyadurgasthānāni udakāśrayāṇi taṭākādīn ṛṇoḥ |
evamupadrutya purukutsāya etannāmne rājñe yūne nityataruṇāya tadarthaṃ vṛtram etannāmaka- masuraṃ randhīḥ asādhayaḥ ahanaḥ |
niruktadṛṣṭyā tu he indra mṛdhavāco viśo marṣaṇadhvaniyuktā vṛṣṭirūpāḥ prajā danaḥ adamanaḥ |
yadyadā sapta puraḥ śāradīrdarta sarpaṇasvabhāvavān pratyagrān vṛṣṭyā jagatpūrakān meghānadārayaḥ |
tathā kṛtvā he anavadya arṇa arṇasvabhāvā apaḥ ṛṇoḥ agamayaḥ prāvartayaḥ kulyādirūpeṇa |
anantaraṃ yūne purukutsāya vṛtraṃ mukhyaṃ meghaṃ randhīḥ asādhayaḥ ahanaḥ |
' tvaṃ ha tyadindra sapta yudhyan ' ( ṛ. saṃ. 1. 63. 7 ) ityādimantrāntareṣu prasiddhaḥ |
yāskastvevaṃ vyākhyāt - ' dano dānamanaso no manuṣyāninrda mṛdhavācaḥ kuru ' ( niru. 6. 31 ) iti ||
3. jha-he anavadya kātaratvānandin; jha-he anavadya kātaratayatvānandite |

ajā vṛta indra śūrapatnīyāṃ ca yebhiḥ puruhūta nūnam | rakṣau amiśuṣṃ tūrvayāṇaṃ siṃho na dame apāṃsi vastoḥ || 3 || arja | vṛtaḥ | indra | śūrapatnīḥ | dyām | ca | yebhiḥ | puru'huta | nūnam | rakṣo iti | agrim | aśruṣm | tūrvayāṇam | siṃhaḥ | na | dame | apāṃsi | vastoḥ || 3 ||
he indra śūrapatnīḥ śūraiḥ rakṣobhiḥ pālitāḥ vṛtaḥ |
tathā kṛtvā dyāṃ ca nūnam avaśyam aja |
he puruhūta bahubhirbahudhā vā āhūtendra yebhiḥ marudādibhiranugato'si taiḥ sahitaḥ san |
tathā kṛtvā aśupam āśoṣayitāramaśāntaṃ vā tūrvayāṇaṃ tūrṇagamanam agni
vaha | kutsam | indra | yasmin | cākan | syūmanyū iti | ṛjā | vātasya | aśvā | pra | sūraḥ | cakram | bṛhatāt | abhīke | abhi | spṛdhaḥ | yāsiṣat | vajra'bāhuḥ || 5 ||
he indra kutsam etannāmānamapi prāptaṃ syūmanyū |
tadicchantau satatagāminau vā ṛjā ṛjugāminau vātasya vāyoḥ samānavegau aśvā tadīyā- vaśva vaha prasthāpaya |
yasmin haviṣi nimittabhūte sati kutsaṃ cākan kāmayase tarpayase vā havirā- dikam |
tadarthaṃ sūraḥ prerakaḥ sūryaḥ cakraṃ svamaṇḍalaṃ svarathacakraṃ vā abhīke āsanne deśe bṛhatāt ūrdhvaṃ gamayatu prakāśayatu |
he vindra vtvāṃ vkavi: krāntadarśī anucāno vā hotā vakaṃsātau arpanīyasyāsya lābhe nimittabhūte sati vrapat stauti |
tathā ca vdāsāya prāṇyupakṣapayitre'surāya vkṣāṃ bhūmim vupabarhaṇīṃ śayyāṃ vkaḥ akaroḥ |
dārśikapāśukasaumikarūpā bhūmīḥ kṣiyantarikṣaśurūpā vā bhūmīḥ vdānu- citrāḥ dānena dairdhyanairvā cāyanīyāḥ vkarat karoti |
tisraḥ ayorajatahiraṇyamayāḥ purīrdānucitrāḥ khaṇḍanena citrā akarot |
tathā vduryoṇe duṣṭayonau sthāne vtannāmakasya rājñaḥ prītyarthaṃ vā vkuyavācaṃ kutsitaṃ śabdāyantametannāmāmasuraṃ vmṛdhi saṃgrāme vni vśret hiṃsitavān |
sanā tā taṃ indra navyā āguḥ saho namo'viraṇāya pūrvīḥ |
bhinatpuro na bhido adevaryanamo vadhardevasya pīyoḥ |
sanā | tā | te | indra | navyāḥ | ā | aguḥ | sahaḥ | namaḥ | aviraṇāya | pūrvīḥ | bhinat | puraḥ | na | bhidaḥ | adevīḥ | nṛnamaḥ | vardhaḥ | adevasya | pīyoḥ || 8 ||
he vindra vte tava saṃbandhīni vsanā sanātanāni nityāni tāni śauryāṇi vnavyāḥ navatarāḥ idānīṃtanā ṛpayaḥ vāguḥ āgacchanti stutivyājena prāpnuvantītyarthaḥ |
vtā hiṃsāḥ vaviraṇāya avigataraṇāya saṃgrāmanāśanāya vsahaḥ abhyabhavaḥ |
tadartha vbhidaḥ bhettṛrghātikāḥ vadevīḥ āsurīḥ vpuro vna purīrapi vbhinat vidāritavānasi |
tathā vadevasya astutyasya vpīyoḥ hiṃsakasyāsurasya vvadhaḥ vajraṃ vnanamaḥ anamayaḥ anukūlamakaroḥ |
he indra sanā nityaṃ tatta- tkāle te tava saṃbandhinyaḥ tā tāni |
tāḥ pūrvīḥ purātanya āpo navyā nṛnāḥ stutyāḥ sadyaḥ āguḥ āgacchanti |
tadarthaṃ namo hiṃsakān bandhakān vā meghān sahaḥ marṣaṇamakaroḥ |
kiṃca adevīḥ puraḥ avarpaṇenādevanaśīlānukapaṭa- bandhān bhinat bhijñānakaroḥ |
tathā adevasya adevanaśīlasya pīyoḥ pratikūlasya vṛtrasya vadharvadhaṃ nanamaḥ anamayaḥ |
tvaṃ dhurnirendra dhurnimatīṛṇorapaḥ sīrā na sravantīḥ |
pra yatsamudramati śūra parṣī pārayāṃ turvaśaṃ yaduṃ svasti |
tvam | dhurniḥ | indra | dhurni'matīḥ | ṛṇoḥ | apaḥ | sīrāḥ | na | sravantīḥ | pra | yat | samudram | ati | śūra | parṣī | pāraya | turvaśam | yadum | svasti || 9 ||

he vindra vtvaṃ vdhuniḥ kampayitā śatrūṇāmasi | ataḥ vdhunimatīḥ kampanopetataraṅgavatīḥ | athavā | dhunināma jalapratirodhakārī asuraḥ | sa eva pratibandhakatayā yāsāṃ tādṛśīḥ | vapaḥ vṛṇoḥ agamayaḥ | bhūmāvapātayaḥ | tatra dṛṣṭāntaḥ | vsravantīḥ pravahantīḥ vsīrā vna nadīnāmavaitat | saraṇavatīrdīriva |
evaṃ kṛtvā he śūra yat yadā samudram ati parṣi atikramya purayasyudakaṃ tadānīṃ turvaśaṃ yadum ubhāvapi rājarṣī svasti avināśaṃ pāraya apālayaḥ saṃpūrṇajalavarṣaṇena |
tathā ca mantrāntaraṃ- 'tvampo yadave turvaśāyāramayaḥ ' ( ṛ. saṃ. 5. 31. 8 ) iti ||
tvamasmākamindra viśvadha syā avukṛtamo nṛāṃ nṛpātā |
sa no viśvāsāṃ spṛdhāṃ sahodā vidyāmeṣaṃ vṛjanai jīradānum ||
tvam | asmākam | indra | viśvadha | syāḥ | avukṛtamaḥ | nṛām | nṛpātā | saḥ | naḥ | viśvāsāṃ | spṛdhām | sahaḥdāḥ | vidyāma | iṣam | vṛjanam | jīradānum ||10||
he indra tvamasmākaṃ viśvadha viśvasminnapi kāle viśvaprakārairvā avukṛtamaḥ |
tathā narāṃ nṛpātā asmadīyānāṃ putrabhṛtyādirūpāṇāṃ bahūnāṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ sarvadā rakṣako bhava |
kiṃca vasaḥ tvaṃ viśvāsāṃ spṛdhāṃ sarvāsāṃ spardhā- nimittānām asmatsenānāṃ sahodāḥ tāsāmarthāya balasya dātā bhava |
ādyā skandhogrīvī bṛhatī dvitīya- pādasya dvādaśākṣaratvāditareṣāṃ trayāṇāmaṣṭākṣaratvācca |
‘ dvitīyaścayaḍkusāriṇyuparobṛhatī vā skandho- grīvī vā ’ ( anu. 7.3 ) ityuktalakṣaṇasadbhāvāt |
‘ malsi palāṇuṣṭubhaṃ tu triṣṭubantaṃ svācā skandhogrīvī ’ ityanukrāntam |
‘ abhijidhapṛṣṭhaḥ ’ iti khaṇḍe sūtritaṃ- ‘ matsyapāyi te maha emenaṃ pratyetana ’ ( ādha. śrau. 8. 5 ) iti ||
matsyapāyi te mahaḥ pātrasyeva hurivo matsaro madaḥ |
matsi | apāyi | te | mahaḥ | pātrasyeva | hariḥvaḥ | matsaraḥ | madaḥ | vṛṣā | te | vṛṣṇe | induḥ | vājī | sahasrasātamḥ || 1 ||
he harivaḥ haribhyāṃ tadvajjindra mahaḥ mahān pūjyo'yaṃ somaḥ pātrasyeva tatpātreṇaiva somapātreṇa yathā dhāryate somastatsadṛśena te tvayā |
pātrasyeva te tvat svabhūto maho mahān soma iti vā yojanā |
yataḥ pibasi ataḥ matsi māyasi mādayasva vā |
pātre yathā somaḥ pūryate tathā atyadhikaṃ piba pītvā ca mādayasvetyarthaḥ |
matsaraḥ madasādhanaḥ madaḥ tarpayitā vṛṣā varṣitā induḥ kledayitā āhlādakārītyarthaḥ |
sahasrasātam aparimitadātṛtamaḥ sahasrapuruṣasaṃbhajanaparyāptasahasrasyatiśayo vā evaṃmahānubhāvaḥ somaḥ saṃpāditaḥ |
ā na̭ste gantu matsaro vṛṣā ma॒do varḙṇyaḥ |
ā | naḥ | te | gantu | matsaraḥ | vṛṣā | madaḥ | vareṇyaḥ | sahavān | indra | sānasiḥ | pṛtanāṣāṭ | amartyaḥ || 2 ||
he indra te tvāṃ naḥ asmadīyaḥ matsaraḥ marpaṇasādhanaḥ somaḥ ā gantu āgacchatu |
vṛṣā varṣakaḥ madaḥ tarpayitā vareṇyaḥ varaṇīyaḥ sahāvān sahāyavān sahasā balena tadvān vā sānasiḥ saṃbhajanīyaḥ pṛtanāṣāṭ śatrusenāyāḥ abhibhavitā amartyaḥ avināśī |
he indra sahāvān asmatsatsoma- sahāyavān balavān vā sānasirasmābhiḥ saṃbhajanīyaḥ pṛtanāpāḍamartyaśca bhavasi ||
tvaṃ hi śūraḥ sa̭nitā co॒dayo ma̭nuṣo ra॒tham |
tvam | hi | śūraḥ | sanitā | codayaḥ | manuṣaḥ | ratham | sahavān | dasyum | avratam | opaḥ | pātram | na | śociṣā || 3 ||
he indra tvaṃ khalu śūraḥ śauryopetaḥ sanitā dātāsi |
ataḥ manuṣaḥ manuṣyasya me rathaṃ raṃhaṇaṃ spandanaṃ manorathaṃ vā svargagamanasādhanaṃ yajñarathaṃ vā codayaḥ preraya |
kiṃca tvaṃ sahāvān soma- sahāyavān balavān vā bhūtvā dasyum upakṣapayitāram avratam akarmāṇamananuṣṭhāyinam opaḥ daha |
kimiba śociṣā dīptyā jvālayā agniḥ pātraṃ na svādhāra pātraviśeṣamiva |
yāgādhikārī san yo na yajate taṃ dahetyarthaḥ ||
muṣāya | sūryam | kave | cakram | īśānaḥ | ojasā | vaha | śuṣṇāya | vadham | kutsam | vātasya | aśvaiḥ || 4 ||
he kave krāntadarśinindra īśānaḥ samarthaḥ san sūrya sūryasya ||
tatsaṃbandhi cakram ekam ojasā balena sāmarthyā- tiśayena muṣāya amuṣmāṇaḥ ||
pūrvaṃ sūryasya cakradvayamasti ekamindro mumuṣa itihāsaḥ |
'kutsaṃ kartanasādhanaṃ 'vadhaṃ vajraṃ 'vātasya vāyoḥ 'aśvaiḥ vāyuvegavatsvairyuktaḥ san 'vaha avahaḥ śuṣṇaṃ hantuṃ vajramadhārayaḥ |
taṃ ca hatvā tadīyairvāyuvegairastadupalakṣitastadīyairdhanaiḥ kutsaṃ maharṣimagamaḥ śuṣṇāsuradhanaṃ kutsāyādā ityarthaḥ |
tathā cānyatra 'tvaṃ kutsaṃ śuṣṇahasyevāvitha ' ( ṛ. saṃ. 1. 51. 6 ), ' kutsāya śuṣmaśuṣam ' ( ṛ. saṃ. 4. 16. 12 ) ityāhīti ||
śuṣmintamo hi te mado ghumintama uta kratuḥ |
śuṣmin'tamaḥ | hi | te | madaḥ | ghumin'tamaḥ | uta | kratuḥ | vṛtra'hā | varivaḥ'vidā | maṃsīṣṭhāḥ | aśva'sātarmaḥ || 5 ||
'uta api ca te 'kratuḥ karma vyāpāro'smadarthaḥ 'śuṣmintamaḥ atiśayenānnavān yaśovān vā ||
ubhayatra 'athasmāyādīni cchandasi ' iti bhasaṃjñā bādhitavānna lopaḥ ||
he indra 'aśvasātarmaḥ aśvopalakṣitabahudhanadātthaṃ 'vṛtrahā vṛtraghātinau 'varivovidā dhanasya paricaraṇasya vā vedayitārau lambhayitārau tava madakrat 'maṃsīṣṭhāḥ anujñātavānasi |
yathā pūrvebhyo jaritṛbhya indra maryaivāpo na tṛṣyate bubhūtha |
tāmanu tvā nividaṃ johavīmi vidyāmeṣaṃ vṛjanaṃ jīradānum ||
yathā | pūrvebhyaḥ | jaritṛ'bhyaḥ | indra | maryaḥ'iva | āpaḥ | na | tṛṣyate | bubhūtha | tām | anu | tvā | ni'vidam | johavīmi | vidyām | iṣam | vṛjanam | jīra'dānum ||6||
tasmāt 'tāṃ 'nividaṃ svaprītikarīṃ prasiddhāṃ stutiṃ 'tvā tubhyam 'anu 'johavīmi punaḥpunaḥ karomi |
tāṃ nividamanu ' tṛtīyārthe ' ( pā. sū. 1. 4. 85 ) ityanayoḥ karmapravacanīyatvam ||
' masti naḥ ' iti ṣaḍṛcaṃ dvāviśaṃ sūktamāgastyamaindramānuṣṭubham |
pūrvatra tuśabdāt ' triṣṭubantaṃ tu ' ityuktvāt amyā triṣṭup |

matsi no vasya̭iṣṭaya indramindo vṛṣā viśa | ṛdhāyamāṇa invasi śatrumānta na vindasi || 1 || matsi | naḥ | vasyaḥ'iṣṭaye | indram | indo iti | vṛṣā | ā | viśa | ṛdhāyamāṇaḥ | invasi | śatrum | anti | na | vindasi || 1 ||
he ᵥindo kledayitaḥ soma tvaṃ ᵥno ᵥvasyaṣṭaye vasīyaso dhanasya prāptaye utlakṣaṇāya yāgāya vā ᵥindraṃ ᵥmatsi mādayasva |
tadarthaṃ tvamevendraṃ ᵥvṛṣā kāmānāṃ varṣitā ᵥā ᵥviśa |
atha tathā pītaḥ san ᵥṛdhāyamāṇaḥ śatrūn hiṃsayan ᵥinvasi vyāpnoṣi |
ataḥ ᵥanti antike ᵥśatruṃ ᵥna ᵥvindasi na labhase |
yataḥ śatruvastvasāmarthyena palāyitāḥ ato na vindasi |
ᵥdivyā divi bhavā ᵥaśaniḥ ᵥiva aśanibhūtvā asmaddveṣṭṛn ᵥjahi |
asunvantaṃ samaṃ jahi dūṇāśaṃ yo na te maryaḥ | asmabhyamasya vedanaṃ daddi surirvidohate || 4 ||
asunvantam | samam | jahi | duḥ'narśam | yaḥ | na | te | maryaḥ | asmabhyam | asya | vedanam | daddi | sūriḥ | cit | ohate || 4 ||

he indra ᵥasunvantaṃ somābhipavamakurvāṇam | tvāmayajantamityarthaḥ | ᵥdūṇāśaṃ duḥkhena nāśanīyaṃ ᵥsamam | ayaṃ sarvānudāttaḥ sarvaśabdaparyāyaḥ | ayaṣṭun sarvān | yadvā | samamekodyogenāviśeṣeṇa vā ᵥjahi | tena kimaparāddhamiti ata āha | ᵥyaḥ ᵥte tava ᵥmayaḥ | maya iti sukhanāma | tava sugrahetuḥ ᵥna bhavati | yo homema stutyā vā na prīṇāti taṃ jahi | kiṃca ᵥasya ᵥvedanaṃ dhanam ᵥasmabhyaṃ ᵥdaddi dehi || 'dada dāne' ityasmāt vyatyayena parasmaipadam | chāndasaḥ śapo luk || ᵥsurirvidohate | cit evārthe | sūrinnāca stotā eva ohate | vahati prāpnoti dhanam ||
ādyo yasya dvibarhaso'rkeṣu sānuṣagsat | ājāvindrasyendo prāvo vājeṣu vājinam || 5 ||
ādyaḥ | yasya | dvi'barhasaḥ | arkeṣu | sānuṣak | asat | ājau | indrasya | indo iti | pra | āvaḥ | vājeṣu | vājinam || 5 ||
he ᵥindo soma tava ᵥyasya ᵥdvibarhasaḥ stotrahavīrūpadvividhaparivṛḍhakarmavato yajamānasya ᵥarkeṣu mantreṣu ᵥsānuṣak sānuṣaṅgaḥ sātyam ᵥasat bhavet tam ᵥāvaḥ |
yaṃ dvayoḥ sthānayoḥ parivṛḍhaṃ yamindra he indo yadārkeṣu sānuṣagsat bhaveḥ tadāvaḥ arakṣaḥ atarpayo vā |
tasyaiva ᵥindrasya ᵥājau saṃgrāme he soma ᵥvājinaṃ tathāścavantaṃ tamindraṃ ᵥvājeṣu balepvaleṣu vā nimittabhūteṣu ᵥprāvaḥ prakarṣeṇa arakṣayaḥ |
pānasamaye tarpayitvā saṃgrāmasamaye balavardhanena jayaprāptaśatrudhanatarpaṇena vā arakṣaḥ ityarthaḥ |
yathā pūrvebhyo jaritṛbhya indra maryaivāpo na tṛṣyate babhūtha |
tāmanu tvā nividaṃ johavīmi vidyāmeṣaṃ vṛjanaṃ jīradānum |
yathā | pūrvebhyaḥ | jaritṛ'bhyaḥ | indra | maryaḥ'iva | āpaḥ | na | tṛṣyate | babhūtha | tām | anu | tvā | ni'vidam | johavīmi | vidyām | iṣam | vṛjanam | jīradānum || 6 ||
‘ ā carṣaṇiprāḥ ’ iti pañcarcaṃ trayodaśaṃ sūktamāgastyamaindraṃ traiṣṭubham |
‘ aindrāṇi traiṣṭubhānyamaruha- dvānyāvaperan ’ ( āśva. śrau. 7. 12 ) iti sūtritatvāt ||
ā carṣaṇiprā vṛṣabho janānāṃ rājā kṛṣṭīnāṃ puruhūta indraḥ |
stutaḥ śravasyavasopa madriguktvā harī vṛṣaṇā yāhyarvāṅ ||
ā | carṣaṇi'prāḥ | vṛṣabhaḥ | janānām | rājā | kṛṣṭīnām | puru'hūtaḥ | indraḥ | stutaḥ | śravasyan | avasā | upa | madrik | yuktvā | harī iti | vṛṣaṇā | ā | yāhi | arvāṅ || 1 ||

he indra stutaḥ asmābhiḥ śravasyan havirlakṣaṇāsamicchan avasā asmadrakṣaṇena tarpaṇena vā yuktaḥ san madrik madabhimukhamañjan vṛṣaṇā varṣakau yuvānau harī aśvau yuktvā rathe yojayitvā arvāṅ asmadabhimukham ā yāhi āgaccha ||
ye te vṛṣaṇo vṛṣabhāsa indra brahmayujo vṛṣarathāso atyāḥ |
tāṃ ā tiṣṭha tebhirā yāhyarvāṅ havāmahe tvā suta indra somam ||
ye | te | vṛṣaṇaḥ | vṛṣabhāsaḥ | indra | brahma'yujaḥ | vṛṣa'rathāsaḥ | atyāḥ | tān | ā | tiṣṭha | tebhiḥ | ā | yāhi | arvāṅ | havāmahe | tvā | sute | indra | somam || 2 ||
he indra te tava sambandhinaḥ vṛṣaṇaḥ varṣakā yuvāno varṣavanto vā vṛṣabhāsaḥ śreṣṭhāḥ brahmayujaḥ parivṛḍhena mantreṇa yujyamānāḥ vṛṣarathāsaḥ varṣarathavantaḥ |
īdṛśāḥ atyāḥ aśvā ye santi tān ā tiṣṭha āśraya āroha |
tebhiḥ taiḥ arvāṅ asmadabhimukham ā yāhi āgaccha |
vayaṃ ca he indra some sute sati tvā tvāṃ havāmahe āhvayāmaḥ ||
ā tiṣṭha rathaṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ vṛṣā te sutaḥ somaḥ pariṣiktā madhūni |
yuktvā vṛṣamyā vṛṣabha kṣitīnāṃ haribhyāṃ yāhi pravatopa madrik ||
ā | tiṣṭha | ratham | vṛṣaṇam | vṛṣā | te | sutaḥ | somaḥ | pari'siktā | madhūni | yuktvā | vṛṣa'bhyām | vṛṣabha | kṣitīnām | harī'bhyām | yāhi | pravatā | upa | madrik ||3||
tathā ^madhūmi madhurāṇi ghṛtakṣīrādīni ^pariviktā paritaḥ siktāni saṃpāditāni|
he ^vṛṣabha varṣakendra ^vṛṣamyāṃ varṣakābhyāṃ ^haribhyāṃ ^yuktvā rathaṃ yojayitvā ^kṣitīnāṃ karmasu nivasataṃ yajamānānāṃ asmākamanugrahāya|
ayaṃ yajño devayā ayaṃ miyedha imā brahmāṇyayamindra somaḥ |
stīrṇaṃ barhirā tu śakra pra yāhi pibā niṣadya vi mucā harī iha ||

o suṣṭuta indra yāhyarvāṅupa brahmāṇi mānyasya kāroḥ |

tvayā vayaṃ maghavannindra śatrūn abhi ṣyāma mahato manyamānān |

etadādīni tṛtīyavarjitāni pañca sūktāni prātaranuvākāśvinaśastrayorbahume chandasi viniyuktāni |
‘athāśvina:’ iti khaṇḍe sūtritaṃ- ‘yuvo rajāṃsīti pañcānāṃ tṛtīyamuddharet’ (āśva. śrau. 4. 15) iti ||
yuvo rajāṃsi suyamāso aśvā ratho yadvāṃ paryaṇīṃsi dīyat |
hiraṇyayā vāṃ pa॒vaya: pra॒yāyanmadhva: pibantā uṣasa: sacethe ||

he aśvinau vyuvo: yuvayo: vaśvā: rathoḍāra: vrajāṃsi rañkān lokān vsuyamāsa: śobhananiyamanā: |
vyat yadā vvāṃ vratha: varṇasi araṇīyān abhimatadeśān vpari vdīyat parigacchet parito gacchati vā |
kiṃca rathāgamanakāle vvāṃ yuvayo: vpavaya: vajrā rathanemayo vā vhiraṇyayā: hiraṇmayā: vprayāyan pṛṣṇanyabhimatam |
yasmādevaṃ tasmāt yuvāṃ vmadhva: madhuno madhusadṛśasya somarasasya ||
somarasaṃ vpibantau āsvādayantau vuṣasa: upa:sambandhini kāle vsacethe yajñaṃ saṃgacchethe |
svasā yadvāṃ viśvagūrtī bharāti vājāyeṣṭe madhupāviṣe ca ||
yuvam | atyasya | ava | nakṣatha: | yat | vi'patamana: | naryasya | pra'yajyo: | svasā | yat | vām | viśva'gūrtī iti viśva'gūrtī | bharāti | vājāya | iṣṭe | madhu'pā | viṣe | ca ||2||
he aśvinau vyuvaṃ yuvāṃ vyat vatyasya atanaśīlasya satatasaṃcāriṇa: vvipatamana: vividhagamanasya vicitragamanasya vā vnaryasya manuṣyāṇāṃ hitasya vprayajyo: prakarṣeṇa pūjyasya |
uttakarūpaṃ ratham vava avasthāt tadudayāt pūrvaṃ vnakṣatha: vyāpnutho devayajanaṃ gantum |
kiṃca vyat yadā vviśvagūrtī sarvastutyau sarvadā udūrṇau vā vvāṃ yuvayo: vsvasā svasasthānīyā svayaṃsāriṇī vā uṣā: vbharāti poṣate tvadāgamanāya prabhātaṃ karoti |
yadā he vmadhupāau madhurasya somarasasya pātau yuvāṃ yajamāna: vvājāya balāya gamanāya vā viṣe prabhūtannāya viṣṭe stauti |
yuvaṃ parya ustriyāyāmadhattaṃ pakmāmāyāmava pūryaṃ goḥ |
antaryadvinino vāmṛtapsū dvāro na śuciyarjate haviṣmān ||

bhogollāviṇyāṃ gavi ᵥpathaḥ ᵥadhattam adhārayataṃ sthāpitavantau |
tathā ᵥāmāyām apakvāyāṃ ᵥpakkaṃ paripakkaṃ bhogayogyaṃ gosaṃbandhi dugdhaṃ ᵥpūyaṃ pūrvabhavaṃ tatraivoptapsam ᵥava avastādadhārayatama |
tathā madhvaḥ madhusravāḥ somarasā api yuvābhyāṃ prati yanti abhigacchanti |
ā vāṃ dānārya vavṛtiya dastrā gorohena taugrayo na jivriḥ |
apaḥ kṣoṇī saṃcate māhinā vāṃ jurṇo vāmakṣuraṃhaso yajatrā ||

pra vāṃ śara ddhanvṛṣabho na niṣpāṭ pūrvīriṣabharati madhvaṃ i ṣṇan |
evairanyasyaṃ pī payanta vā jairveśantīrūrdhvā na ryo na āguḥ ||

he aśvinau vāṃ yuvayoḥ ruśataḥ dīptasya vapsasaḥ rūpasyaiva vapuṣo vā syāpayitrī gīḥ stutivāk tribarhiṣi tridhāvāstīrṇabarhiṣke sadasi yāgasadane nṛn karmanetṛnaramān pinvate āpyāyayati āpyāyayatu vā ucchinnapradānādinā |

yuvāṃ puṣevāśvinā puraṃdhirāmimuṣāṃ na jarate haviṣmān | huve yadvāṃ varivasyā gṛṇāno vidyāmeṣaṃ vṛjanaṃ jīradānum || 9 || yuvām | puṣā'iva | aśvinau | puram'dhiḥ | agnim | upām | na | jarate | haviṣmān | huve | yat | vām | varivasyā | gṛṇānaḥ | vidyām | iṣam | vṛjanam | jīra'dānum ||9||
he aśvinau yuvāṃ puraṃdhiḥ bahuprajñaḥ pūyeva poṣaka iva haviṣmān haviryuktaḥ jarate stauti |
prātaranuvākāśvinaśastrayoḥ āśvinakratu- vat ābheyopasyayorapi sannāvāditi bhāvaḥ |
yat yadā varivasyā varivasyayā pari- caryayā yuktaḥ gṛṇānaḥ stotā stauti tadā yajamāno'pi jarate ityarthaḥ |
'avaviddham' iti ṣaṣṭhī 'tadvāṃ narā nāsatyau' ityaṣṭamī ca ubhe triṣṭubhau |
tathā ca sūtritam- 'abhūdidaṃ yo vāṃ parijmeti trīṇi' ( āśva. śrau. 4. 15 ) iti ||

abhūdidaṃ vayunamo ṣu bhūṣatā ratho vṛṣaṇvānmedatā manīṣīḥ | dhiyaṃjinvā dhiṣṇyā viśvalāṃvas divo napātā sukṛte śucivratā || 1 || abhūt | idam | vayunam | o iti | su | bhūṣata | rathaḥ | vṛṣaṇvān | medata | manīṣīḥ | dhiyam'jinvā | dhiṣṇyā | viśvalāṃvas iti | divaḥ | napātā | su'kṛte | śuci'vratā ||1||
he ^manīṣiṇa: manasvino medhāvina ṛtvija: asmākam ^hvaṃ ^vayunaṃ prajñānam ^abhūt utpannam |
^vṛṣaṇān abhimatavarṣaṇavān ^ratha: aśvino: sambandhī gamana- sādhano ratha āgata iti śeṣa: |
