jambhayatamabhito rāyataḥ śuno hataṃ mṛdho vidadhustānyaśvinā | vācaivācaṃ jaritṛ ratninīṃ kṛtamubhā śaṃsaṃ nāsatyāvataṃ mama || 4 || jambhayatam | abhitaḥ | rāyataḥ | śunaḥ | hatam | mṛdhaḥ | vidadhuḥ | tāni | aśvina | vācam'vācam | jarituḥ | ratninīm | kṛtam | ubhā | śaṃsam | nāsatyā | avatam | mama ||4||
he aśvinau ᵥrāyataḥ ninditaṃ śabdayataḥ asmān hantumāgacchato vā ᵥśunaḥ śvasadaśān ᵥabhitaḥ ᵥjambhayataṃ nāśayatama |
tathā ᵥmṛdhaḥ teṣāṃ saṃgrāmān saṃgrāmaṃ kurvato vā ᵥhataṃ mārayatama |
kiṃca ᵥjarituḥ yuṣmān stotuḥ ᵥvācaivācaṃ tāṃ tāṃ stutilakṣaṇāṃ vācaṃ ᵥratninīṃ ᵥkṛtaṃ sarvamapi stutiṃ ramaṇīyaphalavatīṃ kurutam |
he ᵥnāsatyā satyabhūtau yuvām ᵥubhā ᵥmama madīyāṃ ᵥśaṃsaṃ stutim ᵥavataṃ rakṣatama ||

yuvametaṃ cakrathuḥ sindhuṣu plavamātmanvantaṃ pakṣiṇaṃ taugrāya kam | yenaṃ devatrā manasā nirūhathuḥ supamnī pethathuḥ kṣodasaḥ mahaḥ || 5 || yuvam | etam | cakrathuḥ | sindhuṣu | plavam | ātman'vantam | pakṣiṇam | taugrāya | kam | yena | deva'trā | manasā | niḥūhathuḥ | su'pamnī | pethathuḥ | kṣodasaḥ | mahaḥ || 5 ||

he aśvinau ᵥyuvaṃ yuvāṃ ᵥsindhuṣu samudrodakeṣu ᵥetaṃ ᵥplavaṃ prasiddhaṃ stutisādhanaṃ plavaṃ nāvam ᵥātmanvantaṃ dāḍharyavantaṃ ᵥpakṣiṇaṃ pakṣavattutisādhanarathavantaṃ ᵥtaugrāya tugnāmno rājñaḥ putrāya bhujyunāmne rājñe ᵥkaṃ sukhakaraṃ ᵥcakrathuḥ |
taugyo bhujyu rājā samudravartī sasenaḥ paracakraṃ pramathituṃ prasthitaḥ |
taṃ pratīpabalāni āgattyāpātayan sa ca prasādaphalakarāśvinau stutvā svātmānaṃ rakṣa ityayamitihāso bahudhā pūrva prapañcitaḥ |
ayamarthastu ‘tamahathurnaubhiḥ’ (ṛ. saṃ. 1. 116. 3), ‘catasro nāvaḥ’ (ṛ. saṃ. 1. 182. 6), ‘tribhī rathaiḥ’ (ṛ. saṃ. 1. 116. 4) ityādimantrāntareṣu prasiddhaḥ |
ᵥyena yuṣmattena plavena ᵥdevatrā deveṣu madhye ᵥmanasā anugrahayuktayā buddhayā |
tathā ᵥsupamnī śobhanapatanaṃ yathā bhavati supatanāva vā yuvāṃ ᵥmahaḥ mahataḥ ᵥkṣodasaḥ |

arvividdhaṃ taugryamapsvantaranārambhaṇe tamasi praviddham | catasro nāvojaṭhalasya juṣṭā udaśvibhyāmiṣitāḥ pārayanti || 6 || arva'viddham | taugryam | ap'su | antaḥ | anārambhaṇe | tamasi | pra'viddham | catasraḥ | nāvaḥ | jaṭhalasya | juṣṭāḥ | ut | aśvibhyām | iṣitāḥ | pārayanti || 6 ||
ᵛapasvantaḥ madhye ᵛavaviddham avasthācchannabhiḥ pātitam ᵛanārambhaṇe anālambane ālambana- rahite ᵛtamasi |
dṛṣṭisādādipratibandhake jalamadhye ᵛpraviṣṭaṃ prakarṣeṇa pīḍitaṃ ᵛtaudhyaṃ bhujyuṃ ᵛjaṭhalasya¹ jaṭharadudakadhārakasya madhye ᵛjuṣṭāḥ sevitāḥ |
ᵛaśvibhyāmiṣitāḥ ᵛyatanto ᵛnāvaḥ ᵛut ᵛpārayanti utsārayanti prāpayanti ||
kaḥ svi॒dvṛkṣo॒ niṣṭhi̭to॒ madhyḙ a॒rṇaso॒ yaṃ tau॒dhyo nā̭dhita॒ḥ parya̭ṣvajat |
pūrṇā॒ mṛga̭sya॒ pata̭rau॒rivāra̭bha u॒daśvi̭nā ūhathu॒ḥ śroma̭tāya॒ kam ||

kaḥ | svi॒t | vṛkṣaḥ | niḥ'sthitaḥ | madhye | a॒rṇasaḥ | yam | tau॒dhyaḥ | nā̭dhitaḥ | pari̭'a॒sattvajat | pūrṇā | mṛga̭sya | pata̭rauḥ'iva | ā॒'rabha̭ | ut | a॒śvinau | ūhathuḥ | śroma̭tāya | kam || 7 ||
ᵛkaḥ ᵛsvit kaścidanugrāhakaḥ ᵛvṛkṣaḥ vṛkṣavikāro rathaḥ |
ᵛyaṃ vṛkṣaṃ ᵛtaudhyaḥ tumaputro bhujyuḥ ᵛnādhitaḥ yācamānaḥ ᵛparyaṣvajat pariṣvakmakarot |
ᵛpataroḥ patanaśīlasya ᵛmṛgasya mārjayituḥ śodhayituhiṃsādeḥ ᵛārambhe ālambanāya parṇānīva² |
he ᵛaśvinī ᵛśromatāya kīrtimattvāya ᵛut ᵛūhathuḥ ūrdhvaṃ prāpayathaḥ |
tadvā॒ṃ narā̭ nāsa̭tyā॒vanṷ pyā॒ghnāṃ mā॒nāṃsa̭ u॒catha̭mavocan |
a॒smādya॒ sa॒dasa̭ḥ so॒myādā॒ vidyā̭me॒ṣaṃ vṛ॒jana̭m jī॒radā̭num ||
tat | vām | narā̭ | nāsa̭tyā | anṷ | pyā॒ghnām | mā॒nāṃsaḥ | u॒catha̭m | a॒vo॒ca॒n | a॒smāt | a॒dya | sa॒dasa̭ḥ | so॒myāt | ā | vidyā̭ma | i॒ṣam | vṛ॒jana̭m | jī॒ra'dā̭num || 8 ||
he ᵛnarā netārī karmaṇo narākārī vā he ᵛnāsatyau asatyarahitau satyaphalau vā ᵛvāṃ yuvāṃ ᵛtat tādṛśaṃ stotram ᵛanu ᵛsyāt anukūlaṃ bhavatu anubhavatu vā vām |
ᵛvāṃ prati ᵛmānāsaḥ pūjāvanto'smadīyā hotrādayaḥ ᵛyat ᵛucathaṃ stotram ᵛavocan akurvan tadvām anu pyāt |
he aśvinau ᵛatha asmin pradhānayāgadine ᵛasmāt asmābhiḥ kriyamāṇāt ᵛsadasaḥ sambandhinaḥ ᵛsomyāt somayāgasaṃpādakāt |
‘ taṃ yujāthām ’ iti ṣaṭkaṃ caturthaṃ sūktaṃ traidhubhagamāstyamāśvinam ||
taṃ yṷñjāthā॒ṃ mana̭so॒ yo ja॒vīyā̭ntri॒vandhṷro vṛṣa॒ṇā ya॒strica̭kraḥ |
yeno̭pa॒yātha॒ḥ sukṛ̭to du॒roṇa॒ṃ tridhā̭tunā pata॒tho vi॒rna pa॒rṇaiḥ ||

tam | yu॒ñjā॒thā॒m | mana̭saḥ | yaḥ | ja॒vīyā̭n | tri॒'vandhṷraḥ | vṛ॒ṣa॒ṇā | yaḥ | tri॒'cakra̭ḥ | yena̭ | u॒pa॒'yātha̭ḥ | su॒'kṛ̭taḥ | du॒roṇa̭m | tri॒'dhā॒tu॒nā | pa॒thaḥ | viḥ | na | pa॒rṇaiḥ || 1 ||
he vṛṣaṇā varṣakau kāmānāṃ yuvāṃ taṃ vakṣyamāṇaguṇaviśiṣṭaṃ rathaṃ yuñjāthāṃ yojayatam |
virna parṇaiḥ pakṣī pakṣairyathā śīghraprayatnena gacchati tadvadukalakṣaṇena rathena patathaḥ gacchathaḥ ||
su॒vṛ॒drathau॒ varta̭te ya॒jñabhi॒kṣāṃ yatti̭ṣṭhathaḥ kra॒tuma̭ntānu॒ pṛkṣḙ |
va॒pu॒rvapṷṣyā sa॒catā॒miya̭ṃ gī॒rdivo̭ du॒hitrā॒ upa̭sā sacethe ||

su॒'vṛt | rathaṷ | varta̭te | yan | a॒bhi | kṣām | yat | ti̭ṣṭhathaḥ | kra॒tu'ma̭ntā | anṷ | pṛkṣḙ | va॒puḥ | va॒puḥ'pyā | sa॒catā̭m | i॒yam | gīḥ | di॒vaḥ | du॒hitrā̭ | u॒pa॒sā | sa॒cethe॒ iti̭ || 2 ||
he aśvinau yuvayoḥ rathaḥ suvṛt śobhanavartanaḥ śobhanacakraparibhramaṇaḥ yan gacchan kṣām abhi vartate devayajanabhūmiṃ prati gacchati |
yat yaṃ rathaṃ kratumantā saṃkalpavantau karmavantau vā pṛkṣe annanāmaiṭat |
anantaraṃ vapuṣyā yuṣmadvapuṣi hitā śarīravardhanī iyaṃ gīḥ idānīṃ kriyamāṇaprakārā stutirūpā vāk vapuḥ sacatām |
yuvāṃ ca divaḥ dyulokasya ādityasya vā duhitrā duhitṛsthānītayā upasā upadevatayā sacethe yajñaṃ saṃgacchethe |
ā ti̭ṣṭhataṃ su॒vṛdra॒tho vā̭manu॒ vratā̭ni॒ varta̭te ha॒viṣma̭ān |
yena̭ na॒rā nāsa̭tyāe॒ṣadhyai॒ vṛti̭ryāthasta॒rnāya॒ tmanḙ ca ||
ā | ti̭ṣṭhatam | su॒'vṛt | ra॒thaḥ | vā॒m | anṷ | vratā̭ni | varta̭te | ha॒viṣma̭ān | yena̭ | na॒rā | nāsa̭tyā | i॒ṣa॒dhyai | vṛti̭ḥ | yā॒thaḥ | ta॒rnāya̭ | tmanḙ | ca || 3 ||
he aśvinau ᵛvāṃ yuvāṃ ᵛsuvṛttaṃ śobhanavartanaṃ ratham ᵛā ᵛtiṣṭhatam āśrayatama |
haviṣmato yajamānasya ᵛvratāni karmāṇi ᵛanu ᵛvartate |
ᵛyena ca rathena he ᵛnarā netārau vā he ᵛnāsatyā asatyarahitau yuvām ᵛiṣayadhyai yajñaṃ prāptumicchatamiti śeṣaḥ |
yajamānasya yajñagṛhaṃ ᵛtanayāya putralābhāya ᵛtmane ātmane ātmahitāya ᵛca ᵛyāthaḥ |
mā ᵛvāṃ vṛko mā vṛkīrā ᵛdadharṣīnmā pariṃ ᵛvarttamuta mātiṃ ᵛdhattam |
ayaṃ ᵛvāṃ bhāgo nihitaṃ ᵛiyaṃ ᵛgīrdasrāvime ᵛvāṃ ᵛnidhayo ᵛmadhūnām |
mā | ᵛvām | ᵛvṛkaḥ | mā | ᵛvṛkīḥ | ā | ᵛdadharṣīt | mā | pariṃ | ᵛvarttum | uta | mā | atiṃ | ᵛdhattam |
ayam | ᵛvām | ᵛbhāgaḥ | ᵛni'hitaḥ | ᵛiyam | gīḥ | ᵛdasau | ᵛime | ᵛvām | ᵛni'dharyaḥ | ᵛmadhūnām ||4||
he ᵛdasrau śatrūṇāmupakṣapayitārāvaśvinau ᵛvāṃ yuvayoḥ anugrahāditi śeṣaḥ |
ᵛvṛkaḥ hiṃsakaḥ araṇyaśvādiḥ ᵛmā ᵛdadharṣīt mām |
tathā ᵛvṛkīḥ vṛkyo hiṃsikā anyā api ᵛmā ᵛdadharṣīt |
tathā yuvāṃ ᵛmā ᵛpari ᵛvarttaṃ parito mā varjayataṃ mām |
ᵛuta api ca ᵛmātiṃ ᵛdhattam asmānatikramya anyasmai mā dattam |
ᵛvāṃ yuvayorthāya ᵛayaṃ ᵛbhāgaḥ bhajanīyo haviraṃśaḥ ᵛnihitaḥ |
tathā ᵛiyaṃ ca ᵛgīḥ stuterūpā vā'pi nihiteti śeṣaḥ |
he ᵛdasrau aśvinau ᵛvāṃ yuvābhyām ᵛime imāni ᵛmadhūnāṃ somarasānāṃ ᵛnidhayaḥ nidhānāni sthāpitāni |
yuvāṃ gotamaḥ purumīḻho atrirdstrā havate'rvase haviṣmān |
diśaṃ na diṣṭamṛjuyeva yantā me haveṃ nāsatyopa yātama || 5 ||
yuvām | gotamaḥ | ᵛpuru'mīḻhaḥ | ᵛatriḥ | ᵛdasrā | havate | arvase | haviṣmān |
diśam | na | diṣṭam | ᵛṛjuyā'iva | yantā | ā | me | havam | ᵛnāsatyā | ᵛupa | yātum ||5||
he ᵛdasrā dastrāśvinau ᵛyuvāṃ ᵛgotamaḥ ca ᵛpurumīḻhaḥ ca ᵛatriḥ ca maharṣayaśca eteṣu ekaikaḥ ᵛhavi- ṣmān san ᵛavase rakṣaṇāya yuṣmattarpaṇāya vā ᵛhavate āhvayati |
ᵛṛjugāminaṃ mārgajñaṃ ᵛdiṣṭāṃ ᵛdiśaṃ ᵛna gantavyāmabhimatāṃ diśaṃ prati yathā tathā cāmapi |
yathā adhvagāmī svagantavyasya śīghra- gamanāya mārgajñamṛjugāminamāhvayati tadvat |
gantā ᵛṛjunaiva mārgeṇa iṣṭāṃ diśamiva tathā yuṣmatprīṇanena mārgeṇa svābhimataṃ phalaṃ prāpnoti |
he ᵛnāsatyāśvinau ᵛme mama ᵛhavam āhvānamālakṣya ᵛupa ᵛyātama upagacchatam |
atāriṣma tamaspāramasya prati vāṃ stomoṃ aśvināvadhāyi |
atāriṣma | tamasaḥ | pāram | asya | prati | vām | stomaḥ | aśvinau | adhāyi | ā | iha | yātam | pṛthibhiḥ | devayānaiḥ | vidyāma | iṣam | vrajanam | jīradānum ||6||
he aśvinau yuvayoḥ prasādān vaasya vatamasaḥ tamanahetoḥ śreyaḥpratibandharūpasya duḥkhasya vapāraṃ paryantabhūmim vaatāriṣma uttīrṇāḥ smaḥ |
he vaaśvinau vavāṃ vaprati vastomaḥ stotram vaadhāyi akārītyarthaḥ |
yuvāṃ vadevayānaiḥ devagantavyairmārgaiḥ vaiha asmadyajñe vaā vayātam āgacchatam |
yasya niḥśvasitaṃ vedā yo vedebhyo'khilaṃ jagat |
tatra ‘ tā vām ’ itīdaṃ prathamamaṇḍalasya caturviṃśe'nuvāke pañcamaṃ sūktam |
pūrvasūkte ‘ ṣaṭ ’ ityu- ktatvāt ‘ sūktasaṃkhyānuvartate ’ iti paribhāṣātvān ṣaṭkam |
tathā ‘ āśvinaṃ vai ’ ityuktatvāt tuṣṭādiparibhāṣayā idamapyāśvinam |
‘ yuvo rajāṃsi ’ ityādīnāṃ pañca sūktānāṃ tṛtīyavarjitānāṃ prātaranuvākāśvinaśastrayorviniyoga uktaḥ |

tā vāmadya tāvaṃpuraṃ huvemocchantyāmuṣasi vahi̭rukthaiḥ | nāsatyā kuha̭ citsantā̭varyo̭ divo napātā sudāsta̭rāya || 1 || tā | vām | adya | tau | aparam | huvema | ucchantyām | upasi̭ | vahi̭ḥ | ukthaiḥ | nāsatyā | kuha̭ | cit | santa̭ḥ | arya̭ḥ | diva̭ḥ | napātā | sudā̭ḥtarāya || 1 ||
^v tā tau rakṣatvena prasiddhau ^v vāṃ yuvām ^v adya asmin yāgadine ^v huvema āhvayāmaḥ iti āśīḥ |
tathā ^v aparam aparasminnapi dine ^v tau yuvāṃ huvema |
aparamiśyetat aparasminnityarthe samabhivyāhārāt, ‘ adyā ca no maḻyatāparaṃ ca ’ (ṛ. saṃ. 2. 29. 2) ityādimantrāntare tathā darśanācca |
^v upasi upodevatāyām ^v ucchantyāṃ tamo vivāsayantyāṃ satyām |

ukte kāle he ^v nāsatyā asatyarahitau ^v divo ^v napātā dhulokasya napātayitārau natsthānīyāau vā ^v kuha ^v cit ^v santaḥ kutraciddeśe vartamānau yuvāṃ ^v vahiḥ stutervoḍhā ^v arthaḥ īrayitā stuterīśvaro vā īdṛśo'haṃ hotā ^v sudāstarāya atyarthaṃ śobhanahavirdātre yajamānāya tadarthaṃ tau yuvām ^v ukthaiḥ śastrairhuvemeti saṃbandhaḥ |
yasmādvahi̭ryo hotā ūrttugaṇakau yuvāṃ śaṃsati tasmādvayaṃ yajamānāḥ tau yuvāmāhvayāmaḥ iti ||

asme ū ṣu vṛṣaṇā mādyethāmutpaṇīrhatamumūryā mardantā | śrutaṃ me acchoktibhirmatīnāmeṣṭā narā ni caitārā ca karṇaiḥ || 2 || asme iti | ū~ iti | ṣu | vṛṣaṇā̭ | mādyethām | ut | paṇīn | hatam | ūrmyā | mardantā | śrutam | me | acchoktibhiḥ | matīnām | eṣṭā | narā | ni | caitārā | ca | karṇaiḥ || 2 ||
he ᵥvṛṣaṇā kāmānāṃ varṣakau aśvinau yuvām ᵥasme ᵥu asmāsveva ᵥsu ᵥmādyethāṃ suṣṭhu tṛpyatam |
tathā ᵥpaṇīn vaṇijo lubdhakānayaṣṭan ᵥut unmūlya ᵥhataṃ nāśayatama |
‘ūrmyaṃste pavitra ā’ (ṛ. saṃ. 9. 64. 11) ityādiṣu tathā prayogāt |
tādṛśau yuvāṃ ᵥme mama ᵥacchokkibhiḥ ābhimukhyakarairnirmalavedavākyaiḥ racitāḥ ᵥmatīnām |
manasādhanāḥ stutīḥ ᵥkarṇaiḥ ākarṣaṇasādhanaiḥ śrotraiḥ ᵥśrutam śṛṇutam |
he ᵥnarā netārau yuvāṃ khalu ᵥeṣṭā anveṣṭārau asmatstutīnāṃ tathā ᵥnicetārā labdhānāṃ tāsāṃ saṃcayakartārau |
śriye pūṣanviṣukṛtaiva devā nāsatyā vahatuṃ sūryāyāḥ |
vacyante vāṃ kakuhā apsu jātā yugā jurṇeva varuṇasya bhūraiḥ |
śriye | pūṣan | iṣukṛtā'iva | devā | nāsatyā | vahatum | sūryāyāḥ | vacyante | vām | kakuhāḥ | apsu | jātā | yugā | jurṇā'iva | varuṇasya | bhūraiḥ || 3 ||
savitā sūryo duhitaraṃ sūryāyāṃ pradātumanāḥ devānāhvaya sāmarthyasamīkṣaṇāya ājiṃ parikalpya yaḥ imaṃ jeṣyati sa eṣāṃ kanyākamukasahasraklṛptaṃ stotraṃ ca labhate ityakalpayat |
tamagniḥ prathamamajayat tamanu aśvināvapi jitvā agniṃ praṣṭavya ṛksahasraṃ kanyakāṃ ca alabhetām |
tau ca tairadvādibhiḥ prārthitau svaśaktasya kaṃścitkaṃcidbhāgaṃ tebhyaḥ parikalpya sūryā svayathe'dhārayatāmiti |
ayamitihāso brāhmaṇe ‘prajāpatitvaṃ somaśca rājñe’ (te. brā. 4. 7) ityatrāmnāta'smābhiḥ prathamāṣṭame ‘ā vāṃ patiśvaṃ sakhyāya’ (ṛ. saṃ. 1. 119. 5) ityatra prapañcitaḥ |
he poṣakau he ᵥnāsatyā asatyarahitau ᵥdevā devau yuvāṃ ᵥśriye śreyase śastrasya kanyāyāśca lābhāyetyarthaḥ |
ājidhāvanāya iṣuvacchīghramujagāminīṃ kṛtāveva santau ᵥsūryāyāḥ etannāmikāyāḥ savituḥ putryāḥ |
yasmādevaṃ tasmāt ᵥapsu ᵥjātāḥ karmasu saṃpāditāḥ ᵥkakuhāḥ śastrārūpāḥ stutayaḥ ᵥbhūraiḥ |
avicchinnapravāhasya ᵥvaruṇasya phalapratibandhakapāpanivārakasya yāgasya siddhayarthaṃ tatsaṃbandhinyaḥ ᵥvāṃ prati ᵥvacyante hotrādibhiḥ |
purātanā yāgakālāḥ yathā tadvat adyatanāḥ api ityarthaḥ |
pūrvakāle yathā yuvāmeva stuvanti tadvat idānīmapīti tātparyam |

asme sā vāṃ mādhvī ratirastu stomaṃ hinotaṃ mānyasya kāroḥ | anu yadvāṃ śravasyā sudānu suvīryya carṣaṇīyo madanti || 4 || asme iti | sā | vām | mādhvī iti | ratiḥ | astu | stomam | hinotam | mānyasya | kāroḥ | anu | yat | vām | śravasyā | sudānu iti su'dānu | su'vīryya | carṣaṇīyaḥ | madanti ||4||
he mādhvī madhupūṇapātrayuktāśvinau vāṃ yuvayoḥ saṃbandhinī sā prasiddhā ratiḥ dānam asme asmākam astu bhavatu |
tadarthaṃ mānyasya mananīyasya kāroḥ stoturagastyasya stomaṃ stutiṃ hinotaṃ prīṇayatam |

he sudānu śobhanaphaladānau vāṃ yuvāṃ śravasyā kīrterbhavasya vā icchayā yat yasmāt suvīryya yajamānāya śobhanabalāya vā carṣaṇīyaḥ manuṣyā ṛtvijo vā anu madanti anukramena mādyanti yuvābhyāṃ saha svayaṃ vā ||

eṣa vāṃ stomo aśvināvakāri mānebhirmaghavānā suvṛkti | yātaṃ vṛtistanayāya tmanai cāgastyai nāsatyā madantā || 5 || eṣaḥ | vām | stomaḥ | aśvinau | akāri | mānebhiḥ | maghavānā | su'vṛkti | yātam | vṛtiḥ | tanayāya | tmanai | ca | agastyai | nāsatyā | madantā || 5 ||
he aśvinau he maghavānā havirlakṣaṇāśvantau vāṃ yuvābhyām eṣaḥ stomaḥ stotraṃ suvṛkti suṣṭhu pāpavarjanaṃ yathā bhavati tathā |
he nāsatyā asatyarahitau yuvām agastye etannāmni maharṣau mayi madantā mādyantau santau vṛtiḥ gṛhaṃ yajñasaṃbandhi vā yātaṃ prāputam |
tanayāya putrādilābhāya tmanai ātmane ca hitāya ||

atāriṣma tama̭saspāramasya prati vāṃ stomo aśvināvadhāyi | eha yātaṃ pṛthibhirdevayānairvidyāmeṣaṃ vṛjanaṃ jīradānum || 6 || atāriṣma | tama̭saḥ | pāram | asya | prati | vām | stomaḥ | aśvinau | adhāyi | ā | iha | yātam | pṛthibhiḥ | devayānaiḥ | vidyām | iṣam | vṛjanam | jīradānum ||6||
iti khaṇḍe sūtritaṃ- ' katarā pūrvāsāneti vaiśvadevam ' ( āśva. śrau. 7. 7 ) iti |
katarā pūrvā katarāparāyoḥ kuthā jāte kavayaḥ ko vi veda |
viśvaṃ tmanā vibhṛto yad nāma vi vartate ahanī cakriyaiva |
katarā | pūrvā | katarā | aparā | ayoḥ | kuthā | jāte iti | kavayaḥ | kaḥ | vi | veda | viśvam | tmanā | vibhṛtaḥ | yat | ha | nāma | vi | vartate iti | ahanī iti | cakriyā'iva ||1||
tathā vkathā kena hetunā vjāte kimānayorūpādanamityarthaḥ |
he vkavayaḥ krāntadarśino'tīndriyajñāḥ yūyaṃ vadata vko vvi vveda paurvāparya kāraṇaṃ ca viśeṣeṇa vivicya vā jānāti |
vyad yasmātkhalu hetoḥ vnāma prasiddhaṃ vviśvaṃ kṛtsnamapi jagat aviśeṣeṇa vtmanā ātmanaiva anya- nairapekṣyeṇaiva vvibhṛtaḥ dhārayataḥ |
yad nāma yatkiñcit padārthajātam asti viśvaṃ tatsarvamātmanā vibhṛtaḥ |
anena yatkāraṇaṃ brūmastadapi ābhyāmeva śriyate iti kāraṇābhāvaḥ pratipāditaḥ |
vahanī ete dyāvāpṛthivyau vcakriyeva cakrayukte iva vvi vvartate |
atra ' katarā pūrvā katarāparainayoḥ ' ( niru. 3. 22 ) ityādi niruktaṃ draṣṭavyam |
bhūri dve acarantī carantaṃ padvantaṃ garbhamapadīṃ dadhāte |
nityaṃ na sunuṃ pitrorupasthe dyāvā rakṣataṃ pṛthivī no abvāt |
bhūrim | dve iti | acarantī iti | carantam | padvantam | garbham | apadīm iti | dadhāte iti | nityam | na | sunum | pitroḥ | upasthe | dyāvā | rakṣatam | pṛthivī iti | naḥ | abvāt ||2||
vacarantī avicale vdve eva ete dyāvāpṛthivyau vbhūri bahutarāṃ vcarantaṃ vpadvantaṃ pādayuktaṃ vgarbhaṃ garbhamāśritaṃ kṛtsnaṃ prāṇijātam vapadī svayaṃ pādarahite vdadhāte dhārayataḥ |
anayormadhye khalu sarvaṃ jagat kṣemeṇa vartate |
vpitroḥ mātāpitroḥ vupasthe utsaṅge vartamānaṃ vnityaṃ dhruvātmajaṃ vsunuṃ vna putramiva yathā snehena vardhayantau dhārayantau mātāpitarau tadvat |
vnaḥ asmān vabvāt mahato bhayehatoḥ pāpāt vrakṣataṃ pālayatam |
dvandve kṛtatvādeśasya dyāvāpṛthivīśabdasya madhye rakṣatam iti padaprayogaśchāndasaḥ |

aneho dātramaditeranṷ huve svarva̭da॒vadhaṃ na̭rmasvat | tadro̭dasī janayataṃ jari॒tre dyāvā̭ rakṣataṃ pṛthi॒vī no̭ a॒mvāt || 3 || anehaḥ | dātram | aditeḥ | anarvam | huve | svaḥ'vat | avadham | narmasvat | tat | rodasī iti̭ | janayatam | jaritrḙ | dyāvā̭ | rakṣatam | pṛthi॒vī iti̭ | naḥ | a॒mvāt ||3||
akhaṇḍanīyāyāḥ pṛthivyāḥ tādṛśyāstvantarikṣasya ca sambandhi ^dātraṃ dhanaṃ ^huve āhvayāmi spṛhayāmītyarthaḥ |
^svarvat sarvataḥ phalabhūtena svargeṇa tadvat ^avadham ahiṃsitaṃ ^namasvat annavat |
^tat asmābhiḥ kāṅkṣitamukthalakṣaṇaṃ dhanaṃ he ^rodasī dyāvāpṛthivyau ^jaritre stotre yajamānāya ^janayatam utpādayatam |

ata̭pyamāne avasāva̭ntī anṷ ṣyā॒ma ro̭dasī devaputre | ubhḙ de॒vānā̭mu॒bhayḙbhi॒rhrāṃ dyāvā̭ rakṣataṃ pṛthi॒vī no̭ a॒mvāt || 4 || ata̭pyamāne iti̭ | avasā̭ | ava̭ntī iti̭ | anṷ | ṣyā॒ma | ro̭dasī iti̭ | de॒vaputre iti̭ deva'putre | ubhḙ iti̭ | de॒vānā̭m | u॒bhayḙbhiḥ | ahrā̭m | dyāvā̭ | rakṣatam | pṛthi॒vī iti̭ | naḥ | a॒mvāt ||4||
^avasā svata'dhikena kenacit kṛtena avanena samṛddhyā ^atapyamāne anīśvare ||
^avasā annena ^avantī tarpayantyau ^devaputre devāḥ vyavahartāro manuṣyāḥ putrasthānīyāḥ |
lokadvayasthāḥ manuṣyāśca devāśca tadupajībhyatvāt putrāḥ ityucyante |
dyotamānānām ahrāṃ rātrīṇāṃ ca saṃbandhibhiḥ ubhayavidhaiḥ śītoṣṇādirūpaiḥ vilakṣaṇaiḥ dhanaiḥ^2 nimittabhūtaiḥ |

sa॒gaccha̭māne yu॒vatī॒ sama̭nte sva॒sārā॒ jāmī॒ pitro̭rupasthe | a॒bhiji̭ghrantī bhu॒vanasya॒ nābhiṃ dyāvā̭ rakṣataṃ pṛthi॒vī no̭ a॒mvāt || 5 || sa॒gaccha̭māne iti̭ sa॒m'gaccha̭māne | yu॒vatī॒ iti̭ | sama̭nte iti̭ sa॒m'ante | sva॒sārā̭ | jāmī॒ iti̭ | pitroḥ | upa'sthḙ || a॒bhiji̭ghrantī ityabhi'ji̭ghrantī | bhu॒vanasya̭ | nābhi̭m | dyāvā̭ | rakṣatam | pṛthi॒vī iti̭ | naḥ | a॒mvāt || 5 ||
pūrvaṃ saṃsṛṣṭe eva sasthau paścādviyujya vṛṣṭibivipī akurvantyau paścāt manuṣyaiḥ prārthitairdevaiḥ vivāhite sasthau saṃgate abhūtāmityāhuḥ |
vyuvatī niyatataruṇī miśrayantyau vā sarveṣu bhāveṣu vsamante samānāntike samānaparyante vā vsvasārā parasparaṃ svasvabhūte vjāmī bandhubhūte |
tathā ca nigamau-'divaṃ ca pṛthivīṃ cāntarikṣamatho svaḥ' (ṛ. saṃ. 10. 190. 3) 'yato dyāvāpṛthivī niṣṭatakṣuḥ' (ṛ. saṃ. 10. 31. 7) iti |
vpitroḥ sarvasya pitṛsthānīyayoḥ pālakayostayoḥ vupasthe utsaṅge sthitaṃ vbhuvanasya bhūtajātasya vnābhi bandhaka- mudakam vabhijivrantī abhighrāṇaṃ kurvantyau spṛśantyau |
urvī srbanī bṛhatī ṛtena huve devānāṃrvasā janiṃntrī |
dadhāte ye amṛtai supratīke dyāvā rakṣataṃ pṛthivī no abvāt ||
urvī iti | srbanī iti | bṛhatī iti | ṛtena | huve | devānām | avasā | janiṃntrī iti | dadhāte iti | ye iti | amṛtam | supratīke iti su'pratīke | dyāvā | rakṣatam | pṛthivī iti | naḥ | abvāt || 6 ||
vurvī vistīrṇe vsrbanī sadanādhārabhūte vbṛhatī mahatyau mahānubhāve vdevānām |
devamanuṣyādīnām vavasā prītyā nimittena vjanitrī vṛṣṭisyayojanitryau |
vṛṣṭyādevairdevānābhavasā tarpaṇena nimittena vṛtena yajñena ca nimittabhūtena vhuve āhvayāmi |
vye vsupratīke śobhanarūpe vamṛtam udakaṃ vdadhāte dhārayataḥ te yuvāmāhvayāmi |
urvī pṛthivī bahule dureaṃnte upa bruve namasā yajñe asmin |
dadhāte ye subhage supratūrtī dyāvā rakṣataṃ pṛthivī no abvāt ||

urvī iti | pṛthivī iti | bahule iti | dureaṃnte iti dure'ante | upa | bruve | namasā | yajñe | asmin | dadhāte iti | ye iti | subhage iti su'bhage | supratūrtī iti su'pratūrtī | dyāvā | rakṣatam | pṛthivī iti | naḥ | abvāt || 7 ||
vurvī uccyau mahatyau vpṛthivī pṛthivyau vbahule anekaprakāreṇa prathamāne bahvākāre vdureante viprakṛṣṭāntadeśe apāre ityarthaḥ |
īdṛśyau yuvām vasmin vyajñe vnamasā namaḥsādhanena stotreṇa
<sup>v</sup>ye <sup>v</sup>subhage śobhanabhāmye <sup>v</sup>supratī suprataraṇe śobhanadāne <sup>v</sup>dadhāte viśvaṃ jagat te yuvām upa bruve staumi ||
devānvā yaccukuma kaścidāgaḥ sakhāyaṃ vā sadamijjāspatiṃ vā |
iyaṃ dhīrbhūyā avayānameṣāṃ dyāvā rakṣataṃ pṛthivī no abvāt ||
devān | vā | yat | ckuma | kat | cit | āgaḥ | sakhāyam | vā | sadam | it | jāḥpatim | vā | iyam | dhīḥ | bhūyāḥ | ava'yānam | eṣām | dyāvā | rakṣatam | pṛthivī iti | naḥ | abvāt ||8||

he dyāvāpṛthivyau vayaṃ <sup>v</sup>devān devān prati <sup>v</sup>yat <sup>v</sup>kañcita <sup>v</sup>āgaḥ aparādhaṃ tattathāgakāle teṣāṃ- teṣām ayāgalakṣaṇaṃ <sup>v</sup>sadamit sarvadaiva <sup>v</sup>cukuma kṛtavanto vayam |
tāsāṃ patiṃ jāmātaraṃ <sup>v</sup>vā jāyāpatiṃ prati doṣāropaṇakalahotpāda- nādirūpaṃ yatsarvadeva ckuma |
<sup>v</sup>eṣām uktarūpāṇāṃ pāpānām apagamaṃ kartum <sup>v</sup>iyaṃ <sup>v</sup>dhīḥ yuṣmatstuti- rūpam idaṃ karma <sup>v</sup>bhūyāḥ bhūyāt bhavatu |
atra sarvatra prakārāntareṇa mantramantareṇa<sup>1</sup> rakṣataṃ rakṣatamiti prārthanaṃ tayoḥ aśvinyādibahumananāsaṃbhavāt<sup>2</sup> ucitameva |
tasmāt svasthāne eva sthite anukūle bhavatamityevaṃ prārthyate ||
ubhā śaṃsā naryā māmaviṣṭā mubhe māmūtī avasā sacetām |
bhūri̭ ci॒dyaḥ sudāstarāyeṣā ma̭danta iṣayema devāḥ ||
ubhā | śaṃsā | naryā | mām | aviṣṭām | ume iti | mām | ūtī iti | avasā | sacetām | bhūri̭ | ci॒t | aryaḥ | sudāḥ'tarāya | iṣā | ma̭dantaḥ | iṣayema | devāḥ || 9 ||
<sup>v</sup>ubhā <sup>v</sup>śaṃsā dyāvāpṛthivyobhayoḥ viṣayau ubhāvapi śaṃsau <sup>v</sup>naryā narebhyo hitau īdṛśyau ubhayāśraye stutī <sup>v</sup>mām aviṣṭāṃ rakṣatām |
prāṇibhyo hitakarau ubhau aihikāmuṣmikaviṣayau śaṃsau mām aviṣṭāṃ prāpnutām |
tathā ubhe api ūtī tayoḥ saṃbandhyanyorabhimānidevatyayoḥ avamā asmatparṇana nimittena sacetām |

he <sup>v</sup>devāḥ dyāvā- pṛthivyorantarbhūtāḥ <sup>v</sup>sarve'pi devāḥ <sup>v</sup>arthaḥ slotāro vayaṃ <sup>v</sup>sudāstarāya atiśayena śobhanadātratvāya <sup>v</sup>iṣā annena somalakṣaṇena <sup>v</sup>madantaḥ mādayantaḥ santaḥ <sup>v</sup>bhūri <sup>v</sup>cit |
‘ ṛtaṃ dive ’ iti dve dyāvāpṛthivīye paśau puroḍāśahavipoḥ anuvākye |
‘ agnīṣomau ’ iti khaṇḍe sūtritam- ‘ ṛtaṃ dive tadavocaṃ pṛthivyā iti dve ’ ( ābha. śrau. 3. 8 ) iti ||
ṛtaṃ dive tadavocaṃ pṛthivyā abhibhravāya prathamaṃ sumedhāḥ |
ṛtam | dive | tat | avocam | pṛthivyai | abhi'śrāvāya | prathamam | su'medhāḥ | pātām | avadyāt | duḥ'hatāt | abhīke | pitā | mātā | ca | rakṣatām | avaḥ'bhiḥ || 10 ||
kiṃca 'pitā pālako dyulokaḥ 'mātā sasyādernirmātrī pṛthivī 'ca ubhe 'avadyāt ninditāt' duḥkhātpākāt aṃhasaḥ sakāśāt 'pātāṃ rakṣatām |
idam | dyāvāpṛthivī iti | satyam | astu | pitaḥ | mātaḥ | yat | iha | upa'bruve | vām | bhūtam | devānām | avame iti | avaḥ'bhiḥ | vidhāmam | iṣam | vṛjanam | jīra'dānum || 11 ||
he 'dyāvāpṛthivī dyāvāpṛthivyau 'idam asmābhiḥ kriyamāṇaṃ stotraṃ 'satyamastu avitathaṃ bhavatu phalavadbhavatvityarthaḥ |
he 'pitaḥ dyauḥ he 'mātaḥ pṛthivi 'vāṃ yuvāṃ prati 'iha asmin yajñe 'yat stotram 'upabruve upetya bravīmi tatsatyamastu |
'ā na iḻābhiḥ' iti saptamaṃ sūktamekādaśarcamāgastyaṃ traiṣṭubhaṃ vaiśvadevam |
ā na iḻābhirvitaye suśasti viśvānaraḥ savitā deva etu |
api yathā yuvāno matsarsthā no viśvaṃ jagadabhipitve manīṣā ||
ā | naḥ | iḻābhiḥ | vitaye | su'śasti | viśvānaraḥ | savitā | devaḥ | etu | api | yathā | yuvānaḥ | matsarsthā | naḥ | viśvam | jagat | abhi'pitve | manīṣā || 1 ||

'naḥ 'vidyaye asmadīye yajñe 'suśasti | supo luk || suśāstibhiḥ śobhanaśaṃsanaiḥ stutibhiḥ | pradaiyaiḥ ratnaḥ saha | yadvā | 'iḻābhiḥ | tadāśriteṣu tācchabdyam | bhūmisthānāmirdevatābhiḥ saha | 'viśvānaraḥ |
sarvaprāṇihitakāryapriḥ vsavitā preraka ādityaśca vdevaḥ vetu' āgacchatu |
he vyuvānaḥ nitya- taruṇā yajñasya miśrayitāro vā yūyaṃ vnaḥ asmān vabhipitve abhipatanīye'smadyaśe vmanīṣā manī- ṣayā manasaḥ īkṣitutvena svecchayetyarthaḥ |
yadvā kṛtsnaṃ prapañcaṃ matstha tathā asmānapi |
vaiśvadeve paśau 'ā no viśve' ityeṣā havipaḥ puronuvākyā |
'ā no devānāmupahetu śaṃsa ā no viśva āskrā gamantu devāḥ' ( āśva. śrau. 3. 7 ) iti |
ā no viśva āskrā gamantu devā mitro aryamā varuṇaḥ sajoṣaḥ |
bhuvanyathā no viśve vṛdhāsaḥ karantusupāhā vithuraṃ na śarvaḥ |
ā | naḥ | viśve | āskrāḥ | gamantu | devāḥ | mitraḥ | aryamā | varuṇaḥ | su'joṣaḥ | bhuvan | yathā | naḥ | viśve | vṛdhāsaḥ | karan | su'sahāḥ | vithuram | na | śarvaḥ || 2 ||
vnaḥ asmākaṃ yajñaṃ vviśve sarve vdevāḥ vāskrāḥ śatrūṇāmāskandayitāraḥ ākramitāro vā vā vgamantu āgacchantu |
vmitro varyamā vvaruṇaḥ ca trayo'pi vsajoṣaḥ samānaprītayaḥ santaḥ āgacchantu |

kiṃtu vviśve devāḥ vnaḥ asmākaṃ vvṛdhāsaḥ vardhayitāraḥ vyathā vbhuvan bhaveyuḥ tathā vsupāhā suṣṭhu śatrūṇāmabhibhavena no'smadīyaṃ vśarvaḥ astraṃ vvithuraṃ hīnaṃ yathā vna vkaran na kuryuḥ tathā bhāgacchantu |
preṣṭhaṃ vo atithiṃ gṛṇīṣe'gniṃ śastibhisturviṇiḥ sajoṣaḥ |
asyathā no varuṇaḥ sukīrtiriṣaśca parṣadarigurtaḥ sūriḥ |
preṣṭham | vaḥ | atithim | gṛṇīṣe | agnim | śastibhiḥ | turviṇiḥ | su'joṣaḥ | asat | yathā | naḥ | varuṇaḥ | su'kīrtiḥ | iṣaḥ | ca | parṣat | ari'gurtaḥ | sūriḥ || 3 ||
he devāḥ vvaḥ yuṣmākaṃ vpreṣṭhaṃ priyatamam |
vturviṇiḥ tūrṇavaniḥ śīghraṃ saṃbhaktā vsajoṣaḥ yuṣmābhiḥ saha prīyamāṇaḥ |
yaḥ vturviṇiḥ śīghraṃ yajñasya saṃbhaktā vsajoṣaḥ yuṣmābhiḥ saha prīyamāṇaḥ |
vyathā yena prakāreṇa vnaḥ asmākaṃ vvaruṇaḥ etannāmako devaḥ vsukīrtiḥ śobhanakīrtimān vasat |
'sukīrti bhikṣe varuṇasya bhūreḥ' ( ṛ. saṃ. 2. 28. 1 ) ityādimantravarṇeṣu varuṇān sukīrtireva eṣaṇīyā |
varigurtaḥ ariṣu adātṛṣu sadā śabditaḥ arīṇāṃ hananāya uṣkuto vā vsūriḥ prerayitā ayaṃ varuṇaḥ viṣaśca annāni vparṣat pūrayet |
upa va eṣe narmasā jigīṣasānaktā sududhaiva dhenuḥ |
samāne ahanvimimāno arke viṣurūpe paryasi sasminbhūdhan ||
upa | vaḥ | ā | īṣe | narmasā | jigīṣā | ḍabhasānaktā | sududhā'iva | dhenuḥ | samāne | ahan | vi'mimānaḥ | arkam | viṣurūpe | paryasi | sasmin | ūdhan || 4 ||
he devāḥ vvaḥ vnamasa haviṣā namaskāreṇa vā vupa upetya vjigīṣā pāpānāṃ jigīṣayā veṣe icchāmi ||
' ipa gatau ' ityasya vā īpatervā gatyādyarthasya liṭi uttamaikavacane idaṃ rūpam ||
vsududhā vdhenuḥ viva sudogdhī dhenuḥ yathā dohāya dogdhuḥ gṛhamāgacchati tadvat |
vsasmin samāne vūdhan udhasyupanne vviṣurūpe nāna
uta ne īṃ tvaṣṭā gantyacchā smatsūribhirbhipitve sujoṣāḥ |
ā vṛtrahendraścarṣaṇiprāstuviṣṭamo narāṃ ne iha gamyāḥ ||
uta | naḥ | īm | tvaṣṭā | ā | gantu | accha | smat | sūribhiḥ | abhipitve | sujoṣāḥ | ā | vṛtrahā | indraḥ | carṣaṇiprāḥ | tuviḥ'tamaḥ | narām | naḥ | iha | gamyāḥ || 6 ||
tvaṣṭā devo'pi naḥ asmān accha abhiprāyatum īm idānīm imaṃ yajñaṃ vā ā gantu |
praśastaṃ yathā tathā abhipitve abhigantavye yajñe nimittabhūte sati sūribhiḥ stotṛbhirṛtvigbhiḥ |
tuviṣṭamaḥ bahutamo mahattamaḥ iha asmin karmaṇi narāṃ nṛṇāṃ naḥ asmākam uruguṇopetaḥ san ā gamyāḥ āgacchatu ||
uta ne īṃ matayo'śvayogāḥ śiśuṃ na gāvastaruṇaṃ rihanti |
tamīṃ giro janayo na patnīḥ surabhiṣṭamaṃ narāṃ nasantaḥ ||
uta | naḥ | īm | matayaḥ | aśva'yogāḥ | śiśum | na | gāvaḥ | taruṇam | rihanti | tam | īm | giraḥ | janayaḥ | na | patnīḥ | surabhiḥ'tamam | narām | nasantaḥ || 7 ||
uta api ca īm enaṃ taruṇaṃ nityayuvānamindraṃ matayaḥ asmatstutayaḥ aśvayogāḥ aśvasamānaprāsayaḥ rihanti āsvādayanti stuvantītyarthaḥ |
gāvaḥ dogdhyo dhenavaḥ śiśuṃ na śiśumima vatsamima taṃ yathā lihanti tadvat |
tamīṃ tamevainaṃ narāṃ narāṇāṃ yajamānānāṃ surabhiṣṭamam atiśayena surabhi janayaḥ phalasyotpādayitryaḥ giraḥ stutayaḥ nasantaḥ vyāpnuvanti |
janayaḥ na utpādayitryaḥ patnīḥ patyaḥ patimima ||
uta ne īṃ marutau vṛddhasaināḥ smadrodasī sarmanasaḥ sadantu |
pṛṣadaśvāso'vanayo na rathā riśārdaso mitrayujo na devāḥ ||
uta | naḥ | īm | marutaḥ | vṛddha'saināḥ | smat | rodasī iti | sa'manasaḥ | sadantu | pṛṣat'aśvāsaḥ | avinayaḥ | na | rathāḥ | riśārdasaḥ | mitra'yujaḥ | na | devāḥ || 8 ||
uta api ca naḥ asmadīyam īm idānīm enaṃ yāgaṃ vā marutaḥ smat saha api sadantu gacchantu | kuto deśāt | rodasī rodasyorvāpṛthivyoḥ sakāśāt | yadvā | rodasyāvapi gacchatām ||
vvṛddhasenā: vpravṛddhabalā: vsamanasa: vsamānamanaskā: vpṛṣadaśvāsa: vpṛṣṭharṇāśvā: |
vavanayo vna vyathaiva vnamanasvabhāvā: vrathā: vraṃhaṇasvabhāvā vrathavanto vvā |
vteṣām vattāra: vmitrayuja: vdevā: vna vmaitrīyuktā vvyavahartāra: vṛtvija viva |
vmaitrīyuktā vanye vdevā vyathā vgacchanti vtadvat |
pra nu yadeṣāṃ mahinā cikitve pra yuñjate prayuja

iyaṃ sā vo asme dīdhitiryajatrā apiprāṇī ca sadanī ca bhūyāḥ | ni yā deveṣu yatate vasuyurvidyameṣaṃ vṛjanai jīradānum || 11 || iyam | sā | vaḥ | asme iti | dīdhitiḥ | yajatrāḥ | api'prāṇī | ca | sadanī | ca | bhūyāḥ | ni | yā | deveṣu | yatate | vasuyuḥ | vidyam | iṣam | vṛjanam | jīra'dānum || 11 ||
he yajatrāḥ yaṣṭavyā devāḥ vaḥ yuṣmatsaṃbandhinī sā iyaṃ prasiddhā dīdhitiḥ dīptiḥ asme asmākam apiprāṇī sarvadā veṣṭayitrī sadanī ca nivāsavatī ca bhūyāḥ bhūyāt |
yā dīdhitiḥ vasūyuḥ vasumatī deveṣu ni yatate niyamena prayatnaṃ karoti |
tṛtīyā pañcamī ṣaṣṭhī saptamekā- daśī ca iti pañcānuṣṭubhaḥ |
tathā ca anukramaṇikā- ‘pituṃ nvaṣṭastutirgāyatraṃ svādyānuṣṭubhāṃ tṛtīyāmthe pañcamyādyāśca tisro'nuṣṭubhaḥ’ iti |
viniyogaṃ śaunaka āha- ‘pituṃ nvityupatiṣṭheta niyamañcamupa- sthitam |

pituṃ nu stauṣaṃ maho dharmāṇaṃ tarviṣīm | yasya trito vyojasā vṛtraṃ viparvamardyat || 1 || pitum | nu | stauṣam | mahaḥ | dharmāṇam | tarviṣīm | yasya | tritaḥ | vi | ojasā | vṛtram | vi'parvam | ardyat || 1 ||
ahamagastyaḥ nu kṣipraṃ pituṃ pālakam stauṣaṃ staumi |
mahaḥ mahāntaṃ dharmāṇaṃ sarvasya dhārakaṃ tarviṣīṃ balārambhakam |
yasya asya ojasā balena sāmarthyena tritaḥ vistīrṇatamaḥ prakhyātakīrtiḥ triṣu kṣityādisthāneṣu tāyamāno'pi indraḥ vṛtraṃ viparva vicchinnasaṃdhikaṃ yathā tathā ardyat hiṃsitavān ||
svādo pito madho pito vayaṃ tvāṃ vavmahe | asmākamavitā bhava || 2 || svādo iti | pito iti | madho iti | pito iti | vayam | tvā | vavmahe | asmākam | avitā | bhava || 2 ||
he ᵛsvādo āsvādanīya ᵛpito pālaka ᵛmadho mādhuryopeta ᵛpito he pānasādhanānna ᵛvayaṃ ᵛtvā svā ᵛvadhmahe sevāmahe |
urpa naḥ pitvā cara śivaḥ śivābhirūtibhiḥ | mayobhuradviṣeṇyaḥ sakhā suśevo advayāḥ || 3 ||
urpa | naḥ | pito iti | ā | cara | śivaḥ | śivābhiḥ | ūtibhiḥ | mayaḥ'bhuḥ | adviṣeṇyaḥ | sakhā | su'śevaḥ | advayāḥ || 3 ||
he ᵛpito yataḥ tvaṃ ᵛśivaḥ maṅgalaḥ ataḥ ᵛśivābhiḥ maṅgalayuktābhiḥ ᵛūtibhiḥ rakṣaṇaiḥ ᵛnaḥ asmān ᵛā ᵛcara āgaccha |
āgatya ca ᵛmayobhuḥ sukhasya bhāvayitā ᵛadviṣeṇyaḥ adveyyarasaḥ priyarasa ityarthaḥ |
ᵛsakhā sakhivatpriyakārī ᵛsuśevaḥ ata eva suṣṭhu sukhakaraḥ ᵛadvayāḥ dvayarahitaḥ uktaguṇa eva na tu tadvirahito bhavetyarthaḥ |
suśevo'dvayā manaḥkarmavisaṃvādarahitaḥ sakhā yathā mayobhuḥ adveyyaśca bhavati tadvat tvamapi bhavetyarthaḥ |
tava tye pito rasā rajāṃsyanu viṣṭhitāḥ | divi vātāiva śritāḥ || 4 ||
tava | tye | pito iti | rasāḥ | rajāṃsi | anu | vi'sthitāḥ | divi | vātāḥ'iva | śritāḥ ||4||
he ᵛpito ᵛtava tvatsambandhanaḥ ᵛtye te svādmalādi pad ᵛrasāḥ ᵛrajāṃsi lokān lokasthānā- rthān ᵛanu ānukulyena ᵛviṣṭhitāḥ vividhaṃ sthitāḥ |
ᵛdivi dyuloke'nta- rikṣe ᵛśritāḥ ᵛvātāḥ vāyavaḥ te yathā vyāptāstadvat |
tava tye pito dadatastvaṃ svādiṣṭha te pito | pra svādmāno rasānāṃ tuvigrīvāiverate || 5 ||
tava | tye | pito iti | dadata | tava | svādiṣṭha | te | pito iti | pra | svādmānaḥ | rasānām | tuvigrīvāḥ'iva | īrate || 5 ||
he ᵛpito pālakāḥ ᵛtye te svadarthino narāḥ ᵛtava bhoktāro bhavantīti śeṣaḥ |
he ᵛsvādiṣṭha svādutama ᵛpito pālaka ᵛtava tvadanugrahāt ᵛte tvāṃ ᵛdadataḥ prayacchanto bhavanti |
pravṛddhagrīvā eva pra īrate prakarṣeṇa gacchanti saṃcaranti |
bhūloke asāra eva haṭhādvā bhavantīti prasiddham |
tava rasānāmattāraḥ asaṃsyātagrīvā iva bhavanti rasānāṃ bāhutvāditi bhāvaḥ |
tve pito mahānau devānāṃ manau hitam |
tve iti | pito iti | mahānau | devānām | manaḥ | hitam | akāri | cāru | ketunā | tava | ahim | avasā | avadhīt || 6 ||
he pito mahānau pūjyānāṃ mahatāṃ vā devānām indrādīnāṃ manaḥ tve tvayi hitaṃ nihitam akāri kṛtam |
he pito tava cāru samīcīnaṃ ketunā tvat
samiddho adya rājasi devo devai: sahasrajit | dūto havyā kavirvaha || 1 || sama'iddha: | atha | rājasi | deva: | devai: | sahasra'jit | dūta: | havyā | kavi: | vaha ||1||
he agne vdevai: vyavahartṛbhirdevairvibha: vsamiddha: samyagdīpita: vdeva: ata eva dīpyamāna: samiddhe: vā devai: sahita: samiddha: san vadya asmin yāgadine vrājasi dīpśiṣe |
he vsahasrajit sahasrasya dhanasya etatsaṃkhyākānāṃ śatrūṇāṃ vā jeta: tata: vdūta: devānāṃ dūta: tadyajñādivātāṃhara: āhvātā vā |
vkavi: krāntadarśī hetvāsthaṃ vhavyā asmadīyāni havīṃṣi vvaha devebhya: prāpaya ||
tanūnapādyutaṃ yate madhvā yajña: samaṃjyate | dadhatsasriṇīriṣa: || 2 || tanū'napāt | ṛtam | yate | madhvā | yajña: | sam | ajyate | dadhat | sahasriṇī: | iṣa: ||2||
āpo'tra tanva ucyante ityuttvāt apāṃ napātayitā tāsāṃ nasā vā |
īdṛśo'gni: kṛtaṃ yajñaṃ yate gacchate anutiṣṭhate |
vsahasriṇī: etatsaṃkhyākān iṣa: annāni dadhat yajamānebhyo dhārayan ||
ājuhvāno na īḍyo devā~ ā vakṣi yajñiyān | agne sahasrā asi || 3 || ā'juhvāna: | na: | īḍya: | devān | ā | vakṣi | yajñiyān | agne | sahasra'sā: | asi ||3||
he vagne vājuhvāna: asmābhirāhūyamāna: san vīḍya: asmābhi: stutya: hṛpnāmaka: tvaṃ vna: asmadarthaṃ vyajñiyān yajñabhāja: vdevān ā vakṣi āvaha |
he agne tvaṃ vsahasrā asi apari-mitadhanasya dātāsi ||
prācīnaṃ barhirojasā sahasravīramastṛṇan | yatrādityā virājatha || 4 || prācīnam | barhi: | ojasā | sahasra'vīram | astṛṇan | yatra | ādityā: | vi'rājatha ||4||
vprācīnaṃ prāgagraṃ vsahasravīraṃ sahasrasaṃkhyākā vīrā: śatrūṇāṃ viśeṣeṇa īrayitāro devā: yasya tattādṛk |
vbarhi: vojasā mantralakṣaṇabalena upetā: ṛtvija: vastṛṇan ācchādayan |
yatra yasmin barhiṣi vādityā: adite: putrā: yūyaṃ vvirājatha vividhaṃ rājadhve tadarha: astṛṇan ||
virāṭ | samrāṭ | vimbvīḥ | prambvīḥ | bahīḥ | ca | bhūyasīḥ | ca | yāḥ | duraḥ | ghṛtāni | akṣaran || 5 ||

vimbvīḥ vimbyo vividhaṃ bhaviṣyaḥ prambvīḥ prambyaḥ prakarṣeṇa bhaviṣyaḥ bahīḥ vahvyaḥ bhūyasīḥ lokaprasiddhasaṃkhyābhiḥ ca bhūyasyaśca yāḥ duraḥ yajñagṛhadvāraḥ santi tāḥ ghṛtāni udakāni prāṇyupakārārtham akṣaran kṣaranti |
surukme iti su'rukame | hi | su'peśasā | adhi | śriyā | vi'rājataḥ | uṣāsau | ā | iha | sīdatām || 6 ||
surukme śobhanadīptābharaṇe prasiddhe supeśasā śobhanarūpe īdṛśyā~ ahorātradevate adhi adhikaṃ śriyā saundaryeṇa virājataḥ viśeṣeṇa dīpyete |
rātripāśca ubhe iha asmin dine ā sīdatām āgatya tiṣṭhatām āgacchatāṃ vā |
prathamā hi suvārcāsā hotārā daivyā kavī |
prathamā | hi | su'vārcāsā | hotārā | daivyā | kavī iti | yajñam | naḥ | yakṣatām | imam ||7||
suvārcāsā priyavacanau daivyā devāhā~ hotārā devānāmāhvātārī homaniṣpādakau vā kavī medhāvinau etau naḥ asmadīyam imaṃ yajñaṃ yakṣatāṃ yajatāṃ gacchatāṃ vā |
bhāratīḻe sarasvati yā vaḥ sarvā upabruve |
bhārati | iḻe | sarasvati | yāḥ | vaḥ | sarvāḥ | upa'bruve | tāḥ | naḥ | codayata | śriye ||8||
he bhārati | bharataḥ ādityaḥ | tasya saṃbandhanī bhāratī | tādṛśi dyulokadevate he iḻe bhūdevi he sarasvati | saraḥ vāgūdakaṃ vā | tadasyantarikṣadevate tādṛśi devi | etāḥ śriyādidevatāḥ | etā-
^yāḥ tisraḥ ^sarvāḥ ^vaḥ yuṣmān ^upamruve upetya staumi ^tāḥ yūyaṃ ^naḥ asmān ^śriye saṃpade ^codayata prerayata |
tvaṣṭā rūpāṇi hi prabhuḥ paśūnviśvāntsamānuje | teṣāṃ naḥ sphātimā yaja ||9|| tvaṣṭā | rūpāṇi | hi | prabhuḥ | paśūn | viśvān | sam'ānaje | teṣām | naḥ | sphātim | ā | yaja ||9||
^tvaṣṭā yajñasādhanapātrābhimānī devaḥ ^rūpāṇi yonau sṛṣṭāni retāṃsi rūpāṇi kartuṃ ^prabhuḥ ^hi |
‘yāvaccho vai retasaḥ siktasya ’, ‘tvaṣṭā rūpāṇi vikaroti’ (tai. saṃ. 1. 5. 9. 1-2 ) iti śruteḥ |
sa devaḥ ^viśvān sarvānapi ^paśūn asmadīyān gavādikān ^samānaje samyaganakti vyaktīkaroti |
^teṣām aktānāṃ paśūnāṃ ^sphātiṃ vṛddhiṃ ^naḥ asmadartham ^ā ^yaja sarvataḥ pūjaya kurviṣyarthaḥ |
upa tmanyā vanaspate pārtho devebhyaḥ sṛja | agnihvyāni siṣvadat ||10|| upa | tmanyā | vanaspate | pārthaḥ | devebhyaḥ | sṛja | agniḥ | hvyāni | siṣvadat ||10||
he ^vanaspate yūpāmimānideva ^tmanyā ātmanaiva ^devebhyaḥ agnyādibhyaḥ ^pāthaḥ paśurūpamannam ^upa ^sṛja utpādaya |
tvayi evaṃ kṛtavati sati ^agniḥ ^hvyāni havīṃṣi ^siṣvadat svadayatu svādīkarotu |
purogā agnirdevānāṃ gāyatreṇa samajyate | svāhākṛtīṣu rocate ||11|| puraḥ'gāḥ | agniḥ | devānām | gāyatreṇa | sam | ajyate | svāhā'kṛtīṣu | rocate ||11||
devānāṃ madhye yajñaṃ prati agnireva purogāmī |
^svāhākṛtīṣu svāhākāreṣu sarpasu haviḥpu dīyamāneṣu ^rocate atyarthaṃ dīpyate |
tadvārā yajña eva stūyate iti keṣāṃcit matam |
‘ agne naya ’ iti daśamaṃ sūktam aṣṭamaṃrāgasthaṃ traiṣṭabhamāgneyam |
‘ athaitasyāḥ ’ ityatra ‘ agne nayāgre bṛhajjyaṣṭhānāmuttamāduttamāstisra uddharet ’ ( āśva. śrau. 4. 13 ) iti sūtritatvāt |
atra śaunakaḥ- ‘ utpathapratipanno yo aṣṭau vāpi pathaḥ kvacit |
panthānaṃ pratipadyeta kṛtvā vā karma garhitam |
japecca prayato nityamupatiṣṭheta vāmalam ’ ( ṛgvi. 1. 151-153 ) iti |
ityatra sūtritam- ' agne naya supathā rāye asmāniti catasrabhiḥ pratyṛcaṃ hutvā ' (āśva. gṛ. 2.1.4) iti |
tathā ca sūtritam- ' agne naya supathā rāye asmān pāhi no agne pāyubhirajasraiḥ ' (āśva. śrau. 3. 7 ) iti |
' tadahaḥ prāyaṇīyeṣṭiḥ ' ityatra sūtritam-' agne naya supathā rāye asmānā devānāmpi panthāmaganma ' (āśva. śrau. 4. 3 ) iti |

agne naya supathā rāye asmānviśvāni deva vayunāni vidvān | yuyodhyasmajjuhurāṇameno bhūyiṣṭhāṃ te namauktiṃ vidhema || 1 || agne | naya | supathā | rāye | asmān | viśvāni | deva | vayunāni | vidvān | yuyodhi | as mat | juhurāṇam | ena
vacana: | tanayaśabdaḥ putravacana: | yaṃ sukhaṃ yoḥ mibhayitā bhava | yadvā | rogāṇāṃ śamanaṃ bhayānāṃ yāvanaṃ ca bhava kurvityarthaḥ ||
agne | tvam | asmat | yuyodhi | amīvāḥ | anamitrāḥ | abhi | amanta | kṛṣṭīḥ | punaḥ | asmabhyam | suvitārya | deva | kṣām | viśvebhiḥ | amṛtaiḥ | yajatra || 3 ||
he agne tvam amīvāḥ rogān asmat asmasaḥ yuyodhi vyāvartaya |
yāḥ anamitrāḥ agninā apālitāḥ kṛṣṭīḥ prajāḥ abhyamanta abhimamate'smān ||
tā anamitrāḥ pāpinyaḥ kṛṣṭayaḥ prajā abhyamanta |

mā nau agne'va sṛjo aghāyāviṣyave ripave ducchunāyai | mā datvate darśate mādatai no mā rīṣate sahasāvanparā dāḥ || 5 || mā | naḥ | agne | ava | sṛjaḥ | aghāya | aviṣyave | ripave | ducchunāyai | mā | datvate | darśate | mā | adatai | naḥ | mā | rīṣate | sahasāvan | parā | dāḥ || 5 ||
he agne naḥ asmān aghāya hiṃsakāya aviṣyave |
tasmai ripave mā ava sṛjaḥ mā tyākṣīḥ |
tathā naḥ asmān datvate dantavate darśate khādate sarpādaye mā ava sṛjaḥ |
tathā naḥ asmān adate adantakāya śṛṅgādibhirghātine mā ava sṛjaḥ |
tathā ripate hiṃsakāya taskararākṣasādye he sahasāvan sahasvina mā parā dāḥ parābhūtaṃ mā dehi sarvathā na dehītyarthaḥ ||

vi ghna tvāṃ ṛtajāta yaṃsadguṇāno agne tanvaṃ varūtham | viśvādririkṣota vā ninitsorābhihutāmasi hi deva viṣpaṭ || 6 || vi | ghna | tvāṃ | ṛta'jāta | yaṃsat | guṇānaḥ | agne | tanvaṃ | varūtham | viśvāt | ririkṣāḥ | uta | vā | ninitsaḥ | abhi'hutām | asi | hi | deva | viṣpaṭ || 6 ||
he ṛtajāta yajñārthamutpanna agne varūthaṃ varaṇīyaṃ tvāṃ tanve śarīrapoṣāya guṇānaḥ stuvan tvāvān tvayā devatayā tadvān janaḥ vi ghna yaṃsat vimuñcati khalu ātmānam |
he deva abhihutām abhimukhena kuṭilaṃ kurvatāṃ dvipāṃ viṣpad viśeṣeṇa bādhakaḥ asi hi |
ataḥ tvadanugrahāt ayaṃ jano vi yaṃsat ||

tvaṃ tā~ agma ubhayānvi vidvānnerṣi prapitve manuṣo yajatra | abhipitvaṃ manave śāsyo bhūrmumajenya uśigbhirnākraḥ || 7 || tvam | tān | agne | ubhayān | vi | vidvān | verṣi | pra'pitve | manuṣaḥ | yajatra | abhi'pitve | manave | śāsyaḥ | bhūḥ | murmajenyaḥ | uśika'bhiḥ | na | akraḥ || 7 ||
he yajatra yaṣṭavya agne tvaṃ tān yaṣṭavyadṛṣṭān ubhayān manuṣaḥ manuṣyān vivicya vidvān jānan prapitve saṃnihite eva kāle verṣi kāmayase yaṣṭum |
tathā kurvan akraḥ ākramitā tvaṃ manave |
manuṣyasya yajamānasya abhipitve abhiprāptakāle'bhigamanavati yajñe vā śāsyaḥ bhūḥ śikṣaṇīyo bhava |
idaṃ kuru idaṃ kuru iti vidheyo bhava |
murmajenyaḥ śodhayitā yaja- mānaḥ uśigbhiḥ kāmayamānairṛtvigbhiriva ||

avocāma nivacanānyasminmānasya sunuḥ sahasāne agnau | vayaṃ sahasramṛbhiḥ sanema vidyāmeṣaṃ vṛjanaṃ jīradānum || 8 || avocāma | nivacanāni | asmin | mānasya | sunuḥ | sahasāne | agnau | vayam | sahasram | ṛbhiḥ | sanema | vidyām | iṣam | vṛjanam | jīradānum || 8 ||
vayam vasmin agnau vnivacanāni niyamapūrvakāṇi vacāṃsi stotrarūpāṇi vavocāma brūmaḥ |
mānasya sunau vsahasāne śatrūṇāmabhibhavitāra vagnau avocāma |
vvayam ebhiḥ vṛṣibhiḥ atīndriyārthaprakāśakairmantraiḥ sādhanaiḥ vsahasram aparimitaṃ dhanaṃ vsanema saṃbhajemahi |

tamutvayā upa vācaḥ sacante sargo na yo daivyatāmarsarji | bṛhaspatiḥ sa śaṅkho varāṃsi vimvāmvatsamute mātariśvā || 2 || tam | ṛtviyāḥ | upa | vācaḥ | sacante | sargaḥ | na | yaḥ | deva'yatām | asarji | bṛhaspatiḥ | saḥ | hi | aṅgaḥ | varāṃsi | vi'mvā | arṇavat | sam | ṛte | mātariśvā ||2||
vtaṃ bṛhaspatim vṛtviyā varṣartusambandhinyaḥ vvācaḥ mādhyamikāḥ vupa vsacante samīpe sevante |
ṛtviyāḥ prāsakālīnā vācaḥ hotrādipreritā vācaḥ upa sacante taṃ yaḥ sargo na udakasṛṣṭiriva |
vsaḥ sa eva vbṛhaspatiḥ vaṅgaḥ vhi vyañjakaḥ khalu |
ata eva vvimvā vibhuvyāptaḥ vmātariśvā vṛṣṭinirmātari antarikṣe ceṣṭamāno vāyusadṛśo vā vvarāṃsi varaṇīyāni vṛṣṭyādiphalāni saṃpādayan vṛte udake nimitta- bhūte sati vsam vabhavat saṃbhūtaḥ |
aṅgo yajñānāṃ vyañjakaḥ 2 mātariśvā phalasya nirmātari yajñe śrasitā vartamānaḥ sa bṛhaspatirṛte yajñe nimittabhūte sati varāṃsi varaṇīyāni havīṃṣīcchan vimvā vibhuḥ samabhavat ||

upastutiṃ narmas udyatiṃ ca ślokaṃ yaṃsatsaviteva pra bāhū | asya ṛtvahvanyo3 yo asti mṛgo na bhīmo arakṣasastuviṣmān || 3 || upa'stutim | narmasaḥ | uta'dyatim | ca | ślokam | yaṃsat | savitā'iva | pra | bāhū iti | asya | ṛtvā | ahvanyaḥ | yaḥ | asti | mṛgaḥ | na | bhīmaḥ | arakṣasaḥ | tuviṣmān ||3||
ayaṃ bṛhaspatiḥ vupastutiṃ yajamānenopetya kriyamāṇāṃ stutiṃ vnamasaḥ havirlakṣaṇasyāṅgasya vudyatim udgāraṃ vca vślokam anyo yo mantraviśeṣo'sti taṃ ca vpra vyaṃsat prakarṣeṇa yatate svīkartum |
yajamānapradānapakṣe savitā sarvasya prasavitā sūrye iva |
sa yathā bāhubhyaḥ prakāśādi prayacchati tadvat vbāhū bāhubhyāṃ yajamāno'pītyarthaḥ |

varakṣasaḥ svavirodha- rakṣorahitasya vasya bṛhaspateḥ vṛtvā karmaṇā sāsadhyaina vahanmyaḥ aṅgi sādhuḥ vyaḥ sūryaḥ vasti saḥ vbhīmaḥ vna vmṛgaḥ iva bhayanakaḥ siṃhādiva bhīmo bhayahetuḥ vtuviṣmān balavān paribhramatīti śeṣaḥ |
yasya māhātmyena mantrābhimānino bṛhaspateḥ sāmarthyāt mantrādyasurāñjitvātitejasvī bhavati tādṛśo mahānubhāvo yajamānadattaṃ havirādikaṃ svīkarotītyarthaḥ ||

asya ślokau dvivīryate pṛthivyāmatyo na yaṃsadyabhṛdvicetāḥ | mṛgāṇāṃ na hetayo yanti cemā bṛhaspaterahimāyā~ abhi dhūn || 4 || asya | ślokaḥ | divi | īyate | pṛthivyām | asyaḥ | na | yaṃsat | yakṣa'bhṛt | vicetāḥ | mṛgāṇām | na | hetayaḥ | yanti | ca | imāḥ | bṛhaspateḥ | ahi'māyān | abhi | dhūn ||4||
Vasya bṛhaspateḥ Vślokaḥ stutyātmikā kīrtiḥ garjitavāk vā Vdivi dyotamāne dyuloke Vpṛthivyāṃ ca Vīyate gacchati vyāpnoti |
yo bṛhaspatiḥ Vasyo Vna atanaśīla āditya iva Vyakṣabhṛt pūjitaṃ havirādikaṃ dadhānaḥ Vvicetāḥ vividhaṃ cetayitā prāṇināṃ viśiṣṭaprajñāyukto vā Vyaṃsat niyacchati phalam |
kiṃca Vmṛgāṇāṃ hantumanviṣyatāṃ Vhetayaḥ Vna āyudhānīvāsya Vbṛhaspateḥ Vimāḥ hetayo hiṃsrāṇi āyudhāni Vyanti gacchanti Vca ||
Vahimāyān bhāgamya hantyo'ntarikṣacāriṇyo vā māyā yeṣāṃ vṛtrādīnāṃ tānasurān Vdhūn divasān |

ye tvā devolkiṃ manyamānāḥ pāpā bhadramupajīvanti prajāḥ | na duṣṭaye anu dadāsi vāmaṃ bṛhaspate caryasa ityaryārum || 5 || ye | tvā | deva | ulkim | manyamānāḥ | pāpāḥ | bhadram | upa'jīvanti | prajāḥ | na | duḥ'ṣyai | anu | dadāsi | vāmam | bṛhaspate | caryase | it | paryārum || 5 ||
he Vdeva bṛhaspate Vye Vpāpāḥ pāpabuddhayo'lpāḥ Vprajāḥ havilakṣaṇājavataḥ pāpena jīrṇā vā narāḥ Vbhadraṃ kalyāṇaṃ Vtvā tvām Vulkim |
kutsitāmalakṣmīrollāviṇīṃ gāṃ jīrṇa- manugrāhaṃ vā Vmanyamānāḥ Vupajīvanti upetya prāṇanti asyaṃ yācante ityarthaḥ |
Vdurbuddhibhyastebhyaḥ Vvāmaṃ vananīyaṃ dhanaṃ Vna Vanu Vdadāsi anukūlaṃ na vitarasi |
he Vbṛhaspate deva Vpiyāruṃ lomapānaśīlaṃ somena yaṣṭāraṃ mahāphalaripsuṃ tu Vcayase Vit gacchasyevānupra- hītum ||
' bṛhaspate yathātayasi devapīyam ( niru. 4. 25 ) iti niruktam ||

supraituḥ sūryavaso na panthā durniyantuḥ pariprīto na mitraḥ | anarvāṇau abhi ye cakṣate no'pīvṛtā aporṇuvanto asthuḥ || 6 || supraituḥ | sūryavasoḥ | na | panthāḥ | duḥ'niyantuḥ | pari'prītaḥ | na | mitraḥ | anarvāṇau | abhi | ye | cakṣate | naḥ | api'vṛtāḥ | apaḥ'ūrṇuvantaḥ | asthuḥ || 6 ||
he bṛhaspate tvaṃ supanthaḥ suṣṭhu gantumarhasyasya suvavasaḥ śobhanāsya panthāḥ na mārga iva suṣṭhu yajñamārgagāminaḥ suvavasaḥ panthā iva sukhakārī bhavetyarthaḥ |
kiṃca durniyantuḥ duḥkhena niyamituḥ rājaḥ parimitaḥ sarvaprakāreṇa saṃtuṣṭo dveṣarahitaḥ mitraḥ na suhṛnmantrīca |
sa yathā durnayāt nivartayati tadvat tvamapi tathā asmabhyaṃ kurvityarthaḥ |
sakhivat amārgajñasyavat mārgaṃ yajñādirūpe yojayitvā tatrāpi phalaprado bhavetyarthaḥ |
kiṃca anarvāṇaḥ apāpāḥ ye narāḥ naḥ asmān abhi ābhimukhyena cakṣate bodhayanti te apīvṛtāḥ ajñānenāvṛtā api apoṇuvantaḥ apagatāvaraṇavanto jñānavantaḥ asthuḥ tiṣṭhantu |
anarvāṇastvāmaprāpnuvanto ye'smadrirodhino no'smānabhi cakṣate abhivadanti nindanti te'pīvṛtā ācchāditā rakṣitā api apoṇuvantaḥ apagatasarakṣaṇā bhavanti ||
‘saṃ yaṃ stubhaḥ’ ityeṣā bārhaspatye paśau puroḍāśasya yājyā |
sūtritaṃ ca- ‘saṃ yaṃ stubho'vanayo na yantyevā pitre’ (āśva. śrau. 3. 7) iti ||
saṃ yaṃ stubho'vanayo na yanti samudraṃ na sravataḥ rodhacakrāḥ |
sa vidvān ubhayaṃ caṣṭe antarbṛhaspatistara āpaśca gṛdhraḥ ||
sam | yam | stubhaḥ | avanayaḥ | na | yanti | samudram | na | sravataḥ | rodha'cakrāḥ | saḥ | vidvān | ubhayam | caṣṭe | antaḥ | bṛhaspatiḥ | taraḥ | āpaḥ | ca | gṛdhraḥ || 7 ||
yaṃ bṛhaspati stubhaḥ stotrāṇi avanayo na sarvā avanayo bhūmayo manuṣyā yathā svāminaṃ karma prati vā saṃ yanti saṃgacchanti tadvat tathā samudraṃ rodhacakrāḥ |

rodhanaśīlāni cakrāṇi yāsu tāstādṛśyaḥ kūlaṃ kramamāṇāḥ vā sravataḥ sravantyo nadyo yathā yanti tadvat sarvā api stutayo yameva prāpnuvanti gṛdhraḥ gardhanaśīlo vṛṣṭimākāṅkṣamāṇaḥ saḥ bṛhaspatiḥ vidvān vakṣyamāṇa- bhijñaḥ taraḥ taraṇaṃ jalābhivṛddhim āpaḥ udakāni ca ubhayam antaḥ madhye sthitvā caṣṭe paśyati karotītyarthaḥ ||
sa naḥ stuto vīravaddhātu gomaddidyāmeṣaṃ vṛjanaṃ jīradānum ||
eva | mahaḥ | tuvi'jātaḥ | tuviṣmān | bṛhaspatiḥ | vṛṣabhaḥ | dhāyi | devaḥ | saḥ | naḥ | stutaḥ | vīra'vat | dhātu | go'mat | vidvān | iṣam | vṛjanam | jīra'dānum ||8||
mahaḥ mahān tuvijātaḥ bahurbhutpannaḥ tuviṣmān balavān vṛṣabhaḥ apāṃ varṣitā devaḥ bṛha- spatiḥ eva evaṃ stutiprakāreṇa dhāyi dhīyate stūyate ityarthaḥ |
saḥ stutaḥ devaḥ naḥ asmākaṃ vīravat putrādiyutaṃ gomat gobhiryuktaṃ phalaṃ dhātu karotvityarthaḥ |
1. sa-sa1-mārgagāmino mama sūyavasaḥ panthāḥ iva bhava |
atra yadyapi akṣarāṇi nyūnāni tathāpi vyūhena pūraṇī- yāni |
atrānukramaṇikā—‘kaṅkataḥ ṣoḍaśopaniṣadānuṣṭubhamastyathau viṣaśaṅkhāvānagastyaḥ prāgbīha- myādyāśca tisro mahāpaṅktayo mahābṛhatī ca’ iti |
atra śaunakaḥ—‘kaṅkato neti sūktaṃ tu viṣārtaḥ prayato japet |
mūlaṃ ca kṛtrimaṃ caiva japansarvamapohati’ (ṛgvi. 1. 154,-1 56 ) iti ||

kaṅkato na kaṅkata'thau satīnakaṅkataḥ | dvāviti pluṣī iti nyardhaṣṭā alipsata || 1 || kaṅkataḥ | na | kaṅkataḥ | atho iti | satīnakaṅkataḥ | dvau | iti | pluṣī iti | iti | ni | adṛṣṭāḥ | alipsata || 1 ||
vkaṅkataḥ alpaviṣaḥ kaścit vna vkaṅkataḥ tadviparīta'nalpaviṣo mahoragādiḥ |
takatergasthyarthasya varṇavyatyayena kaṅkata iti saran bhavati |
evaṃ vdvāviti alpaviṣamahāviṣabhedena jalasthalabhedena vā dvipakārāviti |
tathā vadṛṣṭāḥ adṛśyamānarūpā etatsaṃjakāśca kecidviṣadharāḥ evamuktaprakārā ye santi te nūnaṃ māṃ vni valipsata viśeṣeṇa limpanti |
kena evaṃ kṛtamiti na jñāyate iti bhāvaḥ ||

adṛṣṭanhantyāyatyathau hanti parāyatī | atho avaghnī hantyathau pinaṣṭi piṃṣatī || 2 || adṛṣṭān | hanti | āyatī | atho iti | hanti | parāyatī | atho iti | avaghnī | hantyathau | pinaṣṭi | piṃṣatī || 2 ||
vāyatī viṣadṛṣṭya sakāśamāgacchantī viṣanibarhaṇasādhanauṣadhiḥ vadṛṣṭān adṛśyamānānviṣadharān vhanti hinasti |
vatho api ca vparāyatī parāgacchantī saṃmārjana- samaye arvākpravṛttā vhanti nāśayati jalacaraviṣadharān |
॰atho api ca ॰pinaṣṭī peṣaṇakartrī haviṣyamāṇā bauṣadhiḥ ॰pinaṣṭi cūrṇīkarotyaviṣān |
athavā sarveṣu vākyeṣvaviśeṣeṇa sarvaviṣakāriṇāṃ nāśa uktaḥ ||
mauñjā adṛṣṭā vairiṇāḥ sarve sākaṃ nyalipsata ||
śarāsaḥ | kuśarāsaḥ | darbhāsaḥ | sairyāḥ | uta | mauñjāḥ | adṛṣṭāḥ | vairiṇāḥ | sarve | sākam | ni | alipsata || 3 ||
v taskāraiva hiṃsakāścaurā dṛśyante yathā tadvat |
v adṛṣṭāḥ aparidṛśyamānāḥ v viśvadṛṣṭāḥ viśvaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ yaiste tādṛśāḥ pratidṛśyante |
ato he narāḥ v pratibuddhā v abhūtana bhavata ||
dyaurvaiḥ pitā pṛthivī mātā somo bhrātāditiḥ svasā |

tatra tāvat he' sarpāḥ' v vaḥ yuṣmākaṃ v dyauḥ v pitā |

v su sutarāṃ v kaṃ sukhaṃ yathā tathā v ilayata īrayata gacchata |
pṛthivyantarikṣadyu- sthānasthāḥ sarpāḥ svasvasthānaṃ prāpnuta asmadarthaṃ3 mā kurutetyarthaḥ ||

sūryaḥ khalu na marāti na mriyate | no vayaṃ marāma | tadanugrahastatraiva viṣasya yojitatvāt bayamapi na mriyāmahe | ubhayoramaraṇe kāraṇamāha | hariṣṭhāḥ | harayoḍasthāḥ | teṣu sthita ādhipaḥ āre dūre asya viṣasya yojanaṃ prāpaṇaṃ cakāra | tadevocyate | he viṣa hatvā tvāṃ madhu amṛtaṃ cakāra | viṣasya viṣabhāvaṃ dūre'panodya amṛtocakāra iti | evaiva madhulā madhudātrī nirviṣīkartrī madhuvidhā | yade- tadādisyasya viṣayojanaṃ tena ca amutīkaraṇaṃ yadasti eṣā madhuvidhā || 15 ||
iyattikā śakuntikā sakā jaghāsa te viṣam |
so citru na marāti no vayaṃ marāmāre asya yojanaṃ hariṣṭhā madhu tvā madhulā cakāra |
iyattikā | śakuntikā | sakā | jaghāsa | te | viṣam | so iti | citru | nu | na | marāti | no iti | vayam | marāma | āre | asya | yojanam | hari'sthāḥ | madhu | tvā | madhulā | cakāra || 11 ||

iyattikā iyattāṃ kurvāṇā iyattāvatī vā | vālerayarthe | śakuntikā | śakuntaḥ śakunaḥ | tasya strī | tāṃ kapiñjalīmāhuḥ | sakā sā te tava viṣaṃ jaghāsa bhakṣitavatī | sā viṣahatrīti prasiddhā | so citru || sā u iti nipātasamudāyaḥ | ekaṃ padam || sāpi śakuntikā na mriyate nityapratipakṣatvādviṣasya | śiṣṭaṃ vyākhyātacaram | anena vidyāyāṃ yadehāhṛtaṃ viṣaṃ tasya śakunebhyaḥ ādityāya ca pradānamastītyuktaṃ bhavati ||
tāścitru na maranti no vayaṃ marāmāre asya yojanaṃ hariṣṭhā madhu tvā madhulā cakāra |
triḥ | sapta | viṣapuliṣkāḥ | viṣasya | puṣyam | akṣan | tāḥ | citru | nu | na | maranti | no iti | vayam | marāma | āre | asya | yojanam | hari'sthāḥ | madhu | tvā | madhulā | cakāra || 12 ||
viṣasya asmadāvarakasya puṣyaṃ poṣam akṣan adantu nāśayantu |
tāḥ ca na maranti na vayam api |

navānāṃ navatīnāṃ viṣasya ropaṇīnām | sarvāṃsāmagrabhaṃ nāmāre asya yojanaṃ hariṣṭhā madhu tvā madhulā cakāra || 13 || navānām | navatīnām | viṣasya | ropaṇīnām | sarvāṃsām | agrabham | nāma | are | asya | yojanam | hariṣṭhāḥ | madhu | tvā | madhulā | cakāra || 13 ||

triḥ sapta mayūrthyaḥ sapta svasāro agravaḥ | tāstai viṣaṃ vi jabhrira udakaṃ kumbhanīriva || 14 || triḥ | sapta | mayūrthyaḥ | sapta | svasāraḥ | agravaḥ | tāḥ | te | viṣam | vi | jabhrire | udakam | kumbhanīḥ | iva || 14 ||
tā yathā taddharanti tadvat nadyo mayūrthyaśca atiprabhūtaṃ harantu ||

iyatsakaḥ kuṣumbhakastakaṃ bhinadyasmanā | tato viṣaṃ pra vāvṛte parācīranu saṃvataḥ || 15 || iyattaḥ | kuṣumbhakaḥ | takam | bhinadmi | aśmanā | tataḥ | viṣam | pra | vavṛte | parācīḥ | anu | saṃvataḥ || 15 ||
٧kuṣumbhakaḥ kuṃ pṛthvīṃ sumbhati vilikhatīti sarpāṇāṃ kutsitaṃ sumbhayitā nigrahatā ٧kuṣumbhako nakulaḥ |
yadi na tathā sa karoti ٧tarka kutsitaṃ taṃ nakulam ٧aśmanā ٧bhinadmi vidārayāmi |
tataḥ evaṃ prayoge sati viśvaṃ pra vāvṛte viṣāvṛtādehāt viṣaṃ pravartate nirgacchatu |
parācīḥ parāṅganavatīḥ atidūragāḥ : saṃvataḥ saṃvibhāgavato diśaḥ anu lakṣīkṛtya digantaṃ prati gacchatu na māṃ prati gacchatvityarthaḥ ||
kusumbhakaḥ | tat | abravīt | gireḥ | pravartamānakaḥ | vṛścikasya | arasam | viṣamrasam | vṛścika | te | viṣama || 16 ||
evaṃ mahānubhāvena agastyamaharṣiṇā ucyamāne sati gireḥ sakāśāt pravartamānakaḥ pravartamānaḥ atiśīghramihāgacchan kusumbhakaḥ nakulaḥ tadabravīt tadvākyamācakhyau |
vṛścikasya etan viṣam arasam asāraṃ bādhakaṃ na bhavatītyarthaḥ |
tathā loke'pi sarvadṛṣṭamapi kimbādidaṃśanameva ato na bādhaḥ iti hi vadanti |
atha taṃ vṛścikaṃ prati nakula āha |
iti sāyaṇācāryaviracite mādhavīye vedārthaprakāśe dvitīyāṣṭake prathame maṇḍale caturviṃśo'nuvākaḥ prathamaṃ maṇḍalaṃ ca ||
